vidhistasya niṣaṇṇasya pīṭhe jānusame mṛdau| śuddhāktasvinnadehasya dinānte gavyamāhiṣam||27|| dvādaśāṅgulavistīrṇaṃ carmapaṭṭaṃ śiraḥsamam| ākarṇabandhanasthānaṃ lalāṭe vastraveṣṭite||28|| cailaveṇikayā baddhvā māṣakalkena lepayet| tato yathāvyādhi śrutaṃ snehaṃ koṣṇaṃ niṣecayet||29|| ūrdhvaṃ keśabhuvo yāvadaṅgulam------------------------| ---------------------------------------------------|30|

Sa. tasya-śirobastervidhānamucyate| niṣaṇṇasya-upaviṣṭasya narasya| kva ? pīṭhe jānutulye, tathā mṛdau-akaṭhine| kimbhūtasya narasya ? śuddho-vamanādinā, aktaḥ-tailādinā, khinnaḥ-khedena, deho yasya tasya śuddhāktakhinnadehasya| kadā ? dinānte,-aparāhne vibhāvaryāṃ vā| carmapaṭṭaṃ-gavyaṃ māhiṣaṃ vā, tathā dvādaśāṅgulavistīrṇaṃ, tathā śirastulyaṃ, tathā''karṇaṃ-yāvat, bandhanasthānaṃ yasya, tadevaṃvidhaṃ carmapaṭṭaṃ cailaveṇikayā saṃyamya māṣakalkena lepayet| kadā ? lalāṭe vastraveṣṭite| saṅgrahe tūktam (sū.a.31)-"atha śuddhatanoḥ sāyaṃ rātrau vā nivātasthasya svabhyaktakhinnasya sopāśrayāsanopaviṣṭasya keśānte ślakṣṇaṃ tryaṅgulaṃ māṣapiṣṭena susūkṣmeṇa sadyaḥ sukhāmbunā mṛditenobhayataḥ pradigdhaṃ vastrapaṭṭaṃ badhnīyāt| tatastasyopari sandhāya bastimākarṇaṃ bastimūlaṃ ca dṛḍhamavalīkaṃ samaṃ cailaveṇikayā baddhvā punarmāṣapiṣṭenāparistrāvi kṛtvā yathāvyādhidoṣadūṣyahitaṃ siddhamanyatamaṃ snehaṃ sukhoṣṇamāsecayet|" iti| tata evaṃ kṛte sati vyādhivaśena pakvaṃ snehaṃ koṣṇamupariccidreṇāvasecayet| keśabhūmerupariṣṭādaṅgulaṃ yāvat|

Ā. rā. śirobastividhimāha-vidhistasyeti| lalāṭaśabdena keśarahitaḥ pradeśaḥ, tasmin vastraveṣṭite| ākarṇaṃ-karṇādadho na veṣṭayedityarthaḥ, ābandhanasthānaṃ-yāvati pradeśe basterbandhanaṃ tāvantaṃ pradeśaṃ veṣṭayet| śiraḥsamaṃ-śiraḥparidhimityarthaḥ| veṣṭanavastramapyubhayato māṣakalkena lepayet| uktaṃ hi saṅgrahe (sū.a. 31)-"keśānteślakṣṇaṃ tryaṅgulaṃ supūkṣmeṇa māṣapiṣṭena sadyaḥ sukhāmbumṛditenobhayataḥ pradigdhaṃ vastrapaṭṭaṃ badhnīyāt|" iti|

sa ca snehaḥ kiyatkālaṃ dhāryaḥ ? ityāha ---- ----------------------------------dhārayecca tam| āvaktranāsikotkledāddaśāṣṭau ṣaṭ calādiṣu||30|| mātrāsahasrāṇyaruje tvekaṃ---------------------| ---------------------------------------------------|31|

Sa. taṃ ca-sneha, yāvadvaktranāsikāsrutiḥ syāttāvaddhārayet| cala ādiryeṣāṃ te calādayaḥ, teṣu yathāsaṅhkhyaṃ daśāṣṭau ṣaṭ mātrāsahasrāṇi yāvatsnehaṃ dhārayet| vāte daśa mātrāsahasrāṇi, pitte'ṣṭau mātrāsahasrāṇi, kaphe ṣaṇmātrāsahasrāṇītyarthaḥ| aruje tu-svasthavṛte, ekaṃ mātrāsahasraṃ dhārayet|
Ā. rā. bastidhāraṇāvadhimāha-dhārayediti| arujetvekaṃ mātrāsahasram| mātrāmānaṃ kledāsambhave| klede tvarvāgapi nivartate|

Sa. muktasnehasya-apanītaśirobasteḥ, skandhaśirogrīvādi mardayet| snehabastirhi snehaśabdenātra gṛhyate| tataḥ "uṣṇodakopacārī syāt " ityādikamācaret| tatra hyavocat (hṛ.sū.a.16|28)-"sarvakarmasvayaṃ prāyo vyādhikṣīṇeṣu ca kramaḥ|" iti|
Ā. rā. bastyante kṛtyamāha-skandhādīti|
Sa. tasya ca-snehabasteḥ, paramaḥ sekaḥ sapta dināni| tasmāttrīṇi pañca sapta vā'hāni kāryaḥ śirobastirityavatiṣṭhate|

Ā. rā. bastyāvṛttyavadhimāha-paramamiti| saṅgrahe tu (sū.a. 31)-"uṣṇāmbunā snātaṃ ca yathārhaṃ bhojayet| snehoktaṃ cāsyācāramādiśet| evaṃ trīṇi pañca sapta vā dināni yojayediti|" tathā (saṃ.sū.a. 31)-"sāpāśrayaṃ pīṭhaṃ, sāyaṃ rātrirvā kālaḥ, vedanopaśamo vā'vadhiḥ|" iti|

ab.seg: dhārayetpūraṇaṃ karṇe karṇamūlaṃ vimardayan| rujaḥ syānmārdavaṃ yāvanmātrāśatamavedane||32||

div.ab: Sa. karṇe pūraṇaṃ dhārayet| kiṃ kurvan ? karṇamūlaṃ vimardayan| kiyantaṃ kālam ? yāvatpīḍāyā mārdavaṃ bhavet| svasthavṛte tu mātrāśataṃ yāvadbibhṛyāt|
Ā. rā. karṇapūraṇe vidhiṃ mānaṃ cāha-dhārayediti|

ab.seg: atha mātrāyāḥ kiṃ pramāṇaṃ ? ityāha ---- yāvatparyeti hastāgraṃ dakṣiṇaṃ jānumaṇḍalam| nimeṣonmeṣakālena samaṃ mātrā tu sā smṛtā||33||

div.ab: Sa. dakṣiṇaṃ hastāgraṃ kartṛ yāvat dakṣiṇaṃ jānumaṇḍalaṃ paryeti-parivartate| dakṣiṇaśabdo'tra kākākṣigolakanyāyena dvayorapi yujyate| kiyatkālena ? ityāha-nimeṣonmeṣamātreṇa samaṃ,-na tu viśramya| sā mātrā smṛteti| munibhiriti śeṣaḥ|
Ā. rā. mātrālakṣaṇamāha-yāvaditi|

kacasadanasitatvapiñjaratvaṃ pariphuṭanaṃ śirasaḥ samīrarogān| jayati, janayatīndriyaprasādaṃ svarahanumūrddhabalaṃ ca mūrddhatailam|34| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ sūtrasthāne gaṇḍūṣādividhirnāma dvāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ|22|

Sa. kacānāṃ sadanādibhiḥ sambandhaḥ| pariphuṭanaṃ-kacānāmeva, prakṛtatvāt| śiraso marudāmayāṃśca hanti| indriyāṇāṃ-cakṣurādīnāṃ, prasādaṃ janayati| tathā, svarādibalaṃ ca mūrddhatailaṃ janayati| iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviraciṭayāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayaṭīkāyāṃ sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ sūtrasthāne gaṇḍūṣādividhirnāma dvāviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 22||
Ā. rā. mūrddhatailaśīlanasya phalamāha-kacasadaneti| iti hemādriṭīkāyāmāyurvedarasāyane| gaṇḍūṣādiprakaraṇaṃ sāmastyena nirūpitam|| 22||

div.head: āścātanāñjanavidhiradhyāyaḥ
div.ab: Sa. trayoviṃśādhyāyārambho jatrūrdhvarogaprastāvāllocanarogapratiṣedhārthamāha ----

ab.seg: athāta āścotanāñjanavidhimadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre||2||

div.ab: Sa. āścotanaṃ cāñjanaṃ ca, tayorvidhiryasminnadhyāye sa evam| śeṣaṃ pūrvavat|
Ā. rā. āścotanāñjanavidhimadhyāyaṃ vyākhyātuṃ pratijānīte-atheti|

ab.seg: sarveṣāmakṣirogāṇāmādāvāścotanaṃ hitam| ruktodakaṇḍūgharṣāśrudāharāganivarhaṇam||1||

div.ab: Sa. sakalānāmapi nayanāmayānāṃ prathamamāścotanaṃ-pariṣeko, hitam| yatastadāścotanamupayuktaṃ rujādighnaṃ syāt| saṅgrahe coktam (sū.a.32)-"avyakteṣveva rujādiṣu tulyaguṇaṃ pakṣmaparihāreṇāścotanenaivākṣikośālepanam| tacca biḍālakasaṃjñam|" iti|

Ā. rā. āścotanasya viṣayamāha-sarveṣāmiti| saṅgrahetu (sū.a.32)-"nānādravyakalpanayā ca rāgāśrugharṣarugdāhatodabhedapākaśophakaṇḍūghnam| avyakteṣvevaṃguṇameva pakṣmaparihāreṇākṣikośālepanam| tacca punarbiḍālasaṃjñam| tayorakālo rātriḥ| kālastu sarvamaharvedanotpattirvā|" iti|
uṣṇaṃ bāte, kaphe koṣṇaṃ, tacchhītaṃ raktapittayoḥ| ----------------------------------------------------|2|
Sa. tat-āścotanaṃ, marutyuṣṇaṃ, kaphe kiñciduṣṇaṃ, rakte pitte ca śītaṃ, hitam|
Ā. rā. āścotanasya doṣabhedenoṣnatvādi vidhatte| uṣṇamiti|

ab.seg: sampratyāścotanasya vidhimaaha ---- ----------------------------------------------------| nivātasthasya vāmena pāṇinonmīlya locanam||2||
śuktau pralambayā'nyena picuvartyā kanīnike| daśa dvādaśa vā bindūn dvyaṅgulādavasecayet||3||
tataḥ pramṛjya mṛdunā cailena, kaphavātayoḥ| anyena koṣṇapānīyaplutena svedayenmṛdu||4||

div.ab: Sa. nivātasthānasthitasyāturasya vaidyo vāmena pāṇinonmīlya locanamapāṅgadeśe bhājanaṃ nidhaya, anyena-dakṣiṇakareṇa, picuvartyā śuktyāṃ pralambayā daśa dvādaśa vā bindūn dvyaṅgulāt-nātinikaṭānnātidūrāt, kanīnike'vasecayet| tata iti anantaraṃ, komalena vastrakhaṇḍena pramṛjya-śodhayitvā, anyena-śodhanāt, cailena koṣṇajalaplutenākṣi mṛdu svedayet-nātiśayena| kayordoṣayoḥ? vātakaphayoḥ,-na tu pittaraktayorityarthaḥ|

Ā. rā. āścotanavidhimāha-nivātasthasyeti| anyena-dakṣiṇena hastena| śuktau pralambayā-śuktisthadravanimagnārddhayā| kanīnake-nāsāsaṃlagnanetrānte| vdyaṅgulāt-netravartyagrayorvdyaṅgulamantaraṃ kṛtvā| saṅgrahe tu (sū.a.32)-"evamasya na bindupātenākṣitāḍanādrāgādayo jāyante|" iti| āścotanāntaraṃ kṛtyamāha-tataḥ pramṛjyeti| pramārjanaṃ sarvatra| kaphavātayostvanyena cailena svedanaṃ ca|

ab.seg: atyuṣṇatīkṣṇaṃ rūgrāgadṛṅnāśāyākṣisecanam| atiśītaṃ tu kurute nistodastambhavedanāḥ||5||
kāṣāyavartmatāṃ gharṣaṃ kṛcchhrādunmeṣaṇaṃ bahu| vikāravṛddhimatyalpaṃ saṃrambhamaparisrutam||6||

div.ab: Sa. atyarthamuṣṇamatitīkṣṇaṃ vā''ścotanaṃ ruje-rogāya, rāgāya-lohitimre, dṛgvināśāya ca syāt| atiśītaṃ tvakṣisecanaṃ nistodādīn vidhatte| nistodaḥ-sūcyava vyadhaḥ| stambhaḥ akṣṇaḥ stambhanamiva| vedanā-śūlam| kaṣāyavartmatvaṃ kurute| gharṣo-vartmanoḥ parasparaṃ saṃśleṣaḥ| bahu-atimātraṃ, āścotanaṃ kṛcchhreṇonmeṣaṇaṃ vidhatte| atyalpamakṣisecanaṃ vikāravṛddhiṃ kurute| aparisrutamakṣisecanaṃ saṃrambhaṃ-vetrakṣobhaṃ, vidhatte|

Ā. rā. atyuṣṇatīkṣṇasyāścotanasya doṣamāha-atyuṣṇatīkṣṇamiti| atiśītasya doṣamāha-atiśītaṃ tviti| atimātrasya doṣamāha-kaṣāyavartmatāmiti| kaṣāyavartmatāṃ rūkṣavartmatvam| atyalpasya doṣamāha-vikāravṛddhimiti| netrādaparisrutasya doṣamāha-saṃrambhamiti| saṃrambhaṃ-śophādiprādurbhāvam|

ab.seg: kayā yuktyā netre prayuktamauṣadhaṃ doṣānapayati ? ityāha ---- gatvā sandhiśitoghrāṇamukhasrotāṃsi bheṣajam| ūrdhvagānnayane nyastamapavartayate malān||7||

div.ab: Sa. sandhyādīnāṃ dvandvaḥ| tataḥ srotaḥśabdena ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| sandhiśabdenehākṣikośasambandhinaḥ sandhayo gṛhyante| tena-akṣikośasandhisrotāṃsi śirāsrotāṃsi mukhasrotāṃsi gatvā nayane kṣiptabhauṣadhamūrdhvagān malānapavartayate|
Ā. rā. āścotanasya phalamāha-gatveti| netre nyastamauṣadhaṃ sandhyādīn gatvā jatrūrdhvagān rogān hanti|

ab.seg: athāñjanaṃ śuddhatanornetramātrāśraye male| pakvaliṅge'lpaśophātikaṇḍūpaicchhilyalakṣite||8||
mandagharṣāśrurāge'kṣiṇa prayojyaṃ ghanadūṣike| ārti pittakaphāsṛgbhirmārutena viśeṣataḥ||9||

div.ab: Sa. atha-āścotanādanantaraṃ, añjanaṃ prayoktavyam| kīdṛśasyāturasya? śuddhā tanuryasya saḥ, tasya| male netramātrāśraye-na tvadhikaśarīravyāpini| tathā, pakvaliṅge| pakvaliṅgatā kathaṃ vedyā? iti viśeṣaṇadvāreṇāha-alpaśophenātikaṇḍvā paicchhilyena ca lakṣite-avagate, 'pakvaliṅge sati| kīdṛśe'kṣiṇa? mandāḥ-alpāḥ, gharṣāśrurāgā yasya tasmin| tathā, ghanā dūṣikā-netramalo, yasminnayane tasmin| etadapi pakvaliṅgameva| pittena kaphena raktena cāture, mārutena cāture viśeṣeṇāñjanaṃ prayojyam|
Ā. rā. añjanasya viṣayamāha-athāñjanamiti| śophālpatvādyupalakṣīte pakalakṣaṇe sati, tathā gharṣādyalpatve dūṣikāghanatve ca|
lekhanaṃ ropaṇaṃ dṛṣṭiprasādanamiti tridhā| añhjanam-------------------------------------|10|

Sa. añjanaṃ ca lekhanādibhedena tridhā| likhyate-śastreṇeva, śukrārmādīnīti lekhanam| ropyate-saṃrohyate, abhiṣyandādīnīti ropaṇam| prasādyate-nirmalīkriyate, aneneti prasādanam| dṛṣṭeḥ prasādanaṃ dṛṣṭiprasādanam| saṅgrahe yat snehanamañjanaṃ kathitaṃ tadiha ropaṇadṛṣṭiprasādanayorevāntarbhūtatvāt pṛthaṅnoktam|
Ā. rā. añjanasya bhedānāha-lekhanamiti| saṅgrahe tu (sū.a.a 32)-"na doṣavegodaye, na cānirhṛtadoṣe| tatra hi doṣotkleśena rāgādivṛddhiḥ śukrapākatimirotpattiśca|" iti|
Sa. tatra-teṣu triṣvañjaneṣu madhyāt, lekhanamañjanaṃ kaṣāyādibhirdravyaiḥ śukrārmādiṣu prayojyam|
Ā. rā. lekhanasya dravyāṇyāha-lekhanamiti|
Sa. ropaṇamañjanaṃ tiktakairdravyaiḥ syāt| tiktagrahaṇamupalakṣaṇārtham| tena-kaṣāyadravyaiḥ saṃsnehaiḥ ropaṇamañjanaṃ vedyam|
Ā. rā. ropaṇasya dravyāṇyāha-ropaṇamiti|

--------------------------svāduśītaiḥ prasādanam| tīkṣṇāñjanābhisantapte nayane tatprasādanam||11|| prayujyamānaṃ labhate pratyañjanasamāhvayam| ----------------------------------------------------|12|
Sa. svāduśītairdravyaiḥ prasādanamañjanaṃ bhavati| prasādanameva svāduśītadravyaiśrūrṇaṃ tīkṣṇāñjanābhisantapte cakṣuṣi prayujyamānaṃ pratyañjanasaṃjñāṃ labhate|
Ā. rā. dṛṣṭiprasādanasya dravyāṇyāha-svāduśītairiti|

ab.seg: praśastā, lekhane tāmrī, ropaṇe kālalohajā| aṅgulī ca, suvarṇotthā rūpyajā ca prasādane||13||

div.ab: Sa. daśāṅgulā rājamāṣasthūlā śalākā praśastā| madhye tanuḥ| tathā, mukulākāre ānane-mukhe dve'pi, yasyāḥ sā mukulānanā| lekhanāñjane tāmrī śalākā praśastā| ropaṇe ca kālalohotthā(lohajā)-kṛṣṇaśastrodbhavā| aṅgulī ca-hastāvayavaviśeṣo, ropaṇa eva śastaḥ| evaṃ prasādane'ñjane suvarṇotthā kanakodbhavā, rajatodbhavā ca śalākā praśastā|
Ā. rā. śalākāmāha-daśāṅguleti| lekhane śalākāmāha-lekhane tāmrīti| ropaṇe śalākāmāha-ropaṇa iti| prasādane śalākāmāha-suvarṇottheti|

ab.seg: añjanakalpanā triprakārā syāt| katham ? ityāha---- piṇḍo rasakriyā cūrṇastridhaivāñjanakalpanā| gurau madhye laghau doṣe tāṃ krameṇa prayojayet||14||

div.ab: Sa. piṇḍādibhedena triprakārā'ñjanakalpanā syāt| piṇḍādayo bahudoṣādiṣu krameṇa prayojyāḥ| gurau doṣe piṇḍaḥ prayojyo, madhye doṣe rasakriyā, laghau doṣe cūrṇa ityarthaḥ|
Ā. rā. añjanakalpanābhedānāha-piṇḍaiti| piṇḍoguṭikā| rasakriyā-avalehaḥ| kalpanātrayasya viṣayatrayamāha-gurāviti|
hareṇumātrā piṇḍasya vellamātrā rasakriyā| tīkṣṇasya, dviguṇaṃ tasya mṛdunaḥ-------------|15|

Sa. tīkṣṇadravyakṛtasya piṇḍasya hareṇumātraṃ pramāṇaṃ kathayanti| mṛdudravyakṛtasya piṇḍasya tat dviguṇaṃ pramāṇaṃ-dvihareṇumātraṃ, vadanti| rasakriyāyā viḍaṅgapramāṇamāhuḥ| [mṛdudravyakṛtāyā rasakriyāyā dvivellamātram|]

Ā. rā. tīkṣṇayoḥ piṇḍarasakriyayormātrāmāha-hareṇumātreti| hareṇuḥ-reṇukā| vellaṃ-viḍaṅgam| mṛdyoḥ piṇḍarasakriyayormātrāmāha-dviguṇamiti| mṛdunaḥ-mṛdudravyakṛtasya| tasya-piṇḍarasakriyārūpasyāñjanasya| dviguṇaṃ pramāṇaṃ-piṇḍasya hareṇudvayaṃ, rasakriyāyā velladvayam|

Sa. cūrṇe tīkṣṇe dviguṇāṃ śalākaṃ, mṛdau triguṇāṃ śalākāmabhidadhuḥ| tantrāntare coktam-"lekhanamañjanaṃ tāmrarajatakāṃsyādyanyatameṣu dhāryam| ropaṇaṃ suvarṇavaṭaśaṅkhānyatameṣu| prasādanaṃ sphaṭikaplakṣacandanānyatameṣu dhāryam| evaṃ hyañjanamavyāpannaguṇaṃ bhavati| vartergharṣaṇārthaṃ śilā nimramadhyā'nudgāriṇī pañcāṅgulāyatā tryaṅgulavistārā|" iti|
Ā. rā. tīkṣṇasya cūrṇasya mātrāmāha-cūrṇitasyeti| mṛdoścūrṇasya mātrāmāha-timra iti|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------------| niśi svapne na madhyāhne mlāne noṣṇagabhastibhiḥ||16||
akṣirogāya doṣāḥ syurvardhitotpīḍitadgutāḥ| prātaḥ sāyaṃ ca tacchhāntyai vyābhrerke'to'ñjayetsadā||17||

div.ab: Sa. niśi-rātrau, añjanaṃ na prayojyam| tathā svapne-svapnakāle, añjanaṃ na prayojyam| tathā, madhyaṃdine'ñjanaṃ na prayojyam| na ca mlāne locane'ñjanaṃ prayojyam| kena (kābhiḥ) mlāne ? uṣṇābhirdīdhitibhiḥ| yasmādeṣu kāleṣvañjanena prayuktena doṣā vṛddhiṃ nītāḥ, tathā'nyasthānagattvādutpīḍitāḥ, tathā drutāḥ- kālasyoṣṇatvādvilayaṃ gatāḥ, akṣirogāya syuḥ| tasmādeṣu kāleṣvañjanaṃ na prayojyam| prātarityādi| yataḥ pūrvokteṣu kāleṣu pūrvoktā doṣāḥ| tasmāt pūrvāhṇe'parāhṇe ca tacchhāntyai-tasyākṣirogasyopaśamāya, vitagābhre ravau sadaiva netre'ñjayet|
Ā. rā. añjanasya kāladvayamāha-niśīti| rātrau nidrayā varddhitā doṣā akṣirogāya syuḥ, ataḥ prātarañjaeyt| amdhyāhne pānānnābhyāmutpīḍitāḥ sūryaśmibhirdravīkṛtā akṣirogāya syuḥ, ataḥ sāyamañjayet|

ab.seg: vadantyanye tu na divā prayojyaṃ tīkṣṇamañjanam| virekadurbalaṃ cakṣurādityaṃ prāpya sīdati||18||

div.ab: Sa. anye tvācāryā evaṃ vadanti| yat tīkṣṇamañjanaṃ divā na prayojyam| kutaḥ ? yasmāccakṣurādityaṃ prāpya sīdati| kimbhūtaṃ ? virekadurbalam, tīkṣṇāñjanena virecitatvāt| tasmāddivase tīkṣṇamañjanaṃ na prayojyam|
Ā. rā. tīkṣṇāñjanasya divā-niṣedhamāha-vadantīti| niṣedhe yuktimāha-virekadurbalamiti|

ab.seg: ata evāha ---- svapnena ratrau kālasya sau myatvena ca tarpitā| śītasātmyā dṛgāgneyī sthiratāṃ labhate punaḥ||19||

div.ab: Sa. yasmātsvapnena rātrau tarpitā, tathā kālasya-rātryākhyasya, sau myatvena tarpitā dṛṣṭiḥ punah sthairyaṃ prāpnoti, tīkṣṇāñjanakṣobhitā'pi| kīdṛgdṛṣṭiḥ ? āgneyī,- agnyutkaṭabhūtasambhavā, tathā śītasātmyā| tasmādrātrāvañjanaṃ prayojyam| āgneyīti "sarvatrāgnikalibhyāṃ ḍhagvaktavyaḥ" iti ḍhak| śītaṃ sātmyaṃ yasyāḥ, paittikajvarasyeva|

Ā. rā. tīkṣṇasya rātriprayoge yuktimāha-svapneneti| dṛṣṭistāvadāgneyatvātsantāpapīḍitā| ata eva śītasātmyā| sā ca tīkṣṇāñjanenātisantaptā rātrau svapnena saumyena kālena ca gatasantāpā punaḥ sthiratāṃ labhate|

ab.seg: tadetadanyamatamavyāpakamiti dūṣayannāha ---- atyudrikte balāse tu lekhanīye'thavā gade| kāmamahynapi nātyuṣṇe tīkṣṇamakṣṇi prayojayet||20||

div.ab: Sa. atyutkṛṣṭe kaphe, athavā lekhanārhe-śukrārmādau, roge dine'pi nātyuṣṇe tīkṣṇamañjanaṃ prayojayet| kāmaṃ-anumatametat| kālasyātyauṣṇyādañjanasya taikṣṇyāccātiyogena dṛṣṭyupaghātaḥ syāt|
Ā. rā. kaphodrake lekhanasādhye ca roge divā'pi tīkṣṇaṃ yojyamityāha-atyudrikta iti|

ab.seg: ata evāha ---- aśmano janma lohasya tata eva ca tīkṣṇatā| upaghāto'pi tenaiva tathā netrasya tejasaḥ||21||

div.ab: Sa. aśmanaḥ-pāṣāṇāt, śastrasyotpattiḥ| tasmādeva cāśmanaḥ ślakṣṇatādiyogāttīkṣṇatā| upaghāto'pi-kuṇṭhatvādikaḥ, tenaiva-pāṣāṇena, na kevalaṃ taikṣṇyam| tathā-tenaivāśmaśastranyāyena, netrasya tejasaḥ-agneraśmasthānīyājjanma| ravisaṃjñāttejasaḥ sakāśāttīkṣṇatā-darśanapaṭutvam| atyuṣṇena tu tena tasyopaghātaḥ| tasmāt yadanye vadanti sāmānyenaiva divā'ñjanaṃ na prayojyamiti, tadasadeva|
Ā. rā. taijasasya tejaḥsahakṛtasya ca netrasya kathaṃ tejasopaghātaḥ ? ityata āha-aśmana iti|

ab.seg: api ca ---- na rātrāvapi śīte'ti netre tīkṣṇāñjanaṃ hitam| doṣamasrāvayetstabdhaṃ kaṇḍūjāḍyādikāri tat||22||

div.ab: Sa. rātrāvapi netre kaphādhikyenātiśīte-kaṇḍūpaicchhityādyanumite, tīkṣṇamañjanaṃ na prayojyam| yato niśi tīkṣṇamañjanamupayuktaṃ kālasya sau myatvāt doṣaṃ-srāvaṇyogyaṃ, asrāvayet| añjanaṃ stabdhaṃ kaṇḍūjāḍyādikṛt syāt, na tu śamakāri| tasmāt "śītasātmyā dṛgāgneyī sthiratāṃ labhate punaḥ|" ityetadapyasat| tasmāt pūrvoktamevānavadyamiti|
Ā. rā. rātrāvapyatiśīte tīkṣṇāñjanaṃ niṣedhati-na rātrāviti|

ab.seg: nāñjayedbhītavamitaviriktāśitavegite| kruddhajvatitatāntākṣiśirorukśokajāgare||23||
adṛṣṭe'rke śiraḥsnāte pītayordhūmamadyayoḥ| ajīrṇe'gnyarkasantapte divāsupte pipāsite||24||

div.ab: Sa. bhītādīnāmakṣiṇī vaidyo nāñjayet| aśito'tra sadyobhukto vedyaḥ| sadyobhuktasya narasya nayane nāñjayedityarthaḥ| tānte-sūkṣmabhāsurādidarśanādabhighātādvā glāne, akṣiṇī yasya saḥ, tasmin| adṛṣṭe'rke, jaladacchhannatvāt| tathā, śiraḥsnātādiṣu|

Ā. rā. bhītādīnāmañjanaṃ niṣedhati-nāñjayediti| saṅgrahe tu (sū. a. 32)-"eṣvañjanādūṣmordhvagaḥ saṃrambhāśruvedanāvilatvoṣārāgadūṣikānistodakṛcchronmīlanaśvayathuśukratimirādīn janayet|" iti| tāntaṃ-uṣṇādinā glānamakṣi|

ab.seg: sāmprataṃ yādṛśamañjanaṃ na prayojyaṃ tādṛśaṃ darśayati ---- atitīkṣṇamṛdustokabahnacchhaghanakarkaśam| atyarthaśītalaṃ taptamañjanaṃ nāvacārayet||25||

div.ab: Sa. atiśabdasya tīkṣṇādibhirghanāntaiḥ sambandhaḥ| atyarthaśītalamityetasmādatyarthaśabdastaptamityatrānuvṛttikṛtena sambandhena yojyaḥ| atitīkṣṇādiguṇamañjanaṃ na prayojayet| tantrāntate cāñjanavidhiruktaḥ-"sukhopaviṣṭasyāturasya sukhopaviṣṭo vaidyo vāmāṅguṣṭhenottaraṃ vartmotkṣipya kṛṣṇabhāgasyādhaḥ kanīnikādapāṅgaṃ yāvadañjanaṃ nayet|" iti|
Ā. rā. atitīkṣṇādi navavidhamañjanaṃ niṣedhati-atitīkṣṇeti|

ab.seg: athānunmīlayan dṛṣṭimantaḥ sañcārayecchhanaiḥ| añjite vartmanī kiñciccālayeccaivamañjanam||26||
tīkṣṇaṃ vyāpnoti sahasā, na conmeṣanimeṣaṇam| niṣpīḍanaṃ ca vartmabhyāṃ kṣālanaṃ vā samācaret||27||

div.ab: Sa. atha-evamañjanasvarūpamavetya, netre'ñjite sati dṛṣṭigolakamanunmīlayan madhye śanaiḥ śanaiḥ sañcārayet| kiñcit vartmanī cālayet| evaṃ tīkṣṇāñjanaṃ netraṃ vyāpnoti-anupraviśati| na ca sahasā-vidhyatikrameṇa, unmeṣanimeṣaṇaṃ kuryāt| caśabdo'vadhāraṇe, naiva samācaredityarthaḥ| vartmabhyāṃ ca niṣpīḍanaṃ na samācaret| vāśabdo'vadhāraṇe, kṣālanaṃ ca naiva kuryāt|

Ā. rā. āñjanānantaraṃ kṛtyamāha-atheti| añjite netre dṛṣṭimanunmīlayan antareva samantataḥ sañcārayet| vartmanī ca kiñciccālayet| uktakṛtyasya phalamāha-evamañjanamiti| mṛdu śanirvyāpnotītyarthalabhyam| añjitanetrasyonmeṣādi niṣedhati-na ceti|

ab.seg: apetauṣadhasaṃrambhaṃ nirvṛtaṃ nayanaṃ yadā| vyādhidoṣartuyogyābhiradbhiḥ prakṣālayettadā||28||

div.ab: Sa. apetaḥ-apagataḥ auṣadhasaṃrambho-bheṣajakṣobho, yasmānnetrāttadevam| yato'petauṣadhasaṃrambhamata eva nirvṛtaṃ-apetaduḥkhānubandhi, yadā locanaṃ syāt, tadā vyādhyādiyogyairjalaiḥ prakṣālayet| tatra vyādhiḥ-abhiṣyandādiḥ, doṣo-vātādiḥ, ṛtuḥ-vasantādiḥ|
Ā. rā. kṣālanakālamāha-apetauṣadhasaṃrambhamiti|

ab.seg: dakṣiṇāṅguṣṭhakenākṣi tato vāmaṃ savāsasā| ūrdhvavartmani saṅgṛhya śodhyaṃ vāmena cetarat||29||

div.ab: Sa. tato-nayanaprakṣālanādanantaraṃ, dakṣiṇāṅguṣṭhena savasreṇa vāmaṃ nayanamūrdhvavartmani samyagādāya śodhanīyam| vāmenāṅguṣṭhena savāsasā, itarat-dakṣiṇaṃ, ūrdhvavartmani saṅgṛhya śodhyam|
Ā. rā. kṣālanānantaraṃ śodhanamāha-dakṣiṇāṅguṣṭhakeneti| savastreṇa dakṣiṇāṅguṣṭhena vāmaṃ saṃśodhyam, vāmena dakṣiṇam|
kimiti śodhyam ? ityāha ---- vartmaprāpto'ñjāddoṣo rogān kuryādato'nyathā| ---------------------------------------------------|30|
Sa. ato'nyathā-aśodhyamāne, vartmani prāptaṃ ca tadañjanaṃ ca vartmaprāptāñjanaṃ, tasmāt doṣo rogān kuryāt| tasmāttacchhodhyaṃ nayanam|
Ā. rā. kṣālanaśodhanākaraṇe doṣamāha-vartmaprāpta iti|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------------| kaṇḍujāḍye'ñjanaṃ tīkṣṇaṃ dhūmaṃ vā yojayet punaḥ||30||

div.ab: Sa. kaṇḍūśca jāḍyaṃ ceti samāhāradvandvaḥ| tasmin sati tīkṣṇāñjanaṃ yojayet| athavā tīkṣṇaṃ dhūmaṃ yojayet|
Ā. rā. añjanāsamyagyogajayoḥ kaṇḍūjāḍyayoḥ pratīkāramāha-kaṇḍūjāḍya iti|
tīkṣṇāñjanābhitapte tu cūrṇaṃ pratyañjanaṃ himam|30.5| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ sūtrasthāna āścotanā ñjanavidhirnāma trayoviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ|23|

Sa. punastīkṣṇenāñjanenābhitapte locane cūrṇaṃ pratyañjanaṃ pūrvoktaṃ, hitamiti| iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayaṭīkāyāṃ sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ sūtrasthāne āścotanāñjanavidhirnāma trayoviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 23||
Ā. rā. tīkṣṇāñjanātiyoge pratīkāramāha-tīkṣṇāñjanābhitapte tviti| pratyañjanamityasyāñjanasya saṃjñā| iti hemādriṭīkāyāmāyurvedarasāyane| sekāñjanaprakaraṇaṃ sāmastyena nirūpitam|| 23||

div.head: tarpaṇapuṭapākavidhiradhyāyaḥ
div.ab: Sa. asmādanantaraṃ caturviṃśādhyāyārambhaḥ| āścotanāñjanābhyāṃ hi prāyo nayanasya daurbalyam| atastarpaṇāderupayogo yukta ityāha ----
athātastarpaṇapuṭapākavidhimadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| gadyasutre|2|
Sa. tarpaṇaṃ ca puṭapākaśca tarpaṇapuṭapākau, tayorvidhiḥ, tam| śeṣaṃ pūrvavat|
Ā. rā. tarpaṇapuṭapākavidhimadhyāyaṃ vyākhyātuṃ pratijānīte-atheti|

nayane tāmyati stabdhe śuṣke rūkṣe'bhighātite| vātapittāture jihme śīrṇapakṣmāvilekṣaṇe||1|| kṛcchronmīlaśirāharṣaśirotpātatamorjunaiḥ| syandamanthānyatovātavātaparyāyaśukrakaiḥ||2|| āture śāntarāgāśruśūlasaṃrambhadūṣike| nivāte tarpaṇaṃ yojyaṃ śuddhayormūrddhakāyayoḥ||3|| kāle sādhāraṇe prātaḥ sāyaṃ vottānaśāyinaḥ| ----------------------------------------------------|4|

Sa. cakṣuṣi mlāyati sati, tathā stabdhādiguṇe tarpaṇaṃ kāryam| tathā, śīrṇe pakṣmaṇī yasya tadevam| āvilaṃ-aspaṣṭaṃ, īkṣaṇaṃ-darśanaṃ, yasya tadevam| śīrṇapakṣma ca tadāvilekṣaṇaṃ ca, tattasmin| tathā kṛcchronmīlādayaḥ-akṣirogeṣu vakṣyante| kṛcchronmīlaśca śirāharṣaśca śirotpātaśca tamaścārjunaśca, tairāture| tathā syandaśca manthaścānyatovātaśca vātaparyāyaśca śukrakaṃ ca, tairāture| { tathā, nasyānarhe| yato vakṣyati (ślo-21)-"tarpaṇaṃ puṭapākaṃ ca nasyānarhe na yojayet|" iti| tathā, śāntāḥ śamaṃ gatāḥ, rāgāśruśūlasaṃrambhadūṣikā yasminnayane tasmin| kīdṛśi sthāne ? nivāte,-vigatānile| upalakṣaṇaṃ cedam| vigatātaparajodhūmādika ityapi draṣṭavyam| kīdṛśayormastakadehayoḥ ? śuddhayoḥ,-yathāyogaṃ vamanavirecananasyaiḥ kṛtaśuddhyorityarthaḥ| kīdṛśi kāle ? sādhāraṇe,-vasantādike| kadā ? sāyaṃ prātarvā, doṣadūśyādyapekṣayā| kīdṛśasyāturasya ? uttānaśāyina iti śayanasthasyottānasyetyarthaḥ|

Ā. rā. tarpaṇasya viṣayaṃ deśaṃ kālaṃ cāha-nayana iti| tāmyati-avalokanāsamarthe| jihye-vakre| āvilekṣaṇe-aspṛṣṭadarśane| kṛcchronmīlādibhirdaśabhirvyādhibhirāture nivṛttarāgādipañcake netre tarpaṇaṃ yojyam| tacca nivāte deśe nasyādau kṛte prātaḥ sāyaṃ vā yojyam|

----------------------------------------------------| yavamāṣamayīṃ pālīṃ netrakośādbahiḥ samām||4|| dvyaṅguloccāṃ dṛḍhāṃ kṛtvā yathāsvaṃ siddhamāvapet| sarpirnimīlite netre taptāmbupravilāyitam||5|| naktāndhyavātatimirakṛcchhrabodhādike vasām| āpakṣmāgrāt---------------------------------|6|

Sa. yavairmiśrā māṣā yavamāṣāḥ, taiḥ kṛtā yā sā yavamāṣamayī, tām| tādṛśīṃ pālīṃ netrakośādbāhyata ubhayapārśvayoḥ samāṃ-animnonnatāṃ kṛtvā, yathāyogaṃ doṣadūṣyādyanurodhāt pakvaṃ ghṛtaṃ nimīlite-anunmiṣite locane kṣipet| atha pālyā ucchhrāyamāha-dvyaṅguloccāṃ,-dvyaṅgulocchhrāyavatīm| tathā dṛḍhāṃ nibiḍhāṃ, yathā sneho na sravet| kīdṛśaṃ sarpiḥ ? taptena jalena prakarṣeṇa vilāyitaṃ-dravīkṛtam| naktāndhyetyādi| rātryandhyādiṣu vasāṃ yathāsvauṣadhasiddhāṃ tathaiva vilāyitāmāvapet| katham ? āpakṣmāgrāt,-pakṣmāgrāṇi yāvannimagnāni tāvatsarṣirādimāvapediti|

Ā. rā. tapraṇavidhimāha-uttānaśāyina iti| taptāmbupravilāyitaṃ-uṣṇāmbukumbhīvāṣpeṇa dravīkṛtam| naktāndhyādiṣu tu sarpiḥsthāne vasāmāvapet| āpakṣmāgrāt-pakṣmāgramajjanaṃ yāvat| saṅgrahe tu (sū.a. 33)-"atha divasasyāṣṭame bhāge gate śeṣe vā nirvātātaparajodhūme kṛtanīlapītānyatarajavanikek veśmani jīrṇabhuktasya sukhaśayanagatasyottānasya sumṛditamāśapiṣṭakalkena netrakośādbahirvdyaṅgulocchrāyāvādhārau parimaṇḍalāvasambādhau samāvaparisrāviṇau kṛtvā, tatroṣṇodakapravilīnaṃ nimīlite netre yathārhauṣadhavipakvaṃ kṣīraṃ sarpirmaṇḍaṃ vā secayet| yāvannimagnānyakṣipakṣmāṇi bhrūromāṇi ca|" iti|

ab.seg: mātrā vigaṇayettatra vartmasandhisitāsate| dṛṣṭau ca kramaśo vyādhau śataṃ trīṇi ca pañca ca||7||
śatāni sapta cāṣṭau ca, daśa manthe, daśānile| pitte ṣaṭ, svasthavṛtte ca balāse pañca dhārayet||8||

div.ab: Sa. atha-ghṛtādyāvapanādanantaraṃ, śanaiḥśanairunmīlanaṃ vidadhatastasya-āturasya, mātrāḥ-pūrvoktāḥ, vigaṇayet| tatra-tasmin vartmādike vyādhau sarpiṣi kṣipte, śatasaṅkhyādīrmātrā vigaṇayet krameṇa| tatra vartmaroge mātrāśatam, sandhiroge trīṇi śatani, sitaroge pañca śatāni, asitaroge sapta śatāni, dṛṣṭiroge'ṣṭau śatāni, dhārayediti kramārthaḥ| yathāsaṅkhyena manthākhye roge daśa śatāni, vātaroge daśaiva śatāni, pittaroge ṣaṭ śatāni, svasthavṛtte ca ṣaṭ śatāni, kaphe pañca śatāni,dhārayet|

Ā. rā. tarpaṇadhāraṇāvadhimāha-atheti| vartmaroge ekaśatam, sandhiroge trīṇi śatāni, sitaroge pañca, astiroge sapta, dṛṣṭiroge'ṣṭau, tathā manthe daśa, vāte daśa, pitte svasthavṛtte ca ṣaṭ, balāse pañca, dhārayet|

ab.seg: kṛtvā'pāṅge tato dvāraṃ snehaṃ pātre nigālayet| pibecca dhūmaṃ, nekṣeta vyoma rūpaṃ ca bhāsvaram||9||

div.ab: Sa. { tataḥ-} yathoktamātrādhāraṇādanantaraṃ, apāṅgadeśe pālyā dvāraṃ kṛtvā snehaṃ bhājane nikṣipet| tataḥ saktupiṇḍyā'kṣikośaṃ pramṛjya sneheritakaphopaśāntaye dhūmaṃ ca pibet, na kevalaṃ tarpaṇaṃ kuryāt| prakṣālitanetraṃ cainaṃ mātrayā''mayādivaśena bhojayet| tathā, nabho na paśyedbhāsvaraṃ rūpaṃ ca| upalakṣaṇaṃ cedam| ātapādyapi bhāsvaraṃ na paśyet|
Ā. rā. tarpaṇānantaraṃ kṛtyamāha-kṛtvā'pāṅga iti|

ab.seg: itthaṃ pratidinaṃ vāyau, pitte tvekāntaraṃ, kaphe| svasthe ca hyantaraṃ dadyādātṛpteriti yojayet||10||

div.ab: Sa. itthaṃ-anena krameṇa, pavane pratyahaṃ tarpaṇaṃ dadyāt| pitte punarekāntaraṃ tarpaṇaṃ dadyāt| kaphe svasthe ca dvidināntaraṃ yojayet| iti-evaṃ, yāvannayanasya tṛptiḥ syāttāvattarpaṇaṃ yojyam|
Ā. rā. vātādibhedena tarpaṇāvṛttimāha-itthamiti| āvṛttyavadhimāha-ātṛpteriti|

ab.seg: tṛptasya kiṃ lakṣaṇaṃ ? ityāha ---- prakāśakṣamatā svāsthyaṃ viśadaṃ laghu locanam| tṛpte, viparyayo'tṛpte'titṛpte śleṣmajā rūjaḥ||11||

div.ab: Sa. prakāśakṣamatvādikaṃ samyaktṛptasya lakṣaṇam| prakāśakṣamatā-prabhābhāsvarādirūpasahatvam| atṛpte-ajātāyāṃ tṛptau, piparyayaḥ-prakāśākṣamatādikaḥ| atitṛpte sati kaphodbhavāḥ kaṇḍūpaicchhilyādikā rujaḥ syuḥ|
Ā. rā. tṛptalakṣaṇamāha-prakāśakṣamateti| atṛptalakṣaṇamāha-viparyaya iti| atitṛpalakṣaṇamāha-tṛpte'tīti|
snehapītā tanuriva klāntā dṛṣṭirhi sīdati| tarpaṇānantaraṃ tasmādṛgbalādhānakāriṇam||12|| puṭapākaṃ prayuñjīta pūrvokteṣveva yakṣmasu| ----------------------------------------------------|13|

Sa. snehapītā dṛṣṭiḥ klāntā tanuriva yato'vasīdati, tasmātkāraṇāt tarpaṇādanantaraṃ puṭapākaṃ prayuñjīta| kīdṛśam ? dṛśorbalaṃ dṛgbalaṃ, tasyādhānaṃ-prabandhena vṛttiḥ, tatkarotīti dṛgbalādhānakāriṇam| hetau dvitīyā, dṛgbalādhānakāritvāt prayuñjītetyarthaḥ| pūrvokteṣveva-tarpaṇokteṣvāmayeṣu|
Ā. rā. puṭapākasya viṣayamāha-snehapīteti| snehapītā-pītasnehā| pūrvokteṣu yakṣamasu-rogeṣu|

----------------------------------------------------| sa vāte snehanaḥ śleṣmasahite lekhano hitaḥ||13|| dṛgdaurbalye'nile pitte rakte svasthe prasādanaḥ| ----------------------------------------------------|14|
Sa. sa ca-puṭapāko, vāte snehano hitaḥ| kaphasahite mārute lekhano hitaḥ| dṛṣṭidaurbalyādiṣu prasādano hitaḥ|
Ā. rā. puṭapākasya traividhyaṃ saviṣayamāha-sa vāta iti|

idānīmeṣāṃ puṭapākānāṃ kalpanāmāha ---- ----------------------------------------------------| bhūśayaprasahānūpamedomajjavasāmiṣaiḥ||14|| snehanaṃ payasā piṣṭairjīvanīyaiśca kalpayet| ----------------------------------------------------|15|

Sa. bhūśayāḥ- bileśayā bhekagodhādyāḥ, prasahāḥ-gokharādayaḥ, ānūpāḥ-mahāmṛgavāricaravāriśayāḥ, teṣāṃ medomajjavasāmiṣāṇi, taiḥ| tathā, jīvanīyaiḥ-jīvantīkākolyādibhiśca, kṣīrapiṣṭaiḥ snehanaṃ puṭapākaṃ kalpayedvaidyaḥ|
Ā. rā. snehanasya dravyāṇyāha-bhūśayeti| bhūśayāḥ bileśayāḥ|

----------------------------------------------------| mṛgapakṣiyakṛnmāṃsamuktāyastāmrasaindhavaiḥ||15|| srotojaśaṅkhaphenālairlekhanaṃ mastukalkitaiḥ| ----------------------------------------------------|16|

Sa. mṛgāḥ-hariṇādyāḥ, pakṣiṇo-lāvādyāḥ, teṣāṃ yakṛnmāṃsāni, taiḥ| tathā, muktādibhirmastukalkitairlekhanaṃ puṭapākaṃ kalpayedvaidyaḥ| prasahānāṃ mṛgapakṣiṇāṃ snehane puṭapāka upayuktatvāt jāṅgalā eva mṛgapakṣiṇo'tra grāhyāḥ|
Ā. rā. lekhanasya dravyāṇyāha-mṛgapakṣīti| pakṣiṇoviṣkirapratudāḥ|

----------------------------------------------------| mṛgapakṣiyakṛnmajjavasāntrahṛdayāmiṣaiḥ||16|| madhuraiḥ saghṛtaiḥ stanyakṣīrapiṣṭaiḥ prasādanam| ----------------------------------------------------|17|
Sa. mṛgapakṣyādīnāṃ yakṛnmajjavasāhṛdayāmiṣāṇi, taiḥ| tathā, madhuraiḥ-madhuravargoktaiḥ, ghṛtānvitaiḥ stanyakṣīrapiṣṭaiḥ prasādanaṃ puṭapākaṃ kalpayedvaidyaḥ| atra stanyaṃ striyā eva|
Ā. rā. prasādanasya dravyāṇyāha-mṛgapakṣiyakṛditi| madhuraiḥ-jīvanīyaiḥ|

adhunā puṭapākasya kalpanāmāha ---- bilvamātraṃ pṛthak piṇḍaṃ māṃsabheṣajakalkayoḥ||17|| urubūkavaṭāmbhojapatraiḥ snehādiṣu kramāt| veṣṭayitvā mṛdā liptaṃ dhavadhanvanagomayaiḥ||18|| pacetpradīptairagnyābhaṃ pakvaṃ niṣpīḍya tadrasam| netre tarpaṇavadyuñjyāt-----------------------|19|

Sa. māṃsaṃ ca bheṣajakalkaśca tayoḥ pṛthak palamātraṃ piṇḍameraṇḍādipatrairveṣṭayitvā kṛṣṇamṛttikayā liptaṃ vṛddhavaidyavyavahārāt dvyaṅhgulotsedhaṃ mṛttikālepaṃ kṛtvā krameṇa dhavādīndhanaiḥ pradīptaiḥ pacet| tatra snehane puṭapāka eraṇḍapatrairveṣṭanaṃ dhavakāṣṭhaiḥ pradīpanam, lekhane vaṭapatrairveṣṭanaṃ dhanvanendhanena pradīpanam, prasādane jalajapatrairveṣṭanaṃ gomayendhanena pradīpanam, iti kramārthaḥ| agnyābhaṃ-agnivarṇaṃ sat, pakvaṃ jñātvā, apanītapatraṃ vidhāya, vāsasā niṣpīḍya, tadrasaṃ nayane tarpaṇamiva yuñjyāt|

Ā. rā. puṭapākasya sādhanamāha-bilvamātramiti| māṃsapīṇḍamauṣadhapiṇḍaṃ ca pṛthak bilvamātramekīkṛtaṃ snehanādiṣveraṇḍādipatraiḥ kramādveṣṭitaṃ kuśamuñjasūtrānyatamena baddhaṃ tato vdyaṅgulotsedhena mṛlliptaṃ dhavādīndhanaiḥ pacet| saṅgrahe tu (sū.a.33)-"dhavadhanvanamadhūkanyagrodhakāśmaryarājādanārjunanaktamālapāṭalīnāmanyatamaiḥ kāṣṭhaiḥ śakṛtā vā gomahiṣayoḥ pacet|" iti| puṭapākavidhimāha-agnyābhamiti| taṃ piṇḍamagnivarṇatvena pakvaṃ jñātvā niṣpīḍya rasaṃ tarpaṇavadyuñjyāt|
Sa. lekhanādiṣu śatādīni dhārayet| tatra lekhane śataṃ mātrāṇāṃ dhārayet| snehane dve śate| antye-prasādane, trīṇi śatāni dhārayet|
Ā. rā. puṭapākadhāraṇāvadhimāha-śatamiti| antyaḥ-prasādanaḥ|
Sa. pūrvo-snehanalekhanau, koṣṇau yojyau| himo'paraḥ-prasādanākhyaḥ|
Ā. rā. puṭapākānāmuṣṇaśītabhedamāha-koṣṇāviti|
Sa. tayoḥ-ādyayoḥ puṭapākayoḥ, ante dhūmapaḥ syāt| sneheritakaphopaśāntyai, na tu prasādanānte, ityevaśabdārthaḥ|
Ā. rā. lekhanasnehanayoranantarakṛtyamāha-dhūmapa iti|
Sa. tatra ca-teṣu puṭapākeṣu, yogāstarpaṇa iva syuḥ| tṛptivaditi saptamyantādvatiḥ| yogā iti bahuvacananirdeśāt samyagyogāyogātiyogā gṛhyante|
Ā. rā. puṭapākasya samyagyogādilakṣaṇamāha-yogā iti|
tarpaṇaṃ puṭapākaṃ ca nasyānarhe na yojayet| ----------------------------------------------------|21|
Sa. tarpaṇapuṭapākau nasyāyogye na yojayet| nasyānarhāḥ-"yojyenna tu nāvanam|" ityādyuktāḥ|
Ā. rā. niṣiddhanasyānāṃ tarpaṇapuṭapākau niṣedhatitarpaṇamiti|
yāvantyahāni yuñjīta dvistato hitabhāgbhavet||21|| mālatīmallikāpuṣpairbaddhākṣo nivasenniśām||21.5||

Sa. yāvantyahāni-yāvanmātrāṇi dināni, tarpaṇapuṭapākau kurvīta tato dviguṇāni dināni hitasevī syāt| kṛtatarpaṇa puṭapāko mālatyādipuṣpairbaddhākṣaḥ san vibhāvarīṃ vaset| mālatī-sumanāḥ| mallikā-gandhavārṣikā|

Ā. rā. tarpaṇapuṭapākayorācāramāha-yāvantīti| saṅgrahe tu (sū.a. 33)-"tathā pakvātisāre'pi puṭapākasyāyameva vidhiriti| bhavati cātra| seke'ñjane tarpaṇe ca puṭapāke ca ye gadāḥ| jāyante vidhividbhraṃśādyathāsvaṃ tān prasādhayet||" iti|

sarvātmanā netrabalāya yatnaṃ kurvīta nasyāñjanatarpaṇādyaiḥ| dṛṣṭiśca naṣṭā vividhaṃ jagacca tamomayaṃ jāyata ekarūpam|22.5| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ sūtrasthāne tarpaṇapuṭapākavidhirnāma caturviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ|24|

Sa. sarveṇa prakāreṇa netrabalāya-cakṣuḥsāmarthyāya, nasyādibhiryatnaṃ kuryāt| dṛṣṭiśceti ca hetau| yato dṛṣṭiryadi na syāttato jagadvividhamapi tamomayaṃ-andhakārarūpaṃ, ekarūpaṃ-ekalakṣaṇaṃ, sampadyata iti| upajātirvṛttam| iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayaṭīkāyāṃ sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ sūtrasthāne tarpaṇapuṭapākavidhirnāma caturviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 24||
Ā. rā. netrarakṣaṇe yatnaḥ kārya ityāha-sarvātmaneti| dṛṣṭiśceti caśabdaścedarthe| iti hemādriṭīkāyāmāyurvedarasāyane| dṛktarpaṇaprakaraṇam sāmastyena nirūpitam|| 24||

div.head: yantravidhiradhyāyaḥ
div.ab: Sa. athedānīṃ pañcaviṃśādhyāyārambho yantravidhānapradarśanārthaḥ| yato bastinasyāñhjanakṣārādīni yantrāśrayaṇyevetyāha-
athāto yantravidhimadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti sa smādurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre|2|
Sa. yantrasya vidhiryantravidhiḥ śeṣaṃ pūrvavat| arśobhagandarādiṣu niruje'ṅhge yamyate-niyamyate śastrakṣārāgnikarmeti yantram|
Ā. rā. yantravidhimadhyāyaṃ vyākhyātuṃ pratijānīte-atheti|

etadeva spaṣṭayannāha ---- nānāvidhānāṃ śalyānāṃ nānādeśaprabādhinām| āhartumabhyupāyo yastadyantraṃ yacca darśane||1|| arśobhagandarādīnāṃ śastrakṣārāgniyojane| śeṣāṅgaparirakṣāyāṃ tathā bastyādikarmaṇi||2|| ghaṭikālābuśṛṅgaṃ ca jāmbavauṣṭhādikāni ca| ----------------------------------------------------|3|

Sa. anekaprakārāṇi yāni śalyāni-śastraveṇupāṣāṇādirūpāṇi, vividheṣu śarīrapradeśeṣu niviśante, teṣāmāharaṇe ākṛṣṭuṃ, yo'bhyupāyastadyantram| 'ucyate' iti śeṣaḥ| tathā, arśobhagandaranāḍīvraṇādīnāṃ śastrādiyojane sati śeṣasya-nirujasyāṅgasya, parirakṣāyāṃ-rakṣānimittam, svasthasyāṅgasya śastrādyābādhānivṛttyarthamityarthaḥ| tathā, bastinasyādikarmaṇi ya upāyastacca yantram| tathā ghaṭikādi ca yantraṃ pavanākarṣaṇāya raktādyākarṣaṇāya ca| jāmbavauṣṭhasandaṃśādīni ca yantrāṇi|

Ā. rā. yantralakṣaṇamāha-nānāvidhānāmiti| śalyāharaṇe ya upāyaḥ, yaścārśaḥprabhṛtidarśane, yaśca śāstrādicchedyasamīpāṅgarakṣaṇe, yaśca bastyādipraṇayane, yaśca ghāṭikādirācūṣaṇādau, tadyantram| evaṃvidha upāyaviśeśo yantramityarthaḥ|

yantrāṇāṃ kiṃ rūpaṃ kiṃ |ca] kāryaṃ syāt? ityāha- ----------------------------------------------------| anekarūpakāryāṇi yantrāṇi vividhānyataḥ||3|| vikalpya kalpayedbuddhyā yathāsthūlaṃ tu vakṣyate| ----------------------------------------------------|4|

Sa. rūpāṇi ca kāryāṇi ca rūpakāryāṇi| anekāni vicitrāṇi, rūpakāryāṇi teṣāṃ tāni yantrāṇi nānāprakārāṇi| tatra rūpaṃ-kaṅkamukhasvastikādyākāratvam| kāryaṃ-asthyādilagnaśalyaharaṇādikam| yataścaivaṃ yantrāṇāṃ nānāvidhatvam, atastāni buddhyā vikalpya kāryānurodhāt kalpayet| nanu, yantrāṇāṃ diṅmātre'pyanabhijñaḥ kathamiva kalpanāṃ kartuṃ pārayet ? ityāha- saṃ-yāni yāni sthūlāni yathāsthūlam| "yathā sādṛśye" ityavyayībhāvaḥ| yathāsthūlayantrakaraṇena vyutpannamatiḥ śeṣāṇāmapi yantrāṇāmutpādane vikalpaṃ kartuṃ samartho bhavediti bhāvaḥ|

Ā. rā. yantraviśeṣāṇāmanantatvāt buddhyā kalpyatvamāha-anekarūpakāryāṇīti| ā raṃ-nidarśanārthaṃ kāṃścidyantraviśeṣān vaktumāha-yathāsthūlamiti| svastikasandaṃśatālanāḍīśalākānuyantrabhedāt ṣoḍhā yantrāṇi|

atha yantrāṇyāha ---- ----------------------------------------------------| tulyāni kaṅkasiṃharkṣakākādimṛgapakṣiṇām||4|| mukhairmukhāni yantrāṇāṃ kuryāttatsaṃjñakāni ca| aṣṭādaśāṅgulāyāmānyāyasāni ca bhūriśaḥ||5|| masūrākāraparyantaiḥ kaṇṭhe baddhāni kīlakaiḥ| vidyātsvastikayantrāṇi mūle'ṅkuśanatāni ca||6|| tairdṛḍhairasthisaṃlagnaśalyāharaṇamiṣyate| ----------------------------------------------------|7|

Sa. yena pārśvena śalyamuddhriyate tadyantrāṇāṃ mukhaṃ vedyam| kaṅkādīnāṃ pakṣimṛgāṇāṃ mukhaistulyāni yantrāṇāṃ mukhāni kuryāt| ādiśabdena gṛdhrahaṃsahariṇādiparigrahaḥ| tāni tatsaṃjñakāni| ca evārthe, tāni yantrāṇi tannāmānyeva| yathā,-kaṅkumukhaṃ siṃhamukhamityādi| aṣṭādaśāṅguletyādi, svastikākhyāni yantrāṇi vidyāt| kīdṛśāni ? aṣṭādaśāṅguladairghyāṇi, bhūriśo-bāhulyena, āyasāni-śastramayāni| dantādimayānāmapi kvaciddarśanāt bhūriśa ityuktam| tathā, kaṇṭhapradeśe kīlakairbaddhāni| kīdṛśaiḥ kīlakaiḥ ? masūrākārāḥ paryantā yeṣāṃ taiḥ| yatra pradeśe yantrāṇāṃ hastagrahastatra tanmūlam| tatrāṅkuśavannatāni-pariṇatāni| taiḥ-kaṅkamukhādibhiḥ, asthisaṃlagnaśalyasya-kāṇḍaphalādeḥ, āharaṇaṃ-ākarṣaṇamiṣyate|

Ā. rā. tatra svastikānyāha-tulyānīti| tatsaṃjñakāni-kaṅkamukhasiṃhamukhādināmāni| āyāmo-dairghyam| bhūriśa iti vacanāt dārvādikṛtānyapi| kaṇṭhe-mukhākārasampādakaśakaladvayasandhānasthāne| mūle-dhāraṇasthāne| svastikānāṃ kāryamāha-tairddaḍhairiti|

----------------------------------------------------| kīlabaddhavimuktāgrau sandaṃśau ṣoḍaśāṅgulau||7|| tvakśirāsnāyupiśitalagnaśalyāpakarṣaṇau| ----------------------------------------------------|8|

Sa. kīlena-masūrākāraparyantena, baddhaṃ tathā vimuktamagraṃ- mukhaṃ, yayostau kīlabaddhavimuktāgrau sandaṃśau bhavataḥ| kīdṛśau ? ṣoḍaśāṅgulapramāṇau| kvopayoga etayoḥ syāt ? ityāha-tvagityādi| tvagādīnāṃ dvandvaḥ| tvakśirāstrāyupiśitalagnaṃ ca tacchhalyaṃ ca, tasyāpakarṣṇe-āharaṇe, tāvupayujyete|
Ā. rā. sandaṃśāścatvāraḥ| tatra krīlabaddhāgrakīlamuktāgrau sandaṃśāvāha-kīlabaddhavimuktāgrāviti|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------------| ṣaḍaṅgulo'nyo haraṇe sūkṣmaśalyopapakṣmaṇām||8||

div.ab: Sa. ṣoḍaśāṅgulasandaṃśadvayādanyaḥ sandaṃśaḥ (ṣaḍaṅgulapramāṇaḥ) sūkṣmaśalyānāṃ-nāsāromādīnāṃ, haraṇe-ākarṣaṇe, tathā, upapakṣmaṇāṃ vartmādibhavānāṃ haraṇe yujyate|
Ā. rā. ṣaḍaṅgulaṃ sandaṃśamāha-ṣaḍaṅgula iti| upapakṣmaṇāṃ-netreṣvavāntarapakṣmaṇām|

ab.seg: mucuṇḍī sūkṣmadantarjurmūle rucakabhūṣaṇā| gambhīravraṇamāṃsānāmarmaṇaḥ śeṣitasya ca||9||

div.ab: Sa. sā ca mucuṇḍīsaṃjñā| kimbhūtā mucuṇḍī? sūkṣmā dantā yasyāḥ sā sūkṣmadantā, tathā, ṛjuḥ-avakrā, na ca sandaṃśavadvakrā dvibāhurityārthaḥ| tathā, mūle-hastagrahaṇasthāne, rucakaṃ-aṅgulīyakarūpaṃ, bhūṣaṇaṃ yasyāḥ sā rucakabhūṣaṇā| rucakapīḍanena sā karma karotītyarthaḥ| gambhīraścāsau vraṇaśca gambhīravraṇastasmin māṃsāni-tasyādhimāṃsaṃ, etadviṣaya āharaṇe| armaṇaśca śeṣitasya cchhinnaśeṣasyāharaṇe mucuṇḍī|
Ā. rā. mucuṇḍyākhyaṃ sandaṃśamāha-mucuṇḍīti| sūkṣmadantā-sūkṣmāgrā| ṛjuḥ-avakrā| rucakabhūṣaṇā-mūle mudrikābaddhā| gambhīreṣu vraṇeṣu yāni māṃsāni, yāni ca netreṣu chinnaśeṣāṇyarmāṇi, teṣāṃ haraṇe|

ab.seg: dve dvādaśāṅgule matsyatālavat dvyekalālake| tālayantre smṛte karṇanāḍīśalyāpahāriṇī||10||

div.ab: Sa. dve tālayantre bhavataḥ| kiṃpramāṇe ? dvādaśāṅgule| saṃsthānamāha-matsyatālavat mīnagalatālavat, dvitālakaṃ-ekaṃ dvayoḥ pārśvayormatsyamukhasadṛśam, aparamekatālakaṃ-ekapārśve matsyamukhākārameva| te dve tālayantre bhavataḥ| karṇetyādi| karṇanāḍī śalyamapaharataḥ-karṇanāḍīśalyāpahāriṇī|
Ā. rā. tālayantradvayamāha-dve dvādaśāṅgula iti| matsyatālo-matsyagalatālaḥ|

ab.seg: nāḍīyantrāṇi suṣirāṇyekānekamukhāni ca| srotogatānāṃ śalyānāmāmayānāṃ ca darśane||11||
kriyāṇāṃ sukaratvāya kuryādācūṣaṇāya ca| tadvistāraparīṇāhadairghyaṃ srotonurodhataḥ||12||

div.ab: Sa. nāḍīyantrāṇi bastinetrādivat suṣirāṇi syuḥ| ekaṃ cānekaṃ caikānekaṃ mukhaṃ yeṣām| tani ca kānicidekamukhāni ekadvārāṇi, kānicidanekamukhāni-anekadvārāṇi| etatkarmācaṣṭe-srota ityādi| tāni ca karṇādisrotogatānāṃ śalyānāṃ darśananimittaṃ vidadhīta| tathā, kaṇṭhādisrotogatānāṃ rogāṇāṃ darśane-darśananimittaṃ, vidadhīta| tathā, kriyāṇāṃ-śastrakṣārāgniprakṣālanauṣadhapraṇidhānādīnāṃ, sukaratvārtham| tathā, viṣidigdhāṅgādīnāmācūṣaṇāya vidadhīta| tadvistāretyādi| teṣāṃ-nāḍīyantrāṇāṃ, vistāraśca parīṇāhaśca dairghyaṃ ca, tāni srotovaśāt bhavanti| yathā,-anuvāsanottarabastinasyanāḍikādiṣu nirdiṣṭam|
Ā. rā. nāḍīyantrāṇyāha-nāḍīyantrāṇīti| vistāro-vivarasya| parīṇāhaḥ-sthaulyaṃ yantrasya|
daśāṅgulā'rdhanāhā'ntaḥkaṇṭhaśalyāvalokinī| nāḍī----------------------------------------|13|
Sa. kaṇṭhe śalyaṃ kaṇṭhaśalyam| kaṇṭhābhyantaraśalyāvalokanārthaṃ daśāṅgulā nāḍī| ardhanāhā-pañcāṅgulapariṇāhā|
Ā. rā. kaṇṭhāntaḥśalyāvalokinīṃ nāḍīmāha-daśāṅguleti| ardhanāhā-pañcāṅgulasthaulyā|

----------------------------------------------------| --------pañcamukhacchhidrā catuṣkarṇasya saṅgrahe||13|| vāraṅgasya, dvikarṇasya tricchhidrā tatpramāṇataḥ| ----------------------------------------------------|14|

Sa. pañcamukhāni chhidrāṇi yasyāḥ sā| catuṣkarṇasya vāraṅgasya saṅgrahe-saṅgrahaṇanimittamidaṃ yantram| catvāraḥ karṇā yasya vāraṅgasyeti samāsaḥ| tatra śarādidaṇḍapraveśaḥ śikhākāraḥ kīlako vāraṅga ucyate| dvikarṇasya vāraṅgasya tricchhidrā nāḍī syāt| trīṇi chhidrāṇi yasyāḥ sā tricchhidrā| chhidraśabdasyopalakṣaṇarthatvāt trimukhetyetadapi draṣṭavyam| tasya vāraṅgasya pramāṇaṃ tatpramāṇaṃ tasmādvāraṅgapramāṇataḥ-tadanusāreṇa nāḍīpramāṇaṃ jñeyam|

Ā. rā. catuṣkarṇavāraṅgasaṅgrahaṇīṃ nāḍīmāha-nāḍīti| pañcamukhacchidrā-mukhe chidrapañcakayutā| dvikarṇasaṅgrahaṇīṃ nāḍīmāha-dvikarṇasyeti| tatpramāṇataḥ-saṅgrahyapramāṇena| etacca nāḍīdvaye chidramānam|

----------------------------------------------------| vāraṅgakarṇasaṃsthānānāhadairghyānurodhataḥ||14|| nāḍīrevaṃvidhāścānyā draṣṭuṃ śalyāni kārayet| ----------------------------------------------------|15|
Sa. tathā, karṇaśca saṃsthānaṃ cānāhaśca dairghyaṃ ca tānyevam| vāraṅgasya karṇasaṃsthānānāhadairghyāṇi, teṣāmanurodhastasmāt, evaṃprakārā anyā api nāḍīḥ śalyāni śarīrāntargatāni draṣṭuṃ kārayet|
Ā. rā. anyāni nāḍīyantrāṇyāha-vāraṅgakarṇeti| saṃsthānaṃ-ākṛtiḥ| ānāhaḥ-sthaulyam|

Sa. mūrdhni-mūrddhabhāge, padmakarṇikayā-jalajakarṇikayā, sadṛśī| kiyatpramāṇā ? dvādaśāṅgulā| tathā, caturthaḥ-caturbhāgaḥ, suṣiro yasyāḥ sā, tryaṅhgulasuṣireti yāvat| sā nāḍī śalyanirghātinī matā| munīnāmiti śeṣaḥ| arśoyantraṃ lakṣayitumāha-
Ā. rā. śalyanirghātinīṃ nāḍīmāha-padmakarṇikayeti| caturthasuṣirā-tryaṅguladīrghavivarā|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------------| arśasāṃ gostanākāraṃ yantrakaṃ caturaṅgulam||16||
nāhe pañcāṅgulaṃ puṃsāṃ pramadānāṃ ṣaḍaṅgulam| dvicchhidraṃ darśane vyādherekacchhidraṃ tu karmaṇi||17||
madhye'sya tryaṅgulaṃ chhidramaṅguṣṭhodaravistṛtam| ardhāṅgulocchhritodvṛttakarṇikaṃ ca tadūrdhvataḥ||18||

div.ab: Sa. arśasāṃ sambandhi yantrakaṃ gostanākṛti caturaṅgulaṃ mānato dairghyeṇa syāt| yantrakamityākarṣakaṃ syāt| nāhe-pariṇāhe, pañcāṅgulam| yatpañcāṅguladīrgheṇa sūtreṇa veṣṭyate, tatpramāṇaṃ sthaulyamityarthaḥ| etat puṃsāmeva pañcāṅgulaṃ nāhe syāt| strīṇāṃ tu pariṇāhe ṣaḍaṅgulaṃ yantrakaṃ syāt, svabhāvata eva tāsāṃ gudasya mahattvāt| vyādherdarśane dvicchhidraṃ-ubhayapārśvacchhidraṃ yantram| karmaṇi-śastrakṣārādyavacāraṇe, ekacchhidraṃ yantram| asya yantrasya madhye tryaṅgulaṃ chhidram| aṅhguṣṭhamadhyatulyavistāraṃ, tathā tadūrdhvato'rdhāṅgulocchhritā uddṛttā karṇikā yasya tadevam|

Ā. rā. arśoyantrākhyāṃ nāḍīmāha-arśasāmiti| caturaṅgulaṃ dairghye| pariṇāhe tu puṃsāṃ pañcāṅgulaṃ, strīṇāṃ ṣaḍaṅgulam| vyādherdarśane dvicchidram, kṣārādiyojane tu śeṣāṅgaparirakṣāyāmekacchidram| dvicchidrasya tu dvayoḥ pārśvayoścchidram, ekacchidrasyaikasmin pārśve| tacca tryaṅguladairghyamaṅguṣṭhodaravistāraṃ madhye kāryam| chidrādurdhvabhage mūle'rdhāṅgulocchrāyā bahiḥkuñcitāgrā karṇikā kāryā|
śamyākhyaṃ tādṛgacchhidraṃ yantramarśaḥprapīḍanam| ----------------------------------------------------|19|

Sa. śamyākhyaṃ-śamīsaṃjñaṃ, tṛtīyaṃ yantrakaṃ tādṛg-gostanākāramityādilakṣaṇalakṣitayantrasadṛśaṃ syāt| atra viśeṣamāha-acchhidramityādi| acchhidraṃ-chhidrarahitam, yantre chhidraṃ na vidheyamityarthaḥ| idaṃ ca yantramarśaḥprapīḍanaṃ syāt|
Ā. rā. tṝtīyamarśaḥpīḍanaṃ śamyākhyaṃ yantramāha-śamyākhyamiti| tādṛk-gostanākārādilakṣaṇam| acchidraṃ-pārśvacchidrarahitam|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------------| sarvathā'panayedoṣṭhaṃ chhidrādūrdhvaṃ bhagandare||19||

div.ab: Sa. sarvathā bhagandare-bhagandarayantre, oṣṭhamapanayet| kutaḥ prabhṛti ? chhidrādūrdhvam,-upariṣṭādardhāṅgulamapakarṣayedityarthaḥ| karṇikā tu kāryaiva (?)|
Ā. rā. bhagandarayantrākhyāṃ nāḍīmāha-sarvatheti| arśoyantramevāpanītauṣṭhaṃ bhagandarayantram| mukhacchidrasya pārśvabhāga oṣṭhaḥ|

ab.seg: ghrāṇārbudārśasāmekacchhidrā nāḍyaṅguladvayā| pradeśinīparīṇāhā syādbhagandarayantravat||20||

div.ab: Sa. ghrāṇārbude ghrāṇārśasi caikacchhidrā nāḍī dairghyeṇāṅguladvayapramāṇā| tathā, pradeśinītulyaḥ parīṇāho yasyāḥ saivam| sā ca bhagandarayantratulyā syāt, apanītauṣṭhetyarthaḥ|
Ā. rā. ghrāṇārśorbudayantrākhyāṃ nāḍīmāha-ghrāṇārbudeti|

ab.seg: aṅhgulitrāṇakaṃ dāntaṃ vārkṣaṃ vā caturaṅgulam| dvicchhidraṃ gostanākāraṃ tadvaktravivṛtau sukham||21||

div.ab: Sa. aṅgulitrāṇakākhyaṃ yantraṃ dantamayaṃ kāṣṭhamayaṃ vā caturaṅgulapramāṇamarśasāṃ yantrasadṛśaṃ dvicchhidraṃ gostanākṛti syāt| tacca vaktrasya vivṛtau-prasāraṇe, sukham| yato vaktraprasāraṇe aṅgulerdantebhyo rakṣaṇādanvarthamaṅgulitrāṇakamiti nāma|
Ā. rā. aṅgulitrāṇākhyaṃ nāḍīyantramāha-aṅgulitrāṇakamiti| vaktravivṛtau-vaktravikāśanārthaṃ, praveśitāmaṅgulīṃ rakṣatītyaṅgulitrāṇakam|
yonivraṇekṣaṇaṃ madhye suṣiraṃ ṣoḍaśāṅgulam| mudrābaddhaṃ caturbhittamambhojamukulānanam||22|| catuḥśalākamākrāntaṃ mūle tadvikasenmukhe| ----------------------------------------------------|23|

Sa. yonivraṇamīkṣate'neneti tat yonivraṇekṣaṇaṃ yantrakam| madhye-madhyabhāge, suṣiram| tathā, dairdhyeṇa ṣoḍaśāṅgulam| tathā mudrikayā-ūrmikayā'sañcāriṇyā, baddhaṃ-yuktam| tathā, catvāro (ri) bhittāḥ(ttāni)-patrāṇi, yasya taccaturbhittam| tathā, jalajamukulasadṛśamukham| tathā, catasraḥ śalākā yatra tat catuḥśalākam| tathā, tat-yantraṃ, mūla ākrāntaṃ-mūlaśalākākramaṇāt mukhe vikaset-prasaret|
Ā. rā. yonivraṇekṣaṇākhyāṃ nāḍīmāha-yonivraṇekṣaṇamiti| caturbhittaṃ-catuḥśakalam|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------------| yantre nāḍīvraṇābhyaṅgakṣālanāya ṣaḍaṅgule||23||
bastiyantrākṛtī mūle mukhe'ṅguṣṭhakalāyakhe| agrato'karṇike mūle nibaddhamṛducarmaṇī||24||

div.ab: Sa. yantre dve ṣaḍaṅgule bhavataḥ| kimartham ? nāḍīvrāṇābhyaṅgakṣālanāya,-abhyaṅgaśca kṣālanaṃ cābhyaṅgakṣālane tadarthaṃ, upayujyete| ākaraṇaṃ-ākṛt, sampadāditvāt kvip| pūrvavihitasya bastiyantrasyeva ākṛt-ākāro, yayoste bastiyantrākṛtī,-vṛtte gopucchhākāre| tathā, yathāsaṅkhyaṃ mūle mukhe'ṅguṣṭhakalāyakhe-mūle'ṅguṣṭhatulyacchhidre, mukhe kalāyatulyacchhidre| agrato'karṇike- karṇikārahite, iti bastiyantrādviśeṣaḥ| mūle tu karṇike dve'pi puṭakayojanārthaṃ kārya evetyagragrahaṇam| mūle-mūladeśe, nibaddhaṃ- yojitaṃ, mṛdu carma-bastipuṭakākāraṃ, yayoste nibaddhamṛducarmaṇī|

Ā. rā. nāḍīvraṇābhyañjananāḍīvraṇakṣālanākhyaṃ nāḍīdvayamāha-yantra iti| mūle'ṅguṣṭhapraveśacchidre, agre kalāyapraveśacchidre| agrato'karṇike-agre karṇikārahite| bastiyantrākṛtīni nāḍīviśeṣaṇam, yantraviśeṣaṇatve tu numprasaṅgaḥ|
Sa. udakodare jalasrāvaṇārthaṃ nalikā dvidvārā-ubhayamukhī, syāt| athavā, picchanalikā-mayūrapicchhajetyarthaḥ|
Ā. rā. jalodarayantrākhyāṃ nāḍīmāha-dvidvāreti| nalikā-veṇvādināḍī| picchanalikā-pakṣipicchanāḍī|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------------| dhūmabastyādiyantrāṇi nirdiṣṭāni yathāyatham||25||

div.ab: Sa. dhūmādiyantrāṇi yathāsvaṃ dhūmapānādyadhyāyeṣūktāni|
Ā. rā. dhūmayantrādyā nāḍya uktā ityāha-dhūmabastyādīti|

ab.seg: tryaṅgulāsyaṃ bhavecchhṛṅgaṃ cūṣaṇe'ṣṭādaśāṅgulam| agre siddhārthakacchhidraṃ sunaddhaṃ cūcukākṛti||26||

div.ab: Sa. śṛṅgaṃ tryaṅgulamukham| duṣṭavātaviṣaraktāmbuduṣṭastanyādeścūṣaṇe-cūṣaṇanimittaṃ, aṣṭādaśāṅgulaṃ syāt| aṣṭādaśeti ""hyaṣṭana" ityādinā''kārādeśaḥ| tathā, agre-prānte, sarṣapapramāṇacchhidram| yaḥ pradeśaścūṣaṇāya śarīre yojyate tadagram| tathā, suṣṭhu naddhaṃ-samyagbaddham| cūcukasya-strīkucāgrasyeva, ākṛtiḥ-ākāro, yasya tadevam|

Ā. rā. śṛṅgaṃ tryaṅgulamukham| duṣṭavātaviṣaraktāmbuduṣṭastanyādeścūṣaṇe-cūṣaṇanimittaṃ, aṣṭādaśāṅgulaṃ-aṣṭāṅgulaṃ daśāṅgulaṃ vā| saṅgrahe tu dvādaśāṅgulamapyuktam (sū.a.34)- "śṛṅgaṃ tu hRasvamadhyadīrghamaśṭādaśadvādaśāṅgulāyatam" iti|

ab.seg: syādvādaśāṅgulo'lāburnāhe tvaṣṭādaśāṅgulaḥ| catustryaṅgulavṛttāsyo dīpto'ntaḥ śleṣmaraktahṛt||27||

div.ab: Sa. alābuḥ-tumbaḥ, dvādaśāṅgulo dairghyeṇa syāt| pariṇāhe'ṣṭādaśāṅgulaḥ| catvāri vā trīṇi vā'ṅhgulāni yasya taccatustryaṅgulam, tattādṛśaṃ vṛtaṃ-vartulaṃ, āsyaṃ-mukhaṃ, yasya sa evam| tathā, antaḥ-madhye, dīpto-jvalitaḥ, picurbhūrjādi garbha ityarthaḥ| sa īdṛśo duṣṭakapharaktaharaḥ syāt|
Ā. rā. tumbākhyāṃ nāḍīmāha-syādvādaśeti| caturaṅgulāsyastryaṅgulāsyo vā| antardīptaḥ-pradīptatṛṇasṛṣṭapicunā|
Sa. tadvat-tenālābunā tulyadairghyānāhādiḥ, tulyakāryākārā ca, ghaṭī syāt| sā ca gulmasya vilaya unnamane ca hitā, na kevalaṃ kapharaktahṛditi cārthaḥ|
Ā. rā. ghatikākhyāṃ nāḍīmāha-tadva-ṭīti| tadvat-alābusadṛśī| gulmavilayane gulmonnamane ca| cakārāt śleṣmaraktāvacūṣaṇe ca|
Sa. śalākāsaṃjñāni yantrāṇi vividhakarmāṇi vividhākārāṇi yathāyogapramāṇāni syuḥ|
Ā. rā. śalākāyantrāṇyāha-śalākākhyānīti|
Sa. teṣāṃ madhya ubhe gaṇḍūpadatulyāsya eṣaṇakarmaṇī|
Ā. rā. eṣiṇyau śalāke āha-teṣāmiti| eṣaṇaṃ avalokanam|
Sa. tathā srotobhyaḥ śalyahāriṇī śalākāyantre bhavataḥ| kimbhūte ? masūretyādi| masūradalamiva vaktraṃ yayoste, masūradalamukhe dve śalāke'ṣṭāṅgule navāṅgule vā syātām|
Ā. rā. śalyahāriṇyau śalāke āha-srotobhya iti|
Sa. śaṅkavaḥ ṣaṭ syuḥ|
Ā. rā. śaṅkvākhyāḥ śalākā gaṇayati-śaṅkava iti|
Sa. teṣāṃ madhye dvau ṣoḍaśāṅguladvādaśāṅgulau bhavataḥ| vyūhane-nyūhanakarmaṇi, sarpaphaṇāmukhau|
Ā. rā. vyūhanau śaṅkū āha-ubhāviti| vyūhanaṃ-prasṛtamāṃsādīnām yathāsthānaṃ vinyāsaḥ|
------------------------dvau daśadvādaśāṅgulau| cālane śarapuṅkhāsyau-----------------------------|31|
Sa. dvau śaṅkū daśāṅguladvādaśāṅgulau bhavataḥ| cālane kāṇḍavāja iva mukhaṃ yayostau śarapuṅkhāsyau bhavataḥ|
Ā. rā. cālanau śaṅkū āha-dvāviti| śarapuṅkaṃ-śarakartarī|
Sa. āhārye-ākarṣaṇe, baḍiśākārau| ṣaṭśaṅhkūnākhyāya garbhaśaṅkumāha-
Ā. rā. āharaṇau śaṅkū āha-āhārye baḍiśākṛtīti| baḍiśaṃ-matsyavedhanam|

ab.seg: nato'gre śaṅkunā tulyo garbhaśaṅkuriti smṛtaḥ| āṣṭāṅgulāyatastena mūḍhagarbhaṃ haret striyāḥ||32||

div.ab: Sa. nato'gre-agrabhāge, tathā śaṅkunā samaḥ-kīlakākāraḥ, aṣṭāṅguladīrghaḥ sa garbhaśaṅkuriti smṛtaḥ, 'munibhiḥ' iti śeṣaḥ| tena-garbhaśaṅkunā, mūḍhagarbha-aniḥsarantaṃ, haret|
Ā. rā. saptamaṃ garbhaśaṅkumāha-nato'gra iti| nato-vakraḥ| śaṅkunā tulyaḥ-kīlakākāraḥ|
aśmaryāharaṇaṃ sarpaphāṇāvadvaktramagrataḥ| ----------------------------------------------------|33|
Sa. aśmaryākarṣaṇe sarpaphaṇāvadagre vaktraṃ syāt| sarpaphaṇākhyameva caitadyantram|
Ā. rā. aśmaryāharaṇaṃ śalākāyantramāha-aśmaryāharaṇamiti|

----------------------------------------------------| śarapuṅkhamukhaṃ dantapātanaṃ caturaṅgulam||33|| kārpāsavihitoṣṇīṣāḥ śalākāḥ ṣaṭ pramārjane| ----------------------------------------------------|34|

Sa. śarapuṅkhamukhākhyaṃ yantraṃ caturaṅgulaṃ dantapātanaṃ syāt| anena hi dantāścalantaḥ pātyante kṛmyādibhakṣitā vā| saṃ-pramārjane-kṣālane kṣārakledādeḥ, ṣaṭ śalākāḥ syuḥ| kimbhūtāḥ ? kārpāsena vihitamuṣṇīṣaṃ-śiroveṣṭanamiva, yāsāṃ tāstathoktāḥ|
Ā. rā. dantapātanaṃ śalākāyantramāha-śarapuṅkhamukhamiti| ā raṃ-pramārjanīḥ śalākā gaṇayati-kārpāsavihitoṣṇīṣā iti| uṣṇīṣaṃ-śiroveṣṭanam|
Sa. pāyāvāsannadūrārthe daśadvādaśāṅgule dve bhavataḥ| āsannārthe daśāṅgulā, dūrārthe dvādaśāṅguletyarthaḥ|
Ā. rā. pāyupramārjanyau śalāke āha-pāyāviti|
dve ṣaṭsaptāṅgule ghrāṇe, dve karṇe'ṣṭanavāṅule| ----------------------------------------------------|35|
Sa. ghrāṇe ṣaṭsaptāṅgule dve bhavataḥ| 'āsannadūrārthe' ityatrāpyanuvartate| tathaiva karṇe'ṣṭanavāṅgule bhavataḥ|
Ā. rā. ghrāṇapramārjanyau śalāke āha-dve ṣaḍiti| karṇapramārjanyau śalāke āha-dve karṇa iti|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------------| karṇaśodhanamaśvatthapatraprāntaṃ sruvānanam||35||

div.ab: Sa. karṇaśodhanākhyaṃ yantram| aśvatthapatrasyeva prānto yasya tattathā| tathā, sruvasyevānanaṃ yasya tadevam|
Ā. rā. karṇaśodhanaṃ śalākāyantramāha-karṇaśodhanamiti| dravasya malasyāpanayanaṃ-mārjanam, kaṭhinasya-śodhanam|
śalākājāmbavauṣṭhānāṃ kṣāre'gnau ca pṛthak trayam| yuñjyāt sthūlāṇudīrghāṇāṃ-----------------------------------|36|

Sa. śalākāśca jāmbavauṣṭhāni ca teṣāṃ pṛthak trayaṃ kṣāre kṣārapātane, [ āgnau-] āgnidāhakaraṇe ca yuñjyāt| kimbhūtānāṃ śalākājāmbavauṣṭhānām ? sthūlāṇudīrghāṇāṃ,-sthūlāścāṇavaśca dīrghāśca, teṣām| tatra śalākāstistro jāmbavauṣṭhāni ca trīṇi, kṣāre tathā dāhane, evaṃ dvādaśaitāni śalākākhyāni yantrāṇīti|

Ā. rā. kṣārāgniprayogārthaṃ tisraḥ śalākāstrīṇi ca jāmbavauṣṭhānyāha-śalākājāmbavauṣṭhānāmiti| sthūlaṃ ca sthūlāṃ ca aṇuśca aṇu ca dīrghā ca dīrghaṃ ca tāni sthūlāṇudīrghāṇītyekaśeṣeṇa nirdeśaḥ| aṇu-sūkṣmaṃ hrasvaṃ ca| tena sthūladīrghaṃ sūkṣmahasvaṃ madhyaṃ ceti trividhaṃ śalākāyantraṃ jāmbavauṣṭhaṃ ca| jambūphalavadoṣṭho yasya tajjāmbavauṣṭham, śalākāviśeṣa eva| saṅgrahe'pyuktam (sū.a. 34)-"kṣārāgnikarmārthaṃ jāmbavauṣṭhāni dvādaśadaśāṣṭāṅgulāni kramāt vdyaṅgulāṅgulārddhāṅgulaphalāni| śalākāśca sthūlasūkṣmadīrghahrasvamadhyāḥ|" iti|
Sa. antravardhmani-antravṛddhau, śalākāṃ yuñjyāt| kīdṛśīm ? madhyādūrdhvaṃ vṛtto daṇḍo yasyāstām| tathā, mūle-mūlabhāge, ardhendusannibhāṃ-ardhacandrākārām|
Ā. rā. antravṛddhau dāhārthaṃ śalākāmāha-śalākāmiti| mūle-grahaṇasthāne| madhyordhvavṛttadaṇḍāṃ-ardhacandrākṛtiṃ śalākāṃ vidhāya tanmadhye ūrdhvo vṛtto daṇḍaḥ kāryaḥ|
Sa. badarāsthikhaṇḍasamaṃ mukhaṃ yasyāḥ sā kolāsthidalatulyāsyā| sā nāsārśaḥsu nāsārbudeṣu ca dāhaṃ karoti|
Ā. rā. nāsārśorbudadāhārthaṃ śalākāmāha-kolāsthidaleti|

ab.seg: aṣṭāṅgulā nimnamukhāstisraḥ kṣārauṣadhakrame| kanīnīmadhyamānāmīnakhamānasamairmukhaiḥ||38||

div.ab: Sa. kṣārauṣadhakrame tisraḥ śalākā nimnamukhā aṣṭāṅgulāḥ syuḥ| kīdṛśyaḥ ? kanīnī ca madhyamā cānāmī ca, tāsāṃ nakhāḥ, teṣāṃ mānaṃ-pramāṇaṃ, tena samaiḥ-tulyaiḥ, mukhairupalakṣitāḥ syuḥ|
Ā. rā. darvyākhyāstisraḥ śalākā āha-aṣṭāṅgulā iti|
svaṃsvamuktāni yantrāṇi meḍhraśuddhyañjanādiṣu| -----------------------------------------------------|39|
Sa. meḍhrādiṣu viṣayeṣu-uttarabastyādiṣu, svaṃsvaṃ-yathāsvaṃ, yantrāṇi gaditāni| ādiśabdena nāvanādiparigrahaḥ|
Ā. rā. meḍhraśodhanādyāḥ śalākāstatra tatroktā ityāhasvaṃsvamuktānīti|

-----------------------------------------------------| anuyantrāṇyayaskāntarajjuvastrāśmamudgarāḥ||39|| vadhrāntrajihvābālāśca śākhānakhamukhadvijāḥ| kālaḥ pākaḥ karaḥ pādo bhayaṃ harṣaśca, tatkriyāḥ||40|| upāyavitpravibhajedālocya nipuṇaṃ dhiyā||40.5||
Sa. ayaskāntādīnyaṇuyantrāṇi, svalpayantrakāryakaraṇāt| teṣāṃ kriyāstatkriyāḥ-nirghātanādikāḥ, buddhyā nipuṇamālocya pravibhajet,-nirghātanādikarmāṇi pravibhajya yuñjyādityarthaḥ|

Ā. rā. anuyantrāṇyāha-anuyantrāṇīti| ayaskāntādīnyekonaviṃśatiranuyantrāṇi| saṅgrahe tu (sū.a. 34)-"etāni dehe sarvasmin dehasyāvayave'pi vā| sandhau koṣṭhe dhamanyāṃ ca yathāyogaṃ prayojayet||" iti| anuyantrakarmāṇi svayamūhyānītyata āha tatkriyā iti|
tānyeva yantrāṇāṃ karmāṇyāha ---- nirghātanonmathanapūraṇamārgaśuddhi- saṃvyūhanāharaṇabandhanapīḍanāni| ācūṣaṇonnamananāmanacālabhaṅga- vyāvartanarjukaraṇāni ca yantrakarma||41.5||
Sa. nirghātanādi yantrasya karma| nirghātanaṃ-tāḍanaṃ paripātanam, unmathanaṃ-āloḍanaṃ unmūlanam, evamanyadapi cintyam| caḥ samuccaye, tena prakṣālanādīni samuccīyante|
Ā. rā. yantrakarmāṇyāha-nirghātaneti| saṅgrahe tu (sū.a. 34)-"vivaraṇavikarṣaṇavyathanaiṣaṇadāraṇaprakṣālanapradhamanāñjanapramārjanāni" iti navādhikānīti caturviṃśatiḥ|

vivartate sādhvavagāhate ca grāhyaṃ gṛhītvoddharate ca yasmāt| yantreṣvataḥ kaṅkamukhaṃ pradhānaṃ sthāneṣu sarveṣvadhikāri yacca| 42 1/2| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ sūtrasthāne yantravidhirnāma pañcaviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ|25|

Sa. vivartanādibhiścaturbhiḥ kāraṇairyantreṣu madhye kaṅkamukhaṃ śreṣṭhamiti| yasmācca sarveṣu pradeśeṣvadhikāri-adhikriyate iti| vasantatilakopajātī vṛtte| iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayaṭīkāyāṃ sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ sūtrasthāne yantravidhirnāma pañcaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 25||

Ā. rā. yantreṣu kaṅkamukhasya prādhānyamāha-vivartata iti| saṅgrahe tu (sū.a.34)-"hrasvadīrghasthūlatanuvakraviṣamagrāhyagrāhiśithilatetyaṣṭau yantradoṣāḥ|" iti| iti hemādriṭīkāyāmāyurvedarasāyane| yantrakarmaprakaraṇaṃ sāmastyena nirūpitam|| 25||

div.head: śastravidhiradhyāyaḥ
div.ab: Sa. athedānīṃ ṣaḍviṃśādhyāyarambhaḥ śastrasvarūpavijñānārthaḥ|
athātaḥ śastravidhimadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre|2| )|3|
Sa. śastrasya vidhiḥ śastravidhiḥ| śeṣaṃ pūrvavat|
Ā. rā. śastravidhimadhyāyaṃ vyākhyātuṃ pratijānīte-atheti|

ṣaḍviṃśatiḥ sukarmārairghaṭitāni yathāvidhi| śastrāṇi romavāhīni bāhulyenāṅgulāni ṣaṭ||1|| surūpāṇi sudhārāṇi sugrahāṇi ca kārayet| akarālāni sudhmātasutīkṣṇāvartite'yasi||2|| samāhitamukhāgrāṇi nīlambhojacchavīni ca| nāmānugatarūpāṇi sadā sannihitāni ca||3|| svonmanārdhacaturthaaṃśaphalānyekaikaśo'pi ca| prāyo dvitrāṇi, yuñjīta tāni sthānaviśeṣataḥ||4|| (maṇḍalāgraṃ vṛddhipatramutpalādhyarddhadhārake| sarpaiṣaṇyau vetasākhyaṃ śarāryāsyatrikūrcake||1|| kuśāsyaṃ sāṭavadanamantarvakrārdhacandrake (kam)| vrīhimukhaṃ kuṭhārī ca śalākāṅguliśastrake||2|| baḍiśaṃ karapatrākhyaṃ kartarī nakhaśastrakam| dantalekhanakaṃ sūcyaḥ kūrco nāma khrajāhvayam||3|| ārā caturvidhākārā tathā syātkarṇavedhanī(nam)||3.5||

Sa. bāhulyena śastrāṇi ṣaḍaṅgulāni bhavanti| tathā ṣaḍviṃśatisaṅkhyāni, tathā sukarmāraiḥ-karmakuśalairnaraiḥ, yathāvidhi { ghaṭitāni }-samyaṅniṣpāditāni, tathā romavāhīni-lomaśātanasamarthāni, tathā surūpāṇi-śobhanākārāṇi, tathā sudhārāṇi-śobhanadhārāṇi, tathā sukhena gṛhyante-sugrahāṇi ca, kārayet| kva ? ayasi| kīdṛśe ? suṣṭhu dhmātaṃ sudhmātaṃ, tathā sutīkṣṇaṃ svāvartitaṃ ca yadayaḥ-śastraṃ, tasmin| kīdṛśāni śastrāṇi ? akarālāni-sudarśanāni| tathā, samāhitaṃ-suṣṭhukṛtaṃ, mukhāgraṃ-phalaṃ, yeṣāṃ tāni samāhitamukhāgrāṇi| tathā, nīlotpaladyutīni| tathā, nāmnā'nugataṃ rūpaṃ yeṣāṃ tāni-anvarthanāmānītyarthaḥ| tathā, sarvakālaṃ sannihitāni-samīpasthāni| tathā, svaṃ ca tadunmānaṃ ca svonmānaṃ-ātmīyaṃ pramāṇaṃ, tasmātsakāśādardham, tasya caturthāṃśaḥ-aṣṭabhāgaḥ, phalaṃ yeṣāṃ tānyevam| api ceti samuccaye| evaṃvidhāni śastrāṇyekaikaśaḥ sthānaviśeṣāt dvitrāṇi prayuñjīta| ekaikaśa iti "ekaṃ bahuvrīhivat " iti dvitvasublopau, tataḥ śaspratyayaḥ|

Ā. rā. śastrāṇāṃ sāmānyalakṣaṇamāha-ṣaḍviṃśatiriti| sukarmāraiḥ-uttamalohakāraiḥ| romavāhīni-romacchedīni| akarālāni-ārjavavanti| ayasi-lohe ghaṭitāni, tṛtīyārthe saptamī| samāhitaṃ-samyagghāṭitaṃ, mukhāgraṃ-phalaṃ, yeṣāṃ tāni| svonmānasya-aṅgulaṣaṭkasya, ardhacaturthāṃśaḥ-adhyuṣṭo bhāgaḥ,- saptamāṃśadvayasahitaṃ yavadaśakam, tatparimāṇaṃ phalaṃ yeṣāṃ tāni| ekaikaśo dvitrāṇi-pratyekaṃ dve trīṇi vā, kārayet| ṣaḍviṃśaterupayogamāha-yuñjīteti|

ab.seg: maṇḍalāgraṃ phale teṣāṃ tarjanyantarnakhākṛti| lekhane chedane yojyaṃ pothakīśuṇḍikādiṣu||5||

div.ab: Sa. teṣāṃ śastrāṇāṃ madhye maṇḍalāgraṃ nāma śastram| kīdṛk ? phaloddeśe tarjanyā antarnakhastarjanyantarnakhaḥ tasyevākṛtiryasya tadevam| kvaitadyojyam ? ityāha-lekhane chedane ca pothakyādiṣu yojyam| ādiśabdena vartmarogādayo gṛhyante|
Ā. rā. maṇḍalāgraṃ śastramāha-maṇḍalāgramiti| śuṇḍikā-galaśuṇḍikā|

vṛddhipatraṃ kṣurākāraṃ chedabhedanapāṭane| ṛjvagramunnate śophe gambhīre ca tadanyathā||6|| natāgraṃ pṛṣṭhato dīrghahrasvavaktraṃ yathāśrayam| -----------------------------------------------------|7|

Sa. vṛddhipatraṃ nāma śastraṃ kṣurākāraṃ syāt| tacca chedanādiṣu yojyamiti prakṛtam| phalaparimāṇaṃ tūktameva| kīdṛk ? ṛju-spaṣṭamagraṃ yasya tadṛjvagram, tadunnate śophe syāt| gambhīre tu śophe tat-vṛddhipatramanyathā| kathamanyathā ? ityāha-natetyādi| pṛṣṭhataḥ-pṛṣṭhadeśe, natamagraṃ yasya tannatāgraṃ bhavatīti|
Ā. rā. vṛddhipatramāha-vṛddhipatramiti| unnate gambhīre ca śophe ṛjvagram| anyathābhūte śophe pṛṣṭhato natāgram| sthānavaśena dīrghamukhaṃ hrasvamukhaṃ ca|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------------| utpalādhyardhadhārākhye bhedane chedane tathā||7||

div.ab: Sa. { yathāyathaṃ-yathāsvaṃ, dīrghavaktraṃ hrasvavaktraṃ ca yuñjyāt| } utpalaṃ cādhyardhadhāraṃ ca, te ākhye yayosta utpalādhyardhadhārākhye śastre yathākramaṃ dīrghahrasvavaktre bhavathaḥ| utpalapatraṃ dīrghamukhamadhyardhadhāraṃ tu hrasvavaktramityarthaḥ| te bhedane chedane ca yojye| tatheti samuccaye, pāṭane ca yojya ityarthaḥ|
Ā. rā. utpalapatramadhyarddhadhāraṃ ceti śastradvayamāha-utpaleti| ete svanāmānugatarūpe|
sarpāsyaṃ ghrāṇakarṇārśaścchedane'rdhāṅgulaṃ phale| -----------------------------------------------------|8|
Sa. sarpavaktraṃ nāma śastraṃ nāmānugatākāraṃ ghrāṇārśaścchedane karṇārśaśchedane ca yojyam| tacca phale'rdhāṅgulaṃ bhavati|
Ā. rā. sarpavaktramāha-sarpāsyamiti|

Sa. eṣaṇī nāma śastram gatervraṇānāmanveṣaṇe yojyam| kīdṛśī ? ślakṣṇā-komalasparśā| tathā, gaṇḍūpadamukhamiva mukhaṃ yasyāḥ sā gaṇḍūpadamukhā| dvitīyāmeṣaṇīmāha- aparaiṣaṇī bhedanārthe sūcīmukhā syāt| tathā, mūle niviṣṭaṃ-kṛtaṃ, khaṃ-chidraṃ, yasyāḥ sā mūlaniviṣṭakhā|
Ā. rā. anveṣaṇārthameṣaṇīmāha-gateriti| gateḥ-nāḍīvraṇasya| bhedanārthameṣaṇīmāha-bhedanārtha iti| bhedanatvaṃ kṣārāktasūtrapraveśanena|
Sa. vetasaṃ- vetasapatrākāraṃ śastram, ṣaḍaṅgulaṃ pūrvoktaphalam| tacca vyadhane yojyam|
Ā. rā. vetasaśastramāha-vetasamiti|
Sa. śarāriḥ-āṭhyākhyaḥ pakṣiviśeṣaḥ| śarāryāsyaṃ nāma śastraṃ trikūrcake ca srāvye yojyam|
Ā. rā. śarārimukhaṃ trikūrcakaṃ ceti śastradvayamāhasrāvya iti| srāvye-pracchānena raktasrutau| bhāve kṛtyapratyayaḥ| śarāriḥ-pakṣiviśeṣaḥ|
kuśāṭāvadane srāvye hyaṅgulaṃ syāttayoḥ phalam| -----------------------------------------------------|10|
Sa. kuśāṭā nāma śastraṃ vadane srāvye yojyam| tayoḥ-śarārikuśāṭayoḥ, phalaṃ dvyaṅgulapramāṇaṃ syāt|
Ā. rā. kuśapatramāṭāmukhaṃ ceti śastradvayamāha-kuśāṭeti| āṭā-pakṣiviśeṣaḥ|
Sa. antarmukhaṃ nāma śastraṃ tadvat-kuśāṭātulyam| tasya-antarmukhasya, phalaṃ sārdhamaṅgulaṃ syāt| tathā-kuśāṭātulyametadapi, ardhacandrāsyasaṃjñaṃ śastram| caḥ samuccaye bhinnakrame|
Ā. rā. antarmukhamāha-tadvaditi| tadvat-srāvye|

ab.seg: ----------------------tathādhyardhāṅgulaṃ phale| vrīhivaktraṃ prayojyaṃ ca tacchirodarayorvyadhe||11||

div.ab: Sa. vrīhivaktramapyadhyardhāṅgulaṃ phale syāt| tacca śirāvyadha udaravyadhe ca yojyam|
Ā. rā. vrīhimukhamāha-tatheti|

ab.seg: pṛthuḥ kuṭhārī godantasadṛśārdhāṅgulānanā| tayordhvadaṇḍayā vidhyeduparyasthāṃ sthitāṃ śirām||12||

div.ab: Sa. kuṭhārī nāma śastraṃ pṛthuḥ-vistīrṇasaṃsthānadaṇḍā| tathā, godantasadṛśamardhāṅgulamānanaṃ yasyāḥ saivam| tayā-kuṭhārikayā, ūrdhvadaṇḍayā satyā śirāmasthnāmupari sthitāṃ vidhyet|
Ā. rā. kuṭhārīmāha-pṛthuriti| kuṭhāryāḥ kāryamāha-tayeti|
tāmrī śalākā dvimukhī mukhe kurubakākṛtiḥ| liṅganāśaṃ tayā vidhyet------------------|13|

Sa. tāmramayī śalākā dvimukhī syāt| sā ca mukhe kurubakākṛtiḥ-raktasahacarapuṣpamukulākārā syāt| tayā śalākayā, liṅganāśaṃ-kaphotthapaṭalasaṃjñaṃ, vidhyet| raṃ0-śalākāmāha-tāmrīti| kurubakaṃ-kuraṇṭakamukulam|

ab.seg: mudrikānirgatamukhaṃ phale tvardhāṅgulāyatam| yogato vṛddhipatreṇa maṇḍalāgreṇa vā samam||14||
tatpradeśinyagraparvapramāṇārpaṇamudrikam| sūtrabaddhaṃ galasrotorogacchedanabhedane||15||

div.ab: Sa. aṅguliśastrakaṃ kuryāt| kīdṛśam ? mudrikayā-ūrmikayā, nirgataṃ-niṣkrāntaṃ, mukhaṃ yasya tanmudrikānirgatamukham| phale tu-tasminmukhe, ardhāṅguladīrgham| yogataḥ-saṃsthānena, vṛddhipatreṇa maṇḍalāgreṇa vā tulyam| kiyatpramāṇā'sya mudrikā kāryā ? ityāha-tatpradeśinyagretyādi| tasya-vaidyasya, yā pradeśinī tasyā yadagraparva tasya yatpramāṇaṃ tenārpyata iti tatpradeśinyagraparvapramāṇārpaṇī-bhiṣaktarjanyagraparvapraveśāgracchhidrā, mudrikā yasmin tat tatpradeśinyagraparvapramāṇārpaṇamudrikam| tathā, sūtreṇa baddhaṃ-sūtrabaddham, sūtreṇa baddhvā maṇibandhe yojyamityarthaḥ| galasrotorogāṇāṃ chedane bhedane ca tadyojyam|
Ā. rā. aṅguliśastrakamāha-kuryāditi| mudrikānirgatamukhaṃ-kaṇṭhasthamudrikam| yogataḥ-sthānarogayogyatānusāreṇa vikalpya|
grahaṇe śuṇḍikārmāderbaḍiśaṃ sunatānanam| ----------------------------------------------|16|
Sa. baḍiśaṃ nāma śastraṃ śuṇḍikārmādergrahaṇe yojyam| ādiśabdena pratijihvikādergrahaṇam| kīdṛśaṃ tat ? sunataṃ-aṅkuśavadānataṃ, ānanaṃ-mukhaṃ, yasya tadevam|
Ā. rā. baḍiśamāha-grahaṇa iti|

----------------------------------------------| chede'stthnāṃ karapatraṃ tu kharadhāraṃ daśāṅgulam||16|| vistāre dvyaṅgulaṃ sūkṣmadantaṃ sutsarubandhanam| ----------------------------------------------|17|

Sa. karapatraṃ nāma śastraṃ kharadhāraṃ, tathā daśāṅgulaṃ dairghyeṇa, dvyaṅgulaṃ vistāreṇa, sūkṣmā dantā yasya tatsūkṣmadantam| tathā, tsaruḥ-muṣṭiḥ, bandhanaṃ-grahaṇam, śobhane tsarubandhane yasya tat sutsarubandhanam| abhidhānakośe yadyapi 'tsaruḥ-asimuṣṭiḥ' ityabhyadhāyi, tathā'pi muṣṭimātrasyehopalakṣaṇārthatvāt muṣṭāvapyupapannameva|
Ā. rā. karapatramāha-chede'sthnāmiti| suṣṭhu tsarubandhanaṃ grahaṇārthaṃ yasya|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------| snāyusūtrakacacchede kartarī kartarīnibhā||17||

div.ab: Sa. kartarī nāma śastraṃ kartarīsadṛśaṃ snāyvādicchede yojyam|
Ā. rā. kartarīmāha-srāyusūtrakacaccheda iti|

ab.seg: vaktrarjudhāraṃ dvimukhaṃ nakhaśastraṃ navāṅulam| sūkṣmaśalyoddhṛticchedamedapracchānalekhane||18||

div.ab: Sa. nakhaśastraṃ-nakhacchedakaṃ, prasiddham| tacca vaktrā ṛjuśca dhārā yasya tadevam| tasyaikaṃ mukhaṃ vaktramanyadṛju-spaṣṭam| tathā, navāṅgulaṃ-navāṅulapramāṇam, na tu ṣaḍaṅgulam| etacca sūkṣmaśalyasya-kaṇṭakāderuddharaṇadau nakhacchedane bhedane { pracchaane lekhane } ca yojyam|
Ā. rā. nakhaśastramāha-vakrarjudhāramiti| navāṅgulaṃ na tu ṣaḍaṅgulam| nakhacchedanakaṃ-prasiddham| vakrarjudhāraṃ ekasminmukhe vakrā dhārā, anyasmin ṛjuḥ|

ab.seg: adhunā dantalekhanaśastramāha ---- ekadhāraṃ catuṣkoṇaṃ prabaddhākṛti caikataḥ| dantalekhanakaṃ tena śodhayedvantaśarkarām||19||

div.ab: Sa. ekadhāraṃ-ekasmin pradeśe { dhārā yasya tadevam| } tathā, catuṣkoṇam| tathā, ekataḥ-ekasmindeśe prabaddhā ākṛtiryasya tat| taddantalekhanakaṃ nāma śastram| tena dantaśarkarāṃ śodhayet|
Ā. rā. adhunā sūcīśastramāha-dantalekhanamāha-ekadhāramiti| prabaddhavat-veṣṭitavat, ākṛtiryasya tat prabaddhākṛti|

adhunā sūcīśastramāha ---- vṛttā gūḍhadṛḍhāḥ pāśe tisraḥ sūcyo'tra sīvane| māṃsalānāṃ pradeśānāṃ tryasrā tryaṅgulamāyatā||20|| alpamāṃsāsthisandhisthavraṇānāṃ dvyaṅgulāyatā| vrīhivaktrā dhanurvaktrā pakvāmāśayamarmasu||21|| sā sārdhadvyaṅgulā-------------------------| ----------------------------------------------|22|

Sa. atra-eṣu śastreṣu madhye, sīvane-sīvanaviṣaye, tisraḥ sūcyaḥ syuḥ| kimbhūtāḥ ? vṛttāḥ-vartulāḥ, pāśe gūḍhāstathā dṛḍhāḥ sāratvāt| āsāṃ ca pratyekaṃ saṃsthānaviśeṣeṇa viśeṣopayogamāha- māṃsalānāṃ-bahumāṃsānāṃ, śarīradeśānāṃ tryasrā mukhe sūcī syāt| saṅgrahe'pyavocat (sū.a.34)-"tryasrāgrā" iti| tryasreti cintyam| tathā, tryaṅgulamāyatā-tryaṅguladīrghā| vṛttatvaṃ dṛḍhapāśatvaṃ coktameva sāmānyalakṣaṇena| alpamāṃsānāṃ vraṇānāṃ sandhyasthisaṃśritānāṃ ca dvyaṅgulamāyatā-dīrghā| vṛttamukhatvaṃ cāsyāḥ sāmānyenoktam| tṛtīyāmāha- vrīhimukhā, cāpavat kuṭilā, dairghyeṇa dve'ṅgule sārdhe syāt| sā ca pakvāśaya āmāśaye marmasu ca vraṇānāṃ sīvane yojyā|
Ā. rā. sūcītrayamāha-vṛttā iti| pāśe-chidrasthāne, gūḍhā dṛḍhāśca| tatra tryaṅgulāṃ sūcīmāha-māṃsalānāmiti| dvyaṅgulāṃ sūcīmāha-alpamāṃseti| sārddhyaṅgulāṃ sūcīmāha-vrīhivakreti|

adhunā kūrcaṃ lilakṣayiṣurāha ---- ------------------------sarvavṛttāstāścaturaṅgulāḥ| kūrco vṛttaikapīṭhasthāḥ saptāṣṭau vā subandhanāḥ||22|| sa yojyo nīlikāvyaṅgakeśaśāteṣu kuṭṭane| ----------------------------------------------|23|

Sa. tāḥ-sūcyaḥ, sarvato vartulā dairghyeṇa caturaṅgulāḥ kūrca ityucyate| kimbhūtāḥ ? vṛtta ekasmin pīṭhe saṃsthitāḥ| tathā, saptasaṅkhyā aṣṭau vā| tathā, śobhanaṃ bandhanaṃ yāsāṃ tāḥ subandhanāḥ| ata evedaṃ śastraṃ sūcīkūrcasaṃjñaṃ śaṃsanti| tathā cārśaścikitsite jagāda (hṛ. ci. a. 8|29)- "arśobhyo jalajaśśastrasūcīkūrcaiḥ" ityādi| sa ca-subaddhasaptāṣṭasūcīkaḥ kūrco, nīlikādiṣu ca kuṭṭanaviṣaye yojyaḥ| upalakṣaṇārthatvāccāsya(sau) śvitrendraluptādiṣvapi yojyaḥ|
Ā. rā. kūrcamāha-sarvavṛttā iti| sarvavṛttāḥ-pāśarahitāḥ, tāḥ-sūcyaḥ, vṛttaekasmin pīṭhe nikhātāḥ|

----------------------------------------------| ardhāṅgulamukhairvṛttairaṣṭābhiḥ kaṇṭakaiḥ khajaḥ||23|| pāṇibhyāṃ mathyamānena ghrāṇāttena haredasṛk| ----------------------------------------------|24|
Sa. aṣṭābhiḥ kaṇṭakaiḥ khaja ucyate| kīdṛśaiḥ ? ardhāṅgulapramāṇaṃ mukhaṃ yeṣāṃ taiḥ, tathā vartulaiḥ| tena-khajena, hastābhyāṃ viloḍyamānena, nāsikāto'straṃ haret|
Ā. rā. khajamāha-arddhāṅgulamukhairiti|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------| vyadhanaṃ karṇapālīnāṃ yūthikāmukulānanam||24||

div.ab: Sa. karṇapālīnāṃ vyadhane yūthikā nāma śastraṃ syāt| kīdṛśī ? mukulānanā|
Ā. rā. karṇavyadhanamāha-vyadhanamiti|

ārā'rdhāṅgulavṛttāsyā tatpraveśā tathordhvataḥ| caturasrā, tayā vidhyecchhophaṃ pakvāmasaṃśaye||25|| karṇapālīṃ ca bahalāṃ-----------------------------| ----------------------------------------------|26|

Sa. ardhāṅgulapramāṇaṃ vṛttaṃ āsyaṃ-mukhaṃ, yasyāḥ sā'rdhāṅgulavṛttāsyā| tathā, sa eva-ardhāṅgulapramāṇaḥ praveśo yasyāḥ sā tatpraveśā| tathordhvata iti vṛttārdhāṅgulādupariṣṭāt tathaiva-ardhāṅgulapramāṇaiva caturasrā syāt| sā ārānāma śastram| tayā ārayā, śophaṃ vidhyet| kadā ? pakvāmasaṃśaye,-kimayaṃ pakvaḥ śopha utāma iti sandehe| bahalāṃ ca karṇapalīṃ tayā vidhyet|
Ā. rā. ārāmāha-āreti| tatpraveśā-arddhāṅgulapraveśā| ūrdhvataḥ-vṛttānmukhādūrdhvaṃ, caturasrā| pakvāmasaṃśayepakvatvāmatvasandehe| bahalāṃ-ghanām|

ab.seg: -----------------------bahalāyaaśca śasyate| sūcī tribhāgasuṣirā tryaṅgulā karṇavedhanī||26||

div.ab: Sa. bahalāyāḥ-atimāṃsalāyāḥ karṇapālyāśca, sūcī śasyate,-na kevalamārā| kīdṛśī sūcī ? tribhāgaḥ-prāntabhāgāt suṣiro yasyāḥ saivam| tathā, tryaṅgulā-dairghyeṇa| sā ca karṇavedhanī syāt|
Ā. rā. bahalakarṇapālīvyadhanārthaṃ sūcīmāha-bahalāyāśceti|
jalaukaḥkṣāradahanakācopalanakhādayaḥ| alauhānyanuśastrāṇi, tānyevaṃ ca vikalpayet||27|| aparāṇyapi yantrādīnvupayogaṃ ca yaugikam| ----------------------------------------------|28|

Sa. jalaukaḥprabhṛtayo'nuśastrāṇi raktasrāvakāryakāraṇāt| tāni cālauhāni-lohavarjitāni| ādiśabdenāyaskāntaśākaśophālikādikharapatrādīnāṃ grahaṇam| evaṃ coktena nyāyenānyānyapi yantrādīni vikalpayet| ādiśabdena śastrāṇāṃ grahaṇam| upayogaṃ ca yaugikaṃ-sādhutaraṃ, buddhyā nirūpayet|
Ā. rā. anuśastrāṇyāha-jalauka iti| uktebhyaḥ śastrayantrebhyo'nyānyapi svabuddhyā kalpyānītyāha-tānyevamiti| tāni-śastrānuśastrāṇi, yantrādīniyantrānuyantrāṇi, teśāṃ yogyamupayogaṃ ca, vikalpayet|

----------------------------------------------| utpāṭyapāṭyasīvyaiṣyalekhyapracchhānakuṭṭanam||28|| chhedyaṃ bhedyaṃ vyadho mantho graho dāhaśca tatkriyāḥ| ----------------------------------------------|29|

Sa. utpāṭyādīni tatkriyāḥ,-teṣāṃ-ṣaḍviṃśatiśastrāṇāṃ, kriyāḥ-karmāṇi, tatkriyāḥ| { tāni ṣaḍviṃśatiśastrāṇi saṅgrahoktāni (sū. a. 34)- "tadyathā-dantalekhanamaṇḍalāgravṛddhipatrotpalapatrādhyardhadhāramudrikākartarīsarpavaktrakarapatrakuśapatrāṭāmukhā-ntarmukhaśarārimukhatrikūrcakūṭhārikāvrīhimukhaśalākāvetasapatrārākarṇavyadhanasūcīsūcīkurcakhajaiṣaṇī-baḍiśanakhaśastrāṇi|" iti| } utpāṭyaṃ-uddhāryam, tatra nakhaśastraṃ prayojyam| pāṭane vṛddhipatrādi| sīvane sūcyaḥ| lekhane maṇḍalāgrādiḥ| pracchāne nakhaśastrādi| kuṭṭane kūrcaḥ| chedane utpalapatrādi| bhedane eṣaṇī sūcīmukhā| vyadhane vetasādi| manthane khajaḥ| grahe sandaṃśaḥ| dāhe śalākādiriti|
Ā. rā. śastradoṣānāha-śastrakāryāṇi gaṇayati-utpāṭyeti| utpāṭhyaṃ-utpāṭanam, bhāve yatpratyayaḥ| evaṃ pāṭhyādiṣu| sīvyaṃ-sīvanam|

śastradośānaha ---- ----------------------------------------------| kuṇṭhakhaṇḍatanusthūlahrasvadīrghatvavakratāḥ||29|| śastrāṇāṃ kharadhāratvamaṣṭau doṣāḥ prakīrtitāḥ| ----------------------------------------------|30|
Sa. spaṣṭam
Ā. rā. śastradoṣānāha-kuṇṭhakhaṇḍeti| te ca doṣā anyatra karapatrāt|

ab.seg: adhunā śastrāṇāṃ grahaṇavidhiṃ darśayati ---- ----------------------------------------------| chedabhedanalekhyārthaṃ śastraṃ vṛntaphalāntare||30||
tarjanīmadhyamāṅguṣṭhairgṛhṇīyātsusamāhitaḥ| visrāvaṇāni vṛntāgre tarjanyaṅguṣṭhakena ca||31||
talapracchannavṛntāgraṃ grāhyaṃ vrīhimukhaṃ mukhe| mūleṣvāharaṇārthāni kriyāsaukaryato'param||32||

div.ab: Sa. chedabhedanalekhyārthaṃ tarjanīmadhyamāṅguṣṭhairmilitaiḥ śastraṃ vṛntaphalāntare-vṛntaphalamadhyabhāge, gṛhṇīyāt| kīdṛk ? susamāhitaḥ,-tadgatamanāḥ| visrāvaṇakāryāṇi śarāryāsyādīni śastrāṇi vṛntāgre tarjanyaṅguṣṭhābhyāṃ gṛhṇīyāt| gṛhṇīyādityanuvartate| talaśabdena pāṇitalamucyate, ādilopākhyayā tantrayuktyā| talena pracchhannaṃ vṛntāgraṃ yasya tat vrīhimukhaṃ mukhe gṛhṇīyāt| śeṣaṃ śastraṃ kriyāsaukaryato gṛhṇīyāt| sukarasya bhāvaḥ saukaryam| yathā sukarā pāṭanādikā kriyā syāttathā''dadītetyarthaḥ|

Ā. rā. śastrakośamācaṣṭe-śastradhāraṇavidhimāha-chedabhedaneti| chedanādikarmaṇi vṛntaphalayormadhye tarjanyādibhirmilitaiḥ śastraṃ gṛhṇīyāt| visrāvaṇe tu tarjanyaṅguṣṭhābhyāṃ vṛntāgre gṛhṇīyāt| vrīhimukhaṃ tu pāṇitalena vṛntāgraṃ pracchādya mukhe grāhyam| āhāraṇe tu śastraṃ mūle grāhyam| pāśasyopari madhye laghusandaṃśaḥ kartarī ca| śeṣeṣu tu karmasu yatra gṛhīte kriyāsaukaryaṃ tatra grāhyam|

ab.seg: śastrakośamācaṣṭate ---- syānnavāṅgulavistāraḥ sughano dvādaśāṅgulaḥ| kṣau mapatrorṇakauśeyadukūlamṛducarmajaḥ||33||
vinyastapāśaḥ susyūtaḥ sāntarorṇārsthaśastrakaḥ| śalākāpihitāsyaśca śastrakośaḥ susañcayaḥ||34||

div.ab: Sa. navāṅgulavistāraḥ śastrakośaḥ syāt| tathā, suṣṭhu ghanonibiḍaḥ| tathā, dvādaśāṅgulapramāṇo dairdhyeṇa| tathā, kṣau mādijaḥ| tathā, vinyastaḥ-kṛtaḥ, pāśo yasya sa vinyastapāśaḥ| tathā, suṣṭhu syūtaḥ| tathā, sāntarāṇi-savyavadhānāni, ūrṇāsthāni śastrāṇi yasmin sa sāntarorṇāsthaśastrakaḥ| tathā, śalākayā pihitaṃ-sthagitaṃ, āsyaṃ yasya sa evam| tathā, śobhanaḥ sañcayo yasya sa susañcayaḥ, nāpitabhāṇḍikāvat| tantrāntare coktam "niśānī tu śastrāṇāṃ ślakṣṇā śilikā māṣamudgaprabhā" ityādi|

Ā. rā. sukumārabālānāmastravisrāvaṇārthaṃ jalaukaso nirdidikṣurāha-śastrasthāpanārthaṃ śastrakośamāha-syāditi| saṅgrahe tu (sū.a. 34)-"hasta eva cātra pradhānatamastadadhīnatvādyantraśastrāṇām| tatra kṣāreṇa pāyitaṃ śastraṃ śaraśalyāsthicchedaneṣu, udakena māṃsacchedane, tailena pāṭanabhedanaśirāvyadhasnāyucchedaneṣu ca prayuñjīta| dhārā punarbhedanānāṃ māsūrī, lekhanānāmardhamāsūrī, vyadhanānāṃ visrāvaṇānāṃ ca kaiśikī, chedanānāmardhakaiśikī| niśānī tu teṣāṃ ślakṣṇā śilikā māṣamudgaprabhā| dhārāsaṃsthāpanaṃ ca śālmalīphalakam| atha yogyā| na cādhikṛtaśāstre'pyakṛtayogyaḥ, yogyā-abhyāsaḥ, subahuśo vā'pyadṛṣṭakarmā śastrakarmaṇi pravarteta, śirāsnāyumarmādivyāptatvāddehasya| tasmāt saromacarmapuṣpaphalālābutrapusodakapaṅkapūrṇadṛtibastivadhramāṃsapeśikotpalanālādiṣu yathārhamāharaṇādiyogyāṃ kuryāt| tathā ghaṭapārśvasrotasyambhobhiḥ paripūrṇena netreṇa bastipīḍanayogyām| mṛdumāṃsakhaṇḍeṣvagnikṣārāvacaraṇayogyām| pustamayapuruṣāṅgapratyaṅgeṣu bandhanayogyām| api ca| yuktakārī bhiṣagbubhūṣuḥ puruṣaṃ sampūrṇagātramaviṣahatamadīrghavyādhipīḍitaṃ niṣkṛṣṭāntramavahantyāmāpagāyāṃ muñjabalvajaveṣṭitaṃ pañjarasthamaprakāśe deśe kothayet| taṃ samyakprakuthitaṃ coddhṛtyāyatadehaṃ kṛtvośīraveṇukūrcādīnāmanyatamena śanaiḥśanairavaghṛṣya tvagādīn sarvāneva vāhyābhyantarānaṅgasirāsrāyvādīnavayavānācāryopadarśitenāgamena cakṣuṣā ca lakṣayet| iti śāstreṇa yaddṛṣṭaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ pratyakṣataśca yat| samāgataṃ tadubhayaṃ bhūyo jñānaṃ vivardhayet||" iti|
sukumārabālānāmasravisrāvaṇārthaṃ jalaukaso yojayet ---- jalaukasastu sukhināṃ raktasrāvāya yojayet| ----------------------------------------------|35|
Sa. sukhināṃ-sukhocitānāṃ, raktasrāvaṇārthaṃ jalaukaso yojayet| tāśca dviprakāraaḥ,-saviṣānirviṣāśca| tatra saviṣāṇāṃ sāpāyatvāttā eva tāvallakṣayati-
Ā. rā. jalaukasāṃ viṣayamāha-jalaukasastviti|

tāśca dwiprakārāḥ,- saviṣā nirviṣāśca| tatra saviṣāṇāṃ sāpāyatvāttā eva tāvallakṣayati ---- ----------------------------------------------| duṣṭāmbumatsyabhekāhiśavakothamalodbhavāḥ||35|| raktāḥ śvetā bhṛśaṃ kṛṣṇāścapalāḥ sthūlapicchhilāḥ| indrāyudhavicitrordhvarājayo romaśāśca tāḥ||36|| saviṣā varjayet------------------------------| ----------------------------------------------|37|

Sa. duṣṭāmbūdbhavāśca jalaukasaḥ saviṣā iti varjayet| tathā matsyabhekasarpādiśavakothodbhavāḥ, tathā teṣāmeva matsyādīnāṃ ye malāḥ-mūtrapurīṣādayaḥ, tadudbhavāśca saviṣā iti varjayet| saviṣāṇāṃ lakṣaṇamāha-raktā ityādi| yāvallomaśā yāstāḥ saviṣā yataḥ, tato varjayet-tā na yojayet|
Ā. rā. varjyāṃ jalaukasa āha-duṣṭāmtrviti| duṣṭāmbuni matsyādiśavakothamaleṣu ca jātāḥ|
-------------------------tābhiḥ kaṇḍūpākajvarabhramāḥ| viṣapittāsranutkāryaṃ tatra----------------------|37|
Sa. tābhirhi yojitābhiḥ kaṇḍvādayaḥ syuḥ| upalakṣaṇaṃ cedam| dāhaśoṣamūrcchhādayo'pi syuḥ| { tatra- } tāsu mohādyojitāsu, viṣādijit kāryam|
Ā. rā. varjyāprayoge doṣamāha-tābhiriti| varjyādoṣe cikitsāmāha-viṣapittāsranuditi|

ab.seg: nirviṣāḥ śaivalaśyāvā vṛttā nīlordhvarājayaḥ| kaṣāyapṛṣṭhāstanvaṅgyaḥ kiñcitpītodarāśca yāḥ||38||

div.ab: Sa. jalaukasa ityanuvartate| śuddhajalodbhavāḥ (śuddhāmbujāḥ)-saugandhikotpalakamalavipulasalilaśaivālajā jalaukaso, nirviṣāḥ syuḥ| āsāṃ ca lakṣaṇamāha-śaivaletyādi| śaivalamiva śyāvāḥ, tathā vṛttāḥ, tathā nīlordhvarājayaḥ, tathā kaṣāyaṃ-nyagrodhādivalkalasadṛśavarṇaṃ, pṛṣṭhaṃ yāsāṃ tā evam, tathā tanuśarīrāḥ kiñcitpītavarṇajaṭharāśca nirviṣā vedyāḥ|
Ā. rā. grāhyā jalaukasa āha-śuddhāmbusambhavā iti|

ab.seg: tā apyasamyagvamanāt pratataṃ ca nipātanāt| sīdantīḥ salilaṃ prāpya raktamattā iti tyajet||39||

div.ab: Sa. nirviṣā api jalaukaso raktamattā iti tyajet| na kevalaṃ saviṣā iti pratipādanārtho'piśabdaḥ| raktamattatve hetudvayamāha-asamyagvamanāt, duṣṭaraktasyeti śeṣaḥ| pratataṃ ca lāganāt, duṣṭaraktavāsitvena raktamattā ityuktāḥ| tāśca kathaṃ lakṣyante ? ityāha-sīdantīrityādi| jalaṃ (salilaṃ) prāpyatoyapūrṇabhāṇḍamāsādya, sīdantīḥ-na tathā ceṣṭamānāḥ, iti jñātvā tyajet|
Ā. rā. grāhyāsvapi mattā varjyā ityāha-tā iti| pratataṃ nipātanāt-aviśramayya prayogāt| sīdantīḥ-śramamatyajantīḥ| raktamattā iti- raktamattatvāddhetoḥ|

ab.seg: athetarā niśākalkayukte'mbhasi pariplutāḥ| avantisome takre vā punaścāśvāsitā jale||40||
lāgayeddṛtamṛtstanyaraktaśastranipātanaiḥ| pibantīrunnataskandhāśchādayenmṛduvāsasā||41||

div.ab: Sa. atha-parikṣāto'nantaraṃ, itarā lāgayet| kimbhūtāḥ ? haridrākalkayuktajale pariplutāḥ, kāñjike kālaśeye vā pariplutāḥ, punaśca jale samāśvāsitāḥ-sātmyabhūte jale plavanārhāḥ sotsāhāḥ satīḥ, yojayet| alagantīḥ kathaṃ lāgayet ? ityāha-ghṛtetyādi| ghṛtādipātanaistā yojayet| pātanaśabdaḥ pratyekaṃ yojyaḥ| śastreṇāṅge raktaṃ mokṣayitvā vā ta yojayet| tāśca pibantīḥ sūkṣmavāsasā''cchhādayet| evaṃ hi tāsāṃ makṣikādyanupadravāt samyagyojanā syāt| atha kimetāḥ pibantyuta neti kathaṃ jñāyate ? ityatra viśeṣaṇadvāreṇa hetumāha-unnataskandhā iti| unnataḥ skandho yāsāṃ tā evam| unnataskandhatvena tāsāṃ pānaṃ jñāyata ityarthaḥ|

Ā. rā. nanu, śuddharaktaduṣṭaraktayorekalkībhūtatvāt śuddharaktākarṣaṇājjālaukā doṣāya syaadityāha-jalaukasāṃ prayogamāha-athetarā iti| itarāḥ-avarjyāḥ| avantisome-kāñjike| ghṛtādyanyatamena pradeśamabhyajya śastreṇa vā pracchāya lāgayet|

ab.seg: sampṛktādduṣṭaśuddhāsrājjalaukā duṣṭaśoṇitam| ādatte prathamaṃ haṃsaḥ kṣīraṃ kṣīrodakādiva||42||
(gulmārśovidradhīn kuṣṭhavātaraktagalāmayān| netrarugviṣavīsarpān śamayanti jalaukasaḥ| )||1||

div.ab: Sa. duṣṭaśuddhāsrānmilitādapi jalaukā duṣṭaraktameva pūrvamādatte, na śuddhaṃ dehadhātustham, iti dṛṣṭāntena darśayati-haṃsa ityādi| haṃso yathā kṣīrajalānmiśritāt prāgdugdhamādatte na tu jalam, tathā jalaukāḥ prāgśuddhaṃ raktamādatte paścāditaraditi nyāyyametat|
Ā. rā. duṣṭaśuddhasamparke jalaukāḥ prathamaṃ duṣṭaṃ pibatītyāha sampṛktāditi|

Sa. daṃśasya tode sati kaṇḍvāṃ satyāṃ vā mokṣayet, śuddharaktarakṣārthamatiyogabhayācca| tāmityekavacananirdeśādekaikāṃ mokṣayet, na tu sarvāḥ sakṛdeveti gamayati| atha pānalaulyalyādṛśaṃ, - na tyajettato haridrācūrṇaṃ vā vadane dattvā mokṣayet|
Ā. rā. jalaukasāṃ mokṣaṇakālamāha-daṃśasyeti|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------vāmayecca tām| paṭutailāktavadanāṃ ślakṣṇakaṇḍanarūṣitām||43||

div.ab: Sa. mokṣitāṃ ca jalaukasaṃ vāmayet| vamanavidhānamāha paṭvityādi| saindhavayutena tailena rūṣitāsyāṃ tathā sūkṣmeṇa taṇḍulakaṇḍanena rūṣitāṃ-avakīrṇāṃ, vāmayet| taṇḍulaśabdasyātra lopo jñeyastantrayuktyā|
Ā. rā. mokṣitānāṃ kṛtyamāha-vāmayediti| kaṇḍanaṃ tuṣaḥ|
rakṣan raktamadādbhūyaḥ saptāhaṃ tā na pātayet| ----------------------------------------------|44|
Sa. tāḥ-kṛtavamanā jalaukaso, raktamadādrakṣan punaḥ saptāhaṃ na yojayet|
Ā. rā. saptāhādarvāk jalaukasāṃ punaḥprayogaṃ niṣedhati-rakṣanniti|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------| pūrvavat paṭutā dārḍhyaṃ samyagvānte jalaukasām||44||

div.ab: Sa. jalaukasāṃ samyagvānte sati pūrvavat-alāgitānāmiva, paṭutādi bhavati|
Ā. rā. jalaukasāṃ samyagvamanalakṣaṇamāha-pūrvavaditi|
Sa. atiyogādvamanasya klamo mṛtyurvā syāt|
Ā. rā. ativānte lakṣaṇamāha-klama iti|
Sa. durvānte sati stabdhatā madaśca syāt|
Ā. rā. durvānte lakṣaṇamāha-durvānta iti|

------------------------------------------------------| anyatrānyatra tāḥ sthāpyā ghaṭe mṛtsnāmbugarbhiṇi||45|| lālādikothanāśārthaṃ, saviṣāḥ syustadanvayāt| ------------------------------------------------------|46|
