saptacchadaḥ parpaṭakaḥ śamyākaḥ kaṭukā vacā| triphalā padmakaṃ pāṭhā rajanyau sārive kaṇe||8|| nimbacandanayaṣṭyāhvaviśālendrayavāmṛtāḥ| kirātatiktakaṃ sevyaṃ vṛṣo mūrvā śatāvarī||9|| paṭolātiviṣāmustātrāyantīdhanvayāsakam| tairjale'ṣṭaguṇe sarpirdviguṇāmalakīrase||10|| siddhaṃ tiktānmahātiktaṃ guṇairabhyadhikaṃ matam| ---------------------------------------------|11|
Sa. saptacchadādibhiḥ kalkairghṛtādaṣṭaguṇe jale dviguṇāmalakarase sarpiḥ pakvaṃ mahātiktasaṃjñaṃ guṇaiścābhyadhikaṃ tiktānmatam, munīnāmiti śeṣaḥ|
---------------------------------------------| kaphottare ghṛtaṃ siddhaṃ nimbasaptāhracitrakaiḥ||11|| kuṣṭhoṣaṇavacāśālapriyālacaturaṅgulaiḥ| ---------------------------------------------|12|
Sa. kaphottare nimbādibhiḥ kalkīkṛtaiḥ pakvaṃghṛtaṃ pibet|
---------------------------------------------| sarveṣu cāruṣkarajaṃ tauvaraṃ sārṣapaṃ pibet||12|| snehaṃ ghṛtaṃ vā kṛmijitpathyābhallātakaiḥ śṛtam| ---------------------------------------------|13|
Sa. sarveṣu ca kuṣṭheṣu bhallātakotthaṃ tuvarajaṃ sarṣapajaṃ vā snehamathavā ghṛtaṃ kṛmijidādibhiḥ sādhitaṃ pibet|
---------------------------------------------| āragvadhasya mūlena śatakṛtvaḥ śṛtaṃ ghṛtam||13|| piben kuṣṭhaṃ jayatyāśu bhajan sakhadiraṃ jalam| ---------------------------------------------|14|
Sa. karṇikārasya mūlena śatavārān ghṛtaṃ pakvaṃ piban kuṣṭhaṃ jayati khadirayutaṃ pānīyaṃ sevamānaḥ|

ab.seg: --------------------------------------------| ebhireva yathāsvaṃ ca snehairabhyañjanaṃ hitam||14||

div.ab: Sa. ebhireva pūrvoktaiḥ snehairyathāyogamabhyañjanaṃ hitam|
snigdhasya śodhanaṃ yojyaṃ visarpe yadudāhṛtam| ---------------------------------------------|15|
Sa. snigdhasya kuṣṭhinaḥ śodhanaṃ yojyaṃ yadvisarpe kathitam| tatra coktam (hṛ. ci. a. 18|3)- "rasena yuktaṃ trāyantyā drākṣāyāḥ" ityādi|
---------------------------------------------| lalāṭahastapādeṣu śirāścāsya vimokṣayet||15|| pracchānamalpake kuṣṭhe śṛṅgādyāśca yathāyatham| ---------------------------------------------|16|
Sa. lalāṭādiṣu cāsyāturasya balāpekṣī vaidyo śirāṃ vimokṣayet| atyalpe kuṣṭhe pracchānaṃ syāt| yathāyathaṃ-yathāsvaṃ, śṛṅgādyāśca syuḥ|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| snehairāpyāyayeccainaṃ kuṣṭhaghnairantarā'ntarā||16||
muktaraktaviriktasya riktakoṣṭhasya kuṣṭhinaḥ| prabhañjanastathā hyasya na syāddehaprabhañjanaḥ||17||

div.ab: Sa. antarā'ntarā srutaraktaṃ kṛtavirekaṃ ca kuṣṭhaghnaiḥ snehairenaṃ-kuṣṭhinaṃ, āpyāyayet| evaṃ kṛte satyasya-kuṣṭhino, muktaraktasya tathā viriktasyāta eva riktakoṣṭhasya prabhañjano dehasya prabhañjano-vighātako, na syāt|

ab.seg: vāsāmṛtānimbavarāpaṭola- vyāghrīkarañjodakakalkapakvam| sarpirvisarpajvarakāmalāsra- kuṣṭhāpahaṃ vajrakamāmananti||18||

div.ab: Sa. vāsādibhiḥ siddhaṃ sarpirvisarpādighnam| etacca vajrakasaṃjñaṃ ghṛtaṃ vadanti| indravajrāvṛttam|

ab.seg: triphalātrikaṭudvikaṇṭakārī- kaṭukākumbhanikumbharājavṛkṣaiḥ| savacātiviṣāgnikaiḥ sapāṭhaiḥ picubhāgairnavavajradugdhamuṣṭyā||19||
piṣṭaiḥ siddhaṃ sarpiṣaḥ prasthamebhiḥ krūre koṣṭhe snehanaṃ recanaṃ ca| kuṣṭhaśvitraplīhavardhmāśmagulmān hantyātkṛcchrāṃstanmahāvajrakākhyam||20||

div.ab: Sa. triphalādibhiḥ kārṣikaiḥ pratyagrasruhīkṣīrapalena saha piṣṭairebhirauṣadhairghṛtaprasthaṃ caturguṇajalasiddhaṃ krūrakoṣṭhe snehanaṃ syāt recanaṃ ca| tathā, kuṣṭhādīn dāruṇān hanyāt| tacca mahāvajrakaṃ nāma| aupacchandasikaśālinyau vṛtte|

ab.seg: dantyāḍhakamapāṃ droṇe paktvā tena ghṛtaṃ pacet| dhāmārgavapale pītaṃ tadūrdhvādho viśuddhikṛt||21||

div.ab: Sa. dantyāścatuḥṣaṣṭipalāni jaladroṇe pacet| tena kvāthena rājakośātakīpale ghṛtaṃ pacet| tatpītamūrdhvādho viśuddhikaram|

ab.seg: āvartakītulāṃ droṇe pacedaṣṭāṃśaśeṣitam| tanmūlaistatra niryūhe ghṛtaprasthaṃ vipācayet||22||
pītvā tadekadivasāntaritaṃ sujīrṇe bhuñjīta kodravamasaṃskṛtakāñjikena| kuṣṭhaṃ kilāsamapacīṃ ca vijetumicchan icchan prajāṃ ca vipulāṃ grahaṇaṃ smṛtiṃ ca||23||

div.ab: Sa. āvartakyāḥ śataṃ droṇe'pāmaṣṭāṃśaśeṣitaṃ pacet| ttrakvāthe, tasyā mūlaiḥ kalkīkṛtairghṛtaprasthaṃ vipācayet| taddhṛtamekadivasāntaritaṃ pītvā suṣṭhu jīrṇe ca ghṛte kodravamasaṃskṛtena kāñjikena saha bhuñjīta| kuṣṭhādīn vijigīṣuḥ, prajāṃ ca vistīrṇāmicchan, grahaṇaṃ smṛtiṃ cābhilaṣan| vasantatilakāvṛttam|

ab.seg: yaterlelītakavasā kṣaudrajātīrasānvitā| kuṣṭhaghnī samasarpirvā sagāyartryasanodakā||24||

div.ab: Sa. yateḥ-brahmacaryāsthitasya, lelītakavasā mākṣikajātīrasayutā kuṣṭhaghnī syāt| lelītakavasā-sauvarcalalavaṇatailam, gandhakameke| jātīraso-bolaḥ| athavā, samaghṛtā khadirāsanodakasahitā kuṣṭhaghnī syāt|

ab.seg: śālayo yavagodhūmāḥ koradūṣāḥ priyaṅgavaḥ| mudgā masūrāstuvarī tiktaśākāni jāṅgalam||25||
varāpaṭolakhadiranimbāruṣkarayojitam| madyānyauṣadhagarbhāṇi mathitaṃ cendurājimat||26||
annapānaṃ hitaṃ kuṣṭhe, na tvamlalavaṇoṣaṇam| dadhidugdhaguḍānūpatilamāṣāṃstyajettarām||27||

div.ab: Sa. śālyādikamannapānaṃ ca varādibhiryojitaṃ kuṣṭhe hitam| indurājiḥ-bākucī| amlādikamannapānaṃ na hitaṃ kuṣṭhe syāt| tathā dadhyādīnatiśayena varjayet| pratirogaṃ ca yannidānavarjanaṃ taccikitsitamevetyavagantavyam|

ab.seg: paṭolamūlatriphalāviśālāḥ pṛthaktribhāgāpacitatriśāṇāḥ| syustrāyamāṇā kaṭurohiṇī ca| bhāgārdhike nāgarapādayukte||28||
etatpalaṃ jarjaritaṃ vipakvaṃ jale pibeddoṣaviśodhanāya| jīrṇe rasairdhanvamṛgadvijānāṃ purāṇaśālyodanamādadīta||29||
kuṣṭhaṃ kilāsaṃ grahaṇīpradoṣa- marśāṃsi kṛcchrāṇi halīmakaṃ ca| ṣaḍrātrayogena nihanti caitad hṛdvastiśūlaṃ viṣamajvaraṃ ca||30||

div.ab: Sa. pṛthak-pratyekaṃ, tribhāgenāpacito-nyūnaḥ, tṛtīyaḥ śāṇo yeṣāṃ te paṭolādayaḥ pañca pṛthaktribhāgāpacitatriśāṇāḥ| loke'pi caivaṃ prayuktā eva| yathā,-tribhāgonāstrayo drammā deyā iti| atra hi dvau drammau tṛtīyaśca drammastribhāgena hīna iti gamyate| tadevaṃ paṭolasya śāṇau dvau dhānakāśca catasro bhavanti| ṣaḍdhānako hi śāṇaḥ| evaṃ paṭolamūlādidravyāṇāṃ pañcānāṃ pratyekaṃ ṣoḍaśadhānakāḥ syuḥ| syāttrāyamāṇā kaṭurohiṇī ca bhāgārdhike| kimbhūte ? nāgarapādayukte satyau, na tu kevale| tadayamarthaḥ,-trāyantyā dhānakāḥ ṣaṭ, kaṭukāyā dhānakāḥ ṣaṭ, nāgarasya dhānakāścatasraḥ| ṣoḍaśadhānakā hyatra mūladravyabhāgaḥ| tadevaṃ paṭolādīnāṃ pañcānāmaśītirdhānakāḥ, trāyantīkaṭukayoḥ śuṇṭhīpādayutayoḥ ṣoḍaśadhānakāḥ, iti ṣaṇṇavatidhānakābhiḥ palaṃ bhavati| tadidaṃ palaṃ jarjaritaṃ kiñciccūrṇitaṃ jale vipakvaṃ doṣaviśuddhyarthaṃ pibet| jīrṇe satyauṣadhe jāṅgalamṛgapakṣiṇāṃ māṃsarasaiḥ saha purāṇaśālyodanamaśrnīyāt| upajātī vṛtte| etacca pītaṃ ṣaḍrātrayogena-ṣaḍdinānyupayuktaṃ, kuṣṭhādīn hanti| indravajrāvṛttam|

ab.seg: viḍaṅgasārāmalakābhayānāṃ palatrayaṃ, trīṇi palāni kumbhāt| guḍasya ca dvādaśa, māsameṣa jitātmanāṃ hantyupayujyamānaḥ||31||
kuṣṭhaśvitraśvāsakāsodarārśo- mehaplīhagranthirugjantugulmān| siddhaṃ yogaṃ prāha yakṣo mumukṣo- rbhikṣoḥ prāṇān māṇibhadraḥ kilemam||32||

div.ab: Sa. viḍaṅgasārādīnāṃ samuditānāṃ palatrayam, trīṇi palāni kumbhāt-trivṛtāyāstrīṇi palāni, guḍasya ca dvādaśapalāni| eṣa prayogo jitendriyāṇāṃ māsamupayujyamāno vakṣyamāṇān gadān hanti| "upendravajrā tu jatau jagau gaḥ|" māsaśabdopādānācca pratyahamasmādyogādardhapalaṃ dhānakānavaraktikātrayasahitamabhyavaharaṇīyatvenātrāvatiṣṭhate| anyatrāpi pradeśe ya evaṃvidho nirdeśastatra parimāṇakalpanāyāmayameva nyāyo'numantavyaḥ| maṇibhadrākhyo yakṣo bhikṣoḥ prāṇān mumukṣoḥ-jīvitaṃ jihāsoḥ, imaṃ siddhaṃ yogaṃ prāṇakaraṃ prāha,-jagādetyarthaḥ| atra bhūte kāle prāheti, tathā sādhu kiletyāgamikatvaṃ ca sūcayati| śālinīvṛttam|

bhūnimbanimbatriphalāpadmakātiviṣākaṇāḥ| mūrvāpaṭolīdviniśāpāṭhātiktendravāruṇīḥ||33|| sakaliṅgavacāstulyā dviguṇāśca yathottaram| lihyāddantītrivṛdbrāhmīścūrṇitā madhusarpiṣā||34|| kuṣṭhamehaprasuptīnāṃ paramaṃ syāttadauṣadham|35|
Sa. bhūnimbādayastulyā dantyādayaśca yathottaraṃ dviguṇāścūrṇitā madhusarpiṣā lihyāt| kuṣṭhādīnāmetat paramaṃ bheṣajam|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| varāviḍaṅgakṛṣṇā vā lihyāttailājyamākṣikaiḥ||35||

div.ab: Sa. triphalādīn vā tailaghṛtamākṣikairlihyāt|

ab.seg: kākodumbarikāvellanimbābdavyoṣakalkavān| hanti vṛkṣakaniryūhaḥ pānātsarvāṃstvagāmayān||36||

div.ab: Sa. kākodumbarikādikalkavān vṛkṣakakvāthaḥ pānātsarvān tvagrogān hanti| kākodumbarikā-phalguḥ| vṛkṣako-vatsakaḥ|
kuṭajāgninimbanṛpatarukhadirāsanasaptaparṇaniryūhe| siddhā madhughṛtayuktāḥ kuṣṭhaghnīrbhakṣayedabhayāḥ|37|
Sa. kuṭajādikvāthe siddhāḥ pakvā harītakīrmadhughṛtasaṃyuktāḥ kuṣṭhanudo bhakṣayet| āryāvṛttam|

ab.seg: dārvīkhadiranimbānāṃ tvakkvāthaḥ kuṣṭhasūdanaḥ| ---------------------------------------------||37||

div.ab: Sa. dārvyādīnāṃ tvakkvāthaḥ kuṣṭhanāśanaḥ syāt|

ab.seg: niśottamānimbapaṭolamūla- tiktāvacālohitayaṣṭikābhiḥ| kṛtaḥ kaṣāyaḥ kaphapittakuṣṭhaṃ susevito dharma ivocchinatti||38||
ebhireva ca śṛtaṃ ghṛtamukhyaṃ bheṣjairjayati mārutakuṣṭham| kalpayetkhadiranimbaguḍūcī- devadārurajanīḥ pṛthagevam||39||

div.ab: Sa. niśādibhiḥ kaṣāyaḥ kṛtaḥ kaphapittajaṃ kuṣṭhamuddalayati| suṣṭhu sevito yathā dharmaḥ| ebhireva-pūrvoktairauṣadhaiḥ, pakvaṃ varaṃ ghṛtaṃ vātakuṣṭhaṃ jayati| evaṃ-anayaiva kalpanayā, pṛthak khadirādīn kalpayet| upajātisvāgate vṛtte|

ab.seg: pāṭhādārvīvahnighuṇeṣṭākaṭukābhi- mūtraṃ yuktaṃ śakrayavaiścoṣṇajalaṃ vā| kuṣṭhī pītvā māsamaruk syādgudakīlī mehīśophī pāṇḍurajīrṇī kṛmīmāṃśca||40||

div.ab: Sa. pāṭhādibhirindrayavaiśca gomūtraṃ yuktamathavoṣṇajalaṃ māsaṃ pītvā kuṣṭhī nīruk syāt| arśasādiśca| "vedai randhrairmtau yasagā mattamayūram|" (vṛ. ra. a. 3|72)|

ab.seg: lākṣādantīmadhurasavarādvīpipāṭhāviḍaṅga- pratyak''puṣpītrikaṭurajanīsaptaparṇāṭarūṣam| raktā nimbaṃ surataru kṛtaṃ pañcamūlyau ca cūrṇaṃ pītvā māsaṃ jayati hitabhuggavyamūtreṇa kuṣṭham||41||

div.ab: Sa. lākṣādicūrṇaṃ gomūtreṇa māsaṃ pītvā hitabhojī san kuṣṭhaṃ jayati| raktā-mañjiṣṭhā| surataruśabdasya napuṃsakatvamauṣadhavācitvāllokāśrayatvālliṅgasyetivā| pañcamūlyau-deśamūlamityarthaḥ| "mandākrāntā mabhanatatagā gaḥ samudrartulokaiḥ|"

ab.seg: niśākaṇānāgaravellatauvaraṃ savahnitāpyaṃ kramaśo vivardhitam| gavāmbupītaṃ vaṭakīkṛtaṃ tathā nihanti kuṣṭhāni sudāruṇānyapi||42||

div.ab: Sa. niśādikaṃ krameṇa vivardhitaṃ gomūtreṇa pītamathavā vaṭakīkṛtaṃ kuṣṭhāni sukṛcchrāṇyapi nihanti| "uśanti vaṃśasthamidaṃ jatau jarau|"

ab.seg: trikaṭūttamātilāru- ṣkarājyamākṣikasitopalāvihitā| gulikā rasāyanaṃ ku- ṣṭhajicca vṛṣyā ca saptasamā||43||

div.ab: Sa. trikaṭukādibhirgulikā vihitā rasāyanaṃ kuṣṭahṛd vṛṣyā ca syāt| evaṃ ca saptasamākhyā| trikaṭukatriphale hyatra samudāyarūpatvād dve eva kalpite| "āryā vipulā tu yā'nyathā pādabhāk|"

ab.seg: cāndraśakalāgnirajanī- viḍaṅgatuvarāsthyaruṣkaratriphalābhiḥ| vaṭakā guḍāṃśaklRptāḥ samastakuṣṭhāni nāśayantyabhyastāḥ||44||

div.ab: Sa. candraśakalādibhirvaṭakā guḍāṃśena klRptāḥ-śīlitāḥ, niḥśeṣakuṣṭhāni ghnanti| candraśakalā-bākucī| āryāgītiḥ|

ab.seg: viḍaṅgabhallātakabākucīnāṃ sadvīpivārāhiharītakīnām| salāṅgalīkṛṣṇatilopakulyā guḍena piṇḍī vinihanti kuṣṭham||45||

div.ab: Sa. viḍaṅgādīnāṃ cūrṇena guḍena piṇḍī lāṅgalikādyanvitā kuṣṭhaṃ vijayate|

ab.seg: śaśāṅkalekhā saviḍaṅgasārā sapippalīkā sahutāśamūlā| sāyomalā sāmalakā satailā kuṣṭhāni kṛcchrāṇi nihanti līḍhā||46||

div.ab: Sa. śaśāṅkalekhā viḍaṅgādibhiḥ saha tailena līḍhā kṛcchrāṇi kuṣṭhāni vināśayati| upajātivṛttam(tte)|

ab.seg: pathyātilaguḍaiḥ piṇḍī kuṣṭhaṃ sāruṣkarairjayet| guḍāruṣkarajantughnasomarājīkṛtā'thavā||47||

div.ab: Sa. pathyādibhiḥ sabhallātakaiḥ piṇḍī kuṣṭhaṃ jayet| guḍādibhirvā kṛtā piṇḍī kuṣṭhaṃ hanti|

ab.seg: viḍaṅgādrijatukṣaudrasarpiṣmatkhādiraṃ rajaḥ| kiṭibhaśvitradadrughnaṃ khādenmitahitāśanaḥ||48||

div.ab: Sa. khadiracūrṇaṃ viḍaṅgādiyutaṃ mitahitabhojanaḥ kiṭibhādighnaṃ khādet|

ab.seg: sitātailakṛmighnāni dhātryayomalapippalīḥ| lihānaḥ sarvakuṣṭhāni jayatyatigurūṇyapi||49||

div.ab: Sa. sitādīni lihāno'śeṣakuṣṭhāni kṛcchrāṇyapi jayati|

ab.seg: mustaṃ vyoṣaṃ triphalā mañjiṣṭhā dāru pañcamūle dve| saptacchadanimbatvak saviśālā citrako mūrvā||50||
cūrṇaṃ tarpaṇabhāgairnavabhiḥ saṃyojitaṃ samadhvaṃśam| nityaṃ kuṣṭhanibarhaṇametatprāyogikaṃ khādan||51||
śvayathuṃ sapāṇḍurogaṃ śvitraṃ grahaṇīpradoṣamarśāṃsi| vardhabhagandarapiḍakākaṇḍūkoṭhāpacīrhanti||52||

div.ab: Sa. mustādikaṃ samabhāgaṃ saktubhāgairnavabhiḥ saṃyojitaṃ madhvaṃśena yutametaccūrṇaṃ prāyogikaṃ-prayogayogyaṃ, kuṣṭhaghnaṃ satataṃ khādet| āryāstisraḥ|

ab.seg: rasāyanaprayogeṇa tuvarāsthīni śīlayet| bhallātakaṃ bākucikāṃ vahnimūlaṃ śilāhvayam||53||

div.ab: Sa. rasāyanoktena vidhinā tuvarāsthīni (hṛ. ū. a. 39|84) , śīlayet| bhallātakaṃ vā (hṛ. u. a. 39|75) , somarājīṃ vā (hṛ. u. a. 39|107) , citrakamūlaṃ vā (hṛ. u. a. 39|63) , śilājatu vā (hṛ. u. a. 39|137)|

ab.seg: iti doṣe vijite'ntas- tvaksthe śamanaṃ bahiḥ pralepādi hitam| tīkṣṇālepotkliṣṭaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ hi vivṛddhimeti maline dehe||54||

div.ab: Sa. iti-evaṃprakāreṇa, antarvijite doṣe'ta eva tvaksthe bahiḥ pralepādi hitam| ādiśabdena snānādiparigrahaḥ| nanu, bahirbhāgasthaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ kimiti pūrvameva pralepādinā na jīyate ? ityāha-tīkṣṇetyādi| yasmāttīkṣṇena lepenotkliṣṭaṃ-utkleśaṃ prāpitaṃ, kuṣṭhaṃ maline-sadoṣe, kāye vivṛddhiṃ yāti| tasmādantaḥśuddhe kāye pralepādikaṃ hitam| āryāgītiḥ|

ab.seg: sthirakaṭhinamaṇḍalānāṃ kuṣṭhānāṃ poṭalairhitaḥ svedaḥ| svinnotsanaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ śastrairlikhitaṃ pralepanairlimpet||55||

div.ab: Sa. sthirāṇi kaṭhināni ca maṇḍalāni yeṣāṃ kuṣṭhānāṃ teṣāṃ poṭalaiḥ svedo hitaḥ| svinnotsannaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ śastrairlikhitaṃ pralepairlimpet| gītirāryā|

ab.seg: yeṣu na śastraṃ kramate sparśendriyanāśaneṣu kuṣṭheṣu| teṣu nipātyaḥ kṣāro raktaṃ doṣaṃ ca visrāvya||56||

div.ab: Sa. yeṣu kuṣṭheṣu sparśendriyanāśaneṣu śastraṃ na kramate, teṣu raktaṃ doṣaṃ ca visrāvya kṣāro nipātanīyaḥ| kramata iti "vṛttisarga" ityādinā taḍ|

ab.seg: lepo'tikaṭhinapuruṣe supte kuṣṭhe sthire purāṇe ca| pītāgadasya kāryo viṣaiḥ samantro'gadaiścānu||57||

div.ab: Sa. pāṣāṇavatkaṭhine tathā paruṣasparśe tathā supte sthirībhūte tathā purāṇe ca kuṣṭhe satyāturasyopayuktāgadasya viṣairmantrasahitairle(to le)paḥ kāryaḥ| anu-paścāt, agadaiśca lepaḥ|

ab.seg: stabdhāni suptasuptānyasvedanakaṇḍulāni kuṣṭhāni| ghṛṣṭāni śuṣkagomayaphenakaśastraiḥ pradehyāni||58||

div.ab: Sa. kuṣṭhāni stabdhāni tathā'tisuptāni tathā'svedanāni kaṇḍūvanti ca śuṣkagomayādibhighṛṣṭānyanantaraṃ pralepyāni|

ab.seg: mustā triphalā madanaṃ karañja āragvadhaḥ kaliṅgayavāḥ| saptāhvakuṣṭhaphalinīdārvyaḥ siddhārthakaṃ snānam||59||
eṣa kaṣāyo vamanaṃ virecanaṃ varṇakastathoddharṣaḥ| tvagdoṣakuṣṭhaśophaprabādhanaḥ pāṇḍurogaghnaḥ||60||

div.ab: Sa. mustādayaḥ snānaṃ syāt| eṣa eva kaṣāyo vamanaṃ [virecanaṃ] varṇakarastathoddharṣastvagdoṣādiprabādhanaḥ pāṇḍurogahṛcca syāt|

ab.seg: karavīranimbakuṭajācchamyākāccitrakācca mūlānām| mūtre darvīlepī kvātho lepena kuṣṭhaghnaḥ||61||

div.ab: Sa. karavīramūlādinā caturguṇe gomūtre kvathite darvīlepī kvātho lepena kuṣṭhaghnaḥ-kuṣṭhāpahaḥ|

ab.seg: śvetakaravīmūlaṃ kuṭajakarañjātphalaṃ tvaco dārvyāḥ| sumanaḥpravālayukto lepaḥ kuṣṭhāpahaḥ siddhaḥ||62||

div.ab: Sa. sitakaravīramūlādayaḥ sumanaḥpallavayuto lepo niścitaṃ kuṣṭhaghnaḥ|

ab.seg: śairīṣī tvak puṣpaṃ kārpāsyā rājavṛkṣapatrāṇi| piṣṭā ca kākamācī caturvidhaḥ kuṣṭhahā lepaḥ||63||

div.ab: Sa. śirīṣatvagādilepaścatuḥprakāraḥ kuṣṭhajit| āryā aṣṭau|

ab.seg: vyoṣasarṣapaniśāgṛhadhūmai- ryāvaśūkapaṭucitrakakuṣṭhaiḥ| kolamātraguṭikā'rdhaviṣāṃśā śvitrakuṣṭhaharaṇo varalepaḥ||64||

div.ab: Sa. vyoṣādibhirdravyaiḥ samāṃśaistadardhaviṣopetaiḥ kolapramāṇāvaṭikā lepataḥ śvitraṃ kuṣṭhaṃ hanti| [ svāgatāvṛttam| ]

ab.seg: nimbaṃ haridre surasaṃ paṭolaṃ kuṣṭhāśvagandhe suradāru śigruḥ| sasarṣapaṃ tumbarudhānyavanyaṃ caṇḍā ca cūrṇāni samāni kuryāt||65||
taistakrapiṣṭaiḥ prathamaṃ śarīraṃ tailāktamudvartayituṃ yateta| tathā'sya kaṇḍūḥ piṭikāḥ sakoṭhāḥ kuṣṭhāni śophāśca śamaṃ vrajanti||66||

div.ab: Sa. pūrvaṃ tailābhyaktaṃ śarīraṃ nimbādibhiḥ samabhāgena cūrṇīkṛtairudvartanārthaṃ yatnaṃ kuryāt| tathā-evaṃ kṛte, asya-āturasya, kaṇḍvādayaḥ śāmyanti| udvartanānantaramuṣṇajalasnānaṃ kāryam|

ab.seg: mustāmṛtāsaṅgakaṭaṅkaṭerī- kāsīsakampillakakuṣṭharodhrāḥ| gandhopalaḥ sarjaraso viḍaṅgaṃ manaḥśilāle karavīrakatvak||67||
tailāktagātrasya kṛtāni cūrṇā- nyetāni dadyādavacūrṇanārtham| dadrūḥ sakaṇḍūḥ kiṭibhāni pāmā vicarcikā ceti tathā na santi||68||

div.ab: Sa. mustādīni samānyetāni cūrṇāni kṛtāni tailabhyaktadehasyāvacūrṇanārthaṃ dadyāt| tathā-evamavacūrṇite sati, dadrurityādayo naśyanti| catvāryetānyupajātisaṃjñāni vṛttāni|

ab.seg: snuggaṇḍe sarṣapātkalkaḥ kukūlānalapācitaḥ| lepādvicarcikāṃ hanti rāgavega iva trapām||69||
manaḥśilāle maricāni taila- mārkaṃ payaḥ kuṣṭhaharaḥ pradehaḥ| tathā karañjaprapunāṭabījaṃ kuṣṭhānvitaṃ gosalilena piṣṭam||70||

div.ab: Sa. sarṣapāṇāṃ kalkaḥ sruhyā gaṇḍe kukūlāgnau pācito lepena vicarcikāṃ hanti, rāgavego lajjāṃ yathā| manaḥśilādayaḥ pralepāt kuṣṭhahṛtaḥ| tadvadeva karañjādi gomūtrapiṣṭam| upajātivṛttam|

ab.seg: guggulumaricaviḍaṅgaiḥ sarṣapakāsīsasarjarasamustaiḥ| śrīveṣṭakālagandhairmanaḥśilākuṣṭhakampillaiḥ||71||
ubhayaharidrāsahitaiścākrikatailena miśritairebhiḥ| dinakarakarābhitaptaiḥ kuṣṭhaṃ ghṛṣṭaṃ ca naṣṭaṃ ca||72||

div.ab: Sa. guggulvādibhiretaiścakrajatailena miśritaiḥ sūryaraśmitaptaighṛṣṭaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ drāk naśyati| cākrikaṃ tailaṃ-sadyaḥpīḍitaṃ cakrasthamevoṣṇaṃ tailam| kecittu bahukālakṛtatailapīḍanāt kollu(hṛ)kakāṣṭhāddevadārukāṣṭhavat khaṇḍaśaḥ pāṭitādyuktyā yattailaṃ gṛhyate taccakratailamityāhuḥ|

ab.seg: maricaṃ tamālapatraṃ kuṣṭhaṃ samanaḥśilaṃ sakāsīsam| tailena yuktamuṣitaṃ saptāhaṃ bhājane tāmre||73||
tenāliptaṃ sidhmaṃ saptāhād gharmasevino'paiti| māsānnavaṃ kilāsaṃ snānena vinā viśuddhasya||74||

div.ab: Sa. maricādikaṃ tailena yuktaṃ saptadināni tāmrabhājane sthitaṃ tena ca-maricādinā, sidhmamāliptaṃ gharmasevino narasya saptāhenāpaiti| māsādyatsadyotthitaṃ śvitraṃ tannaśyati| snānena vinā viśuddhasya narasya| catasra āryāḥ, āryāśca jaghanacapalāḥ|

ab.seg: mayūrakakṣārajale saptakṛtvaḥ parisrate| siddhaṃ jyotiṣmatītailamabhyaṅgātsidhmanāśanam||75||

div.ab: Sa. apāmārgakṣārodake saptavārān parisrute suvarṇalatātailaṃ pakvamabhyaṅgena sidhmaṃ nāśayati|

ab.seg: vāyasajaṅghāmūlaṃ vamanīpatrāṇi mūlakādbījam| takreṇa bhaumavāre lepaḥ sidhmāpahaḥ siddhaḥ||76||

div.ab: Sa. kākajaṅghāmūlaṃ vamanyāḥ patrāṇi mūlakabījaṃ ca takreṇāṅgārakadine lepaḥ sidhmaghnaḥ siddhaḥ|

ab.seg: jīvantī mañjiṣṭhā dārvī kampillakaṃ payastuttham| eṣa ghṛtatailapākaḥ siddhaḥ siddhe ca sarjarasaḥ||77||
deyaḥ samadhūcchiṣṭo vipādikā tena naśyati hyaktā| carmaikakuṣṭhakiṭibhaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ śāmyatyalasakaṃ ca||78||

div.ab: Sa. eṣa ghṛtatailapākaḥ ghṛtatailābhyāṃ pāko yasya yogasya sa ghṛtatailapākaḥ, gamakatvātsamāsaḥ| siddho-niṣpannaḥ| siddhe'smin pāke sarjaraso madanena saha deyaḥ| tena-siddhena yogena, vipādikā'bhyaktā naśyati| tathā, carmaikakuṣṭhādikaṃ ca śāmyati| kṣīramūtrārkaṃ grāhyam, yaugikatvādvṛddhavaidyavyavahārācca| āryāstisraḥ|

ab.seg: mūlaṃ saptāhvāttvak śirīṣāśvamārā- darkānmālatyāścitrakāsphotanimbāt| bījaṃ kārañjaṃ sārṣapaṃ prāpunāṭaṃ śreṣṭhā jantughnaṃ tryūṣaṇaṃ dve haridre||79||
tailaṃ tailaṃ sādhitaṃ taiḥ samūtrai- stvagdoṣāṇāṃ duṣṭanāḍīvraṇānām| abhyaṅgena śleṣmavātodbhavānāṃ nāśāyālaṃ vajrakaṃ vajratulyam||80||

div.ab: Sa. saptaparṇamūlaṃ śirīṣādīnāṃ tvak karañjādīnāṃ bījaṃ tathā triphalādayaḥ, etairgomūtrasahitaistilatailaṃ paktvā vātakaphodbhavānāṃ tvagdoṣāṇāṃ tathā duṣṭanāḍīvraṇānāmabhyaṅgena nāśāya vajrakasaṃjñametadalaṃ-samartham| tathā vajratulyam, avyāhataśaktitvāt| [ vaiśvadevī śālinī ca| ]

ab.seg: eraṇḍatārkṣyaghananīpakadambabhārṅgī- kampillavellaphalinīsuravāruṇībhiḥ| nirguṇḍyaruṣkarasurāhvasuvarṇadugdhā- śrīveṣṭagugguluśilāpaṭutālaviśvaiḥ||81||
tulyasnugarkadugdhaṃ siddhaṃ tailaṃ smṛtaṃ mahāvajram| atiśayitavajrakaguṇaṃ śvitrārśogranthimālāghnam||82||

div.ab: Sa. eraṇḍādibhistulyasnugarkadugdhaṃ tailaṃ pakvaṃ mahāvajrasaṃjñaṃ smṛtam| atiśayena vajrakaguṇaṃ śvitrādighnam| vasantatilakaṃ āryā ca|

ab.seg: kuṣṭhāśvamārabhṛṅgārkamūtrasnukkṣīrasaindhavaiḥ| tailaṃ siddhaṃ viṣāvāpamabhyaṅgāt kuṣṭhajitparam||83||

div.ab: Sa. kuṣṭhādibhiḥ siddhaṃ tailaṃ viṣāvāpamabhyaṅgāt paraṃ kuṣṭhahṛt|

ab.seg: siddhaṃ sikthakasindūrapuratutthakatārkṣyajaiḥ| kacchūṃ vicarcikāṃ cāśu kaṭutailaṃ nibarhati||84||

div.ab: Sa. sikthakādibhiḥ pakvaṃ sarṣapatailaṃ kacchvādīnnihanti|

ab.seg: lākṣā vyoṣaṃ prāpunāṭaṃ ca bījaṃ saśrīveṣṭaṃ kuṣṭhasiddhārthakāśca| takronmiśraḥ syāddharidrā ca lepo dadrūṣūkto mūlakotthaṃ ca bījam||85||

div.ab: Sa. lākṣādayo niśā ca takronmiśro dadrūṣu lepa uktaḥ| mūlakabījaṃ ca takramiśraṃ tadvat| śālinīvṛttam|

ab.seg: citrakasobhāñjanakau, guḍūcyapāmārgadevadārūṇi| khadiro dhavaśca lepaḥ, śyāmā dantī dravantī ca||86||
lākṣārasāñjanailāḥ, punarnavā ceti kuṣṭhināṃ lepāḥ| dadhimaṇḍayutāḥ pādaiḥ ṣaṭ proktā mārutakaphaghnāḥ||87||

div.ab: Sa. citrakādayo dadhimaṇḍānvitāḥ pādaiḥ ṣaṭ vātaśleṣmakuṣṭhaghnā gaditāḥ| tatra citrakasobhāñjanakāvityeko lepaḥ, guḍūcyapāmārgadevadārūṇīti dvitīyaḥ, evamanye'pi vedyāḥ| ārye|

ab.seg: jalavāpyalohakesarapatraplavacandanamṛṇālāni| bhāgottarāṇi siddhaṃ pralepanaṃ pittakaphakuṣṭhe||88||

div.ab: Sa. jalādīni bhāgottarāṇi siddhaḥ pittakaphakuṣṭhe pralepaḥ| jalaṃ-vālakam| vāpyaṃ-kuṣṭham| jaghanacapalā''ryā|

ab.seg: tiktaghṛtairdhautaghṛtairabhyaṅgo dahyamānakuṣṭheṣu| tailaiścandanamadhukaprapauṇḍarīkotpalayutaiśca||89||
klede prapatati cāṅge dāhe visphoṭake ca carmadale| śītāḥ pradehasekā vyadhanavirekaughṛtaṃ tiktam||90||

div.ab: Sa. tiktadravyasādhitairghṛtaistathā jalena dhautairghṛtairabhyaṅgo dāhayukteṣu kuṣṭheṣu hitaḥ| klede ca prakarṣeṇa patati sati tailaiścandanādiyuktairabhyaṅgaḥ, caśabdāddhṛtaiśca, prakṛtatvāddhitaḥ| aṅge dāhādimati śītapradehādyāstiktakaṃ ca ghṛtaṃ hitam| vyadhanaṃ-sirāvyadhaḥ|

ab.seg: khadiravṛṣanimbakuṭajāḥśreṣṭhākṛmijitpaṭolamadhuparṇyaḥ antarbahiḥ prayuktāḥ kṛmikuṣṭhanudaḥ sagomūtrāḥ||91||

div.ab: Sa. khadirādayo gomūtrānvitā abhyantaraṃ bāhyataśca prayuktāḥ kṛmiyutakuṣṭhahṛtaḥ|

ab.seg: vātottareṣu sarpirvamanaṃ śleṣmottareṣu kuṣṭheṣu| pittottareṣu mokṣo raktasya virecanaṃ cāgre||92||

div.ab: Sa. vātādhikeṣu kuṣṭheṣu ghṛtamagre-pūrvaṃ, hitam| śleṣmādhikeṣu ca vamanam| pittottareṣu raktamokṣo virecanaṃ cāgre hitam|

ab.seg: ye lepāḥ kuṣṭhānāṃ yujyante nirhṛtāsradoṣāṇām| saṃśodhitāśayānāṃ sadyaḥ siddhirbhavati teṣām||93||

div.ab: Sa. nirhṛtāsradoṣāṇāṃ tathā saṃśodhitaśayānāṃ kuṣṭhānāṃ ye lepā yujyante, teṣāṃ sadyaḥ-śīghrameva, siddhiḥ-āmayanivṛttiḥ, bhavati| ata evedamāha-

ab.seg: doṣe hṛte'panīte rakte bāhyāntare kṛte śamane| snehe ca kālayukte na kuṣṭhamativartate sādhyam||94||

div.ab: Sa. doṣe-vātādau, hṛte rakte'panīte bāhye'bhyantare śamane kṛte snehe kṛte ca kāle yukte kuṣṭhaṃ sādhyaṃ nātivartate| api tūpaśāmyati| āryāḥ ṣaṭ, anyatra jaghanacapalāḥ (?)|

ab.seg: bahudoṣaḥ saṃśodhyaḥ kuṣṭhī bahuśo'nurakṣatā prāṇān| doṣe hyatimātrahṛte vāyurhanyādabalamāśu||95||

div.ab: Sa. bahudoṣaḥ kuṣṭhī prāṇān rakṣatā bhiṣajā punaḥpunaḥ saṃśodhyaḥ| ekavelayaiva kasmānna śodhyate ? ityāha-yasmāddoṣe'timātrahṛte satyabalaṃ naraṃ vāto drāgeva hanyāt| āryā|

ab.seg: pakṣātpakṣācchardanānyabhyupeyā- nmāsānmāsācchodhanānyapyadhastāt| śuddhirmūrghni syāttrirātrāttrirātrāt ṣaṣṭhe ṣaṣṭhe māsyasṛḍmokṣaṇaṃ ca||96||

div.ab: Sa. asau kuṣṭhī pakṣeṇa vamanāni seveta| māsānmāsādadhaḥśodhanāni bhajet| śirasi trirātre trirātre śuddhiḥ syāt| ṣaṣṭhe ṣaṣṭhe raktamokṣaśca syāt|

ab.seg: yo durvānto durvirikto'thavā syāt kuṣṭhī doṣairuddhatairvyāpyate'sau| niḥsandehaṃ yātyasādhyatvamevaṃ tasmāt kṛtsnānnirharedasya doṣān||97||

div.ab: Sa. yaḥ kuṣṭhī kṛtāsamyagvamanavirecanaḥ syāt, asāvuddhatairdoṣairvyāpyate| evaṃ niścayenāsādhyatvaṃ yāti| tasmāddhetorasya-kuṣṭhinaḥ, kṛtsnān-nikhilān, doṣānnirharet| śālinīvṛttam(tte)|

vratadamayamasevā tyāgaśīlābhiyogo dvijasuragurupūjā sarvasattveṣu maitrī| śivaśivasutatārābhāskarārādhanāni prakaṭitamalapāpaṃ kuṣṭhamunmūlayanti|98| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe cikitsitasthāne kuṣṭhacikitsitaṃ nāmaikonaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ|19|

Sa. vratādisevā tyāgādyabhyāso dvijādipūjā sarvasattvamaitrī śivādyārādhanāni kuṣṭhaṃ prakaṭitamalapāpaṃ nāśayanti| mālinīvṛttam| iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayaṭīkāyāṃ sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ caturthe cikitsitasthāne kuṣṭhacikitsitaṃ nāmaikonaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 19||

div.head: śvitrakṛmicikitsitādhyāyaḥ
div.ab: Sa. asmādanantaraṃ śvitrakṛmicikitsitaṃ vyākhyāyate| cikitsāsāmyamityāha-

ab.seg: athātaḥ śvitrakṛmicikitsitaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre|2| ) kuṣṭhādapi bībhatsaṃ yacchīghrataraṃ ca yātyasādhyatvam| śvitramatastacchāntyai yateta dīpte yathā bhavane||1||

div.ab: Sa. yat-yasmāt, kuṣṭhādapi bībhatsaṃ-jugupsitaṃ nindyaṃ, tathā śīghrataramasādhyatvaṃ śvitraṃ yāti| ataḥ-asmāddhetoḥ, tasya-śvitrasya śamāya, yatnaṃ kuryāt| yathā jvalite gṛhe| āryā|

ab.seg: saṃśodhanaṃ viśeṣātprayojayetpūrvameva dehasya| śvitre sraṃsanamagryaṃ malayūrasa iṣyate saguḍaḥ||2||
taṃ pītvā'bhyaktatanuryathābalaṃ sūryapādasantāpam| seveta niriktatanustryahaṃ pipāsuḥ pibetpeyām||3||

div.ab: Sa. prathamameva śarīrasya saṃśodhanaṃ viśeṣeṇa prayojayet| tadevāha-śvitre malayūraso-bākucīkvāthaḥ, saha guḍayā-snuhyā, saguḍo virecanamiṣyate| mukhacapalā| taṃ-kvāthaṃ, pītvā'vyaktaśarīraḥ san yathāśakti sūryakiraṇasantāpaṃ bhajet| viriktaśca san pipāsitaḥ peyāṃ trīṇi dināni pibet|

ab.seg: śvitre'ṅge sphoṭā jāyante kaṇṭakena tānbhindyāt| sphoṭeṣu niḥsruteṣu prātaḥ prātaḥ pibet tridinam||4||
malayūmasanaṃ priyaṅgūṃ śatapuṣpāṃ cāmbhasā samutkvāthya| pālāśaṃ vā kṣāraṃ yathābalaṃ phāṇitopetam||5||

div.ab: Sa. śvitre sābhyaṅge ye sphoṭā udbhavanti, tān-sphoṭakān, kaṇṭakena bhindyāt| sphoṭeṣu niḥsruteṣu satsu prātaḥ prātastrīṇi dināni malayvādīni samutkvāthya pibet| pālāśaṃ vā kṣāraṃ phāṇitayuktaṃ yathāśakti pibet| tisra āryāḥ|

ab.seg: phalgvakṣavṛkṣavalkalaniryūheṇendurājikākalkam| pītvoṣṇasthitasya jāte sphoṭe takreṇa bhojanaṃ nirlavaṇam||6||

div.ab: Sa. phalgorakṣesya ca tvaco yo niryūhaḥ-kvāthaḥ, tena [indurājikāyāḥ-] bākucyāḥ, kalkaṃ pītvā uṣṇe-ātape, sthitasya sphoṭeṣu jāteṣu satsu takreṇa saha bhojanaṃ nirlavaṇaṃ hitam| āryā gītiḥ (?)|

ab.seg: gavyaṃ mūtraṃ citrakavyoṣayuktaṃ sarpiḥkumbhe sthāpitaṃ kṣaudramiśram| pakṣādūrdhvaṃ śvitriṇā peyametat kāryaṃ cāsmai kuṣṭhadṛṣṭaṃ vidhānam||7||

div.ab: Sa. gomūtraṃ citrakādiyuktaṃ mākṣikānvitaṃ ghṛtakumbhe sthāpitaṃ pakṣaṃ yāvat pakṣādūrdhvaṃ śvitravataitatpeyam| asmai ca-śvitriṇe, kuṣṭhoktaṃ vidhānam| asmai iti kriyāgrahaṇātsampradānatvam| [śālinīvṛttam| ]

ab.seg: mārkavamathavā svādedbhṛṣṭhaṃ tailena lohapātrastham| bījakaśṛtaṃ ca dugdhaṃ tadanu pibocchvitranāśāya||8||

div.ab: Sa. bhṛṅgarājaṃ vā tailena bhṛṣṭaṃ lohapātrasthaṃ khādet| bhuktvā ca paścādbījakaśṛtaṃ kṣīraṃ śvitraśāntyai pibet| āryā|

ab.seg: pūtikārkavyādhighātasnuhīnāṃ mutre piṣṭāḥ pallavā jātijāśca| ghnantyālepācchvitradurnāmadadrū- pāmākoṭhān duṣṭanāḍīvraṇāṃśca||9||

div.ab: Sa. pūtikādīnāṃ pallavā gomūtre piṣṭāstathā jātipallavā gomūtre piṣṭāḥ pralepena śvitrādīn ghnanti|
dvaipaṃ dagdhaṃ carma mātaṅgajaṃ vāśvitre lepastailayukto variṣṭhaḥ| ------------------------------ ----------------------------|10|
Sa. dvīpasambandhi carma dagdhaṃ hastijaṃ ca carma dagdhaṃ tailānvito lepaḥ śvitre'tiśayena varaḥ|

ab.seg: --------------------------------- ------------------------------------| pūtiḥkīṭo rājavṛkṣodbhavena kṣāreṇāktaḥ śvitrameko'pi hanti||10||

div.ab: Sa. pūtiḥkīṭo rājavṛkṣajena kṣāreṇa lepata eka eva śvitraṃ hanti| pūtiḥkīṭo-varṣākālodbhavaḥ pilindiketi loke prasiddhaḥ| śālinyau vṛtte|

ab.seg: rātrau gomūtre vāsitān jarjarāṅgā- nahni cchāyāyāṃ śoṣayetsphoṭahetūn| evaṃ vārāṃstrīṃstaistataḥ ślakṣṇapiṣṭaiḥ snuhyāḥ kṣīreṇa śvitranāśāya lepaḥ||11||

div.ab: Sa. sphoṭahetūn-bhallātakān, jarjarīkṛtān niśi gomūtre sthitān divase chāyāyāṃ śoṣayet| evaṃ trīn vārān mūtrasthitān śoṣitāṃśca| tataḥ-anantaraṃ, taiḥ snuhīkṣīreṇa ślakṣṇapiṣṭaiḥ śvitraśāntyai lepaḥ| vaiśvadevī|

ab.seg: akṣatailadrutā lepaḥ kṛṣṇasarpodbhavā maṣī| śikhipittaṃ tathā, dagdhaṃ hrīberaṃ vā tadāplutam||12||

div.ab: Sa. kṛṣṇasarpajā maṣī akṣatailena drutā lepaḥ| mayūrapittaṃ ca lepaḥ pūrvaguṇaḥ| athavā, hrīberaṃ dagdhaṃ tena-akṣatailenāloḍitaṃ, lepastadvat|

ab.seg: kuḍavo'valgujabījāddharitālacaturthabhāgasammiśraḥ| mūtreṇa gavāṃ piṣṭaḥ savarṇakaraṇaṃ paraṃ śvitre||13||

div.ab: Sa. bākucībījaṃ palacatuṣṭayaṃ haritālapalaṃ gomūtreṇa piṣṭaṃ śvitre savarṇakaraṃ syāt| āryā|

ab.seg: kṣāre sudagdhe gajaliṇḍaje ca gajasya mūtreṇa parisrute ca| droṇapramāṇe daśabhāgayuktaṃ dattvā pacedbījamavalgujānām||14||
śvitraṃ jayeccikkaṇatāṃ gatena tena pralimpan bahuśaḥ praghṛṣṭam| kuṣṭhaṃ maṣaṃ vā tilakālakaṃ vā yadvā vraṇe syādadhimāṃsajātam||15||

div.ab: Sa. gajapurīṣaje kṣāre sudagdhe droṇapramāṇe yathāpramāṇaṃ gajasya mūtreṇa kṣāravidhinā parīsrute'smin bākucībījaṃ dattvā pacet| kimbhūtam ? daśabhāgayuktam,-daśabhirbhāgaiḥ prakṛtatvāt kṣārasya sambandhibhirmiśritam| tena cikkaṇatāṃ-madanarūpatāṃ, gatena puruṣo bahuśaḥ praghṛṣṭaṃ śvitraṃ pralimpan jayet, kuṣṭhādīṃśca| adhimāṃsarūpato yacca syāttacca jayet| upajātī|

ab.seg: bhallātakaṃ dvīpisudhārkamūlaṃ guñjāphalaṃ tryūṣaṇaśaṅkhacūrṇam| tutthaṃ sakuṣṭhaṃ lavaṇāni pañca kṣāradvayaṃ lāṅgalikāṃ ca paktvā||16||
snugarkadugdhe ghanamāyasasthaṃ śalakayā tadvidadhīta lepam| kuṣṭhe kilāse tilakālakeṣu maṣeṣu durnāmasu carmakīle||17||

div.ab: Sa. bhallātakādikaṃ snugarkayordugdhe paktvā ghanamāyasapātre sthitaṃ tat-etat, śalākayā lepaṃ kuṣṭhādiṣu vidadhīta| indravajropajātī|

ab.seg: śuddhyā śoṇitamokṣairvirūkṣaṇairbhakṣaṇaiśca saktūnām| śvitraṃ kasyacideva praśāmyati kṣīṇapāpasya||18||
iti śvitracikitsitam||1||

div.ab: Sa. śvitraṃ kasyacideva narasya kṣīṇakalmaṣasya śuddhyādibhiḥ śāmyati| āryā| iti śvitracikitsā| asmādanantaraṃ kṛmicikitsitaṃ vyākhyāyate, cikitsāsāmānyāt|

ab.seg: atha kṛmicikitsitam| snigdhasvinne guḍakṣīramatsyādyaiḥ kṛmiṇodare| utkleśitakṛmikaphe śarvarīṃ tāṃ sukhoṣite||19||
surasādigaṇaṃ mūtre kvāthayitvā'rdhavāriṇi| taṃ kaṣāyaṃ kaṇāgālakṛmijitkalkayojitam||20||
satailasvarjikākṣāraṃ yuñjyādvastiṃ tato'hani| tasminneva nirūḍhaṃ taṃ pāyayeta virecanam||21||
trivṛtkalkaṃ phalakaṇākaṣāyāloḍitaṃ tataḥ| ūrdhvādhaḥśodhite kuryātpañcakolayutaṃ kramam||22||
kaṭutiktakaṣāyāṇāṃ kaṣāyaiḥ pariṣecanam| kāle viḍaṅgatailena tatastamanuvāsayet||23||

div.ab: Sa. kṛmiṇamaduraṃ yasyeti pāmāditvānnapratyayaḥ| tasmin kṛmiṇodare nare snigdhasvinne tathā guḍādibhirutkleśitāḥ-svasthānāccyāvitāḥ , kṛmayaḥ kaphaśca yasya tasmiṃstathābhūta udare tathā samutkleśitādanantaraṃ tāṃ rātriṃ sukhoṣite sati satailasvarjikākṣāraṃ bastiṃ yuñjyāt| katham ? ityāha-surasādigaṇaṃ (hṛ. sū. a. 15|30) gomūtre'rdhavāriṇi kvāthayitvā tatastaṃ kaṣāyaṃ kaṇādīnāṃ kalkena yojitaṃ-miśraṃ kṛtvā| tato-nirūhādanantaraṃ , tasminnevāhani taṃ-nirūḍhaṃ , virecanaṃ trivṛtkalkaṃ phalādikaṣāyāloḍitaṃ pāyayet| tataḥ-anantaraṃ , ūrdhvādhaḥśodhite tasmin pañcakolayutaṃ kramaṃ-peyāvilepyādikaṃ , kuryāt| tataḥ kaṭvādibhiḥ kaṣāyaiḥ pariṣecitaṃ samanantaraṃ yadā sandhukṣito'gnistadā tasmin kāle viḍaṅgatailena tamanuvāsayet|

ab.seg: śiroroganiṣedhoktamācarenmūrdhageṣvanu| udriktatiktakaṭukamalpasnehaṃ ca bhojanam||24||

div.ab: Sa. śirorogapratiṣedhe yaduktaṃ tanmūrdhageṣu kṛmiṣvācaret| anu-paścāt, prabhūtatiktakaṭukamalpasnehaṃ ca bhojanamācaret|

ab.seg: viḍaṅgakṛṣṇāmaricapippalīmūlaśigrubhiḥ| pibetsasvarjikākṣārairyavāgūṃ takrasādhitam||25||

div.ab: Sa. tathā viḍaṅgādibhistakrasādhitāṃ peyāṃ pibet|
rasaṃ śirīṣakiṇihīpāribhadrakakembukāt| palāśabījapattarapūtikādvā pṛthak pibet||26|| sakṣaudraṃ, surasādīn vā lihyātkṣaudrayutān pṛthak| ---------------------------------------------|27|
Sa. śirīṣādirasaṃ pibet| kiṇihī-girikarṇikā| palāśabījādīnāṃ vā rasaṃ mākṣikānvitaṃ pṛthak pibet| athavā , surasādīn (hṛ. sū. a. 15|30) kṣaudrayutān pṛthag lihyāt|
---------------------------------------------| śatakṛtvo'śvaviṭcūrṇaṃ viḍaṅgakvāthabhāvitam||27|| kṛmimān madhunā lihyādbhāvitaṃ vā varārasaiḥ| ---------------------------------------------|28|
Sa. aśvapurīṣacūrṇaṃ bahūn vārān viḍaṅgakvāthena bhāvitamathavā'śvaśakṛccūrṇaṃ triphalākvāthena bhāvitaṃ madhunā kṛmimān lihyāt|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| śirogateṣu kṛmiṣu cūrṇaṃ pradhamanaṃ ca tat||28||

div.ab: Sa. śirogateṣu kṛmiṣu tat-śiroroganiṣedhoktaṃ, cūrṇaṃ pradhamanaṃ-nasyaṃ , cācaret|
ākhukarṇīkisalayaiḥ supiṣṭaiḥ piṣṭamiśritaiḥ| paktvā pūpalikāṃ khādeddhānyāmlaṃ ca pibedanu||29|| sapañcakolalavaṇamasāndra takrameva vā| ---------------------------------------------|30|
Sa. tathā, mūṣakakarṇīpallavaiḥ sūkṣmacūrṇitaiḥ śālicūrṇamiśritaiḥ pūpalikāṃ paktvā khādet| tadanu-paścācca, dhānyāmlaṃ pibet| athavā , takraṃ-mathitaṃ , pañcakolalavaṇayutaṃ pibet|
---------------------------------------------| nīpamārkavanirguṇḍīpallaveṣvapyayaṃ vidhiḥ||30|| viḍaṅgacūrṇamiśrairvā piṣṭairbhakṣyān prakalpayet| ---------------------------------------------|31|
Sa. nīpādiṣvayameva-pūrvokto mūṣakakarṇīpallavavidhiḥ , kalpyaḥ| athavā , piṣṭairviḍaṅgacūrṇamiśritairbhakṣyān prakalpayet|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| viḍaṅgataṇḍulairyuktamardhāṃśairātape sthitam||31||
dinamāruṣkaraṃ tailaṃ pāne bastau ca yojayet| surāhvasaralasnehaṃ pṛthagevaṃ ca kalpayet||32||

div.ab: Sa. aruṣkarajaṃ tailaṃ pāne bastau ca yojayet| kimbhūtam ? ardhabhāgapramāṇairviḍaṅgataṇḍulairmiśritaṃ tathā dinamātape sthitam| dinamityatyantasaṃyoge dvitīyā| devadārvāditailaṃ pṛthagevaṃ-viḍaṅgataṇḍulānvitamātape sthitaṃ , kalpayet|
purīṣajeṣu sutarāṃ dadyādbastivirecane| ---------------------------------------------|33|
Sa. purīṣajeṣu kṛmiṣu sutarāṃ bastiṃ virecanaṃ ca dadyāt|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| śirovirekaṃ vamanaṃ śamanaṃ kaphajanmasu||33||

div.ab: Sa. kaphajanmasu kṛmiṣu śirovirekaṃ-nasyaṃ , vamanaṃ śamanaṃ ca kuryāt|
raktajānāṃ pratīkāraṃ kuryātkuṣṭhacikitsitāt| ---------------------------------------------|34|
Sa. raktotthānāṃ kṛmīṇāṃ kuṣṭhacikitsitāt pratīkāraṃ vidadhyāt| lyablope pañcamī , kuṣṭhacikitsitoktapekṣyetyarthaḥ|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| indraluptavidhiścātra vidheyo romabhojiṣu||34||

div.ab: Sa. romabhojiṣu kṛmiṣvindraluptavidhiḥ (hṛ. u. a. 24|28) kāryaḥ|

kṣīrāṇi māṃsāni ghṛtaṃ guḍaṃ ca dadhīni śākāni ca parṇavanti| samāsato'mlānmadhurān rasāṃśca kṛmīn jihāsuḥ parivarjayet|35| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe cikitsitasthāne śvitrakṛmicikitsitaṃ nāma viṃśo'dhyāyaḥ|20|

Sa. kṛmīn jihāsuḥ kṣīrādīn varjayet| upajātivṛttam| iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayaṭīkāyāṃ sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ caturthe cikitsitasthāne śvitrakṛmicikitsitaṃ nāma viṃśo'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 20||

div.head: vātavyādhicikitsitādhyāyaḥ
div.ab: Sa. asmādanantaraṃ vātavyādhicikitsitaṃ vyākhyātumupakramyate , sarvacikitsābādhitatvāt|

athāto vātavyādhicikitsitaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre||2|| ) kevalaṃ nirupastambhamādau snehairupācaret| vāyuṃ sarpirvasāmajjatailapānairnaraṃ tataḥ||1|| snehaklāntaṃ samāśvāsya payobhiḥ snehayetpunaḥ| yūṣairgrāmyodakānūparasairvā snehasaṃyutaiḥ||2|| pāyasaiḥ kṛsaraiḥ sāmlalavaṇaiḥ sānuvāsanaiḥ| nāvanaistarpaṇaiścānnaiḥ susnigdhaiḥ svedayettataḥ||3|| svabhyaktaṃ snehasaṃyuktaiḥ śaṅkarādyaiḥ punaḥ punaḥ| ---------------------------------------------|4|

Sa. kevalaṃ-śuddhaṃ , tathā nirupastambhaṃ-anyenādhānakena samīpasambhavinā'nādhāritaṃ , īdṛśaṃ vāyuṃ snehairādāvevopācaret| katham ? ityāha-sarpirityādi| nanu, tailasya pavanavijaye prādhānyādevaṃ nirdeśaḥ kartuṃ yuktaḥ , tailavasāmajjasarpiḥpānairiti| yuktamāha bhavān| kintu, ājanmasātmyāt sarpiḥ pradhānamanavaratamiti sarpiḥ prāgupanyastam| sarpiḥpānādibhistāvat snehayet yāvat "snehodvegaḥ klamaḥ " (hṛ. sū. a. 16|30) ityādi snehalakṣaṇaṃ syāt| snehaklāntaṃ ca naraṃ payobhiḥ samāśvāsya punaryūṣādibhiḥ snehānvitaiḥ snehayet| tathā tarpaṇaiścānnaiḥ susnigdhaiḥ snehayet| tataḥ-anantaraṃ , suṣṭvabhyaktaṃ antaṃ śaṅkarādyaiḥ-svedaiḥ svedavidhigaditaiḥ, punaḥ punaḥ svedayet| eva svedite sati yo guṇaḥ syāttamāha-
---------------------------------------------| snehāktaṃ svinnamaṅgaṃ tu vakraṃ stabdhaṃ savedanam||4|| yatheṣṭamānāmayituṃ sukhameva hi śakyate| ---------------------------------------------|5|

Sa. snehābhyaktaṃ gātraṃ svinnaṃ sadvakraṃ tathā stabdhaṃ tathā sarujaṃ yatheṣṭaṃ sukhamevānāmayituṃ śakyate| "jalahvalahmalanamāmanupasargāṇāṃ vā mitvam|" iti nāmayitumityatra na hṛsvatvam| etadeva dṛṣṭāntadvāreṇa pratipādayannāha--
---------------------------------------------| śuṣkāṇyapi hi kāṣṭhāni snehasvedopapādanaiḥ||5|| śakyaṃ karmaṇyatāṃ netuṃ kimu gātrāṇi jīvitām| ---------------------------------------------|6|

Sa. hi-yasmāt, śuṣkāṇyapi kāṣṭhāni snehasvedasaṃyojanena karmaṇyatāṃ netuṃ śakyante| kimuta jīvatāṃ gātrāṇi na śakyante ? śakyanta evetyarthaḥ| śakyamiti pūrvoktakramamātre napuṃsakatvamekatvaṃ ca| yathā kālidāsasya-"śakyamaṅgulibhiruddhṛtairadhaḥ śākhināṃ patitapuṣpakomalaiḥ| patrajarjaraśaśiprabhālavairebhirutkacayituṃ tavālakān||" iti|
---------------------------------------------| harṣatodarugāyāmaśophastambhagrahādayaḥ||6|| svinnasyāśu praśāmyanti mārdavaṃ copajāyate| ---------------------------------------------|7|
Sa. svinnasya puṃso harṣādayaḥ śīghraṃ praśāmyanti| mṛdutvaṃ ca gātreṣu jāyate|
---------------------------------------------| snehaśca dhātūn saṃśuṣkān puṣṇātyāśūpayojitaḥ||7|| balamagnibalaṃ puṣṭiṃ prāṇāṃścāsyābhivardhayet| ---------------------------------------------|8|
Sa. tathā, sninnasya sneha upayojito dhātūn viśuṣkān drāgeva puṣṇāti| tathā, asya-vātarogiṇo, balādīnabhivardhayet|
---------------------------------------------| asakṛttaṃ punaḥ snehaiḥ svedaiśca pratipādayet||8|| tathā snehamṛdau koṣṭhe na tiṣṭhantyanilāmayāḥ| ---------------------------------------------|9|
Sa. taṃ-āturaṃ, punaḥ snehasvedābhyāṃ yojayet| tathā-evaṃ kṛte snehamṛdau koṣṭhe sati sarve vātarogā naśyanti|
---------------------------------------------| yadyetena sadoṣatvātkarmaṇā na praśāmyati||9|| mṛdubhiḥ snehasaṃyuktairbheṣajaistaṃ viśodhayet| ---------------------------------------------|10|
Sa. anena karmaṇā cenna praśāmyati vātāmayastadā taṃ-vātāmayinaṃ, mṛdubhirdravyaiḥ-karṇikārādibhiḥ, snehānvitairviśodhayet|
--------------------------------------------| ghṛtaṃ tilvakasiddhaṃ vā sātalāsiddhameva vā||10|| payasairaṇḍatailaṃ vā pibeddoṣaharaṃ śivam| --------------------------------------------|11|
Sa. tilvakena pakvaṃ sātalayā vā pakvaṃ kṣīreṇa vā sahairaṇḍatailaṃ pibet| tacca pītaṃ doṣaharaṃ śivaṃ ca syāt| nanu, kimityanulomanaṃ kriyate ? ityāha-
---------------------------------------------| snigdhāmlalavaṇoṣṇādyairāhārairhi malaścitaḥ||11|| sroto baddhvā'nilaṃ rundhyāttasmāttamanulomayet| ---------------------------------------------|12|
Sa. yasmāt snigdhādibhirāhārairmalaścitaḥ srotāṃsi ruddhvā vāyuṃ rundhyāt, tasmānmārutamanulomayet|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| durbalo yo'virecyaḥ syāttaṃ nirūhairupācaret||12||
dīpanaiḥ pācanīyairvā bhojyairvā tadyutairnaram| saṃśuddhasyotthite cāgnau snehasvedau punarhitau||13||

div.ab: Sa. yo naro durbalo virecanānarho bhavet taṃ-naraṃ, nirūhairupācaret| kimbhūtaiḥ ? dīpanai pācanīyaiśca| athavā, tadyutaiḥ-dīpanīyapācanīyayutaiḥ, bhojyairupācaret| anantaraṃ samyakśuddhasya vahnau cotthite sati punarapi snehasvedau hitau|
āmāśayagate vāyau vamitapratibhojite| sukhāmbunā ṣaḍdharaṇaṃ vacādiṃ vā prayojayet||14|| sandhukṣite'gnau parato vidhiḥ kevalavātikaḥ| ---------------------------------------------|15|

Sa. āmāśayagate vāte sati tathā vamitaścāsau pratibhojitaśca tasmin vamitapratibhojite nara uṣṇajalena ṣaḍdharaṇaṃ vacādigaṇaṃ (hṛ. sū. a. 15|35) vā prayojayet| ṣaḍdharaṇayogaḥ saṅgrahādevāvagantavyaḥ| tatraivaṃ paṭhyate (ci. a. 21)- "dārvīkaliṅgakaṭukātiviṣāgnipāṭhā mūtreṇa sūkṣmarajaso dharaṇapramāṇāḥ| pītā jayanti gudajodarakuṣṭhamehakoṣṭhānilāḍhyapavanagrahaṇīpradoṣān||" iti| dharaṇaṃ-palasya daśamo bhāgaḥ| agnau sandīpite sati, anantaraṃ kevalavātiko vidhiḥ, 'kāryaḥ' iti śeṣaḥ|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| matsyānnābhipradeśasthe siddhānbilvaśalāṭubhiḥ||15||

div.ab: Sa. nābhipradeśasthe vāte matsyān bilvaśalāṭubhiḥ siddhā yojayet|
bastikarma tvadhonābheḥ śasyate cāvapīḍakaḥ| ---------------------------------------------|16|
Sa. adhonābheḥ sthite vāte'vapīḍakaḥ śasyate| caśabdānmatsyāśca|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| koṣṭhage kṣāracūrṇādyā hitāḥ pācanadīpanāḥ||16||

div.ab: Sa. koṣṭhage vāyau kṣārādyāḥ pācanā dīpanāśca hitāḥ|
Sa. hṛdayasthite samīraṇe kṣīraṃ śāliparṇyā śṛtaṃ hitam|

ab.seg: -------------------------śirobastiḥ śirogate| snaihikaṃ nāvanaṃ dhūmaḥ śrotrādīnāṃ ca tarpaṇam||17||

div.ab: Sa. śirogate śirobastiḥ śasyate| snaihikaṃ nasyaṃ tathā dhūmaḥ karṇāditarpaṇaṃ ca hitam|
svedābhyaṅganivātāni hṛdyaṃ cānnaṃ tvagāśrite| ---------------------------------------------|18|
Sa. sa-tvaksthe maruti svedādīni hitāni| hṛdayapriyaṃ cānnaṃ hitam|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| śītāḥ pradehā raktasthe vireko raktamokṣaṇam||18||

div.ab: Sa. raktasthe vāte śītāḥ pradehā raktamokṣaṇaṃ ca hitam|
vireko māṃsamedaḥsthe nirūhāḥ śamanāni ca| ---------------------------------------------|19|
Sa. māṃsamedaḥsthite vāyau virekastathā nirūhāḥ śamanāni ca hitāni|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| bāhyābhyantarataḥ snehairasthimajjagataṃ jayet||19||

div.ab: Sa. asthimajjasthaṃ mārutaṃ bāhyābhyantarataḥ snehairjayet|
praharṣo'nnaṃ ca śukrasthe balaśukrakaraṃ hitam| ---------------------------------------------|20|
Sa. śukrasthe samīraṇe praharṣaṇaṃ tathā balaśukrakāri cānnaṃ hitam|

---------------------------------------------| vibaddhamārgaṃ dṛṣṭvā tu śukraṃ dadyādvirecanam||20|| viriktaṃ pratibhuktaṃ ca pūrvoktāṃ kārayetkriyāṃ| ---------------------------------------------|21|
Sa. śukraṃ ca ruddhamārgaṃ dṛṣṭvā virekaṃ dadyāt| viriktaṃ pratibhuktaṃ ca naraṃ pūrvoditāṃ kriyāṃ kārayet| "hṛkroranyatarasyām|" iti pratibhuktasyāpi karmatvam|
---------------------------------------------| garbhe śuṣke tu vātena bālānāṃ ca viśuṣyatām||21|| sitākāśmaryamadhukaiḥ siddhamutthāpane payaḥ| ---------------------------------------------|22|
Sa. vātena garbhe śuṣke sati bālānāṃ ca viśuṣyatāṃ śarkarādibhiḥ siddhaṃ kṣīramutthāpane hitam|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| snāvasandhiśirāprāpte snehadāhopanāhanam||22||

div.ab: Sa. snāvādiprāpte snehadāhopanāhanaṃ hitam|
tailaṃ saṅkucite'bhyaṅgo māṣasaindhavasādhitam| ---------------------------------------------|23|
Sa. saṅkucite'ṅge sati māṣasaindhavasādhitaṃ tailamabhyaṅgaḥ|
---------------------------------------------| āgāradhūmalavaṇatailairlepaḥ srute'sṛji||23|| supte'ṅge veṣṭayukte tu kartavyamupanāhanam| ---------------------------------------------|24|
Sa. rakte srute satyāgāradhūmādibhirlepaḥ| supte gātre tathā veṣṭanayukte copanāhaḥ kāryaḥ| ākṣepakādīnāṃ madhyāt mahātyayatvādapatānakasya tāvaccikitsāmāha-

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| athāpatānakenārtamasrastākṣamavepanam||24||
astabdhameḍhramasvedaṃ bahirāyāmavarjitam| akhaṭvāghātinaṃ cainaṃ tvaritaṃ samupācaret||25||

div.ab: Sa. atha-anantaraṃ, vātavyādhayaḥ saṃjñānirdiṣṭāḥ prastūyante| enaṃ-apatānakārtaṃ naraṃ, asrastākṣādiyuktaṃ yāvadakhaṭvāghātinaṃ ca tvaritaṃ kṛtvopakramet|

ab.seg: tatra prāgeva susnigdhasvinnāṅge tīkṣṇanāvanam| srotoviśuddhaye yuñjyādacchapānaṃ tato ghṛtam||26||
vidāryādigaṇakvāthadadhikṣīrarasaiḥ śṛtam| nātimātraṃ tathā vāyurvyāpnoti sahasaiva vā||27||

div.ab: Sa. tasminnapatānakārte nare, pūrvameva ca suṣṭhu snigdhāṅge svinnāṅge ca tīkṣṇaṃ nasyaṃ-trikaṭukādinā, srotoviśuddhaye yojyam| tataḥ-anantaraṃ, acchapānaṃ ghṛtaṃ yuñjīta| katarat ? ityāha-vidāryādigaṇakvāthādiśṛtam| ghṛtādvidāryādigaṇakvāthaścaturguṇo dadhikṣīrarasāḥ sarpiḥsamā grāhyāḥ| tathā-evaṃkṛte sati, māruto'timātraṃ na vyāpnoti| sahasā-jhaṭityeva ca, nāśrute|

kulatthayavakolāni bhadradārvādikaṃ gaṇam| niḥkvāthyānūpamāṃsaṃ ca tenāmlaiḥ payasā'pi ca||28|| svāduskandhapratīvāpaṃ mahāsnehaṃ vipācayet| sekābhyaṅgāvagāhānnapānanasyānuvāsanaiḥ||29|| sa hanti vātaṃ, te te ca snehasvedāḥ suyojitāḥ| ---------------------------------------------|30|

Sa. kulatthādīnānūpamāṃsaṃ ca niḥkvāthya tena kvāthenāmlaiḥ-dhānyāmlādibhiḥ, svāduskandhakṛtakalkaṃ mahāsnehaṃ vipācayet| saḥ-mahāsneho, vātaṃ hanti| te te ca-pūrvoktāḥ snehāḥ svedāḥ, samyagyojitāḥ vātaṃ ghnanti|
---------------------------------------------| vegāntareṣu mūrdhānamasakṛccāsya recayet||30|| avapīḍaiḥ pradhamanaistīkṣṇaiḥ śleṣmanibarhaṇaiḥ| śvasanāsu vimuktāsu tathā saṃjñāṃ sa vindati|31|

Sa. vegāntareṣu-vegāntarāleṣu, mūrdhānamasakṛt-bahūn vārān, recayet| kaiḥ ? ityāha-avapīḍaiḥ-"kalkādyairavapīḍastu sa tīkṣṇairmūrdharecanaḥ|" (hṛ. sū. a. 20|7) ityuktaiḥ| tathā pradhamanaiḥ-"dhmānaṃ virecaneścūrṇairyuñjyāt" (hṛ. sū. a. 20|8) ityuktaiḥ| etaiśca tīkṣṇaiḥ-tīkṣṇadravyakṛtaiḥ, ata eva śleṣmanāśanaiḥ| [ tathā- ] evaṃkṛte sati, śvasanāsu śleṣmavimuktāsu saṃjñāṃ-cetanāṃ, saḥ-rogī, labhate| prāṇanāḍyo hṛdāśritāḥ śvasanā ityucyante|

ab.seg: sauvarcalābhayāvyoṣasiddhaṃ sarpiścale'dhike||31||

div.ab: Sa. vāyāvadhike sauvarcalādibhiḥ kalkīkṛtaiḥ siddhaṃ sarpirhitam|

ab.seg: palāṣṭakaṃ tilvakato varāyāḥ prasthaṃ palāṃśaṃ gurupañcamūlam| sairaṇḍasiṃhītrivṛtaṃ ghaṭe'pāṃ paktvā pacetpādaśṛtena tena||32||
dadhnaḥ pātre yāvaśūkāttribilvaiḥ sarpiḥprasthaṃ hanti tatsevyamānam| duṣṭān vātānekasarvāṅgasaṃsthān yonivyāpadgulmavardhmodaraṃ ca||33||

div.ab: Sa. tilvakato-lodhrāt palāṣṭakaṃ, triphalāyāḥ prasthaṃ, mahatpañcamūlaṃ pṛthak palabhāgam| kimbhutaṃ pañcamūlam ? eraṇḍavyāghrītrivṛtābhiryuktam| ete'pi palāṃśā ityarthaḥ| jaladroṇe pacet| tena ca pādāvaśeṣeṇa tathā dadhna āḍhake yavakṣārapalaistribhighṛtaprasthaṃ pacet| etacca ghṛtaṃ sevyamānaṃ duṣṭavātādīn hanti| upajātiśālinyau vṛtte|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| vidhistilvakavajjñeyo ramyakaśokayorapi||34||

div.ab: Sa. tilvakasyeva tilvakavat mahānimbasyāśokasya ca vidharjñeyaḥ|
cikitsitamidaṃ kuryācchuddhavātāpatānake| saṃsṛṣṭadoṣe saṃsṛṣṭaṃ--------------|35|
Sa. evamupakramaṃ śuddhavātāpatānake kuryāt| saṃsṛṣṭadoṣe saṃsṛṣṭaṃ-doṣadvayoktaṃ, cikitsitaṃ kuryāt|

ab.seg: tumbarūṇyabhayā hiṅgu pauṣkaraṃ lavaṇatrayam| yavakvāthāmbunā peyaṃ hṛtpārśvārtyapatantrake||36||
hiṅgu sauvarcalaṃ śuṇṭhī dāḍimaṃ sāmlavetasam| pibedvā śleṣmapavanahṛdrogoktaṃ ca śasyate||37||

div.ab: Sa. kaphayukte tumbarvādikaṃ cūrṇayitvā yavakvāthajalena peyaṃ hṛtpīḍādiṣu(ke)| athavā, hiṅgvādikaṃ yavakvāthāmbunā peyam| śleṣmavātahṛdroge ca yatkathitaṃ tacca śasyate|

ab.seg: āyāmayorarditavadbāhyābhyantarayoḥ kriyā| tailadroṇyāṃ ca śayanamāntaro'tra sudustaraḥ||38||

div.ab: Sa. āyāmayorbāhyābhyantarayorarditavatkriyā syāt| tailadroṇyāṃ śayanaṃ ca| atra-anayormadhyāt, āntara āyāmaḥ sudustaraḥ-atikaṣṭasādhyaḥ|

ab.seg: vivarṇadantavadanaḥ srastāṅgo naṣṭacetanaḥ| prasvidyaṃśca dhanuṣambhī daśarātraṃ na jīvati||39||

div.ab: Sa. vivarṇadantāsyaḥ srastāṅgādiḥ prasvedavāṃśca dhanuṣkambhī daśarātraṃ na jīvati|

vegeṣvato'nyathā jīvenmandeṣu vinato jaḍaḥ| khañjaḥ kuṇiḥ pakṣahataḥ paṅgulo vikalo'thavā||40|| hanusraṃse hanū snigdhasvinnau svasthānamānayet| unnāmayecca kuśalaścibukaṃ vivṛte mukhe||41|| nāmayetsaṃvṛte śeṣamekāyāmavadācaret| ---------------------------------------------|42|

Sa. ato'nyathā-vivarṇadantādiviparyayeṇa, tathā mandeṣu vegeṣu satsu jīvet| jīvaṃśca vinatādiguṇaḥ syāt| hanusraṃse tu hanū snigdhasvinnau santau svasthānaṃ prāpayet| kuśalo bhiṣak vivṛte mukhe sati cibukamūrdhvaṃ nāmayet| saṃvṛte tu mukhe cibukaṃ nāmayet| śeṣaṃ cikitsitamekayāmavadācaret-arditavadācaret|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| jihvāstambhe yathāvasthaṃ kāryaṃ vātacikitsitam||42||

div.ab: Sa. jihvāyāḥ stambhe sati yathāvasthaṃ vātasyopakramaḥ kāryaḥ snehasvedānvitaḥ|

ab.seg: ardite nāvanaṃ mūrdhni tailaṃ śrotrākṣitarpaṇam| saśophe vamanaṃ, dāharāgayukte sirāvyadhaḥ||43||

div.ab: Sa. ardite nāvanādi cikitsitam| śophānvite sati vamanaṃ kāryam| dāhādiyukte sati sirāvyadhaḥ|
snehanaṃ snehasaṃyuktaṃ pakṣāghāte virecanam| ---------------------------------------------|44|
Sa. pakṣāghāte snehanaṃ tathā virekaḥ kāryaḥ snehānvitaḥ|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| avabāhau hitaṃ nasyaṃ snehaścottarabhaktikaḥ||44||

div.ab: Sa. avabāhau nasyādi hitam| āme tūpavāsa eva hita ityuvāca saṅgrahe (?)|

ūrustambhe tu na sneho na ca saṃśodhanaṃ hitam| śleṣmāmamedobāhulyādyuktyā tatkṣapaṇānyataḥ||45|| kuryādrūkṣopacāraśca yavaśyāmākakodravāḥ| śākairalavaṇaiḥ śastāḥ kiñcittailairjalaiḥ śṛtaiḥ||46|| jāṅgalairaghṛtairmāṃsairmadhvambhoriṣṭapāyinaḥ| vatsakādirharidrādirvacādirvā sasaindhavaḥ||47|| āḍhyavāte sukhāmbhobhiḥ peyaḥ ṣaḍdharaṇo'thavā| ---------------------------------------------|48|

Sa. ūrustambhe tu snehādi na hitaṃ śleṣmāmamedobāhulyāt| [ataḥ-] asmācca hetoḥ, tayoḥ-āmaśleṣmaṇoḥ, kṣapaṇāni-kṣayakaraṇāni, yuñjyāt| rūkṣopacārārthaṃ madhvambhoriṣṭapāyino yavādayaḥ śākairīṣallavaṇaistathā jalaiḥ śṛtaiḥ| tathā māṃsaiḥ saha| kimbhūtaiḥ ? jāṅgalaistathā ghṛtarahitairhitāḥ|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| lihyātkṣaudreṇa vā śreṣṭhācavyatiktākaṇāghanāt||48||
kalkaṃ samadhu vā cavyapathyāgnisuradārujam| mūtrairvā śīlayetpathyāṃ gugguluṃ girisambhavam||49||

div.ab: Sa. athavā kṣaudreṇa triphalādikaṃ kalkaṃ lihyāt| cavyādikaṃ vā kalkaṃ mākṣikānvitaṃ lihyāt| athavā, gomūtreṇa harītakīmabhyaset| tathā, gugguluṃ śilājatu vā śīlayet|

ab.seg: vyoṣāgnimustatriphalāviḍaṅgairgugguluṃ samam| khādan sarvān jayedvyādhīn medaḥ śleṣmāmavātajān||50||

div.ab: Sa. vyoṣādibhirnavabhirdravyairguggulaṃ tulyaṃ bhakṣayan sarvān medaḥśleṣmāmavātajān vyādhīn hanti|

ab.seg: śāmyatyevaṃ kaphākrāntaḥ samedaskaḥ prabhañjanaḥ| kṣāramūtrānvitān svedān sekānudvartanāni ca||51||
kuryāddihyācca mūtrāḍhyaiḥ karañjaphalasarṣapaiḥ| mūlairvā'pyarkatarkārīnimbajaiḥ sasurāhvayaiḥ||52||
sakṣaudrasarṣapāpakvaloṣṭavalmīkamṛttikaiḥ| kaphakṣayārthaṃ vyāyāme sahye cainaṃ pravartayet||53||
sthalānyullaṅghayennārīḥ śaktitaḥ pariśīlayet| sthiratoyaṃ saraḥ kṣemaṃ pratisroto nadīṃ taret||54||

div.ab: Sa. evaṃ-prāgukte kriyākrame kṛte sati, kaphāvṛto marut samedaskaḥ śāmyati| tathā kṣāramūtrayutān svedādīn kuryāt| tathā, karañjaphalasarṣapaiḥ prabhūtamūtrāloḍitairlimpet| athavā, mūlairarkādijaiḥ kṣaudrādiyutairlimpet| enaṃ-ūrustambhinaṃ, soḍhuṃ śakye vyāyāme ca kaphakṣayāya pravartayet| śakya iti "śakisahośca" iti yat| vyāyāmaṃ śanaiḥ kārayedityarthaḥ| tameva vyāyāmamāha-sthalānyullaṅghayet| nārīryathāśakti śīlayet| sthiratoyaṃ sarastaret| kṣemaṃ-grahādirahitam| tathā nadīṃ taret| katham ? pratisrotaḥ-srotobhimukham|

ab.seg: śleṣmamedaḥkṣaye cātra snehādīnavacārayet| sthānadūṣyādi cālocya kāryā śeṣeṣvapi kriyā||55||

div.ab: Sa. śleṣmamedaḥkṣaye satyasmin snehādīnavacārayet| śeṣeṣu ca vātarogeṣu sthānadūṣyādīnnirūpya cikitsitaṃ kāryam|

ab.seg: sahacaraṃ suradāruṃ sanāgaraṃ kvathitamambhasi tailavimiśritam| pavanapīḍitadehagatiḥ piban drutavilambitago bhavatīcchayā||56||

div.ab: Sa. sahacarādi kvathitaṃ tailayutaṃ piban mārutārditaśarīra icchayā drutagamano vilambitagamano vā bhavati| tantrakṛtā sumatinaitadvātasya vṛttasya nāmāpi śliṣṭaṃ kṛtvā vibaddham| drutavilambitākhyaṃ hyetadvṛttam| tasya ca lakṣaṇam (vṛ. ra. a. 3|49)- "drutavilambitamāha nabhau bharau|" iti|

ab.seg: rāsnāmahauṣadhadvīpippalīśaṭhipauṣkaram| piṣṭvā vipācayetsarpirvātarogaharaṃ param||57||

div.ab: Sa. rāsnādīn piṣṭvā sarpiḥ sāmānyaparibhāṣayā vipācayet| tacca suṣṭhu vātarogahṛt|

ab.seg: nimbāmṛtāvṛṣapaṭolanidigdhikānāṃ bhāgān pṛthak daśa palān vipaceddhaṭe'pām| aṣṭāṃśaśeṣitarasena punaśca tena prasthaṃ ghṛtasya vipacetpicubhāgakalkaiḥ||58||
pāṭhāviḍaṅgasuradārugajopakulyā- dvikṣāranāgaraniśāmiśicavyakuṣṭhaiḥ| tejovatīmaricavatsakadīpyakāgni- rohiṇyaruṣkaravacākaṇamūlayuktaiḥ||59||
mañjiṣṭhayā'tiviṣayā viṣayā yavānyā saṃśuddhaguggulupalairapi pañcasaṅkhyaiḥ| tatsevitaṃ vidhamati prabalaṃ samīraṃ sandhyasthimajjagatamapyatha kuṣṭhamīdṛk||60||
nāḍīvraṇārbudabhagandaragaṇḍamālā- jatrūrdhvasarvagadagulmagudotthamehān| yakṣmāruciśvasanapīnasakāsaśopha- hṛtpāṇḍurogamadavidradhivātaraktam||61||

div.ab: Sa. nimbādīnāṃ pṛthak pṛthak daśapalānambudroṇe pacet| tenāṣṭāṃśaśeṣeṇa kvāthena pāṭhādibhiryavānyantaiḥ kalkīkṛtaiḥ karṣāṃśaiḥ śreṣṭhaguggulupalaiśca pañcabhiḥ sarpiṣaḥ punaḥ prasthaṃ vipacet| tat-sarpiḥ, śīlitaṃ vāyumatibalaṃ sandhyādigatamapi parākaroti| kuṣṭhamapīdṛśaṃ(k)-sandhyādigataṃ, hanti| tathā, nāḍīvraṇādīn śamayati| vasantatilakāścatasraḥ|

ab.seg: balābilvaśṛte kṣīre ghṛtamaṇḍaṃ vipācayet| tasya śuktiḥ prakuñco vā nasyaṃ vāte śirogate||62||

div.ab: Sa. balābilvābhyāṃ kvathite kṣīre ghṛtamaṇḍaṃ vipācayet| tasya-ghṛtamaṇḍasya pakvasya, karṣadvayaṃ palaṃ vā nasyaṃ śirogate vāte prayoktavyam|

ab.seg: tadvatsiddhā vasā nakramatsyakūrmaculūkajā| viśeṣeṇa prayoktavyā kevale mātariśvani||63||

div.ab: Sa. tadvat-ghṛtamaṇḍavat, nakrādijā vasā kevale vāte viśeṣeṇa prayojyā|

ab.seg: jīrṇaṃ piṇyākaṃ pañcamūlaṃ pṛthak ca kvāthaṃ kvāthābhyāmekastailamābhyām| kṣīrādaṣṭāṃśaṃ pācayettena pānā- dvātā naśyeyuḥ śleṣmayuktā viśeṣāt||64||

div.ab: Sa. purāṇaṃ piṇyākaṃ pañcamūlaṃ ca pṛthak kvāthyam| kvāthābhyāmetābhyāṃ tailamekataḥ-ekasmin tailaṃ miśritaṃ, kṣīrādaṣṭāṃśaṃ pācayet| tena tailena vātā naśyanti, viśeṣeṇa kaphayuktāḥ| vaiśvadevī|

ab.seg: prasāriṇītulākvāthe tailaprasthaṃ payaḥsamam| dvimedāmiśimañjiṣṭhākuṣṭharāsnākucandanaiḥ||65||
jīvakarṣabhakākolīyugulāmaradārubhiḥ| kalkitairvipacetsarvamārutāmayanāśanam||66||

div.ab: Sa. prasāriṇītulākvāthe tailaprasthaṃ kṣīrasamaṃ dvimedādibhiḥ kalkitaiḥ sāmānyaparibhāṣayoktakalkapramāṇairvipacet| taccāśeṣavātarogaghnam|

ab.seg: samūlaśākhasya sahācarasya tulāṃ sametāṃ daśamūlataśca| palāni pañcāśadabhīrutaśca pādāvaśeṣaṃ vipacedvahe'pām||67||
tatra sevyanakhakuṣṭhahimailā- spṛkpriyaṅgunalikāmbuśilājaiḥ| lohitānaladalohasurāhvaiḥ kopanāmiśituruṣkanataiśca||68||
tulyakṣīraṃ pālikaistailapātraṃ siddhaṃ kṛcchrān śīlitaṃ hanti vātān| kampākṣepastambhaśoṣādiyuktān gulmonmādau pīnasaṃ yonirogān||69||

div.ab: Sa. sahācarasya mūlaśākhānvitasya tulāṃ sametāṃ daśamūlācca tulāṃ śatāvaryāḥ palāni pañcāśat jalasya caturdroṇe pādāvaśeṣaṃ vipacet| tasmin pādāvaśeṣe sevyādibhiḥ pālikaistailāḍhakaṃ tulyakṣīraṃ siddhaṃ śīlitaṃ kṛcchrān mārutān kampādiyutān gulmādīṃśca hanti| svāgatāśālinyau vṛtte|

sahācaratulāyāstu rase tailāḍhakaṃ pacet| mūlakalkāddaśapalaṃ payo dattvā caturguṇam||70|| athavā nataṣaḍgranthāsthirākuṣṭhasurāhvayāt| sailānaladaśaileyaśatāhvāraktacandanāt||71|| siddhe'smin śarkarācūrṇādaṣṭādaśapalaṃ kṣipet| bheḍasya sammataṃ tailaṃ tatkṛcchrānanilāmayān||72|| vātakuṇḍalikonmādagulmavardhmādikān jayet| ---------------------------------------------|73|

Sa. sahācaratulāyāḥ kvāthe tailāḍhakaṃ pacet| mūlakalkāddaśapalāni kṣīraṃ tailacaturguṇaṃ dadyādityevaṃ pākaḥ| athavā sahācaratulāyāḥ kvāthe natādibhiḥ siddhe'smin taile śarkarārajaso'ṣṭādaśapalāni kṣipet| etacca bheḍākhyasya maharṣeḥ sammataṃ dāruṇān vātarogān vātakuṇḍalikādīṃśca jayet|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| balāśataṃ chinnaruhāpādaṃ rāsnāṣṭabhāgikam||73||
jalāḍhakaśate paktvā śatabhāgasthite rase| dadhimastvikṣuniryāsaśuktaistailāḍhakaṃ samaiḥ||74||
pacetsājayordhāṃśaṃ kalkairebhiḥ palonmitaiḥ| śaṭhīsaraladārvelāmañiṣṭhāgurucandanaiḥ||75||
padmakātibalāmustāśūrpaparṇīhareṇubhiḥ| yaṣṭyāhvasurasavyāghranakharṣabhakajīvakaiḥ||76||
palāśarasakastūrīnalikājātikośakaiḥ| spṛkkākuṅkumaśaileyajātīkaṭuphalāmbubhiḥ||77||
tvakkundarukakarpūrataruṣkaśrīnivāsakaiḥ| lavaṅganakhakaṅkolakuṣṭhamāṃsīpriyaṅgubhiḥ||78||
sthauṇeyatagaradhyāmavacāmadanakaplavaiḥ| sanāgakesaraiḥ siddhe dadyāccātrāvatārite||79||
patrakalkaṃ tataḥ pūtaṃ vidhinā tatprayojitam| kāsaṃ śvāsaṃ jvaraṃ chardiṃ mūrcchāṃ gulmakṣatakṣayān||80||
plīhaśoṣāvapasmāramalakṣmīṃ ca praṇāśayet| balātailamidaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ vātavyādhivināśanam||81||

div.ab: Sa. balāyāḥ śataṃ, guḍūcyāḥ pañcaviṃśatipalāni, rāsnāyāḥ sārdhāni dvādaśapalāni, etacca jalāḍhakaśate paktvā''ḍhakamātrasthite kvāthe dadhyādibhistulyaistailāḍhakamajākṣīrasyārdhāḍhakaṃ śaṭhyādibhiḥ palonmitaiḥ pacet| kaṭuphalaṃ-laghukaṅkolakam| plavaḥ-kuṭannaṭaḥ| avatārite cāsmin patrakalkaṃ dadyāt| anantarametattailaṃ vidhinā prayojitaṃ kāsādīn hanti| etadbalātailaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ garbhavyāpaduktādbalātailāt| tathā vātarogaghnam|

ab.seg: pāne nasye'nvāsane'bhyañjane ca snehāḥ kāle samyagete prayuktāḥ| duṣṭān vātānāśu śāntiṃ nayeyu- rvandhyā nārīḥ putrabhājaśca kuryuḥ||82||

div.ab: Sa. ete-pūrvoktāḥ snehāḥ, pānādiṣu kāle-avasare, prayuktā duṣṭān vātān drāgeva śamayeyuḥ| vandhyāśca nārīḥ putrabhājo vidadhyuḥ| śālinīvṛttam|

snehasvedairdrutaḥ śleṣmā yadā pakvāśaye sthitaḥ| pittaṃ vā darśayedrūpaṃ bastibhistaṃ vinirjayet|83| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe cikitsitasthāne vātavyādhicikitsitaṃ nāma ekaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ|21|

Sa. snehasvedaiśca yadā kapho druto-dravatvaṃ prāptaḥ, pakvāśayastho rūpaṃ darśayet, athavā pittaṃ rūpaṃ darśayet, taṃ-kaphaṃ pittaṃ vā, bastibhirvinirjayet| iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayaṭīkāyāṃ sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ caturthe cikitsitasthāne vātavyādhicikitsitaṃ nāma ekaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 21||

div.head: vātaśoṇitacikitsitadhyāyaḥ
div.ab: Sa. asmādanantaraṃ vātaraktacikitsitamārabhyate| yato vātaśoṇitākhyo vyādhiḥ prāyo vātavyādhireva| śoṇitayuktena vāyunā kṛtatvādbahuvaktavyācca pṛthagasyopadeśaḥ, ityata āha-

ab.seg: athāto vātaśoṇitacikitsitaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre|2| ) vātaśoṇitino raktaṃ snigdhasya bahuśo haret| alpālpaṃ pālayan vāyuṃ yathādoṣaṃ yathābalam||1||

div.ab: Sa. vātaśoṇitino narasya snigdhasya sato bahūn vārān lohitamalpālpaṃ haredvātakopabhayāt| ata evāha,-pālayan vāyum, tathā yathādoṣaṃ-doṣānatikrameṇa, tathā balānatikrameṇa| yathādoṣamityupalakṣaṇārtham, dūṣyādyanatikrameṇāpi raktaṃ haret|
rugrāgatodadāheṣu jalaukobhirvinirharet| śṛṅgatumbaiścimicimākaṇḍūrugdūyanānvitam||2|| pracchānena sirābhirvā deśāddeśāntaraṃ vrajat| --------------------------------------------|3|
Sa. rugrāgādiṣu satsu jalaukobhī rudhiraṃ haret| cimicimādyanvitaṃ raktaṃ śṛṅgatumbairharet| deśāddeśāntaraṃ gacchadasṛk pracchānena sirayā vā haret|

ab.seg: --------------------------------------------| aṅgaglānau tu na srāvyaṃ rūkṣe vātottare ca yat||3||
gambhīraṃ śvayathuṃ stambhaṃ kampaṃ snāyusirāmayān| glānimanyāṃśca vātotthān kuryādvāyurasṛkṣayāt||4||

div.ab: Sa. aṅgaglānau tu satyāṃ na sādhyaṃ syāt| tathā rūkṣe vātottare ca yadraktaṃ tadapi na srāvyam| rūkṣe sati vātacikitsitaṃ seveta| nanu, kasmādraktasrāvo na vidhīyate ? ityāha-vāyurasṛkkṣayādgambhīraśophādīn kuryāt|
virecyaḥ snehayitvā tu snehayuktairvirecanaiḥ| --------------------------------------------|5|
Sa. virecanayogyaḥ puruṣaḥ snehayitvā virecanadravyeḥ snehayutairvirecanīyaḥ|

ab.seg: vātottare vātarakte purāṇaṃ pāyayedghṛtam| --------------------------------------------||5||

div.ab: Sa. vātottare vātarakte purāṇaṃ ghṛtaṃ pāyayet|

ab.seg: śrāvaṇīkṣīrakākolīkṣīriṇījīvakaiḥ samaiḥ| siddhaṃ sarṣabhakaiḥ sarpiḥ sakṣīraṃ vātaraktanut||6||

div.ab: Sa. śrāvaṇyādibhiḥ ṛṣabhayuktaiḥ kalkīkṛtaiḥ siddhaṃ ghṛtaṃ dugdhayuktaṃ vā vātaśoṇitahṛt|
drākṣāmadhūkavaribhyāṃ siddhaṃ vā sasitopalam| ghṛtaṃ pibettathā kṣīraṃ guḍūcīsvarase śṛtam||7|| tailaṃ payaḥ śarkarāṃ ca pāyayedvā sumūrcchitam| --------------------------------------------|8|
Sa. drākṣāmadhūkayoḥ kvāthe siddhaṃ vā ghṛtaṃ saśarkaraṃ pibet| kṣīraṃ ca guḍūcīsvarase kvathitaṃ pibet| tailādi vā sammiśritaṃ pāyayet|
--------------------------------------------| balāśatāvarīrāsnādaśamūlaiḥ sapīlubhiḥ||8|| śyāmairaṇḍasthirābhiśca vātārtighnaṃ śṛtaṃ payaḥ| --------------------------------------------|9|
Sa. balādibhiḥ śṛtaṃ payo vātarujānāśanaṃ syāt|

ab.seg: --------------------------------------------| dhāroṣṇaṃ mūtrayuktaṃ vā kṣīraṃ doṣānulomanam||9||

div.ab: Sa. dhāroṣṇaṃ kṣīraṃ gomūtrayuktaṃ vā doṣānulomanaṃ syāt|

ab.seg: paitte paktvā varītiktāpaṭolatriphalāmṛtāḥ| pibeddhṛtaṃ vā kṣīraṃ vā svādutiktakasādhitam||10||

div.ab: Sa. paitte-pittādhike vātaśoṇite, śatāvaryādīn paktvā pibet| svādutiktadravyaiḥ sādhitaṃ ghṛtaṃ kṣīraṃ vā pibet|

ab.seg: kṣīreṇairaṇḍatailaṃ ca prayogeṇa pibennaraḥ| bahudoṣo virekārthe jīrṇe kṣīraudanāśanaḥ||11||

div.ab: Sa. bahudoṣo naro virekārthameraṇḍatailaṃ kṣīreṇa pibet| jīrṇe tasmin kṣīraudanāśī syāt|

ab.seg: kaṣāyamabhayānāṃ vā pāyayeddhṛtabharjitam| kṣīrānupānaṃ trivṛtācūrṇe drākṣārasena vā||12||

div.ab: Sa. athavā, harītakīnāṃ kvāthaṃ ghṛtabharjitaṃ pāyayet| trivṛtāmūlacūrṇaṃ kṣīrānupānaṃ drākṣārasena vā pāyayet|
nirharedvā malaṃ tasya saghṛtaiḥ kṣīrabastibhiḥ| na hi bastisamaṃ kiñcidvātaraktacikitsitam||13|| viśeṣātpyupārśvoruparvāsthijaṭharārtiṣu| --------------------------------------------|14|
Sa. athavā tasya-vātaraktavato, malaṃ kṣīrabastibhirghṛtānvitairnirharet| yasmādbastitulyaṃ nānyadvātaraktacikitsitamasti| viśeṣeṇa pāthvādipīḍāsu bastirhitaḥ|
--------------------------------------------| mustādhātrīharidrāṇāṃ pibetkvāthaṃ kapholbaṇe||14|| sakṣaudraṃ triphalāyā vā guḍūcīṃ vā yathātathā| --------------------------------------------|15|
Sa. mustādīnāṃ kvāthaṃ mākṣikānvitaṃ kaphottare vātaśoṇite pibet| triphalāyāḥ kvāthaṃ vā samākṣikaṃ pibet| sarveṇa prakāreṇa guḍūcīṃ vā pibet|

--------------------------------------------| yathārhasnehapītaṃ ca vāmitaṃ mṛdu rūkṣayet||15|| triphalāvyoṣapatrailātvakkṣīrīcitrakaṃ vacām| viḍaṅgam ṃ pippalīmūlaṃ lomaśāṃ vṛṣakaṃ tvacam||16|| ṛddhiṃ lāṅgalikīṃ cavyaṃ samabhāgāni peṣayet| kalye liptvā''yasīṃ pātrīṃ madhyāhne bhakṣayedidam||17|| vātāsre sarvadoṣe'pi paraṃ śūlānvite hitam| --------------------------------------------|18|

Sa. yo yasyārhaḥ snehastaṃ pītavantaṃ kṛtavamanaṃ ca mṛdu kṛtvā rūkṣayet| triphalādīni samāṃśāni jalena peṣayet| piṣṭvā ca prabhāte lauhīṃ pātrīṃ liptvā madhyāhna idaṃ bhakṣayet| etacca vātarakte sarvadoṣe'pi paraṃ śūlānvite hitam|
--------------------------------------------| kokilākṣakaniryūhaḥ pītastacchākabhojinā||18|| kṛpābhyāsa iva krodhaṃ vātaraktaṃ niyacchati| --------------------------------------------|19|
Sa. kokilākṣabhojinā kokilākṣakakvāthaḥ pīto vātaraktaṃ śamayati| kṛpābhyāsaḥ krodhaṃ yathā|
--------------------------------------------| pañcamūlasya dhātryā vā rasairlelītakīṃ vasām||19|| khuḍaṃ surūḍhamapyaṅge brahmacārī piban jayet| --------------------------------------------|20|
Sa. pañcamūlasya rasairāmalakarasairvā lelītakīṃ vasāṃ brahmacārī piban śarīre khuḍaṃ susthirībhūtamapi jayet|

ab.seg: --------------------------------------------| ityābhyantaramuddiṣṭaṃ karmabāhyamataḥ param||20||

div.ab: Sa. iti-evaṃ, abhyantaraṃ karma-cikitsitamuktam| ataḥ paraṃ bāhyaṃ karmocyate|

ab.seg: āranālāḍhake tailaṃ pādasarjarasaṃ śṛtam| prabhūte khajitaṃ toye jvaradāhārtinutparam||21||

div.ab: Sa. kāñjikasyāḍhake tailaṃ caturthabhāgasarjarasaṃ pakvaṃ prabhūte jale mathitaṃ paraṃ jvaradāhārtinut|

ab.seg: samadhūcchiṣṭamañjiṣṭhaṃ sasarjarasasārivam| piṇḍatailaṃ tadabhyaṅgādvātaraktarujāpaham||22||

div.ab: Sa. pūrvoktaṃ tailaṃ pakvaṃ saha madhūcchiṣṭamañjiṣṭhāsarjarasasārivābhirāvāparūpābhirvartate yattadevabhūtaṃ satpiṇḍatailamucyate| taccābhyaṅgādvātaraktarujāharam|

ab.seg: daśamūlaśṛtaṃ kṣīraṃ sadyaḥ śūlanivāraṇam| pariṣeko'nilaprāye tadvatkoṣṇena sarpiṣā||23||

div.ab: Sa. daśamūlena kṣīraṃ siddhaṃ śīghrameva śūlahṛt, pariṣekeṇetyarthādavagamyate| ata evāha-pariṣeko'nilaprāye| tatheva koṣṇena sarpiṣā-ghṛtena, hitaḥ|

ab.seg: snehairmadhurasiddhairvā caturbhiḥ pariṣecayet| stambhākṣepakaśūkārtaṃ koṣṇairdāhe tu śītalaiḥ||24||

div.ab: Sa. athavā stambhādibhirārtaṃ naraṃ caturbhirmadhuradravyasādhitaiḥ snehaiḥ koṣṇaiḥ pariṣecayet| dāhe punastaireva śītaiḥ pariṣecayet|
tadvadgavyāvikacchāgaiḥ kṣīraistailavimiśritaiḥ| --------------------------------------------|25|
Sa. athavā, gavyāvikacchāgaiḥ kṣīraistailavimiśritaiḥ koṣṇaiḥ stambhākṣepakaśūlārtaṃ tadvat-prāgvat, pariṣecayet| dāhe punaretaireva kṣītaiḥ pariṣecayet|

ab.seg: --------------------------------------------| niḥkvāthairjīvanīyānāṃ pañcamūlasya vā laghoḥ||25||

div.ab: Sa. jīvanīyānāṃ dravyāṇāṃ niḥkvāthairlaghorvā pañcamūlasya kvāthaiḥ koṣṇaiḥ stambhādyārtaṃ pariṣecayet| dāhe tu śītalaiḥ|

ab.seg: drākṣekṣurasamadyāni dadhimastvamlakāñjikam| sekārthaṃ taṇḍulakṣaudraśarkarāmbhaśca śasyate||26||

div.ab: Sa. dāhe drākṣārasa ikṣurasa madyāni dadhimastvamlakāñjikaṃ sekārthaṃ śasyate| tathā, taṇḍulāmbhaḥ kṣaudrāmbhaḥ śarkarāmbhaśca sekārthaṃ śasyate|

ab.seg: priyāḥ priyaṃvadā nāryaścandamārdrakarastanāḥ| sparśaśītāh sukhasparśā ghnanti dāhaṃ rujaṃ klamam||27||

div.ab: Sa. nāryaḥ priyāḥ-vallabhāḥ, priyavacasaścandanonārdrāḥ karāḥ stanāśca yāsāṃ tāṃ evaṃvidhāḥ sparśena śītāḥ sukhasparśāśc dāhaṃ [ rujaṃ ] klamaṃ ca ghnanti|

ab.seg: sarāge saruje dāhe raktaṃ hṛtvā pralepayet| prapauṇḍarīkamañjiṣṭhādārvīmadhukacandanaiḥ||28||
sitopalairakāsaktumasūrośīrapadmakaiḥ| lepo rugdāhavīsarparāgaśophanibarhaṇaḥ||29||

div.ab: Sa. dāhe sarāge sati raktaṃ hṛtvā prapauṇḍarīkādibhirlepaḥ kāryaḥ| sa ca lepo rugdāhādinibarhaṇaḥ| dārvī-dāruharidrā| madhukaṃ-yaṣṭīmadhu| sitopalā-śarkarā| erakāsaktuḥ-erakābījasaktuḥ|

ab.seg: vātaghnaiḥ sādhitaḥ snigdhaḥ kṛśaro mudgapāyasaḥ| tilasarṣapapiṇḍaiśca śūlaghnamupanāhanam||30||

div.ab: Sa. kṛśaraḥ-tilamudgādikṛto, vātaghnaiḥ sādhito mudrapāyaso-mudrakṣīre yo miśritaḥ, tilasarṣapapiṇḍaiścaitadupanāhanaṃ śūlaghnam|

ab.seg: audakaprasahānūpavesavārāḥ susaṃskṛtāḥ| jīvanīyauṣadhaiḥ snehayuktāḥ syurupanāhane||31||
stambhatodarugāyāmaśophāṅgagrahanāśanāḥ| jīvanīyauṣadhaiḥ siddhā sapayaskā vasā'pi vā||32||

div.ab: Sa. audakādyā jīvanīyauṣadhaiḥ sādhitāḥ snehayuktāḥ susaṃskṛtā upanāhena stambhādināśanāḥ syuḥ| athavā, audakādīnāṃ vasā jīvanīyauṣadhaiḥ siddhā sapayaskā stambhādināśanā syāt|

ab.seg: ghṛtaṃ sahacarānmūlaṃ jīvantī chāgalaṃ payaḥ| lepaḥ piṣṭāstilāstadvadbhṛṣṭāḥ payasi nivṛtāḥ||33||

div.ab: Sa. sahacarajīvantīmūlakalko ghṛtacchāgapayomiśro lepa upayogī bhavati| piṣṭāstilā bhṛṣṭāḥ-bhajitāḥ, payasi-kṣīre, nivṛtāḥ-prakṣiptāḥ, tadvat-prāgvat pralepe yojyāḥ|

ab.seg: kṣārapriṣṭakṣumāṃ lepameraṇḍasya phalāni vā| kughārcchūlanivṛttyarthaṃ śatāhvāṃ vā'nile'dhike||34||

div.ab: Sa. kṣumāṃ-atasīṃ, kṣīreṇa piṣṭāmadhike'nile śūlanivṛtyarthaṃ lepaṃ kuryāt| yadvā, eraṇḍasya phalāni kṣīrapiṣṭāni śūlanivṛttyarthaṃ lepaṃ kuryāt| yadvā, śatapuṣpāṃ kṣīre piṣṭvā śūlanivṛttyarthaṃ lepaṃ kuryāt|
mūtrakṣārasurāpakvaṃ ghṛtamabhyañjane hitam| --------------------------------------------|35|
Sa. mūtrādibhiḥ siddhaṃ ghṛtamadhike'nile'bhyañjane hitam|

ab.seg: Sa. śuktaṃ-cukraṃ, siddhaṃ samākṣikaṃ seke pariṣeke'bhyaṅge ca hitam||36||

div.ab: --------------------------------------------| ----------------------------kaphottare||35|| gṛhadhūmo vacā kuṣṭhaṃ śatāhvā rajanīdvayam| pralepaḥ śūlanudvātarakte----------------|36|
Sa. kaphottare vātarakte gṛhadhūmādipralepo hito bhavati| śatāhvā-śatapuṣpā| rajanīdvayaṃ-haridre dve|
Sa. vātakaphottare vātarakte madhuśigrorbījaṃ kāñjikasaṃyuktaṃ tadvat-pralepe hitam|

ab.seg: --------------------------------------------| muhūrtaliptamamlaiśca siñcedvātakaphottare||37||

div.ab: Sa. vātakaphottare vātarakte muhūrtaliptamarthādeva kāñjikapiṣṭamadhuśigrubījena liptamamlaiḥ-śuktādibhiḥ, siñcet|
uttānaṃ lepanābhyaṅgapariṣekāvagāhanaiḥ| --------------------------------------------|38|
Sa. uttānaṃ vātaraktaṃ lepādibhirācaret-cikitset|

ab.seg: --------------------------------------------| virekāsthāpanasnehapānairgambhīramācaret||38||

div.ab: Sa. gambhīraṃ vātaśoṇitaṃ virekādibhirācaret|

ab.seg: vātaśleṣmottare koṣṇā lepadyāstatra śītalaiḥ| vidāhaśopharukkaṇḍūvivṛddhiḥ stambhanādbhavet||39||

div.ab: Sa. vātaśleṣmottara uttāne vātaśoṇite lepādyāḥ koṣṇā hitāḥ| tatra-tasmin vātaśleṣmottare, śītalairlepanaiḥ stambhanāt vidāhādīnāṃ vivṛdbhirbhavati|

ab.seg: pittaraktottare vātarakte lepādayo himāḥ| uṣṇaiḥ ploṣoṣarugrāgasvedāvadaraṇodbhavaḥ||40||

div.ab: Sa. vātarakte pittaraktottare himāḥ śītā lepādayo hitāḥ| tatra pittaraktottare vātarakta uṣṇairlepaiḥ pleṣādayo bhavanti|

ab.seg: madhuyaṣṭyāḥ palaśataṃ kaṣāye pādaśeṣite| tailāḍhakaṃ samakṣīraṃ pacetkalkaiḥ palonmitaiḥ||41||
sthirātāmalakīdūrvāpayasyābhīrucandanaiḥ| lohahaṃsapadīmāṃsīdvimedāmadhuparṇibhiḥ||42||
kākolīkṣīrakākolīśatapuṣparddhipadmakaiḥ| jīvakarṣabhajīvantītvak''patranakhavālakaiḥ||43||
prapauṇḍarīkamañjiṣṭhāsārivaindrīvitunnakaiḥ| catuṣprayogaṃ vātasṛk''pittadāhajvarārtinut||44||

div.ab: Sa. madhuyaṣṭyāḥ palaśataṃ kvāthakalpanayā kvathitaṃ tasminkaṣāye pādaśeṣite caturbhāgāvaśiṣṭe tailasyāḍhakaṃ samakṣīramāḍhakapramāṇena kṣīreṇa tulyaṃ sthirādibhiḥ palonmitaiḥ kalkīkṛtairyuktaṃ pacet| tattailaṃ catuṣprayogaṃ-pāne nasye'nuvāsane bastau ca yojitaṃ, vātāsṛgādīnāmartinudbhavet| sthirā-śāliparṇī| tāmalakī-bhūdhātrī| payasyā-arkapuṣpī| abhīruḥ-śatāvarī| lohaṃ-agaru| haṃsapadī-kīṭamārī| madhuparṇī-guḍūcī| aindrī-viśālā| vitunnakaṃ-paripelavam|

ab.seg: balākaṣāyakalkābhyāṃ tailaṃ kṣīrasamaṃ pacet| sahasraśatapākaṃ tadvātāsṛgvātaroganut||45||
rasāyanaṃ mukhyatamamindriyāṇāṃ prasādanam| jīvanaṃ bṛhaṇaṃ svaryaṃ śukrāsṛgdoṣanāśanam||46||

div.ab: Sa. balākaṣāyeṇa kalkena ca tailaṃ kṣīreṇa samaṃ tulyaṃ pacet| tat-tailaṃ, sahasrapākaṃ śatapākaṃ vā vātaśoṇitavātarogaharam| tathā, mukhyatamaṃ-śreṣṭham, tadrasāyanamindriyāṇāṃ-cakṣurādīnāṃ, prasādanaṃ-prasādajanakam| jīvanaṃ-prāṇadhāraṇam| bṛṃhaṇaṃ-upacayakaram| svaryaṃ-svarakaram| śukrāsṛgdoṣāṇāṃ nāśanam|

ab.seg: kupite mārgasaṃrodhānmedaso vā kaphasya vā| ativṛddhyā'nile śastaṃ nādau snehanabṛṃhaṇam||47||
kṛtvā tatrāḍhyavātoktaṃ vātaśoṇitikaṃ tataḥ| bheṣajaṃ snehanaṃ kuryādyacca raktaprasādanam||48||

div.ab: Sa. anile-vāte, medaso'tivṛddhyā kaphasya vā'tivṛddhyā mārgasaṃrodhāt kāraṇāt kupite snehanabṛṃhaṇamauṣadhamādau na śastam| tatra-medasāvṛte kaphāvṛte vā vāte, āḍhyavātoktaṃ yaccikitsitamuktaṃ tatkāryam| tataḥ-anantaraṃ, vātaśoṇitikaṃ snehanaṃ bheṣajaṃ kuryāt| yaccāpi raktasya prasādanaṃ tadapi kuryāt| vātaśoṇitacikitsitamuktvā prāṇādicikitsāmāha-

ab.seg: prāṇādikope yugapadyathoddiṣṭaṃ yathāmayam| yathāsannaṃ ca bhaiṣajyaṃ vikalpyaṃ syādyathābalam||49||

div.ab: Sa. prāṇādīnāṃ pañcānāṃ yugapat-tulyakālaṃ kope, yathoddiṣṭaṃ-yathoktavātavyādhicikitsānatikrameṇa, yathāmayaṃ-prāṇādikopajanitarogādyapekṣayā, yathāsannaṃ-prāṇādīnāmanyatamamāsannamanatikramya, yasminneva roge ya eva prāṇādīnāmanyatama āsannastameva cikitset| yathābalaṃ-balānatikrameṇa, prāṇādīnāmanyatamasya balinaḥ pūrvapratīkāraṃ kuryāt| ityevamatra bhaiṣajyaṃ-auṣadhaṃ, vikalpyaṃ-vikalpanīyaṃ, syāt-bhavet|

ab.seg: nīte nirāmatāṃ sāme svedalaṅghanapācanaiḥ| rūkṣaiścālepasekādyaiḥ kuryātkevalavātanut||50||

div.ab: Sa. sāme vāte svedādibhistathā rūkṣaiḥ sekalepādibhirnirāmatāṃ nīte paścāt kevalavātanut-śuddhavātacikitsitaṃ, kuryāt|

śoṣākṣepaṇasaṅkocastambhasvapanakampanam| hanusraṃso'rditaṃ khāñjyaṃ pāṅgulyaṃ khuḍavātatā||51|| sandhicyutiḥ pakṣavadho medomajjāsthigā gadāḥ| ete sthānasya gāmbhīryātsidhyeyuryatnato navāḥ||52|| tasmājjayennavānetān balino nirupadravān| --------------------------------------------|53|

Sa. śoṣaḥ-aṅgaśoṣaḥ| ākṣepaṇaṃ-āyāmaḥ| saṅkocaḥ-aṅgāvayavānām| stambho-daṇḍavat stabdhatā| svapanaṃ-acaitanyam| kampanaṃ-vepathuḥ| hanusraṃso-hanubhraṃśaḥ| ardittaṃ-vāyunā vakrīkṛtaṃ vakrārdham| khāñjyaṃ-khañjatā| pāṅgulyaṃ-paṅgutā| khuḍavāto-vātaśoṇitam| sandhicyutiḥ-sthānādbhraṃśaḥ| pakṣavadhaḥ-pakṣāghātaḥ| tathā, ye gadāḥ-rogāḥ, medaādisthānasthā bhavanti ta ete sthānasya gāmbhīryabhāvena jātā navāḥ-acirakālotpannāḥ, yatnataḥ sidhyeyuḥ, balinaḥ puṃsaḥ| tasmādetān śoṣādīn nirupadravān [ navān- ] śīghrajanmano, jayet-cikitset|

ab.seg: --------------------------------------------| vāyau pittāvṛte śītāmuṣṇāṃ ca bahuśaḥ kriyām||53||
vyatyāsādyojayetsarpirjīvanīyaṃ ca pāyayet| dhanvamāṃsaṃ yavāḥ śālirvirekaḥ kṣīravān mṛduḥ||54||

div.ab: Sa. vāyau pittāvṛte vyatyāsāt-paryāyeṇa, śītāmuṣṇāṃ ca kriyāṃ baḥuśaḥ-śataśo, yojayet| tathā, jīvanīyaṃ sarpistamāturaṃ pāyayet| atra ca pittāvṛte vāyau dhanvamāṃsaṃ-jāṅgalaṃ piśitaṃ, yojyam| yavāḥ śālayaśca, tathā kṣīravān-kṣīrayukto, mṛdurvireko yojyaḥ|

ab.seg: sakṣīrā bastayaḥ kṣīraṃ pañcamūlabalāśṛtam| kāle'nuvāsanaṃ tailairmadhurauṣadhasādhitaiḥ||55||

div.ab: Sa. atrāpi pittāvṛte vāyau bastayaḥ sakṣīrā yojyāḥ| pañcamūlaṃ-mahat, tena balāsahitena śṛtaṃ kṣīraṃ prayoktavyam| kāle-yathāvasaramanuvāsanayogye, madhurauṣadhasādhitaistailairanuvāsanaṃ deyam|

ab.seg: yaṣṭīmadhubalātailaghṛtakṣīraiśca secanam| pañcamūlakaṣāyeṇa vāriṇā śītalena vā||56||

div.ab: Sa. madhuyaṣṭitailena balātailena ghṛtena kṣīreṇa ca secanaṃ hitam| pañcamūlasya kaṣāyeṇa-kvāthena, vā śītalena vāriṇā pittāvṛte vāte secanaṃ yojyam|
kaphāvṛte yavānnāni jāṅgalā mṛgapakṣiṇaḥ| svedāstīkṣṇā nirūhāśca vamanaṃ savirecanam||57|| purāṇasarpistailaṃ ca tilasarṣapajaṃ hitam| --------------------------------------------|58|
Sa. kaphāvṛte yavānnāni hitāni| jāṅgalā mṛgāḥ pakṣiṇaśca tathā svedā hitāḥ| tīkṣṇā nirūhāḥ-āsthāpanaviśeṣāśca| tīkṣṇaṃ vamanaṃ savirecanaṃ hitam| purāṇaṃ ca sarpiḥ, tilasarṣapajaṃ ca tailaṃ hitam|

ab.seg: --------------------------------------------| saṃsṛṣṭe kaphapittābhyāṃ pittamādau vinirjayet||58||

div.ab: Sa. kaphapittābhyāṃ dvābhyāṃ saṃsṛṣṭe vāta ādāveva pittaṃ vinirharet| paścāt kaphaṃ vātayuktaṃ jayet|
kārayedraktasaṃsṛṣṭe vātaśoṇitikīṃ kriyām| --------------------------------------------|59|
Sa. raktasaṃsṛṣṭe vāte vātaśoṇitikīṃ kriyāṃ kārayet|

ab.seg: --------------------------------------------| svedābhyaṅgarasāḥ kṣīraṃ sneho māṃsāvṛte hitam||59||

div.ab: Sa. māṃsāvṛte svedābhyaṅgamāṃsarasāḥ kṣīraṃ snehaśca yathāyogametaddhitam|

ab.seg: pramehamedovātaghnamāḍhyavāte bhiṣagjitam| mahāsneho'sthimajjasthe pūrvoktaṃ retasā''vṛte||60||

div.ab: Sa. āḍhyavāte-medasā''vṛte vāyau, pramehanaṃ medoghnaṃ vātaghnaṃ ca bhiṣagjitaṃ-auṣadhaṃ, hitam| asthimajjasthe vāte mahasneho-ghṛtamajjāvasātailaiḥ siddho, yadvā nārāyaṇādirhitaḥ| retasā''vṛte pūrvoktaṃ-vātavyādhau śukrastavātoktaṃ (hṛ. ci. a. 21|20) , hitam|
annāvṛte pācanīyaṃ vamanaṃ dīpanaṃ laghu| --------------------------------------------|61|
Sa. annenāvṛte pācanīyamauṣadhaṃ vamanaṃ hitam| dīpanīyaṃ-āgneyaṃ, yadauṣadhaṃ laghu ca-prakṛtyā, tatsarvaṃ hitam|
--------------------------------------------| mūtrāvṛte mūtralāni svedāścottarabastayaḥ|61|
Sa. mūtreṇāvṛte vāte mūtralāni-trapusādīni, svedāścottarabastayoḥ hitāḥ|

ab.seg: eraṇḍatailaṃ varcaḥsthe bastisnehāśca medinaḥ| --------------------------------------------||61||

div.ab: Sa. varcasā''vṛte vāta eraṇḍatailaṃ bastayaśca snehāśca medino hitāḥ|

-------------------------------------------| kaphapittāviruddhaṃ yadyaśca vātānulomanam||62|| sarvasthānāvṛte'pyāśu tatkāryaṃ mātariśvani| anabhiṣyandi ca snigdhaṃ srotasāṃ śuddhikāraṇam||63|| yāpanā bastayaḥ prāyo madhurāḥ sānuvāsanāḥ| prasamīkṣya balādhikyaṃ mṛdu kāryaṃ virecanam||64|| rasāyanānāṃ sarveṣāmupayogaḥ praśasyate| śilāhvasya viśeṣeṇa payasā śuddhagugguloḥ||65|| leho vā bhārgavastadvadekādaśasitāśitaḥ| -------------------------------------------|66|

Sa. sarvasthānāvṛte mātariśvani-vāyau, āśu-śīghrameva, yadauṣadhaṃ kaphapittayoraviruddhaṃ vātasya cānulomanaṃ tatkāryam|tasmin sarvadhātvāvṛte mātariśvani yadanabhiṣyandi snigdhaṃ srotasāṃ yacchuddhikaraṃ tatsarvamannapānauṣadhaṃ yojyam| yāpanasaṃjñā bastayo bāhulyena madhurāḥ sānuvāsanāḥ-snehabastayaśca, hitāḥ| balasyādhikyaṃ prasamīkṣya-buddhvā, mṛdu virecanaṃ hitam| sarveṣāṃ rasāyanaprayogāṇāmupayogaḥ praśasyate| tathā śuddhasya gugguloḥ prayogaḥ, bhārgavo leho-brāhmarasāyanoktaścyavanaprāśo vā, tadvadekādaśasitāśito-brāhmarasāyanoktaḥ (?), praśasyate|
--------------------------------------------| apāne tvāvṛte sarvaṃ dīpanaṃ grāhi bheṣajam||66|| vātānulomanaṃ kāryaṃ mūtrāśayaviśodhanam| --------------------------------------------|67|
Sa. apāne vāyau yenakenacidāvṛte sarvaṃ bheṣajaṃ dīpanaṃ-agneḥ, grāhi-saṅgrahaṇaṃ, vātasyānulomanaṃ mūtrāśayasya-basteḥ, viśodhanaṃ tatsarvaṃ kāryam|
--------------------------------------------| iti saṅkṣepataḥ praoktamāvṛtānāṃ cikitsitam||67|| prāṇādīnāṃ bhiṣakkuryādvitarkya svayameva tat| --------------------------------------------|68|
Sa. iti-anantaroktena prakāreṇa, āvṛtānāṃ saṅkṣepataścikitsitaṃ-auṣadhaṃ, proktam| yat prāṇādīnāṃ pañcānāmāvṛtānāṃ cikitsitaṃ tat-pūrvoktaṃ, bhiṣak svayameva vitarkya-vicārya, kuryāt|

--------------------------------------------| udānaṃ yojayedūrdhvamapānaṃ cānulomayet||68|| samānaṃ śamayedvidvāṃstridhā vyānaṃ tu yojayet| prāṇo rakṣyaścaturbhyo'pi tatsthitau dehasaṃsthitiḥ||69|| svaṃ svaṃ sthānaṃ nayedevaṃ vṛtān vātān vimārgagān| --------------------------------------------|70|

Sa. udānākhyaṃ vāyumūrdhvameva yojayet-yato'sau sadaivordhvagāmī, tathā prayateta yathordhvagāmī bhavati| apānākhyaṃ cānilamanulomayet-adhogatirhyayaṃ sadaiva samīraṇastasmādadhogamanaṃ yathā'sya sampadyeta tathā cikitsitaṃ kāryamityarthaḥ| samānākhyaṃ vāyuṃ vidvān vaidyo vātaghnairauṣadhaiḥ śamayet| ayamabhiprāyo granthakṛtaḥ-kila nāsyordhvagāmitā naivādhogāmitā yathā sampadyate tathā cikitsitaṃ hitam, kiṃ tarhi svasthānapratipattirevetyevaṃ cikitsā kāryeti| vyānākhyaṃ tu vāyuṃ tridhā yojayet-ūrdhvādhomadhyagamanaṃ yathā'sya śarīre sampadyate tathā cikitsā kāryeti| tathā, prāṇo vāyuścaturbhyo'pi-udānāpānasamānavyānebhyo'pi, sarvaprayatnena rakṣyaḥ-ythodānādibhirnāsya bādhā sampadyate tathā cikitsā kāryetyarthaḥ| yatastasya-prāṇasya, sthitau satyāṃ dehasya-śarīrasya, saṃsthitiḥ-jīvanaṃ bhavati, prāṇaṃ vinā na jīvatītyathaḥ| evaṃ-anena prakāreṇa, vātān vimārgagānāvṛtān svaṃ svaṃ sthānaṃ nayet|
--------------------------------------------| sarvaṃ cāvaraṇaṃ pittaraktasaṃsargavarjitam||70|| rasāyanavidhānena laśuno hanti śīlitaḥ| --------------------------------------------|71|
Sa. sarvamevāvaraṇaṃ vātānāṃ pittaraktasaṃsargavarjitaṃ rasāyanavidhinā śīlito laśuno hanti| etena pittaraktasaṃsṛṣṭamāvaraṇaṃ varjayitvā sarvāvaraṇānyanyāni laśunaḥ kevala eva nihanti|

ab.seg: --------------------------------------------| pittāvṛte pittaharaṃ marutaścānulomanam||71||

div.ab: Sa. pittāvṛta udānādau pittaharaṃ pavanasya cānulomanaṃ hitam|

ab.seg: raktāvṛte'pi tadvacca khuḍoktaṃ yacca bheṣajam| raktapittānilaharaṃ vividhaṃ ca rasāyanam||72||

div.ab: Sa. raktāvṛte tadvat-pittaharaṃ tathaiva mārutānulomanaṃ, hitam| yacca khuḍoktaṃ-vātaśoṇitoktaṃ, bheṣajaṃ tathā pittaraktānilaharaṃ ca hitam, vividhaṃ rasāyanaṃ ca| vividhaṃ-nānāprakāraṃ, sarvadoṣadūṣyādikaṃ cālokya yathāyogaṃ vidheyam|

ab.seg: yathānidānaṃ nirdiṣṭamiti samyak cikitsitam| āyurvedaphalaṃ sthānametatsadyo'rtināśanāt||73||

div.ab: Sa. iti-anena prakāreṇa, yathānidānaṃ-nidānānatikrameṇa, yathoddeśastathā nirdeśaḥ| anayā rītyā sarvameva cikitsitaṃ nirdiṣṭam| etaccāyurvedaphalabhūtaṃ sthānam, etadupadeśena sadyo'rtināśanāddhetoḥ|

cikitsitaṃ hitaṃ pathyaṃ prāyaścittaṃ bhiṣagjitam| bheṣajaṃ śamanaṃ śastaṃ paryāyaiḥ smṛtamauṣadham|74| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe cikitsitasthāne vātaśoṇitacikitsitaṃ nāma dvāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ|22|

Sa. cikitsitādaya auṣadhasya paryāyāḥ smṛtā iti| iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayaṭīkāyāṃ sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ caturthe cikitsitasthāne vātaśoṇitacikitsitaṃ nāma dvāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 22||

div.head: vamanakalpādhyāyah
div.ab: Sa. śreegaṇeśāya namaḥ| cikitsitasthānādantaraṃ kalpasthānamārabhyate cikitsitasthānasya kalpasthānāpekṣatvāt| tathā hi prāgadhyageeṣṭa (hṛ. ci. a. 1/8) - "tarpaṇena rasenekṣormadyaiḥ kalpoditāni vā| vamanāni prayujyeta" iti| tadevamādyupadeśāt sapekṣatvamasya| tasmāt kalpasthānamucyata ityāha --

ab.seg: tasmāt kalpasthānamucyata ityāha ---- athāto vamanakalpaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre)||2||

div.ab: Sa. vamanaṃ-ūrdhvaṃ mukhena doṣaharaṇam , tasya kalpa:-kalpanaṃ yojanamityartha:| śeṣamāyuṣkāmīyādhyāyavadvyākhyeyam|

Ā. rā. śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ| atha kalpasthānārambhaḥ| vamanakalpaṃ vyākhyātuṃ pratijānīte-atheti| atha vamanakalpaḥ| tatra saṅgrahe (ka. a. 1)-"vamandravyāṇāṃ madanaphalajīmūtakekṣvākudvikośātakīkuṭajaphalāni śreṣṭhāni| teṣvapi madanaphalam| doṣadūṣyādivaśāccaiṣāmetatkalpanānāṃ ca prādhānyam| doṣādīnāmeva cātibahvavasthābhedādvamanādiṣu kalpanānāṃ vyāpadāṃ sādhanānāṃ ca yadasaṅkhyeyatvaṃ, ato buddhimatāṃ vikalpamārgadarśanārthamudāharaṇamātraṃ kalpasiddhisthānamupadekṣyate|" iti|

ab.seg: prādhānyācca vamanakalpe madanameva śasyata ityāha ---- atha madanakalpaḥ| vamane madanaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ, trivṛnmūlaṃ virecane| nityamanyasya tu vyādhiviśeṣeṇa viśiṣṭatā||1||
