-------------------------------------------------| vacāmṛtāśaṭhīpathyāśaṅkhinīvellanāgaraiḥ||46|| apāmārgeṇa ca ghrutaṃ sādhitaṃ pūrvavadguṇaiḥ| -------------------------------------------------|47|
Sa. vacādibhiḥ sādhitaṃ ghṛtaṃ pūrveṇa samānam|

-------------------------------------------------| hema śvetavacā kuṣṭhamarkapuṣpī sakāñcanā||47|| hema matsyākṣakaḥ śaṅkhaḥ kaiḍaryaḥ kanakaṃ vacā| catvāra ete pādoktāḥ prāśā madhughṛtaplutāḥ||48|| varṣaṃ līḍhā vapurmedhābalavarṇakarāḥ śubhāḥ| -------------------------------------------------|49|
Sa. hemādiślokoktāḥ pādikāścatvāro yogā madhughṛtābhyāṃ sadravā varṣaṃ līḍhā vapurādikṛtaḥ śubhāśca|

-------------------------------------------------| vacāyaṣṭyāhvasindhūtthapathyānāgaradīpyakaiḥ|49| śudhdyate vāgghavirlīḍhaiḥ sakuṣṭhakaṇajīrakaiḥ| 49 1/2| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitā- yāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne bālo- pacaraṇīyo nāma prathamo'dhyāyaḥ|1|

ab.seg: Sa. vacādibhiḥ sarpirlīḍhairvāk śasyate| śudhyata iti cintyam, "karmavatkarmakartā" ityasya tvaviṣayaḥ| iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdaya- ṭīkāyāṃ |sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne bālopa- caraṇīyo nāma prathamo'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ||1||

div.head: bālāmayapratiśedhādhyāyaḥ
div.ab: athāto bālāmayapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| gadyasūtre|2| trividhaḥ kathito bālaḥ kṣīrānnobhayavartanaḥ| svāsthyaṃ tābhyāmaduṣṭābhyāṃ duṣṭābhyāṃ rogasambhavaḥ|1|

Sa. asmādanantaraṃ bālasyopacaryamāṇasya ye rogāstaccikitsārtho bālāmayapratiṣedha ucyate- bālastriprakāraḥ kathito munibhiḥ| kṣīravartano'nnavartana ubhayavartanaḥ-kṣīrānnābhyāṃ yo vartate| tābhyāṃ-annakṣīrābhyāṃ, aduṣṭābhyāṃ svāsthyaṃ bhavati| duṣṭābhyāṃ tu kṣīrānnābhyāṃ rogodbhūtiḥ| śuddhaṃ kṣīraṃ lakṣayati|

ab.seg: śuddhaṃ kṣīraṃ lakṣayati ---- athāto bālāmayapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| gadyasūtre|2| trividhaḥ kathito bālaḥ kṣīrānnobhayavartanaḥ| svāsthyaṃ tābhyāmaduṣṭābhyāṃ duṣṭābhyāṃ rogasambhavaḥ||1||

div.ab: Sa. asmādanantaraṃ bālasyopacaryamāṇasya ye rogāstaccikitsārtho bālāmayapratiṣedha ucyate- bālastriprakāraḥ kathito munibhiḥ| kṣīravartano'nnavartana ubhayavartanaḥ-kṣīrānnābhyāṃ yo vartate| tābhyāṃ-annakṣīrābhyāṃ, aduṣṭābhyāṃ svāsthyaṃ bhavati| duṣṭābhyāṃ tu kṣīrānnābhyāṃ rogodbhūtiḥ|
Sa. vātaduṣṭaṃ kṣīraṃ jale plavate-taratīva naikatāṃ gacchati| kaṣāyādiguṇayuktaṃ ca syāt|

ab.seg: -------------------------------------------------| pittāduṣṇāmlakaṭukaṃ pītarājyapsu dāhakṛt||3||

div.ab: Sa. pittādduṣṭaṃ kṣīramuṣṇāmlakaṭukam, tathā toye prakṣiptaṃ pītarāji syāt dāhakaraṃ ca|
kaphātsalavaṇaṃ sāndraṃ jale majjati picchilam| -------------------------------------------------|4|
Sa. kaphāt kṣīraṃ duṣṭaṃ salavaṇaṃ ghanaṃ ca syāt| apsu ca majjati|

-------------------------------------------------| saṃsṛṣṭaliṅgaṃ saṃsargāttriliṅgaṃ sānnipātikam||4|| yathāsvaliṅgāṃstadvyādhīn janayatyupayojitam| -------------------------------------------------|5|
Sa. saṃsargād duṣṭaṃ kṣīraṃ saṃsṛṣṭaliṅgaṃ syāt| sānnipātikaṃ kṣīraṃ triliṅgaṃ syāt| tacca kṣīramupayojitaṃ bālasya ca yathāsvaliṅgān vyādhīn janayati|

ab.seg: -------------------------------------------------| śiśostīkṣṇamabhīkṣṇaṃ ca rodanāllakṣayedrujam||5||

div.ab: Sa. bālasya tīkṣṇaṃ-kharaṃ, abhīkṣṇaṃ ca rujaṃ-pīḍāṃ, rodanāllakṣayet,- atirodanena kiñcidrodanena ca yathāyogaṃ rujaṃ vidyādityarthaḥ|
sa yaṃ spṛśedbhṛśaṃ deśaṃ yatra ca sparśanākṣamaḥ| tatra vidyādrujaṃ----------------------------------------|6|
Sa. yaṃ dehadeśaṃ sa bhṛśaṃ spṛśet yatra ca dehadeśe sparśanākṣamaḥ syāt tatra deśe rujaṃ vidyāt|

ab.seg: hṛdi jihvauṣṭhadaśanaśvāsamuṣṭinipīḍanaiḥ| koṣṭhe vibandhavamathustanadaṃśāntrakūjanaiḥ||7||
ādhmānapṛṣṭhanamanajaṭharonnamanairapi| bastau guhye ca viṇmūtrasaṅgottrāsadigīkṣaṇaiḥ||8||

div.ab: Sa. śirasi pīḍāmakṣinimīlanādvidyāt| vināśahetumata eva jihvauṣṭhadaśanādibhirhṛdi pīḍāṃ vidyāt| vibandhādibhirādhmānādibhiśca koṣṭhe rujaṃ vidyāt| bastau guhye ca pīḍāṃ viṭsaṅgādibhirvidyāt|
atha dhātryāḥ kriyāṃ kuryādyathādoṣaṃ yathāmayam| -------------------------------------------------|9|
Sa. atha-anantaraṃ, evaṃ jñātvā dhātryā vaidyo yathādoṣaṃ yathārogaṃ kriyāṃ kuryāt|

ab.seg: -------------------------------------------------| tatra vātātmake stanye daśamūlaṃ tryahaṃ pibet||9||
athavā'gnivacāpāṭhākaṭukākuṣṭhadīpyakam| sabhārgīdārusaralavṛścikālīkaṇoṣaṇam||10||

div.ab: Sa. tatra-teṣu, vātena duṣṭe stanye trīṇi dināni daśamūlaṃ pibet| athavā citrakādīni kvathitāni tryahaṃ pibet|
tataḥ pibedanyatamaṃ vātavyādhiharaṃ ghṛtam| anu cācchasurāmevaṃ snigdhāṃ mṛdu virecayet||11|| bastikarma tataḥ kuryātsvedādīṃścānilāpahān| -------------------------------------------------|12|

Sa. anantaraṃ vātavyādhicikitsitoktaṃ ghṛtaṃ pibet| paścādacchasurāṃ pibet| evaṃ snigdhāṃ satīṃ mṛdu virecayet-āragvadhena| anantaraṃ bastikarma kuryāt| svedādīṃśca mārutāpahān| ādiśabdenābhyaṅgādergrahaḥ|
-------------------------------------------------| rāsnājamodāsaraladevadārurajonvitam||12|| bālo lihyād ghṛtaṃ tairvā vipakvaṃ sasitopalam| -------------------------------------------------|13|
Sa. rāsnādicūrṇānvitaṃ śiśuḥ sarpirlihyāt| athavā taiḥ siddhaṃ saśarkaraṃ ghṛtaṃ lihyāt|

-------------------------------------------------| pittaduṣṭe'mṛtābhīrupaṭolīnimbacandanam||13|| dhātrī kumāraśca pibet kvāthayitvā sasārivam| athavā triphalāmustabhūnimbakaṭurohiṇīḥ||14|| sārivādiṃ paṭolādiṃ padmakādiṃ tathā gaṇam| ghṛtānyebhiśca siddhāni pittaghnaṃ ca virecanam||15|| śītāṃścābhyaṅgalepādīn yuñjyāt--------------| -------------------------------------------------|16|

Sa. pittaduṣṭe guḍūcyādīni kvāthayitvā bālaḥ pibet dhātrī ca| athavā triphalādīn pibet| athavā sārivādigaṇaṃ(gaṇādyanyatamaṃ) pibet saṃ-athavā sārivādibhirgaṇaiḥ pṛthak pṛthak siddhāni ghṛtāni lihyāt| virecanadravyaṃ ca pittaghnaṃ kuryā(yuñjyā)t| abhyaṅgādīṃśca śītān yuñjyāt|

--------------------------------śleṣmātmake punaḥ| yaṣṭyāhvasaindhavayutaṃ kumāraṃ pāyayed ghṛtam||16|| sindhūtthapippalīmadvā, piṣṭaiḥ, kṣaudrayutairatha| rāṭhapuṣpaiḥ stanau limpecchiśośca daśanacchadau||17|| sukhamevaṃ vamedbālaḥ-------------------------------| -------------------------------------------------|18|

Sa. śleṣmaduṣṭe stanye madhuyaṣṭīsaindhavayuktaṃ ghṛtaṃ bālaṃ pāyayet| saindhavapippaliyuktaṃ ghṛtaṃ vā pāyayet| madanakusumairmākṣikayuktaiḥ stanau limpet| bālasya coṣṭhau limpet| evaṃ kṛte sati bālaḥ sukhaṃ vamet|
Sa. dhātrīṃ tīkṣṇairvamanairvāmayet|

ab.seg: -------------------------------------------------| athācaritasaṃsargī mustādiṃ kvathitaṃ pibet||18||
tadvattagarapṛthvīkāsuradārukaliṅgakān| athavā'tiviṣāmustaṣaḍgranthāpañcakolakam||19||

div.ab: Sa. anantaraṃ kṛte saṃsarge sati mustādiṃ kvathitaṃ pibet| tagarādīn vā ativiṣādīn vā pibet|

ab.seg: stanye tridoṣamaline durgandhyāmaṃ jalopamam| vibaddhamacchaṃ vicchinnaṃ phenilaṃ copaveśyate||20||
śakṛnnānāvyathāvarṇaṃ, mūtraṃ pītaṃ sitaṃ ghanam| jvarārocakatṛṭchardiśuṣkodgāravijṛmbhikāḥ||21||
aṅgabhaṅgo'ṅgavikṣepaḥ kūjanaṃ vepathurbhramaḥ| ghrāṇākṣimukhapākādyā jāyante'nye'pi taṃ gadam||22||
kṣīrālasakamityāhuratyayaṃ cātidāruṇam tatrāśu dhātrīṃ bālaṃ ca vamanenopapādayet||23||

div.ab: Sa. tridoṣaduṣṭe stanye durgandhyādiguṇaṃ śakṛdupaveśyate, tathā nānāvyathāvarṇam| mūtraṃ ca pītaṃ sitaṃ ghanaṃ-styānaṃ, ca syāt| tathā jvarādayaḥ, anye'pi-evaṃprakārā rogāḥ, jāyante| taṃ-īdṛśaṃ, gadaṃ kṣīrālasakamiti kathayanti| atyayaṃ-vināśahetum, ata evātidāruṇam tatra-kṣīrālasake, śīghrameva dhātrīṃ bālaṃ ca vamanenopakramet|

ab.seg: vihitāyāṃ ca saṃsargyāṃ vacādiṃ yojayedgaṇam| niśādiṃ vā'thavā mādrīpāṭhātiktāghanāmayān||24||

div.ab: Sa. [ vihitāyāṃ ] saṃsargyāṃ-peyādike krame kṛte, vacādiṃ niśādiṃ vā gaṇaṃ prayojayet| mādryādīn vā yojayet|

ab.seg: pāṭhāśuṇṭhyamṛtātiktatiktādevāhvasārivāḥ| samustamūrvendrayavāḥ stanyadoṣaharāḥ param||25||

div.ab: Sa. pāṭhādaya upayuktāḥ paraṃ stanyadoṣaharāḥ| tiktaḥ kirātatiktaḥ|
anubandhe yathāvyādhi pratikurvīta kālavit| -------------------------------------------------|26|
Sa. anubandhe tu sati yathārogaṃ cikitsitaṃ kuryādvaidyaḥ|

ab.seg: -------------------------------------------------| dantodbhedaśca rogāṇāṃ sarveṣāmapi kāraṇam||26||
viśeṣājjavaraviḍbhedakāsacchardiśirorujām| abhiṣyandasya pothakyā visarpasya ca jāyate||27||

div.ab: Sa. rogāṇāṃ ca sarveṣāmapi dantodbhedo heturjāyate| viśeṣeṇa jvarādīnāṃ tu hetuḥ sampadyate|

ab.seg: pṛṣṭhabhaṅge biḍālānāṃ barhiṇāṃ ca śikhodgame| dantodbhede ca bālānāṃ na hi kiñcinna dūyate||28||
yathādoṣaṃ yathārogaṃ yathodrekaṃ yathābhayam| vibhajya deśakālādīṃstatra yojyaṃ bhiṣagjitam||29||

div.ab: Sa. mārjārāṇāṃ pṛṣṭhabhaṅge sati, mayūrāṇāṃ ca śikodbhave sati, dantotthāne ca śiśūnāṃ, naneti dvau pratiṣedhau prakṛtamarthaṃ gamayataḥ, tena sarvaṃ vapurbālasyottaptaṃ bhavet| na kiñcinna dūyate,- api tu sarvāṇyevāṅgāni pīḍyanta ityarthaḥ| tatra doṣānusāreṇa tathā doṣādikyānurodhena tathā rogānusāreṇa ca deśakālasattvasātmyaprakṛtīrnirūpyāuṣadhaṃ prayojayet|
ta eva doṣā dūṣyāśca jvarādyā vyādhayaśca yat| atastadeva bhaiṣajyaṃ mātrā tvasya kanīyasī||30|| saukumāryālpakāyatvāt sarvānnānupasevanāt| --------------------------------------------|31|

Sa. yat-yasmāt, ta eva vātādayo doṣāḥ, ta eva rasādayo dūṣyāḥ, jvarādayaśca rogāḥ pūrvoktāsta eva, tasmāt tadeva pūrvoktaṃ bhaiṣajyam| asya tu-bālasya, mātrā kanīyasī| kuto'sya hrasvatarā mātrā ? ityāha-saukumāryetyādi|
-----------------------------------------------| snigdhā eva sadā bālā ghṛtakṣīraniṣevaṇāt||31|| sadyastān vamanaṃ tasmāt pāyayenmatimān mṛdu| -----------------------------------------------|32|
Sa. śiśavaḥ sarvadaiva snigdhāḥ| kutaḥ ? ghṛtakṣīraniṣevaṇāt| yataścaivaṃ tasmāt tān-bālān, sadyo vamanaṃ mṛdu dhīmān pāyayet|
---------------------------------------------| stanyasya tṛptaṃ vamayet kṣīrakṣīrānnasevinam||32|| pītavantaṃ tanuṃ peyāmannādaṃ ghṛtasaṃyutām| ---------------------------------------------|33|

Sa. kṣīrasevinaṃ tathā kṣīrānnasevinaṃ bālaṃ stanyasya tṛptaṃ santaṃ vāmayet| stanyasya tṛptamiti "adhikaraṇavācinaśca" iti ṣaṣṭhī| vā(va)mayediti "glāsnāvanuvamāṃ ca" iti mittvavikalpaḥ annādaṃ bālaṃ tanuṃ-aghanāṃ, peyāṃ sasarpiṣkāṃ pītavantaṃ vāmayet|
---------------------------------------------| bastiṃ sādhye virekeṇa, marśena pratimarśanam||33|| yuñjayādvirecanādīṃstu dhātryā eva yathoditān| ---------------------------------------------|34|
Sa. virekeṇa sādhye roge bastiṃ yuñjayāt| marśena sādhye roge pratimarśaṃ yuñjyāt| virecanādīn punaryathoditān dhātryā eva yuñjyāt|
---------------------------------------------| mūrvāvyoṣavarākolajambūtvakdārusarṣapāḥ||34|| sapāṭhā madhunā līḍhāḥ stanyadoṣaharāḥ param| ---------------------------------------------|35|
Sa. mūrvādayo madhunā līḍhāḥ suṣṭhu stanyadoṣaharāḥ|
---------------------------------------------| dantapālīṃ samadhunā cūrṇena pratisārayet||35|| pippalyā dhātakīpuṣpadhātrīphalakṛtena vā| ---------------------------------------------|36|
Sa. śiśordantapālīṃ pippalyāścūrṇena samākṣikeṇa pratisārayet| athavā dhātakīpuṣpādikṛtena cūrṇena pratisārayet|
---------------------------------------------| lāvatittirivallūrarajaḥ puṣparasadrutam||36|| drutaṃ karoti bālānāṃ dantakesaravanmukham| ---------------------------------------------|37|
Sa. lāvādicūrṇaṃ mākṣikadravīkṛtamupayuktaṃ śiśūnāṃ śīghraṃ dantakesaravanmukhaṃ karoti| dantā eva kesaraṃ tat (rāṇi tāni) vidyate(nte) yasminniti matup|
---------------------------------------------| vacādvibṛhatīpāṭhākaṭukātiviṣāghanaiḥ||37|| madhuraiśca ghṛtaṃ siddhaṃ siddhaṃ daśanajanmani| ---------------------------------------------|38|
Sa. vacādibhiḥ pakvaṃ ghṛtaṃ dantotthāne siddham,- avyāhataśaktitvāt|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| rajanīdārusaralaśreyasībṛhatīdvayam||38||
pṛśniparṇī śatāhvā ca līḍhaṃ mākṣikasarpiṣā| grahaṇīdīpanaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ mārutasyānulomanam||39||
atīsārajvaraśvāsakāmalāpāṇḍukāsanut| bālasya sarvarogeṣu pūjitaṃ balavarṇadaṃ||40||

div.ab: Sa. rajanyādicūrṇaṃ mākṣikayuktena sarpiṣā līḍhaṃ grahaṇyā dīpanaṃ suṣṭhu vātasya cānulomanam| tathā'tīsārādijit| bālasya sarvāmayeṣu hitaṃ balavarṇadaṃ ca|

samaṅgādhātakīrodhrakuṭannaṭabalādvayaiḥ| mahāsahākṣudrasahāmudgabilvaśalāṭubhiḥ||41|| sakārpāsīphalaistoye sādhitaiḥ sādhitaṃ ghṛtam| kṣīramastuyutaṃ hanti śīghraṃ dantodbhavodbhavān||42|| vividhānāmayānetadvṛddhakāśyapanirmitam| ---------------------------------------------|43|
Sa. samaṅgādibhiḥ sāmānyaparibhāṣayā toye sādhitaṃ ghṛtaṃ kṣīramastuyutaṃ pakvaṃ dantotthān rogānanekaprakārān hanti| etacca vṛddhakāśyapena nirmitam|
---------------------------------------------| dantodbhaveṣu rogeṣu na bālamatiyantrayet||43|| svayamapyupaśāmyanti jātadantasya yadgadāḥ| ---------------------------------------------|44|

Sa. dantodbhaveṣu rogeṣu bālaṃ nātīva yantrayet-pathyabhojanādinā nātīva niyamayet, yathā'nyarogiṇam| kim ? ityāha-yat-yasmāt, svayameva(mapi)-cikitsāmantareṇāpi, jātadantasya sato bālasya rogāḥ praśāmyanti|

-----------------------------------------------| atyahaḥsvapnaśītāmbuślaiṣmikastanyasevinaḥ||44|| śiśoḥ kaphena ruddheṣu srotaḥsu rasavāhiṣu| arocakaḥ pratiśyāyo jvaraḥ kāsaśca jāyate||45|| kumāraḥ śuṣyati tataḥ snigdhaśuklamukhekṣaṇaḥ| -----------------------------------------------|46|

Sa. bhṛśaṃ divāsvapnādisevino'rbhakasya kaphena rasavāhiṣu srotaḥsu ruddheṣu satsu arocakādayaḥ prādurbhavanti| tataḥ-teṣu jāteṣu, kumāraḥ śuṣyati| snigdhaṃ śuklaṃ vadananayanaṃ yasya sa evaṃbhūtaḥ san|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------| saindhavavyoṣaśārṅgeṣṭāpāṭhāgirikadambakān||46||
śuṣyato madhusarpirbhyāmarucyādiṣu yojayet| -----------------------------------------------||47||

div.ab: Sa. tasyārocakādiṣu saindhavādīn samadhughṛtān yojayet|
-----------------------------------------------| aśokarohiṇīyuktaṃ pañcakolaṃ ca cūrṇitam||47|| badarīdhātakīdhātrīcūrṇaṃ vā sarpiṣā drutam| -----------------------------------------------|48|
Sa. tathā pañcakolaṃ rajīkṛtamaśokakaṭukābhyāṃ yuktaṃ yojayet| athavā badaryādicūrṇaṃ sarpiṣā dravīkṛtaṃ yojayet|

-----------------------------------------------| sthirāvacādvibṛhatīkākolīpippalīnataiḥ||48|| niculotpalavarṣābhūbhārgīmustaiśca kārṣikaiḥ| siddhaṃ prasthārdhamājyasya srotasāṃ śodhanaṃ param||49|| simhyaśvagandhāsurasākaṇāgarbhaṃ ca tadguṇam| -----------------------------------------------|50|
Sa. sthirādibhiḥ kārṣikairghṛtasya prasthārdhaṃ siddhaṃ paraṃ srotasāṃ viśodhanam| simhyādibhirghṛtaṃ pūrvaguṇam|
-----------------------------------------------| yaṣṭyāhvapippalīrodhrapadmakotpalacandanaiḥ||50|| tālīsasārivābhyāṃ ca sādhitaṃ śoṣajidghṛtam| -----------------------------------------------|51|
Sa. madhuyaṣṭikādibhiḥ sādhitaṃ sarpiḥ śoṣajit|

-----------------------------------------------| śṛṅgīmadhūlikābhārgīpippalīdevadārubhiḥ||51|| aśvagandhādvikākolīrāsnarṣabhakajīvakaiḥ| śūrpaparṇīviḍaṅgaiśca kalkitaiḥ sādhitaṃ ghṛtam||52|| śaśottamāṅganiryūhe śuṣyataḥ puṣṭikṛtparam| -----------------------------------------------|53|
Sa. śṛṅgyādibhiḥ kalkitaiḥ śaśasya śiraḥkvāthena sādhitaṃ ghṛtaṃ śuṣyato bālasyātipuṣṭikaram|
-----------------------------------------------| vacāvayaḥsthātagarakāyasthācorakaiḥ śṛtam||53|| bastamūtrasurābhyāṃ ca tailamabhyañjane hitam| -----------------------------------------------|54|
Sa. vacādibhiśchāgamūtrasurābhyāṃ ca siddhaṃ tailamabhyaṅge hitam|

-----------------------------------------------| lākṣārasasamaṃ tailaprasthaṃ mastu caturguṇam||54|| aśvagandhāniśādārukauntīkuṣṭhābdacandanaiḥ| samūrvārohiṇīrāsnāśatāhvāmadhukaiḥ samaiḥ||55|| siddhaṃ lākṣādikaṃ nāma tailamabhyañjanādidam| balyaṃ jvarakṣayonmādaśvāsāpasmāravātanut||56|| yakṣarākṣasabhūtaghnaṃ garbhiṇīnāṃ ca śasyate| -----------------------------------------------|57|
Sa. lākṣārasatulyaṃ tailaprasthaṃ mastucaturguṇamaśvagandhādibhiḥ sāmānyaparibhāṣoktapramāṇaiḥ siddhaṃ lākṣādikasaṃjñam| etattailamabhyaṅgād balyaṃ jvarādijit yakṣmādighnaṃ garbhiṇībhyaśca hitam|
-----------------------------------------------| madhunā'tiviṣāśṛṅgīpippalīrlehayecchiśum||57|| ekāṃ vā'tiviṣāṃ kāsajvaracchardirupadrutam| -----------------------------------------------|58|
Sa. ativiṣādīn madhunā kāsādipīḍitaṃ śiśuṃ-bālaṃ, lehayet| athavā, ativiṣāmekāṃ lehayet|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------| pītaṃ pītaṃ vamati yaḥ stanyaṃ taṃ madhusarpiṣā||58||
dvivārtākīphalarasaṃ pañcakolaṃ ca lehayet| pippalīpañcalavaṇaṃ kṛmijitpāribhadrakam||59||
tadvallihyāttathā vyoṣaṃ maṣīṃ vā romacarmaṇām| lābhataḥ śalyakaśvāvidgodharkṣaśikhijanmanām||60||

div.ab: Sa. yo bālaḥ pītaṃ pītaṃ stanyaṃ vamet taṃ bṛhatīdvayasya phalasvarasaṃ pañcakolaṃ ca ghṛtamākṣikābhyāṃ lehayet| athavā pippalyādikaṃ tadvat-pūrvavat madhusarpiṣā, bālo lihyāt| vyoṣaṃ tathā-madhusarpiṣā, lihyāt| [ athavā ] śalyakādijanmanāṃ romṇāṃ carmaṇāṃ ca yathālābhaṃ maṣīṃ madhughṛtābhyāṃ lihyāt|

ab.seg: khadirārjunatālīsakuṣṭhacandanaje rase| sakṣīraṃ sādhitaṃ sarpirvamathuṃ viniyacchati||61||

div.ab: Sa. khadirādirase sakṣīraṃ sarpiḥ pakvamupayuktaṃ vamiṃ śamayati|

-----------------------------------------------| tālumāṃse kaphaḥ kruddhaḥ kurute tālukaṇṭakam||63|| tena tālupradeśasya nimnatā mūrdhni jāyate| tālupātaḥ stanadveṣaḥ kṛcchrātpānaṃ śakṛddravam||64|| tṛḍāsyakaṇḍvakṣirujā grīvādurdharatā vamiḥ| -----------------------------------------------|65|

Sa. kapho madhurādyaistālumāṃse prakupitastālukaṇṭakaṃ kuryāt| tena-tālukaṇṭakena, śirasi tālupradeśe nimnatā syāt| tathā tālunaḥ patanaṃ stanadveṣaḥ kṛcchreṇa stanapānaṃ śakṛcca dravaṃ syāt| tathā tṛḍādyāḥ syuḥ|
-----------------------------------------------| tatrotkṣipya yavakṣārakṣaudrābhyāṃ pratisārayet||65|| tālu tadvatkaṇāśuṇṭhīgośakṛdrasasaindhavaiḥ| -----------------------------------------------|66|
Sa. tatra tālūtkṣipya yavakṣārakṣaudrābhyāṃ pratisārayet| tathaiva kaṇādibhiḥ pratisārayet

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------| śṛṅgaveraniśābhṛṅgaṃ kalkitaṃ vaṭapallavaiḥ||66||
badhvā gośakṛtā liptaṃ kukūle svedayettataḥ| rasena limpettālvāsyaṃ netre ca pariṣecayet||67||

div.ab: Sa. tathā śuṇṭhyādikaṃ kalkitaṃ vaṭapallavairbadhvā gośakṛtā liptaṃ tataḥ kukūle svedayet| anantaraṃ rasena ca-tataḥ srutena, tālu āsyaṃ ca limpet| tathā netre pariṣecayet|

ab.seg: harītakīvacākuṣṭhakalkaṃ mākṣikasaṃyutam| pītvā kumāraḥ stanyena mucyate tālukaṇṭakāt||68||

div.ab: Sa. harītakyādikaṃ mākṣikayuktaṃ stanyena śiśuḥ pītvā tālukaṇṭakādvimucyate

ab.seg: malopalepātsvedādvā gude raktakaphodbhavaḥ| tāmro vraṇo'ntaḥ kaṇḍūmān jāyate bhūryupadravaḥ||69||
kecittaṃ mātṛkādoṣaṃ vadantyanye'hipūtanam| pṛṣṭārurgudakuṭṭaṃ ca kecicca tamanāmikam||70||

div.ab: Sa. gude raktakaphodbhavo malopalepāt svedādvā tāmro vraṇaḥ kaṇḍūmānāntaro bahūpadravo jāyate| taṃ-tathāvidhaṃ, kecinmātṛkādoṣaṃ kathayanti| apare ca pūtanasaṃjñamityāhuḥ| kecit pṛṣṭāruriti, kecit gudakuṭṭamiti, kecicca tamanāmikaṃ, bruvate|
tatra dhātryāḥ payaḥ śodhyaṃ pittaśleṣmaharauṣadhaiḥ| -----------------------------------------------|71|
Sa. tatra-tasminnanekanāmni roge, dhātryāḥ kṣīraṃ śodhanīyam kaiḥ ? pittaśleṣmahṛdbhirauṣadhaiḥ|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------| śṛtaśītaṃ ca śītāmbuyuktamantarapānakam||71||
sakṣaudratārkṣyaśailena vraṇaṃ tena ca lepayet| triphalābadarīplakṣatvakkvāthapariṣecitam||72||
kāsīsarocanātutthamanohvālarasāñjanaiḥ| lepayedamlapiṣṭairvā cūrṇitairvā'vacūrṇayet||73||
suślakṣṇairathavā yaṣṭīśaṅkhasauvīrakāñjanaiḥ| sārivāśaṅkhanābhibhyāmasanasya tvacā'thavā||74||
rāgakaṇḍūtkaṭe kuryādraktasrāvaṃ jalaukasā| sarvaṃ ca pittavraṇajicchasyate gudakuṭṭake||75||

div.ab: Sa. saha kṣaudreṇa vartate yattat sakṣaudram, sakṣaudram ca tat tārkṣyaśailaṃ ca, tena yuktaṃ śītāmbu, antaraṃ pānakaṃ ca hitam| kimbhūtam ? śṛtaśītam| atra ca śītamātrasya śītatvenaiva labdhatvācchītāmbivatyatiśayārtham| evaṃ hi pittopaśāntirbhavati| ata eva ca tatsahitasya kaphasya śamanāya mākṣikarasāñjanayogo'tra kṛtaḥ| tena ca jalena vraṇaṃ lepayet| kimbhūtaṃ vraṇam ? triphalādikvāthena pariṣecitaṃ santaṃ kāsīsādibhiramlapiṣṭairvā lepayet| athavā, etaireva cūrṇitairvraṇamavacūrṇayet| athavā madhukādibhiḥ supiṣṭairavacūrṇayet| sārivāśaṅkhanābhibhyāmavacūrṇayet| athavā, asanatvacā limpet| rāgakaṇḍvādhikye jalaukobhirasrasrāvaṃ kuryāt| jalaukasā "jātau" ityekavacanāt tasya prayogo na doṣāya, tathā sallakṣasya dṛṣtatvāt| sarvaṃ cikitsitaṃ pittavraṇatulyaṃ gudakuṭṭake śasyate|
pāṭhāvelladvirajanīmustabhārgīpunarnavaiḥ| sabilvatryūṣaṇaiḥ sarpivṛścikālīyutaiḥ śṛtam||76|| lihāno mātrayā rogairmucyate mṛttikodbhavaiḥ| -----------------------------------------------|77|
Sa. pāṭhādibhiḥ pakvaṃ ghṛtaṃ mātrayā lihan mṛttikodbhavairāmayairmucyate|

vyādheryadyasya bhaiṣajyaṃ stanastena pralepitaḥ| sthito muhūrtaṃ dhauto'nu pītastaṃ taṃ jayedgadam|77| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitā yāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne bālā- mayapratiṣedho nāma dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ|2|

Sa. yasya rogasya yadauṣadhamuktaṃ tenaivauṣadhena stanaḥ pralepito muhūrtamātraṃ-nāḍikādvayaṃ yāvad vidhṛtaḥ, stano'nu dhautaḥ paścāt pītastaṃ taṃ-aniyataṃ rogaṃ, jayet| iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattavirachitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdaya- ṭīkāyāṃ sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne bālā mayapratiṣedho nāma dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 2||

div.head: balagrahapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ
div.ab: athāto bālagrahapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre|2|
Sa. asmādanantaraṃ bālagrahapratiṣedha ucyate, grahāṇāmapi roga hetutvāt| bālānāṃ grahā bālagrahāḥ, teṣāṃ pratiṣedho yasmin sa bālagrahapratiṣedhaḥ, tam| śeṣaṃ pūrvavat|

purā guhasya rakṣārthaṃ nirmitāḥ śūlapāṇinā| manuṣyavigrahāḥ pañca sapta strīvigrahā grahāḥ||1|| skando viśākho meṣākhyaḥ śvagrahaḥ pitṛsaṃjñitaḥ| śakuniḥ pūtanā śītapūtanā'dṛṣṭipūtanā||2|| mukhamaṇḍitikā tadvadrevatī śuṣkarevatī| -------------------------------------------|3|
Sa. pūrvaṃ śrīmahādevena kārtikeyasya rakṣārthaṃ manuṣyaśarīrāḥ pañca grahā nirmitāḥ| strīśarīrāśca saptotpāditāḥ| saṃ-skandādayaḥ pañca nararūpāḥ| śakunyādayaḥ sapta strīrūpāḥ|

ab.seg: ------------------------------------------------------| teṣāṃ grahīṣyatāṃ rūpaṃ pratataṃ rodanaṃ jvaraḥ||3||

div.ab: Sa. teṣāṃ-grahāṇāṃ, grahīṣyatāṃ pūrvarūpaṃ pratataṃ rodanaṃ jvaraśca|

ab.seg: sāmānyaṃ rūpamuttrāsajṛmbhābhrūkṣepadīnatāḥ| phenasrāvordhvadṛṣṭyoṣṭhadantadaṃśaprajāgarāḥ||4||
rodanaṃ kūjanaṃ stanyavidveṣaḥ svaravaikṛtam| nakhairakasmātparitaḥ svadhātryaṅgavilekhanam||5||

div.ab: Sa. teṣāṃ sāmānyaṃ rūpamuttrāsa ityādi svadhātryaṅgavilekhanāntam|

tatraikanayanasrāvī śiro vikṣipate muhuḥ| hataikapakṣaḥ stabdhāṅgaḥ sasvedo natakandharaḥ||6|| dantakhādī stanadveṣī trasyan roditi visvaram| vakravaktro vaman lālāṃ bhṛśamūrdhvaṃ nirīkṣate||7|| vasāsṛggandhirudvigno baddhamuṣṭiśakṛcchiśuḥ| calitaikākṣigaṇḍabhrūḥ saṃraktobhayalocanaḥ||8|| skandārtastena vaikalyaṃ maraṇaṃ vā bhaved dhruvam| --------------------------------------------------|9|

Sa. tatra-teṣu graheṣu madhye, ekalocanasravaṇaśīlastathā śiro vikṣipata ityādi saṃraktalocanadvayāntaṃ skandagṛhītasya lakṣaṇam| tena vaikalyaṃ-paṅgutvakāṇatvādi, mṛtyureva vā dhruvaṃ niścitaṃ, bhavet|

ab.seg: samprati viśākhasya skandāpasmārāparasaṃjñasya lakṣaṇamāha ---- --------------------------------------------------| saṃjñānāśo muhuḥ keśaluñcanaṃ kandharānatiḥ||9||
vinamya jṛmbhamāṇasya śakṛvmūtrapravartanam| phenodvamanamūrdhvekṣā hastabhrūpādanartanam||10||
stanasvajihvāsandaṃśasaṃrambhajvarajāgarāḥ| pūyaśoṇitagandhaśca skandāpasmāralakṣaṇam||11||

div.ab: Sa. saṃjñānāśādikaṃ pūyaśoṇitagandhāntaṃ skandāpasmāralakṣaṇam|

ab.seg: ādhmānaṃ pāṇipādasya spandanaṃ phenanirvamaḥ| tṛṇmuṣṭibandhātīsārasvaradainyavivarṇatāḥ||12||
kūjanaṃ stananaṃ chardiḥ kāsahidhmāprajāgarāḥ| oṣṭhadaṃśāṅgasaṅkocastambhabastābhagandhatāḥ||13||
ūrdhvaṃ nirīkṣya hasanaṃ, madhye vinamanaṃ, jvaraḥ| mūrcchaikanetraśophaśca naigameṣagrahākṛtiḥ||14||

div.ab: Sa. meṣasya naigameṣāparasaṃjñasyādhmānādi ekanetraśophāntaṃ lakṣaṇam|
kampo hṛṣitaromatvaṃ svedaścakṣurnimīlanam| bahirāyāmanaṃ jihvādaṃśo'ntaḥkaṇṭhakūjanam||15|| dhāvanaṃ viṭsagandhatvaṃ krośanaṃ ca śvavacchuni| --------------------------------------------------|16|
Sa. śuni-śvagrahe, kampa ityādikaṃ krośanaṃ śvavadityantaṃ lakṣaṇam|

--------------------------------------------------| romaharṣo muhustrāsaḥ sahasā rodanaṃ jvaraḥ||16|| kāsātisāravamathujṛmbhātṛṭśavagandatāḥ| aṅgeṣvākṣepavikṣepaśoṣastambhavivarṇatāḥ||17|| muṣṭibandhaḥ srutiścākṣṇorbālasya syuḥ pitṛgrahe| --------------------------------------------------|18|
Sa. pitṛgrahe romaharṣaṃ ityādikaṃ bālasya syurityantaṃ lakṣaṇam|

--------------------------------------------------| srastāṅgatvamatīsāro jihvātālugale vraṇāḥ||18|| sphoṭāḥ sadāharukpākāḥ sandhiṣu syuḥ punaḥpunaḥ| niśyahni pravilīyante pāko vaktre gude'pi vā||19|| bhayaṃ śakunigandhatvaṃ jvaraśca śakunigrahe| --------------------------------------------------|20|
Sa. śakunigrahe srastāṅgatvamityādikaṃ jvaraścetyantaṃ liṅgam|

ab.seg: --------------------------------------------------| pūtanāyāṃ vamiḥ kampastandrā rātrau prajāgaraḥ||20||
hidhmā''dhmānaṃ śakṛdbhedaḥ pipāsā mūtranigrahaḥ| srastahṛṣṭāṅgaromatvaṃ kākavatpūtigandhitā||21||

div.ab: Sa. vamiḥ kampa ityādikaṃ kākavatpūtigandhitetyantaṃ pūtanāgrahe liṅgam|
śītapūtanayā kampo rodanaṃ tiryagīkṣaṇam| tṛṣṇā'ntrakūjo'tīsāro vasāvadvisragandhatā||22|| pārśvasyaikasya śītatvamuṣṇatvamaparasya ca| --------------------------------------------------|23|
Sa. śītapūtanayā kampo rodanamityādikamuṣṇatvamaparasya cetyevamantaṃ śītapūranāgrahe liṅgam

ab.seg: --------------------------------------------------| andhapūtanayā chardirjvaraḥ kāso'lpanidratā||23||
varcaso bhedavaivarṇyadaurgandhyānyaṅgaśoṣaṇam| dṛṣṭeḥ sādātirukkaṇḍūpothakījanmaśūnatāḥ||24||
hidhmodvegastanadveṣavaivarṇyasvaratīkṣṇatāḥ| vepathurmatsyagandhatvamathavā sāmlagandhatā||25||

div.ab: Sa. chardyādikaṃ sāmlagandhatetyantamandhapūtanāyā [a] dṛṣṭipūtanāparasaṃjñāyā lakṣaṇam|
mukhamaṇḍitayā pāṇipādāsyaramaṇīyatā| sirābhirasitābhābhirācitodaratā jvaraḥ||26|| arocako'ṅgaglapanaṃ gomūtrasamagandhatā| --------------------------------------------------|27|
Sa. mukhamaṇḍitāyāṃ grahe pāṇipādāsyaramaṇīyatetyādikaṃ lakṣaṇam|

ab.seg: --------------------------------------------------| revatyāṃ śyāvanīlatvaṃ karṇanāsākṣimardanam||27||
kāsahidhmākṣivikṣepavakravaktratvaraktatāḥ| bastagandho jvaraḥ śoṣaḥ purīṣaṃ haritaṃ dravam||28||

div.ab: Sa. revatyāṃ-revatīgrahe, śyāvanīlatvādi liṅgam|
adhunā'sādhyalakṣaṇaṃ vakti ---- jāyate śuṣkarevatyāṃ kramātsarvāṅgasaṅkṣayaḥ| --------------------------------------------------|29|
Sa. śuṣkarevatyāṃ kramātsarvāṅgasaṅkṣaya iti liṅgam|

--------------------------------------------------| keśaśāto'nnavidveṣaḥ svaradainyaṃ vivarṇatā||29|| rodanaṃ gṛdhragandhatvaṃ dīrghakālānuvartanam| udare granthayo vṛttā yasya nānāvidhaṃ śakṛt||30|| jihvāyā nimnatā madhye śyāvaṃ tālu ca taṃ tyajet| --------------------------------------------------|31|
Sa. keśaśāta ityādikaṃ śyāvaṃ tālu cetyantaṃ yasya bālasya syāt, taṃ na cikitset|

-------------------------------------------------| bhuñjāno'nnaṃ bahuvidhaṃ yo bālaḥ parihīyate||31|| tṛṣṇāgṛhītaḥ kṣāmākṣo hanti taṃ śuṣkarevatī| -------------------------------------------------|32|
Sa. bhuñjāno'nnamityādilakṣaṇaṃ bālaṃ śuṣkarevatī hanti|

ab.seg: tribhiḥ kāraṇairgrahā gṛhṇantītyāha ---- -------------------------------------------------| hiṃsāratyarcanākāṅkṣā grahagrahaṇakāraṇam||32||

div.ab: Sa. hiṃsā ca ratiścārcanā ca, tāsāmākāṅkṣā-abhilāṣaḥ, sā grahāṇāṃ grahaṇe kāraṇaṃ-hetuḥ|

tatra hiṃsātmake bālo mahān vā srutanāsikaḥ| kṣatajihvaḥ kvaṇedbāḍhamasukhī sāśrulocanaḥ||33|| durvarṇo hīnavacanaḥ pūtigandhiśca jāyate| kṣāmo mūtrapurīṣaṃ svaṃ mṛdgāti na jugupsate||34|| hastau codyamya saṃrabdho hantyātmānaṃ tathā param| tadvacca śastrakāṣṭhādyairagniṃ vā dīptamāviśet||35|| apsu majjetpatetkūpe kuryādanyacca tadvidham| tṛḍdāhamohān pūyasya chardanaṃ ca pravartayet||36|| raktaṃ ca sarvamārgebhyo riṣṭotpattiṃ ca taṃ tyajet| -------------------------------------------------|37|

Sa. tatra-teṣu graheṣu madhyāt, hiṃsātmake grahe sati bālo mahān vā puruṣaḥ srutanāsikādiguṇo jāyate| tathā kṣāmaḥ san idamidaṃ kuryāt| tadvidhaṃ-ātmahananādikaṃ, anyadapi kuryāt| tṛṭdāhamohāṃstathā chardanaṃ ca pūyasya pravartayet| tathā sarvasrotobhyo raktaṃ ca pravartayet, riṣṭotpattiṃ ca| taṃ bālaṃ nopakramet|

sampratyarcanākāmaṃ brūte ---- -------------------------------------------------| rahaḥstrīratisaṃlāpagandhasragbhūṣaṇapriyaḥ||37|| hṛṣṭaḥ śāntaśca duḥsādhyo ratikāmena pīḍitaḥ| -------------------------------------------------|38|
Sa. rahaḥstrīratyādipriyo hṛṣṭādiguṇo bālo ratikāmena graheṇa pīḍitaḥ kṛcchrasādhyaḥ syāt|

adhunaiṣāṃ cikitsitamāha ---- -------------------------------------------------| dīnaḥ parimṛśan vaktraṃ śuṣkauṣṭhagalatālukaḥ||38|| śaṅkitaṃ vīkṣate rauti dhyāyatyāyāti dīnatām| annamannābhilāṣe'pi dattaṃ nāti bubhukṣate||39|| gṛhītaṃ balikāmena taṃ vidyātsukhasādhanam| -------------------------------------------------|40|
Sa. dīnādiguṇaḥ san idamidaṃ karoti| taṃ-evaṃvidhaṃ, balikāmena gṛhītaṃ bālaṃ sukhasādhyaṃ vidyāt|

-------------------------------------------------| hantukāmaṃ jayeddhomaiḥ siddhamantrapravartitaiḥ||40|| itarau tu yathākāmaṃ ratibalyādidānataḥ| -------------------------------------------------|41|

Sa. jighāṃsugrahaṃ homādibhirjayet| nanu, hiṃsākāmo'sādhyastaṃ tyajedityuktam, tatkathaṃ tasya sādhanamuktam ? brūmaḥ| asādhyasyāpi cikitsā kāryaiva| tathā ca saṅgrahe'bhyadhāyi "tasmādācaramocchvāsāccikitset|" ityādi| api ca mantraprabhāvasyācintyatvāt| itarau tu-ratyarcanākāmau, yathābhilāṣaṃ ratibalyādidānena jayet|

-------------------------------------------------| atha sādhyagrahaṃ bālaṃ vivikte śaraṇe sthitam||41|| trirahnaḥ siktasaṃmṛṣṭe sadā sannihitānale| vikīrṇabhūtikusumapatrabījānnasarṣape||42|| rakṣoghnatailajvalitapradīpahatapāpmani| vyavāyamadyapiśitanivṛttaparicārake||43|| purāṇasarpiṣā'bhyaktaṃ pariṣiktaṃ sukhāmbunā| sādhitena balānimbavaijayantīnṛpadrumaiḥ||44|| pāribhadrakakaṭvaṅgajambūvaruṇakaṭūtṛṇaiḥ| kapotavaṅkāpāmārgapāṭalāmadhuśigrubhiḥ||45|| kākajaṅghāmahāśvetākapitthakṣīripādapaiḥ| sakadambakarañjaiśca, dhūpaṃ snātasya cācaret||46|| dvīpivyāghrāhisiṃharkṣacarmabhirghṛtamiśritaiḥ| -------------------------------------------------|47|

Sa. atheti kṛtamaṅgalam| sādhyagrahaṃ bālaṃ vivikte gṛhe sthitam| kimbhūte ? [ triḥ- ] trīn vārān, śodhite sikte ca| trirahna iti "kṛtvo'rthaprayoge kāle'dhikaraṇe" ityadhikaraṇe ṣaṣṭhī| tathā sarvadā nikaṭāgnau| tathā vikṣiptabhūtyādike, rakṣoghnatailapradīptapradīpahatapāpe, vyavāyādinivṛttaparicārake| kimbhūtaṃ bālam ? purāṇaghṛtābhyaktam| tathā snātamuṣṇāmbunā| kimbhūtena jalena ? balādibhiḥ sādhitena| vaijayantī-araṇikā| mahāśvetā_kaṭabhī| pariṣiktasya cāsya dvīpyādicarmādibhirghṛta miśritairdhūpanaṃ kuryāt|

-------------------------------------------------| pūtīdaśāṅgasiddhārthavacābhallātadīpyakaiḥ||47|| sakuṣṭhaiḥ saghṛtairdhūpaḥ sarvagrahavimokṣaṇaḥ| -------------------------------------------------|48|
Sa. pūtyādibhirdhūpaḥ sarvagrahavimokṣaṇaḥ syāt| pūtī-pūtīkarañjaḥ| "vacāhiṅguviḍaṅgāni saindhavaṃ gajapippalī| pāṭhā prativiṣā vyoṣaṃ" (hṛ. u. a. 37|27) iti daśāṅgaḥ kāśyapena vinirmitaḥ|
-------------------------------------------------| sarṣapā nimbapatrāṇi mūlamaśvakhurā vacā||48|| bhūrjapatraṃ ghṛtaṃ dhūpaḥ sarvagrahanivāraṇaḥ| -------------------------------------------------|49|
Sa. sarṣapādibhirdhūpo'śeṣagrahanivāraṇaḥ| aśvakhurā-girikarṇikā|

ab.seg: -------------------------------------------------| anantāmrāsthitagaraṃ maricaṃ madhuro gaṇaḥ||49||
śṛgālavinnā mustā ca kalkitaistairghṛtaṃ pacet| daśamūlarasakṣīrayuktaṃ tad grahajitparam||50||

div.ab: Sa. yavāsādibhiḥ kalkitairdaśamūlarasakṣīrayutaṃ ghṛtaṃ pacet| tacca śiśoḥ pathyaṃ paraṃ grahajit|

rāsnāhyaṃśumatīvṛddhapañcamūlabalāghanāt| kvāthe sarpiḥ pacetpiṣṭaiḥ sārivāvyoṣacitrakaiḥ||51|| pāṭhāviḍaṅgamadhukapayasyāhiṅgudārubhiḥ| sagranthikaiḥ sendrayavaiḥ śiśostatsatataṃ hitam||52|| sarvarogagrahaharaṃ dīpanaṃ balavarṇadam| -------------------------------------------------|53|
Sa. rāsnādikvāthe sārivādibhiḥ kalkaiḥ sarpiḥ pacet| tacca śiśoḥ sadā pathyaṃ sarvarogagrahaghnaṃ dīpanaṃ balavarṇadaṃ ca|

ab.seg: -------------------------------------------------| sārivāsurabhibrāhmīśaṅkhinīkuṣṭhasarṣapaiḥ||53||
vacāśvagandhāsurasayuktaiḥ sarpirvipācayet| tannāśayedgrahān sarvān pānenābhyañjanena ca||54||

div.ab: Sa. sārivādibhiḥ surasayuktaiḥ sarpirvipācayet| tacca pānābhyañjanābhyāṃ sarvagrahanāśanam|

ab.seg: gośṛṅgacarmavālāhinirmokaṃ vṛṣadaṃśaviṭ| nimbapatrājyakaṭukāmadanaṃ bṛhatīdvayam||55||
kārpāsāsthiyavacchāgaromadevāhvasarṣapam| mayūrapatraśrīvāsaṃ tuṣakeśaṃ sarāmaṭham||56||
mṛdbhāṇḍe bastamūtreṇa bhāvitaṃ ślakṣṇacūrṇitam| dhūpanaṃ ca hitaṃ sarvabhūteṣu viṣamajvare||57||

div.ab: Sa. gośṛṅgādi sarpanirmokādi ca mṛnmaye bhāṇḍe chāgamūtreṇa bhāvitaṃ sūkṣmarajīkṛtaṃ sarvabhūteṣu viṣamajvare ca dhūpanārthaṃ hitam|

ab.seg: ghṛtāni bhūtavidyāyāṃ vakṣyante yāni tāni ca| yuñjyāttathā baliṃ homaṃ snapanaṃ mantratantravit||58||

div.ab: Sa. yāni ca sarpīṣi bhūtavidyāyāṃ vakṣyante tāni ca yuñjyāt| tathā mantrāḥ-saṅgrahoktāḥ, tantrāṇi ca, etāni vettīti mantratantravit,-vaidyo, baliṃ homaṃ snapanaṃ ca yuñjyāt|
pūtīkarañja(ñjāt)tvakpatraṃ kṣīribhyo barbarādapi| tumbīviśālāralukaśamībilvakapitthataḥ||59|| utkvāthya toyaṃ tadrātrau bālānāṃ snapanaṃ śivam| -------------------------------------------------|60|
Sa. pūtīkarañjatvak tathā patraṃ kṣīrivṛkṣādbarbarādibhyaśca toyamutkvāthya tadrātrau bālānāṃ snapanaṃ śivaṃ syāt|

-------------------------------------------------| anubandhān yathākṛcchraṃ grahāpāye'pyupadravān|60| bālāmayaniṣedhoktabheṣajaiḥ samupācaret| 60 1/2| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭavira citāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttara- sthāne bālagrahapratiṣedho nāma tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ|3|

Sa. anubandhān yathākṛcchraṃ tathā grahāṇāmapāye-mokṣe, ca ye upadravāstāṃśca bālāmayapratiṣedhādhyāyoktairauṣadhaiḥ samupakramet| iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputra śrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdaya- ṭīkāyāṃ sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne bālagra- hapratiṣedho nāma tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 3|| ityaṣṭāṅgahṛdaye dvitīyaṃ kaumāratantraṃ samāptam|

div.head: bhūtavijñānīyādhyāyaḥ
div.ab: athāto bhūtavijñānīyamadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre|2|
Sa. adhunā bhūtavijñānādhyāyārambho grahasāmānyāt|
athāto bhūtavijñānīyamadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre|2|
Sa. adhunā bhūtavijñānādhyāyārambho grahasāmānyāt|

ab.seg: bhūtasya rūpaprakṛtibhāṣāgatyādiceṣṭitaiḥ| yasyānukāraṃ kurute tenāviṣṭaṃ tamādiśet||2||

div.ab: Sa. yasya bhūtasya rūpāderanukāraṃ yādṛśaṃ bhajate tena taṃ puruṣamadhiṣṭhitaṃ vadet|
so'ṣṭādaśavidho devadānavādivibhedataḥ| -------------------------------------------------|3|
Sa. sa bhūto'ṣṭādaśaprakāro devādibhedena|

ab.seg: -------------------------------------------------| hetustadanuṣaktau tu sadyaḥ pūrvakṛto'thavā||3||
prajñāparādhaḥ, sutarāṃ tena kāmādijanmanā| luptadharmavratācāraḥ pūjyānapyativartate||4||
taṃ tathā bhinnamaryādaṃ pāpamātmopaghātinam| devādayo'pyanughnanti grahāśchidraprahāriṇaḥ||5||

div.ab: Sa. tasya bhūtasyānuṣaṅge prajñāparādhaḥ sadyaḥ-adhunātanaḥ, pūrvajanmakṛto vā hetuḥ| tena-prajñāparādhena, kāmakrodhādijena sutarāṃ naṣṭadharmavratācāraḥ san pūjyānapyatikrāmati| taṃ puruṣaṃ tathā luptadharmavratācāratvādbhinnamaryādaṃ devādayo grahā apyatyanta- maryādātikramādanu-paścāt, ghnanti| na kevalaṃ hiṃsātmakānāmakṣamā iti dyotanārtho'piśabdaḥ| kīdṛśāste ? chidraprahāriṇaḥ| hetāviyaṃ prathamā, chidraprahāritvādityarthaḥ|

ab.seg: chidraṃ pāpakriyārambhaḥ pāko'niṣṭasya karmaṇaḥ| ekasya śūnye'vasthānaṃ śmaśānādiṣu vā niśi||6||
digvāsastvaṃ gurornindā rateravidhisevanam| aśucerdevatārcādi parasūtakasaṅkaraḥ||7||
homamantrabalījyānāṃ viguṇaṃ parikarma ca| samāsāddinacaryādiproktācāravyatikramaḥ||8||

div.ab: Sa. chidraṃ pāpakriyārambha ucyate| sa cāśubhasya karmaṇaḥ pākaḥ-phalam| ekasya-advitīyasya, śūnye sthāne'vasthitiḥ, athavā śmaśānādiṣu niśyavasthitiḥ| tathā nagretyādi| kiṃ vā bahunoditena ? saṅkṣepeṇa dinacaryādikathitasyācārasya ca vyatikrama iti grahagrahaṇe hetuḥ|

ab.seg: grūhṇanti śuklapratipattrayodaśyoḥ surā naram| śuklatrayodaśīkṛṣṇadvādaśyordānavā grahāḥ||9||
gandharvāstu carturdaśyāṃ dvādaśyāṃ coragāḥ punaḥ| pañcamyāṃ, śuklasaptamyekādaśyostu dhaneśvarāḥ||10||
śuklāṣṭapañcamīpaurṇamāsīṣu brahmarākṣasāḥ| kṛṣṇe rakṣaḥ piśācādyā navadvādaśaparvasu||11||
daśāmāvāsyayoraṣṭanavamyoḥ pitaro'pare| guruvṛddhādayaḥ prāyaḥ kālaṃ sandhyāsu lakṣayet||12||

div.ab: Sa. devāḥ śuklapratipadi śuklatrayodaśyāṃ ca naraṃ gṛhṇanti| śuklatrayodaśyāṃ kṛṣṇadvādaśyāṃ ca dānavā grahā gṛhṇanti| gandharvāśca- turdaśyāṃ dvādaśyāṃ ca| sarpāstu pañcamyām| śuklapakṣasya saptamyāmekādaśyāṃ ca yakṣā gṛhṇanti| śuklāṣṭamyādiṣu brahmarākṣasā gṛhṇanti| rakṣaḥpiśācādayaḥ kṛṣṇapakṣe navamīdvādaśyoḥ parvasu ca gṛhṇanti| daśamyādiṣu pitaro gṛhṇanti| apare-anuktā guruvṛddhādayaḥ, aṣṭamīnavamyorgṛhṇanti| pūrvākteṣveva tithiṣu prāyeṇa(yaḥ)-bāhulyena, grahaṇakālaṃ sandhyāsu-parvādiṣu, jānīyāt

ab.seg: phullapadmopamamukhaṃ saumyadṛṣṭimakopanam| alpavāksvedaviṇmūtraṃ bhojanānabhilāṣiṇam||13||
devadvijātiparamaṃ śuciṃ saṃskṛtavādinam| mīlayantaṃ cirānnetre surabhiṃ varadāyinam||14||
śuklamālyāmbarasaricchailoccabhavanapriyam| anidramapradhṛṣyaṃ ca vidyāddevavaśīkṛtam||15||

div.ab: Sa. phullapadmopamamukhamityādi devagrahagṛhītaṃ vidyāt|

ab.seg: jihmadṛṣṭiṃ durātmānaṃ gurudevadvijadviṣam| nirbhayaṃ māninaṃ śūraṃ krodhanaṃ vyavasāyinam||16||
rudraḥ skando viśākho'hamindro'hamiti vādinam| surāmāṃsaruciṃ vidyāt daityagrahagṛhītakam||17||

div.ab: Sa. jihmadṛṣṭimityādilakṣaṇalakṣitaṃ daityavaśīkṛtaṃ vidyāt|
svācāraṃ surabhiṃ hṛṣṭaṃ gītanartanakāriṇam| snānodyānaruciṃ raktavastramālyānulepanam||18|| śṛṅgāralīlābhirataṃ gandharvādhyuṣitaṃ vadet| -------------------------------------------------|19|
Sa. svācāramityādilakṣaṇalakṣitaṃ gandharveṇa gṛhītaṃ vidyāt

-------------------------------------------------| raktākṣaṃ krodhanaṃ stabdhadṛṣṭiṃ vakragatiṃ calam||19|| śvasantamaniśaṃ hihvālolinaṃ sṛkkiṇīliham| priyadugdhaguḍasnānamadhovadanaśāyinam||20|| uragādhiṣṭhitaṃ vidyāttrasyāntaṃ cātapatrataḥ| -------------------------------------------------|21|
Sa. raktākṣamityādilakṣaṇaṃ chatrācca trasyantaṃ sarpādhiṣṭhitaṃ vidyāt|

-------------------------------------------------| viplutatrastaraktāṃkṣaṃ śubhagandhaṃ sutejasam||21|| priyanṛtyakathāgītasnānamālyānulepanam| matsyamāṃsaruciṃ hṛṣṭaṃ tuṣṭaṃ balinamavyatham||22|| calitāgrakaraṃ kasmai kiṃ dadāmīti vādinam| rahasyabhāṣiṇaṃ vaidyadvijātiparibhāvinam||23|| alparoṣaṃ drutagatiṃ vidyādyakṣagṛhītakam| -------------------------------------------------|24|
Sa. viplutatrastaraktākṣamityādilakṣaṇaṃ yakṣagṛhītaṃ vidyāt|

-------------------------------------------------| hāsyanṛtyapriyaṃ raudraceṣṭaṃ chidraprahāriṇam||24|| ākrośinaṃ śīghragatiṃ devadvijabhiṣagdviṣam| ātmānaṃ kāṣṭhaśastrādyairghnantaṃ bhoḥśabdavādinam||25|| śāstravedapaṭhaṃ vidyād gṛhītaṃ brahmarākṣasaiḥ| -------------------------------------------------|26|
Sa. hāsyanṛtyapriyamityādilakṣaṇaṃ brahmarākṣasagṛhītaṃ vidyāt|

ab.seg: -------------------------------------------------| sakrodhadṛṣṭiṃ bhṛkuṭimudvahantaṃ sasaṃbhramam||26||
praharantaṃ pradhāvantaṃ śabdantaṃ bhairavānanam| annādvinā'pi balinaṃ naṣṭanidraṃ niśācaram||27||
nirlajjamaśuciṃ śūraṃ krūraṃ paruṣabhāṣiṇam| roṣaṇaṃ raktamālyastrīraktamadyāmiṣapriyam||28||
dṛṣṭvā ca raktaṃ māṃsaṃ vā''lihānaṃ daśanacchadau| hasantamannakāle ca rākṣasādhiṣṭhitaṃ vadet||29||

div.ab: Sa. sakrodhadṛṣṭimityādilakṣaṇaṃ rākṣasādhiṣṭhitaṃ vadet|

avasthacittaṃ naikatra tiṣṭhantaṃ paridhāvinam| ucchiṣṭanṛtyagāndharvahāsamadyāmiṣapriyam||30|| nirbhartsanāddīnamukhaṃ rudantamanimittataḥ| nakhairlikhantamātmānaṃ rūkṣadhvastavapuḥsvaram||31|| āvedayantaṃ duḥkhāni sambaddhābaddhabhāṣiṇam| naṣṭasmṛtiṃ śūnyaratiṃ lolaṃ nagnaṃ malīmasam||32|| rathyācailaparīdhānaṃ tṛṇamālāvibhūṣaṇam| ārohantaṃ ca kāṣṭhāśvaṃ tathā saṅkarakūṭakam||33|| bahvāśinaṃ piśācena vijānīyādadhiṣṭhitam| -------------------------------------------------|34|
Sa. avasthacittamityādilakṣaṇaṃ piśācagṛhītaṃ vidyāt|
-------------------------------------------------| pretākṛtikriyāgandhaṃ bhītamāhāravidviṣam||34|| tṛṇacchidaṃ ca pretena gṛhītaṃ naramādiśet| -------------------------------------------------|35|
Sa. pretākṛtikriyāgandhamityādilakṣaṇaṃ pretagṛhītaṃ naraṃ vidyāt
-------------------------------------------------| bahupralāpaṃ kṛṣṇāsyaṃ pravilambitayāyinam||35|| śūnapralambavṛṣaṇaṃ kūṣmāṇḍādhiṣṭhitaṃ vadet| -------------------------------------------------|36|
Sa. bahupralāpādilakṣaṇaṃ kūṣmāṇḍādhiṣṭhitaṃ vadet|

ab.seg: -------------------------------------------------| gṛhītvā kāṣṭhaloṣṭādi bhramantaṃ cīravāsasam||36||
nagnaṃ dhāvantamuttrastadṛṣṭiṃ tṛṇavibhūṣaṇam| śmaśānaśūnyāyatanarathyaikadrumasevinam||37||
tilānnamadyamāṃseṣu satataṃ saktalocanam| niṣādādhiṣṭhitaṃ vidyād vadantaṃ paruṣāṇi ca||38||

div.ab: Sa. gṛhītvā kāṣṭhamityādilakṣaṇaṃ tathā paruṣāṇi bhāṣamāṇaṃ niṣādagṛhītaṃ vidyāt|

ab.seg: yācantamudakaṃ cānnaṃ trastalohitalocanam| ugravākyaṃ ca jānīyānnaramaukiraṇārditam||39||

div.ab: Sa. yācantamudakamityādilakṣaṇamaukiraṇārditaṃ vidyāt

ab.seg: gandhamālyaratiṃ satyavādinaṃ parivepinam| bahunidraṃ ca jānīyādvetālena vaśīkṛtam||40||

div.ab: Sa. gandhamālyaratimityādilakṣaṇaṃ vetālagṛhītaṃ vidyāt|

ab.seg: aprasannadṛśaṃ dīnavadanaṃ śuṣkatālukam| calannayanapakṣmāṇaṃ nidrāluṃ mandapāvakam||41||
apasavyaparīdhānaṃ tilamāṃsaguḍapriyam| skhaladvācaṃ ca jānīyāt pitṛgrahavaśīkṛtam||42||

div.ab: Sa. aprasannadṛśamityādilakṣaṇaṃ pitṛgrahagṛhītaṃ vidyāt|

ab.seg: guruvṛddharṣisiddhābhiśāpacintānurūpataḥ| vyāhārāhāraceṣṭābhiryathāsvaṃ tadgrahaṃ vadet||43||

div.ab: Sa. gurvādīnāṃ śāpacintānurūpavacanādibhiryathāyogaṃ tadgrahaṃ vidyāt|

kumāravṛdānugataṃ nagnamuddhatamūrdhajam| asvasthamanasaṃ dairghyakālikaṃ sagrahaṃ tyajet|44| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitā- yāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne bhūta vijñānīyo nāma caturtho'dhyāyaḥ|4|

Sa. sarvagrahagṛhītaṃ tyajet| kīdṛśam ? kumārasamūhenānuyātaṃ, tathā nagnamuddhatakeśaṃ, tathā'svasthacittaṃ, tathā dīrghakālānuvartinaṃ ceti| iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayaṭīkāyāṃ sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne bhūtavijñānīyo nāma caturtho'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 4||

div.head: bhūtapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto bhūtapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātrayādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre||2||

div.ab: Sa. bhūtagrahavijñānādanantaraṃ bhūtasya pratiṣedhaṃ-cikitsitaṃ, ucyate| nanu, nidānacikitsitapadābhyāṃ prasiddhatarābhyāṃ pūrvavatkimitīdaṃ tantrakṛtā nopanibaddham ? iti keciccodyamacūcudan| tān sañcakṣmahe| śāstrakārasyāsyedṛśī pratijñā,-sūtraśārīranidāna cikitsitakalpottarākhyaiḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ sthānaistantramidamabhidheyamiti| tadevaṃ yadyuttare sthāne'pi kiñcinnidānacikitsitapadābhyāmabhidhīyate, tataḥ ṣaṭsthānakamidaṃ tantramiti pratijñāṃ vyāhanyāt| tasmādayaṃ viracanāprakāraviśeṣaḥ kṛtaḥ|

ab.seg: bhūtaṃ jayedahiṃsecchaṃ japahomabalivrataiḥ| tapaḥśīlasamādhānadānajñānadayādibhiḥ||1||

div.ab: Sa. ahiṃsākāmaṃ bhūtaṃ japādibhirjayet|

hiṅguvyoṣālanepālīlaśunārkajaṭājaṭāḥ| ajalomī sagolomī bhūtakeśī vacā latā||2|| kukkuṭī sarpagandhākhyā tilāḥ kāṇavikāṇike| vajraproktā vayaḥsthā ca śṛṅgī mohanavallyapi||3|| srotojāñjanarakṣoghnaṃ rakṣoghnaṃ cānyadauṣadham| kharāśvaśvāviduṣṭrarkṣagodhānakulaśalyakāt||4|| dvīpimārjāragosiṃhavyāghrasāmudrasattvataḥ| carmapittadvijanakhā varge'smin sādhayedghṛtam||5|| purāṇamathavā tailaṃ navaṃ tatpānanasyayoḥ| abhyaṅge ca prayoktavyameṣāṃ cūrṇaṃ ca dhūpane||6|| ebhiśca guṭikāṃ yuñjyādañjane sāvapīḍane| pralepe kalkameteṣāṃ kvāthaṃ ca pariṣecane||7|| prayogo'yaṃ grahonmādān sāpasmārāñśamaṃ nayet| --------------------------------------------------|8|

Sa. hiṅgvādaya auṣadham| ālaṃ-haritālam| nepālī- kastūrikā| jaṭā-jaṭāmāṃsī| ajalomī-śvetadūrvā| golomī-dūrvā| latā-priyaṅguḥ| kukkuṭī-śitivārakaḥ| sarpagandhākhyā-nākulī| kāṇaviṣā(kā)ṇike-kākolīkṣīrakākolyau| śṛṅgī-ativiṣā| mohanavallī-vandākaḥ| anyadapi rakṣoghnaṃ guggulvādikamauṣadham| tathā gardabhaturaṅgādibhyaścarmādayaḥ| sāmudrasattvato-jaladhijantoḥ| tadetasmin hiṅgvādivarge, ghṛtaṃ purāṇamathavā navaṃ tailaṃ pacet-sādhayet| tacca-ghṛtaṃ tailaṃ vā, siddhaṃ pāne nasye'bhyaṅge ca prayojyam| eṣāṃ dravyāṇāṃ ca cūrṇaṃ dhūpane prayojyam| ebhiścūrṇairguṭikāmañjane'vapīḍane ca yuñjyāt| eteṣāṃ ca dravyāṇāṃ kalkaṃ pralepe kvāthaṃ pariṣecane ca yuñjyāt| ayaṃ prayogo grahādīn śamayet|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------| gajāhvāpippalīmūlavyoṣāmalakasarṣapān||8||
godhānakulamārjārajhaṣapittaprapeṣitān| nāvanābhyaṅgasekeṣu vidadhīta grahāpahān||9||

div.ab: Sa. hastipippalyādīni(n) godhādipittapiṣṭāni(n) nasyābhyaṅgasekeṣu grahāpahān kuryāt| mūlaṃ-puṣkaramūlam| jhaṣo jalacarabhedaḥ|

siddhārthakavacāhiṅgupriyaṅgurajanīdvayam| mañjiṣṭhā śvetakaṭabhī varā śvetā'drikarṇikā||10|| nimbasya patraṃ bījaṃ tu naktamālaśirīṣayoḥ| surāhvaṃ tryūṣaṇaṃ sarpirgomūtre taiścaturguṇe||11|| siddhaṃ siddhārthakaṃ nāma pāne nasye ca yojitam| grahān sarvānnihantyāśu viśeṣādāsurān grahān||12|| kṛtyālakṣmīviṣonmādajvarāpasmārapāpma ca| -----------------------------------------------|13|

Sa. sarṣapādi gomūtre caturguṇe sarpiḥ siddhaṃ siddhārthakasaṃjñaṃ pāne nasye ca yojitaṃ sarvān grahān drāk nāśayati| viśeṣeṇāsuragrahān kṛtyādīṃśca| śvetakaṭabhī-śvetaguñjā| śvetā'drikarṇikā-śuklā girikarṇikā|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------| ebhirevauṣadhairbastavāriṇā kalpito'gadaḥ||13||
pānanasyāñjanālepasnānoddharṣaṇayojitaḥ| guṇaiḥ pūrvavaduddiṣṭo rājadvāre ca siddhikṛt||14||

div.ab: Sa. ebhireva dravyaiśchāgamūtreṇa kalpito'gadaḥ pānādiṣu yojito guṇaiḥ pūrveṇa tulya ukto rājadvāre ca siddhikaraḥ syāt|

ab.seg: siddhārthakavyoṣavacāśvagandhā- niśādvayaṃ hiṅgupalāṇḍukandaḥ| bījaṃ karañjāt, kusumaṃ śirīṣāt phalaṃ ca valkaṃ ca kapitthavṛkṣāt||15||
samāṇimanthaṃ sanataṃ sakuṣṭhaṃ syonākamūlaṃ kiṇihī sitā ca| bastasya mūtreṇa subhāvitaṃ tat pittena gavyena guḍān vidadhyāt||16||
duṣṭavraṇonmādatamoniśāndhā- nudbandhakān vārinimagnadehān| digdhāhatān darpitasarpadaṣṭāṃ- ste sādhayantyañjananasyalepaiḥ||17||

div.ab: Sa. siddhārthakādi bastamūtreṇa subhāvitaṃ gavyena pittena guḍān-guḍakān, kuryāt| te ca-guḍakāḥ, añjananasyalepairduṣṭavraṇādīn sādhayanti| upajātivṛtte indravajrā ca|

ab.seg: kārpāsāsthimayūrapatrabṛhatīnirmālyapiṇḍītaka- tvaṅmāṃsīvṛṣadaṃśaviṭtuṣavacākeśāhinirmokakaiḥ| nāgendradvijaśṛṅgahiṅgumaricaistulyaiḥ kṛtaṃ dhūpanaṃ skandonmādapiśācarākṣasasurāveśajvaraghnaṃ param||18||

div.ab: Sa. kārpāsāsthyādibhiḥ kṛtaṃ dhūpanaṃ skandādighnaṃ paraṃ syāt| nirmālyaṃ-mahādevasambandhi| vṛṣadaṃśaviṭ-mārjāraviṣṭhā| śārdūlavikrīḍitaṃ vṛttam|

ab.seg: trikaṭukadalakuṅkumagranthikakṣārasiṃhī- niśādārusiddhārthayugmāmbuśakrāhvayaiḥ sitalaśunaphalatrayośīratiktāvacā- tutthayaṣṭībalālohitailāśilāpadmakaiḥ| dadhitagaramadhūkasārapriyāhvāviṣākhyā- viṣātārkṣyaśailaiḥ sacavyāmayaiḥ kalkitairghṛtamanavamaśeṣamūtrāṃśasiddhaṃ mataṃ bhūtarāvāhvayaṃ pānatastad grahaghnaṃ param||19||

div.ab: Sa. trikaṭukādibhiḥ kalkitaiḥ purāṇaṃ sarpiraśeṣamūtrāṇāṃ- gomūtrādīnāṃ, aṃśaiḥ bhāgaiḥ, siddhaṃ bhūtarāvasaṃjñaṃ matam| tat pāne(nataḥ) paraṃ grahaghnaṃ syāt| dalaṃ-tamālapatram| siddhārthayugmaṃ-pītakṛṣṇabhedena| tutthaṃ-karpārikātuttham| śakrāhvayāḥ-indrayavāḥ| sitalaśunaṃ-śuklarasonam| priyāhvā-kaṅguṇikā| viṣākhyā-ativiṣā| viṣā-kākolī| "prathamaka iha daṇḍakaścaṇḍavṛṣṭiprayāto nadvayānāpyanāpyaraiḥ saptabhiḥ| pratipadamiha vṛddhirephavṛddhyā syurarṇārṇavavyālabīmūtalīlākaroddāmaśaṅkhādayaḥ||

ab.seg: natamadhukarañjalākṣāpaṭolīsamaṅgāvacā- pāṭalīhiṅgusiddhārthasiṃhīniśāyuglatārohiṇī- badarakaṭuphalatrikākāṇḍadārukṛmighnājagandhā- marāṅkollakośātakīśigrunimbāmbudendrāhvayaiḥ| gadaśukatarupuṣpabījograyaṣṭyadrikarṇīnikumbhā- gnibilvaiḥ samaiḥkalkitairmūtravargeṇa siddhaṃ ghṛtaṃ vidhivinihitamāśu sarvaiḥ kramairyojitaṃ hanti sarvagrahonmādakuṣṭhajvarāṃstanmahābhūtarāvaṃ smṛtam||20||

div.ab: Sa. natādibhirmūtravargeṇa-gomūtrādimūtrakadambakena, sarpiḥ pakvaṃ vidhivinihitaṃ sarvaiḥ kramaiḥ-abhyaṅgapānanasyādibhiḥ, yojitaṃ śīghraṃ sarvān grahādīn hanti| etacca mahābhūtarāvasaṃjñaṃ ghṛtam| daṇḍako vyālākhyaḥ|

ab.seg: grahā gṛhṇanti ye yeṣu teṣāṃ teṣu viśeṣataḥ| dineṣu balihomādīn prayuñjīta cikitsakaḥ||21||

div.ab: Sa. yeṣu dineṣu grahā gṛhṇanti teṣu dineṣu teṣāṃ grahāṇāṃ viśeṣeṇa balihomādīn bhiṣak prayuñjīta|

ab.seg: snānavastravasāmāṃsamadyakṣīraguḍādi ca| rocate yadyadā yebhyastatteṣāmāharettadā||22||

div.ab: Sa. snānavastrādi yadyebhyo grahebhyo rocate tattebhyastasmin dine dadyāt|

ab.seg: ratnāni gandhamālyāni bījāni madhusarpiṣī| bhakṣyāśca sarve sarveṣāṃ sāmānyo vidhirityayam||23||

div.ab: Sa. tathā ratnādīni tathā bījāni-yavādīni, madhusarpiṣī sarve ca bhakṣyāḥ sarveṣāṃ grahāṇām| ityayaṃ sāmānyo vidhiḥ|

surarṣiguruvṛddhebhyaḥ siddhebhyaśca surālaye| diśyuttarasyāṃ tatrāpi devāyopaharedbalim||24|| paścimāyāṃ yathākālaṃ daityabhūtāya catvare| gandharvāya gavāṃ mārge savastrābharaṇaṃ balim||25|| pitṛnāgagrahe nadyāṃ nāgebhyaḥ pūrvadakṣiṇe| yakṣāya yakṣāyatane saritorvā samāgame||26|| catuṣpathe rākṣasāya bhīmeṣu gahaneṣu ca| rakṣasāṃ dakṣiṇasyāṃ tu pūrvasyāṃ brahmarakṣasām||27|| śūnyālaye piśācāya paścimāṃ diśamāsthite| -----------------------------------------------|28|

Sa. surādibhyaḥ pañcabhyaḥ surālaye baliṃ dadyāt| tatrāpi devāyottarasyāṃ balimupaharet| daityabhūtāya paścimāyāṃ diśicatvare balimupaharet| gavāṃ pathi vastrābharaṇasahitaṃ baliṃ gandharvāyopaharet| pitṛnāgagrahebhyo nadyāṃ baliṃ dadyāt| nāgebhyaḥ pūrvadakṣiṇadeśe baliṃ dadyāt| yakṣāya yakṣaprāsāde athavā saritoḥ-nadyoḥ, samāgame balimupaharet| rākṣasaśabdeneha brahmarākṣaso gṛhyate| rākṣasāya catuṣpathe bhayānakeṣu vaneṣu ca baliṃ dadyāt| dakṣiṇasyāṃ tu diśi rākṣasānāṃ baliṃ dadyāt| pūrvasyāṃ diśi brahmarakṣasām| śūnyālaye paścimāṃ diśamāsthite piśācāya baliṃ dadyāt|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------| śuciśuklāni mālyāni gandhāḥ kṣaireyamodanam||28||
dadhi chatraṃ ca dhavalaṃ devānāṃ baliriṣyate| hiṅgusarṣapaṣaḍgranthāvyoṣairardhapalonmitaiḥ||29||
caturguṇe gavāṃ mūtre ghṛtaprasthaṃ vipācayet| tatpānanāvanābhyaṅgairdevagrahavimokṣaṇam||30||

div.ab: Sa. śuciśuklamālyādikaṃ ca devānāṃ baliriṣyate| hiṃgvādibhirardhapalikaiḥ sarpiḥprasthaṃ caturguṇe gomūtre vipācayet| tatpānādibhirdevagrahavimokṣaṇaṃ syāt|
nasyāñjanaṃ vacāhiṅgulaśunaṃ bastavāriṇā| -----------------------------------------------|31|
Sa. vacāhiṅgulaśunaṃ chāgamūtreṇa nasyamañjanaṃ ca dadyāt|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------| daitye balirbahuphalaḥ sośīrakamalotpalaḥ||31||

div.ab: Sa. daityagrahe balirbahūni phalāni yasmin, tathośīrakamalotpalairyukto deyaḥ|

nāgānāṃ sumanolājaguḍāpūpaguḍaudanaiḥ| paramānnamadhukṣīrakṛṣṇamṛnnāgakesaraiḥ||32|| vacāpadmapurośīraraktotpaladalairbaliḥ| śvetapatraṃ ca rodhraṃ ca tagaraṃ nāgasarṣapāḥ||33|| śītena vāriṇā piṣṭaṃ nāvanāñjanayorhitam| -----------------------------------------------|34|
Sa. nāgānāṃ sumanolājādibhirbalirdeyaḥ| śvetapatrādayaḥ śītalajalapiṣṭā nasye'ñjane ca hitāḥ| śvetapatraṃ śukla puṇḍarīkam|
-----------------------------------------------| yakṣāṇāṃ kṣīradadhyājyamiśrakaudanaguggulu||34|| devadārūtpalaṃ padmamuśīraṃ vastrakāñcanam| hiraṇyaṃ ca baliryojyo------------------------|35|
Sa. yakṣāṇāṃ kṣīrādibhirbaliryojyaḥ|
Sa. gomūtrakṣīraghṛtaṃ tulyapramāṇamekasmin pakvaṃ nasyābhyañjanayorhitam|

---------------------------------------------------| haritakī haridre dve laśuno maricaṃ vacā||36|| nimbapatram ca bastāmbukalkitaṃ nāvanāñjanam| ---------------------------------------------------|37|
Sa. harītakyādi chāgamūtreṇa piṣṭaṃ nāvanāñjane hitam|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------------| brahmarakṣobaliḥ siddhaṃ yavānāṃ pūrṇamāḍhakam||37||
toyasya kumbhaḥ palalaṃ chatraṃ vastraṃ vilepanam| ---------------------------------------------------||38||

div.ab: Sa. pakvaṃ yavānāmāḍhakaṃ-pātraṃ, pūrṇaṃ jalakumbhaḥ palalaṃ chatraṃ vastraṃ pralepanamiti brahmarākṣasāya baliṃ dadyāt| yavānāṃ pūrṇaṃ siddhamāḍhakaṃ-pakvapātraṃ, yavaiḥ pūrṇaṃ pakvapātramityarthaḥ| pūraṇārthe'traṣaṣṭhī| āḍhakaśabdo'tra pātravācako na tu mānavācakaḥ| pakvapātraṃ-pakvaśarāvamiti

---------------------------------------------------| naktamālaśirīṣatvaṅmūlapuṣpaphalāni ca||41|| tadvacca kṛṣṇapāṭalyā bilvamūlaṃ kaṭutrikam| hiṃgvindrayavasiddhārthalaśunāmalakīphalam||42|| nāvanāñjanayoryojyo bastamūtrayuto'gadaḥ| ---------------------------------------------------|43|
Sa. naktamālādikaṃ bastamūtreṇa yutamagado nasyābhyañjanayoryojyaḥ|

---------------------------------------------------| ebhireva ghṛtaṃ siddhaṃ gavāṃ mūtre caturguṇe||43|| rakṣograhān vārayate pānābhyañjananāvanaiḥ| ---------------------------------------------------|44|
Sa. ebhireva dravyairghṛtaṃ gomūtre caturguṇe siddhaṃ pānādibhī rakṣograhanivāraṇaṃ syāt|

---------------------------------------------------| piśācānāṃ baliḥ sīdhuḥ piṇyākaḥ palalaṃ dadhi||44|| mūlakaṃ lavaṇaṃ sarpiḥ sabhūtaudanayāvakam| ---------------------------------------------------|45|
Sa. piśācānāṃ sīdhvādibhirbalirdeyaḥ|

---------------------------------------------------| haridrādvayamañjiṣṭhāmiśisaindhavanāgaram||45|| hiṅgupriyaṅgutrikaṭurasonatriphalā vacā| pāṭalīśvetakaṭabhīśirīṣakusumairghṛtam||46|| gomūtrapādikaṃ siddhaṃ pānābhyañjanayorhitam| ---------------------------------------------------|47|
Sa. haridrādvayādibhirgomūtrapādikaṃ ghṛtaṃ pakvaṃ pānābhyañjanayorhitam|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------------| bastāmbupiṣṭaistaireva yojyamañjananāvanam||47||

div.ab: Sa. bastāmbupiṣṭairetaireva dravyairnasyamañjanaṃ ca hitamuktam|

ab.seg: devarṣipitṛgandharve tīkṣṇaṃ nasyādi varjayet| sarpiṣpānādi mṛdvasmin bhaiṣajyamavacārayet||48||

div.ab: Sa. devarṣipitṛgandharve tīkṣṇaṃ nasyādi na yojayet| mṛdu sarpiṣpānādikamauṣadhamatra yojyam|

ab.seg: ṛte piśācātsarveṣu pratikūlaṃ ca nācaret| savaidyamāturaṃ ghnanti kruddhāste hi mahaujasaḥ||49||

div.ab: Sa. sarveṣu ca graheṣu piśācamantareṇa pratikūlaṃ nācaret| te hi devādayo mahaujasaḥ pratikūlācaraṇāt kruddhāḥ santaḥ vaidyasahitamāturaṃ ghnanti|
īśvaraṃ dvādaśabhujaṃ nāthamāryāvalokitam| sarvavyādhicikitsāṃ ca japan sarvagrahān jayet||50|| tathonmādānapasmārānanyaṃ vā cittaviplavam| ---------------------------------------------------|51|
Sa. īśvaraṃ dvādaśabhujaṃ nāthamāryāvalokitaṃ tathā sarvavyādhicikitsitamityādi japan sarvān grahānunmādādīṃśca parākaroti|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------------| mahāvidyāṃ ca māyūrīṃ śuciṃ taṃ śrāvayetsadā||51||

div.ab: Sa. māyurīṃ mahāvidyāṃ taṃ-grahagṛhītaṃ, śuciṃ santaṃ satataṃ śrāvayet|

ab.seg: bhūteśaṃ pūjayet sthāṇuṃ pramathākhyāṃśca tadgaṇān| japan siddhāṃśca tanmantrān grahān sarvānapohati||52||

div.ab: Sa. tathā sthāṇuṃ bhūtādhipaṃ pūjayet| tathā tasya gaṇān pramathasaṃjñān pūjayet grahān parākaroti| | siddhāṃśca tanmantrān japan sarvān

ab.seg: yaccānantarayoḥ kiñcidvakṣyate'dhyāyayorhitam| yaccoktamiha tatsarvaṃ prayuñjīta parasparam||53||
iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭavira- citāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttara- sthāne bhūtapratiṣedho nāma pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ||5||

div.ab: Sa. yadapynantarayoradhyāyayoḥ-unmādāpasmārapratiṣedhākhyayoḥ, vakṣyati-bhaṇiṣyati, taccātra hitam| yacca,[iha-]asminnadhyāye, devagrahādīnāṃ pṛthak cikitsitaṃ kathitaṃ tadapi parasparaṃ grahāṇāṃ prayuñjīteti| iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdaya- ṭīkāyāṃ sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne bhūta- pratiṣedho nāma pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 5|| ā raṃ-dravadravyavijñānīyamadhyāyaṃ vyākhyātu pratijānīte-atheti| yataḥ pūrvaistribhiradhyāyairvihāra uktaḥ| āhāro vaktvyaḥ| sa ca dvividhaḥ,-dravo'dravaśca| tatra dravo'sminnadhyāye| ata evāyaṃ dravadravyavijñānīyaḥ| tatra ca pañca vargāḥ| vakṣyati hi (hṛ. sū.a. 5183)- "toyakṣīrekṣutailānaṃ vargairmadyasya ca kramāt" iti| ā raṃ-tatrādou toyavargaḥ| tattoyaṃ dvedhā,- divyaṃ bhaumaṃ ca| divyaṃ caturdhā,- dhāraṃ kāraṃ touṣāraṃ haimaṃ ca| dhāraṃ dvedhā,-gāṅgaṃ sāmudraṃ ca| tatra gāṅgaguṇānāha-jīvanamiti| jīvanaṃ prāṇadhāraṇam| tarpaṇaṃ-tṛptijananam| hṛdyaṃ-hṛdayasya priyam, tatprasādakaratvāt| hlādi-sukhajanakam| buddhiprabodhanaṃ-prajñāvikāśajanakam| tanu-sarvebhyo'pi viralam| acyaktarasaṃ-rasavadapyanabhivyaktamadhurādirasaviśeṣam| mṛṣṭam-jihvendriyapriyam| śītaṃ-sparśavīryābhyām| laghu-śīghrapākam| amṛtopamaṃ-devānāmamṛtamivedaṃ manuṣyāṇām| gaṅgāmbu-ākāśagaṅgātoyaṃ meghairānītam| nabhaso bhRaṣṭaṃ-ākāśātpatitam, divyamityarthaḥ| gaṅgāmbvati sāmudrasya vyāvṛttyartham| nabhaso bhraṣṭamiti bhaumasya| divyasya bhaumādviśeṣamāha-spṛṣṭamiti| divyameva bhūsambandhādbhaumamucyate-spṛṣṭamiti| devyameva bhūsambandhādbhaumamucyate| taccārkādibhiḥ spṛśyate| spṛṣṭaṃ ca vyaktarasatvādidoṣasambandhāddhitāhitatve bhūyo deśakālāvapekṣate| bhūyograhaṇaṃ divyasyāpi kiñciddeśakālāpekṣatvaṃ dyotayati| deśāpekṣā yathā-supātrasthaṃ hitam, ahitaṃ duṣpātrastham| vakṣyati hi-"endramambu supātrasthamavipannaṃ sadā pibet|" iti| kālāpekṣā yathā-ārtavaṃ hitam, anārtavamahitam| vakṣyati hi-"anārtavaṃ ca yaddivyamārtavaṃ prathamaṃ ca yat " iti| bhaumaṃ tu bhūyastato'pyadhikamapekṣate| tatra deśāpekṣā yathā-jāṅgale hitam, ahitamanūpe| tatrāpi śucyādou hitam, ahitamaśucyādou| tatrāpi kūpādou hitam, ahitaṃ ṣalvalādou| tatrāpi supātre hitam, ahitaṃ duṣpātre| tatrāpi kvaciddehe hitam, ahitaṃ kvacit ityādi| kālāpekṣā yathāśaraddhīṣmayorhitam, ahitamanyadā| tatrāpi divā hitam, ahitaṃ rātrou| tatrāpi bhuktasya madhye hitam, ahitamantādyoḥ, ityādi| divyaṃ sarvadā sarvatra sarveṣāṃ hitam| ā raṃ-gāṅgaṃ lakṣayati-yenābhivṛṣṭamiti| abhivṛṣṭaṃ dhārāsampātena siktam| rājate-roupyapātre| aklinnaṇ-sikthaprakledarahitam| avivarṇaṃ-varṇāntararahitam| parīkṣā ca muhūrtamātram| uktaṃ hi suśrute (sū. a. 4517)- "sa yadi muhūrtamātraṃ sthitastādṛśa eva bhavati, tadā tadā patatītyavagantavyam" iti| peyaṃ-pānārham| ā raṃ-sāmudraṃ lakṣayati-anyathā sāmudramiti| anyathā-kledavaivarṇyotpattau| sāmudrapānaṃ niṣedhayati-tanneti| tat sāmudram, māsādāśvayujādvinā, gṛhītamiti śeṣaḥ| uktaṃ hi suśrute (sū. a. 45/7)-"sāmudramapyāśvayuje māsi gṛhītaṃ gaṅgāvadbhavati" iti| ā raṃ-divyapānaṃ vidhatte-endramiti| endraṃ-divyam| supātrasthaṃ-śuddhasauvarṇādipātrastham| uktaṃ hi saṅgrahe (sū. a. 6)-"khātadhautaśilāpṛṣṭhavastrādibhyaḥ srutaṃ jalam| haimamṛnmayayātrasthamavipannaṃ sadā pibet||" iti| avipannaṃ-sparśarasādivikṛtirahitam| sadā-sarveṣu ṛtuṣu| bhaumapānaṃ vidhatte-tadabhāva iti| tadabhāve-divyābhāve| bhūmiṣṭhaṃ-bhaumam| āntarikṣānukāri-divyasadṛśaguṇam| śucyādau deśe sthitam| śuciḥ-nirmalaḥ| pṛthuḥ-vistīrṇaḥ| asitaḥ-kṛṣṇaḥ| śveto-dhavalaḥ| asitaḥ-kṛṣṇaḥ| śveto-dhavalaḥ|

div.head: unmādapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāta unmādapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre||2||

div.ab: Sa. bhūtapratiṣedhādanantaramunmādāpasmārapratiṣedha ucyate, cikitsāsāmānyāt| tatrāpyapasmārādunmādasya pūrvamupanyāso bahuvaktavyatvādityāha- unmādasya pratiṣedha-cikitsitaṃ, bhaṇiṣyāmaḥ|
unmādāḥ ṣaṭ pṛthagdoṣanicayādhiviṣodbhavāḥ| ----------------------------------------------|1|
Sa. pratyekaṃ doṣaistrayaḥ sānnipātika ādhijo viṣajaśceti|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------| unmādo nāma manaso doṣairunmārgagairmadaḥ||1||

div.ab: Sa. unmādo doṣaiḥ-vātapittakaphaiḥ, unmārgagaiḥ-apathaprasthitaiḥ, manaso yo madaḥ sa unmādo nāma roga ucyate|

adhunā vistareṇotpattikramamunmādānāmāha ---- śārīramānasairduṣṭairahitādannapānataḥ| vikṛtāsātmyasamalādviṣamādupayogataḥ||2|| viṣaṇṇasyālpasattvasya vyādhivegasamudgamāt| kṣīṇasya ceṣṭāvaiṣamyāt pūjyapūjāvyatikramāt||3|| ādhibhiścittavibhraṃśād viṣeṇopaviṣeṇa ca| ebhirhi hīnasattvasya hṛdi doṣāḥ pradūṣitāḥ||4|| dhiyo vidhāya kāluṣyaṃ hatva mārgān manovahān| unmādaṃ kurvate, tena dhīvijñānasmṛtibhramāt||5|| deho duḥkhasukhabhraṣṭo bhraṣṭasārathivadrathaḥ| bhramatyacintitārambhaḥ-------------------------|6|

Sa. śārīramānasairdoṣairduṣṭairyāvadupaviṣeṇa ceti| ebhiḥ-amībhirhetubhiḥ, doṣā hṛdaye pradūṣitāḥ santo hīnasattvasya puṃso buddheḥ kāluṣyaṃ kṛtvā tathā cittavahāni srotāṃsi hatvonmādaṃ kurvate| tena-unmādena, deho buddhibhramānnaṣṭasukhaduḥkho bhraṣṭasārathiriva ratho bhramati| acintitaḥ-anirūpitakriyaḥ, ārambhaḥ-udyamo, yasya sa evam|

iti sāmānyalakṣaṇamunmādasyoktvā pavanādijasya viśiṣṭaṃ lakṣaṇamāha ---- ----------------------------------------------| ----------------------tatra vātātkṛśāṅgatā||6|| asthāne rodanākrośahasitasmitanartanam| gītavāditravāgaṅgavikṣepāsphoṭanāni ca||7|| asāmnā veṇuvīṇādiśabdānukaraṇaṃ muhuḥ| āsyātphenāgamo'jasramaṭanaṃ bahubhāṣitā||8|| alaṅkāro'nalaṅkārairayānairgamanodyamaḥ| gṛddhirabhyavahāryeṣu tallābhe cāvamānatā||9|| utpiṇḍitāruṇākṣitvaṃ jīrṇe cānne gadodbhavaḥ| ----------------------------------------------|10|
Sa. vātādunmāde sati kṛśāṅgādilakṣaṇaṃ ca jīrṇe cānne gadodbhava ityantam| asthāne-aprasaṅge, rodanādīni| asāmnā auddhatyena, punaḥpunaḥ veṇuvīṇādivādyasyānukaraṇam|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------| pittātsantarjanaṃ krodho muṣṭiloṣṭādyabhidravaḥ||10||
śītacchāyodakākāṅkṣā nagnatvaṃ pītavarṇatā| asatyajvalanajvālātārakādīpadarśanam||11||

div.ab: Sa. pittādunmāde sati santarjanakrodhādayaḥ syuḥ| asatyānāṃ jvalanādīnāṃ darśanam|

ab.seg: kaphādarocakaśchardiralpehāhāravākyatā| strīkāmatā rahaḥprītirlālāsiṅghāṇakasrutiḥ||12||
baibhatsyaṃ śaucavidveṣo nidrā śvayathurānane| unmādo balavān rātrau bhuktamātre ca jāyate||13||

div.ab: Sa. kaphādunmāde satyarocakādayaḥ syuḥ| tathā rātrau balavān sadyo bhukte ca syāt|

ab.seg: sarvāyatanasaṃsthānasannipāte tadātmakam| unmādaṃ dāruṇaṃ vidyāt taṃ bhiṣak parivarjayet||14||

div.ab: Sa. āyatanāni-nimittāni, saṃsthānāni-liṅgāni, sarvāṇi tridoṣaviṣayāṇyāyatanāni saṃsthānāni ca yasmin sannipāte| tadātmakaṃ-tridoṣottham, unmādaṃ dāruṇaṃ-māraṇātmakaṃ, vidyāt| taṃ-unmādaṃ, nopakramet|

ab.seg: atha cittajamunmādaṃ vakti ---- dhanakāntādināśena duḥsahenābhiṣaṅgavān| pāṇḍurdīno muhurmuhyan hāheti paridevate||15||
rodityakasmānmriyate tadguṇān bahu manyate| śokakliṣṭamanā dhyāyan jāgarūko viceṣṭate||16||

div.ab: Sa. dhanādināśena duḥsahenābhiṣaṅgavānunmādaḥ syāt| tena pāṇḍvādikaḥ sannidamidaṃ karoti| tathā śokakhinnacetāḥ san dhyāyan jāgaraṇaśīlo viceṣṭate|

ab.seg: viṣeṇa śyāvavadano naṣṭacchāyābalendriyaḥ| vegāntare'pi sambhrānto raktākṣastaṃ vivarjayet||17||

div.ab: Sa. viṣeṇonmāde śyāvavadanaḥ syāt| taṃ varjayet-nopakramet|

ab.seg: athānilaja unmāde snehapānaṃ prayojayet| pūrvamāvṛtamārge tu sasnehaṃ mṛdu śodhanam||18||

div.ab: Sa. athedṛśyunmādalakṣaṇe'vagate sati pavanajo ya unmādastasmin snehapānaṃ pūrvaṃ kārayet| āvṛtavartmani tvanile sasnehaṃ mṛdu śodhanaṃ pūrvaṃ snehapānāt kārayet|
kaphapittabhave'pyādau vamanaṃ savirecanam| sasnigdhasvinnasya bastiṃ ca śirasaḥ savirecanam||19|| tathā'sya śuddhadehasya prasādaṃ labhate manaḥ| ----------------------------------------------|20|

Sa. kaphabhave pittabhave conmāde snigdhasvinnasya narasya yathāsaṅkhyaṃ vamanaṃ virecanaṃ ca kārayet| apiśabdānna kevalaṃ pavanajesnehapānamādau, yāvat kaphapittotthe'pi kāryamiti gamayati| tathā ca muniḥ(?)-"unmādaṃ snehapānena pūrvaṃ sarvamupācaret|" iti| bastiṃ śirasaḥ savirecanaṃ triṣvapyunmādeṣu kārayet| tathā ca-evaṃ, śuddhaśarīrasya sato manaḥ prasīdati|

----------------------------------------------| itthamapyanuvṛttau tu tīkṣṇaṃ nāvanamañjanam||20|| harṣaṇāśvāsanottrāsabhayatāḍanatarjanam| abhyaṅgodvartanālepadhūpān pānaṃ ca sarpiṣaḥ||21|| yuñjyāttāni hi śuddhasya nayanti prakṛtiṃ manaḥ| ----------------------------------------------|22|
Sa. evamapyupakrānta unmāde'syānubandhe sati tīkṣṇaṃ nāvanāñjanaṃ yuñjyāt, harṣaṇādi ca| kutaḥ ? yasmādetāni kṛtāni śuddhadehasya cittaṃ prakṛtiṃ prāpayanti|
----------------------------------------------| hiṅgusauvarcalavyoṣairdvipalāṃśairghṛtāḍhakam||22|| siddhaṃ samūtramunmādabhūtāpasmāranutparam| ----------------------------------------------|23|
Sa. hiṅgvādibhirdvipalikairghṛtasyāḍhakaṃ gomūtreṇa saha pacet| taccopayuktaṃ paramamunmādādijit|

----------------------------------------------| dvau prasthau svarasād brāhayā ghṛtaprasthaṃ ca sādhitam||23|| vyoṣaśyāmātrivṛddantīśaṅkhapuṣpīnṛpadrumaiḥ| sasaptalākṛmiharaiḥ kalkitairakṣasammitaiḥ||24|| palavṛddhyā prayuñjīta paraṃ mātrā catuṣpalam| unmādakuṣṭhāpasmāraharaṃ vandhyāsutapradam||25|| vāksvarasmṛtimedhākṛd dhanyaṃ brāhmīghṛtaṃ smṛtam| ----------------------------------------------|26|

Sa. brāhmīsvarasātprasthadvayaṃ ghṛtasya prasthaṃ vyoṣādibhiḥ kārṣikai rajīkṛtaiḥ pakvaṃ palavṛddhyā-palaṃ prathame'hni dvipalaṃ dvitīye'hni tripalaṃ tṛtīye'hni catuṣpalaṃ caturthe'hne tataḥ paraṃ catuṣpalamityevaṃ, prayuñjīta| tacconmādādijidvandhyāsutapradaṃ vāgādikṛcchivaṃ ca brāhmīghṛtaṃ smṛtam|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------| varāviśālābhadrailādevadārvelavālukaiḥ||26||
dvisārivādvirajanīdvisthirāphalinīnataiḥ| bṛhatīkuṣṭhamañjiṣṭhānāgakesaradāḍimaiḥ||27||
vellatālīsapatrailāmālatīmukulotpalaiḥ| sadantīpadmakahimaiḥ karṣāṃśaiḥ sarpiṣaḥ pacet||28||
prasthaṃ bhūtagrahonmādakāsāpasmārapāpmasu| pāṇḍukaṇḍūviṣe śoṣe mohe mehe gare jvare||29||
aretasyaprajasi vā daivopahatacetasi| amedhasi skhaladvāci smṛtikāme'lpapāvake||30||
balyaṃ maṅgalyamāyuṣyaṃ kāntisaubhāgyapuṣṭidam| kalyāṇakamidaṃ sarpiḥ śreṣṭhaṃ puṃsavaneṣu ca||31||

div.ab: Sa. varādibhiḥ karṣapramāṇairghṛtaprasthaṃ pacet| taccopayuktaṃ bhūtagrahādiṣu śreṣṭhaṃ balyādiguṇaṃ ca| kalyāṇakākhyametatsarpiḥ puṃsavaneṣu ca varam| atra ca bhadrailā-sthūlailā|

ebhyo dvisārivādīni jale paktvaikaviṃśatim| rase tasmin pacetsarpirgṛṣṭikṣīracaturguṇam||32|| vīrādvimedākākolīkapikacchūviṣāṇibhiḥ| śūrpaparṇīyutairetanmahākalyāṇakaṃ param||33|| bṛṃhaṇaṃ sannipātaghnaṃ pūrvasmādadhikaṃ guṇaiḥ| ----------------------------------------------|34|

Sa. ebhyo-varādibhyo, madhyādādyāni sapta hitvā, dvisārivādīnyekaviṃśatiṃ jale ṣoḍaśaguṇe snehāpekṣayā pacedyāvatsnehāccaturguṇaḥ kvāthaḥ| tasmin snehacaturguṇe rase sarpirgṛṣṭikṣīracaturguṇaṃ vīrādibhiḥ snehakvathitaiḥ pādikaiḥ kalkīkṛtaiḥ pacet| etanmahākalyāṇakaṃ nāma ghṛtaṃ pūrvasmāt-kalyāṇakāt, guṇairatiriktam| atra dvisārivādināṃ pāṭhādevaikaviṃśatitvaṃ cet atadguṇasaṃvijñāno'yaṃ bahuvrīhiriti kasyacid bhrāntiḥ syāt| evaṃ ca sārivādidvayasya grahaṇaṃ na prāpnuyādityekaviṃśatigrahaṇam

----------------------------------------------| jaṭilā pūtanā keśī cāraṭī markaṭī vacā||34|| trāyamāṇā jayā vīrā corakaḥ kaṭurohiṇī| vayaḥsthā śūkarī chatrā sāticchatrā palaṅkaṣā||35|| mahāpuruṣadantā ca kāyasthā nākulīdvayam| kaṭambharā vṛścikālī śāliparṇī ca tairghṛtam||36|| siddhaṃ cāturthikonmādagrahāpasmāranāśanam| mahāpaiśācakaṃ nāma ghṛtametadyathā'mṛtam||37|| buddhimedhāsmṛtikaraṃ bālānaṃ cāṅgavardhanam| ----------------------------------------------|38|

Sa. jaṭilādibhirghṛtaṃ pakvaṃ cāturthikādināśanam| jaṭilāmāṃsī| pūtanā-harītakī| keśī-gandhamāṃsī| caraṭī-padmacāriṇī| markaṭī-kapikacchūḥ| jayā-araṇikā| vīrā-kākolī| corakaḥ-caṇḍā| vayaḥsthā-dhātrī| śūkarī-vṛddhadārukaḥ| chatrā-dhānyakam| aticchatrā-śatapuṣpā| palaṅkaṣā-lākṣā| mahāpuruṣadantā-śatāvarī| kāyasthā-kṣīrakākolī| nākulīdvayaṃ-sarpākṣī sarpasugandhā ca| mahāpaiśācakasaṃjñaṃ cāturthikādināśanam| tathā'mṛtatulyaṃ mahāguṇatvāt| buddhyādikaṃ śiśūnāṃ ca saṃvardhayati|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------| brāhmīmaindrīṃ viḍaṅgāni vyoṣaṃ hiṅgu jaṭāṃ murām||38||
rāsnāṃ viṣaghnāṃ laśunaṃ viśalyāṃ surasāṃ vacām| jyotiṣmatīṃ nāgavinnāmanantāṃ saharītakīm||39||
kāṅkṣīṃ ca hastimūtreṇa piṣṭvā chāyāviśoṣitā| vartirnasyāñjanālepadhūpairunmādasūdanī||40||

div.ab: Sa. brāhmyādibhirgajamūtrapiṣṭā vartiśchāyāyāṃ viśoṣitā nasyādibhirunmādahṛt| viṣaghnā-ativiṣā| viśalyā-lāṅgalī| nāgavinnā-nāgadantī| kāṅkṣī-saurāṣṭrikā|
avapīḍāśca vividhāḥ sarṣāpāḥ snehasaṃyutāḥ| kaṭutailena cābhyaṅgo dhmāpayeccāsya tadrajaḥ||41|| sahiṅgustīkṣṇadhūmaśca sūtrasthānodito hitaḥ| ----------------------------------------------|42|

Sa. sa-"kalkādyairavapīḍastu" (hṛ.sū.a. 20/7) iti kathito'vapīḍaḥ| te'vapīḍāḥ sarṣapatailayutā hitāḥ| abhyaṅgaśca sarṣapatailena| tathā'sya tadrajaḥ-sarṣapacūrṇaṃ, ghrāṇe dhmāpayet| tathā sūtrasthānoktastīkṣṇo dhūmo (a. 21/17) hiṅgunā saha hitaḥ|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------| śṛgālaśalyakolūkajalaukāvṛṣabastajaiḥ||42||
mūtrapittaśakṛllomanakhacarmabhirācaret| dhūpadhūmāñjanābhyaṅgapradehapariṣecanam||43||

div.ab: Sa. śṛgālādimūtrādibhirdhūpādikamācaret| atra jalaukācarmacaṭikā|
dhūpayetsatataṃ cainaṃ śvagomatsyaiḥ supūtibhiḥ| vātaśleṣmātmake prāyaḥ------------------------|44|
Sa. enaṃ-conmādinaṃ, punaḥpunaśca gomatsyādibhiḥ suṣṭhu pūtiṃgandhibhirdhūpayet| vātaśleṣmātmake bāhulyenaiṣa upakramaḥ|

ab.seg: tiktakaṃ jīvanīyaṃ ca sarpiḥ snehaśca miśrakaḥ| śītāni cānnapānāni madhurāṇi laghūni ca||45||

div.ab: Sa. paittike tūnmāde tiktakaṃ sarpirjīvanīyaṃ ca śasyate| tathā miśrako-yamakaḥ snehaḥ, praśasyate| tathā śiśirāṇi madhurāṇyannapānāni laghūni ca śasyante|

ab.seg: vidhyecchirāṃ yathoktāṃ vā tṛptaṃ medyāmiṣasya vā| nivāte śāyayedevaṃ mucyate mativibhramāt||46||

div.ab: Sa. tathā śirāvyadhavidhyuktāṃ śirāṃ vidhyet| meduramāṃsasya tṛptaṃ nivāte svāpayecca| evaṃ kṛte sati mativibhramāt mucyate|

ab.seg: prakṣipyāsalile kūpe śoṣayedvā bubhukṣayā| āśvāsayetsuhṛttaṃ vā vākyairdharmārthasaṃhitaiḥ||47||
bṛyādiṣṭavināśaṃ vā darśayedadbhutāni vā| baddhaṃ sarṣapatailāktaṃ nyasedvottānamātape||48||
kapikacchvā'thavā taptairlohatailajalaiḥ spṛśet| kaśābhistāḍayitvā vā baddhaṃ śvabhre viniḥkṣipet||49||
athavā vītaśastrāśmajane saṃtamase gṛhe| sarpeṇoddhṛtadaṃṣṭreṇa dāntaiḥ siṃhairgajaiśca tam||50||
(trāsayecchastrahastairvā kirātārātitaskaraiḥ| ) athavā rājapuruṣā bahirnītvā susaṃyatam| bhāpayeyurvadhenainaṃ tarjayanto nṛpājñayā||51||
dehaduḥkhabhayebhyo hi paraṃ prāṇabhayaṃ matam| tena yāti śamaṃ tasya sarvato viplutaṃ manaḥ||52||

div.ab: Sa. athavā jalavarjite kūpe prakṣipya kṣudhā śoṣayet| athavā taṃ-unmādavantaṃ, suhṛt dharmārthayutairvākyairāśvāsayet-sāntvayet| athavā'sya putrādervināśaṃ-vighātaṃ, taṃ brūyāt| adbhutāni vā taṃ darśayet| athavā kaṭutailenābhyaktaṃ badhvā tamuttānaṃ kṛtvā''tape nyaset| kapikacchvā, athavā taptairlohādibhiḥ| athavā carmakaśābhirahatya baddhaṃ santamavaṭe viniḥkṣipet| śastrādivarjite tvagāre('ndhakāre) bhavane vā badhvā vinikṣipet| nanu ca, ekasya śūnyagṛhe sthitirunmādasya nidānamuktam| yacca yasya nidānaṃ tadeva tasya kathaṃ cikitsitaṃ syāt ? naiṣadoṣaḥ| tadarthakāribheṣajatvāt| tadarthakāriṇi hi bheṣajeyadeva nidānaṃ tadevauṣadham| yathā,-tucchadagdhe'gnipratapanam, madātyaye madyapānamiti| tadvadihāpyavagantavyam| athavā samutpāṭitadaṃṣṭreṇa sarpeṇa bhāpayet, dāntairgajādibhirvā| rājapuruṣā bahirnītvā taṃ suṣṭu yantritaṃ kṛtvā rājājñayā tarjayanto vadhena bhāpayeyuḥ| yato dehaduḥkhabhayebhyaḥ sakāśāt paraṃ-atiśayena, prāṇabhayaṃ matam| tena-bhayena, itaścetaścittaṃ viplutamunmādinaḥ śamameti|
siddhā kriyā prayojyeyaṃ deśakālādyapekṣayā| ----------------------------------------------|53|
Sa. iyaṃ kriyā deśādyapekṣayā siddhā prayojanīyā
----------------------------------------------| iṣṭadravyavināśāttu mano yasyopahanyate||53|| tasya tatsadṛśaprāptisāntvāśvāsaiḥ śamaṃ nayet| ----------------------------------------------|54|
Sa. iṣṭadravyavināśād yasya mānasamupahanyate tasya tatsadṛśā-tulyā, prāptiḥ kāryā| tathā sāntvanaiścāśvāsanaiśca śamamunmādinaṃ nayet|
----------------------------------------------| kāmaśokabhayakrodhaharṣerṣyālobhasambhavān||54|| parasparapratidvandvairebhireva śamaṃ nayet| ----------------------------------------------|55|
Sa. kāmādijānunmādān anyonyapratikṣairebhireva-kāmādibhiḥ, śamaṃ nayet|
----------------------------------------------| bhūtānubandhamīkṣeta proktaliṅgādhikākṛtim||55|| yadyunmāde tataḥ kuryādbhūtanirdiṣṭamauṣadham| ----------------------------------------------|56|

Sa. bhūtaiḥ-devādibhiḥ pūrvoktaiḥ, anubandhaḥ-anuṣaṅgaḥ, tamanantarokta āgantāvunmāde yadīkṣeta tato bhūtapratiṣedhoktamauṣadhaṃ kuryāt| nanu, kathamīkṣaṇaṃ kartuṃ śakyate ? iti viśeṣaṇadvāreṇa hetumāha-proktaliṅgādhikākṛtimiti| proktāni pūrvaṃ ṣaḍvidhasyonmādasya yāni liṅgāni tebhyo'dhikā''kṛtiḥ-lakṣaṇaṃ, yasya-bhūtānubandhasya, taṃ tathāvidham|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------| baliṃ ca dadyātpalalaṃ yāvakaṃ saktupiṇḍikām||56||
snigdhaṃ madhuramāhāraṃ taṇḍulān rudhirokṣitān| pakvāmakāni māṃsāni surāṃ maireyamāsavam||57||
atimuktasya puṣpāṇi jātyāḥ sahacarasya ca| catuṣpathe gavāṃ tīrthe nadīnāṃ saṅgameṣu ca||58||

div.ab: Sa. tathā'tra bhūtānubandhe palalayāvakādi ca yāvat puṣpāṇi sahacarasya ceti baliṃ dadyāt| kva ? catuṣpathe, tathā gotīrthe nadyorvā saṅgame|

ab.seg: nivṛttāmiṣamadyo yo hitāśī prayataḥ śuciḥ| nijāgantubhirunmādaiḥ satvavānna sa yujyate||59||

div.ab: Sa. yaḥ puruṣo nivṛttamadyamāṃso hitabhojī prayataḥ śuciḥ syāt| sa sātviko nijāgantubhirunmādairna yujyate| tasmādīdṛśena bhāvyamiti bhāvaḥ|

prasāda indriyārthānāṃ buddhyātmamanasāṃ tathā| dhātūnāṃ prakṛtisthatvaṃ vigatonmādalakṣaṇam|60| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭavira- citāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttara- sthāne unmādapratiṣedho nāma ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ|6|

Sa. indriyārthānāṃ prasannatvaṃ tathābuddhyātmamanasāṃ ca, dhātūnāṃ prakṛtisthatvaṃ ceti vigatonmādasya lakṣaṇamiti| iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdaya- ṭīkāyāṃ sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne unmā- dapratiṣedho nāma ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 6||

div.head: apasmārapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ
div.ab: athāto'pasmārapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre|2| )|3|
Sa. asmādanantaramapasmārapratiṣedha ucyate, cikitsāsāmānyāt|

smṛtyapāyo hyaposmāraḥ sa dhīsattvābhisaṃplavāt| jāyate'bhihate citte cintāśokabhayādibhiḥ||1|| unmādavatprakupitaiścittadehagatairmalaiḥ| hate sattve hṛdi vyāpte saṃjñāvāhiṣu kheṣu ca||2|| tamo viśan mūḍhamatirbībhatsāḥ kurute kriyāḥ| dantān khādan vaman phenaṃ hastau pādau ca vikṣipan||3|| paśyannasanti rūpāṇi praskhalan patati kṣitau| vijihyakṣibhruvo doṣavege'tīte vibudhyate||4|| kālāntareṇa sa punaścaivameva viceṣṭate| --------------------------------------------|5|

Sa. smṛterapāyo-vināśaḥ, apasmāra ucyate| sa ca-smṛtivināśo, buddhyādivināśāccitte cintādyabhihate, tathonmādavaccittadehagatairdoṣaiḥ prakṛpitaiḥ sattve hate, hṛdaye vyāpte, tathā saṃjñāvāhiṣu srotaḥsu vyāpteṣu satsu, jāyate| tasmiṃśca jāte sati mūḍhamatiḥ san tamo-mohaṃ, viśan bībhatsāḥ-ninditāḥ, kriyāḥkurute| na tu tamo dravyaviśeṣa iha gṛhyate, tasya divā'sambhavasyāpi darśanaṃ sambhāvyata eva, rogasvabhāvāt| ata eva vakṣyati,-"paśyannasanti rūpāṇi" iti| tā eva kriyā vakti-dantānityādi yāvadvijihvākṣibhruva iti| vijihyamakṣibhruvaṃ yasya sa evam| akṣibhruvaśabdo'caturādinipātaḥ| doṣavege cātikrānte vibudhyate-prakṛtiṃ yāti| kālāntaraiṇa saḥ-apasmarīm evameva-pūrvavat, karoti|
Sa. apasmāraścatuḥprakāraḥ| katham ? ityāha-vātādibhiḥ sannipātena ca|

ab.seg: rūpamutpatsyamāne'smin hṛtkampaḥ śūnyatā bhramaḥ| tamaso darśanaṃ dhyānaṃ bhrūvyudāso'kṣivaikṛtam||6||
aśabdaśravaṇaṃ svedo lālāsiṅghāṇakasrutiḥ| avipāko'rucirmūrcchā kukṣyāṭopo balakṣayaḥ||7||
nidrānāśo'ṅgamardastṛṭ svapne gānaṃ sanartanam| pānaṃ tailasya madyasya tayoreva ca mehanam||8||

div.ab: Sa. asminnapasmāra udbubhūṣati sati hṛtkampādayaḥ syuḥ| gānādi syāt, tailamadyayoḥ pānaṃ syāt, tathā tayoreva-taila madyayoḥ, mehanaṃ-mūtraṇaṃ, syāt|

tatra vātātsphuratsakthiḥ prapataṃśca muhurmuhuḥ| apasmarati saṃjñāṃ ca labhate visvaraṃ rudan||9|| utpiṇḍitākṣaḥ śvasiti phenaṃ vamati kampate| āvidhyati śirodantān daśatyādhmātakandharaḥ||10|| parito vikṣipatyaṅgaṃ viṣamaṃ vinatāṅguliḥ| rūkṣśyāvāruṇākṣitvaṅnakhāsyaḥ kṛṣṇamīkṣate||11|| capalaṃ paruṣaṃ rūpaṃ virūpaṃ vikṛtānanam| --------------------------------------------------------|12|
Sa. tatra-teṣu madhyāt, vātādapasmāre sati sphuratsakathyādikaḥ syāt|

ab.seg: pītaphenākṣivaktratvagāspālayati medinīm| bhairavādīptaruṣitarūpadarśī tṛṣānvitaḥ||13||

div.ab: Sa. pittenāpasmāre sati punaḥpunaḥ saṃjñāṃ-cetanāṃ ca labhate| pītaphenākṣimukhatvaṃ syāt| atra ca vaktragrahaṇenaivākṣigrahaṇe siddhe'kṣigrahaṇamatiśayārtham| tathā''sphālayati medinīmityādi ca syāt|
kaphāccireṇa grahaṇaṃ cireṇaiva vibodhanam| ceṣṭā'lpā bhūyasī lālā śuklanetranakhāsyatā||14|| śuklābharūpadarśitvaṃ----------------------| --------------------------------------------------------|15|
Sa. kaphāccireṇa kālena grahaṇam| cireṇaiva vimokṣaṇaṃ syāt| śceṣṭā'lpetyādi ca|
Sa. sarvaliṅgamapasmāraṃ varjayet-nopakramet|

--------------------------------------------------------| athā''vṛtānāṃ dhīcittahṛtkhānāṃ prākprabodhanam||15|| tīkṣṇaiḥ kuryādiapasmāre karmabhirvamanādibhiḥ| --------------------------------------------------------|16|
Sa. atha-evamapasmārasvarūpamavagamya, dhīcittahṛdayasrotasāṃ pūrvaṃ prabodhanaṃ kuryāt| kaiḥ ? vamanādibhiḥ tīkṣṇaiḥ karmabhiḥ|

--------------------------------------------------------| vātikaṃ bastibhūyiṣṭhaiḥ, paittaṃ prāyo virecanaiḥ||16|| ślaiṣmikaṃ vamanaprāyairapasmāramupācaret| --------------------------------------------------------|17|
Sa. vātikamapasmāraṃ bastiprāyairupācaret| paittaṃ virecanaprāyairupācaret| ślaiṣmikaṃ vamanaprāyairupācaret|
Sa. sarvataḥ-adha upariṣṭācca viśuddhasya, tathā samyagāśvāsitasya ca-kṛtapeyādyannasaṃsargikasya ca samyagāśvāsanaṃ sampadyate| tasyāpasmāriṇaḥ, apasmāraviśodhanāya vakṣyamāṇānimān yogānākarṇaya|
Sa. gomayasvarasādibhirghrutaṃ pakvamapasmārādighnaṃ pibet|

--------------------------------------------------------| dvipañcamūlatriphalādviniśākuṭajatvacaḥ||19|| saptaparṇamapāmārgaṃ nīlinīṃ kaṭurohiṇīm| śamyākapuṣkarajaṭāphalgumūladurālabhāḥ||20|| dvipalāḥ saliladroṇe paktvā pādāvaśeṣite| bhārgīpāṭhāḍhakīkumbhanikumbhavyoṣarohiṣaiḥ||21|| mūrvābhūtīkabhūnimbaśreyasīsārivādvayaiḥ| madayantyagniniculairakṣāṃśaiḥ sarpiṣaḥ pacet||22|| prasthaṃ tadvad dravaiḥ pūrvaiḥ pañcaganyamidaṃ mahat| jvarāpasmārajaṭharabhagandaraharaṃ param||23|| śophārśaḥkāmalāpāṇḍugulmakāsagrahāpaham| --------------------------------------------------------|24|

Sa. dvipañcamūlādīni pṛthag dvipalapramāṇāni jaladroṇe paktvā pādāvaśeṣite kvāthe bhārgyādibhiḥ karṣāśaiḥ kalkīkṛtairghṛtasya prasthaṃ tadvat pūrvaiḥ-gomayasvarasādibhirdravaiḥ, pācayet| mahadidaṃ pañcagavyaṃ paraṃ jvarādiharam, śophādighnaṃ ca| bahudravyayogāccāsya mahattvam, yathā mahākalyāṇakādeḥ|

--------------------------------------------------------| brāhmīrasavacākuṣṭhaśaṅkhapuṣpīśṛtaṃ ghṛtam||24|| purāṇaṃ medhyamunmādālakṣmyapasmārapāomajit| --------------------------------------------------------|25|
Sa. brāhmyādibhiḥ purāṇaṃ sarpiḥ pakvaṃ medhyamunmādādijit|

--------------------------------------------------------| tailaprasthaṃ ghṛtaprasthaṃ jīvanīyaiḥ palonmitaiḥ||25|| kṣīradroṇe pacetsiddhamapasmāravimokṣaṇam| --------------------------------------------------------|26|
Sa. tailaprasthaṃ ghrutaprasthaṃ jīvaniyaiḥ rajīkṛtaiḥ palapramāṇaiḥ kṣīradroṇe pacet| tatsiddhamapasmāravimocanam|

ab.seg: kāRṣikairjīvanīyaiśca sarpiḥprasthaṃ vipācayet| vātapittodbhavaṃ kṣipramapasmāraṃ nihanti tat||27||

div.ab: Sa. kṣīrekṣurasayoḥ kaṃse-āḍhake, tathā kāśmaryarase'ṣṭaguṇe-aṣṭaprasthaparimāṇe, ghṛtādasyāṣṭaguṇatvam| jīvaniyaiḥkārṣikairghṛtaprasthaṃ vipācayet| tat vātapittajamapasmāraṃ śīghrameva nihanti| nanu, dvandvajasyāpasmārasyāsambhavāt kathamuktaṃ vātapittodbhavaṃ hantīti? ucyate| vātapittotthayordvayorapyapasmārayorhantītyetadihokta mityadoṣaḥ|
Sa. tadvat-pūrvavat, kāśādikvāthe śṛtaṃ kṣīraṃ syāt|
Sa. kūṣmāṇḍasvarase'ṣṭādaśaguṇe madhuyaṣṭikākalkaṃ ghṛtaprasthaṃ pakvamapasmārajit budhdyādipradaṃ ca|
Sa. kapilānāṃ gavāṃ pittaṃ nasye suṣṭru hitam, na kṛṣṇānām gavām, acintyatvātprabhāvasya| śvādīnāmapi pittaṃ hitam|
Sa. godhādīnāṃ ca pitteṣu sādhitaṃ tailaṃ nasye'bhyaṅge ca śasyate|

ab.seg: śryāhvāpāmārgakārañjabījaistailaṃ vipācitam| bastamūtre hitaṃ nasyaṃ cūrṇaṃ vā dhmāpayedbhiṣak||32||

div.ab: Sa. triphalādibhiḥ kalkitaiśchāgamūtre caturguṇe sādhitaṃ tailaṃ nasyamunmādāpasmāriṇorhitam| cūrṇaṃ triphalādervā vaidyo nāsāyā madhye dhmāpayet|

ab.seg: nakulolūkamārjāragṛdhrakīṭāhikākajaiḥ| tuṇḍaiḥ pakṣaiḥ purīṣaiśca dhūpamasya prayojayet||33||

div.ab: Sa. nakulādīnāṃ yathāsambhavaṃ tuṇḍādibhirapasmāriṇo dhūmaṃ (paṃ) yojayet|

ab.seg: śīlayettailalaśunaṃ payasa vā śatāvarīm| brāhmīrasaṃ kuṣṭharasaṃ vacāṃ vā madhusaṃyutām||34||

div.ab: Sa. tathā tailalaśunaṃ śīlayet| kṣīreṇa vā śatāvarīmadyāt| brāhmīrasaṃ vā kuṣṭharasaṃ madhunā samabhyaset, vacāṃ vā|

ab.seg: samaṃ kruddhairapasmāro doṣaiḥ śārīramānasaiḥ| yajjāyate yataścaiṣa mahāmarmasamāśrayaḥ||35||
tasmādrasāyanairenaṃ duścikitsyamupācaren| tadārtaṃ cāgnitoyāderviṣamātpālayetsadā||36||
