div.ab: Sa. yat-yasmāt, apasmāro yugāpatprakopitaiḥ śārīramānasairdoṣairjāyate, yataścaiṣa mahāmarmāśrayaḥ, tata enaṃ-apasmāraṃ, duścikitsyaṃ rasāyanairupācaret| apasmārārtaṃ cāgnijalāderviṣamāt sada pālayet|

muktaṃ mano vikāreṇa tvamitthaṃ kṛtavāniti| na brūyādviṣayairiṣṭaiḥ kliṣṭaṃ ceto'sya bṛṃhayet|37| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭavira- citāyāmaṣṭāṅahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttara- sthāne'pasmārapratiṣedho nāma saptamo'dhyāyaḥ|7|

Sa. manovikāreṇa ca muktaṃ santaṃ tvamitthaṃ kṛtavāniti na brūyāt| asya ca manaḥ kliṣṭamiṣṭairviṣayairupabṛṃhayediti| iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdaya- ṭīkāyāṃ sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne'pasmāra- pratiṣedho nāma saptamo'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 7|| ityaṣṭāṅgahṛdaye bhūtatantraṃ tṛtīyaṃ samāptam

div.head: vartmarogavijñānīyādhyāyaḥ
div.ab: prādhānyāt pūrvamupanyāsa ityāha ---- athāto vartmarogavijñānīyamadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre|2| )|3|

Sa. apasmārādanantaraṃ śālākyamupakramyate| yathaiva hṛdayākhyamahāmarmāśritairapasmāro janyate tathaiva murdhākhyamahāmarmāśritairūrdhvajatrūtthā rogā janyante| teṣāmapi ca madhye cakṣūrogāṇāṃ vartmani rogā vartmarogāḥ,-kṛcchronmīlādayaḥ, teṣāṃ vijñānaṃ-bodhaḥ, sa vidyate yasminniti chaḥ, tasya pūrvavalluk|

sarvaroganidānoktairahitaiḥ kupitā malāḥ| acakṣuṣyairviśeṣeṇa prāyaḥ pittānusāriṇaḥ||1|| śirābhirūrdhvaṃ prasṛtā netrāvayavamāśritāḥ| vartma sandhiṃ sitaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ dṛṣṭiṃ vā sarvamakṣi vā||2|| rogān kuryuḥ--------------------------------------------| --------------------------------------------------------|3|

Sa. sarvaroganidāne uktāni-abhihitāni yathāyogaṃ tiktoṣaṇādīni, tairāhāravihāraiḥ prakupita malā rogān kuryuḥ| viśeṣādacakṣuṣyairāhāravihāraiḥ kupitā malāḥ prāyo-bāhulyena, pittānusāriṇastathā śirādibhiḥ karaṇabhūtābhirūrdhvaṃ jatruṇaḥ prasṛtāstathā netrasya sambandhinamavayavaṃ-vakṣyamāṇaṃ vartmādikaṃ, āśritāḥ| vartmetyādi| vāśabdaḥ pratyekaṃ yujyate, vartma vā sandhiṃ vā sitaṃ vā'sitaṃ vā dṛṣṭiṃ vā sakalaṃ locanamāśritāḥ| iti sāmānyena nayanarogāṇāṃ samprāptiḥ|

ab.seg: ----------calastatra prāpya vartmāśrayāḥ sirāḥ| suptotthitasya kurute vartmastambhaṃ savedanam||3||
pāṃśupūrṇābhanetratvaṃ kṛcchronmīlanamaśru ca| vimardanāt syācca śamaḥ kṛcchronmīlaṃ vadanti tat||4||

div.ab: Sa. tatra-teṣu vartmādyāśriteṣu madhye, vartmāśrayāḥ sirā vāyuḥ prāpya suptotthitasya narasya vartmastambhaṃ kurute, rujayā saha| tathā paṃśupūrṇābhanayanatvaṃ kṛcchreṇonmīlanamaśru ca kurute| vimardanāt-malanācca, śamaḥ syāt| taṃ-īdṛksvarūpaṃ, kṛcchronmīlākhyaṃ netrerogaṃ vadanti|
cālayan vartmanī vāyurnimeṣonmeṣaṇaṃ muhuḥ| karotyaruṅ nimeṣo'sau---------------------|5|
Sa. vāyurvatmanī cālayan nimeṣonmeṣaṇaṃ pīḍārahitaṃ punaḥ punaḥ karoti| asau nimeṣākhyo rogo jñeyaḥ|
Sa. yatpunarvartma vimuktasandhi tathā niśceṣṭaṃ hīnam ca nimīlyate taṃ vātahatākhyaṃ rogaṃ vadanti, 'munayaḥ' iti śeṣaḥ|

---------------------------------------------------------| kṛṣṇāḥ pittena bahvyo'ntarvartma kumbhīkabījavat||6|| ādhmāyante punarbhinnāḥ piṭikāḥ kumbhisaṃjñitāḥ| ---------------------------------------------------------|7|
Sa. pittena kṛṣṇavarṇāḥ piṭikā bahvyo vartmanormadhye kumbhīkabījatulyāstathā bhinnāḥ satyaḥ punaradhmāyante, tāḥ kumbhīsaṃjñāḥ|

---------------------------------------------------------| sadāhakledanistodaṃ raktābhaṃ sparśanākṣamam||7|| pittena jāyate vartma pittotkliṣṭamuśanti tat| ---------------------------------------------------------|8|
Sa. pittena sadāhakledanistodaṃ tathā raktākāraṃ sparśanākṣamaṃ vartma jāyate, tat pittotkliṣṭamuśanti-kathayanti|

---------------------------------------------------------| karoti kaṇḍūṃ dāhaṃ ca pittaṃ pakṣmāntamāsthitam||8|| pakṣmaṇāṃ śātanaṃ cānu pakṣmaśātaṃ vadanti tam| ---------------------------------------------------------|9|
Sa. pittaṃ pakṣmāntamāsthitaṃ kaṇḍūm dāhaṃ ca karoti| anupaścāt, pakṣmāṇāṃ śātaṃ karoti| taṃ pakṣmaśātaṃ varṇayanti|

---------------------------------------------------------| pothakyaḥ piṭikāḥ śvetāḥ sarṣapabhā ghanāḥ kaphāt||9|| śophopadeharukkaṇḍūpicchilāśrusamanvitāḥ| ---------------------------------------------------------|10|
Sa. kaphāt piṭikāḥ sitāḥ sarṣapopamā ghanāḥ-nibiḍāḥ, śophādiyutāḥ pothakīsaṃjñāḥ|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------------------| kaphotkliṣṭaṃ bhavedvartma stambhakledopadehavat||10||

div.ab: Sa. stambhādiyutaṃ vartma yad bhavet tatkaphotkliṣṭaṃ nāma|

ab.seg: granthiḥ pāṇḍurarukpākaḥ kaṇḍūmān kaṭhinaḥ kaphāt| kolamātraḥ sa lagaṇaḥ kiñcidalpastato'tha vā||11||

div.ab: Sa. kaphāt yo granthiḥ kolamātraḥ, athavā tataḥ-tasmāt kolātkiñcidalpaḥ, pāṇḍuḥ pīḍāpākarahitaḥ kaṇḍūmān kaṭhinaśca syāt, sa lagaṇākhyaḥ|
raktā raktena piṭikā tattulyapiṭikācitā| utsaṅgākhyā------------------------------|12|
Sa. raktena raktevarṇā piṭikā tattulyapiṭikairācitā utsaṅgākhyā|
Sa. tathā-utsaṅgavat, utkliṣṭākhyaṃ vartma| tacca na piṭikārupam, kiṃ tarhi ? rājiyutaṃ sparśanākṣamaṃ ca syāt|

ab.seg: arśo'dhimāṃsaṃ vartmāntaḥ stabdhaṃ snigdhaṃ sadāharuk| raktaṃ raktena tatsrāvi chinnaṃ chinnaṃ ca vardhate||13||

div.ab: Sa. adhikamāṃsaṃ ca vartmābhyantarasthitamarśo nāma raktena syāt| raktaṃ varṇataḥ, tathā stabdhatādiguṇaṃ syāt| tathā tatsrāvitadraktaṃ sravatyabhīkṣṇam| tat punaḥpunaschinnamapi vardhate|

ab.seg: madhye vā vartmano'nte vā kaṇḍūṣārugvatī sthirā| mudgamātrā'sṛjā tāmrā piṭikā'ñjananāmikā||14||

div.ab: Sa. asṛjā tāmrā piṭikā mudgapramāṇā vartmano madhye'nte vā kaṇḍvādimatī sthirā cāñjananāmikā syāt|

ab.seg: doṣairvartma bahiḥ śūnaṃ yadantaḥ sūkṣmakhācitam| sasrāvamantarudakaṃ bisābhaṃ bisavartma tat||15||

div.ab: Sa. doṣaiḥ-vātādibhiḥ, bahiḥ śūnaṃ yadvartma sūkṣmaiḥ khaiḥchidraiḥ, antarācitaṃ sasrāvaṃ ca tad bisavartma, udakāntaḥsthitasacchidrabisatulyatvāt|

ab.seg: yadvartmotkliṣṭamutkliṣṭamakasmānmlānatāmiyāt| raktadoṣatrayotkleśādbhavatyutkliṣṭavartma tat||16||

div.ab: Sa. yadvartma raktotkleśāddoṣatrayotkleśācca utkliṣṭaṃ-utkleśitaṃ sat, akasmāt-hetuṃ vinaiva, mlānimiyāt-śuṣkatvaṃ yāyāt, tadutkliṣṭavartma syāt|
śyāvavartma malaiḥ sāsraiḥ śyāvaṃ rukkledaśophavat| ---------------------------------------------------------|17|
Sa. raktasahitaistrimalairyadvartma śyāvaṃ rujā kledena śophena ca yuktaṃ bhavati, tacchyāvavartma|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------------------| śliṣṭākhyaṃ vartmanī śliṣṭe kaṇḍūśvayathurāgiṇī||17||

div.ab: Sa. śliṣṭe-ekatra saṃlagne, vartmanī kaṇḍvādiyute śliṣṭavartma nāma|
vartmano'ntaḥ kharā rūkṣāḥ piṭikāḥ sikatopamāḥ| sikatāvartma-----------------------------------|18|
Sa. vartmano madhye vālikātulyāḥ piṭikāḥ kharasparśāstathā rūkṣāḥ, tat sikatāṃvartma|
Sa. kardamasadṛśaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ vartma kardamākhyam|
bahalaṃ bahalairmāṃsaiḥ savarṇaiścīyate samaiḥ| ---------------------------------------------------------|19|
Sa. bahalaiḥ-ghanaiḥ, māṃsaiḥ savarṇaiḥ samaiḥ-na viṣamaiḥ, cīyate tadbahalaṃ nāma|

ab.seg: syāttena śiśurucchranatāmrākṣo vīkṣaṇākṣamaḥ| savartmaśūlapaicchilyaḥ karṇanāsākṣimardanaḥ||20||

div.ab: Sa. kukūṇakaḥ śiśoreva-na mahato, jayate| yato'sau dantotpattihetuko bhavati| tena-kukūṇakena, bāla ucchūnatāmranayano vīkṣaṇākṣamastathā vartmaśūlādimān karṇādimardanaśca syāt|

ab.seg: pakṣmoparodhe saṅkoco vartmanāṃ jāyate tathā| kharatā'ntarmukhatvaṃ ca romṇāmanyāni vā punaḥ||21||
kaṇṭakairiva tīkṣṇāgrairghṛṣṭaṃ tairakṣi śūyate| uṣyate cānilādidviḍalpāhaḥ śāntiruddhṛtaiḥ||22||

div.ab: Sa. pakṣmoparodhe vartmanāṃ saṅkoco bhavati| tathā kharatvamantarmukhatvaṃ ca romṇām, anyāni va romāṇi jāyante| taiścakharāntarmukhaiḥ, apūrvairvā rogasvabhāvāttīkṣṇāgraiḥ kaṇṭakairiva ghṛṣṭamakṣiśūyate| uṣyate ca-sāntardāhastīvroṣmā syādityarthaḥ| tathā pavanādidviṭ, ādiśabdenānalātapau gṛhyete| stokānyahānyuddhṛtaiḥ-utpāṭitaistaistaiḥ, śāntirbhavati|

ab.seg: kanīnake bahirvartma kaṭhino granthirunnataḥ| tāmraḥ pakvo'srapūyasrudalajyādhmāyate muhuḥ||23||

div.ab: Sa. kanīnake vartmanorbāhyataḥ kaṭhina unnato granthiralajītyucyate| kimbhūto granthiḥ ? tāmraḥ pakvaścāsrasrāvī pūyasrāvī ca| tathā muhurmuhuḥ srutaḥ sannādhmāyate|

ab.seg: vartmāntarmāṃsapiṇḍābhaḥ śvayathurgrathito'rujaḥ| srāsraiḥ syādarbudo doṣairviṣamo bāhyataścalaḥ||24||

div.ab: Sa. vartmano'ntare māṃsapiṇḍākṛtiḥ śvayathuḥ saraktaistribhirdoṣairarbudaḥ syāt| kimbhūtaḥ śvayathuḥ ? grathito nīrujaḥ| sa ca bāhyataścalo viṣamaśca syāt|
caturviṃśatirityete vyādhayo vartmasaṃśrayāḥ| ---------------------------------------------------------|25|
Sa. iti-anena prakāreṇa, caturviṃśatisaṅhkhyā vartmāśrayā rogāḥ syuḥ|

---------------------------------------------------------| ādyo'tra bheṣajaiḥ sādhyo dvau tato'rśaśca varjayet||25|| pakṣmoparodho yāpyaḥ syāccheṣāñchastreṇa sādhayet| ---------------------------------------------------------|26|
Sa. [ atra-] eṣu madhyāt, ādyaḥ-kṛcchronmīlanākhyo, bheṣajaiḥ sādhyaḥ| tataḥ-anantaraṃ, dbau-nimeṣavātahatau arśaśca varjayet| pakṣmoparodho yāpanīyaḥ| śeṣān-ekonaviṃśatiṃ, śastreṇopacaret|

---------------------------------------------------------| kuṭṭayetpakṣmasadanaṃ chindyātteṣvapi cārbudam|26| bhindyāllagaṇakumbhīkābisotsaṅgāñjanālajīḥ| pothakīśyāvasikatāśliṣṭotkliṣṭacatuṣṭayam|27| sakardamaṃ sabahalaṃ vilikhetsakukūṇakam| 27 1/2| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhagupasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭavira- citāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttara- sthāne vartmarogavijñānīyo nāma aṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ|8|

Sa. teṣvapi-śastrasādhyeṣu madhye, pakṣmasadanaṃ kuṭṭayet sūcīkūrcena| arbudaṃ ca chindyādvṛddhipatrādinā| lagaṇādīni vrīhimukhādinā bhindyāt| pothakyādayaḥ kukūṇakāntā ekādaśa vilekhyāḥ| utkliṣṭacatuṣṭayaṃ-pittotkliṣṭaṃ kaphotkliṣṭaṃ raktotkliṣṭamutkliṣṭavartmaceti| iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdaya- ṭīkāyāṃ sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne vartmaroga- vijñānīyo nāmāṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 8||

div.head: vartmarogapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: vartmarogavijñānādanantaraṃ vartmarogapratiṣedha ārabhyata ityāha ---- athāto vartmarogapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre||2||
kṛcchronmīle purāṇājyaṃ drākṣākalkāmbusādhitam| sasiraṃ yojayetsnigdhaṃ nasyadhūmāñjanādi ca||1||

div.ab: Sa. kṛcchronmīle vartmaroge purāṇaṃ ghṛtaṃ drākṣākalkāmbupakvaṃ samaśarkaraṃ yojayet| snigdhaṃ ca nasyādikam|

ab.seg: kumbhīkāvartmopakramamāha ---- kumbhīkāvartma likhitaṃ saindhavapratisāritam| yaṣṭīdhātrīpaṭolīnāṃ kvāthena pariṣecayet||2||

div.ab: Sa. kumbhīkāvartma likhitaṃ vṛddhipatrādinā saindhavalavaṇena pratisāritaṃ sat madhuyaṣṭikādikvāthena pariṣecayet|

kathaṃ vartma lekhanīyam ? ityāha ---- nivāte'dhiṣṭhitasyāptaiḥ śuddhasyottānaśāyinaḥ| bahiḥ koṣṇāmbutaptena sveditaṃ vartma vāsasā||3|| nirbhujya vastrāntaritaṃ vāmāṅguṣṭhāṅgulīdhṛtam| na sraṃsate calati vā vartmaivaṃ sarvatastataḥ||4|| maṇḍalāgreṇa tattiryak kṛtvā śastrapadāṅkitam| likhettenaiva patrairvā śākaśophālikādijaiḥ||5|| phenena toyarāśervā picunā pramṛjannasṛk| sthite rakte sulikhitaṃ sakṣaudraiḥ pratisārayet||6|| yathāsvamuktairanu ca prakṣālyoṣṇena vāriṇā| ghṛtena siktamabhyaktaṃ badhnīyānmadhusarpiṣā||7|| ūrdhvādhaḥ karṇayordattvā piṇḍīṃ ca yavasaktubhiḥ| dvitīye'hani muktasya pariṣekaṃ yathāyatham||8|| kuryāccaturthe nasyādīn muñcedevāhni pañcame| ---------------------------------------------------------|9|

Sa. nivāte sthāne āptairadhiṣṭhitasya-kṛtāśrayasya, tathā śuddhasya-vamanavirecanādinā, uttānaṃ nityaṃ śete tasya vartma vāsasā koṣṇāmbunā taptena sveditaṃ sannirbhujya-kuṭilīkṛtya, vastrāntaritaṃ vāmāṅguṣṭhāṅgulībhyāṃ dhṛtamevaṃ na sraṃsate| na vā calati sarvataḥ| anantaraṃ tadvartma tiryaṅ maṇḍalāgreṇa śastrapadāṅkitaṃ kṛtvā tenaiva śastreṇa śākādipatrairvā samudraphenena vā likhet| kiṃ kurvan ? picunā-karpaṭādiyojitena, raktaṃ pramṛjan| rakte sthite-avahati, sulikhitaṃ tadvartma jñātvā sakṣaudrairyathāsvaṃ kathitaiḥ saindhavādibhiḥ pratisārayet| paścāccoṣṇena vāriṇā prakṣālya sarpiṣā siktamanantaramabhyaktaṃ madhusarpiṣā ūrdhvādhaḥ karṇayoryavasaktubhiḥ piṇḍīṃ ca dattvā'vabadhnīyāt| dvitīye divase muktasya vartmano yathāsvaṃ pariṣekaṃ kuryāt| caturthe divase nasyādīn kuryāt| pañcame divase muñcedeva-nānyatkiñcitkuryāt|

---------------------------------------------------------| samaṃ nakhanibhaṃ śophakaṇḍūghārṣādyapīḍitam||9|| vidyātsulikhitaṃ vartma likhed bhūyo viparyaye| ---------------------------------------------------------|10|
Sa. samaṃ nakhasadṛśaṃ śophādyapīḍitaṃ sulikhitaṃ vartma jānīyāt| viparyaye-asmāllakṣaṇādvaiparītye sati, tadvartma punarlikhet|
Sa. atilekhanādrujādīni syuḥ| tasmin-atilekhane, snehasvedādiko vātaghno vidhiḥ kāryaḥ|

---------------------------------------------------------| abhyajya navanītena śvetarodhraṃ pralepayet||11|| eraṇḍamūlakalkena puṭapāke pacettataḥ| svinnaṃ prakṣālitaṃ śuṣkaṃ cūrṇitaṃ poṭalīkṛtam||12|| striyāḥ kṣīre chagalyā vā mṛditaṃ netrasecanam| ---------------------------------------------------------|13|

Sa. śvetarodhraṃ navanītenābhyajya eraṇḍamūlakalkena pralepayet| anantaraṃ puṭapāke pacet| svinnaṃ prakṣālitaṃ śuṣkaṃ cūrṇitaṃ poṭalīkṛtaṃ sat yuvatīkṣīreṇa chagalyā vā kṣīreṇa marditaṃ netre secanaṃ hitam|

ab.seg: kuryānnetre'tilikhite mṛditaṃ dadhimastunā| kevalenāpi vā sekaṃ mastunā jāṅgalāśinaḥ||14||

div.ab: Sa. atilikhite vartmani navanītenāktaṃ śvetarodhraṃ śālitandulakalkena liptaṃ baddhaṃ pariṣkṛtaṃ-pūrvavatparikalpitaṃ puṭapākīkṛtaṃ svinnaṃ prakṣālitaṃ śuṣkaṃ cūrṇitaṃ poṭalīkṛtaṃ cetyarthaḥ, tat dadhimastunā mṛditaṃ sekaṃ kuryāt| dadhigrahaṇaṃ takramastvādinivṛttyai| athavā kevalena-kalkarodhrarahitena, mastunā jāṅgalamāṃsāśino narasya sekaṃ kuryāt| apiḥ svedanādisamudāyavikalpārthaḥ|

ab.seg: piṭikā vrīhivakreṇa bhittvā tu kaṭhinonnatāḥ| niṣpīḍayedanu vidhiḥ pariśeṣastu pūrvavat||15||

div.ab: Sa. kaṭhinonnatāḥ piṭikāḥ vrīhivakreṇa bhittvā'nu niṣpīḍayet| pariśeṣo vidhiḥ-pralepanakṣālanabandhanasecanādiḥ, pūrvavatkāryaḥ|
Sa. lekhane bhedane ca eṣa eva kramaḥ sarvatra vartmani kāryaḥ|

---------------------------------------------------------| pittāsrotkliṣṭayoḥ svāduskandhasiddhena sarpiṣā||16|| sirāvimokṣaḥ snigdhasya trivṛcchreṣṭhaṃ virecanam| likhite srutarakte ca vartmani kṣālanaṃ hitam||17|| yaṣṭīkaṣāyaḥ, sekastu kṣīraṃ candanasādhitam| ---------------------------------------------------------|18|

Sa. pittotkliṣṭe raktotkliṣṭe ca madhuraskandhaśṛtena ghṛtena snigdhasya puṃsaḥ sirāvimokṣaḥ kāryaḥ| tathā trivṛtātriphale virecanam| likhite vartmani srutalohite ca sati madhuyaṣṭikākvāthaḥ kṣālanaṃ hitam| kṣīraṃ candanasādhitaṃ tu seko hitaḥ|

ab.seg: grāhayedvā jalaukobhiḥ payasekṣurasena vā| vamanaṃ, nāvanaṃ sarpiḥ śṛtaṃ madhuraśītalaiḥ||19||

div.ab: Sa. pakṣmaṇāṃ sadane sati romakūpān-romamūlāni, sucyā vikuṭṭayet| jalaukobhirvā grāhayet| kṣīreṇekṣurasena vā vamanaṃ hitam| madhuraśītalaiḥ-drākṣādibhiḥ, pakvaṃ ghṛtaṃ nāvanaṃ hitam|

ab.seg: sañcūrṇya puṣpakāsīsaṃ bhāvayetsurasārasaiḥ| tāmre daśāhaṃ paramaṃ pakṣmaśāte tadañjanam||20||

div.ab: Sa. puṣpakāsīsaṃ cūrṇayitvā tāmrapātre daśāhaṃ surasārasaiḥ-samūrvārasaiḥ, bhāvayet| tat-etat, pakṣmaśāte śreṣṭhamañjanam

pothakīrlikhitāḥ śuṇṭhīsaindhavapratisāritāḥ| uṣṇāmbukṣālitāḥ siñcet khadirāḍhakiśigrubhiḥ||21|| apsiddhairdviniśāśreṣṭhāmadhukairvā samākṣikaiḥ| ---------------------------------------------------------|22|
Sa. pothakīrlikhitā vṛddhipatrādibhiḥ, śuṇṭhīsaindhavābhyāṃ pratisāritāḥ, tathoṣṇāmbunā kṣālitāḥ, jalakvathitaiḥ khadirādibhiḥ siñcet| dviniśādibhirvā jalakvathitaiḥ samākṣikaiḥ siñcet|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------------------| kaphotkliṣṭe vilikhite sakṣaudraiḥ pratisāraṇam||22||
sūkṣmaiḥ saindhavakāsīsamanohvākaṇatārkṣyajaiḥ| vamanāñjananasyādi sarvaṃ ca kaphajiddhitam||23||

div.ab: Sa. kaphotkliṣṭe vartmani śastreṇa vilikhite saindhavādibhiḥ sūkṣmarajīkṛtairmākṣikasahitaiḥ pratisāraṇaṃ hitam| tathā vamanādi hitam| sarvaṃ ca yatkaphajit tacca hitam|
Sa. lagaṇe'pīdaṃ kāryam| evamapyaśame sati jvalanena dahet|

|svinnāṃ bhittvā viniṣpīḍya bhiṣaga(ḍyotsaṅgāṃ cā)_ ñjananāmikām| śilailāsaindhavanataiḥ sakṣaudraiḥ pratisārayet||1|| ---------------------------------------------------------| kukūṇe khadiraśreṣṭhānimbapatraśṛtaṃ ghṛtam||24|| pītvā dhātrī vametkṛṣṇāyaṣṭīsarṣapasaindhavaiḥ| ---------------------------------------------------------|25|
Sa. kukūṇe khadirādibhiḥ pakvaṃ ghṛtaṃ dhātrī-stanadāyinī, pītvā kṛṣṇādibhirvamet|
Sa. abhayādikvāthenaināṃ-stanadāyinīṃ, virecayet|
mustādvirajanīkṛṣṇākalkenālepayetstanau| dhūpayetsarṣapaiḥ sājyaiḥ----------------|26|
Sa. mustādikalkena kucāvālepayet| sājyaiḥ sarṣapaiḥ stanau dhūpayet|
Sa. śuddhāṃ ca-vamanavirecanādinā, paṭolādikaṃ kvāthaṃ tāṃ pāyayet|

---------------------------------------------------------| śiśostu likhitaṃ vartma srutāsṛgvā'mbujanmabhiḥ||27|| dhātryaśmantakajambūtthapatrakvāthena secayet| ---------------------------------------------------------|28|
Sa. śiśoḥ punarvartma likhitaṃ jalaukābhirvā srutaraktaṃ dhātryādipatrakvāthena secayet|
Sa. prāyo-bāhulyena, kṣīraghṛtabhojanatvācchiśūnāṃ kaphajā rogāḥ syuḥ| tasmādvamanameva pūrvaṃ teṣāṃ sarvavyādhiṣu pūjitam|

tadeha vamanamāha ---- ---------------------------------------------------------| sindhūtthakṛṣṇāpāmārgabījājyastanyamākṣikam||29|| cūrṇo vacāyāḥ sakṣaudro madanaṃ madhukānvitam| kṣīraṃ kṣīrānnamannaṃ ca bhajataḥ kramataḥ śiśoḥ||30|| vamanaṃ sarvarogeṣu viśeṣeṇa kukūṇake| ---------------------------------------------------------|31|

Sa. sindhūtthetyādi vamanaṃ dadyāt, vacācūrṇaḥ sakṣaudro vā, madanaphalaṃ madhuyaṣṭīyuktaṃ vā| kṣīraṃ kṣīrānnaṃ tathā'nnaṃ bhajataḥ śiśoryathākramaṃ vamanatrayametat yojyam| vamanaṃ sarveṣvevāmayeṣu śiśoḥ śreṣṭham| viśeṣeṇa kukūṇake hitam|
Sa. saptalārasena vā siddhaṃ ghṛtamūrdhvādhaḥ śodhanaṃ hitam|

dviniśārodhrayaṣṭyāhvarohiṇīnimbapallavaiḥ| kukūṇake hitā vartiḥ piṣṭaistāmrarajonvitaiḥ||32|| kṣīrakṣaudraghṛtopetaṃ dagdhaṃ vā lohajaṃ rajaḥ| ---------------------------------------------------------|33|
Sa. kukūṇake dviharidrādibhistāmracūrṇayuktairjalapiṣṭairvartirhitā| kṣīrādiyuktaṃ dagdhaṃ lohotthaṃ vā cūrṇaṃ hitam| kecittu samudraphenacūrṇaṃ dagdhaṃ dugdhamākṣikayuktamityāhuḥ|
Sa. elādibhiḥ kaṭphalayuktaḥ kukūṇapothakyoḥ surāpiṣṭairvatirhitā|

ab.seg: utsṛjya dvau bhruvo'dhastādbhāgau bhāgaṃ ca pakṣmataḥ| yavamātraṃ yavākāraṃ tiryak chitvā''rdravāsasā||35||
apaneyamasṛk tasminnalpībhavati śoṇite| sīvyetkuṭilayā sūcyā mudgamātrāntaraiḥ padaiḥ||36||
badhvā lalāṭe paṭṭaṃ ca tatra sīvanasūtrakam| nātigāḍhaślathaṃ sūcyā nikṣipedatha yojayet||37||
madhusarpiḥkavalikāṃ na cāsmin bandhamācaret| nyagrodhādikaṣāyaiśca sakṣīraiḥ secayedruji||38||
pañcame divase sūtramapanīyāvacūrṇayet| gairikeṇa vraṇaṃ yuñjyāttīkṣṇaṃ nasyāñjanādi ca||39||

div.ab: Sa. pakṣmarodhe romasu prakarṣeṇa vṛddheṣu śuddhaśarīrasya narasya bhravo'dhastādvou bhāgāvutsṛjya-vihāya, pakṣmato bhāgaṃ hitvā yavamātraṃ-yavasaṃsthānaṃ, tiryak chittvā klinnavastreṇa raktamapanayet| rakte cālpībhavati sati vakrayā sūcyā mudgamātrāntaraiḥ padaiḥ sīvyet| tato lalāṭe paṭṭaṃ badhvā tatra ca paṭṭe sīvanasūtrakaṃ nātigāḍhaślathaṃ sūcyā vinikṣipet| anantaraṃ mākṣīkaghṛtakavalikāṃ yojayet| na cātra bandhaṃ kuryāt| pīḍāyāṃ satyāṃ nyagrodhādi kaṣāyaiḥ kṣīrayutaiḥ secayet| pañchame divase sūtramapanīya vraṇaṃ gairikeṇāvacūrṇayet| tīkṣṇaṃ ca nasyādi yuñjyāt|

dahedaśāntau nirbhujya vartmadoṣāśrayāṃ valīm| saṃdaṃśonādhikaṃ pakṣma hṛtvā tasyāśrayaṃ dahet|40| sūcyagreṇāgnivarṇena, dāho bāhyālajeḥ punaḥ| bhinnasya kṣāravahnibhyāṃ succhinnasyārbudasya ca|41| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭavira- citāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttara- sthāne vartmarogapratiṣedho nāma navamo'dhyāyaḥ|9|

Sa. evamapyaśāntau vartmadoṣāśrayāṃ valīṃ nirbhujya dahet| adhikaṃ pakṣma saṃdaṃśena hṛtvā tasya pakṣmaṇa āśrayaṃ dahet| kena ? sūcyagreṇāgnivarṇena| bāhyālajestu bhinnasya dāhaḥ kāryaḥ| alajīśabdaḥ puṃsyapi dṛṣṭaḥ| arbudasya kṣāravahnibhyāṃ suṣṭu cchinnasya dāhaḥ kārya iti| iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdaya- ṭīkāyāṃ sarvāṅgasundarakhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne vartma- rogapratiṣedho nāma navamo'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 9||

div.head: sandhisitāsitarogavijñānīyādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: yathoddeśastathā nirdeśa iti tāneva tāvatsandhiroganāha ---- athātaḥ sandhisitāsitarogavijñānīyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre|2| )||3||

div.ab: Sa. vartmarogapratiṣedhādanantaraṃ sthānānupūrvyā sandhisitāsitarogavijñānamārabhyate- saṃ-sandhī ca sitāsitau ca sandhisitāsitāḥ, teṣu rogāḥ, teṣāṃ vijñānam| śeṣaṃ pūrvavat|
vāyuḥkruddhaḥ sirāḥ prāpya jalābhaṃ jalavāhinīḥ| aśru srāvayate vartmaśuklasandheḥ kanīnakāt||1|| tena netraṃ sarugrāgaśophaṃ syātsa jalāsravaḥ| -----------------------------------------------|2|
Sa. pavanaḥ kupito jalavāhinīḥ sirāḥ prāpya jalākṛti aśru srāvayate| kutaḥ ? vartmaśuklasandhe kanīnakāt| tena-jalābhasrāveṇa, nayanaṃ saruk sarāgaṃ saśophaṃ ca syāt| sa ca jalāsravākhyo rogaḥ|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------| kaphāt kaphāsrave śvetaṃ picchilaṃ bahalaṃ sravet||2||

div.ab: Sa. kaphāt kaphāsrave sati śvetaṃ picchilaṃ bahalaṃ ca sravet|
kaphena śophastīkṣṇāgraḥ kṣārabudbudakopamaḥ| pṛthumūlabalaḥ snigdhaḥ savarṇo mṛdupicchilaḥ||3|| mahānapākaḥ kaṇḍūmānupanāhaḥ sa nīrujaḥ| -----------------------------------------------|4|
Sa. śleṣmaṇā śophastīkṣṇāgrādiguṇaḥ| sa upanāhākhyo nīrujaḥ syāt|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------| raktād raktāsrave tāmraṃ bahūṣṇaṃ cāśru saṃsravet||4||

div.ab: Sa. raktena raktāsravo bhavati| tasmiṃśca tāmravarṇamuṣṇaṃ cāśru saṃsravet|

ab.seg: vartmasandhyāśrayā śukle piṭikā dāhaśūlinī| tāmrā mudgopamā bhinnā raktaṃ sravati parvaṇī||5||

div.ab: Sa. vartmasandhirāśrayo yasyāḥ sā vartmasandhyāśrayā, śukle piṭikā śūladāhavatī tāmravarṇā mudgasadṝśī parvaṇī bhaṇyate| sā ca bhinnā satī raktaṃ sravati| eṣā ca raktasamutthaiva vedyā, raktāsravādanantaramasyāḥ pāṭhāt raktasrāvitvācca|

ab.seg: pūyāsrave malāḥ sāsrā vartmasandheḥ kanīnakāt| srāvayanti muhuḥ pūyaṃ sāsraṃ tvaṅmāṃsapākataḥ||6||

div.ab: Sa. pūyāsravākhye doṣā raktasahitā vartmasandheḥ kanīnakāt punaḥ punaḥ pūyaṃ sāsraṃ tvaṅmāṃsapākāddhetoḥ srāvayanti|

ab.seg: pūyālaso vraṇaḥ sūkṣmaḥ śophasaṃrambhapūrvakaḥ| kanīnasandhāvādhmāyī pūyāsrāvī savedanaḥ||7||

div.ab: Sa. pūyālaso vraṇa ucyate| kīdṛk ? sūkṣmaḥ tathā śophasaṃrambhapūrvakaḥ| kvāsau syāt ? kanīnasandhau| tathā''dhmāyīānāhavān, pūyāsrāvī saruk ca syāt|
kanīnasyāntaralajī śopho ruktodadāhavān| -----------------------------------------------|8|
Sa. kanīnasyāntaḥ śopho ruktodadāhavān alajītyucyate|
-----------------------------------------------| apāṅge vā kanīne vā kaṇḍūṣāpakṣmapoṭavān||8|| pūyāsrāvī kṛmigranthirgranthiḥ kṛmiyuto'rtimān| -----------------------------------------------|9|
Sa. apāṅge kanīne vā kaṇḍvādimāṃstathā pūyāsrāvī granthireva kṛmiyukto'rtimān kṛmigranthirucyate|
-----------------------------------------------| upanāhakṛmigranthipūyālasakaparvaṇīḥ||9|| śastreṇa sādhayetpañca sālajīnāsravāṃstyajet| -----------------------------------------------|10|
Sa. upanāhādīṃścturaḥ śastreṇa sādhayet| āsravān-jalāsravādīṃścaturaḥ, alajīṃ ceti pañca tyajet|

ab.seg: evaṃ sandhigatānnava rogānākhyāya sitabhāgasthān rogānāha ---- -----------------------------------------------| pittaṃ kuryātsite bindūnasitaśyāvapītakān||10||
malāktādarśatulyaṃ vā sarvaṃ śuklaṃ sadāharuk| rogo'yaṃ śuktikasaṃjñaḥ saśakṛdbhedatṛḍjvaraḥ||11||

div.ab: Sa. site netradeśe pittaṃ kartṛ bindūn kṛṣṇaśyāvapītān kuryāt| malalepadigdhadarpaṇasamānaṃ vā sarvam śuklam| evamubhayaprakāro'pyayaṃ sadāharuk śuktikasaṃjño rogaḥ, śakṛdbhedena tṛṣā jvareṇa ca yuktaḥ|
kaphācchukle samaṃ śvetaṃ ciravṛddhyadhimāṃsakam| śuklārma-----------------------------------------|12|
Sa. kaphācchuklabhāge samaṃ-na tu viṣamam, tathā śvetavarṇamadhimāṃsakaṃ ciravṛddhi, tat śuklārma|
Sa. śophastu nīrujaḥ samānavarṇo bahalādistathā jalabindusamo balāsagrathitaṃ smṛtam|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------| bindubhiḥ piṣṭadhavalairutsannaiḥ piṣṭakaṃ vadet||13||

div.ab: Sa. bindubhiḥ piṣṭavatsitairutsannaiḥ piṣṭakaṃ nāmārma vadet

ab.seg: raktarājītataṃ śuklamuṣyate yatsavedanam| aśophāśrūpadehaṃ ca sirotpā taḥ sa śoṇitāt||14||

div.ab: Sa. raktarājītataṃ śuklaṃ-śuklabhāgaṃ, uṣyate| yatsavedanaṃ śophāśrūpaleparahitaṃ sa śoṇitāt sirotpātaḥ|

ab.seg: upekṣitaḥ sirotpāto rājīstā eva vardhayan| kuryātsāsraṃ sirāharṣaṃ tenākṣyudvīkṣaṇākṣamam||15||

div.ab: Sa. sirotpāto'cikitsitastā eva-raktā eva, rājīrvardhayan sirāharṣaṃ sāsraṃ kuryāt| tena-sirāharṣeṇa, locanaṃ vīkṣaṇākṣamaṃ syāt|
sirājāle sirājālaṃ būhadraktaṃ ghanonnatam| -----------------------------------------------|16|
Sa. sirājāle bṛhattathā raktaṃ ghanamunnataṃ ca yad bhavati, tatsirājālaṃ nāma|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------| śoṇitārma samaṃ ślakṣṇaṃ padmābhamadhimāṃsakam||16||

div.ab: Sa. samaṃ-natu viṣamaṃ, tathā ślakṣṇaṃ yadadhimāṃsakaṃ tacchoṇitārma|
nīruk ślakṣṇo'rjunaṃ binduḥ śaśalohitalohitaḥ| -----------------------------------------------|17|
Sa. nīrujaḥ ślakṣṇo binduḥ śaśalohitatāmro'rjunaṃ nāma|
Sa. māṃsaṃ prastāritaṃ tathā mṛdu tathā āśuvṛddhi tathā nīruk śyāvalohitaṃ prastāryarmetyucyate| tacca tribhirdoṣaiḥ saśoṇitaiḥ syāt|
Sa. snāvasadṛśaṃ tu snāvārmetyucyate|
Sa. śuṣkaraktapiṇḍavacchyāvaṃ yanmāṃsaṃ tathā bahalaṃ pṛthu ca syāt, tadadhimāṃsārma bhaṇyate|

ab.seg: ----------------------dāhagharṣavatyaḥ sirāvṛtāḥ| kṛṣṇāsannāḥ sirāsaṃjñāḥ piṭikāḥ sarṣapopamāḥ||19||

div.ab: Sa. piṭikā dāhādimatyastathā sirācitāḥ kṛṣṇabhāgāsannāḥ sarṣapasaṃsthānāḥ sirāsaṃjñāḥ|

sitabhāgotthānāmeṣāṃ trayodaśānāṃ sādhanaṃ sūtrayati ---- śuktiharṣasirotpātapiṣṭakagrathitārjunam| sādhayaidauṣadhaiḥ ṣaṭkaṃ śeṣaṃ śastreṇa saptakam||20|| navotthaṃ tadapi dravyaiḥ-----------------------------| -----------------------------------------------|21|
Sa. śuktyādīn ṣaḍauṣadhaiḥ sādhayet| śeṣān sapta śastreṇa sādhayet| navotthitānetānapi bheṣajairupakramet na kevalaṃ pūrvoktaṃ ṣaṭkamityarthaḥ|
---------------------armoktaṃ yacca pañcadhā| tacchedyamasitaprāptaṃ māṃsasnavasirāvṛtam||21|| carmoddālavaducchrāyi dṛṣṭiprāptaṃ ca varjayet| -----------------------------------------------|22|

Sa. yacca pañcaprakāramarmoktaṃ-śuklārma śoṇitārma prastāryarma snāvārmādhimāṃsārma, etacchedanārham| yat kṛṣṇabhāgaprāptaṃ māṃsasnāvasirāvṛtaṃ carmoddālavaducchrāyi tadvarjayet-na cikitset| yacca dṛṣṭiprāptaṃ tadapi varjayet|

atha kṛṣṇarogānāha ---- -----------------------------------------------| pittaṃ kṛṣṇe'thava dṛṣṭau śukraṃ todāśrurāgavat||22|| chitvā tvacaṃ janayati tena syātkṛṣṇamaṇḍalam| pakvajambūnibhaṃ kiñcinnimnaṃ ca kṣataśukrakam||23|| tatkṛcchrasādhyaṃ, yāpyaṃ tu dvitīyapaṭalavyadhāt| tatra todādibāhulyaṃ sūcīviddhābhakṛṣṇatā||24|| tṛtīyapaṭalacchedādasādhyaṃ nicitaṃ vraṇaiḥ| -----------------------------------------------|25|

Sa. pittaṃ kartṛ kṛṣṇabhāge dṛṣṭau vā śukraṃ janayati| kimbhūtam ? todāśrurāgayuktam| kiṃ kṛtvā ? tvacaṃ-prathamaṃ paṭalaṃ chittvā, tena kṛṣṇamaṇḍalaṃ pakvajambūsadṛśaṃ nimraṃ ca kṣataśukrakaṃ syāt| tacca kṛcchrasādhyam| dvitīyapaṭalavyadhāttu yāpyaṃ syāt| tatra-dvītīyapaṭalavyadhe, todādīnāṃ bāhulyaṃ tathā sūcīviddhopamakṛṣṇamaṇḍalatvaṃ ca| todādibhūyastvena sevanīviddhopamakṛṣṇamaṇḍalatayā ca dvitīyapaṭalavyadho'numīyata ityarthaḥ| tṛtīyapaṭalacchedāt vraṇairnicitamasādhyaṃ kṣataśukrakam| evaṃ kṣataśukrakaṃ tridhā'bhidhāya śuddhaśukramācaṣṭe|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------| śaṅkhaśuklaṃ kaphātsādhyaṃ nātiruk śuddhaśukrakam||25||

div.ab: Sa. śaṅkhavacchuklaṃ śuddhaśukrakam| tacca kaphājjāyate| na cātivedanam|

ab.seg: ātāmrapicchilāsrasrudātāmrapiṭikā'tiruk| ajāviṭsadṛśocchrāyakārṣṇyā varjyā'sṛjā'jakā||26||

div.ab: Sa. ātāmraṃ-īṣattāmravarṇaṃ, picchilaṃ cāsraṃ sravati yā'sau ātāmrapicchilāsrasrut| tathā ātāmrapiṭikā tathā'tipīḍāvatī tathā'jāviṭsadṛśe ucchrāyakārṣṇye yasyāḥ saivam| ajakākhyā raktena syāt| sā ca varjyā'sādhyatvāt|
sirāśukraṃ malaiḥ sāsraistajjuṣṭaṃ kṛṣṇamaṇḍalam| satodadāhatāmrābhiḥ sirābhiravatanyate||27|| animittoṣṇaśītācchaghanāsrasrucca tattyajet| -----------------------------------------------|28|

Sa. saraktairmalaiḥ sirāśukraṃ syāt| tena sirāśukreṇa juṣṭaṃ kṛṣṇamaṇḍalaṃ sirābhiravatanyate| kimbhūtābhiḥ ? satodadāhatāmrābhiḥ| animittaṃ-akasmāt, asmin kadāciduṣṇamacchaṃ ghanaṃ vā'sraṃ sravati| tacca tyajedasādhyatvāt|

-----------------------------------------------| doṣaiḥ sāsraiḥ sakṛtkṛṣṇaṃ nīyate śuklarūpatām||28|| dhavalābhropaliptābhaṃ niṣpāvardhadalākṛti| atitīvrarujārāgadāhaśvayathupīḍitam||29|| pākātyayena tacchukraṃ varjayettīvravedanam| -----------------------------------------------|30|

Sa. doṣaiḥ saraktaiḥ sakṛt-ekahelayaiva, kṛṣṇamaṇḍalaṃ śuklarūpatāṃ nīyate| kimbhūtam ? dhavalābhropaliptābham| tathā niṣpāvārdhadalasyevākṛtiryasya tadevam| tathā tīvravedanārāgadāhaśvayathubhiḥ pīḍitam| tacca śukraṃ pākātyayena tīvrarujaṃ varjayet-nopakramet|

-----------------------------------------------| yasya vā liṅganāśo'ntaḥ śyāvaṃ yadvā salohitam|30| atyutsedhāvagāḍhaṃ vā sāśru nāḍīvraṇāvṛtam| purāṇaṃ viṣamaṃ madhye vicchinnaṃ yacca śukrakam|31| pañcetyuktā gadāḥ kṛṣṇe sādhyāsādhyavibhāgataḥ| 31 1/2| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviraci- tāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne sandhisitāsitarogavijñhānīyo nāma daśamo'dhyāyaḥ|10|

Sa. yasya ca śukrasya liṅganāśaḥ-antardṛṣṭivināśa ityarthaḥ, yacca śyāvamantaḥ, yacca kiñcillohitam, tathā'tyunnatamavagāḍhaṃ vā, sāśrunāḍīvraṇāvṛtaṃ vā, tathā purāṇaṃ-vatsarātītam tathā viṣamasaṃsthānam, tathā madhye vicchinnaṃ yacca śukrakaṃ, tatsarvaṃ varjayet| kṛṣṇamaṇḍale iti-pūrvoktena prakāreṇa, pañca rogāḥ sādhyāsādhyavibhāgenoktāḥ| sukhagrahaṇadhāraṇārthaṃ saṅkhyopādānamiti| iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅga- hṛdayaṭīkāyāṃ sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttara- sthāne sandhisitāsiratogavijñānīyo nāma daśamo'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 10||

div.head: sandhisitasitarogapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: asmādanantaraṃ sandhisitāsitarogapratiṣedha ucyate ---- athātaḥ sandhisitāsitarogapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyadayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre|2| )||3||

div.ab: Sa. pratiṣidhyate nirākriyate cikitsyata iti pratiṣedhaḥ,-cikitsā| śeṣaṃ pūrvavat|

ab.seg: jalāsrāvakaphāsrāvayorasādhyatvādupanāhacikitsāmāha ---- upanāhaṃ bhiṣak svinnaṃ bhinnaṃ vrīhimukhena ca| lekhayenmaṇḍalāgreṇa tataśca pratisārayet||1||
pippalīkṣaudrasindhūtthairbadhnīyātpūrvavattataḥ| paṭolapatrāmalakakvāthenāścyotayecca tam||2||

div.ab: Sa. vaidyo maṇḍalāgreṇopanāhaṃ sandhirogaṃ lekhayet| kimbhūtam ? svinnaṃ vartmarogapratiṣedhoktena prakāreṇa poṭalikayoṣṇodakaplutayeti| tathā vrīhimukhena bhinnam| tataḥ pippalyādibhiḥ pratisārayet| [ tataḥ-] anantaraṃ, pūrvavat-prakṣālyoṣṇena vāriṇā ghṛtena siktamabhyaktaṃ madhusarpiṣā ūrdhvādhaḥ karṇayośca yavasaktubhiḥ piṇḍīṃ dattvā, badhnīyāditi| tathā paṭolapatrāmalakakvāthena cāścyotayet|
parvaṇī baḍiśenāttā bāhyasandhitribhāgataḥ| vṛddhipatreṇa vardhyā'rdhe syādaśrugatiranyathā||3|| cikitsā cārmavatkṣaudrasaindhavapratisāritā| -----------------------------------------------|4|

Sa. parvaṇī bāhyasandhitribhāge baḍiśena gṛhītā satī vṛddhi patreṇa vardhyā-chedanīyā| kutra bhāge vardhyā ? ityāha-ardhe| ato'nyathā-adhikacchedanāt, aśrugatiḥ syāt| cikitsā ceyamarmavat| tatra caivamuktam (ślo. 20)-"samyak chinnaṃ madhuvyoṣasaindhavapratisāritam| uṣṇena sarpiṣā siktamabhyaktaṃ madhusarpiṣā|| badhnīyātsecayenmuktvā tṛtīyādidineṣu ca| karañjabījasiddhena kṣīreṇa' iti|
-----------------------------------------------| pūyālase sirāṃ vidhyettatastamupanāhayet||4|| kurvīta cākṣipākoktaṃ sarvaṃ karma yathāvidhi| -----------------------------------------------|5|
Sa. pūyālase sirāṃ vidhyet| anantaramupanāhayet| akṣipākoktaṃ cāśeṣaṃ karma yathāvidhi kurvīta|
-----------------------------------------------| saindhavārdrakakāsīsalohatāmraiḥ sucūrṇitaiḥ||5|| cūrṇañjanaṃ prayuñjīta sakṣaudrairvā rasakriyām| -----------------------------------------------|6|
Sa. saindhavādibhiścūrṇāñjanaṃ prayuñjīta| saindhavādibhireva mākṣikayutai rasakriyāṃ vā|

-----------------------------------------------| kṛmigranthiṃ karīṣeṇa svinnaṃ bhittvā vilikhya ca||6|| triphalākṣaudrakāsīsasaindhavaiḥ pratisārayet| -----------------------------------------------|7|
Sa. kṛmigranthi tripalādibhiḥ pratisārayet| kimbhūtam ? karīṣeṇa-gomayādinā svinnam, tathā vrīhimukhādibhirbhittvā vilikhya ca|
Sa. śuktyākhyaṃ rogaṃ pittābhiṣyandena tulyamupācaret|

ab.seg: kaphābhiṣyandavanmuktvā sirāvyadhamupācaret| bījapūrarasāktaṃ ca vyoṣakaṭphalamañjanam||8||

div.ab: Sa. balāsagrathitaṃ piṣṭakaṃ ca sirāvyadhaṃ varjayitvā kaphābhiṣyandavadupācaret| tathā bījapūrakarasenāktaṃ vyoṣakaṭphalamañjanaṃ|

ab.seg: jātīmukulasindhūtthadevadārumahauṣadhaiḥ| piṣṭaiḥ prasannayā vartiḥ śophakaṇḍūghnamañjanam||9||

div.ab: Sa. jātīmukulādibhiḥ prasannayā piṣṭairvartiḥ śophakaṇḍūharamañjanam|
raktasyandavadutpātaharṣajālārjunukriyā| -----------------------------------------------|10|
Sa. sirotpātasirāharṣasirājālārjune kriyā raktasyanda iva kāryā|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------| sirotpāte viśeṣeṇa ghṛtamākṣikamañjanam||10||
sirāharṣe tu madhunā ślakṣṇaghṛṣṭaṃ rasāñjanam| arjune śarkarāmastukṣaudrairāścayotanaṃ hitam||11||
sphaṭikaḥ kuṅkumaṃ śaṅkho madhukaṃ madhunā'ñjanam| madhunā cāñjanaṃ śaṅkhaḥ pheno vā sitayā saha||12||

div.ab: Sa. sirotpāte viśeṣeṇa ghṛtamākṣikamañjanaṃ hitam| sirāharṣe mākṣikeṇa ślakṣṇaghṛṣṭaṃ rasāñjanam| arjune śarkarāmastukṣaudreṇāścyotanaṃ hitam| spāṭikādi mākṣikeṇāñjanamathavā sauvīrāñjanaṃ madhunā hitam| śaṅkho vā samudrapheno vā śarkarayā saha hitaḥ|

ab.seg: armoktaṃ pañcadhā tatra tanu dhūmāvilaṃ ca yat| raktaṃ dadhinibhaṃ yacca śukravattasya bheṣajam||13||

div.ab: Sa. arma pañcaprakāramuktam| teṣu madhye yattanu dhūmavadāvilaṃ ca, tathā raktaṃ-raktavarṇaṃ, dadhisadṛśaṃ ca yat, tasyārmaṇaḥ śukrasadṛśamauṣadham|

ab.seg: athārmaṇaḥ śastracikitsāmāha ---- uttānasyetarat svinnaṃ sasindhūtthena cāñjitam| rasena bījapūrasya nimīlyākṣi vimardayet||14||
itthaṃ saṃroṣitākṣāsya pracale'rmādhimāṃsake| dhṛtasya niścalaṃ mūrdhni vartmanośca viśeṣataḥ||15||
apāṅgamīkṣamāṇasya vṛddh'rmaṇi kanīnakāt| valī syādyatra tatrārma baḍiśenāvalambitam||16||
nātyāyataṃ mucuṇḍyā vā sūcyā sūtreṇa vā tataḥ| samantānmaṇḍalāgreṇa mocayedatha mokṣitam||17||
kanīnakamupānīya caturbhāgāvaśeṣitam| chindyātkanīnakaṃ rakṣedvāhinīścāśruvāhinīḥ||18||
kanīnakavyadhādaśru nāḍī cākṣṇi pravartate| vṛddhe'rmaṇi tathā'pāṅgātpaśyato'sya kanīnakam||19||

div.ab: Sa. uttānasya puṃso vāmadakṣiṇayoritarat-ekamakṣi, svinnaṃkṛtasvedaṃ ca, tathā bījapūrarasena saindhavānvitenāñjitaṃ nimīlyasthagayitvā, vimardayet-malayet| anena prakāreṇa saṃroṣitākṣasyasato'rmādhimāṃse pracale sati mūrdhni niścalaṃ ghṛtasya vartmanośca viśeṣeṇa ghṛtasya kanīnakādarmaṇi vṛddhe satyapāṅgaṃ paśyato yatra valī syāt tatrārma baḍiśenāvalambitaṃ nātyāyataṃ-nātidīrghaṃ yathābhavatitathā'valambitam| tataḥ-anantaraṃ, mucuṇḍyā sūcyā sūtreṇa vā mocayet| atha mokṣitaṃ ca viccheditaṃ ca sat kanīnakamupānīya caturbhāgāvaśeṣitaṃ maṇḍalāgrena chindyāt| vyavahitānāmapi padānāmarthayogyatāvaśādeva sambandho'tra yojyaḥ| kanīnakaṃ rakṣet| kanīnakavyadhādaśru nāḍī cākṣṇi pravartate| apāṅgapradeśāccārmaṇi vṛddhe tathā kanīnakaṃ vīkṣamāṇasya chindyāt|

ab.seg: samyak chinnaṃ madhuvyoṣasaindhavapratisāritam| uṣṇena sarpiṣā siktamabhyaktaṃ madhusarpiṣā||20||
badhnīyātsecayenmuktvā tṛtīyādidineṣu ca| karañjabījasiddhena kṣīreṇa kvathitaistathā||21||
sakṣaudrairdviniśārodhrapaṭolīyaṣṭikiṃśukaiḥ| kuraṇṭamukulopetairmuñcedevāhni saptame||22||

div.ab: Sa. samyak chinnaṃ madhvādibhiḥ pratisāritaṃ ghṛtenoṣṇena siktaṃ mākṣikasarpiṣā'bhyaktaṃ badhnīyāt| tṛtīyādidineṣu ca muktvā kṣīreṇa karañjabījasiddhena secayet| dviharidrādibhiśca kvathitaiḥ śītaiśca madhuyutaiḥ sekaṃ kuryāt| saptame dine muñcedeva|

ab.seg: samyak chinne bhavetsvāsthyaṃ hīnāticchedajān gadān| sekāñjanaprabhṛtibhirjayellekhanabṛṃhaṇaiḥ||23||

div.ab: Sa. samyak chinne'rmaṇi svāsthyaṃ bhavet| hīnāticchedajān rogān sekāñjanādyairyathāyogaṃ lekhanairbṛṃhaṇaiśca jayet|
sitāmanaḥśilaileyalavaṇottamanāgaram| ardhakarṣonmitaṃ tārkṣyaṃ palārdhaṃ ca madhudrutam||24|| añjanaṃ śleṣmatimirapillaśukrārmaśeṣajit| -----------------------------------------------|25|
Sa. sitādibhirardhakarṣonmitai rasāñjanaṃ dvikarṣonmitaṃ madhudrutamañjanaṃ śleṣmatimirādijit

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------| triphalaikatamadravyatvacaṃ pānīyakalkitām||25||
śarāvapihitāṃ dagdhvā kapāle cūrṇayettataḥ| pṛthakśeṣauṣadharasaiḥ pṛthageva ca bhāvitā||26||
sā maṣī śoṣitā peṣyā bhūyo dvilavaṇānvitā| triṇyetānyañjanānyāha lekhanāni paraṃ nimiḥ||27||

div.ab: Sa. triphalāyā ekatamasya harītakyāderdravyasya tvacaṃ pānīyakalkitāṃ śarāvapihitāṃ kapāle dagdhvā cūrṇayet| tata eva triphalāyāḥ pṛthak śeṣauṣadharasaiḥ pṛthageva caikaikaṃ bhāvitā sā maṣī śoṣitā punaḥ peṣyā lavaṇadvayayutā| trīṇyetānyañjanāni paraṃ lekhanāni timiraghnāni nimirvakti|

ab.seg: sirājāle sirā yāstu kaṭhinā lekhanauṣadhaiḥ| na siddhyantyarmavattāsāṃ piṭikānāṃ ca sādhanam||28||

div.ab: Sa. sirājāle yāḥ sirā kaṭhinā lekhanauṣadhairna sidhyanti tāsāmarmavat cikitsā, piṭikānāṃ ca|

ab.seg: doṣānurodhācchukreṣu snigdharūkṣā varā ghṛtam| tiktamūrdhvamasṛksrāvo rekasekādi ceṣyate||29||

div.ab: Sa. śukreṣu doṣavaśāt kadācit rūkṣā kadācit snigdhā triphalā hitā| tathā ghṛtaṃ tiktamūrdhvamasṛksrāvo rekasekādi ceṣyate|

tristrivṛdvāriṇā pakvaṃ kṣataśukre ghṛtaṃ pibet| sirāyāν haredraktaṃ jalaukobhiśca locanāt||30|| siddhenotpalakākolīdrākṣāyaṣṭividāribhiḥ| sasitenājapayasā secanaṃ salilena vā||31|| rāgāśruvedanāśāntau paraṃ lekhanamañjanam| -----------------------------------------------|32|

Sa. trivṛtkvāthena trīn vārān ghṛtaṃ pakvaṃ kṣataśukre pibet| paścātsirayā raktaṃ haret| nayanādvā jalaukobhirharet| tathā''jadugdhenotpalādibhiḥ siddhena saśarkareṇa secanaṃ hitam| athavotpalādikvathitena jalena secayet| rāgāśruvedanāśāntau satyāṃ lekhanamañjanaṃ hitam|
-----------------------------------------------| vartayo jātimukulalākṣāgairikacandanaiḥ||32|| prasādayanti pittāsraṃ ghnanti ca kṣataśukrakam| -----------------------------------------------|33|
Sa. jātimukulādibhirvartayaḥ pittāsraṃ prasādayanti| kṣataśukraṃ ca ghnanti|

-----------------------------------------------| dantairdantivarāhoṣṭragavāśvājakharodbhavaiḥ||33|| saśaṅkhamauktikāmbhodhiphenairmaricapādikaiḥ| kṣataśukramapi vyāpi dantavartirnivatayet||34|| tamālapatraṃ godantaśaṅkhapheno'sthi gārdabham| tāmraṃ ca vartirmūtreṇa sarvaśukrakanāśinī||35|| ratnāni dantāḥ śṛṅgāṇi dhātavastryūṣaṇaṃ truṭiḥ| karañjabījaṃ laśuno vraṇasādi ca bheṣajam||36|| savraṇāvraṇagambhīratvaksthaśukraghnamañjanam| nimnamunnamayetsnehapānanasyarasāñjanaiḥ||37|| sarujaṃ nīrujaṃ tṛptipuṭapākena śukrakam| -----------------------------------------------|38|

Sa. gajādyudbhavairdantaiḥ śaṅkhamuktāphenayutaiścuturthāṃśakamaricaiḥ kṣataśukrakamapi vyāpi dantavartiriyaṃ nivartayet| apiśabdācchuddhaśukrakamapi| tamālapatrādibhirvartirgomūtreṇa sarvaśukrakahṛt| ratnani-mauktikādīni, dantāḥ-gajādīnām, śṛṅgāṇi chāgādīnām, dhātavo-gairikādyāḥ, tryūṣaṇādīni, tathā vraṇasādi bheṣajaṃ-svarṇakṣīryādi, etadañjanaṃ savraṇāvraṇagambhīratvaksthaśukraharam| nimnaṃ śukrakaṃ snehapānādibhirunnamayet| sarujaṃ nīrujaṃ ca tarpaṇapuṭapākenonnamayet|
-----------------------------------------------| śuddhaśukre niśāyaṣṭīsārivāśābarāmbhasā||38|| secanaṃ rodhrapoṭalyā koṣṇāmbhomagnayā'thavā| -----------------------------------------------|39|
Sa. śuddhaśukre haridrādikvāthena secanaṃ hitam| athavā rodhrapoṭālyā koṣṇāmbumagnayā|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------| bṛhatīmūlayaṣṭyāhvatāmrasaindhavanāgaraiḥ||39||
dhātrīphalāmbunā piṣṭairlepitaṃ tāmrabhājanam| yavājyāmalakīpatrairbahuśo dhūpayettataḥ||40||
tatra kurvīta guṭikāstā jalakṣaudrapeṣitāḥ| mahānīlā iti khyātāḥ śuddhaśukraharāḥ param||41||

div.ab: Sa. bṛhatīcūrṇādibhirāmalakajalena piṣṭaistāmrabhājanaṃ lepitaṃ yavādibhirdhūpayet| anantaraṃ tatra guṭikāstoyamākṣikapiṣṭāḥ kuryāt| etāśca mahānīlā iti prathitāḥ paraṃ śuddhaśukraghnāḥ|

ab.seg: sthire śure ghane cāsya bahuśo'paharedrasṛk| śiraḥkāyavirekāṃśca puṭapākāṃśca bhūriśaḥ||42||

div.ab: Sa. sthire śukre ghane cāturasyāsya bahuśo raktaṃ mokṣayet| śirovirekādīn puṭapākāṃśca punaḥpunaḥ kuryāt|

ab.seg: kuryānmaricavaidehīśirīṣaphalasaindhavaiḥ| harṣaṇaṃ triphalākvāthapītena lavaṇena vā||43||

div.ab: Sa. maricādibhirharṣaṇaṃ kuryāt| triphalākvāthapītena saindhavena vā|
kuryādañjanayogau vā ślokārdhagaditāvimau| śaṅkhakolāsthikatakadrākṣāmadhukamākṣikaiḥ||44|| surādantārṇavamalaiḥ śirīṣakusumānvitaiḥ| -----------------------------------------------|45|
Sa. imau ślokārdhauktau yogau gha(ha)rṣaṇāya kuryāt| śaṅkhādibhirmākṣikāntaireko yogaḥ, surādibhiḥ kusumāntairanyaḥ|
-----------------------------------------------| dhātrīphaṇijjakarase kṣāro lāṅgalikodbhavaḥ||45|| uṣitaḥ śoṣitataścūrṇaḥ śukraharṣaṇamañjanam| -----------------------------------------------|46|
Sa. dhātryādirase kṣāro lāṅgalikaja uṣitaḥ śoṣitaścūrṇaḥ śukraharṣaṇamañjanam|

-----------------------------------------------| mudgā vā nistuṣāḥ piṣṭāḥ śaṅkhakṣaudrasamāyutāḥ||46|| sāro madhūkānmadhumān majjā vā'kṣātsamākṣikā| gokharāśvoṣṭradaśanāḥ śaṅkhaḥ phenaḥ samudrajaḥ||47|| vartirarjunatoyena hṛṣṭaśukrakanāśinī| -----------------------------------------------|48|

Sa. śaṅkhamadhuyutā mudgā nistuṣāḥ piṣṭā athavā'ñjanam| madhūkātsāro madhuyuto'ñjanam| athavā bibhītakānmajjā mākṣikānvitā| saṃ-gavādidantāḥ śaṅkhaḥ samudrapheno vā pārthajalena piṣṭāvartihṛṣṭaśukrahṛt|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------| utsannaṃ vā saśalyaṃ vā śukraṃ vālādibhirlikhet||48||

div.ab: Sa. utsannaṃ vā saśalyaṃ vā śukraṃ vālaśākapatrādibhirlikhet|
sirāśukre tvadṛṣṭighne cikitsā vraṇaśukravat| -----------------------------------------------|49|
Sa. sirāśukre punaradṛṣṭighne cikitsā vraṇaśukra iva kāryā|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------| puṇḍrayaṣṭyāhvakākolīsiṃhīlohaniśāñjanam||49||
kalkitaṃ chāgadugdhena saghṛtairdhūpitaṃ yavaiḥ| dhātrīpatraiśca paryāyādvartiratrāñjanaṃ param||50||

div.ab: Sa. pāṇḍrādikaṃ chāgadugdhena piṣṭaṃ sasarpiṣkairyavairāmalakapatraiśca paryāyeṇa dhūpitā vartirne(ra)trāñjanaṃ param|
aśāntāvarmavacchastramajakākhye ca yojayet| -----------------------------------------------|51|
Sa. aśāntau satyāmarmavadajakākhye ca śastraṃ prayojayet|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------| ajakāyāmasādhyāyāṃ śukre'nyatra ca tadvidhe||51||
vedanopaśamaṃ snehapānāsṛksrāvaṇādibhiḥ| kuryādbībhatsatāṃ jetuṃ śukrasyotsedhasādhanam||52||

div.ab: Sa. asādhyāyāmajakāyāṃ śukre cānyatra roge tatprakāre'sādhye vedanopaśamaṃ snehapānādibhirvidadhīta| bībhatsatāṃ-nindyatāṃ, jetuṃ śukrasyotsedhasādhanaṃ kuryāt|

ab.seg: nālikerāsthibhallātatālavaṃśakarīrajam| bhasmādbhiḥ srāvayettābhirbhāvayetkarabhāsthijam||53||
cūrṇaṃ śukreṣvasādhyeṣu tadvaivarṇyaghnamañjanam| sādhyeṣu sādhanāyālamidameva ca śīlitam||54||

div.ab: Sa. nālikerāsthyādijaṃ bhasma adbhiḥ srāvayet| tābhiradbhiḥ karabhāsthijaṃ cūrṇaṃ bhāvayet| taccūrṇamañjanamasādhyeṣu śukreṣu vaivarṇyaharam| śīlitaṃ caitadeva śukrāṇāṃ sādhanāyālaṃ-śreṣṭham|

ajakāṃ pāRśvato vidhvā sūcyā visrāvya codakam| samaṃ prapīḍyāṅguṣṭhena vasārdreṇānu pūrayet|55| vraṇaṃ gomāṃsacūrṇena baddhaṃ baddhaṃ vimucya ca| saptarātrād vraṇe rūḍhe kṛṣṇabhāge same sthire|56| snehāñjanaṃ ca kartavyaṃ nasyaṃ ca kṣīrasarpiṣā| tathā'pi punarādhmāne bhedacchedādikāṃ kriyām|57| yuktyā kuryādyathā nāticchedena syānnimajjanam| 57 1/2| nityaṃ ca śukreṣu śṛtaṃ yathāsvaṃ pāne ca marśe ca ghṛtaṃ vidadhyāt| na hīyate labdhabalā tathā'nta- stīkṣṇāñjanairdṛk satataṃ prayuktaiḥ| 58 1/2| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭavira- citāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttara- sthāne sandhisitāsitarogapratiṣedho nāmaikādaśo'dhyāyaḥ|11|

Sa. ajakāṃ pārśvataḥ sūcyā vidhvā jalaṃ ca niḥsrāvyānantaramaṅguṣṭhena samaṃ vasārdreṇa-vasayā dravīkṛtya, vraṇaṃ gomāṃsacūrṇena pūrayet| baddhaṃ baddhaṃ vimucya sa saptarātrād vraṇe rūḍhe sati tathā kṛṣṇabhāge same sthite sati snehāñjanaṃ ca kartavyam| kṣīraghṛte ca nasyam| evamapi kṛte punarādhmāne sati bhedacchedādikāṃ kriyāṃ yuktyā kuryāt| yathā'ticchedena dṛṣṭernimajjanaṃ na syāt| śukreṣu ca nityaṃ ghṛtaṃ yathāyogaṃ pakvaṃ pānādau vidadhyāt| kim ? ityāha-tathā ghṛtapānasecanena labdhabalā dṛgantaḥ pratataṃ prayuktaistīkṣṇāñjanairna hīyate-na hāniṃ yāyāditi| upajātirvṛttam| iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayaṭī- kāyāṃ sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne sandhisitā- sitarogapratiṣedho nāmaikādaśo'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 11||

div.head: dṛṣṭirogavijñānīyādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto dṛṣṭirogavijñānīyamadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre|2| ) sirānusāriṇi male prathamaṃ paṭalaṃ śrite| avyaktamīkṣate rūpaṃ vyaktamapyanimittataḥ||1||

div.ab: Sa. asmādanantaraṃ dṛṣṭirogavijñānamāha| tatrāpi pūrvaṃ timiraṃ lilakṣayiṣurāha- [ male- ] doṣe vātādyanyatame, sirānusāriṇi tathā prathamaṃ-bāhyaṃ, paṭalaṃ śrite satyavyaktaṃ rūpaṃ paśyati| vyaktamapi kadācinnimittamantareṇa paśyati| eṣa timirākhyo roga iti vakṣyamāṇena sambandhaḥ|

ab.seg: prāpte dvitīyaṃ paṭalamabhūtamapi paśyati| bhūtaṃ tu yatnādāsannaṃ dūre sūkṣmaṃ ca nekṣate||2||
dūrāntikasthaṃ rūpaṃ ca viparyāsena manyate| doṣe maṇḍalasaṃsthāne maṇḍalānīva paśyati||3||
dvidhaikaṃ dṛṣṭimadhyasthe bahudhā bahudhāsthite| dṛṣṭerabhyantaragate hnasvavṛddhaviparyayam||4||
māntikasthamadhaḥsaṃsthe dūragaṃ nopari sthite| pārśve paśyennapārśvasthe timirākhyo'yamāmayaḥ||5||

div.ab: Sa. dvitīyaṃ paṭalaṃ prāpte'bhūtamapi paśyati, na kevalaṃ bhūtam| bhūtaṃ tu yatnena paśyati, taccāsannameva| dūre na ca sūkṣmaṃ paśyati| dūrāntikasthaṃ ca rūpaṃ vaiparītyena manyate,-dūrasthaṃ nikaṭasthaṃ, nikaṭasthaṃ dūrasthamityarthaḥ| doṣe maṇḍalasaṃsthāne dvitīyapaṭalāśrite eva maṇḍalānīvālokate| dṛṣṭimadhyasthe doṣa ekameva vastu dviprakāraṃ paśyati| bahudhāsthite doṣa ekameva vastu bahuprakāraṃ paśyati| dṛṣṭerabhyantarāśrite doṣe hrasvaṃ ca vṛddhaṃ ca tayorviparyayaḥ| hrasvaṃ ca mahāntaṃ, mahāntaṃ ca hrasvamiti vaiparītyena paśyati| adhaḥsthite doṣe samīpasthaṃ padārthaṃ nekṣate| upariṣṭātsthite doṣe dūragaṃ na paśyati| pārśvasthe doṣe pārśve rūpaṃ na paśyet| ayaṃ sarva eva timirasaṃjño rogaḥ|
prāpnoti kācatāṃ doṣe tṛtīyapaṭalāśrite| tenordhvamīkṣate nādhastanucailāvṛtopamam||6|| yathā varṇaṃ ca rajyeta dṛṣṭirhīyeta ca kramāt| -----------------------------------------------|7|

Sa. tṛtīyaṃ paṭalaṃ sthite doṣe kācatvaṃ prāpnoti| tena kācenordhvamīkṣate na tvadhaḥ| tacca tanuvastracchannasadṛśam| dṛṣṭiścātra doṣānusāreṇa rajyate| yathā vātena śyāvetyādi| krameṇa ca dṛṣtirhīyate|
-----------------------------------------------| tathā'pyupekṣamāṇasya caturthaṃ paṭalaṃ gataḥ||7|| liṅganāśaṃ malaḥ kurvan chādayeddṛṣṭimaṇḍalam| -----------------------------------------------|8|
Sa. evamapyupekṣamāṇasyācikitsitasya tṛtīyaṃ paṭalaṃ muktvā caturthapaṭalaṃ gato malo-doṣaḥ, liṅganāśaṃ-dṛṣṭināśaṃ ca, kurvan dṛṣṭimaṇḍalaṃ chādayet|

iti sāmānyalakṣaṇamuktva viśeṣamāha ---- -----------------------------------------------| tatra vātena timire vyāviddhamiva paśyati||8|| calāvilāruṇābhāsaṃ prasannaṃ cekṣate muhuḥ| jalāni keśān maśakān raśmīṃścopekṣite'tra ca||9|| kācībhūte dṛgaruṇā paśyatyāsyamanāsikam| candradīpādyanekatvaṃ vakramṛjvapi manyate||10|| vṛddhaḥ kāco dṛśaṃ kuryādrajodhūmāvṛtāmiva| spaṣṭāruṇābhāṃ vistīrṇāṃ sūkṣmāṃ vā hatadarśanām||11|| sa liṅganāśo------------------------------------| -----------------------------------------------|12|

Sa. tatra-timireṣu madhye, pavanena timire sati vyāviddhamiva paśyati| tathā calaṃ dhūmāvilamaruṇābhāsaṃ muhuḥ-punaḥ-prasannaṃ cālokate-prakṛtisthanayanena paśyati, pavanasya calarūpatvāt| tathā jālādīni muhuḥ paśyati| āsyaṃ-mukhaṃ, anāsikaṃ-nāsikārahitaṃ, paśyati| tathā candradīpādīnāmanekatvaṃ vakramavakramiva ca manyate| vṛddhaḥ kāco rajodhūmāvṛtāmiva ca dṛṣṭiṃ kuryāt| tathā spaṣṭā'ruṇā''bhā yasyāstām| tathā vistīrṇāṃ sūkṣmāṃ vā| tathā hatadarśanām| sa evaṃbhūto liṅganāśaḥ| iti vātajāstimirakācaliṅganāśā uktāḥ|

ab.seg: adhunā vāyusāmānyāṃ gambhīrāṃ dṛṣṭiṃ vyācaṣṭe ---- -------------------vāte tu saṅkocayati dṛksirāḥ| dṛgmaṇḍalaṃ viśatyantargambhīrā dṛgasou smṛtā||12||

div.ab: Sa. vāte tu dṛksirāḥ saṅkocayati sati dṛṣṭimaṇḍalamantaḥ praviśati| sā gambhīrā dṛṣṭiḥ smṛtā| 'munibhiḥ' iti śeṣaḥ|

ab.seg: pittaje timire vidyutkhadyotadyotadīpitam| śikhitittiripatrābhaṃ prāyo nīlaṃ ca paśyati||13||
kāce dṛk kācanīlābhā tādṛgeva ca paśyati| arkendupativeṣāgnimaricīndradhanūṃṣi ca||14||

div.ab: Sa. pittodbhave timire vidyudādidīpitaṃ tathā mayūratittiripatrābhaṃ prāyeṇa nīlaṃ ca paśyati| kāce kācanīlasadṛśī dṛṣṭiḥ syāt| tādṛgeva-kācanīlābhāsaṃ, paśyati| kāce kācanīla sadṛśī dṛṣṭiḥ śyāt| tādṛgeva kācanīlābhasaṃ paśyati| tathā'rkendu pariveṣādīn paśyati|

ab.seg: bhṛṅganīlā nirālokā dṛk snigdhā liṅganāśataḥ| dṛṣṭiḥ pittena hrasvākhyā sā hṛsva hrasvadarśinī||15||

div.ab: Sa. liṅganāśād dṛṣṭiśca bhramaranīlā nirālokā snigdhā ca syāt| pittena hrasvasaṃjñā dṛṣṭiḥ syāt| sā ca hrasvā-hrasvasaṃsthānā, tathā hrasvadarśinī-alpadarśinī|
bhavetpittavidagdhākhyā pītā pītābhadarśanā| -----------------------------------------------|16|
Sa. pittabidagdhasaṃjñā dṛṣṭiḥ pītavarṇā syāt| tathā pītābhaṃ darśanaṃ yasyāḥ sā pītābadarśanā ca|

-----------------------------------------------| kaphena timire prāyaḥ snigdhaṃ śvetaṃ ca paśyati||16|| śaṅkhedukundakusumaiḥ kumudairiva cācitam| kāce tu niṣprabhendvarkapradīpādyairivācitam||17|| sitābhā sā ca dṛṣṭiḥ syālliṅganāśe tu lakṣyate| mūrtaḥ kapho dṛṣṭigataḥ snigdho darśananāśanaḥ||18|| bindurjalasyeva calaḥ padminīpuṭasaṃsthitaḥ| uṣṇe saṅkocamāyāti chāyāyāṃ parisarpati||19|| śaṅkhakundendukumudasphaṭikopamaśuklimā| -----------------------------------------------|20|

Sa. kaphena timire sati prāyaḥ snigdhaṃ śuklaṃ cālokate| tathā śaṅkhādibhirivācitaṃ paśyati| kāce tu niṣprabhendvarkādibhirivācitaṃ paśyati| dṛk śuklābhā syāt liṅganāśe tu dṛśyate mūrtaḥ kapho dṛṣṭigataḥ snigdhastathā dṛṣṭivināśanaśca| jalasyeva binduścalaḥ padminīpuṭasaṃsthitaḥ| ātape cāsou binduḥ saṅkucati| chāyāyāṃ prasarati| tathā śaṅkhādiśuklimā syāt|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------| raktena timire raktaṃ tamobhūtaṃ ca paśyati||20||
kācena raktā kṛṣṇā vā dṛṣṭistadṛk ca paśyati| liṅganāśe'pi tādṛg dṛṅ niṣprabhā hatadarśanā||21||

div.ab: Sa. raktena timire sati raktābhaṃ tathā tama iva ca paśyati| kācena raktā kṛṣṇā vā dṛṣṭiḥ syāt| tādṛgeva-rakta kṛṣṇaṃ vā, paśyati| liṅganāśe ca tādṛśyeva-kācavat, dṛṣṭistathā niṣprabhā hatadarśanā ca syāt|
saṃsargasannipāteṣu vidyātsaṅkīrṇalakṣaṇān| timirādīnakasmācca taiḥ syādvyaktākulekṣaṇaḥ||22|| timire, śeṣayordṛṣṭau citro rāgaḥ prajāyate| -----------------------------------------------|23|

Sa. saṃsargasannipāteṣu saṅkīrṇalakṣaṇān-vyāmiśralakṣaṇān, timirakācaliṅganāśān vidyāt| tathā'kasmāt-nimittamantareṇa, taiḥ-saṃsargasannipātaiḥ, vyaktaṃ-spaṣṭaṃ, kadācidākulamīkṣaṇaṃdarśanaṃ, yasya sa evaṃbhūto narastimire syāt| śeṣayoḥ-kācaliṅganāśayoḥ dṛṣṭau citro rāgaḥ syāt|
-----------------------------------------------| dyotyate nakulasyeva yasya dṛṅ nicitā malaiḥ||23|| nakulāndhaḥ sa tatrāhni citraṃ paśyati no niśi| -----------------------------------------------|24|
Sa. yasyāturasya nakulasyeva dṛṣṭirdoṣairnicitā dyotyate-dedīpyate, sa nakulāndhaḥ| tatra-nakulāndhe, divā citraṃ paśyati, na tu niśi-rajānyām|

-----------------------------------------------| arke'stamastakanyastagabhastau stambhamāgatāḥ||24|| sthagayanti dṛśaṃ doṣā doṣāndhaḥ sa gado'paraḥ| divākarakaraspṛṣṭā bhraṣṭā dṛṣṭipathānmalāḥ||25|| vilīnalīnā yacchanti vyaktamatrāhni darśanam| -----------------------------------------------|26|

Sa. arke'staparvatasya mastake nyastā gabhastayo yena tasmin sati stambhaṃ prāptā doṣā dṛśaṃ chādayanti| sa evaṃbhūto doṣāndho nāma rogaḥ| divā kathaṃ paśyati ? ityatra yuktimāha- saṃ-malā ahni divākararaśmibhiḥ spṛṣṭāstathā dṛṣṭipathādbhraṣṭā vilīnāḥ santaḥ, atra-rātryandhe, spaṣṭaṃ darśanaṃ dadati| divākarakaraspṛṣṭā iti hetau prathamā|

-----------------------------------------------| uṣṇataptasya sahasā śītavārinimajjanāt||26|| tridoṣaraktasaṃpṛkto yātyūṣmordhvaṃ tato'kṣiṇi| dāhoṣe malinaṃ śuklamahanyāviladarśanam||27|| rātrāvāndhyaṃ ca jāyeta vidagdhoṣṇena sā smṛtā| -----------------------------------------------|28|

Sa. uṣṇena taptasya sahasā-jhaṭityeva, śiśirajalanimajjanāt tridoṣaraktasaṃpṛkta ūṣmordhvamakṣṇi yāti| tataḥ-ūṣmaṇa ūrdhvagamanāt, akṣṇi dāhoṣe bhavataḥ| śuklabhāgaśca malino bhavati| ahani-dine, āvilaṃ darśanaṃ jāyate, rātrau cāndhyam| sā dṛṣṭiruṣṇavidagdhākhyā|
-----------------------------------------------| bhṛśamamlāśanāddoṣaiḥ sāsrairyā dṛṣṭirācitā||28|| sakledakaṇḍūkaluṣā vidagdhā'mlena sā smṛtā| -----------------------------------------------|29|
Sa. atyantamamlāśanāt-amlabhakṣaṇāt, doṣaiḥ saraktairyā dṛṣṭirācitā kledakaṇḍūkaluṣānvitā syāt| sā vidagdhāmleti dṛṣṭiḥ smṛtā|
-----------------------------------------------| śokajvaraśirorogasantaptasyānilādayaḥ||29|| dhūmāvilāṃ dhūmadṛśaṃ dṛśaṃ kuryuḥ sa dhūmaraḥ| -----------------------------------------------|30|
Sa. śokādisantaptasya narasya vātādayo dhūmenevāvilāṃ dhūmadarśanāṃ dṛṣṭiṃ kuryuḥ| sa dhūmaro nāma rogaḥ|

-----------------------------------------------| sahasaivālpasattvasya paśyato rūpamadbhutam||30|| bhāsvaraṃ bhāśkarādiṃ vā vātādyā nayanāśritāḥ| kurvanti tejaḥ saṃśoṣya dṛṣṭiṃ muṣitadarśanām||31|| vaidūryavarṇāṃ stimitāṃ prakṛtisthāmivāvyathām| oupasargika ityeṣa liṅganāśo--------------------|32|

Sa. sahasaiva-atarkitasya, puṃso'lpasattvasya rūpamadbhutaṃ paśyato bhāsvaraṃ bhāskaraprakāraṃ paśyato vā vātādayo locanāśritā dṛṣṭiṃ muṣitadarśanāṃ vaiḍūryavarṇāṃ stimitāṃ prakṛtisthāmiva pīḍārahitāṃ kurvanti| kiṃ kṛtvā ? tejaḥ saṃśoṣya| ityeṣa aupasargiko liṅganāśaḥ|

-----------------------------------------------| -------------------------------'tra varjayet|32| vinā kaphālliṅganāśān gambhīrāṃ hRasvajāmapi| ṣaṭ kācā nakulāndhaśca yāpyāḥ, śeṣāṃstu sādhayet|33| dvādaśeti gadā dṛṣṭou nirdiṣṭāḥ saptaviṃśatiḥ| 33 1/2| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭavira- citāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttara- sthāne dṛṣṭirogavijñānīyo nāma dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ|12|

Sa. atra-eṣu madhye, kaphādvinā liṅganāśān-vātapittasaṃsargasannipātaraktajoupasargikān ṣaṭ, tathā gabhīrāṃ hrasvajāmapidṛṣṭimityaṣṭau varjayet| ṣaṭ kācāḥ-vātapittakaphasaṃsargasannipātaraktajāḥ, nakulāndhaśceti sapta yāpyāḥ| śeṣāṃśca dvādaśa sādhayet, tatra vātapittakapharaktasaṃsargasannipātaiḥ pṛthak timirāṇīti ṣaṭ, saptamaḥ kaphena ca liṅganāśaḥ, aṣṭamaḥ pittavidagdhā dṛṣṭiḥ, navamo doṣāndhaḥ, daśama uṣṇavidagdhā, ekādaśo vidagdhāmlā, dvādaśo dhūmaraḥ, iti| evaṃ dṛṣṭimaṇḍale rogāḥ saptaviṃśatisaṅkhyāḥ kathitāḥ| iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdaya- ṭīkāyāṃ sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne dṛṣṭiroga- vijñānīyo nāma dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 12||

div.head: timirapratiśedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: asmādanantaraṃ timiripratiṣedha ucyate ----- athātastimirapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre||2||

div.ab: Sa. nanu, dṛṣṭirogavijñānādanantaraṃ dṛṣṭirogapratiṣedho jñāpyaḥ| upapannamāha bhavān| kiṃ tu dṛṣṭitogacikitsitasya bahuvaktavyatvāt pṛthagadhyāyo vaktuṃ yuktaḥ| tatrāpi kramaprāptastimirapratiṣedha iti timirapratiṣedhārambha eva yuktaḥ| kācādīnāṃ tvalpavaktavyatvādatraivābhidhānam| tato bahuvaktavyatvāt pṛthagadhyāyo liṅganāśasya| iti sarvaṃ yuktam|

ab.seg: timiraṃ kācatāṃ yāti kāco'pyāndhyamupekṣayā| netrarogeṣvato ghoraṃ timiraṃ sādhayed drutam||1||

div.ab: Sa. timiramupekṣayā kācatvaṃ yāti| kāco'pyupekṣita āndhyaṃ gacchati| ataḥ kāraṇānnetrarogeṣu madhye timiraṃ dāruṇaṃ śīghraṃ sādhayet|

tulāṃ pacet jīvantyā droṇe'pāṃ pādaśeṣite| tatkvāthe dviguṇakṣīraṃ ghṛtaprasthaṃ vipācayet||2|| prapauṇḍarīkakākolīpippalīrodhrasaindhavaiḥ| śatahvāmadhukadrākṣāsirādāruphalatrayaiḥ||3|| karṣikairniśi tatpītaṃ timirāpaharaṃ param| ----------------------------------------------|4|
Sa. jīvantyāḥ palaśatamapāṃ droṇe pādāvaśeṣitaṃ pacet| tatkvāthe ghṛtaprasthaṃ dviguṇakṣīraṃ prapauṇḍarīkādibhiḥ karṣaparimāṇaiḥ kalkitairvipācayet| niśi pītaṃ tatparaṃ timirāpaham|

----------------------------------------------| drākṣācandanamañjiṣṭhākākolīdvayajīvakaiḥ||4|| sitāśatāvarīmedāpuṇḍrāhvamadhukotpalaiḥ| pacejjīrṇaghṛtaprasthaṃ samakṣīraṃ picūnmitaiḥ||5|| hanti tatkācatimiraraktarājīśirorujaḥ| ----------------------------------------------|6|
Sa. tathā drākṣādibhiḥ picūnmitaiḥ-karṣāṃśaiḥ, jīrṇasya-purāṇaghṛtasya prasthaṃ samakṣīraṃ pacet| tacca kācādīn hanti|

----------------------------------------------| paṭolanimbakaṭukādārvīsevyavarāvṛṣam||6|| sadhanvayāsatrāyantīparpaṭaṃ pālikaṃ pṛthak| prasthamāmalakānaṃ ca kvāthayennalvaṇe'mbhasi||7|| tadāḍhake'rdhapalikaiḥ piṣṭaiḥ prasthaṃ ghṛtātpacet| mustabhūnimbayaṣṭyāhvakuṭajodīcyacandanaiḥ||8|| sapippalīkaistatsarpighrāṇakarṇāsyarogajit| vidradhijvaraduṣṭārurvisarpāpacikuṣṭhanut||9|| viśeṣācchukratimiranaktāndhyoṣṇāmladāhahṛt| ----------------------------------------------|10|

Sa. paṭolādikaṃ parpaṭāntaṃ pṛthak palonmitamāmalakānāṃ prasthaṃ nalvaṇe-droṇe'mbhasi, kvāthayet| tadāḍhake mustādibhiḥ sapippalīkaiḥ piṣṭaiḥ-kalkitaiḥ, ardhapalikairghṛtaprasthaṃ vipācayet| tacca ghṛtaṃ ghrāṇādirogajit, vidradhyādirogajit, viśeṣeṇa śukrādighnam| etatpaṭolādyaṃ ghṛtam|

----------------------------------------------| triphalāṣṭapalaṃ kvāthyaṃ pādaśeṣaṃ jalāḍhake||10|| tena tulyapayaskena triphalāpalakalkavān| ardhaprastho ghrutātsiddhaḥ sitayā mākṣikeṇa vā||11|| yuktaṃ pibettattimirī tadyuktaṃ vā varārasam| ----------------------------------------------|12|

Sa. triphalāyāḥ palāṣṭakaṃ jalāḍhake pādaśeṣaṃ kvāthyam| tena kvāthena tulyakṣīreṇa triphalāpalakalkayukto ghṛtārdhaprasthaḥ pakvaḥ śarkarayā mākṣikeṇa vā yutaṃ tattimirī pibet| ghṛtena vā tena yuktaṃ triphalākvāthaṃ doṣadūṣyādivaśāt pibet| etacca triphalāghrutamucyate|

----------------------------------------------| yaṣṭīmadhudvikākolīvyāghrīkṛṣṇāmṛtotpalaiḥ||12|| pālikaiḥ sasirādrākṣairghṛtaprasthaṃ pacetsamaiḥ| ajākṣīravarāvāsāmārkavasvarasaiḥ pṛthak||13|| mahātraiphalamityetatparaṃ dṛṣṭivikārajit| ----------------------------------------------|14|
Sa. yaṣṭyādibhiḥ pālikaiḥ sahasitādrākṣairajākṣīrādibhiḥ pṛthaksvarasaiḥ samaiḥ prasthapramāṇaiḥ sarpiḥprasthaṃ vipācayet| etanmahātraiphalaṃ suṣṭru dṛṣṭivikārajit|

----------------------------------------------| traiphalenātha haviṣā lihānastriphalāṃ niśi||14|| yaṣṭīmadhukasaṃyuktāṃ madhunā ca pariplutām| māsamekaṃ hitāhāraḥ pibannāmalakodakam||15|| sauparṇaṃ labhate cakṣurityāha bhagavānnimiḥ| ----------------------------------------------|16|
Sa. traiphalena ca sarpiṣā triphalāṃ yaṣṭīyuktāṃ mākṣikeṇa ca pariplutāṃ rātrau lihāno māsamekaṃ hitāśī sannāmalakodakaṃ piban gārutmataṃ cakṣurlabhata iti bhagavānnimirāha|
----------------------------------------------| tāpyāyohemayaṣṭyāhvasitājīrṇājyamākṣikaiḥ||16|| saṃyojitā yathākāmaṃ timiraghnī varā varā| ----------------------------------------------|17|
Sa. tāpyādibhiḥ saṃyojitā triphalā yathākāmaṃ varā timiraghnī syāt|
----------------------------------------------| saghṛtaṃ vā varākvāthaṃ śīlayettimirāmayī||17|| apūpasūpasaktūn vā triphalācūrṇasaṃyutān| ----------------------------------------------|18|
Sa. athavā triphalākvāthaṃ sasarpiṣkaṃ timirarogaharamabhyaset| apūpādīn vā triphalācūrṇasaṃyutān śīlayet|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------| pāyasaṃ vā varāyuktaṃ śītaṃ samadhuśarkaram||18||
prātarbhaktasya vā pūrvamadyātpathyāṃ pṛthak pṛthak| mṛdvīkāśarkarākṣaudraiḥ satataṃ timirāturaḥ||19||

div.ab: Sa. pāyasaṃ triphalāyutaṃ va śītaṃ samadhuśarkaraṃ prātaradyāt| bhaktasya pūrvaṃ vā| harītakīṃ vā mṛdvīkāśarkarākṣaudraiḥ pṛthak pṛthak yutāmanārataṃ timirāturo'dyāt|

ab.seg: srotojāṃśāṃścatuḥṣaṣṭiṃ tāmrāyorūpyakāñcanaiḥ| yuktān pratyekamekāṃśairandhamūṣodarasthitān||20||
dhmāpayitvā samāvṛttaṃ tatastacca niṣecayet| rasaskandhakaṣāyeṣu saptakṛtvaḥ pṛthak pṛthak||21||
vaiḍūryamuktāśaṅkhānāṃ tribhirbhāgairyutaṃ tataḥ| cūrṇāñjanaṃ prayuñjīta tatsarvatimirāpaham||22||

div.ab: Sa. srotojāt catuḥṣaṣṭimaṃśāṃstāmrādibhiḥ pratyekamekāṃ-śairyutānandhamūṣodarasthitān dhmāpayitvā samyagāvṛttaṃ-āvartitaṃ śilāyāṃ, tataḥ-anantaraṃ, madhurādigaṇakvātheṣu tanniṣecayet pṛthak pṛthak saptavārān| tato vaiḍūryamuktāśaṅkānāṃ tribhirbhāgairyutametaccūrṇāñjanaṃ sarvatimiraghnaṃ prayuñjīta|

ab.seg: māṃsītrijātakāyaḥkuṅkumanīlotpalābhayātutthaiḥ| sitakācaśaṅkhaphenakamaricāñjanapippalīmadhukaiḥ||23||
candre'śvanīsanāthe sucūrṇitairañjayedyugulamakṣṇoḥ| timirārmaraktarājīkaṇḍūkācādiśamamicchan||24||

div.ab: Sa. saṃ-māṃsyādibhiḥ sūkṣmarajīkṛtaiścandre'śvinīyukte satyakṣiyugmamañjayet timirādiśāntimicchan| ārye mukhacapale|

ab.seg: maricavaralavaṇabhāgau bhāgau dvau kaṇasamudraphenābhyām| sauvīrabhāganavakaṃ citrāyāṃ cūrṇitaṃ kaphamayajit||25||
| manohvātutthakastūrīmāṃsīmalayarocanāḥ| daśakarpūrasaṃyuktamaśītiguṇamañjanam||1||
piṣṭaṃ citrāśvinīpuṣye ṣaḍvidhe timire hitam| prasādanaṃ ca dṛṣṭeḥ syāccakṣuṣeṇāvabhāṣitam]||2||

div.ab: Sa. maricasaindhavayordvau bhāgau, pippalīsamudraphenayordvau bhāgau, sauvīrāñjanasya bhāgā nava, etaccitrāyāṃ cūrṇitaṃ kaphāmayajit| gītirāryā|

ab.seg: drākṣāmṛṇālīsvarase kṣīramadyavasāsu ca| pṛthak divyāpsu srotojaṃ saptakṛtvo niṣecayet||26||
taccūrṇitaṃ sthitaṃ śaṅkhe dṛkprasādanamañjanam| śastaṃ sarvākṣirogeṣu videhapatinirmitam||27||

div.ab: Sa. drākṣādisvaraseṣu pṛthak pṛthak divyajale ca srotoñjanaṃ saptakṛtvo niṣecayet| taccūrṇikṛtaṃ śaṅke sthitaṃ dṛṣṭiprasādakṛdañjanaṃ sarvākṣirogeṣu śreṣṭhaṃ videhapatinirmitam|

nirdagdhaṃ bādarāṅgāraistutthaṃ cetthaṃ niṣecitam| kramādajāpayaḥ sarpiḥkṣaudre tasmāt paladvayam||28|| kārṣikaistāpyamaricasrotojakaṭukānataiḥ| paṭurodhnaśilāpathyākaṇailāñjanaphenakaiḥ||29|| yuktaṃ palena yaṣṭyāśca mūṣāntardhmātacūrṇitam| hanti kācārmanaktāndhyaraktarājīḥ suśīlataḥ||30|| cūrṇo viśeṣāttimiraṃ bhāskaro bhāskaro yathā| ----------------------------------------------|31|

Sa. bādaraṅgāraistutthaṃ nirdagdhaṃ pūrvavat krameṇa chāgakṣīraghṛtamākṣike niṣecitaṃ, tasmāt-nirdagdhācca tutthāt paladvayaṃ, tāpyādibhiḥ kārṣikairyaṣṭīpalena ca yuktaṃ, mūṣāntardhmāpitaṃ cūrṇitaṃ, kācādīn hanti| susevito'yaṃ bhāskaraścūrṇo viśeṣeṇa timiraṃhanti| yathā ravirandhakāramityupamāśleṣo'laṅkāraḥ|

----------------------------------------------| triṃśadbhāgā bhujaṅgasya gandhapāṣāṇapañcakam||31|| śulbatālakayordvau dvau vaṅgasyaiko'ñjanāttrayam| andhamūṣīkṛtaṃ dhmātaṃ pakvaṃ vimalamañjanam||32|| timirāntakaraṃ loke dvitīya iva bhāskaraḥ| ----------------------------------------------|33|

Sa. bujaṅgasya-sīsakasya triṃśadbhāgāḥ, gandhapāṣāṇasya bhāga pañcakaṃ, śulbatālakayordvau dbau bhāgau, vaṅgasya-trapuṇa eko bhāgaḥ, añjanādbhāgatrayamandhamūṣādhmātaṃ vipakvamañjanaṃ dvitīyo bhāskara ivaloke timirāntakaram| bhujaṅgādīnāṃ śodhitanāmatra prayogaḥ, na tu māritānām|

ab.seg: gomūtre chagaṇarase'mlakāñjike ca strīstanye haviṣi viṣe ca mākṣike ca| yattutthaṃ jvalitamanekaśo niṣiktaṃ tatkuryādgaruḍasamaṃ narasya cakṣuḥ||33||

div.ab: Sa. tattutthaṃ narasya garuḍanayanatulyaṃ nayanaṃ kuryāt| katamam ? yaddīptaṃ sat gomūtrādiṣvanekaśaḥ-saptakṛtvo, niṣiktam| praharṣiṇīvṛttam|

ab.seg: śreṣṭhājalaṃ bhṛṅgarasaṃ saviṣājyamajāpayaḥ| yaṣṭīrasaṃ ca yatsīsaṃ saptakṛtvaḥ pṛthak pṛthak||34||
taptaṃ taptaṃ pāyitaṃ tacchalākā netre yuktā sāñjanā'nañjanā vā| taimiryārmasrāpapaicchilyapaillaṃ kaṇḍūṃ jāḍyaṃ raktarājīṃ ca hanti||35||

div.ab: Sa. yatsīsaṃ taptaṃ taptaṃ triphalākvāthādikaṃ pṛthak pṛthak spatakṛtvaḥ pāyitaṃ tasya sīsasya śalākā nayane yuktā sahāñjanā'ñjanena rahitā vā taimiryādīn hanti| śālinīvṛttam| dravyaśalākeyamiti prathitā|

ab.seg: rasendrabhujagau tulyau tayostulyamathāñjanam| īṣātkarpūrasaṃyuktamañjanaṃ timirāpaham||36||

div.ab: Sa. pāradasīsakau samāṃśau, tayoḥ samamañjanaṃ, ṣoḍaśāṃśakarpūrayutamidamañjanaṃ timirāpahaṃ bhavati|

ab.seg: yo gṛdhrastaruṇaraviprakāśagalla- stasyāsyaṃ samayamṛtasya gośakṛdbhiḥ| nirdagdhaṃ samadhṛtamañjanaṃ ca peṣyaṃ yogo'yaṃ nayanabalaṃ karoti gārdhram||37||

div.ab: Sa. yo gṛdhrastaruṇaraviprakāśagallastasya samayamṛtasyāsyaṃ mukhaṃ, gośakṛdbhiḥ-gomayakarīṣaiḥ, nirdagdhaṃ-bhasmāsātkṛtaṃ, tasya samamañjanaṃ-srotojaṃ, samadhṛtaṃ-samabhāgaṃ, peṣyaṃ-cūrṇayitavyam| ayaṃ yogo nayanayoḥ-netrayoḥ, balaṃ gārdhraṃ-gṛdhratulyaṃ, karoti|

ab.seg: kṛṣṇasarpavadane sahaviṣkaṃ dagdhamañjananiḥsṛtadhūmam| cūrṇitaṃ naladapatravimiśraṃ bhinnatāramapi rakṣati cakṣuḥ||38||

div.ab: Sa. kṛṣṇasarpasya vadane sahaviṣkamañjanamaniḥsṛtadhūmaṃ dagdhaṃ māṃsīpatrakamiśritaṃ cūrṇītamupayuktaṃ sat cakṣurbhinnatāramapi rakṣati| bhinnatāramapītyanena śaktyatiśayamasyāha| na tu bhinnatārasya kathañcidrakṣaṇaṃ syāt| anyatrāpyevaṃvidho nyāyo'yamanusaraṇīyaḥ| svāgatāvṛttam|

ab.seg: kṛṣṇasarpaṃ mṛtaṃ nyasya caturaścāpi vṛścikān| kṣīrakumbhe trisaptāhaṃ kledayitvā pramanthayet||39||
tatra yannavanītaṃ syātpuṣṇīyāttena kukkuṭam| andhastasya purīṣeṇa prekṣate dhruvamañjanāt||40||

div.ab: Sa. kṣīrakumbhe mṛtaṃ kṛṣṇasarpaṃ nyasya vṛścikāṃśca caturastrisaptāhaṃ kledayitvā viloḍayet| tasmin yannavanītaṃ bhavet, tena navanītena kukkuṭaṃ puṣṇīyāt| tasya kukkuṭasya purīṣeṇāndho'pyañjanānniścitamīkṣate|

ab.seg: kṛṣṇasarpavasā śaṅkhaḥ katakāt phalamañjanam| rasakriyeyamacirādandhānaṃ darśanapradā||41||

div.ab: Sa. kṛṣṇasarpasya vasā śaṅkhaḥ katakaphalaṃ sauvīrāñjanam| iyaṃ rasakriyā drāgevāndhānāṃ dṛṣṭipradā|

ab.seg: maricāni daśārdhapicu- stāpyāttutthātpalaṃ picuryaṣṭyāḥ| kṣīrārdradagdhamañjana- mapratisārākhyamuttamaṃ timire||42||

div.ab: Sa. daśa maricāni, vaṭṭamākṣikādardhakarṣaṃ, tutthātpalaṃ, madhuyaṣṭikāyāḥ karṣaḥ, etatsarvaṃ kṣīrārdraṃ paścāddagdhamapratisārasaṃjñamañjanamatiśreṣṭhaṃ timire| gītirāryā|

ab.seg: akṣabījamaricāmalakatvak- tutthayaṣṭimadhukairjalapiṣṭaiḥ| chāyayaiva guṭikāḥ pariśuṣkā nāśanyanti timirāṇyacireṇa||43||

div.ab: Sa. akṣabījādibhirjalapiṣṭairguṭikāḥ chāyayaiva pariśuṣkāḥ-na tvātapena, timirāṇi laghu nāśayanti| svāgatāvṛttam|

ab.seg: maricāmalakajalodbhava- tutthāñjanatāpyadhātubhiḥ kramavṛddhaiḥ| ṣaṇmākṣika iti yoga- stimirārmakledakācakaṇḍūhantā||44||

div.ab: Sa. maricādibhiḥ kramavṛddhaiḥ ṣaṇmākṣika iti yogastimirādighnaḥ| ṣaṇmākṣika iti ko'rthaḥ ? kīdṛśaḥ samāsaḥ ? brūmaḥ| mākṣikaśabdenādilopākhyayā tantrayuktyā vaṭṭamākṣika ityucyate| ṣaṭpūraṇo vaṭṭamākṣiko yasminniti samāsaḥ| tenāsmin yoge ṣaṣṭho vaṭṭamākṣika ityavatiṣṭhate| gītirāryā|

ab.seg: ratnāni rūpyaṃ sphaṭikaṃ suvarṇaṃ srotoñjanaṃ tāmramayaḥ saśaṅkham| kucandanaṃ lohitagairikaṃ ca cūrṇāñjanaṃ sarvadṛgāmayaghnam||45||

div.ab: Sa. ratnādibhiścūrṇāñjanam| ratnānyatra vajramarakatādīni yathālābhaṃ grāhyāṇi| lohitagairikaṃ-lohitaṃ gairikam, kecittu lohitaṃ-kuṅkumamāhuḥ| etaccūrṇāñjanamaśeṣadṛṣṭirogaharam| upajātivṛttam|

ab.seg: tilatailamakṣatailaṃ bhṛṅgasvaraso'sanācca niryūhaḥ| āyasapātravipakvaṃ karoti dṛṣṭerbalaṃ nasyam||46||

div.ab: Sa. tilatailamakṣatailaṃ ca samāṃśaṃ mārkavasvaraso'sanācca kvāthaścetyayasaḥ pātre vipakvaṃ dṛṣṭerbalametannasyaṃ karoti| āryā|

ab.seg: doṣānurodhena ca naikaśastaṃ snehāsravisravaṇarekanasyaiḥ| upācaredañjanamūrdhabasti- bastikriyātarpaṇalepasekaiḥ||47||

div.ab: Sa. doṣavaśācca snehādibhirmuhurmuhurenaṃ-netrarogiṇamupakramet| mūrdhabastiḥ-gaṇḍūṣādividhyuktaḥ (hṛ.sū.a. 22)| bastiḥbastividhyuktaḥ (hṛ.sū.a. 19)| upajātivṛttam|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------| sāmānyaṃ sādhanamidam pratidoṣamataḥ śṛṇu||48||

div.ab: Sa. idaṃ-anantarābhihitaṃ, sāmānyaṃ cikitsitam saṃ-ataḥ-anantaraṃ, pratidoṣaṃ sādhanaṃ śṛṇu|

ab.seg: kiṃ tat ? ityāha ---- vātaje timire tatra daśamūlāmbhasā ghṛtam| kṣīre caturguṇe śreṣṭhākalkapakvaṃ pibettataḥ||49||
triphalāpañcamūlānāṃ kaṣāyaṃ kṣīrasaṃyutam| eraṇḍatailasaṃyuktaṃ yojayecca virecanam||50||

div.ab: Sa. [tatra-] teṣu timirādiṣu madhye, vātotthe timire daśamūlakvāthena ghṛtaṃ kṣīre caturguṇe triphalākalkapakvaṃ pibet| anantaraṃ triphalāpañcamūlānāṃ kvāthaṃ kṣīreṇa saṃyutameraṇḍatailānvitaṃ virecanaṃ yojayet|

samūlajālajīvantītulāṃ droṇe'mbhasaḥ pacet| aṣṭabhāgasthaite tasmiṃstailaprasthaṃ payaḥsame||51|| balātritayajīvantīvarīmūlaiḥ palonmitaiḥ| yaṣṭīpalaiścaturbhiśca lohapātre vipācayet||52|| loha eva sthitaṃ māsaṃ nāvanādūrdhvajatrujān| vātapittāyamayān hanti tadviśeṣāddṛgāśrayān||53|| keśāsyakandharāskandhapuṣṭilāvaṇyakāntidam| ----------------------------------------------|54|

Sa. mūlajālayutāyā jīvantyāḥ palaśataṃ jaladroṇe pacet| tasmin jale'ṣṭabhāgaśeṣe kṣīratulye tailaprasthaṃ balātritayādibhiḥ palonmitairmadhuyaṣṭikāpalaiścaturbhirlohapātre vipācayet| lohabhāṇḍa evaṃ māsaṃ sthitaṃ tannasyenordhvajatrujān rogān hanti| viśeṣeṇa dṛṣṭyāśrayān vātapittarogān parākaroti| keśādiṣu puṣṭilāvaṇyakāntikaram|

ab.seg: ghoṣayā bilvamūlaiśca tailaṃ pakvaṃ payonvitam| nasyaṃ sarvordhvajatrūtthavātaśleṣmāmayārtijit||55||

div.ab: Sa. śuklairaṇḍamūlādibhistailaṃ sakṣīraṃ pakvaṃ nasyena sarvajatrūrdhvarogādijit|

ab.seg: vasā'ñjane ca vaiyāghrī vārāhī vā praśasyate| gṛdhrāhikukkuṭotthā vā madhukenānvitā pṛthak||56||

div.ab: Sa. vaiyāghrī vārāhī vā vasā'ñjane śasyate| gṛdhrasarpakukkuṭotthā vā vasā pṛthaṅ madhuyaṣṭikāyutā śreṣṭhā|

ab.seg: pratyañjane ca srotojaṃ rasakṣīraghṛte kramāt| niṣiktaṃ pūrvavadyojyaṃ timiraghnamanuttamam||57||

div.ab: Sa. pratyañjane ca srotoñjanaṃ māṃsarasādiṣu krameṇa taptaṃ taptaṃ saptakṛtvaḥ niṣiktaṃ pūrvavadyojyam| etacca paraṃ timirahṛt|
Sa. yadyevaṃ timiraṃ na śāmyet tatastarpaṇamācaret-kuryāt|

ab.seg: prapauṇḍarīkasaralapippalīdevadārubhiḥ| sarpiraṣṭaguṇakṣīraṃ pakvaṃ tarpaṇamuttamam||59||

div.ab: Sa. śatapuṣpādibhirghṛtamaṣṭaguṇakṣīraṃ pakvaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ tarpaṇam|

ab.seg: medasastadvadaiṇeyāddugdhasiddhāt khajāhatāt| uddhṛtaṃ sādhitaṃ tejo madhukośīracandanaiḥ||60||

div.ab: Sa. tathaiva kṛṣṇahariṇānmedaso dugdhe siddhāt khajenāloḍitāt teja uddhṛtya madhikośīracandanaiḥ saha pakvaṃ tarpaṇamuttamam|

ab.seg: śvāvicchalyakagodhānāṃ dakṣatittiribarhiṇām| pṛthakpṛthaganenaiva vidhinā kalpayedvasām||61||

div.ab: Sa. śvāvidādīnāṃ pṛthaganenaiva vidhinā vasāṃ kalpayet|
prasādanaṃ snehanaṃ ca puṭapākaṃ prayojayet| ----------------------------------------------------|62|
Sa. puṭapākaṃ tu prasādanaṃ snehanaṃ ca-tarpaṇapuṭāpākavidhyuktaṃ (hṛ.sū.a. 24/14-16), prayojayet|
Sa. atra ca-vātaje timire, vātapīnasa iva nirūhamanuvāsanaṃ ca prayojayet

ab.seg: pittaje timire sarpirjīvanīyaphalatrayaiḥ| vipācitaṃ pāyayitvā snigdhasya vyadhayetsirām||63||

div.ab: Sa. pittaje timire jīvanīyaiḥ phalatrikena ca pakvaṃ sarpiḥ pāyayitvā tataḥ snigdhasya sataḥ sirāṃ vyadhayet|
śarkarailātrivṛccūrṇairmadhuyuktairvirecayet| ----------------------------------------------------|64|
Sa. śarkarādibhiḥ samākṣikairviracayet|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------------| suśītān sekalepādīn yuñjyānnetrāsyamūrdhasu||64||

div.ab: Sa. netrāsyaśiraḥsu cātiśiśiran sekalepādīn yuñjyāt|

ab.seg: sārivāpadmakośīramuktāśābaracandanaiḥ| vartiḥ śastā'ñjane, cūrṇastathā patrotpalāñjanaiḥ||65||
sanāgapuṣpakarpūrayaṣṭyāhvasvarṇagairikaiḥ| ----------------------------------------------------||66||

div.ab: Sa. sārivādibhirvartirañjane śastā| tathā patrādibhiścūrṇo'ñjanaṃ śastam|

----------------------------------------------------| sauvīrāñjanatutthakaśṛṅgīdhātrīphalasphaṭikakarpūtam| pañcāṃśaṃ pañcāṃśaṃ tryaṃśamathaikāṃśamañjanaṃ timiraghnam| ----------------------------------------------------|67|

Sa. sauvīrāñjanādikamañjanaṃ śastam| kiyatkiyatpramāṇam ? ityāha-pañcāṃśamityādi| tadevaṃ pañca bhāgāḥ sauvīrāñjanasya, pañcaiva tutthakasya, śṛṅgyāmalakānāṃ bhāgāstrayaḥ, sphaṭikakarpūrasya bhāga ekaḥ, iti sthitam| evametadañjanaṃ timirahṛt kuryāt| gītirāryeyam|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------------| nasyaṃ cājyaṃ śṛtaṃ kṣīrajīvanīyasitotpalaiḥ||67||

div.ab: Sa. kṣīreṇa caturguṇena jīvanīyādibhirājyaṃ-ghṛtaṃ, pakvaṃ nasye śreṣṭham|
śleṣmodbhave'mṛtākvāthavarākaṇaśṛtaṃ ghṛtam| vidhyetsirāṃ pītavato dadyāccānu virecanam||68|| kvāthaṃ pūgābhayāśuṇṭhīkṛṣṇākumbhanikumbhajam| ----------------------------------------------------|69|
Sa. śleṣmotthatimire'mṛtādibhiḥ pakvaṃ ghṛtaṃ pītavataḥ sirāṃ vidhyet| virecanaṃ ca pūgādibhiḥ kvāthaṃ dadyāt|

----------------------------------------------------| hnīberadārudviniśākṛṣṇākalkaiḥ payonvitaiḥ||69|| dvipañcamūlaniryūhe tailaṃ pakvaṃ ca nāvanam| ----------------------------------------------------|70|
Sa. hnīberādibhiḥ kalkitaiḥ payonvitardvirpañcamūlakvāthe tailaṃ pakvaṃ nāvanaṃ hitam|
Sa. śaṅkhādibhirdṛgvaimalyāya vimalākhyeyaṃ vartirhitā syāt|

ab.seg: -------------------------------------kokilā punaḥ| kṛṣṇaloharajovyoṣasaindhavatriphalāñjanaiḥ||71||

div.ab: Sa. kṛṣṇalohādibhiḥ kokilākhyā vartiḥ|
śaśagokharasiṃhoṣṭradvijā lālāṭamasthi ca| śvetagovālamaricaśaṅkhacandanaphenakam||72|| piṣṭaṃ stanyājadugdhābhyāṃ vartistimiśukrajit| ----------------------------------------------------|73|
Sa. śaśādijā dvijāḥ-dantāḥ, eṣāmeva lālāṭaṃ-lalāṭe bhavamasthi, tathā śvetagovālādīni, strīkṣīracchāgadugdhābhyāṃ piṣṭā vartistimiraśukraharetyarthaḥ|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------------| raktaje pittavatsiddhiḥ śītaiścāsraṃ prasādayet||73||

div.ab: Sa. raktaje timire pittavadupakramaḥ| [śītaiḥ-] śītavīryaiḥ śītasparśairannapānauṣadhasekalepādibhiśca, raktaṃ prasādayet|

ab.seg: drākṣayā naladarodhrayaṣṭibhiḥ śaṅkhatāmrahimapadmapadmakaiḥ| sotpalaiśchagaladugdhavartitai- rasrajaṃ timiramāśu naśyati||74||

div.ab: Sa. drākṣādibhiśchāgalīdugdhapiṣṭaiḥ śīghraṃ raktotthaṃ timiraṃ naśyati|
saṃsargasannipātotthe yathādoṣodayaṃ kriyā| ----------------------------------------------------|75|
Sa. saṃsargaje sannipātaje ca timire yathādoṣodrekaṃ cikitsitam|

----------------------------------------------------| siddhaṃ madhūkakṛmijinmaricāmaradārubhiḥ||75|| sakṣīraṃ nāvanaṃ tailaṃ piṣṭairlepo mukhasya ca| ----------------------------------------------------|76|
Sa. madhūkādibhiḥ sakṣīraṃ tailaṃ siddhaṃ nāvanaṃ hitam| madhūkādibhireva jalena piṣṭairmukhalepo hitaḥ|

----------------------------------------------------| natanīlotpalānantāyaṣṭyāhvasuniṣaṇṇakaiḥ||76|| sādhitaṃ nāvane tailaṃ śirobastau ca śasyate| ----------------------------------------------------|77|
Sa. natādibhiḥ sādhitaṃ tailaṃ nāvane śirobastau ca śasyate|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------------| dadyāduśīraniryūhe cūrṇitaṃ kaṇasaindhavam||77||
tatsrutaṃ saghṛtaṃ bhūyaḥ pacetkṣaudraṃ ghane kṣipet| śīte cāsmin hitamidaṃ sarvaje timire'ñjanam||78||

div.ab: Sa. uśīrakvāthe pippalīsaindhavaṃ rajīkṛtaṃ dadyāt| tacca srutaṃ sat ghṛtānvitaṃ punaḥ pacet| ghane cāsmin śīte ca kṣaudraṃ kṣipet| etat sarvotthe timire hitamañjanam|

asthīni majjapūrṇāni sattvānāṃ rātricāriṇām| srotojāñjanayuktāni vahatyambhasi vāsayet||79|| māsaṃ viṃśatirātraṃ vā tataścoddhṛtya śoṣayet| sameṣaśṛṅgīpuṣpāṇi sayaṣṭyāhvāni tānyanu||80|| cūrṇitānyañjanaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ timire sānnipātike| ----------------------------------------------------|81|

Sa. rātricāriṇāṃ prāṇināmasthīni majjapūrṇāni srotoñjanayuktāni jale vahati māsaṃ viṃśatirvā niśā vāsayet| tataḥ-paścāt, uddhṛtya śoṣayet| tani ca meṣaśṛṅgīpuṣpairyutāni madhūkena ca, cūrṇitāni sānnipātike timire'ñjanaṃ śreṣṭham|

----------------------------------------------------| kāce'pyeṣā kriyā muktvā sirāṃ, yantranipīḍitāḥ||81|| āndhyāya syurmalā dadyātsrāvye tvasre jalaukasaḥ| ----------------------------------------------------|82|
Sa. kāce'pyayeṣā-pūrvoditā kriyā, sirāṃ hitvā| sirā'pi kasmānnānumīyate ? ityāha-yantretyādi| siropayogiyantranipīḍitā malā āndhyāya yataḥ syuḥ| srāvye tu rakte jalaukaso dadyāt|
----------------------------------------------| guḍaḥ pheno'ñjanaṃ kṛṣṇā maricaṃ kuṅkumādrajaḥ||82|| rasakriyeyaṃ sakṣaudrā kācayāpanamañjanam| ----------------------------------------------|83|
Sa. guḍādayo rasakriyā kṣaudrānviteyaṃ kācayāpanamañjanam|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------| nakulandhe tridoṣotthe taimiryavihito vidhiḥ||83||

div.ab: Sa. nakulāndhe tridoṣaje timiravihito vidhiḥ kāryaḥ|

ab.seg: rasakriyā ghṛtakṣaudragomayasvarasadrutaiḥ| tārkṣyagairikatālīsairniśāndhe hitamañjanam||84||

div.ab: Sa. ghṛtādidrutai rasāñjanādibhirniśāndhe rasakriyā hitamañjanam|
daghnā vighṛṣṭaṃ maricaṃ rātryandhe'ñjanamuttamam| ----------------------------------------------|85|
Sa. dadhnā vighṛṣṭaṃ maricaṃ rātryandhe śreṣṭhamañjanam|
----------------------------------------------| karañjikotpalasvarṇagairikāmbhojakesaraiḥ||85|| piṣṭairgomayatoyena vartidoṣāndhanāśinī| ----------------------------------------------|86|
Sa. karañjikādibhirgomayarasena piṣṭairvartirnaktāndhyahṛt|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------| ajāmūtreṇa vā kauntīkṛṣṇāsrotojasaindhavaiḥ||86||
kālānusārītrikātutriphalālamanaḥśilāḥ| saphenāśchāgadugdhena rātryandhe vartayo hitāḥ||87||

div.ab: Sa. ajāmūtreṇa piṣṭaiḥ kauntyādibhirvā vartirniśāndhyaghnī| saṃ-kālānusāryādayo'jākṣīreṇa piṣṭā vartayo niśāndhe hitāḥ|

ab.seg: sanniveśya yakṛnmadhye pippalīradahanpacet| tāḥ śuṣkā madhunā ghṛṣṭā niśāndhe śreṣṭhamañjanam||88||

div.ab: Sa. pippalīryakṛnmadhye sanniveśyādahan pacet| tataḥ pippalyaḥ śuṣkā madhughṛṣṭā rātryandhe paramañjanam|
khādecca plīhayakṛtī māhiṣe tailasarpiṣā| ----------------------------------------------|89|
Sa. māhiṣe ca plīhayakṛtī tailasarpiṣā saha bhakṣayet|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------| ghṛte siddhāni jīvantyāḥ pallavāni ca bhakṣayet||89||
tathā'timuktakairaṇḍāśophālyabhīrujāni ca| bhṛṣṭaṃ ghṛtaṃ kumbhayoneḥ patraiḥ pāne ca pūjitam||90||

div.ab: Sa. jīvantyāśca pallavāni sarpiṣā pakvāni bhuñjīta| tathā atimuktakādīni patrāṇi ghṛtasiddhāni khādet| agastipatraiḥ sarpiḥ siddhaṃ pāne ca pūjitam|

ab.seg: dhūmarākhyāmlapittoṣṇavidāhe jīrṇasarpiṣā| snigdhaṃ verecayecchītaiḥ śītordihyācca sarvataḥ||91||

div.ab: Sa. amlapittoṣṇairvidāho-vidagdhatvaṃ, amlapittoṣṇavidāhaḥ| dhūmarākhyaścāmlapittoṣṇavidāhaśca tasmin| tatra dhūmarākhyaḥ-"śokajvarādi" (a. 12/29) ityādi lakṣaṇaḥ| "bhṛśamamlāśanāt" (a. 12/28) ityādinā'mlavidagdhā| "bhavetpittavidagdhākhyā" (a. 12/16) iti pittavidagdhā| "uṣṇataptasya" (a. 12/26) ityādinā uṣṇāvidagdheti| tasmin dhūmarākhyāmlapittoṣṇavidāhe'tipurāṇasarpiṣā'bhyaktaṃ snigdhaṃ śītairviśodhayet| śītaiśca sarvato lepayet|

ab.seg: gośakṛdrasadugdhājyairvipakvaṃ śasyate'ñjanam| svarṇagairikatālīsacūrṇāvāpā rasakriyā||92||

div.ab: Sa. gośakṛdādibhirvapakvamañjanaṃ śasyate| svarṇagairikādīnāṃ cūrṇairāvāpo yasyāṃ sā, evaṃvidhā rasakriyā va śasyate|

ab.seg: medāśābarakānantāmañjiṣṭhādārviyaṣṭibhiḥ| kṣīrāṣṭāṃśaṃ ghṛtaṃ pakvaṃ satailaṃ nāvanaṃ hitam||93||

div.ab: Sa. medādibhiḥ kṣīrāṣṭāṃśaṃ ghṛtaṃ tailasahitaṃ pakvaṃ nāvanaṃ hitam|
tarpaṇaṃ kṣīrasarpiḥ syādaśāmyati sirāvyadhaḥ| ----------------------------------------------|94|
Sa. kṣīrodbhavam sarpistarpaṇaṃ hitam| evamaśāmyati sirāvyadhaḥ kāryaḥ|

----------------------------------------------| cintābhighātabhīśokaraukṣyāt sotkaṭakāsanāt||94|| virekanasyavamanapuṭapākādivibhramāt| vidagdhāhāravamanāt kṣuttṛṣṇādividhāraṇāt||95|| akṣirogāvasānācca paśyettimirarogivat| ----------------------------------------------|96|
Sa. cintādibhiratimiravānapi timirarogīva paśyet|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------| yathāsvaṃ tatra yuñjīta doṣādīn vīkṣya bheṣajam||96||

div.ab: Sa. [ tatra- ] tasmiṃśca timirarogisadṛśadarśane, yathāyogaṃ doṣadūṣyadeśādīn vīkṣyauṣadhaṃ prayuñjīta|

ab.seg: sūryoparāgānalavidyudādi- vilokanenopahatekṣaṇasya| santarpaṇaṃ snigdhahimādi kāryaṃ tathāñjanaṃ hema ghṛtena ghṛṣṭam||97||

div.ab: Sa. sūryoparāgādivilokanenopahatadarśanasya snigdhahimādi santarpaṇaṃ kāryam| ādiśabdenātisūkṣmātibhāsurādiparigrahaḥ| survaṇaṃ ca ghṛtena ghṛṣṭamañjanaṃ hitam| upājātivṛttam|

ab.seg: cakṣūrakṣāyāṃ sarvakālaṃ manuṣyai- ryatnaḥ kartavyo jīvite yāvadicchā| vyartho loko'yaṃ tulyarātriṃdivānāṃ puṃsāmandhānāṃ vidyamāne'pi vitte||98||

div.ab: Sa. netrarakṣāyāṃ sadā yatno vidheyo yāvajjīvitābhilāṣitvam| yasmādandhānāṃ tulyarātriṃdivānāṃ puṃsāṃ vidyamāne'pi dhane loka eva nirarthakaḥ syāt| rātriṃdivaśabdo'trācaturādisūtre nipātitaḥ| vaiśvadevīvṛttam|

ab.seg: triphalā rudhirasrutirviśuddhi- rmanaso nirvṛtirañjanaṃ sanasyam| śakunāśanatā sapādapūjā ghṛtapānaṃ ca sadaiva netrarakṣā||99||

div.ab: Sa. triphalādikaṃ sadaiva-sarvakālaṃ, netrarakṣā syāt|

ahitādaśanātsadā nivṛtti- rbhṛśabhāsvaccalasūkṣmavīkṣaṇācca| muninā niminopadaṣṭametat paramaṃ rakṣaṇamīkṣaṇasya puṃsām|100| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviraci- tāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttara sthāne timirapratiṣedho nāma trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ|13|

Sa. ahitādāhārāt satataṃ nivṛttiḥ, atibhāsurādyālokanāccoparatiḥ, ityetannimināmrā muninā paramaṃ nṛṇāṃ nayanasya rakṣaṇamuditam| aupacchandasikaṃ(ke) vṛttam(tte)| iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdaya- ṭīkāyām sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne timira- pratiṣedho nāma trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 13||

div.head: liṅganāśapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ
