ab.seg: athāto liṅganāśapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātrayādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre|2| ) vidhyetsujātaṃ niḥprekṣyaṃ liṅganāśaṃ kaphodbhavam| āvartakyādibhiḥ ṣaḍbhirvivarjitamupadravaiḥ||1||

div.ab: Sa. liṅganāśastimirapratiṣedhātpṛthagucyate, bahuvaktavyatvāt| sujātaṃ-suṣṭhu ghanībhūtaṃ, liṅganāśaṃ niḥprekṣyaṃ kaphodbhavaṃ vidhyet| śeṣāstu liṅganāśā asādhyā iti na tān vidhyet| tathā''vartakyādibhirvakṣyamāṇaiḥ ṣaḍbhirupadravairvivarjitam|

ab.seg: sujātaṃ kasmādvidhyet ? ityāha ---- so'sañjāto hi viṣamo dadhimastunibhastanuḥ| śalākayā'vakṛṣṭo'pi punarūrdhvaṃ prapadyate||2||
karoti vedanāṃ tīvrāṃ dṛṣṭiṃ ca sthagayetpunaḥ| śleṣmalaiḥ pūryate cāśu so'nyaiḥ sopadravaścirāt||3||

div.ab: Sa. sa liṅganāśo yasmādasañjāto viṣamo-na samasaṃsthānaḥ, tathā dadhimastusadṛśastathā tanuḥ-na ghanaḥ, śalākayā'vakṛṣṭo'pi san punarūrdhvam pravartate| tīvrāṃ rujaṃ karoti| punarapi-kṛtavyadho'pi san bhūyo'pi, dṛṣṭimācchādayet| śleṣmalairāhārairāśu pūryate| so'paraiśca-aśleṣmalairāhāraiḥ, sopadravai(va)ścirātpūryate|
ślaiṣmiko liṅganāśo hi sitatvācchleṣmaṇaḥ sitaḥ| tasyānyadoṣābhibhavādbhavatyānīlatā gadaḥ|4|
Sa. yasmācchlaiṣmiko liṅganāśaḥ śleṣmaṇaśca śuklatvācchuklaḥ|tasya-liṅganāśasya, anyadoṣeṇa-vātādinā, abhibhavādānīlatā bhavati gadaḥ|

ab.seg: ślaiṣmiko liṅganāśo hi sitatvācchleṣmaṇaḥ sitaḥ| tasyānyadoṣābhibhavādbhavatyānīlatā gadaḥ||4||

div.ab: Sa. yasmācchlaiṣmiko liṅganāśaḥ śleṣmaṇaśca śuklatvācchuklaḥ|tasya-liṅganāśasya, anyadoṣeṇa-vātādinā, abhibhavādānīlatā bhavati gadaḥ|
Sa. saṃ-śarkarā'rkakṣīralavaniciteva tathā'tighana syāt|
rājīmatī dṛṅnicitā śāliśūkābharājibhiḥ| -----------------------------------------------|6|
Sa. rājīmatī dṛṣṭiḥ śāliśūkasadṛśībhī rājībhirnicitā syāt|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------| viṣamacchinnadagdhābhā saruk chinnāṃśukā smṛtā||6||

div.ab: Sa. viṣamā chinnadagdhābhā tathā sarujā chinnāṃśukā dṛṣṭiḥ smṛtā|
dṛṣṭiḥ kāṃsyasamacchāyā candrakī candrakākṛtiḥ| ----------------------------------------------|7|
Sa. candrakī dṛṣṭiḥ kāṃsyatulyacchāyā candrakākārā syāt|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------| chatrābhā naikavarṇā ca chatrakī nāma nīlikā||7||

div.ab: Sa. chatrābhā'nekavarṇā ca chatrakī nāma nīlikā syāt|

ab.seg: na vidhyedasirārhāṇāṃ na tṛṭpīnasakāsinām| nājīrṇabhīruvamitaśiraḥkarṇākṣiśūlinām||8||

div.ab: Sa. asirārhādīnāṃ narāṇāṃ liṅganāśaṃ na vidhyet|

atha sādhāraṇe kāle śuddhasambhojitātmanaḥ| deśe prakāśo pūrvāhṇe bhiṣagjānūccapīṭhagaḥ||9|| yantritasyopaviṣṭasya svinnākṣasya mukhānilaiḥ| aṅguṣṭhamṛdite netre dṛṣṭau dṛṣṭvotplutaṃ malam||10|| svāṃ nāsāṃ prekṣamāṇasya niṣkampaṃ mūrdhni dhārite| kṛṣṇādardhāṅgulaṃ muktvā tathā'rdhārdhamapāṅgataḥ||11|| tarjanīmadhyamāṅguṣṭhaiḥ śalākāṃ niścalaṃ dhṛtām| daivacchidraṃ nayetpārśvādūrdhvamāmanthayanniva||12|| savyaṃ dakṣiṇahastena netraṃ savyena cetarat| vidhyet---------------------------------------|13|

Sa. atheti maṅlārthaḥ| kṛtamaṅgalasya śuddhasya tathā sambhojitātmana āturasya sādharaṇe kāle prakāśe deśe pūrvāhṇe jānutulyāsanasthito vaidya āturasya yantritasyopaviṣṭasya, tathā svinne'kṣiṇī yasya tasya svinnākṣasya| kaiḥ ? mukhavāyubhiḥ| tathā'ṅguṣṭhena malite nayane sati dṛṣṭau malamutplutaṃ-udgataṃ dṛṣṭvā, svāṃ nāsikāṃ vīkṣamāṇasya mūrdhni niṣkampaṃ dhārite sati kṛṣṇamaṇḍalādardhāṅgulaṃ hitvā'pāṅgāccāṅgulacaturbhāgaṃ muktvā tarjanīmadhyamāṅguṣṭhaiḥ śalākāṃ niścalaṃ yathā bhavati tathā dhṛtāṃ daivacchidrasya pārśvaṃ nayet ūrdhvamāloḍayanniva| savyaṃ netraṃ dakṣiṇakareṇa, vāmena ca hastena dakṣiṇamakṣi, vidhyet|

----------------------------------------------| -------suviddhe śabdaḥ syādaruk cāmbulavasrutiḥ||13|| sāntvayannāturaṃ cānu netraṃ stanyena secayet| śalākāyāstato'greṇa nirlikheṇṇetramaṇḍalam||14|| abādhamānaḥ śanakairnāsāṃ prati nudaṃstataḥ| ucchiṅghanāccāpahareddṛṣṭimaṇdalagaṃ kapham||15|| sthire doṣe cale vā'ti svedayedakṣi bāhyataḥ| atha dṛṣṭeṣu rūpeṣu śalākāmāharecchanaiḥ||16|| ghṛtāplutaṃ picuṃ dattvā baddhākṣaṃ śāyayettataḥ| viddhādanyena pārśvena tamuttānaṃ dvayorvyadhe||17|| nivāte śayane'bhyaktaśiraḥpādaṃ hite ratam| ----------------------------------------------|18|

Sa. suviddhe sati śabdaḥ syāt| tathā'rug jalalavasya ca srutiḥ syāt| sāntvayan rogiṇamanu-paścāt, netraṃ stanyena secayet| tataḥ-anantaraṃ, śalākāyā agreṇa dṛṣṭimaṇḍalaṃ nirlikhet| katham ? apīḍayan| tathā śanairnāsāṃ prati kaphaṃ nudan| tata ucchiṅghanācca dṛṣṭimaṇḍalagaṃ kaphaṃ haret| doṣe cale sthire vā satyakṣibāhyato'ti svedayet| anantaraṃ rūpeṣu-vastuṣu, dṛṣṭeṣu satsu śanaiḥ śalākāmārkarṣet| tato ghṛtāplutaṃ picuṃ dattvā paṭṭikayā baddhākṣaṃ viddhādanyena pārśvena śāyayet| dvayorakṣṇorvyadhe sati tamuttānaṃ nivāte śayane'bhyaktaśiraḥ pādaṃ hite rataṃ śāyayet|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------| kṣavathuṃ kāsamudgāraṃ ṣṭhīvanaṃ pānamambhasaḥ||18||
adhomukhasthitiṃ snānaṃ dantadhāvanabhakṣaṇam| saptāhaṃ nācāretsnehapītavaccātra yantraṇā||19||

div.ab: Sa. kṣavathvādīn saptāhaṃ nācaret| atra ca snehapīta iva yantraṇā|

ab.seg: śaktito laṅghayetseko ruji koṣṇena sarpiṣā| savyoṣāmalakaṃ vāṭyamaśnīyātsaghṛtaṃ dravam||20||
vilepīṃ vā tryahāccāsya kvāthairmuktvā'kṣi secayet| vātaghnaiḥ saptame tvahni sarvathaivākṣi mocayet||21||

div.ab: Sa. śaktyanusāreṇa ca taṃ laṅghayet| pīḍāyāṃ satyāṃ koṣṇena ghṛtena seko hitaḥ| tathā vyoṣāmalakayuktaṃ vāṭhyaṃ dravaṃ saghṛtaṃ tryahaṃ bhuñjīta vilepikāṃ vā| tryahādantaraṃ nayanaṃ muktvā kvāthairvātaghnaiḥ sevayet| saptame tu dine sarvathaivākṣi mocayet|

ab.seg: yantraṇāmanurudhyeta dṛṣṭerāsthairyalābhataḥ| rūpāṇi sūkṣmadīptāni sahasā nāvalokayet||22||

div.ab: Sa. dṛṣṭeśca yantraṇāṃ kuryāt| atisūkṣmabhāsurādīn nekṣetetyarthaḥ| sthairyalābho yāvadakṣṇi syāt| sthirībhūtāyāmapi dṛśi sūkṣmaṇi rūpāṇi bhāsurāṇi ca sahasā nāvalokayet|

ab.seg: śopharāgarujādīnāmadhimanthasya codbhavaḥ| ahitairvedhadoṣācca yathāsvaṃ tānupācaret||23||

div.ab: Sa. ahitairācaritaistathā vedhadoṣācca śophādīnāmadhimanthasya codbhūtiḥ| tāṃśca yathāyogamupakramet|

ab.seg: kalkitāḥ saghṛtā dūrvāyavagairikasārivāḥ| mukhālepe prayoktavyā rujārāgopaśāntaye||24||

div.ab: Sa. dūrvādayaḥ kalkitāḥ saghṛtā mukhālepe prayoktavyā rūgrāgaśamāya|
sasarṣapāstilāstadvanmātuluṅgarasāplutāḥ| ----------------------------------------------|25|
Sa. tilāḥ sarṣapayuktā bījapūrarasāplutāḥ pūrvaguṇāḥ|
----------------------------------------------| payasyāsārivāpatramañjiṣṭhāmadhuyaṣṭibhiḥ||25|| ajākṣīrayutairlepaḥ sukhoṣṇaḥ śarmakṛtparam| ----------------------------------------------|26|
Sa. payasyādibhiśchāgakṣīrānvitaiḥ sukhoṣṇo lepaḥ paraṃ sukhakṛt|
----------------------------------------------| rodhrasaindhavamṛdvīkāmadhukaiśchāgalaṃ payaḥ||26|| śṛtamāścyotanaṃ yojyaṃ rujārāgavināśanam| ----------------------------------------------|27|
Sa. rodhrādibhirajākṣīraṃ śṛtamāścyotane yojyaṃ rujādihṛt|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------| madhukotpalakuṣṭhairva drākṣālākṣāsitānvitaiḥ||27||

div.ab: Sa. madhukādibhirvā śṛtamajākṣīramāścyotanaṃ hitam|

ab.seg: vātaghnasiddhe payasi śṛtaṃ sarpiścaturguṇe| padmakādipratīvāpaṃ sarvakarmasu śasyate||28||
sirāṃ tathā'nupaśame snigdhasvinnasya mokṣayet| manthoktāṃ ca kriyāṃ kuryādvedhe rūḍhe'ñjanaṃ mṛdu||29||

div.ab: Sa. vātaghnaśṛte kṣīre caturguṇe sarpiḥ padmakādipratīvāpaṃ sarvakarmasu śasyate| saṃ-evamapyanupaśāntau snigdhasvinnasya sirāṃ mokṣayet| manthoktaṃ copakramaṃ yuñjīta| vedhe rūḍhe sati mṛdvañjanaṃ hitam|

ab.seg: āḍhakīmūlamaricaharitālarasāñjanaiḥ| viddhe'kṣṇi saguḍā vartiryojyā divyāmbupeṣitā||30||

div.ab: Sa. āḍhakyādibhiḥ saguḍā vartirdivyāmbupiṣṭhā viddhe nayane yojyā|

jātīśirīṣadhavameṣaviṣāṇipuṣpa vaiḍūryamauktikaphalaṃ payasā supiṣṭam| ājena tāmramamunā pratanu pradigdhaṃ saptāhataḥ punaridaṃ payasaiva piṣṭam||31|| piṇḍāñjanaṃ hitamanātapaśuṣkamakṣṇi viddhe prasādajananaṃ balakṛcca dṛṣṭeḥ| ---------------------------------------- - ----------------------------------|32|
Sa. jātyādikamajākṣīreṇa ślakṣṇapiṣṭametena ca tāmraṃ pratanu pradigdhaṃ saptāhātpunarajākṣīreṇa caitat piṣṭaṃ piṇḍāñjanaṃ chāyāśuṣkaṃ viddhe nayane prasādanaṃ hitam| dṛṣṭeśca balakṛt|

---------------------------------------- - ----------------------------------| srotojavidrumaśilāmbudhiphenatīkṣṇai- rasyaiva tulyamuditaṃ guṇakalpanābhiḥ|32| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitā- yāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne liṅganāśapratiṣedho nāma catu rdaśo'dhyāyaḥ|14|

Sa. srotojādibhirajākṣīrapiṣṭaiḥ piṇḍāñjanaṃ pūrvavaditi| vasantatilakaṃ(ke) vṛttam(tte)| iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayaṭīkāyāṃ sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne liṅganāśapratiṣedho nāma caturdaśo'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 14||

div.head: sarvākṣirogavijñāniyādhyāyaḥ
div.ab: adhunā kramaprāptaṃ sarvākṣirogavijñānaṃ vakti ---- athātaḥ sarvākṣirogavijñānīyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre)|2| vātena netre'bhiṣyaṇṇe nāsānāho'lpaśophatā| śaṅkhākṣibhrūlalāṭasya todasphuraṇabhedanam||1|| śuṣkālpā dūṣikā śītamacchaṃ cāśru calā rujaḥ| nimeṣonmeṣaṇaṃ kṛcchrājjantūnāmiva sarpaṇam||2|| akṣyādhmātamivābhāti sūkṣmaiḥ śalyairivācitam| snigdhoṣṇaiścopaśamanaṃ so'bhiṣyandaḥ--------|3|
Sa. netre vātenābhiṣyaṇṇe nāsānāha ityādinā liṅgānirdeśaḥ| snigdhoṣṇaiścopaśamanaṃ-sukham, ityupaśayanirdeśaḥ|

ab.seg: adhimantho bhavettatra karṇayornadanaṃ bhramaḥ| araṇyeva ca mathyante lalāṭākṣibhruvādayaḥ||4||

div.ab: Sa. vātabhiṣyando mohādupekṣito'dhimantho bhavet| tatrādhimanthe, karṇanādādikaṃ syāt| araṇiśabdaḥ puṃstrīliṅgaḥ|

ab.seg: hatādhimanthaḥ so'pi syāt pramādāttena vedanāḥ| anekarūpā jāyante vraṇo dṛṣṭau ca dṛṣṭihā||5||

div.ab: Sa. adhimantho'pi pramādādupekṣito hatādhimantho bhavet| tena-hatādhimanthena, anekarūpā rujā jāyante| vraṇaśca dṛṣṭau dṛṣṭihā syāt|
manyākṣiśaṅkhato vāyuranyato vā pravartayan| vyathāṃ tīvrāmapaicchilyarāgaśophaṃ vilocanam||6|| saṅkocayati paryaśru so'nyatovātasaṃjñitaḥ| -----------------------------------------------|7|
Sa. saṃ-manyādibhyo vāyuranyato vā tīvrāṃ vyathāṃ pravartayet (yan) nayanaṃ saṅkocayati| kimbhūtam ? paicchilyarāgaśopharahitam| tathā paryaśru| sa anyatovātasaṃjñitaḥ|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------| tadvajjihmaṃ bhavennetramūnaṃ vā vātaparyaye||7||

div.ab: Sa. tadvat-anyatovāta iva, jihmaṃ netramūnaṃ-hīnaṃ vā, vātaparyaye syāt|
dāho dhūmāyanaṃ śophaḥ śyāvatā vartmano bahiḥ| antaḥ kledo'śru pītoṣṇaṃ rāgaḥ pītābhadarśanam||8|| kṣārokṣitakṣatākṣitvaṃ pittābhiṣyandalakṣaṇam| -----------------------------------------------|9|
Sa. saṃ-dāha ityādi pittābhiṣyandalakṣaṇam|
Sa. saṃ-adhimanthe jvaladaṅgārakīrṇābhaṃ yakṛtpiṇḍatulyābhaṃ netraṃ bhavet|

---------------------------syande tu kaphasambhave| jāḍyaṃ śopho mahān kaṇḍūrnidrā'nnānabhinandanam||10|| sāndrasnigdhabahuśvetapicchāvaddūṣikāśrutā| -----------------------------------------------|11|
Sa. kaphaje tu syande jāḍyādikaṃ syāt|
-----------------------------------------------| adhimanthe nataṃ kṛṣṇamunnataṃ śuklamaṇḍalam||11|| praseko nāsikādhmānaṃ pāṃśupūrṇamivekṣaṇam| -----------------------------------------------|12|
Sa. adhimanthe kṛṣṇamaṇḍalaṃ nataṃ śuklamaṇḍalaṃ connataṃ prasekādi ca syāt|
-----------------------------------------------| raktāśrurājīdūṣīkāraktamaṇḍaladarśanam||12|| raktasyandena nayanaṃ sapittasyandalakṣaṇam| -----------------------------------------------|13|
Sa. raktasyandena raktāśrurājyādikaṃ nayanaṃ syāt| pittasyandalakṣaṇaṃ ca|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------| manthe'kṣi tāmraparyantamutpāṭanasamānaruk||13||
rogeṇa bandhūkanibhaṃ tāmyati sparśanākṣamam| asṛṅnimagnāriṣṭābhaṃ kṛṣṇamagnyābhadarśanam||14||

div.ab: Sa. manthe sati tāmraparyantaṃ tathotpāṭanena samānā rug yasya tadevaṃbhūtaṃ nayanaṃ syāt| bandhūkapuṣpatulyarāgam| tathā tāmyati sparśanākṣamaṃ lohitanimagnanimbābhaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ pāvakasadṛśaṃ ca darśanaṃ syāt|

ab.seg: adhimanthā yathāsvaṃ ca sarve syāndādhikavyathāḥ| śaṅkadantakapoleśu kapāle cātirukkarāḥ||15||

div.ab: Sa. adhimanthāśca yathāsvaṃ sarve syandādhikavyathāḥ, tathā śaṅkhādiṣvatiśayena rukkarāḥ syuḥ|
vātapittāturaṃ ghārṣatodabhedopadehavat| rūkṣadāruṇavartmākṣi kṛcchronmīlanimīlanam||16|| vikūṇanaviśuṣkatvaśītecchāśūlapākavat| uktaḥ śuṣkākṣipāko'yaṃ--------------------|17|

Sa. vātapittottaraṃ netraṃ gharṣādimat syāt| tathā rūkṣe dāruṇe ca vartmanī yasmistathā kṛcchrādunmīlanimīlane yasmiṃstathā'kṣisaṅkocanena viśuṣkatvaṃ tathā śītecchā śūlapākena ca yutamakṣi syāt| ayaṃ śuṣkākṣipāko nāma uktaḥ|

-----------------------------------------------| ----------------------saśophaḥ syāttribhirmalaiḥ||17|| saraktaistatra śopho'tirugdāhaṣṭhīvanādimān| pakvodumbarasaṅkāśaṃ jāyate śuklamaṇḍalam||18|| aśrūṣṇaśītaviśadapicchilācchaghanaṃ muhuḥ| -----------------------------------------------|19|

Sa. tribhirmalaiḥ-doṣairvātādibhiḥ, saraktaiḥ saśopho nāma netrarogo bhavet| tatra-saśophe, śopho'tirug dāhaṣṭhīvanādimān bhavet| tadā śuklamaṇḍalaṃ pakvodumbarasaṅkāśaṃ jāyate| aśru ca muhuruṣṇaṃ muhuḥ śītamityādi ghanaṃ ca|

-----------------------------------------------| alpaśophe'lpaśophastu pāko'nyairlakṣaṇaistathā||19|| akṣipākātyaye śophaḥ saṃrambhaḥ kaluṣāśrutā| kaphopadigdhamasitaṃ sitaṃ prakledarāgavat||20|| dāho darśanasaṃrodho vedanāścānavasthitāḥ| -----------------------------------------------|21|
Sa. pāka iti pākaśabdenākṣipākātyaya upalakṣyate| ādyantalopākhyayā tantrayuktyā

-----------------------------------------------| annasāro'mlatāṃ nītaḥ pittaraktolbaṇairmalaiḥ||21|| śirābhirnetramārūḍhaḥ karoti śyāvalohitam| saśophadāhapākāśru bhṛśaṃ cāviladarśanam||22|| amloṣito'yam--------------------------------| -----------------------------------------------|23|
Sa. pittaraktolbaṇairdoṣairannasāro'mlatvaṃ nītaḥ śirābhirnetramārūḍhaḥ san śyāvalohitaṃ nayanaṃ karoti| tathā śophādiyutam| bhṛśaṃ cāspaṣṭadarśanam| ityayamamloṣitaḥ|
Sa. ityevaṃ ṣoḍaśa sarvagā rogā uktāḥ| prakṛtatvāt sarvanetragā iti gamyate|

ab.seg: --------------------------------------------------| hatādhimanthameteṣu sākṣipākātyayaṃ tyajet||23||

div.ab: Sa. eteṣu rogeṣu madhye sākṣipākātyayaṃ hatādhimanthaṃ tyajet|

vātodbhūtaḥ pañcarātreṇa dṛṣṭiṃ saptāhena śleṣmajāto'dhimanthaḥ| raktotpanno hanti tadvattrirātrāt mithyācārāt paittikaḥ sadya eva|24| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭavira- citāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttara- sthāne sarvākṣirogavijñānīyo nāma pañcadaśo'dhyāyaḥ|25|

Sa. vātajo'dhimanthaḥ pañcarātreṇa dṛṣṭiṃ hanti| mithyācārāditi sarvatrānuvartate| śleṣmajo'dhimanthaḥ saptarātreṇa dṛṣṭiṃ hanti| raktajaścādhimanthastrirātreṇa dṛṣṭiṃ hanti| paittikaścādhimantho mithyopacārāt sadya eva dṛṣṭiṃ hanti| śālinīvṛttam| iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayaṭī- kāyāṃ sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne sarvākṣirogavi- jñānīyo nāma pañcadaśo'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 15||

div.head: sarvākṣirogapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: adhunā sarvākṣirogapratiṣedha upakramyate ---- athātaḥ sarvākṣirogapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre)|2| prāgrūpa eva syandeṣu tīkṣṇaṃ gaṇḍūṣanāvanam| kārayedupavāsaṃ ca kopādanyatra vātajāt||1||

div.ab: Sa. syandeṣu pūrvarūpāvasthāyāṃ tīkṣṇameva gaṇḍūṣādikamupavāsaṃ ca syandavantaṃ kārayet, vātotthaṃ kopaṃ muktvā|
dāhopadeharāgāśruśophaśāntyai biḍālakam| kuryātsarvatra patrailāmaricasvarṇagairikaiḥ||2|| sarasāñjanayaṣṭyāhvanatacandanasaindhavaiḥ| ------------------------------------------------|3|
Sa. dāhādiśāntyai biḍālakaṃ kuryāt| sarvatra syande patrailādibhiḥ saindhavāntairbiḍālakaṃ kuryāt|

------------------------------------------------| saindhavaṃ nāgaraṃ tārkṣyaṃ bhṛṣṭaṃ maṇḍena sarpiṣaḥ||3|| vātaje ghṛtabhṛṣṭaṃ vā yojyaṃ śabaradeśajam| māṃsīpadmakakālīyayaṣṭyāhvaiḥ pittaraktayoḥ||4|| manohvāphalinīkṣaudraiḥ kaphe, sarvaistu sarvaje| ------------------------------------------------|5|

Sa. saindhavādi ghṛtamaṇḍena bhṛṣṭaṃ vā pavanaje ghṛtabhṛṣṭaṃ vā rodhraṃ yojyam| māṃsyādibhiḥ pittaraktayorbiḍālakaṃ kuryāt| manaḥśilādibhiḥ kaphaje| sarvaje tu syande sarvaiḥ-pūrvoktairmilitaiḥ, biḍālakaṃ kāryam|

ab.seg: sitamaricabhāgamekaṃ caturmanohvaṃ dviraṣṭaśābarkam| sañcūrṇya vastrabaddhaṃ prakupitamātre'vaguṇṭhanaṃ netre||5||

div.ab: Sa. caturbhāgapramāṇā manohvā yasmiṃstaccaturmanohvam| dviḥ-dvau vārau, aṣṭāṣṭabhāgapramāṇaḥ śābarako yasmiṃstat dviraṣṭaśābarakam| tena sitamaricasyaikaṃ bhāgaṃ manaḥśilāyāścaturo bhāgān rodhrasya ṣoḍaśa bhāgān sañcūrṇya etatsūkṣmavastrabaddhaṃ prakupitamātre-sadyaḥprakupite, nayane'vaguṇṭhanaṃ hitam| gītiḥ samukhacapalā|

ab.seg: āraṇyāśchagaṇarase paṭāvabaddhāḥ susvinnā nakhavituṣīkṛtāḥ kulatthāḥ| taccūrṇaṃ sakṛdavacūrṇanānniśīthe netrāṇāṃ vidhamati sadya eva kopam||6||

div.ab: Sa. āraṇyāḥ kulatthāśchagaṇarase-gośakṛdrase, paṭāvabaddhāḥ susvinnāstathā nakhairvituṣīkṛtāsteṣāṃ cūrṇamekavāramevāvacūrṇanāt sadya eva netrāṇāṃ kopaṃ vidhamati-jayati| praharṣiṇīvṛttam|

ab.seg: ghoṣābhayātutthakayaṣṭirodhrai- rmūtī susūkṣmaiḥ ślathavastrabaddhaiḥ| tāmrasthadhānyāmlanimagnamūrti- rartiṃ jayatyakṣiṇi naikarūpām||7||

div.ab: Sa. ghoṣādibhiḥ susūkṣmaiḥ ślathavastrabaddhairmūtī-poṭalikā, tāmrasthakāñjikanimagnamūrtiḥ pīḍāṃ nānāvidhāṃ netre dhāritā jayati| indravajrāvṛttam|

ab.seg: ṣoḍaśabhiḥ salilapalaiḥ palaṃ tathaikaṃ kaṭaṅkaṭeryāḥ siddham| seko'ṣṭabhāgaśiṣṭaḥ kṣaudrayutaḥ sarvadoṣakupite netre||8||

div.ab: Sa. dārvyāḥ palaṃ jalapalaiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiḥ śṛtamaṣṭabhāgaśeṣaḥ seko madhuyutaḥ sarvadoṣakupite cakṣuṣi hitaḥ| āryā gītiḥ|

ab.seg: vātapittakaphasannipātajāṃ netrayorbahuvidhāmapi vyathām| śīghrameva jayati prayojitaḥ śigrupallavarasaḥ samākṣikaḥ||9||

div.ab: Sa. ekaikadoṣajāṃ sannipātajāṃ vā nayanayornānāvidhāṃ pīḍāṃ śīghrameka eva śobhāñjanakarasaḥ sakṣaudro jayati| rathoddhatāvṛttam|

ab.seg: taruṇamurubūkapatraṃ mūlaṃ ca vibhidya siddhamāje kṣīre| vātābhiṣyandarujaṃ sadyo vinihanti saktupiṇḍikā coṣṇā||10||

div.ab: Sa. eraṇḍasya taruṇaṃ patraṃ mūlaṃ ca vibhidya-saṃkṣudya, chāgadugdhasiddhaṃ vātābhiṣyande pīḍāṃ sadya eva nihanti| doṣādivaśāt saktupiṇḍī uṣṇā vā rujaṃ hanti| āryā gītiḥ|

ab.seg: āścyotanaṃ mārutaje kvātho bilvādibhirhitaḥ| koṣṇaḥ sahairaṇḍajaṭābṛhatīmadhuśigrubhiḥ||11||
hrīberavakraśārṅgeṣṭodumbaratvakṣu sādhitam| sāmbhasā payasā''jena śūlāścyotanamuttamam||12||
mañjiṣṭhārajanīlākṣādrākṣarddhimadhukotpalaiḥ| kvāthaḥ saśarkaraḥ śītaḥ secanaṃ raktapittajit||13||

div.ab: Sa. vātaje'bhiṣyande bilvādibhireraṇḍamūlādibhiḥ saha kvāthaḥ kṛtaḥ koṣṇo hitamāścyotanam| hrīberādiṣu sādhitaṃ sajalenājena payasā uttamaṃ śūlāścyotanaṃ prasādanaṃ bhavet| hrīberaṃ-vālakam| vakraṃ-tagaram| mañjiṣṭhādibhiḥ kvāthaḥ sasitaḥ śiśiraḥ seko raktapittaghnaḥ|

ab.seg: kaseruyaṣṭyāhvarajastāntave śithilaṃ sthitam| apsu divyāsu nihitaṃ hitaṃ syande'srapittaje||14||

div.ab: Sa. kaserukādirajo vastre śithilaṃ sthitaṃ divyajale kṣiptaṃ syande raktapittaje hitam|

ab.seg: puṇḍrayaṣṭīniśāmūtī plutā stanye saśarkare| chāgadugdhe'thavā dāharugrāgāśrunivartanī||15||

div.ab: Sa. puṇḍrādibhirmūtī strīkṣīre saśarkare plutā chāgadugdhe vā dāhādihṛt|

ab.seg: śwetarodhraṃ samadhukaṃ ghṛtabhṛṣṭaṃ sucūrṇitaṃ| vastrasthaṃ stanyamṛditaṃ pittaraktābhighātajit||16||

div.ab: Sa. śvetarodhraṃ samadhukaṃ ghṛtabhṛṣṭaṃ sūkṣmarajīkṛtaṃ vasanasthaṃ stanyena mṛditaṃ pittādijit|

ab.seg: nāgaratriphalānimbavāsarodhrarasaḥ kaphe| koṣṇamāścyotanaṃ miśrairbheṣajaiḥ sānnipātike||17||

div.ab: Sa. nāgarādirasaḥ śleṣmaṇyāścyotanaṃ koṣṇaṃ hitam| sānnipātike'bhiṣyande miśrairauṣadhaiḥ-etairevānantaroktaiḥ, āścyotanaṃ koṣṇaṃ hitam|
sarpiḥ purāṇaṃ pavane, pitte śarkarayā'nvitam| vyoṣasiddhaṃ kaphe pītvā yavakṣārāvacūrṇitam||18|| srāvayedrudhiraṃ bhūyastataḥ snigdhaṃ virecayet| ------------------------------------------------|19|
Sa. pavane purāṇaṃ ghṛtaṃ hitam| pitte śarkarayā yutaṃ ghṛtaṃ hitam| kaphe vyoṣasiddhaṃ ghṛtaṃ yavakṣārāvacūrṇitaṃ pītvā rudhiraṃ srāvayet| bhūyaḥ snigdhaṃ tato virecayet|
Sa. ānūpavesavāreṇa śirovadanalepanamuṣṇena kāryaṃ śūle sati| dāhe tu sati kṣīraghṛtānvitaiḥ śītaiḥ pralepaḥ kāryaḥ|

ab.seg: ------------------------------------------------| timirapratiṣedhaṃ ca vīkṣya yuñjyādyathāyatham||20||

div.ab: Sa. timirapratiṣedhaṃ ca paryālocya yathāyogaṃ cikitsitaṃ yuñjyāt|

ab.seg: ayameva vidhiḥ sarvo manthādiṣvapi śasyate| aśāntau sarvathā manthe bhruvorupari dāhayet||21||

div.ab: Sa. eṣa eva vidhiraśeṣeṣu manthādiṣvapi śasyate| sarvathaivāśāntau manthe bhruvorupari dāhayet|

ab.seg: rūpyaṃ rūkṣeṇa godadhnā limpennīlatvamāgate| śuṣke tu mastunā vartirvātākṣyāmayanāśinī||22||

div.ab: Sa. rūpyaṃ godadhnā rūkṣeṇa limpet| tasmin dadhni nīlatvamāgate śuṣke ca mastunā vartirvātākṣiroganāśinī|

ab.seg: sumanaḥkorakāḥ śaṅkhastriphalā madhukaṃ balā| pittaraktāpahā vartiḥ piṣṭā divyena vāriṇā||23||

div.ab: Sa. sumanaḥkalikādayo vartirdivyena jalena piṣṭā pittaraktahṛt|

ab.seg: saindhavaṃ triphalā vyoṣaṃ śaṅkhanābhiḥ samudrajaḥ| phena aileyakaṃ sarjo vartiḥ śleṣmākṣiroganut||24||

div.ab: Sa. saindhavādibhirvartiḥ śleṣmākṣirogajit|

ab.seg: prapauṇḍarīkaṃ yaṣṭyāhvaṃ dārvī cāṣṭapalaṃ pacet| jaladroṇe rase pūte punaḥ pakve ghane kṣipet||25||
puṣpāñjanāddaśapalaṃ karṣaṃ ca maricāttataḥ| kṛtaścūrṇo'thavā vartiḥ sarvābhiṣyandasambhavān||26||
hanti rāgarujāgharṣān sadyo dṛṣṭiṃ prasādayet| ayaṃ pāśupato yogo rahasyaṃ bhiṣajāṃ param||27||

div.ab: Sa. praprauṇḍarīkādikamaṣṭapalaṃ pṛthagjaladroṇe pacet| rase pūte punaḥ śṛte ghane ca puṣpāñjanāddaśa palāni, marīcātkarṣaṃ ca kṣipet| kṛtaścūrṇo'thavā vartiḥ sarvābhiṣyandotthān rāgādīn hanti| tathā sadya eva dṛṣṭiṃ prasādayet| eṣa pāśupatākhyo yogo bhiṣajāṃ paraṃ rahasyam|
śuṣkākṣipāke haviṣaḥ pānamakṣṇośca tarpaṇam| ghṛtena jīvanīyena nasyaṃ tailena vā'ṇunā||28|| pariṣeko hitaścātra payaḥ koṣṇaṃ sasaindhavam| ------------------------------------------------|29|
Sa. śuṣkākṣipāke ghṛtasya pānamakṣṇośca jīvanīyasiddhena ghṛtena tarpaṇaṃ hitam| aṇunā tailena nasyaṃ hitam atra ca kṣīraṃ koṣṇaṃ saindhavayutaṃ pariṣeko hitaḥ|

------------------------------------------------| sarpiryuktaṃ stanyapiṣṭamañjanaṃ ca mahauṣadham||29|| vasā vā''nūpasattvotthā kiñcitsaindhavanāgarā| ------------------------------------------------|30|
Sa. nāgaraṃ stanyapiṣṭaṃ ghṛtānvitamañjanaṃ hitam| ānūpaprāṇijā vā vasā kiñcitsaindhavaśuṇṭhīyutā [ añjanaṃ ] śasyate|

------------------------------------------------| ghṛtāktān darpaṇe ghṛṣṭān keśān mallakasampuṭe||30|| dagdhvā''jyapiṣṭā lohasthā sā maṣī śreṣṭhamañjanam| ------------------------------------------------|31|
Sa. keśān ghṛtāktān darpaṇe ghṛṣṭān mallakasampuṭe dagdhvā ghṛtapiṣṭā lohapātrasthā sā maṣī śreṣṭhamañjanam|

------------------------------------------------| saśophevā'lpaśophe ca snigdhasya vyadhayetsirām||31|| rekaḥ snigdhe punardrākṣāpathyākvāthatrivṛdghṛtaiḥ| ------------------------------------------------|32|
Sa. saśophe'lpaśophe vā snigdhasya sirāṃ vidhyet| snigdhasya punardrākṣādibhirvirekaḥ|

------------------------------------------------| śvetarodhraṃ ghṛte bhṛṣṭaṃ cūrṇitaṃ tāntavasthitam||32|| uṣṇāmbunā vimṛditaṃ sekaḥ śūlaharaḥ param| ------------------------------------------------|33|
Sa. śvetarodhraṃ ghṛte bhṛṣṭaṃ cūrṇitaṃ vastrasthitamuṣṇāmbunā mṛditaṃ sekaḥ śūlahṛtparam|
------------------------------------------------| dārvīprapauṇḍarīkasya kvātho vā''ścyotane hitaḥ|33|
Sa. dārvīprapauṇḍarīkayośca kvātha āścyotane hitaḥ|

ab.seg: sandhavāṃśca prayuñjīta gharṣarāgāśruruggharān| ------------------------------------------------||33||

div.ab: Sa. sandhāvāṃśca vakṣyamāṇān gharṣādiharān prayuñjīta|
tāmraṃ lohe mūtraghṛṣṭaṃ prayuktaṃ netre sarpirdhūpitaṃ vedanāghnam| tāmre ghṛṣṭo gavyadadhnaḥ saro vā yuktaḥ kṛṣṇāsaindhavābhyāṃ variṣṭhaḥ||34.5||
Sa. lohabhāṇḍe tāmraṃ gomūtreṇa ghṛṣṭaṃ sarpirdhūpitaṃ netre prayuktaṃ pīḍāhṛt| gavyadadhisarastāmre ghṛṣṭaḥ kṛṣṇāsaindhavayukto netre prayukto varīyān vedanāghnaḥ sandhāvaḥ|
śaṅkhaṃ tāmre stanyaghṛṣṭaṃ ghṛtāktaiḥ śamyāḥ patrairdhūpitaṃ tadyavaiśca| netre yuktaṃ hanti sandhāvasaṃjñaṃ kṣipraṃ gharṣaṃ vedanāṃ cātitīvrām||35.5||
Sa. śaṅkhaṃ stanyena tāmre ghṛṣṭaṃ śamīpatrairyavaiśca ghṛtāktairdhūpitaṃ tatsandhāvasaṃjñaṃ netre prayuktaṃ śīghraṃ gharṣaṃ vedanāmatidāruṇāṃ ca hanti| śālinyau vṛtte|
------------------------------------------------| udumbaraphalaṃ lohe ghṛṣṭaṃ stanyena dhūpitam||36|| sājyaiḥ śamīcchadairdāhaśūlarāgāśruharṣajit| ------------------------------------------------|37|
Sa. udumbaraphalaṃ lohe stanyena ghṛṣṭaṃ ghṛtāktaiḥ śamīpatrairdhūpitaṃ dāhādijit|
------------------------------------------------| śigrupallavaniryāsaḥ sughṛṣṭastāmrasampuṭe||37|| ghṛtena dhūpito hanti śophagharṣāśruvedanāḥ| ------------------------------------------------|38|
Sa. śigrupallavarasaḥ sughṛṣṭastāmrasampuṭe ghṛtena dhūpitaḥ śophādīn hanti|

------------------------------------------------| tilāmbhasā mṛtkapālaṃ kāṃsye ghṛṣṭaṃ sudhūpitam||38|| nimbapatrairghṛtābhyaktairgharṣaśūlāśrurāgajit| ------------------------------------------------|39|
Sa. mṛtkapālaṃ tilāmbhasā kāṃsye ghṛṣṭaṃ tathā nimbapatrairghṛtābhyaktairdhūpitaṃ gharṣādijit|

------------------------------------------------| sandhāvenāñjite netre vigatauṣadhavedane||39|| stanyenāścyotanaṃ kāryaṃ triḥ paraṃ nāñjayecca taiḥ| ------------------------------------------------|40|
Sa. sandhāvena netre'ñjite vigatauṣadhavedane sati stanyenāścyotanaṃ hitaṃ kāryaṃ trīn vārān| taiśca-sandhāvaiḥ, paraṃ-tribhyo vārebhyo, nāñjayet|

ab.seg: jātīmukulakāsīsasaindhavairmūtrapeṣitaiḥ| tāmramālipya saptāhaṃ dhārayetpeṣayettataḥ||41||
mūtreṇaivānu guṭikāḥ kāryāśchāyaviśoṣitāḥ| tāḥ stanyaghṛṣṭā gharṣāśruśophakaṇḍūvināśanāḥ||42||

div.ab: Sa. tālīsapatrādibhirmūtrapiṣṭaistāmramālipya saptāhaṃ dhārayet| tataḥ saptāhādūrdhvaṃ gomūtreṇaiva guṭikāḥ kuryāt| tāśca chāyāviśoṣitāḥ stanyaghṛṣṭā gharṣādighnāḥ|

ab.seg: vyāghrītvaṅ''madhukaṃ tāmrarajo'jākṣīrakalkitam| śamyāmalakapatrājyadhūpitaṃ śopharukpraṇut||43||

div.ab: Sa. vyāghryādikamajākṣīrakalkitaṃ śamyāmalakapatrairghṛtānvitairdhūpitaṃ śopharukpraṇut|
amloṣite prayuñjīta pittābhiṣyandasādhanam| ---------------------------------------------|44|
Sa. amloṣite netraroge pittābhiṣyandacikitsitaṃ kuryāt|

---------------------------------------------| utkliṣṭāḥ kaphapittāsranicayotthāḥ kukūṇakaḥ||44|| pakṣmoparodhaḥ śuṣkākṣipākaḥ pūyālaso bisaḥ| pothakyamloṣito'lpākhyaḥ syandamanthā vinā'nilāt||45|| ete'ṣṭādaśa pillākhyā dīrghakālānubandhinaḥ| ---------------------------------------------|46|
Sa. utkliṣṭādayo'ṣṭādaśa rogā ime pillākhyā dīrghakālānubandhinaḥ|

---------------------------------------------| cikitsā pṛthageteṣāṃ svaṃsvamuktā atha vakṣyate||46|| pillībhūteṣu sāmānyāt atha pillākhyarogiṇaḥ| snigdhasya charditavataḥ sirāvyadhahṛtāsṛjaḥ||47|| viriktasya ca vartmānu nirlikhedāviśuddhitaḥ| ---------------------------------------------|48|

Sa. eteṣāṃ pṛthak cikitsā yathāsvamuktā| atha bhaṇiṣyate cikitsā pillībhūteṣu sāmānyena| atha pillākhyākṣirogavataḥ snigdhasya charditavato narasya viddhasirasya viriktasya ca vartma nirlikhedāviśuddheḥ|

---------------------------------------------| tutthakasya palaṃ śvetamaricāni ca viṃśatiḥ||48|| triṃśatā kāñjikapalaiḥ piṣṭvā tāmre nidhāpayet| pillānapillān kurute bahuvarṣotthitānapi||49|| tatsekenopadehāśrukaṇḍūśophāṃśca nāśayet| ---------------------------------------------|50|
Sa. tutthakasya palaṃ, viṃśatiḥ śvetamaricāni-saubhāñjanabījāni, kāñjikapalaistriṃśatā piṣṭvā tāmre nidhāpayet| tatsekena pillān bahuvarṣotthitānapyapillān kurute| upadehādīṃśca nāśayet|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| karañjabījaṃ surasaṃ sumanaḥkorakāṇi ca||50||
saṃkṣudya sādhayetkvāthe pūte tatra rasakriyā| añjanaṃ pillabhaiṣajyaṃ pakṣmaṇāṃ ca prarohaṇam||51||

div.ab: Sa. karañjabījādīni saṃkṣudya jale sādhayet| kvāthe pūte tatra rasakriyā| añjanaṃ pille auṣadhaṃ pakṣmaṇāṃ ca prarohaṇam|
rasāñjanaṃ sarjaraso rītipuṣpaṃ manaḥśilā| samudrapheno lavaṇaṃ gairikaṃ maricāni ca||52|| añjanaṃ madhunā piṣṭaṃ kledakaṇḍūghnamuttamam| ---------------------------------------------|53|
Sa. rasāñjanādikaṃ madhunā piṣṭamañjanaṃ paraṃ kledakaṇḍūhṛt|
---------------------------------------------| abhayārasapiṣṭaṃ vā tagaraṃ pillanāśanam||53|| bhāvitaṃ bastamūtreṇa sasnehaṃ devadāru ca| ---------------------------------------------|54|
Sa. harītakīkvāthapiṣṭaṃ tagaraṃ paraṃ pillaghnam| devadārusasnehaṃ bastamūtreṇa bhāvitaṃ tadvat|
---------------------------------------------| saindhavatriphalākṛṣṇākaṭukāśaṅkhnābhayaḥ||54|| satāmrarajaso vartiḥ pillaśukrakanāśinī| ---------------------------------------------|55|
Sa. saindhavādayastāmrajaḥsahitā vartiḥ pillaśukrahṛt|
---------------------------------------------| puṣpakāsīsacūrṇo vā surasārasabhāvitaḥ||55|| tāmre daśāhaṃ tat paillyapakṣmaśātajidañjanam| ---------------------------------------------|56|
Sa. puṣpakāsīsacūrṇaḥ surasārasena daśāhaṃ bhāvitastadañjanaṃ paillyapakṣmaśātaghnam| surasā-mūrvā|

ab.seg: alaṃ ca sauvīrakamañjanaṃ ca tābhyāṃ samaṃ tāmrarajaḥ susūkṣmam| pilleṣu romāṇi niṣevito'sau cūrṇaḥ karotyekaśalākayā'pi||56||

div.ab: Sa. haritālaṃ sauvīrāñjanaṃ [ca]| tābhyāṃ dvābhyāṃ tulyaṃ tāmracūrṇaṃ sūkṣmam| eṣa cūrṇo niṣevita ekayā'pi śalākayā pilleṣu romāṇi karoti| upajātiḥ|

ab.seg: lākṣānirguṇḍībhṛṅgadārvīrasena śreṣṭhaṃ kārpāsaṃ bhāvitaṃ saptakṛtvaḥ| dīpaḥ prajvālyaḥ sarpiṣā tatsamutthā śreṣṭhā pillānāṃ ropaṇārthe maṣī sā||57||

div.ab: Sa. lākṣādirasena śreṣṭhaṃ kārpāsaṃ saptavārān bhāvitam| tena kārpāsena sarpiṣā dīpaḥ prajvālyaḥ| tatsamutthā maṣī pillānāṃ ropaṇārthe śreṣṭhā| vaiśvadevīvṛttam|

ab.seg: --------------------------------------------| vartmāvalekhaṃ bahuśastadvacchoṇitamokṣaṇam||58||
punaḥpunarvirekaṃ ca nityamāścyotanāñjanam| nāvanaṃ dhūmapānaṃ ca pillarogāturo bhajet||59||

div.ab: Sa. pillarogī vartmāvalekhādikaṃ punaḥpunarbhajet|
pūyālase tvaśānte'nte dāhaḥ sūkṣmaśalākayā| --------------------------------------------|60|
Sa. pūyālase punaraśānte satyante sūkṣmaśalākayā dāho hitaḥ|
--------------------------------------------| caturṇavatirityakṣṇo hetulakṣaṇasādhanaiḥ||60|| parasparamasaṅkīrṇāḥ kārtsnyena gaditā gadāḥ| --------------------------------------------|61|
Sa. ityevamakṣṇaścaturṇavati gadā lakṣaṇahetusādhanairanyonyamasaṅkīrṇāḥ kārtsnyenoktāḥ|

ab.seg: --------------------------------------------| sarvadā ca niṣeveta svastho'pi nayanapriyaḥ||61||
purāṇayavagodhūmaśāliṣaṣṭikakodravān| mudgādīn kaphapittaghnān bhūrisarpiḥpariplutān||62||
śākaṃ caivaṃvidhaṃ māṃsaṃ jāṅgalaṃ dāḍimaṃ sitām| saindhavaṃ triphalāṃ drākṣāṃ vāri pāne ca nābhasam||63||
ātapatraṃ padatrāṇaṃ vidhivaddoṣaśodhanam| varjayedvegasaṃrodhamajīrṇādhyaśanāni ca||64||
krodhaśokadivāsvapnarātrijāgaraṇātapān| vidāhi viṣṭambhakaraṃ yaccehāhārabheṣajam||65||

div.ab: Sa. svastho'pi nayanavallabhaḥ san sadaiva purāṇayavādikaṃ niṣeveta| evaṃvidhaṃ kaphapittaghnaṃ śākaṃ ca| vidhirvidyate yasmiṃstacca śodhanaṃ-virecanādi, bhajet| tathā vegasaṃrodhādikaṃ varjayet|

ab.seg: dve pādamadhye pṛthusanniveśe śire gate te bahudhā ca netre tā mrakṣaṇodvartanalepanādīn pādaprayuktānnayane nayanti||66||

div.ab: Sa. dve pādasya madhye pṛthurūpe sire| te ca bahudhā netragate| tāḥ sirāḥ abhyaṅgādīn pādaprayuktānnetraṃ(tre)prāpayanti|

malauṣṇyasaṅghaṭṭanapīḍanādyai- stā dūṣayante nayanāni duṣṭāḥ| bhajetsadā dṛṣṭihitāni tasmā- dupānadabhyañjanadhāvanāni|67| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne sarvākṣirogapratiṣedho nāma ṣoḍaśo'dhyāyaḥ|16|

Sa. tāśca malauṣṇyādibhirduṣṭā nayanāni dūṣayante| yata evaṃ tasmād dṛṣṭihitāni sarvadā upānadabhyañjanādīni bhajet| upajātī vṛtte| iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayaṭīkāyāṃ sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne sarvākṣirogapratiṣedho nāma ṣoḍaśo'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 16||

div.head: karṇarogavijñānīyādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athātaḥ karṇarogavijñānīyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre||2||
) pratiśyāyajalakrīḍākarṇakaṇḍūyanairmarut| mithyāyogena śabdasya kupito'nyaiśca kopanaiḥ||1||
prāpya śrotrasirāḥ kuryācchūlaṃ srotasi vegavat| ardhāvabhedakaṃ stambhaṃ śiśirānabhinandanam||2||
cirācca pākaṃ pakvaṃ tu lasīkāmalpaśaḥ sravet| śrotraṃ śūnyamakasmācca syātsañcāravicāravat||3||

div.ab: Sa. nayanāmayādanantaraṃ dūragrahaṇasādharmyeṇa karṇarogānāha| yathā hi cakṣurdūradeśasthamapi paśyati tathā śrotraṃ dūrasthamapi śṛṇotītyāha- pratiśyāyetyādibhiḥ śabdasya ca mithyābhiyogena pavanaḥ kupito'parairapi sarvanidānaiḥ kupitaḥ śrotrasirāḥ prāpya srotasi-karṇavivare, śūlaṃ vegavat kuryāt| tathā'rdhāvabhedakaṃ śirorogaṃ stambhaṃ karṇasyaiva, tathā śītasyānabhinandanaṃ cireṇa ca pākaṃ kuryāt| pakvaṃ tu śrotramalpaśo lasīkāṃ sravet| akasmācca śūnyaṃ syāt| sañcāravicāravacca-sthagitāsthagitaṃ ca yathā, syāt|
śūlaṃ pittāt sadāhoṣāśītecchāśvayathujvaram| āśupākaṃ prapakvaṃ ca sapītalasikāsruti||4|| sā lasīkā spṛśedyadyattattatpākamupaiti ca| ---------------------------------------------|5|

Sa. pittena śūlaṃ dāhādyanvitaṃ syāt| tatra ūṣā-prādeśikaḥ santāpaḥ| dāhaḥ-sarvāṅgīṇastīvroṣmā sadā'ratimān| tathā''śu pāko yasmiṃstadevam| tathā prapakvaṃ ca sapītalasikāsruti syāt| sā ca lasīkā yadyadaṅgaṃ spṛśet tat tat pākaṃ gacchati|

-------------------------------------------------| kaphācchirohanugrīvāgauravaṃ mandatā rujaḥ||5|| kaṇḍūḥ śvayathuruṣṇecchā pākācchvetaghanasrutiḥ| -------------------------------------------------|6|
Sa. kaphācchirādigauravaṃ jāyate| rujo mandatvaṃ kaṇḍvādi ca syāt| pākācchvetā ghanā ca srutiḥ syāt|
-------------------------------------------------| karoti śravaṇe śūlamabhighātādidūṣitam||6|| raktaṃ pittasamānārti kiñcidvā'dhikalakṣaṇam| -------------------------------------------------|7|
Sa. raktamabhighātādidūṣitaṃ karṇe śūlaṃ karoti| kimbhūtaṃ raktam ? pittena samā pīḍā yasmiṃstadevam| kiñciccādhikalakṣaṇam|

ab.seg: -------------------------------------------------| śūlaṃ samuditairdoṣaiḥ saśophajvaratīvraruk||7||
paryāyāduṣṇaśītecchaṃ jāyate śrutijāḍyavat| pakvaṃ sitāsitāraktaghanapūyapravāhi ca||8||

div.ab: Sa. samuditaiḥ-sannipatitairdoṣaiḥ, śūlaṃ śophādiyutaṃ jāyate| tathā paryāyeṇoṣṇaśītecchaṃ śrutijāḍyayuktaṃ ca| pakvaṃ sitāsitāraktaghanaṃ pūyaṃ pravahati|

ab.seg: śabdavāhisirāsaṃsthe śṛṇoti pavane muhuḥ| nādānakasmādvividhān karṇanādaṃ vadanti tam||9||

div.ab: Sa. śabdavāhinīṣu sirāsu gate vāte muhuḥ śabdān vividhānakasmācchṛṇoti| taṃ karṇanādaṃ vadanti|

ab.seg: śleṣmaṇā'nugato vāyurnādo vā samupekṣitaḥ| uccaiḥ kṛcchrācchrutiṃ kuryādbadhiratvaṃ krameṇa ca||10||

div.ab: Sa. vāyuḥ śleṣmaṇā'nugataḥ karṇanādo vā samupekṣitaḥ-acikitsitaḥ, karṇe-śrotre, uccaiḥ kṛcchrācchrutiṃ-śravaṇaṃ, kuryāt| krameṇa badhiratvaṃ-bādhiryaṃ ca, kuryāt|

ab.seg: vātena śoṣitaḥ śleṣmā śroto limpettato bhavet| ruggauravaṃ pidhānaṃ ca sa pratīnāhasaṃjñitaḥ||11||

div.ab: Sa. vātena śleṣmā śoṣitaḥ śroto limpet| tato ruggauravaṃ tasya srotaso gurutvaṃ syāt, sthaganaṃ ca| sa pratīnāhasaṃjñako gadaḥ|
kaṇḍūśophau kaphācchrotre sthirau tatsaṃjñayā smṛtau| -------------------------------------------------|12|
Sa. kaphāt kaṇḍūśophau karṇe sthirau tatsaṃjñau kaṇḍūśophākhyau bhavataḥ|
-------------------------------------------------| kapho vidagdhaḥ pittena sarujaṃ nīrujaṃ tvapi||12|| ghanapūtibahukledaṃ kurute pūtikarṇakam| -------------------------------------------------|13|
Sa. kaphaḥ pittena vidagdhaḥ sarujaṃ nīrujaṃ vā ghanapūtibahukledaṃ pūtikarṇakamanugatārthaṃ kurute|

-------------------------------------------------| vātādidūṣitaṃ śrotraṃ māṃsāsṛkkledajā rujam||13|| khādanto jantavaḥ kuryustīvrāṃ sa kṛmikarṇakaḥ| -------------------------------------------------|14|
Sa. vātādibhiḥ dūṣitaṃ śrotraṃ jantavo bhakṣayanto māṃsādikledajāṃ tīvrāṃ rujaṃ kuryuḥ| sa kṛmikarṇakākhyaḥ|

Sa. śrotrakaṇḍūyanājjāte kṣate pūrvoktalakṣaṇo vidradhiḥ syāt| nidāne hyevamuktam (hṛ. ni. a. 11| 2)- "yaḥ śopho bahirantarvā mahāmūlo mahārujaḥ| vṛttaḥ syādāyato yo vā smṛtaḥ ṣoḍhā sa vidradhiḥ||" iti| tadvadiha vidradhisāmānyāt karṇavidradhireka evoktaḥ|

ab.seg: ---------------------------śopho'rśo'rbudamīritam| teṣu ruk pūtikarṇatvaṃ badhiratvaṃ ca bādhate||15||

div.ab: Sa. arśo'rbudaṃ ca tadīritamiti karṇārśaḥ karṇārbudamiti| tatra hyuktam (hṛ. u. a. 8|13)- "arśo'dhimāṃsaṃ vartmāntaḥ stabdhaṃ snigdhaṃ sadāharuk| raktaṃ raktena tatsrāvi chinnaṃ chinnaṃ vivardhate||" iti| arbudasya tu lakṣaṇam (hṛ. u. a. 8|24)- "vartmāntarmāṃsapiṇḍābhaḥ śvayathurgrathito'rujaḥ| sāsraiḥ syādarbudo doṣairviṣamo bāhyataścalaḥ||" iti| teṣu-arśo'rbudeṣu, rug bādhate pūtikarṇatvaṃ badhiratvaṃ ca|
garbhe'nilātsaṅkucitā śaṣkulī kucikarṇakaḥ| ---------------------------------------------|16|
Sa. vātādgarbhe-abhyantare, saṅkucitā śaṣkulī kucikarṇasaṃjñaḥ|
Sa. māṃsāṃṅkuro garbhe sthira eko'neko vā nīrujaḥ pippalītyucyate, karṇapippalītyarthaḥ| sa ca māṃsāṃṅkuraḥ pippalīmānaḥ|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------sannipātādvidārikā| savarṇaḥ sarujaḥ stabdhaḥ śvayathuḥ, sa upekṣitaḥ||17||
kaṭutailanibhaṃ pakvaḥ sravet kṛcchreṇa rohati| saṅkocayati rūḍhā ca sā dhruvaṃ karṇaśaṣkulīm||18||

div.ab: Sa. sannipātena vidārikākhyaḥ śvayathuḥ stabdhastathā savarṇaḥ sarujaḥ| sa upekṣitaḥ san kaṭutailanibhaṃ sravet| kṛcchreṇa rohati| sā ca vidārikā rūḍhā satī niścitaṃ karṇaśaṣkulīṃ saṅkocayati|
sirāsthaḥ kurute vāyuḥ pālīśoṣaṃ tadāhvayam| ---------------------------------------------|19|
Sa. sirāstho vāyuḥ pālīśoṣaṃ tadāhvayaṃ-pālīśoṣasaṃjñaṃ, kurute|

---------------------------------------------| kṛśā dṛḍhā ca tantrīvat pālī vātena tantrikā||19|| sukumāre cirotsargātsahasaiva pravardhite| karṇe śophaḥ saruk pālyāmaruṇaḥ paripoṭavān||20|| paripoṭaḥ sa pavanāt----------------------| ---------------------------------------------|21|

Sa. vātena pālī kṛśā dṛḍhā ca tantrīva syāt| sā tantrīketyucyate| sukumāre karṇe cirotsargāt sahasaiva-na tu śanaiḥ, pravardhite śvayathuḥ pālyāṃ saruk tathā lohitaḥ paripoṭavāṃśca| paripoṭaḥ-sphuṭanam| sa vātāt paripoṭasaṃjñaḥ syāt|
----------------------utpātaḥ pittaśoṇitāt| gurvābharaṇabhārādyaiḥ śyāvo rugdāhapākavān||21|| śvayathuḥ sphoṭapiṭikārāgoṣākledasaṃyutaḥ| ---------------------------------------------|22|
Sa. pittaśoṇitāt sa evotpātasaṃjñaḥ| gurvābharaṇabhārādibhirhetubhūtaiḥ prakupitāt pittaśoṇitāt śopho rugādimān sphoṭādisaṃyutaḥ| śyāvo'nugatārthaḥ|

---------------------------------------------| pālyāṃ śopho'nilakaphātsarvato nirvyathaḥ sthiraḥ||22|| stabdhaḥ savarṇaḥ kaṇḍūmānunmantho galliraśca saḥ| ---------------------------------------------|23|
Sa. vātakaphāt pālyāṃ śophaḥ sarvato nirvyathaḥ sthiraḥ stabdhaḥ samānavarṇaḥ kaṇḍūyuta unmantha ucyate| sa eva gallirākhyaḥ|
---------------------------------------------| durviddhe vardhite karṇe sakaṇḍūdāhapākaruk||23|| śvayath uḥ sannipātotthaḥ sa nāmnā duḥkhavardhanaḥ| ---------------------------------------------|24|
Sa. karṇe durviddhe sati kaṇḍvādisaṃyutaḥ śophaḥ sanni ppātātmako duḥkhavardhanasaṃjñaḥ|
---------------------------------------------| kaphāsṛk''kṛmijāḥ sūkṣmāḥ sakaṇḍūkledavedanāḥ||24|| lehyākhyāḥ piṭikāstā hi lihyuḥ pālīmupekṣitāḥ| ---------------------------------------------|25|
Sa. kapharaktajakṛmijāḥ sūkṣmāḥ kaṇḍvādiyutā lehyākhyāḥ piṭikāḥ| yasmāttā upekṣitāḥ pālīṃ lihyuḥ|

---------------------------------------------| pippalī sarvajaṃ śūlaṃ vidārī kucikarṇakaḥ|25| eṣāmasādhyāḥ, yāpyaikā tantrikā'nyāṃstu sādhayet| pañcaviṃśatirityuktāḥ karṇarogā vibhāgataḥ|26| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne karṇarogavijñānīyo nāma saptadaśo'dhyāyaḥ|17|

Sa. pippalyādayaścatvāro rogā eṣāṃ madhye'sādhyāḥ| tantrikā yāpyā| anyāṃstu viṃśatirogān sādhayet| iti-evaṃ prāguktena prakāreṇa, pañcaviṃśatirāmayā vibhāgenoktāḥ| anenānyatantrakṛtāṃ saṅkīrṇakarṇarogakathanaṃ sūcayati| saṅkhyānaṃ ca sukhasmaraṇārthamatra kṛtamiti| iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayaṭīkāyāṃ sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne karṇarogavijñānīyo nāma saptadaśo'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 17||

div.head: karṇarogapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ
div.ab: athātaḥ karṇarogapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre||2|| ) karṇaśūle pavanaje pibedrātrau rasāśitaḥ| vātaghnasādhitaṃ sarpiḥ, karṇaṃ svinnaṃ ca pūrayet||1|| patrāṇāṃ pṛthagaśvatthabilvārkairaṇḍajanmanām| tailasindhūtthadigdhānāṃ svinnānāṃ puṭapākataḥ||2|| rasaiḥ kavoṣṇaistadvacca mūlakasyāralorapi| ---------------------------------------------|3|

Sa. asmādanantarametaccikitsocyata ityāha- vātodbhave karṇaśūle māṃsarasena bhojito vātaghnadravyasādhitaṃ ghṛtaṃ niśi pibet| karṇaṃ ca svinnaṃ santaṃ pṛthagaśvatthādijānāṃ patrāṇāṃ tailasaindhavadigdhānāṃ puṭapākataḥ svinnānāṃ rasaiḥ koṣṇaiḥ pūrayet| tathaiva mūlakasya rasena syonākasya ca rasena pūrayet|
---------------------------------------------| gaṇe vātahare'mleṣu mūtreṣu ca vipācitaḥ||3|| mahāsneho drutaṃ hanti sutīvrāmapi vedanām| ---------------------------------------------|4|
Sa. vātahare gaṇe'mleṣu mūtreṣu ca-gomūtrādiṣu, vipācito mahāsneho drāgeva sudāruṇāmapi pīḍāṃ jayati|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| mahataḥ pañcamūlasya kāṣṭhātkṣaumeṇa veṣṭitāt||4||
tailasiktātpradīptāgrāt snehaḥ sadyo rujāpahaḥ| yojyaścaivaṃ bhadrakāṣṭhātkuṣṭhātkāṣṭhācca sāralāt||5||

div.ab: Sa. mahataḥ pañcamūlasya ekatamāt kāṣṭhāt kṣaumeṇa veṣṭitāt tailasiktāt prajvalitāt grāhyaḥ snehaḥ| sa karṇe niṣiktaḥ sadyo rujāhṛt| evaṃ-anenaiva vidhinā, devadārukāṣṭhāt kuṣṭhāt saralakāṣṭhācca cyutaḥ sneho-raso, yojyaḥ|

ab.seg: vātavyādhipratiśyāyavihitaṃ hitamatra ca| varjayecchirasā snānaṃ śītāmbhaḥpānamahnyapi||6||

div.ab: Sa. vātavyādhau pratiśyāye ca yadvihitaṃ bheṣajaṃ taccātra hitam| śirasā saha snānaṃ varjayet| śītajalapānaṃ divā'pi na kāryam, rātrau tu sarvathā varjyamevetyarthaḥ|

ab.seg: pittaśūle sitāyuktaghṛtasnigdhaṃ virecayet| drākṣāyaṣṭiśṛtaṃ stanyaṃ śasyate karṇapūraṇam||7||

div.ab: Sa. pittaśūle sitānvitaghṛtena snigdhaṃ virecayet| drākṣāmadhukasiddhaṃ strīkṣīraṃ karṇapūraṇaṃ hitam|

yaṣṭyanantāhimośīrakākolīrodhrajīvakaiḥ| mṛṇālabisamañjiṣṭhāsārivābhiśca sādhayet||8|| yaṣṭīmadhurasaprasthakṣīradviprasthasaṃyutam| tailasya kuḍavaṃ nasyapūraṇābhyañjanairidam||9|| nihanti śūladāhoṣāḥ kevalaṃ kṣaudrameva vā| ---------------------------------------------|10|
Sa. yaṣṭyādibhiḥ kalkairmadhukakvāthaprasthena kṣīrasya dviprasthena ca saṃyutaṃ tailakuḍavaṃ sādhayet| nasyakarṇapūraṇābhyañjanairidaṃ śūlādīn hanti| kevalaṃ kṣaudraṃ vā|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| yaṣṭyādibhiśca saghṛtaiḥ karṇau dihyātsamantataḥ||10||

div.ab: Sa. yaṣṭyādibhiḥ-pūrvoktaiḥ, sasarpikaiḥ karṇau ca parito limpet|

ab.seg: vāmayet pippalīsiddhasarpiḥsnigdhaṃ kaphodbhave| dhūmanāvanagaṇḍūṣasvedān kuryātkaphāpahān||11||

div.ab: Sa. kaphotthe pippalīpakvaghṛtasnigdhaṃ vāmayet| dhūmādīṃśca kaphaghnān vidadhyāt|

ab.seg: laśunārdrakaśigrūṇāṃ muruṅgyā mūlakasya ca| kadalyāḥ svarasaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ kaduṣṇaḥ karṇapūraṇe||12||

div.ab: Sa. laśunādīnāṃ pṛthak pṛthak svarasaḥ karṇapūraṇe koṣṇaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ|
arkāṅkurānamlapiṣṭāṃstailāktāṃllavaṇānvitān| sannidhāya snuhīkāṇḍe korite tacchadāvṛtān||13|| svedayetpuṭapākena sa rasaḥ śūlajitparam| ---------------------------------------------|14|
Sa. arkāṅkurānamlena-kāñikena, piṣṭāṃstailena rūkṣi(ṣi)tān lavaṇānvitān snuhīkāṇḍe korite sannidhāya tasyāḥ-snuhyāḥ, patrairāvṛtān puṭapākena svedayet| sa rasaḥ paraṃ śūlajit|
---------------------------------------------| rasena bījapūrasya kapitthasya ca pūrayet||14|| suktena pūrayitvā vā phenenānvavacūrṇayet| ---------------------------------------------|15|
Sa. tathā bījapūrasya rasena kapittharasena ca pūrayet| athavā suktena pūrayitvā samudraphenacūrṇairavacūrṇayet|
---------------------------------------------| ajāvimūtravaṃśatvak''siddhaṃ tailaṃ ca pūraṇam||15|| siddhaṃ vā sārṣapaṃ tailaṃ hiṅgutumburunāgaraiḥ| ---------------------------------------------|16|
Sa. ajāvimūtrābhyāṃ vaṃśatvacā ca siddhaṃ tailaṃ pūraṇaṃ hitam| sārṣapaṃ tailaṃ hiṅgutumburuśuṇṭhībhiḥ siddhaṃ pūraṇaṃ hitam|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| raktaje pittavatkāryaṃ sirāṃ cāśu vimokṣayet||16||

div.ab: Sa. raktaje karṇaśūle pittavatkāryam| śīghraṃ ca sirāṃ vimokṣayet|

ab.seg: pakve pūyavahe karṇe dhūmagaṇḍūṣanāvanam| yuñjyānnāḍīvidhānaṃ ca duṣṭavraṇaharaṃ ca yat||17||

div.ab: Sa. pakve pūyavahe karṇe dhūmādikaṃ yojyam| nāḍīvidhānaṃ ca yojyam| duṣṭavraṇaghnaṃ yacca tacca yojyam|

ab.seg: srotaḥ pramujya digdhaṃ tu dvau kālau picuvartibhiḥ| pureṇa dhūpayitvā tu mākṣikeṇa prapūrayet||18||
surasādigaṇakvāthaphāṇitāktāṃ ca yojayet| picuvartiṃ susūkṣmaiśca taccūrṇairavacūrṇayet||19||

div.ab: Sa. picuvartibhiśca karṇasroto digdhaṃ-pūyena, dvau kālau pramṛjya guggulunā dhūpayitvā tato mākṣikeṇa pūrayet| surasādigaṇakvāthakṛtaphāṇitāktāṃ picuvartiṃ ca yojayet| susūkṣmaistaccūrṇaiḥ-surasādirajobhiḥ, avacūrṇayet karṇasrotaḥ|

ab.seg: śūlakledagurutvānāṃ vidhireṣa nivartakaḥ| priyaṅgumadhukāmbaṣṭhādhātakyutpalaparṇibhiḥ||20||
mañjiṣṭhālodhralākṣābhiḥ kapitthasya rasena ca| pacettailaṃ tadāsrāvaṃ nigṛhṇātyāśu pūraṇāt||21||

div.ab: Sa. śūlādīnāṃ nivartako vidhireṣaḥ| priyaṅgvādibhiḥ kapittharasena tailaṃ pacet| tatpūraṇāddrāgevāsrāvaṃ nirharati|

ab.seg: nādabādhiryayoḥ kuryād vātaśūloktamauṣadham| śleṣmānubandhe śleṣmāṇaṃ prāgjayedvamanādibhiḥ||22||

div.ab: Sa. nāde badhiratve ca vātaśūloktamauṣadhaṃ kuryāt| śleṣmānubandhe prāk śleṣmāṇaṃ vamanādibhirjayet|

ab.seg: eraṇḍaśigruvaruṇamūlakātpatraje rase| caturguṇe pacettailaṃ kṣīre cāṣṭaguṇonmite||23||
yaṣṭyāhvākṣīrakākolīkalkayuktaṃ nihanti tat| nādabādhiryaśūlāni nāvanābhyaṅgapūraṇaiḥ||24||

div.ab: Sa. eraṇḍādipatraje rase caturguṇe kṣīre cāṣṭaguṇe yaṣṭikādikalkayutaṃ tailaṃ pacet| tacca nāvanādibhirnādādīn hanti|

ab.seg: pakvaṃ prativiṣāhiṅgumiśitvak''svarjikoṣaṇaiḥ| sasuktaiḥ pūraṇāttailaṃ ruk''srāvāśrutinādanut||25||

div.ab: Sa. prativiṣādibhiḥ saṃyuktaṃ tailaṃ pakvaṃ pūraṇādrujādijit|
karṇanāde hitaṃ tailaṃ sarṣapotthaṃ ca pūraṇe| ---------------------------------------------|26|
Sa. sarṣapodbhavaṃ ca tailaṃ karṇanāde hitam|

---------------------------------------------| śuṣkamūlakakhaṇḍānāṃ kṣāro hiṅgu mahauṣadham||26|| śatapuṣpāvacākuṣṭhadāruśigrurasāñjanam| sauvarcalayavakṣārasvarjikaudbhidasaindhavam||27|| bhūrjagranthibiḍaṃ mustā madhusuktaṃ caturguṇam| mātuluṅgarasastadvat kadalīsvarasaśca taiḥ||28|| pakvaṃ tailaṃ jayatyāśu sukṛcchrānapi pūraṇāt| kaṇḍūṃ kledaṃ ca bādhiryapūtikarṇatvaruk''kṛmīn||29|| kṣāratailamidaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ mukhadantāmayeṣu ca| ---------------------------------------------|30|

Sa. śuṣkamūlakakhaṇḍānāṃ kṣārādīni sāmānyaparibhāṣoktapramāṇāni tathā tailānmadhuyutaṃ suktaṃ caturguṇaṃ tathā bījapūrarasaḥ kadalīsvarasaśca caturguṇaḥ| tairetaistailaṃ pakvaṃ pūraṇāt sukṛcchrānapi kaṇḍvādīnāśu jayet| idaṃ kṣāratailaṃ mukhadantarogeṣu ca śreṣṭham|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| atha suptāviva syātāṃ karṇau raktaṃ harettataḥ||30||

div.ab: Sa. yadi karṇau suptāviva syātāṃ tadā'sraṃ haret|

ab.seg: saśophakledayormandaśrutervamanamācaret| bādhiryaṃ varjayedbālavṛddhayościrajaṃ ca yat||31||

div.ab: Sa. karṇayoḥ saśophakledayormandaśruterāturasya vamanaṃ prayuñjyāt| bādhiryaṃ bālavṛddhayościrajātaṃ ca yattadvarjayet|

ab.seg: pratīnāhe parikledya snehasvedairviśodhayet| karṇaśodhanakenānu karṇaṃ tailasya pūrayet||32||
sasuktasaindhavamadhormātuluṅgarasasya vā| śodhanādrūkṣatotpattau ghṛtamaṇḍasya pūraṇam||33||

div.ab: Sa. pratīnāhe snehasvedaiḥ parikledya karṇaṃ karṇaśodhanakena viśodhayet| paścāttailasya suktādinā yuktasya karṇau(rṇaṃ) pūrayet| tailasyeti sambandhamātre ṣaṣṭhī| mātuluṅgarasasya vā suktādiyuktasya pūrayet| śodhanena rūkṣatotpattau satyāṃ ghṛtamaṇḍasya pūraṇaṃ hitam|

ab.seg: kramo'yaṃ malapūrṇe'pi karṇekaṇḍvāṃ kaphāpaham| nasyādi, tadvacchophe'pi kaṭūṣṇaiścātra lepanam||34||

div.ab: Sa. karṇe malena pūrṇe'pyayaṃ-pratīnāhoktaḥ, kramaḥ kāryaḥ| kaṇḍvāṃ tathā kaphaghnaṃ nasyādi| śophe'pi tathaivāyaṃ kramaḥ| kaṭūṣṇaiśca lepanaṃ hitam|

ab.seg: karṇasrāvoditaṃ kuryātpūtikṛmiṇakarṇayoḥ| pūraṇaṃ kaṭutailena viśeṣāt kṛmikarṇake||35||

div.ab: Sa. pūtikarṇe kṛmi[ṇa]karṇe ca karṇasrāvoktaṃ cikitsitaṃ kuryāt| kṛmiṇakarṇake viśeṣātkaṭutailena pūraṇaṃ hitam|

ab.seg: vamipūrvā hitā karṇavidradhau vidradhikriyā| pittotthakarṇaśūloktaṃ kartavyaṃ kṣatavidradhau||36||
arśorbudeṣu nāsāvad āmā karṇavidārikā| karṇavidradhivatsādhyā yathādoṣodayena ca||37||

div.ab: Sa. karṇavidradhau vamanapūrvā vidradhikriyā śastā| kṣatavidradhau pittotthakarṇaśūloktaṃ sarvaṃ kartavyam| arśorbudeṣu nāsāvat cikitsā| karṇavidārikā'pakvā karṇavidradhivat cikitsyā, yathādoṣodayena ca|
pālīśoṣe'nilaśrotraśūlavannasyalepanam| svedaṃ ca kuryāt svinnāṃ ca pālīmudvartayettilaiḥ||38|| priyālabījayaṣṭyāhvahayagandhāyavānvitaiḥ| ---------------------------------------------|39|
Sa. pālīśoṣe vātaśrotraśūla iva nasyādi svedaṃ ca kuryāt| pālīṃ ca svinnāṃ tilaiḥ priyālabījādiyuktairudvartayet|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| tataḥ puṣṭikaraiḥ snehairabhyaṅgaṃ nityamācaret||39||

div.ab: Sa. tataḥ snehaiḥ puṣṭikṛdbhirnityaṃ sā'bhyaktavyā|

ab.seg: śatāvarīvājigandhāpayasyairaṇḍajīvakaiḥ| tailaṃ vipakvaṃ sakṣīraṃ pālīnāṃ puṣṭikṛtparam||40||

div.ab: Sa. śatāvaryādibhistailaṃ sakṣīraṃ pakvaṃ pālīnāṃ paraṃ puṣṭikṛt|

ab.seg: kalkena jīvanīyena tailaṃ payasi pācitam| ānūpamāṃsakvāthe ca pālīpoṣaṇavardhanam||41||

div.ab: Sa. jīvantyādigaṇajena kalkena kṣīre ānūpamāṃsakvāthe ca tailaṃ pācitaṃ pālipoṣaṇaṃ pālīvṛddhikṛcca|
pālīṃ chittvā'tisaṅkṣīṇāṃ śeṣāṃ sandhāya poṣayet| ---------------------------------------------|42|
Sa. pālīmatisaṅkṣīṇāṃ chittvā śeṣāṃ sandhāya vardhayet|
---------------------------------------------| yāpyaivaṃ tantrikākhyā'pi paripoṭe'pyayaṃ vidhiḥ||42|| utpāte śītalairlepo jalaukohṛtaśoṇite| ---------------------------------------------|43|
Sa. yāpyaivaṃ tantrikāsaṃjñā| paripoṭe'pyeṣa eva vidhiryāpyākhyaḥ| utpāte jalaukobhirapanītarakte śītalairlepaḥ|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| jambvāmrapallavabalāyaṣṭīrodhratilotpalaiḥ||43||
sadhānyāmlaiḥ samañjiṣṭhaiḥ sakadambaiḥ sasārivaiḥ| siddhamabhyañjane tailaṃ visarpoktaghṛtāni ca||44||

div.ab: Sa. jambvādibhiḥ siddhaṃ tailamabhyaṅge hitam| visarpoktaghṛtāni ca hitāni|

unmanthe'bhyañjanaṃ tailaṃ godhākarkavasānvitam| tālapatryaśvagandhārkabākucīphalasaindhavaiḥ||45|| surasālāṅgalībhyāṃ ca siddhaṃ, tīkṣṇaṃ ca nāvanam| ---------------------------------------------|46|
Sa. unmanthe tailaṃ godhākarkaṭavasāyuktaṃ tālaparṇyādibhiḥ siddhamabhyañjanaṃ hitam| tathā surasālāṅgalībhyāṃ ca tailaṃ siddhaṃ tīkṣṇaṃ nāvanaṃ hitam|

---------------------------------------------| durviddhe'śmantajambvāmrapatrakvāthena secitām||46|| tailena pālīṃ svabhyaktāṃ suślakṣṇairavacūrṇayet| cūrṇairmadhukamañjiṣṭhāprapuṇḍrāhvaniśodbhavaiḥ||47|| lākṣāviḍaṅgasiddhaṃ ca tailamabhyañjane hitam| ---------------------------------------------|48|
Sa. durviddhe'śmantakādikvāthena secitāṃ pālīṃ tailena svabhyaktāṃ madhukādibhiḥ sūkṣmarajīkṛtairavacūrṇayet| lākṣāviḍaṅgasiddhaṃ tailamabhyañjane hitam|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| svinnāṃ gomayajaiḥ piṇḍairbahuśaḥ parilehikām||48||
viḍaṅgasārairālimpedurabhrīmūtrakalkitaiḥ| kauṭajeṅgudakārañjabījaśamyākavalkalaiḥ||49||
athavā'bhyañjanaṃ tairvā kaṭutailaṃ vipācayet| sanimbapatramaricamadanairlehikāvraṇe||50||

div.ab: Sa. parilehikāṃ gomayajaiḥ piṇḍairbahuśaḥ svinnāṃ viḍaṅgasārairurabhrīmūtrakalkitairālimpet| kauṭajādibījādibhirvā'vimūtreṇa kalkitairālimpet| athavā taireva-kauṭajādibhiḥ, kaṭutailaṃ nimbādibhiḥ saha vipācayet lehikāvraṇe|

ab.seg: chinnaṃ tu karṇaṃ śuddhasya bandhamālocya yaugikam| śuddhāsraṃ lāgayellagne sadyaśchinne viśodhanam||51||

div.ab: Sa. karṇaṃ tu chinnaṃ śuddharaktaṃ śuddhasya yaugikaṃ bandhamālocya lāgayet| lagne karṇe sadyaśchinne viśodhanaṃ-virekādi|

ab.seg: atha karṇarogavidhānamāha ---- atha grathitvā keśāntaṃ kṛtvā chedanalekhanam| niveśya sandhiṃ suṣamaṃ na nimnaṃ na samunnatam||52||
abhyajya madhusarpirbhyāṃ picuplotāvaguṇṭhitam| sūtreṇāgāḍhaśithilaṃ baddhvā cūrṇairavākiret||53||
śoṇitasthāpanairvraṇyamācāraṃ cādiśettataḥ| saptāhādāmatailāktaṃ śanairapanayet picum||54||

div.ab: Sa. keśāntaṃ grathitvā chedanaṃ lekhanaṃ ca kṛtvā sandhiṃ suṣamaṃ niveśya na nimnaṃ na connatam, suṣamamiti "suṣāmādiṣu ca" iti ṣatvam, abhyajya madhusarpirbhyāṃ picuplotāvaguṇṭhitaṃ sūtreṇa na gāḍhaṃ na ca śithilaṃ badhvā śoṇitasthāpanaiḥ-madhukagairikādibhiḥ, avacūrṇayet| tato vraṇahitamācāramācaret| saptāhādūrdhvamāmatailenāktaṃ śanaiḥ picumapanayet| suśrute(?) (saṅgrahe) tūktam (saṃ. u. a. 22)- "na karṇe śopharāgādiyukte sandhānamiṣyate| na ghasmarasya nātyuṣṇe nāviśuddhatanorapi||" iti|

ab.seg: surūḍhaṃ jātaromāṇaṃ śliṣṭasandhiṃ samaṃ sthiram| suvarṣmāṇamarogaṃ ca śanaiḥ karṇaṃ vivardhayet||55||

div.ab: Sa. surūḍhādiguṇaṃ ca karṇaṃ śanairvivardhayet|

varṣmarūpamucyate(?) ---- jalaśūkaḥ svayaṅguptā rajanyau bṛhatīphalam| aśvagandhābalāhastipippalīgaurasarṣapāḥ||56|| mūlaṃ kośātakāśvaghnarūpikāsaptaparṇajam| chucchundarī kālamṛtā gṛhaṃ madhukarīkṛtam||57|| jatūkā jalajanmā ca tathā śabarakandakam| ebhiḥ kalkaiḥ kharaṃ pakvaṃ satailaṃ māhiṣaṃ ghṛtam||58|| hastyaśvamūtreṇa paramabhyaṅgātkarṇavardhanam| ---------------------------------------------|59|

Sa. jalaśūkādibhirgajāśvayormūtraiḥ piṣṭaiḥ satailaṃ māhiṣaṃ ghṛtaṃ kharapākaṃ pakvamabhyaṅgāt karṇavardhanam| jalaśūkaḥ-śevālam| rūpikā-arkaḥ| chucchundarī-mūṣikābhedaḥ| sā ca kālena mṛtā, na tu vyāpāditā| jatūkā-carmacaṭikā| jalajanmā-jalaukā| śabarakandako-laśunaḥ|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| atha kuryādvayasthasya chinnāṃ śuddhasya nāsikām||59||
chindyānnāsāsamaṃ patraṃ tattulyaṃ ca kapolataḥ| tvaṅmāṃsaṃ nāsikāsanne rakṣaṃstattanutāṃ nayet||60||
sīvyed gaṇḍaṃ tataḥ sūcyā sevinyā picuyuktayā| nāsācchede'tha likhite parīvartyopari tvacam||61||
kapolavadhraṃ sandadhyātsīvyennāsāṃ ca yatnataḥ| nāḍībhyāmutkṣipedantaḥ sukhocchvāsapravṛttaye||62||
āmatailena siktvāν pattaṅgamadhukāñjanaiḥ| śoṇitasthāpanaiścānyaiḥ suślakṣṇairavacūrṇayet||63||
tato madhughṛtābhyaktaṃ badhvā''cārikamādiśet| jñātvā'vasthāntaraṃ kuryāt sadyovraṇavidhiṃ tataḥ||64||
chindyādrūḍhe'dhikaṃ māṃsaṃ nāsopāntācca carma tat| sīvyettataśca suślakṣṇaṃ hīnaṃ saṃvardhayetpunaḥ||65||

div.ab: Sa. atheti maṅgale| kṛtamaṅgalasya vayasthasya-taruṇasya, śuddhasya nāsikāṃ chinnāṃ kuryāt| katham ? ityāha-nāsātulyaṃ patraṃ chindyāt| tena-patreṇa, tulyaṃ kapolācchindyāt| nāsikātulye deśe tvacaṃ māṃsaṃ ca rakṣan tat-patraṃ, tanutāṃ nayet| anantaraṃ sūcyā sevinyā picuyuktayā gaṇḍaṃ sīvyet| atha nāsāchede likhite tattvacamuparivartya kapolavadhraṃ sandadhyāt| nāsāṃ ca yatnena sīvyet| antaḥ-madhye, nāsikāṃ nāḍībhyāmutkṣipet sukhocchvāsapravartanāya| tata āmatailena siktvā pattaṅgamadhukāñjanairavacūrṇayet| anyairapi-sirāvyadhavidhyuktaiḥ śoṇitasthāpanaiḥ (hṛ. sū. a. 27|48) , suślakṣṇaiścūrṇairavacūrṇayet| anantaraṃ mākṣikaghṛtābhyāmabhyaktaṃ badhvā, ācārikaṃ-snehavidhyuktaṃ, ādiśet| avasthāntaraṃ ca jñātvā sadyovraṇapratiṣedhavidhiṃ kuryāt| tato rūḍhe satyadhikaṃ māṃsaṃ tacca nāsāsamīpādadhikaṃ carma chindyāt| anantaraṃ sīvyet| tataḥ suślakṣṇaṃ ca kṛtvā punaḥ sīvyet| hīnaṃ ca vardhayet|

niveśite yathānyāsaṃ sadyaścchinne'pyayaṃ vidhiḥ| nāḍīyogādvinauṣṭhasya nāsāsandhānavadvidhiḥ|66| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne karṇarogapratiṣedho nāmāṣṭādaśo'dhyāyaḥ|18|

Sa. sadyaśchinne'pi ghrāṇe yathānyāsaṃ niveśite satyayameva vidhiḥ| nāḍīyogamantareṇauṣṭhasyāpi chinnasya nāsāsandhānatulyo vidhiriti| iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayaṭīkāyāṃ sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne karṇarogapratiṣedho nāmāṣṭādaśo'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 18||

div.head: nāsārogavijñānīyādhyāyaḥ
div.ab: atha kramaprāptaṃ nāsārogavijñānaṃ bibhaṇiṣurāha ---- athāto nāsārogavijñānīyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre||2|| )avaśyāyānilarajobhāṣyātisvapnajāgaraiḥ| nīcātyuccopadhānena pītenānyena vāriṇā||1|| atyambupānaramaṇacchardibāṣpagrahādibhiḥ| kruddhā vātolbaṇā doṣā nāsāyāṃ styānatāṃ gatāḥ||2|| janayanti pratiśyāyaṃ vardhamānaṃ kṣayapradam| ---------------------------------------------|3|
Sa. avaśyāyādibhirvātolbaṇā doṣāḥ kruddhā nāsāyāṃ styānatāṃ-ghanatvaṃ prāptāḥ, pratiśyāyaṃ janayanti| kimbhūtam ? vivardhamānaṃ kṣayapradam|

---------------------------------------------| tatra vātātpratiśyāye mukhaśoṣo bhṛśaṃ kṣavaḥ||3|| ghrāṇoparodhanistodadantaśaṅkhaśirovyathāḥ| kīṭikā iva sarpantīrmanyate parito bhruvau||4|| svarasādaścirātpākaḥ śiśirācchakaphasrutiḥ| ---------------------------------------------|5|

Sa. [tatra-] teṣu rogeṣu vātapittakaphādyuttheṣu madhye, vātāt pratiśyāye sati mukhaśoṣādayaḥ syuḥ| bhruvau paritaḥ kīṭikāḥ sarpantīriva manyate| bhṛvau parita iti "abhitaḥ paritaḥ" iti dvitīyā| svarasādādayaśca syuḥ|
---------------------------------------------| pittāttṛṣṇājvaraghrāṇapiṭikāsambhavabhramāḥ||5|| nāsāgrapāko rūkṣoṣṇatāmrapītakaphasrutiḥ| ---------------------------------------------|6|
Sa. pittāt pratiśyāye sati tṛṣṇādayo bhavanti| ghrāṇamadhye piṭikā ghrāṇapiṭikāḥ, tāsāṃ sambhavaḥ| nāsāyā agre pāko nāsāgrapākaḥ|
---------------------------------------------| kaphātkāso'ruciḥ śvāso vamathurgātragauravam||6|| mādhuryaṃ vadane kaṇḍūḥ snigdhaśuklakaphasrutiḥ| ---------------------------------------------|7|
Sa. kaphāt pratiśyāye sati kāsādayaḥ syuḥ|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| sarvajo lakṣaṇaiḥ sarvairakasmādvṛddhiśāntimān||7||

div.ab: Sa. tridoṣajaḥ pratiśyāyaḥ sarvadoṣalakṣaṇairyutaḥ| akasmāt-nimittaṃ vinā, vṛddhimāṃśchāntimāṃśca|
duṣṭaṃ nāsāsirāḥ prāpya pratiśyāyaṃ karotyasṛk| urasaḥ suptatā tāmranetratvaṃ śvāsapūtitā||8|| kaṇḍūḥ śrotrākṣināsāsu pittoktaṃ cātra lakṣaṇam| ---------------------------------------------|9|
Sa. raktaṃ duṣṭaṃ nāsāsirāḥ prāptaṃ pratiśyāyaṃ karoti| tasminnurasaḥ suptatva tāmranayanatvādikaṃ pittābhihitaṃ ca lakṣaṇaṃ syāt|

ab.seg: atha duṣṭapratiśyāyalakṣaṇamāha ---- ---------------------------------------------| sarva eva pratiśyāyā duṣṭatāṃ yāntyupekṣitāḥ||9||
yathoktopadravādhikyātsa sarvendriyatāpanaḥ| sāgnisādajvaraśvāsakāsoraḥpārśvavedanaḥ||10||
kupyatyakasmādbahuśo mukhadaurgandhyaśophakṛt| nāsikākledasaṃśoṣaśuddhirodhakaro muhuḥ||11||
pūyopamāsitāraktagrathitaśleṣmasaṃsrutiḥ| mūrcchanti cātra kṛmayo dīrghasnigdhasitāṇavaḥ||12||
pakvaliṅgāni teṣvaṅgalāghavaṃ kṣavathoḥ śamaḥ| śleṣmā sacikkaṇaḥ pīto'jñānaṃ ca rasagandhayoḥ||13||

div.ab: Sa. sarva eva pratiśyāyā upekṣitā duṣṭatvaṃ yānti| sa tu-duṣṭapīnaso, yathoktopadravāṇāṃ-mukhaśoṣādīnāṃ, ādhikyāddhetoḥ sarvendriyatāpano-nāsācakṣurādīnāṃ khedakaḥ, agnisādādiyutaśca syāt| tathā sahasaiva punaḥ punaḥ kupyati| mukhadaurgandhyādikaraḥ, tathā nāsikākledādikaro muhuḥ pūyasadṛśakṛṣṇaraktapiṇḍitaśleṣmasrutiḥ| atra ca kṛmayo mūrcchanti dīrghāḥ snigdhāḥ śvetāḥ susūkṣmāśca| teṣu-pratiśyāyeṣu, pakvalakṣaṇāni| tadyathā,-aṅgasya-śarīrasya lāghavaṃ syāt, kṣuteśca śamaḥ, kaphaḥ sacikkaṇaḥ pīto, rasagandhayoścājñānamiti| bhṛśakṣavākhyaṃ lakṣayitumāha-

ab.seg: tīkṣṇāghrāṇopayogārkaraśmisūtratṛṇādibhiḥ| vātakopibhiranyairvā nāsikātaruṇāsthani||14||
vighaṭṭite'nilaḥ kruddho ruddhaḥ śṛṅgāṭakaṃ vrajet| nivṛttaḥ kurute'tyarthaṃ kṣavathuṃ sa bhṛśakṣavaḥ||15||

div.ab: Sa. tīkṣṇasya-marīcādeḥ, ghrāṇāt-siṃhanāt, tathā raviraśmyādibhirvātakopibhiranyairvā nāsātaruṇāsthani vighaṭṭite sati vāyuḥ kṛddho ruddhaḥ śṛṅgāṭakaṃ gacchet| sa nivṛttaḥ san atyantaṃ chikkāṃ kurute| sa bhṛśakṣava ucyate|
śoṣayannāsikāsrotaḥ kaphaṃ ca kurute'nilaḥ| śūkapūrṇābhanāsātvaṃ kṛcchrāducchvasanaṃ tataḥ||16|| smṛto'sau nāsikāśoṣo-----------------------| ---------------------------------------------|17|
Sa. śoṣayannāsikāsrotaḥ kaphaṃ ca vāyuḥ śūkapūrṇābhanāsātvaṃ kurute| tataḥ kṛcchrāducchvasanaṃ syāt| asau nāsikāśoṣaḥ smṛtaḥ|
---------------------------nāsānāhe tu jāyate| naddhatvamiva nāsāyāḥ śleṣmaruddhena vāyunā||17|| niḥśvāsocchvāsasaṃrodhāt srotasī saṃvṛte iva| ---------------------------------------------|18|
Sa. nāsānāhākhye roge jāte sati ghrāṇasya naddhatvaṃ-āpūramiva, jāyate| śleṣmaṇā ruddhena vātena niḥśvāsocchāsasaṃrodhāt srotasī saṃvṛte iva syātām|
Sa. pittaṃ kartṛ nāsāpuṭe tvaṅmāṃsaṃ sadāhaśūlaṃ pacet sa ghrāṇapākākhyaḥ|

ab.seg: --------srāvastu tatsaṃjñaḥ śleṣmasambhavaḥ| accho jalopamo'jasraṃ viśeṣānniśi jāyate||19||

div.ab: Sa. srāvastu tatsaṃjño-ghrāṇasrāvākhyaḥ| sa ca kaphādeva kevalādbhavati| accho jalasadṛśo nityaṃ srāvo jāyate, viśeṣeṇa rātrau|

ab.seg: kaphaḥ pravṛddho nāsāyāṃ ruddhvā srotāṃsyapīnasam| kuryātsaghurghuraśwāsaṃ pīnasādhikavedanam||20||
averiva sravatyasya praklinnā tena nāsikā| ajasraṃ picchilaṃ pītaṃ pakwaṃ siṅghāṇakaṃ ghanam||21||

div.ab: Sa. kapho nāsāyāṃ pravṛddho ruddhvā srotāṃsyapīnasaṃ ghurghuraśvāsayutaṃ pīnasādhikarujaṃ kuryāt| tena-apīnasena, asya rogiṇo meṣasyevānavarataṃ praklinnā nāsikā picchilādiyuktaṃ kaphaṃ siṅghāṇakaṃ sravati|

ab.seg: raktena nāsā dagdheva bāhyāntaḥ sparśanāsahā| bhaveddhūmopamocchvāsā sā dīptirdahatīva ca||22||

div.ab: Sa. raktena nāsā dagdheva bāhyato'ntarataśca sparśanaṃ na sahate| tathā dhūmopamocchvāsā dahatīva ca| sā dīptisaṃjñā rogajātiḥ|

ab.seg: tālumūle malairduṣṭairmāruto mukhanāsikāt| śleṣmā ca pūtirnirgacchet pūtināsaṃ vadanti tam||23||

div.ab: Sa. tālumūle doṣairduṣṭairmukhanāsikād vāyuḥ kaphaśca pūtirnirgacchet, taṃ pūtināsaṃ vadanti|

ab.seg: nicayādabhighātādvā pūyāsṛṅnāsikā sravet| tatpūyar aktamākhyātaṃ śirodāharujākaram||24||

div.ab: Sa. sannipātādabhighātādvā nāsā pūyāsṛk sravet| tatpūyaraktas aṃjñaṃ śirodāharujākaramākhyātam|

ab.seg: pittaśleṣmāvaruddho'ntarnāsāyāṃ śoṣayenmarut| kaphaṃ sa śuṣkaḥ puṭatāṃ prāpnoti puṭakaṃ tu tat||25||

div.ab: Sa. pittaśleṣmāvaruddho vāyurantarnāsāyāṃ śoṣayetkapham| sa ca-kaphaḥ, śuṣka(:) puṭatāṃ prāpnoti| puṭakaṃ taducyate|
arśorbudāni vibhajeddoṣaliṅgairyathāyatham| sarveṣu kṛcchrocchvasanaṃ pīnasaḥ pratataṃ kṣutiḥ||26|| sānunāsikavāditvaṃ pūtināsaḥ śirovyathā| ---------------------------------------------|27|
Sa. arśāṃsyarbudāni ca doṣaliṅgairyathāsvaṃ jānīyat| sarveṣu-arśaḥsvarbudeṣu ca, kṛcchrāducchvasanam| tathā pīnaso'navarataṃ kṣavaḥ, tathā sānunāsikabhāṣitaṃ, tathā pūtināsaḥ śirovyatheti syuḥ|

---------------------------------------------| aṣṭādaśānāmityeṣāṃ yāpayedduṣṭapīnasam|27| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne nāsārogavijñānīyo nāmaikonaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ|19|

Sa. eṣāmaṣṭādaśānāṃ pīnasādīnāṃ madhye duṣṭapīnasaṃ yāpayediti| iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayaṭīkāyāṃ sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne nāsārogavijñānīyo nāmaikonaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 19||

div.head: nāsārogapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ
div.ab: adhunā nāsācikitsābhaṇanāvasara ityāha ---- athāto nāsārogapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre||2|| ) sarveṣu pīnaseṣvādau nivātāgārago bhajet| snehanasvedavamanadhūmagaṇḍūṣadhāraṇam||1|| vāso gurūṣṇaṃ śirasaḥ sughanaṃ pariveṣṭanam| laghvamlalavaṇaṃ snigdhamuṣṇaṃ bhojanamadravam||2|| dhanvamāṃsaguḍakṣīracaṇakatrikaṭūtkaṭam| yavagodhūmabhūyiṣṭhaṃ dadhidāḍimasārikam||3|| bālamūlakajo yūṣaḥ kulatthotthaśca pūjitaḥ| kavoṣṇaṃ daśamūlāmbu jīrṇāṃ vā vāruṇīṃ pibet||4|| jighreccorakatarkārīvacājājyupakuñcikāḥ| ----------------------------------------------|5|

Sa. pīnaseṣvakhileṣvapi nivātaveśmasthitaḥ san snehanasvedanavamanadhūmān gaṇḍūṣadhāraṇaṃ ca sevet| tathā vastraṃ gurūṣṇasvabhāvaṃ kauśeyāvikādibhirmūrdhnaḥ pariveṣṭanaṃ sughanaṃ bhajet| tathā bhojanaṃ laghvādiguṇaṃ bhajet| dāḍimaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ-dāḍimasāram| dadhidāḍimasādhitamiti kecit paṭhanti| bālamūlakottho yūṣaḥ kulatthajaśca yūṣaḥ pūjitaḥ| daśamūlāmbu koṣṇaṃ prasannāṃ vā jīrṇāṃ-purāṇāṃ, pibet| corakādīn jighret|

----------------------------------------------| vyoṣatālīsacavikātintiḍīkāmlavetasam||5|| sāgnyajāji dvipalikaṃ tvagelāpatrapādikam| jīrṇādguḍāttulārdhena pakvena vaṭakīkṛtam||6|| pīnasaśvāsakāsaghnaṃ rucisvarakaraṃ param| ----------------------------------------------|7|
Sa. vyoṣādikaṃ pṛthak dvipaladadhnaṃ, tvagādikaṃ dvikārṣikaṃ, purāṇaguḍena pañcāśatpalapramāṇena pakvena vaṭakīkṛtametat pīnasādihṛt paraṃ rucyādikṛt|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------| śatāhvātvag''balā mūlaṃ syonākairaṇḍabilvajam||7||
sāragvadhaṃ pibeddhūmaṃ vasājyamadanānvitam| athavā saghṛtān saktūn kṛtvā mallakasampuṭe||8||

div.ab: Sa. śatāhvādikaṃ vasādiyutaṃ dhūmaṃ pibet| mallakasampuṭe vā saktūn sasarpiṣkān kṛtvā dhūmaṃ pibet|
tyajetsnānaṃ śucaṃ krodhaṃ bhṛśaṃ śayyāṃ himaṃ jalam| ----------------------------------------------|9|
Sa. snānādīni tyajet|

ab.seg: iti sāmānyena cikitsāmabhidhāya viśeṣeṇāha ---- ----------------------------------------------| pibedvātapratiśyāye sarpirvātaghnasādhitam||9||
paṭupañcakasiddhaṃ vā vidāryādigaṇena vā| svedanasyādikāṃ kuryāt cikitsāmarditoditām||10||

div.ab: Sa. vātapratiśyāye vātaghnaiḥ-rāsnādibhiḥ, sādhitaṃ ghṛtaṃ pibet| saindhavādibhiḥ pañcabhirlavaṇairvā siddhaṃ, 'vidāripañcāṅgula' (hṛ. sū. a. 15|9) ityādinā vā siddhaṃ ghṛtaṃ pibet| tathā, arditoktāṃ cikitsāṃ svedādikāṃ kuryāt|

ab.seg: pittaraktotthayoḥ peyaṃ sarpirmadhurakaiḥ śṛtam| pariṣekān pradehāṃśca śītaiḥ kurvīta śītalān||11||
dhavatvak''triphalāśyāmāśrīparṇīyaṣṭitilvakaiḥ| kṣīre daśaguṇe tailaṃ nāvanaṃ saniśaiḥ pacet||12||

div.ab: Sa. pittotthe raktaje ca pratiśyāye madhuradravyaiḥ śṛtaṃ sarpiḥ pātavyam| pariṣekādīn śītavīryaiḥ śītalān kuryāt| dhavatvagādibhistailaṃ kṣīre daśaguṇe haridrānvitairnāvanaṃ pacet|

ab.seg: kaphaje laṅghanaṃ lepaḥ śiraso gaurasarṣapaiḥ| sakṣāraṃ vā ghṛtaṃ pītvā vamet, piṣṭaistu nāvanam||13||
bastāmbunā paṭuvyoṣavellavatsakajīrakaiḥ| kaṭutīkṣṇairghṛtairnasyaiḥ kavalaiḥ sarvajaṃ jayet||14||

div.ab: Sa. kaphaje laṅghanaṃ hitam| tathā śiraso gaurasarṣapairlepaḥ| ghṛtaṃ sayavakṣāraṃ pītvā vamet| chāgamūtreṇa ca piṣṭaiḥ saindhavādibhirnasyaṃ hitam| ghṛtaiḥ kaṭutīkṣṇairnasyaiḥ kavalaiśca sānnipātikaṃ pratiśyāyaṃ jayet|

ab.seg: yakṣmakṛmikramaṃ kurvan yāpayedduṣṭapīnasam| vyoṣorubūkakṛmijiddārumādrīgadeṅgudam||15||
vārtākabījaṃ trivṛtā siddhārthaḥ pūtimatsyakaḥ| agnimanthasya puṣpāṇi pīluśigruphalāni ca||16||
aśvaviḍ''rasamūtrābhyāṃ hastimūtreṇa caikataḥ| kṣaumagarbhāṃ kṛtāṃ vartiṃ dhūmaṃ ghrāṇāsyataḥ pibet||17||

div.ab: Sa. duṣṭapīnasaṃ yāpayet, yakṣmaharaṃ kṛmiharaṃ ca cikitsitaṃ kurvan| vyoṣādiśigruphalāntāni turagaviḍ''rasamūtrābhyāṃ hastimūtreṇa caikataḥ piṣṭāni kṣaumagarbhāṃ kṛtāṃ vartiṃ nāsayā mukhena ca pibet|
kṣavathau puṭakākhye ca tīkṣṇaiḥ pradhamanaṃ hitam| śuṇṭhīkuṣṭhakaṇāvelladrākṣākalkakaṣāyavat||18|| sādhitaṃ tailamājyaṃ vā nasyaṃ kṣavapuṭapraṇut| ----------------------------------------------|19|
Sa. kṣavathau puṭakākhye ca roge tīkṣṇaiḥ pradhamanaṃ hitam| śuṇṭhyādikalkakvāthavat tailaṃ ghṛtaṃ vā sādhitaṃ nasyaṃ kṣavaṃ puṭaṃ ca hanti|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------| nāsāśoṣe balātailaṃ pānādau bhojanaṃ rasaiḥ||19||
snigdho dhūmastathā svedo nāsānāhe'pyayaṃ vidhiḥ| pāke dīptau ca pittaghnaṃ tīkṣṇaṃ nasyādi saṃsrutau||20||

div.ab: Sa. nāsāśoṣe balātailaṃ pānanasyādau hitam| bhojanaṃ māṃsarasairhitam| tathā snigdho dhūmaḥ svedaśca hitaḥ| nāsānāhe'pyeṣa eva vidhiḥ-cikitsetyarthaḥ| nāsāpāke dīptau ca pittaghnaṃ cikitsitam| saṃsrutau-srāve, tīkṣṇaṃ nasyādi hitam|

kaphapīnasavatpūtināsāpīnasayoḥ kriyā| lākṣākarañjamaricavellahiṅgukaṇāguḍaiḥ||21|| avimūtradrutairnasyaṃ kārayedvamane kṛte| śigrusiṃhīnikumbhānāṃ bījaiḥ savyoṣasaindhavaiḥ||22|| savellasurasaistailaṃ nāvanaṃ paramaṃ hitam| ----------------------------------------------|23|
Sa. pūtināsāpīnasayoḥ kaphapīnasavadupakramaḥ| lākṣādibhirurabhramūtradrutaiḥ kṛte vamane nasyaṃ kārayet| śigrvādīnāṃ bījairvyoṣādiyutaistailaṃ pakvaṃ pūtināsāpīnasayornasyaṃ hitam|
Sa. pūyarakte navotthe raktapīnasa iva cikitsitaṃ kuryāt| atipravṛddhe cāsminnāḍīvraṇavadupakramaḥ|

---------------------dagdheṣvarśorbudeṣu ca| nikumbhakumbhasindhūtthamanohvālakaṇāgnikaiḥ|24| kalkitairghṛtamadhvaktāṃ ghrāṇe vartiṃ praveśayet| śigrvādi nāvanaṃ cātra pūtināsoditaṃ bhajet|25| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne nāsārogapratiṣedho nāma viṃśo'dhyāyaḥ|20|

Sa. arśorbudeṣu ca dagdheṣu nikumbhādibhiḥ kalkitairghṛtamadhvaktāṃ ghrāṇe vartiṃ praveśayet| śigrvādikaṃ ca nasyaṃ pūtināsoktaṃ bhajediti| iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayaṭīkāyāṃ sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne nāsārogapratiṣedho nāma viṃśo'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 20||

div.head: mukharogavijñānīyādhyāyaḥ
div.ab: kramaprāptaṃ mukharogavijñānamabhidhitsurāha ---- athato mukharogavijñānīyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre||2|| ) mātsyamāhiṣavārāhapiśitāmakamūlakam| māṣasūpadadhikṣīrasuktekṣurasaphāṇitam||1|| avākśayyāṃ ca bhajato dviṣato dantadhāvanam| dhūmarcchardanagaṇḍūṣānucitaṃ ca sirāvyadham||2|| kṛddhāḥ śleṣmolbaṇā doṣāḥ kurvantyantarmukhaṃ gadān| ---------------------------------------------------|3|
Sa. mātsyamāhiṣavārāhapiśitādi bhajato dantadhāvanaṃ dviṣataḥ-asevamānasya, dhūmādikaṃ cocitaṃ dviṣataḥ, sirāvyadhaṃ ca dviṣataḥ, śleṣmolbaṇā doṣāḥ kṛddhā mukhasyāntare gadān kurvanti|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------------| tatra khaṇḍauṣṭha ityukto vātenauṣṭho dvidhā kṛtaḥ||3||

div.ab: Sa. teṣu mukharogeṣu madhye pavanādoṣṭho dvidhā kṛtaḥ khaṇḍauṣṭha iti gaditaḥ|

ab.seg: oṣṭhakope tu pavanāt stabdhāvoṣṭhau mahārujau| dālyete paripāṭyete paruṣāsitakarkaśau||4||

div.ab: Sa. pavanādoṣṭhakope tvoṣṭhau stabdhau mahārujau dālyete tathā paripāṭyete iva| tathā paruṣau kṛṣṇau rūkṣau dṛśyete|
pittāttīkṣṇāsahau pītau sarṣapākṛtibhiścitau| piṭikābhirbahukledāvāśupākau--------------------|5|
Sa. pittenauṣṭhau tīkṣṇaṃ na sahete| pītau ca syātām| tathā ca sarṣapākṛtibhiḥ piṭikābhiścitau bahukledau śīghrapākau ca|
Sa. kaphena śītāsahau guru śūnau savarṇaiḥ piṭakairācitau syātām|
---------------------------------------------------| sannipātādanekābhau durgandhāsrāvapicchilau||6|| akasmānmlānasaṃśūnarujau viṣamapākinau| ---------------------------------------------------|7|
Sa. sannipātādoṣṭhau nānāvarṇapiṭakairācitau durgandhasrāvapicchilau sahasaiva mlānau kadācitsaṃśūnau viṣamapākinau vā|

---------------------------------------------------| raktopasṛṣṭau rudhiraṃ sravataḥ śoṇitaprabhau||7|| kharjūrasadṛśaṃ cātra kṣīṇe rakte'rbudaṃ bhavet| ---------------------------------------------------|8|
Sa. saṃ-raktena yuktau rudhiraṃ sravantau raktaprabhau ca| kṣīṇe rakte kharjūrākāramarbudamoṣṭhau syāt|

ab.seg: -------------------------------------------------| māṃsapiṇḍopamau māṃsātsyātāṃ mūrcchatkṛmī kramāt||8||

div.ab: Sa. māṃsena māṃsapiṇḍopamāvoṣṭhau| krameṇa ca mūrcchatkṛmī syātām| mūrcchanti kṛmayo yayoriti mūrcchatkṛmī| tayoḥ kṛmayo jāyanta ityarthaḥ|
tailābhaśvayathukledau sakaṇḍvau medasā mṛdū| kṣatajāvavatīryete pāṭyete cāsakṛtpunaḥ||9|| grathitau ca punaḥ syātāṃ kaṇḍūlau daśanacchadau| -------------------------------------------------|10|
Sa. medasā tailābhaḥ śophaḥ kledaśca yayostāvevam| tathā kaṇḍūyutau mṛdū cauṣṭhau syātām| kṣatajāvasakṛdavadīryete paripāṭyete-bhedyete iva, grathitau ca punaroṣṭhau syātāṃ sakaṇḍūkau ca|

ab.seg: -------------------------------------------------| jalabudbudavadvātakaphādoṣṭhe jalārbudam||10||

div.ab: Sa. vātakaphāt jalabudbudākāraṃ jalārbudamoṣṭhe syāt| ityekādaśa oṣṭhe|
gaṇḍālajī sthiraḥ śopho gaṇḍe dāhajvarānvitaḥ| -------------------------------------------------|11|
Sa. sthiraḥ śopho gaṇḍapradeśe dāhajvarayuto gaṇḍālajītyucyate| ityeko gaṇḍe|
-------------------------------------------------| vātāduṣṇasahā dantāḥ śītasparśe'dhikavyathāḥ||11|| dālyanta iva śūlena śītākhyo dālanaśca saḥ| -------------------------------------------------|12|
Sa. vātena dantā uṣṇasahāḥ śītasparśe'dhikavyathāḥ, śūlena dālyanta iva ca| asau śītadantasaṃjño dālanaścoktaḥ|

ab.seg: -------------------------------------------------| dantaharṣe pravātāmlaśītabhakṣākṣamā dvijāḥ||12||
bhavantyamlāśaneneva sarujāścalitā iva| dantabhede dvijāstodabhedaruksphuṭanānvitāḥ||13||

div.ab: Sa. dantaharṣe pracaṇḍavātasyāmlaśītabhakṣasyā (sya cā)- sahāḥ, dvijāḥ tathā'mlāśaneneva sarujāścilitā iva ca syuḥ| dantabhede dantāstodādiyutāḥ syuḥ|

ab.seg: cālaścaladbhirdaśanairbhakṣaṇādadhikavyathaiḥ| karālastu karālānāṃ daśanānāṃ samudgamaḥ||14||

div.ab: Sa. cālākhyo rogo dantaiśca caladbhirbhakṣaṇādadhikavyathaiśca syāt| karālānāṃ dantānāṃ samudgamaḥ karālākhyo rogaḥ|

ab.seg: danto'dhiko'dhidantākhyaḥ sa coktaḥ khalu vardhanaḥ| jāyamāne'tirug dante, jāte tatra tu śāmyati||15||

div.ab: Sa. adhiko danto'dhidantasaṃjño rogaḥ| vardhanaśca sa evoktaḥ| jāyamāne tasmin dante'tipīḍā jāyate| jāte tu tasmin pīḍā śāmyati|
adhāvanāmalo dante kapho vā vātaśoṣitaḥ| pūtigandhiḥ sthirībhūtaḥ śarkarā----------|16|
Sa. adhāvanāddante malaḥ kapho vā pavanena śoṣitaḥ pūtigandhiḥ sthirībhūtaḥ| sa evopekṣitaḥ śarkarā syāt|
Sa. kapālikākhyo dantāt kapālānyaṇuśaḥ-stokaṃ stokaṃ, śātayati|

ab.seg: -------------------------------------------------| śyāvaḥ śyāvatvamāyāto raktapittānilairdvijaḥ||17||

div.ab: Sa. dvijaḥ śyāvatvamāyāto raktapittānilaiḥ śyāvākhyaḥ|

samūlaṃ dantamāśritya doṣairulbaṇamārutaiḥ| śoṣite majjñi suṣire dante'nnamalapūrite||18|| pūtitvātkṛmayaḥ sūkṣmā jāyante, jāyate tataḥ| ahetutīvrārtiśamaḥ sasaṃrambho'sitaścalaḥ||19|| pralūnaḥ pūyaraktasrut sa coktaḥ kṛmidantakaḥ| -------------------------------------------------|20|

Sa. samūlaṃ dantamāśritya doṣairadhikamārutaiḥ śoṣite majjñi suṣire dante'nnamalapūrite pūtitvāt kṛmayaḥ sūkṣmā jāyante| tato'hetu-nimittamantareṇa, tīvrārtiśāntirjāyate| tathā saṃrambhānvitaḥ kṛṣṇaścalaḥ pralūnākhyaḥ pūyaraktasrāvī| sa ca kṛmidantaka uktaḥ| iti dante daśaite|
-------------------------------------------------| śleṣmaraktena pūtīni vahantyasramahetukam||20|| śīryante dantamāṃsāni mṛduklinnāsitāni ca| śītādo'sau---------------------------------|21|
Sa. śleṣmaraktena dantamāṃsāni pūtīni raktaṃ nirnimittaṃ vahanti śīryante| kimbhūtāni ? mṛduklinnāni asitāni ca| asau śītādaḥ kathyate|

-------------------------------------------------| ---------------upakuśaḥ pākaḥ pittāsṛgudbhavaḥ||21|| dantamāmsāni dahyante raktānyutsedhavantyataḥ| kaṇḍūmanti sravantyasramādhmāyante'sṛji sthite||22|| calā mandarujo dantā pūti vaktraṃ ca jāyate| -------------------------------------------------|23|

Sa. pittaraktottho yo dantamāṃse pākaḥ sa upakuśasaṃjñaḥ| tena dantamāṃsāni dahyante raktavarṇāni sotsedhāni ca| tataḥ kaṇḍūyutāni raktaṃ sravanti| rakte sthite satyādhmāyante| calā dantā mandarujaḥ syuḥ| pūti vaktraṃ ca jāyate|

-------------------------------------------------| dantayostriṣu vā śopho badarāsthinibho ghanaḥ||23|| kaphāsrāttīvraruk śīghraṃ pacyate dantapuppuṭaḥ| -------------------------------------------------|24|
Sa. dvayordantayostriṣu va danteṣu śopho badarāsthisadṛśo ghanaḥ kapharaktāt tīvraruk śīghraṃ pacyate| sa dantapuppuṭasaṃjñaḥ|

-------------------------------------------------| dantamāṃse malaiḥ sāsrairbāhyāntaḥ śvayathurguruḥ||24|| sarugdāhaḥ sravedbhinnaḥ pūyāsraṃ dantavidradhiḥ| -------------------------------------------------|25|
Sa. dantamāṃse bāhye'bhyantare ca doṣaiḥ saraktairguruḥ śvayathuḥ sarugdāhaḥ| sa ca bhinnaḥ san pūyāsraṃ sravet| sa dantāvidradhiḥ|
-------------------------------------------------| śvayathurdantamūleṣu rujāvān pittaraktajaḥ||25|| lālāsrāvī sa suṣiro dantamāṃsapraśātanaḥ| -------------------------------------------------|26|
Sa. saṃ-dantamūleṣu śvayathuḥ pīḍāvān pittaraktottho lālāsrāvī| suṣirasaṃjño dantamāṃsapraśātanaḥ
-------------------------------------------------| sa sannipātājjvaravān sapūyarudhirasrutiḥ||26|| mahāsuṣira ityukto viśīrṇadvijabandhanaḥ| -------------------------------------------------|27|
Sa. sannipātajvarayutaḥ pūyarudhirasrāvenānvitaḥ mahāsuṣirākhya uktaḥ| sa ca viśīrṇadvijabandhanaḥ syāt|

-------------------------------------------------| dantānte kīlavacchopho hanukarṇarujākaraḥ||27|| pratihantyabhyavahṛtiṃ śleṣmaṇā so'dhimāṃsakaḥ| -------------------------------------------------|28|
Sa. dantānte kīlasadṛśaḥ śopho hanau karṇe ca rujāṃ karoti| abhyavahṛtiṃ pratihanti| so'dhimāṃsakaḥ śleṣmaṇā syāt|

-------------------------------------------------| ghṛṣṭeṣu dantamāṃseṣu saṃrambho jāyate mahān||28|| yasmiṃścalanti dantāśca sa vidarbho'bhighātajaḥ| -------------------------------------------------|29|
Sa. dantamāṃseṣu dantakāṣṭhādinā ghṛṣṭeṣu mahān saṃrambho jāyate| yasminsati dantāśca calanti| so'bhighātajo vidarbhākhyaḥ|

-------------------------------------------------| dantamāṃsāśritān rogān yaḥ sādhyānapyupekṣate||29|| antastasyāsravan doṣaḥ sūkṣmāṃ sañjanayedgatim| pūyaṃ muhuḥ sā sravati tvaṅmāṃsāsthiprabhedinī||30|| tāḥ punaḥ pañca vijñeyā lakṣaṇaiḥ svairyathoditaiḥ| -------------------------------------------------|31|

Sa. dantamāṃsāśritān rogān sādhyānapi ya upekṣate, tasyāntareṣu doṣo'sravan sūkṣmāṃ gatiṃ sañjanayet| sā ca gatiḥ punaḥ punaḥ pūyaṃ sravati| tvaṅmāṃsāsthīni prabhinatti| tāśca gatayaḥ pañca vijñeyāḥ svaiḥ svairvātādijairlakṣaṇaiḥ| iti dantamūle trayodaśa|
-------------------------------------------------| śākhapatrakharā suptā sphuṭitā vātadūṣitā||31|| jihvā pittāt sadāhoṣā raktairmāsāṅkuraiścitā| -------------------------------------------------|32|
Sa. vātadūṣitā jihvā śākapatravat kharā suptā sphuṭitā ca syāt| pittāt sadāhoṣā tathā raktairmāṃsāṅkuraiśca citā jihvā syāt|

ab.seg: -------------------------------------------------| śālmalīkaṇṭakābhaistu kaphena bahalā guruḥ||32||

div.ab: Sa. kaphena śālmalīkaṇṭakābhaiḥ kaṇṭakaiścitā bahalā guruśca jihvā syāt|

ab.seg: kaphapittādadhaḥ śopho jihvāstambhakṛdunnataḥ| matsyagandhirbhavetpakvaḥ so'laso māṃsaśātanaḥ||33||

div.ab: Sa. kaphapittāt jihvāyā adhaḥ śopho jihvāstambhakara unnataḥ pakvo matsyagandhirbhavet| so'lasākhyomāṃsaśātanaḥ|

ab.seg: prabandhane'dho jihvāyāḥ śopho jihvāgrasannibhaḥ| sāṅkuraḥ kaphapittāsrairlāloṣāstambhavān kharaḥ||34||
adhijihvaḥ sarukkaṇḍūrvākyāhāravighātakṛt| tādṛgevopajihvastu jihvāyā upari sthitaḥ||35||

div.ab: Sa. jihvāyāḥ prabandhane'dhastājjihvāgratulyaḥ śophaḥ sahāṅkuraḥ kaphapittaraktairlāloṣāstambhayutaḥ kharasparśayuto'dhijihvorukkaṇḍūbhyāṃ yuto vākyāhāravighātaṃ karoti| tādṛgeva-adhijihvāsadṛśa upajihvaḥ, jihvāyā upari sthitaḥ| iti jihvāyāḥ ṣaḍete|

ab.seg: tālumāṃse'nilādduṣṭe piṭikāḥ sarujaḥ kharāḥ| bahyo ghanāḥ srāvayutāstāstālupiṭikāḥ smṛtāḥ||36||

div.ab: Sa. vātāttālumāṃse duṣṭe piṭikāḥ sarujaḥ kharā bahyo ghanāḥ srāvānvitāśca| tāstālupiṭikāḥ smṛtāḥ|
tālumūle kaphātsāsrāt matsyabastinibho mṛduḥ| pralambaḥ picchilaḥ śopho nāsayā''hāramīrayan||37|| kaṇṭhoparodhatṛṭkāsavamikṛt galaśuṇḍikā| -------------------------------------------------|38|
Sa. saṃ-tālumūle kaphādraktānvitāt matsyabastisadṛśo mṛduḥ pralambaḥ picchilaḥ śopho nāsayā''hāraṃ prerayan kaṇṭhoparodhādikṛt| gulaśuṇḍikākhyaḥ|

-------------------------------------------------| tālumadhye niruṅmāṃsaṃ saṃhataṃ tālusaṃhatiḥ||38|| padmākṛtistālumadhye raktācchvayathurarbudam| -------------------------------------------------|39|
Sa. tālumadhye niruṅmāṃsaṃ saṃhataṃ sā tālusaṃhatirityucyate| tālumadhye padmākāro raktādduṣṭācchvayathurarbudam|

-------------------------------------------------| kacchapaḥ kacchapākāraściravṛddhiḥ kaphādaruk||39|| kolābhaḥ śleṣmamedobhyāṃ puppuṭo nīrujaḥ sthiraḥ| -------------------------------------------------|40|

Sa. padārthacandrikā-kaphādduṣṭāt tāludeśe yaḥ śvayathuḥ kacchapākāraściravṛddhiraruk ca, sa kacchapa ityucyate| p cśleṣmamedobhyāṃ duṣṭābhyāṃ kolābhaḥ-kolasadṛśo, nīrujaḥ sthiraśca yaḥ śophaḥ syāt, sa puppuṭa ityucyate|

ab.seg: -------------------------------------------------| pittena pākaḥ pākākhyaḥ pūyāsrāvī mahārujaḥ||40||

div.ab: Sa. p cpittena duṣṭena yastālunaḥ pākaḥ pūyāsrāvī mahārujaḥ, sa pākākhyaḥ-pākasaṃjñaḥ|
vātapittajvarāyāsaistāluśoṣastadāhvayaḥ| -------------------------------------------------|41|
Sa. p cvātapittajvarāyāsaiḥ pratibaddho yaḥ śoṣastāluśoṣaḥ, sa tadāhvayaḥ-tāluśoṣa ityucyate| ityaṣṭau tālurogāḥ|

-------------------------------------------------| jihvāprabandhajāḥ kaṇṭhe dāruṇā mārgarodhinaḥ||41|| māṃsāṅkurāḥ śīghracayā rohiṇī śīghrakāriṇī| -------------------------------------------------|42|

Sa. p ckaṇṭhe-kaṇṭhapradeśe, ye māṃsāṅkurā jihvāprabandhajāḥ-jihvāmūlotthāḥ, dāruṇāḥ-duḥsahāḥ, kaṇṭhamārgānurodhinaḥ śīghracayāḥ-satvarodbhūtāḥ, bhavanti| sā śīghrakāriṇī-āśuvyāpādanaśīlā, rohiṇītyucyate|

ab.seg: -------------------------------------------------| kaṇṭhāsyaśoṣakṛdvātāt sā hanuśrotrarukkarī||42||

div.ab: Sa. p csā-rohiṇī, vātātsamutpannā kaṇṭhāsyaśoṣaṃ karoti| hanvoḥ śrotrayośca rujaṃ karoti|
pittājjvaroṣātṛṇmohakaṇṭhadhūmāyanānvitā| kṣiprajā kṣiprapākā'tirāgiṇī sparśanāsahā||43|| kaphena picchilā pāṇḍuḥ------------------------| -------------------------------------------------|44|
