Sa. p cpittād rohiṇī jvarādibhiranvitā syāt| kṣiprajā-śīghrotthānā| śīghrapākā atirāgiṇī-bhṛśalohitā| sparśanāsahā-sparśaṃ na sahate| paṃ caṃ-kaphena duṣṭena rohiṇī picchilā pāṇḍurā ca bhavet|

ab.seg: --------------------------asṛjā sphoṭakācitā| taptāṅgāranibhā karṇarukkarī pittajākṛtiḥ||44||

div.ab: Sa. p casṛjā-raktena duṣṭena, rohiṇī sphoṭakairācitā samantāt vyāptā syāt| taptāṅgāranibhā-varṇataḥ sparśato vā, karṇayo rujāṃ karoti| pittajākṛtiḥ-pittottharohiṇīlakṣaṇasamanvitā bhavet|
gambhīrapākā nicayāt sarvaliṅgasamanvitā| doṣaiḥ kapholbaṇaiḥ śophaḥ kolavad grathitonnataḥ||45|| śūkakaṇṭakavatkaṇṭhe śālūko mārgarodhanaḥ| -------------------------------------------------|46|

Sa. p cnicayāt-sannipātāt, rohiṇī gambhīrapākāgūḍhapākā, syāt| sarvaliṅgaiḥ-vātādīnāṃ sambandhibhiḥ, samanvitā-yuktā, syāt| p cdoṣaiḥ-vātādibhiḥ, kapholbaṇaiḥ-kaphapradhānaiḥ, kaṇṭhe kolavad grathitonnataḥ śūkakaṇṭakavat mārgarodhano yaḥ śophaḥ syāt, sa kaṇṭhaśālūka ityucyate|

ab.seg: -------------------------------------------------| vṛndo vṛttonnato dāhajvarakṛd galapārśvagaḥ||46||
hanusandhyāśritaḥ kaṇṭhe kārpāsīphalasannibhaḥ| picchilo mandaruk śophaḥ kaṭhināstuṇḍikerikā||47||

div.ab: Sa. p ckaṇṭhe vṛttonnato galapārśvago yaḥ śopho bhavati, dāhajvaraṃ karoti, sa nāmnā vṛnda ityucyate| p ckaṇṭhapradeśe śophaḥ kārpāsyāḥ phalasannibhaḥ-tadākāraḥ, picchilo mandaruk śophaḥ kaṭhinaśca| sa nāmnā tuṇḍikeriketyucyate|
bāhyāntaḥ śvayathurghoro galamārgārgalopamaḥ| galaugho mūrddhagurutātandrālālājvarapradaḥ||48|| valayaṃ nātiruk śophastadvadevāyatonnataḥ| -------------------------------------------------|49|

Sa. p ckaṇṭhe śvayathurbāhyāntarghoro-dustaro, galamārgārgalopamaḥ-sa iva, jāyate| mūrddhagurutādīṃśca pradadāti| sa galaugha ityucyate| p cgale yaḥ śopho nātiruk āyatonnataḥ syāt, sa vyādhirvalayamityucyate| tadvadeva-valayākṛtitvāt|

-------------------------------------------------| māṃsakīlo gale doṣaireko'neko'thavā'lparuk||49|| kṛcchrocchvāsābhyavahṛtiḥ pṛthumūlo gilāyukaḥ| bhūrimāṃsaṅkuravṛtā tīvratṛḍjvaramūrddharuk||50|| śataghnī nicitā vartiḥ śataghnīvātirukvarī| -------------------------------------------------|51|

Sa. p cdoṣaiḥ vātādibhirduṣṭaiḥ, gale māṃsakīla eko'neko vā'lparug jāto mūle pṛthuḥ-vistīrṇaḥ, kṛcchrāt-duḥkhena, ucchvāsābhyavahṛtirya(tī ya)sya saḥ| tathāvidho vyādhirgilāyuka ityucyate| p cbhūribhiḥ-prabhūtaiḥ, māṃsāṅkurairāvṛtā-parivṛtā, tīvratṛḍjvaramūrddharugyutā vṛttā yā vartiḥ sā śataghnī| nicayātsañcayaṃ prāptā śataghnīvaccātirukkarī| sa vyādhirnāmnā śataghnītyucyate| śataghnī-śastraviśeṣaḥ|

-------------------------------------------------| vyāptasarvagalaḥ śīghrajanmapāko mahārujaḥ||51|| pūtipūyanibhasrāvī śvayathurgalavidradhiḥ| jihvāvasāne kaṇṭhādāvapākaṃ śvayathuṃ malāḥ||52|| janayanti sthiraṃ raktaṃ nīrujaṃ tadgalārbudam| -------------------------------------------------|53|

Sa. p cvyāptaḥ sarvagalaḥ-kaṇṭho, yeneti| evaṃvidho yaḥ śvayathuḥ śīghrajanmapāko mahārujaḥ pūti-durgandhi, pūyasadṛśaṃ sravati malaṃ,sa galavidradhirityucyate| p cjihvāvasāne-paryante, kaṇṭhādau śvayathumapākaṃ sthiraṃ raktaṃ nīrujaṃ malāḥ-doṣāḥ, janayanti| tadgalārbudaṃ smṛtam|

ab.seg: pavanaśleṣmamedobhirgalagaṇḍo bhavedbahiḥ| vardhamānaḥ sa kālena muṣkavallambate'tiruk||53||
kṛṣṇo'ruṇo vā todāḍhyaḥ sa vātātkṛṣṇarājimān| vṛddhastālugale śoṣaṃ kuryācca virasāsyatām||54||

div.ab: Sa. p cduṣṭaiḥ pavanaśleṣmamedobhirgalasya bahirgalagaṇḍo nāma vyādhirbhavet| sa ca kālena vivardhamāno

ab.seg: sthiraḥ savarṇaḥ kaṇḍūmān śītasparśo guruḥ kaphāt| vṛddhastālugale lepaṃ kuryācca madhurāsyatām||55||

div.ab: Sa. p ckaphātprakupitāt gale galagaṇḍo jātaḥ sthiraḥ samānavarṇaḥ kaṇḍumān śītasparśo guruśca bhavet| vṛddhaḥ san tālugale lepaṃ kuryāt| tathā madhurāsyatāṃ-madhuravaktratvaṃ ca, kuryāt|

ab.seg: medasaḥ śleṣmavaddhānivṛddhyoḥ so'nuvidhīyate| dehaṃ vṛddhaśca kurute gale śabdaṃ svare'lpatām||56||

div.ab: Sa. p cmedasaḥ pravṛddhādutpanno galagaṇḍaḥ kaphavallakṣaṇairbhavet| sa ca dehaṃ-śarīraṃ, hānivṛddhyoranuvidhīyate-anukaroti| tena dehasya vṛddhau so'pi vṛddho bhavet, dehasya kṣayāt kṣīṇaḥ syāt| vṛddhaḥ sa gale śabdaṃ kurute svare cālpatām|

ab.seg: śleṣmaruddhā'nilagatiḥ śuṣkakaṇṭho hatasvaraḥ| tāmyan prasaktaṃ śvasiti yena sa svarahā'nilāt||57||

div.ab: Sa. p cśleṣmaṇā duṣṭena yadā'nilasya-vāyoḥ, gatiḥ ruddhā bhavet| tathā sa ca yena vyādhinā puruṣaḥ śuṣkakaṇṭho hatasvaraśca syāt| te(ye)na ca tāmyan-tamogacchan tamaḥpraviśan, prakarṣeṇa saktaṃ śvāsaṃ muñcati| sa vyādhiranilāt-vātāt, svarahāsvaraghnanāmnā, bhavet| iti galarogā aṣṭādaśa|

ab.seg: karoti vadanasyāntarvraṇān sarvasaro'nilaḥ| sañcāriṇo'ruṇān rūkṣānoṣṭhau tāmrau calatvacau||58||
jihvā śītāsahā gurvī sphuṭitā kaṇṭākācitā| vivṛṇoti ca kṛcchreṇa mukhaṃ pāko mukhasya saḥ||59||

div.ab: Sa. p canilo-vāyuḥ, sarvasaraḥ-sarvataḥ prasaran san, sarvato vadanasyāntarvraṇān sañcāriṇo'ruṇān rūkṣāṃśca karoti| tathauṣṭhau tāmrau-tāmravarṇau, calatvacau| jihvā ca śītāsahā śītasparśākṣamā, gurvī sphuṭitā kaṇṭakairācitā syāt| sa ca mukhaṃ-vaktraṃ, kṛcchreṇa vivṛṇoti| sa mukhasya pāka ityucyate|

ab.seg: adhaḥ pratihato vāyurarśogulmakaphādibhiḥ| yātyūrdhvaṃ vaktradaurgandhyaṃ kurvannūrdhvagudastu saḥ||60||

div.ab: Sa. p carśogulmakaphādibhirvāyuradhaḥ pratihato vaktradaurgandhyaṃ kurvannūrdhvaṃ yāti| sa ūrdhvaguda iti saṃjñitaḥ|

ab.seg: mukhasya pittaje pāke dāhoṣe tiktavaktratā| kṣārokṣitakṣatasamā vraṇāḥ tadvacca raktaje||61||

div.ab: Sa. p cpittaje-pittodbhave, mukhasya pāke dāhoṣe bhavataḥ| tathā tiktavaktratā-tiktāsyatvaṃ, bhavet| vraṇāśca kṣāreṇokṣitaṃ yat kṣataṃ-vraṇaḥ, tena samānāḥ-tatsamarujāḥ, bhavanti| paṃ caṃ-raktaje pāke mukhasyāntaḥ pittajapākavallakṣaṇāni bhavanti|

kaphaje madhurāsyatvaṃ kaṇḍūmatpicchilā vraṇāḥ| antaḥkapolamāśritya śyāvapāṇḍu kapho'rbudam||62|| kuryāttad ghaṭṭitaṃ chinnaṃ mṛditaṃ ca vivardhate| -------------------------------------------------|63|

Sa. p ckaphaje pāke madhurāsyatvaṃ-madhuramukhatvaṃ, syāt| tathā kaṇḍūmatpicchilāśca vraṇā bhavanti| p ckapho vṛddho'ntaḥkapolamāśrityārbudaṃ śyāvaṃ pāṇḍu ca kuryāt| taccārbudaṃ ghaṭṭitaṃ chinnaṃ mṛditaṃ ca punarvivardhate|

-------------------------------------------------| mukhapāko bhavetsāsraiḥ sarvaiḥ sarvākṛtirmalaiḥ||63|| pūtyāsyatā ca taireva dantakāṣṭhādividviṣaḥ| -------------------------------------------------|64|

Sa. p cmalaiḥ-vātādibhiḥ, sarvaiḥ-tribhiḥ, sāsraiḥ-saraktaiḥ, mukhasya pāko bhavet| sa ca sarvākṛtiḥ-sarvalakṣaṇaḥ, syāt| p cdantakāṣṭhavidviṣaḥ puṃsastaireva doṣaiḥ pūtyāsyatāpūtivaktratvaṃ, syāt| [iti sarvavaktragā aṣṭau|]

-------------------------------------------------| oṣṭe gaṇḍe dvije mūle jihvāyāṃ tāluke gale||64|| vaktre sarvatra cetyuktāḥ pañcasaptatirāmayāḥ| ekādaśaiko daśa ca trayodaśa tathā ca ṣaṭ||65|| aṣṭāvaṣṭādaśāṣṭau ca kramāt-----------------| -------------------------------------------------|66|
Sa. p coṣṭhāmayā ekādaśoktāḥ| gaṇḍe ekaḥ| dvijedante, daśa| dantamūle trayodaśa| jihvāyāṃ ṣaṭ| tālunyaṣṭau| gale'ṣṭadaśa| vaktre'ṣṭavāmayāḥ| evaṃ sarvatra pañcasaptatirāmayā ākhyātāḥ-uktāḥ|

----------------------------teṣvanupakramāḥ| karālo māṃsaraktauṣṭhāvarbudāni jalādvinā|66| kacchapastālupiṭikā galaughaḥ suṣiro mahān| svaraghnordhvagudaśyāvaśataghnīvalayālasāḥ|67| nāḍyoṣṭhakopau nicayāt, raktātsarvaiśca rohiṇī| daśane sphuṭite dantabhedaḥ, pakvopajihvikā|68| galagaṇḍaḥ svarabhraṃśī kṛcchrocchvāso'tivatsaraḥ| yāpyastu harṣo bhedaśca śeṣān śastrauṣadhairjayet|69| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭavira- citāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttara- sthāne mukharogavijñānīyo nāmai- kaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ|21|

Sa. p coṣṭhādyāmayeṣu madhye'nupakramāḥ-asādhyāḥ| karālo nāma dantarogaḥ| mahāsuṣiro dantarogaḥ| svaraghno galarogaḥ| ūrdhvagudo vaktrarogaḥ| śataghnīvalayau kaṇṭharogau| alaso'dhijihvārogaḥ| nicayāt-sannipātāt, nāḍī dantamūlajā| oṣṭhakopaḥ sannipātajo'sādhyaḥ| raktātsannipātāt [ca] jātā rohiṇī| dantabhedo daśane-dante, sphuṭite'sādhyaḥ| pakvopajihvikā'sādhyā| galagaṇḍaḥ svarabhraṃśaḥ(śī)kṛcchrocchvāso'tivatsaro'sādhyaḥ| p cdantaharṣo dantabhedaśca dvāvetau yāpyau| p cśeṣān rogān śastrauṣadhairjayet| yathāyogairvakṣyamāṇairiti| iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdaya- ṭīkāyāṃ sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne mukharoga- vijñānīyo nāmaikaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 21||

div.head: mukharogapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ
div.ab: athāto mukharogapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre|2| ) khaṇḍauṣṭhasya vilikhyāntau syūtvā vraṇavadācaret| -------------------------------------------------|1|
Sa. p ckhāṇḍauṣṭhasya-chinnauṣṭhasya snigdhasvinnasya, oṣṭhaprāntau vilikhya suṣliṣṭau kṣaumasūtreṇa syūtvā sadyovraṇavadupacāraṃ kuryāt,-śatadhautaghṛtābhyaktāṃ vraṇasyopari kavalikāṃ dadyāt|

ab.seg: -------------------------------------------------| yaṣṭijyotiṣmatīrodhraśrāvaṇīsārivotpalaiḥ||1||
paṭolyā kākamācyā ca tailamabhyañjanaṃ pacet| nasyaṃ ca tailaṃ vātaghnamadhuraskandhasādhitam||2||

div.ab: Sa. p cmadhuyaṣṭyādibhiḥ kalkitaistailamabhyañjanaṃ pacet| p cvātaharamadhurauṣadhasādhitaṃ tailaṃ nasyaṃ prayojyam|
mahāsnehena vātauṣṭhe siddhenāktaḥ picurhitaḥ| devadhūpamadhūcchiṣṭaguggulvamaradārubhiḥ||3|| yaṣṭyāhvacūrṇayuktena tenaiva pratisāraṇam| -------------------------------------------------|4|

Sa. p csarjarasasikthakagugguludevadārubhiḥ siddhena mahāsnehena-sarpirmajjavasātailākhyenāktaḥ, picurvātauṣṭhe-vātaja oṣṭhakope, hitaḥ| p ctenaiva-mahāsnehena, madhuyaṣṭīcūrṇayuktena vātauṣṭhe vā pratisāraṇaṃ hitam|

-------------------------------------------------| nāḍyoṣṭhaṃ svedayeddugdhasiddhaireraṇḍapallavaiḥ||4|| khaṇḍauṣṭhavihitaṃ nasyaṃ tasya mūrdhni ca tarpaṇam| -------------------------------------------------|5|
Sa. p c oṣṭhaṃ-vātauṣṭhaṃ, dugdhasiddhaireraṇḍapallavairnāḍyā svedayet| paṃ caṃ-khaṇḍauṣṭhavihitaṃ-khaṇḍauṣṭhoktaṃ, nasyaṃ prayojyam| tathā tasya mūrdhni tarpaṇaṃ-śirobhyaṅgaḥ, kāryaḥ|
-------------------------------------------------| pittābhighātajāvoṣṭhau jalaukobhirupācaret||5|| rodhrasarjarasakṣaudramadhukaiḥ pratisāraṇam| -------------------------------------------------|6|
Sa. p cpittajamabhighātajamo(jaṃ cau)ṣṭhakopaṃ jalaukobhirupācaret-cikitsettābhī raktaṃ srāvayet| p cpittotthe'bhighātaje cauṣṭhakope rodhrādibhiḥ pratisāraṇaṃ hitam|
-------------------------------------------------| guḍūcīyaṣṭipattaṅgasiddhamabhyañjane ghṛtam||6|| pittavidradhivaccātra kriyā śoṇitaje'pi ca| idameva nave kāryaṃ karma---------------------|7|

Sa. p cguḍūcyādibhiḥ kalkitairghṛtaṃ siddhamabhyañjane hitam| p catra-[e]tayoḥ pittābhighātajayoḥ, pittavidradhivat kriyā-cikitsā, kāryā| paṃ caṃ-śoṇitaje rakto(navo)tthe idameva-pittoktaṃ, karmakāryam|

ab.seg: pāṭhākṣāramadhuvyoṣairhṛtāsre pratisāraṇam| dhūmanāvanagaṇḍūṣāḥ prayojyāśca kaphacchidaḥ||8||

div.ab: Sa. kaphātura oṣṭhe hṛtāsre-hṛtarakte, pāṭhādibhiḥ pratisāraṇaṃ hitam| tathā dhūmādayaḥ kaphaghnā hitāḥ|

svinnaṃ bhinnaṃ vimedaskaṃ dahenmedojamagninā| priyaṅgurodhratriphalāmākṣikaiḥ pratisārayet||9|| sakṣaudrā gharṣaṇaṃ tīkṣṇā bhinnaśuddhe jalārbude| avagāḍhe'tivṛddhe vā kṣāro'gnirvā pratikriyā||10|| āmādyavasthāsvalajīṃ gaṇḍe śophavadācaret| -------------------------------------------------|11|

Sa. medojamoṣṭhaṃ svinnaṃ bhinnaṃ-vidāritaṃ, vigatamedasaṃ santamagninā dahet| priyaṅgvādibhiḥ pratisārayet| tīkṣṇāḥ-pippalīmaricādayaḥ, samākṣikā bhinnaśuddhe jalārbude gharṣaṇam| avagāḍhe'tivṛddhe jalārbude kṣāro'gnirathavā cikitsitam|

āmādyavasthāsvalajīṃ gaṇḍe śophavadācaret| svinnasya śītadantasya pālīṃ vilikhitāṃ dahet||11|| tailena, pratisāryā ca sakṣaudraghanasaindhavaiḥ| dāḍimatvagvarātārkṣyakāntājambvasthināgaraiḥ||12|| kavalaḥ kṣīriṇāṃ kvāthairaṇutailaṃ ca nāvanam| dantaharṣe tathā bhede sarvā vātaharā kriyā||13|| tilayaṣṭīmadhuśṛtaṃ kṣīraṃ gaṇḍūṣadhāraṇam| -------------------------------------------------|14|

Sa. āmādyavasthāsvalajīṃ gaṇḍe śophavadupakramet| śītadantasya svinnasya pālīṃ vilikhitāṃ tailena dahet| dāḍimatvagādibhiḥ kṣaudrādiyutaiḥ pratisāryā ca| kṣīriṇāṃ kvāthaiḥ kavalo hitaḥ| nasyamaṇutailaṃ hitam| dantabhede harṣe ca sarvā vātaghnī kriyā śastā| tilayaṣṭīmadhuśṛtaṃ kṣīraṃ gaṇḍūṣadhāraṇam|

ab.seg: -------------------------------------------------| sasnehaṃ daśamūlāmbu gaṇḍūṣaḥ pracaladvije||14||
tuttharodhrakaṇāśreṣṭhāpattaṅgapaṭugharṣaṇam| snigdhāḥ śīlyā yathāvasthaṃ nasyānnakavalādayaḥ||15||

div.ab: Sa. pracaladvije daśamūlāmbu sasnehaṃ gaṇḍūṣaḥ| tutthādibhirgharṣaṇam| snigdhā nasyādayo'vasthāvaśādabhyasanīyāḥ|
adhidantakamāliptaṃ yadā kṣāreṇa jarjaram| kṛmidantamivotpāṭya tadvaccopacarettadā||16|| anavasthitarakte ca dagdhe vraṇa iva kriyā| -------------------------------------------------|17|
Sa. adhidantakaṃ kṣāreṇāliptaṃ yadā jarjaraṃ syāt, tadā kṛmidantaṃ yathotpāṭya tathaivopakramet| anavasthitarakte ca dagdhevraṇa iva cikitsā kāryā|

ab.seg: -------------------------------------------------| ahiṃsan dantamūlāni dantebhyaḥ śarkarāṃ haret||17||
kṣāracūrṇairmadhuyutaistataśca pratisārayet| kapālikāyāmapyevaṃ harṣoktaṃ ca samācaret||18||

div.ab: Sa. dantebhyaḥ śarkarāṃ haret, dantamūlānyahiṃsan-apīḍayan rakṣan| tataḥ-anantaraṃ, śarkarāṃ vilikhya kṣāracūrṇairmadhuyutaiḥ pratisārayet| kapālikāyāmapyevaṃ-eṣa evopakramaḥ kāryaḥ| dantaharṣoktaṃ ca samācaret|

ab.seg: jayedvisrāvaṇaiḥ svinnamacalaṃ kṛmidantakam| snigdhaiścālepagaṇḍūṣanasyāhāraiścalāpahaiḥ||19||
guḍena pūrṇaṃ suṣiraṃ madhūcchiṣṭena vā dahet| saptacchadārkakṣīrābhyāṃ pūraṇaṃ kṛmiśūlajit||20||

div.ab: Sa. kṛmidanatakaṃ svinnamacalaṃ visrāvarṇairvisrāvayet(jayet)| tathā snigdhairvātaghnairālepādibhiḥ| guḍena pūrṇaṃ suṣiraṃ madanena dahedvā| saptaparṇārkakṣīrābhyāṃ pūraṇaṃ hitam| tat kṛmiśūlajit|

ab.seg: hiṅgukaṭphalakāsīsasvarjikākuṣṭhavellajam| rajo rujaṃ jayatyāśu vastrasthaṃ daśane dhṛtam||21||
gaṇḍūṣaṃ grāhayettailamebhireva ca sādhitam| kvāRthairvā yuktameraṇḍadvivyāghrībhūkadambajaiḥ||22||

div.ab: Sa. hiṅgvādikaṃ cūrṇaṃ vasanasthitaṃ dante dhṛtaṃ rujāhṛt| ebhireva-hiṅgvādibhiḥ, kvāthayuktaṃ siddhaṃ tailaṃ gaṇḍūṣaṃ rogiṇaṃ grāhayet| eraṇḍādijaiḥ kvāthairyuktaṃ tailaṃ gaṇḍūṣaṃ dhārayedvā|

ab.seg: kriyāyogairbahuvidhairityaśāntarujaṃ bhṛśam| dṛḍhamapyuddhareddantaṃ pūrvaṃ mūlādvimokṣitam||23||
sandaṃśakena laghunā dantanirghātanena vā| tailaṃ sayaṣṭyāhvarajo gaṇḍūṣo madhu vā tataḥ||24||

div.ab: Sa. iti-evamādibhiḥ, kriyāyogairbahuprakāraiḥ kṛtairapyupakramairaśāntapīḍaṃ dantaṃ sudṛḍhamapi pūrvaṃ mūlādvimokṣitaṃ laghunā sandaṃśakena dantanirghātanena yantreṇa voddharet| anantaraṃ tailaṃ madhuyaṣṭīcūrṇayutaṃ gaṇḍūṣaṃ dhārayet| mākṣikaṃ vā madhuyaṣṭīcūrṇayutam|

tato vidāriyaṣṭyāhvaśṛṅgāṭakakaserubhiḥ| tailaṃ daśaguṇakṣīraṃ siddhaṃ yuñjīta nāvanam||25|| kṛśadurbalavṛddhānāṃ vātārtānāṃ ca noddharet| noddhareccottaraṃ dantaṃ bahūpadravakṛddhi saḥ||26|| eṣāmapyuddhṛtau snigdhasvāduśītakramo hitaḥ| -------------------------------------------------|27|

Sa. tato vidāryādibhirdaśaguṇakṣīraṃ tailaṃ pakvaṃ nasyaṃ yuñjīta| kṛśādīnāṃ dantaṃ noddharet| uttaraṃ ca dantaṃ noddharet| yasmātsa uddhṛto bahūpadravakaraḥ| eṣāmapi dantairuddhṛtaiḥ(dantoddhṛtau) snigdhasvāduśītakramo hitaḥ|

ab.seg: -------------------------------------------------| visrāvitāsre śītāde sakṣaudraiḥ pratisāraṇam||27||
mustārjunatvaktriphalāphalinītāRrkṣyanāgaraiḥ| tatkvāthaḥ kavalo, nasyaṃ tailaṃ madhurasādhitam||28||

div.ab: Sa. visrāvitarakte śītāde mustādibhiḥ sakṣaudraiḥ pratisāraṇaṃ hitam| teṣāṃ-mustādīnāṃ, kvāthaḥ kavalaḥ| madhuraiḥ sādhitaṃ tailaṃ nasyam|

dantamāṃsānyupakuśe svinnānyuṣṇāmbudhāraṇaiḥ| maṇḍalāgreṇa śākādipatrairvā bahuśo likhet||29|| tataśca pratisāryāṇi ghṛtamaṇḍamadhudrutaiḥ| lākṣāpriyaṅgupattaṅgalavaṇottamagairikaiḥ||30|| sakuṣṭhaśuṇṭhīmaricayaṣṭīmadhurasāñjanaiḥ| sukhoṣṇo ghṛtamaṇḍo tailaṃ vā kavalagrahaḥ||31|| ghṛtaṃ ca madhuraiḥ siddhaṃ hitaṃ kavalanasyayoḥ| -------------------------------------------------|32|

Sa. upakuśe dantamāsāni svinnānyuṣṇāmbugaṇḍūṣadhāraṇena| tato maṇḍalāgreṇa śākādipatrairvā bahuśo likhet| tato lākṣādibhirghṛtamaṇḍamadhudrutaiḥ pratisāraṇīyāni| anantaraṃ sukhoṣṇo ghṛtamaṇḍastailaṃ vā kavalagrahaḥ| madhuraiśca pakvaṃ ghṛtaṃ kavalanasyayorhitam|

-------------------------------------------------| dantapuppuṭake svinnachinnabhinnavilekhite||32|| yaṣṭyāhvasvarjikāśuṇṭhīsaindhavaiḥ pratisāraṇam| -------------------------------------------------|33|
Sa. dantapuppuṭake svinnachinnabhinnavilikhite yaṣṭyādibhiḥ pratisāraṇam|

ab.seg: -------------------------------------------------| vidradhau kaṭutīkṣṇoṣṇarūkṣaiḥ kavalalepanam||33||
gharṣaṇaṃ kaṭukākuṣṭhavṛścikālīyavodbhavaiḥ| rakṣetpākaṃ himaiḥ pakvaḥ pāṭyo dāhyo'vagāḍhakaḥ||34||

div.ab: Sa. vidradhau kaṭvādibhiḥ kavalalepanaṃ hitam| kaṭukādibhirgharṣaṇaṃ hitam| himaiḥ-śītalaiḥ, pākaṃ rakṣet| pakvaḥ pāṭanīyaḥ| dāhyo'vagāḍhaḥ|

suṣire chinnalikhite sakṣaudraiḥ pratisāraṇam| rodhramustamiśiśreṣṭhātārkṣyapattaṅgakiṃśukaiḥ||35|| sakaṭphalaiḥ, kaṣāyaiśca teṣāṃ gaṇḍūṣa iṣyate| yaṣṭīrodhrotpalānantāsārivāgurucandanaiḥ||36|| sagairikasitāpuṇḍraiḥ siddhaṃ tailaṃ ca nāvanam| -------------------------------------------------|37|
Sa. sauṣire chinne likhite ca rodhrādibhirmādhvīkayutaiḥ pratisāraṇam| taireva kaṣāyairgaṇḍūṣaśca syāt| yaṣṭyādibhiḥ pakvaṃ tailaṃ nāvanam|

ab.seg: -------------------------------------------------| chittvā'dhimāṃsakaṃ cūrṇaiḥ sakṣaudraiḥ pratisārayet||37||
vacātejovatīpāṭhāsvarjikāyavaśūkajaiḥ| paṭolanimbatriphalākaṣāyaḥ kavalo hitaḥ||38||

div.ab: Sa. adhimāṃsakaṃ chittvā vacādijaiścūrṇaiḥ sakṣaudraiḥ pratisārayet| paṭolādikvāthaḥ kavalo hitaḥ|

ab.seg: vidarbhe dantamūlāni maṇḍalāgreṇa śodhayet| kṣāraṃ yuñjyāttato nasyaṃ gaṇḍūṣādi ca śītalam||39||

div.ab: Sa. vidarbhe dantamūlāni maṇḍalāgreṇa śodhayet| kṣāraṃ yuñjīta| tato nasyam| gaṇḍūṣādi ca śītalam|

saṃśodhyobhayataḥ kāyaṃ śiraścopacarettataḥ| nāḍīṃ dantānugāṃ dantaṃ samuddhṛtyāgninā dahet||40|| kubjāṃ naikagatiṃ pūrṇāṃ guḍena madanena vā| dhāvanaṃ jātimadanakhadirasvādukaṇṭakaiḥ||41|| kṣīrivṛkṣāmbugaṇḍūṣo, nasyaṃ tailaṃ ca tatkṛtam| -------------------------------------------------|42|

Sa. ubhayataḥ-ūrdhvamadhaśca, kāyaṃ mūrdhānaṃ ca, virekeṇa nasyādinā ca saṃśodhya tato nāḍīṃ dantānugāmupacaret| dantaṃ samuddhṛtyāgninā dahet| kubjāṃ naikagatiṃ pūrṇāṃ guḍena madanena samuddhṛtyāgninā dahet| kubjāṃ naikagatiṃ pūrṇāṃ guḍena madanena vā dahet| jātyādibhirdhāvanaṃ hitam| kṣīravṛkṣāmbugaṇḍūṣaḥ| tatpakvaṃ ca tailaṃ nasyam|

ab.seg: -------------------------------------------------| kuryādvātauṣṭhakopoktaṃ kaṇṭakeṣvanilātmasu||42||
jihvāyāṃ pittajāteṣu ghṛṣṭeṣu rudhire srute| pratisāraṇagaṇḍūṣanāvanaṃ madhurairhitam||43||
tīkṣṇaiḥ kaphottheṣvevaṃ ca sarṣapatryūṣaṇādibhiḥ| nave jihvālase'pyevaṃ, taṃ tu śastreṇa na spṛśet||44||

div.ab: Sa. jihvāyāṃ vātottheṣu kaṇṭakeṣu vātauṣṭhakopoktaṃ cikitsitaṃ kuryāt| jihvāyāṃ pittajāteṣu kaṇṭakeṣu ghṛṣṭeṣu rudhire srute pratisāraṇādi madhurairhitam| saṃ-kaphottheṣvapyevaṃ tīkṣṇaiḥ sarṣapādibhiḥ pratisāraṇādi hitam| nave ca jihvālase eṣa evopakramaḥ| kiṃ tu śastreṇainaṃ na spṛśet| etat yuktyā ca pūrveṣāṃ śastrasparśanaṃ kāryamityanujajñe|

ab.seg: unnamya jihvāmākṛṣṭāṃ baḍiśenādhijihvikām| chedayenmaṇḍalāgreṇa tīkṣṇoṣṇairgharṣaṇādi ca||45||

div.ab: Sa. adhijihvikāṃ baḍiśenākṛṣṭāṃ maṇḍalāgreṇa chedayet| kiṃ kṛtvā ? unnamya jihvām| tīkṣṇoṣṇairgharṣaṇādi ca kāryam|

ab.seg: upajihvāṃ parisrāvya yavakṣāreṇa gharṣayet| kaphaghnaiḥ śuṇḍikā sādhyā nasyagaṇḍūṣagharṣaṇaiḥ||46||

div.ab: Sa. upajihvāṃ śastreṇa parisrāvya yavakṣāreṇa gharṣayet| śuṇḍikā kaphaghnairnasyādibhiḥ sādhanīyā|

ab.seg: ervārubījapratimaṃ vṛddhāyāmasirātatam| agraṃ niviṣṭaṃ jihvāyā baḍiśādyavalambitam||47||
chedayenmaṇḍalāgreṇa nātyagre na ca mūlataḥ| chede'tyasṛkkṣayānmṛtyurhīne vyādhirvivarddhate||48||

div.ab: Sa. vṛddhayāṃ śuṇḍikāyāṃ satyāṃ jihvāyā agre(graṃ) niviṣṭaṃ kṛṣṇadīrghakarkaṭikābījasadṛśaṃ baḍiśādinā'valambitaṃ maṇḍalāgreṇa chedayet| katham ? nātiśayena prānte na cātiśayena mūle| yato'ticchede satyasṛkkṣayānmṛtyuḥ| hīnacchinne sati vyādhirvivarddhate|
maricātiviṣāpāṭhāvacākuṣṭhakuṭannaṭaiḥ| chinnāyāṃ sapaṭukṣaudrairgharṣaṇaṃ, kavalaḥ punaḥ||49|| kaṭukātiviṣāpāṭhānimbarāsnāvacāmbubhiḥ| -------------------------------------------------|50|
Sa. chinnāyāṃ maricādibhiḥ sasaindhavaiḥ kṣaudrairgharṣaṇam| kavalaḥ kaṭukādikvāthena|

ab.seg: -------------------------------------------------| saṅghāte puppuṭe kūrme vilikhyaivaṃ samācaret||50||

div.ab: Sa. [tālu]saṃhatau puppuṭake kacchape[ca] vilikhyaivaṃ-anena krameṇa, samācaret|

ab.seg: apakve tālupāke tu kāsīsakṣaudratārkṣyajaiḥ| gharṣaṇaṃ, kavalaḥ śītakaṣāyamadhurauṣadhaiḥ||51||

div.ab: Sa. apakve tu tālupāke kāsīsādibhirgharṣaṇam| śītakaṣāyamadhurauṣadhaiḥ kavalaḥ|

ab.seg: pakve'ṣṭāpadavadbhinne tīkṣṇoṣṇaiḥ pratisāraṇam| vṛṣanimbapaṭolādyaistiktaiḥ kavaladhāraṇam||52||

div.ab: Sa. pakve'ṣṭāpadavadbhinne sati tīkṣṇoṣṇaiḥ pratisāraṇaṃ kāryam| aṣṭāpadaṃ-caturaṅgapīṭham| vṛṣādibhistiktadravyaiḥ kavaladhāraṇam|
tāluśoṣe tvatṛṣṇasya sarpiruttarabhaktikam| kaṇāśuṇṭhīśṛtaṃ pānamamlairgaṇḍūṣadhāraṇam||53|| dhanvamāṃsarasāḥ snigdhāḥ, kṣīrasarpiśca nāvanam| -------------------------------------------------|54|

Sa. tāluśoṣe tvatṛṣṇasya sataḥ sarpiruttarabhaktikaṃ yojyam| pippalīśuṇṭhībhyāṃ śṛtaṃ jalapānam| amlaiḥ-kāñjikādibhiḥ, gaṇḍūṣadhāraṇam| dhanvamāṃsarasāḥ snigdhāḥ| tathākṣīrasya sarpiśca nāvanaṃ hitam|

ab.seg: kaṇṭharogeṣvasṛṅmokṣastīkṣṇairnasyādi karma ca||54||
kvāthaḥ pānaṃ ca dārvītvaṅnimbatārkṣyakaliṅgajaḥ| harītakīkaṣāyo vā peyo mākṣikasaṃyutaḥ| -------------------------------------------------||55||

div.ab: Sa. kaṇṭharogeṣu sarveṣu sirādibhī raktamokṣaḥ| tīkṣṇairdravyairnasyagaṇḍūṣādi ca| dāRvītvagādīnāṃ kvāthaḥ pātavyaḥ| harītakyā vā kvāthaḥ samākṣikaḥ peyaḥ|
śreṣṭhāvyoṣayavakṣāradārvīdvīpirasāñjanaiḥ| sapāṭhātejinīnimbaiḥ suktagomūtrasādhitaiḥ|56| kavalo, guṭikā vā'tra kalpitā pratisāraṇam| -------------------------------------------------|57|
Sa. śreṣṭhādibhiḥ suktagomūtrasādhitaiḥ kavalaḥ| guṭikā vā'tra-asmin kvāthe, parikalpitā pratisāraṇam|

ab.seg: śreṣṭhāvyoṣayavakṣāradārvīdvīpirasāñjanaiḥ| sapāṭhātejinīnimbaiḥ suktagomūtrasādhitaiḥ||56||

div.ab: Sa. śreṣṭhādibhiḥ suktagomūtrasādhitaiḥ kavalaḥ| guṭikā vā'tra-asmin kvāthe, parikalpitā pratisāraṇam|

ab.seg: athāntarbāhyataḥ svinnāṃ vātarohiṇikāṃ likhet||58||
aṅgulīśastrakeṇāśu paṭuyuktanakhena vā| pañcamūlāmbu kavalastailaṃ gaṇḍūṣanāvanam||59||

div.ab: Sa. atheti maṅgale| maṅgalapurvakaṃ vātajāṃ rohiṇikāmantarbāhyataśca svinnāmaṅguliśastrakeṇāthavā paṭuyuktena nakhena śīghrameva likhet| pañcamūlakvāthaḥ kavalaḥ| tailaṃ gaṇḍūṣo nasyaṃ ca|

visrāvya pittasambhūtāṃ sitākṣaudrapriyaṅgubhiḥ| gharṣetsarodhrapattaṅgaiḥ kavalaḥ kvathitaiśca taiḥ||60|| drākṣāparūṣakakvātho hitaśca kavalagrahe| -------------------------------------------------|61|
Sa. pittajāṃ rohiṇīṃ visrāvya-raktaṃ nirhṛtya, sitādibhirgharṣayet| taiśca-sitādibhiḥ, kvathitaiḥ sarodhrādibhiḥ kavalaḥ| drākṣāparūṣakayoḥ kvāthaḥ[ca] kavalo hitaḥ|

-------------------------------------------------| upācaredevameva pratyākhyāyāsrasambhavām||61|| sāgāradhūmaiḥ kaṭukaiḥ kaphajāṃ pratisārayet| nasyagaṇḍūṣayostailaṃ sādhitaṃ ca praśasyate||62|| apāmārgaphalaśvetādantījantughnasaindhavaiḥ| -------------------------------------------------|63|

Sa. raktajāṃ rohiṇikāṃ pratyākhyāya pittajāmivopakramet| kaṭukaiḥ-kaṭuvargoktaiḥ, sāgāradhūmaiḥ kaphotthāṃ pratisārayet| apāmārgādibhiḥ kalkitaiḥ sādhitaṃ tailaṃ kapharohiṇyāṃ nasyagaṇḍūṣayoḥ śreṣṭham|

ab.seg: vidradhau srāvite śreṣṭhārocanātārkṣyagairikaiḥ| sarodhrapaṭupattaṅgakaṇairgaṇḍūṣagharṣaṇe||64||

div.ab: Sa. eṣaiva cikitsā vṛndādiṣu| vidradhau śastreṇa srāvite śreṣṭhādibhirgaṇḍūṣādi hitam|

ab.seg: galagaṇḍaḥ pavanajaḥ svinno niḥsrutaśoṇitaḥ| tilairbījaiśca laṭvomāpriyālaśaṇasambhavaiḥ||65||
upanāhyo, vraṇe rūḍhe pralepyaśca punaḥpunaḥ| śigrutilvakatarkārīgajakṛṣṇāpunarnavaiḥ||66||
kālāmṛtārkamūlaiśca puṣpaiśca karahāṭajaiḥ| ekaiṣikānvitaiḥ piṣṭaiḥ surayā kāñjikena vā||67||
guḍūcīnimbakuṭajahaṃsapādībalādvayaiḥ| sādhitaṃ pāyayettailaṃ sakṛṣṇādevadārubhiḥ||68||

div.ab: Sa. galagaṇḍo vātodbhavaḥ svinno niḥsrutāsrastilairlaṭvādibījaiśca upanāhyaḥ| ruḍhe vraṇe sati pralepyaśca bahuśaḥ śigrvādibhiḥ surayā kāñjikena vā piṣṭaiḥ| ekaiṣikā-trivṛt| guḍūcyādibhiḥ sakṛṣṇādevadārubhiḥ kalkitairgalaṇḍinamāturaṃ pakvaṃ tailaṃ pāyayet|
kartavyaṃ kaphaje'pyetatsvedavimlāpane tvati| lepo'jagandhātiviṣāviśalyāḥ saviṣāṇikāḥ||69|| guñjālābuśukāhvāśca palāśakṣārakalkitāḥ| -------------------------------------------------|70|
Sa. kaphotthe'pyetat-vātagalagaṇḍoktaṃ cikitsitaṃ, kāryam| kintu svedavimlāpane cātyarthaṃ kārye| kaphaje galagaṇḍe'jagandhādayaḥ palāśakṣāraniścotakalkitāḥ lepaḥ|

ab.seg: -------------------------------------------------| mūtrasrutaṃ haṭhakṣāraṃ paktvā kodravabhuk pibet||70||
sādhitaṃ vatsakādyairvā tailaṃ sapaṭupañcakaiḥ| kaphaghnān dhūmavamananāvanādīṃśca śīlayet||71||

div.ab: Sa. haṭho-mimmiṇiḥ, tasya kṣāraṃ gomūtre srutaṃ paktvā kṣāranyāyena pibejjalena, 'peṣaṇāloḍane vāri' (hṛ.ka.a. 6/23) iti vacanāt| kimbhūtaḥ san ? kodravabhuk| vatsakādibhirvā (hṛ.sū.a. 15/33) tailaṃ sādhitaṃ hitam| kaphaghnān dhūmādīn śīlayet|
medobhave sirāṃ vidhyetkaphaghnaṃ ca vidhiṃ bhajet| asanādirajaścainaṃ prātarmūtreṇa pāyayet||72|| aśāntau pācayitvā ca sarvān vraṇavadācaret| -------------------------------------------------|73|
Sa. medobhave galagaṇḍe sirāṃ vidhyet| kaphaghnaṃ ca vidhiṃ seveta| asanādicūrṇaṃ (hṛ.sū.a.15/19) cainaṃ prātargomūtreṇa pāyayet| saṃ-aśāntau satyāṃ pācayitvā sarvān vraṇavadupakramet|

ab.seg: -------------------------------------------------| mukhapākeṣu sakṣaudrā prayojyā mukhadhāvanāḥ||73||
kvathitāstriphalāpāṭhāmṛdvīkājātipallavāḥ| niṣṭhevyā bhakṣayitvā vā kuṭherādirgaṇo'thavā||74||

div.ab: Sa. mukhapākeṣu samākṣikā mukhadhāvanāḥ kvathitāstriphalādayaḥ prayojyāḥ| athavā triphalādīn bhakṣayitvā niṣṭhevyāḥbhuktvā niṣṭhīvet| kuṭherādirgaṇo vā-harītakavargokto (hṛ.sū.a.6/106), bhakṣayitvā niṣṭhevyaḥ|

ab.seg: mukhapāke'nilāt kṛṣṇāpaṭvelāḥ pratisāraṇam| tailaṃ vātaharaiḥ siddhaṃ hitaṃ kavalanasyayoḥ||75||

div.ab: Sa. mukhapāke'nilāt kṛṣṇādayaḥ pratisāraṇam| vātaghnaiḥ siddhaṃ tailaṃ kavale nasye ca hitam|

ab.seg: pittāsre pittaraktaghnaḥ kaphaghnaśca kaphe vidhiḥ| likhecchākādipatraiśca piṭikāḥ kaṭhināḥ sthirāḥ||76||

div.ab: Sa. pittāsre pittaraktaghno vidhiḥ| saṃ-kaphe ca kaphahṛt vidhiḥ| piṭikāḥ kaṭhināḥ sthirāḥ śākādipatrairlikhet|
yathādoṣodayaṃ kuryātsannipāte cikitsitam| nave'rbude tvasaṃvṛddhe chedite pratisāraṇam||77|| svarjikānāgarakṣaudraiḥ, kvātho gaṇḍūṣa iṣyate| -------------------------------------------------|78|

Sa. sannipāte yathādoṣodayaṃ cikitsitaṃ kuryāt| arbude navotthe'saṃvṛddhe chedite ca pratisāraṇaṃ svarjikādibhiḥ| gaṇḍūṣa iṣṭo guḍūcīnimbakalkodbhavaḥ kvātho madhutailayuktaḥ| tathā yavānnabhojī tīkṣṇatailanasyābhyaṅgānācaret|

----------------------------------------------------| guḍūcīnimbakalkottho madhutailasamanvitaḥ||78|| yavānnabhuk tīkṣṇatailanasyābhyaṅgāṃstathā''caret| ----------------------------------------------------|79|
Sa. arbude navotthe'saṃvṛddhe chedite ca pratisāraṇaṃ svarjikādibhiḥ| gaṇḍūṣa iṣṭo guḍūcīnimbakalkodbhavaḥ kvātho madhutailayuktaḥ| tathā yavānnabhojī tīkṣṇatailanasyābhyaṅgānācaret|

----------------------------------------------------| vamite pūtivadane dhūmastīkṣṇaḥ sanāvanaḥ||79|| samaṅgādhātakīrodhraphalinīpadmakairjalam| dhāvanaṃ vadanasyāntaścūrṇitairavacūrṇitam||80|| śītādopakuśoktaṃ ca nāvanādi ca śīlayet| ----------------------------------------------------|81|
Sa. pūtimukhe vamite sati tīkṣṇadhūmo nasyaṃ ca tīkṣṇaṃ prayojyam| samaṅgādijalena vadanasyāntaḥ kṣālayet| etaireva mukhāntaraṃ cūrṇitairavacūrṇayet| śītādopakuśoktaṃ ca nasyādikamabhyaset|

ab.seg: phalatrayadvīpikirātatikta- yaṣṭyāhvasiddhārthakaṭutrikāṇi| mustāharidrādvayayāvaśūka- vṛkṣāmlakāmlāgrimavetasāśca||81||
aśvatthajambvāmradhanañjayatvak tvak cāhimārātkhadirasya sāraḥ| kvāthena teṣāṃ ghanatāṃ gatena taccūrṇayuktā guṭikā vidheyāḥ||82||
tā dhāritā ghnanti mukhena nityaṃ kaṇṭhauṣṭhatālvādigadān sukṛcchrān| viśeṣato rohiṇikāsyaśoṣa- gandhān videhādhipatipraṇītāḥ||83||

div.ab: Sa. triphalādīnāṃ dravyāṇāṃ kvāthena ghanatvaṃ gatena taccūrṇena triphalādirajasā'nvitā gulikāḥ kāryāḥ| tā mukhena nityaṃ dhāritāḥ kaṇṭhādirogān dāruṇānapi ghnanti| viśeṣeṇa rohiṇikādīn| videhapatinā nirmitā etāḥ| amlāgrimavetasaḥ-amlavetasaḥ| atrā[ntyā]dye vṛtte upajātī, madhyamamindravajrā|

ab.seg: khadiratulāmambughaṭe paktvā toyena tena piṣṭaiśca| candanajoṅgakakuṅkumaparipelavavālakośīraiḥ||84||
suratarurodhradrākṣāmañjiṣṭhācocapadmakaviḍaṅgaiḥ| spṛkkānatanakhakaṭphalasūkṣmailādhyāmakaiḥ sapattaṅgaiḥ||85||
tailaprasthaṃ vipacet karṣāṃśaiḥ pānanasyagaṇḍūṣaistat| hatvā''sye sarvagadān janayati gārdhīṃ dṛśaṃ śrutiṃ ca vārāhīm||86||

div.ab: Sa. khadirapalaśataṃ jaladroṇe paktvā pādāvaśeṣitena tena jalena piṣṭaiścandanādibhiḥ karṣāśaistailaprasthaṃ pacet| tacca pānanasyagaṇḍūṣairāsye dhāritaṃ sarvān rogān jitvā gṛdhrasambandhinīṃ dṛṣṭiṃ varāhatulyāṃ śrutiṃ[ca] vidhatte| āryā(rye) gītiḥ[ca]|

ab.seg: udvartitaṃ ca prapunāṭarodhra- dārvībhirabhyaktamanena vaktram| nirvyaṅganīlīmukhadūṣikādi sañjāyate candrasamānakānti||87||

div.ab: Sa. prapunnāṭādibhitudvartitaṃ mukhaṃ tailenānenābhyaktaṃ vyaṅgādirahitaṃ candratulyakānti sañjāyate| upajātiḥ|

ab.seg: palaśataṃ bāṇāttoyaghaṭe paktvā rase'smiṃśca palārdhikaiḥ khadirajambūyaṣṭyānantāmrairahimāranīlotpalānvitaiḥ||88||
tailaprasthaṃ pācayecchlakṣṇapiṣṭai- rebhirdravyairdhāritaṃ tanmukhena| rogān sarvān hanti vaktre viśeṣā- tsthairyaṃ dhatte dantapaṅkteścalāyāḥ||89||

div.ab: Sa. nīlasahacarāt palaśataṃ jalaghaṭe paktvā tasmin rasedvikārṣikaiḥ khadirādibhiḥ kalkitaiḥ sūkṣmarajīkṛtaistailaprasthaṃ vipācayet| tanmukhena dhāritaṃ sarvamukharogahṛt| viśeṣeṇa dantapaṅkteścalāyāḥ sthairyakṛcca| vṛttaṃ (?) śālinī [ca]|

ab.seg: khadirasārād dve tule pacedvalkāttulāṃ cārimedasaḥ| ghaṭacatuṣke pādaśeṣe'smin pūte punaḥ kvathanādghane||90||
ākṣikaṃ kṣipetsusūkṣmaṃ rajaḥ sevyāmbupattaṅgagairikam| candanadvaya(śyāmā) rodhrapuṇḍrā- hvayaṣṭyāhvalākṣāñjanadvayam||91||
dhātakīkaṭuphaladviniśātriphalācaturjātajoṅgakam| mustamañjiṣṭhānyagrodhapraroha|vacā]māṃsīyavāsakam||92||
padmakailāsamaṅgāśca śīte tasmiṃstathā pālikāṃ pṛthak| jātipatrikāṃ sajātīphalāṃ saha- (nakha)lavaṅgakaṅkollakām||93||
sphaṭikaśubhrasurabhikarpūrakuḍavaṃ ca tatrāvapettataḥ| kārayedguṭikāḥ sadā caitā dhāryā mukhe tadvadāpahāḥ||94||

div.ab: Sa. khadirasārad dve tule, tulāṃ cārimedaso valkāt, jalaghaṭacatuṣṭaye pacet| pādāvaśeṣite pūte'smin punaḥ kvathanād ghanībhūte kārṣikāṇi sūślakṣṇacūrṇāni sevyādīni kṣipet| asmin śīte jātīpatrādīn pṛthakpālikān kṣipet| śreṣṭhatamojjvalakarpūrakuḍavaṃ cātra kṣipet| anantaraṃ guṭikāḥ kārayet| etāḥ sadā mukhe dhāryāḥ sarvamukharogaharāḥ| [vṛttāni(?) pañca|]

ab.seg: kvāthyauṣadhavyatyayayojanena tailaṃ pacetkalpanayā'nayaiva| sarvāsyarogoddhṛtaye tadāhu- rdantasthiratve tvidameva mukhyam||95||

div.ab: Sa. kvāthyauṣadhayoḥ-khadirasārārimedasoḥ, vyatyayo-vaiparītyaṃ,-arimedasaḥ-viṭkhadiravalkalād dve tule prayojye, khadirasārattulām, anyatsarvaṃ pūrvavaddeyamiti| tailaṃ pacedanayaiva kalpanayā| tat-tailaṃ, sarvamukharogaghnam| dantasthirakṛtau cedameva pradhānamāhuḥ| indravajrā|

ab.seg: khadireṇaitā guṭikā- stailamidaṃ cārimedasā prathitam| anuśīlayan pratidinaṃ svastho'pi dṛḍhadvijo bhavati||96||

div.ab: Sa. khadireṇaitā guṭikāstailaṃ caitadarimedasā prathitam| dvayamapyetat pratidinamabhyastaṃ svasthasyāpi dvijadārḍhyakṛt| āryā|

ab.seg: kṣudrāguḍūcīsumanaḥpravāla- dārvīyavāsatriphalākaṣāyaḥ| kṣaudreṇa yuktaḥ kavalagraho'yaṃ sarvāmayān vaktragatānnihanti||97||
pāṭhādārvītvakkuṣṭhamustāsamaṅgā- tiktāpītāṅgīrodhratejovatīnām| cūrṇaḥ sakṣaudro dantamāṃsārtikaṇḍū- pākasrāvāṇaṃ nāśano gharṣaṇena||98||

div.ab: Sa. kṣudrādibhiḥ kaṣāyaḥ kṣaudreṇa yutaḥ kavalagraho'yaṃ sarvamukharogān hanti| indravajrā| saṃ-pāṭhādīnāṃ cūrṇaḥ kṣaudrayuto dantamāṃsārtyādīnāṃ gharṣaṇena nāśanaḥ| vaiśvadevī|

ab.seg: gṛhadhūmatārkṣyapāṭhāvyoṣakṣārāgnyayovarātejohvaiḥ| mukhadantagalavikāre sakṣaudraḥ kālako vidhāryaścūrṇaḥ||99||
dārvītvaksindhūdbhavamanaḥ śilāyāvaśūkaharitālaiḥ| dhāryaḥ pītakacūrṇo dantāsyagalāmaye samadhvājyaḥ||100||

div.ab: Sa. gṛhadhūmādibhiścūrṇaḥ samākṣikaḥ kālakākhyo mukha[di]vikāre dhāryaḥ| āryā gītiḥ| dārvyādibhiḥ pītakākhyaścūrṇo dantādyāmaye samadhughṛto dhāryaḥ| gītirāryā|

ab.seg: dvikṣāradhūmakavarāpañcapaṭuvyoṣavellagiritārkṣyaiḥ| gomūtreṇa vipakvā galāmayaghnī rasakriyā eṣā||101||
gomūtrakvathanavilīnavigrahāṇāṃ pathyānāṃ jalamiśikuṣṭhabhāvitānām| attāraṃ naramaṇavo'pi vaktrarogāḥ śrotāraṃ nṛpamiva na spṛśantyanarthāḥ||102||

div.ab: Sa. dvikṣārādibhirgomūtreṇa vipakvā eṣā rasakriyā guṭikā galarogaghnī bhavati| [gītirāryā|] gomūtrakvāthena vilīnaśarīrāṇāṃ pathyānāṃ vālakaśatapuṣpākuṣṭairbhāvitānāṃ bhakṣayitāraṃ naraṃ svalpā api vaktrarogā na spṛśanti| anarthāḥ śrotāraṃ nṛpamivetyupamālaṅkāraḥ| praharṣiṇī|

ab.seg: saptacchadośīrapaṭolamusta- harītakītiktakarohiṇībhiḥ| yaṣṭyāhvarājadrumacandanaiśca kvāthaṃ pibetpākaharaṃ mukhasya||103||
paṭolaśuṇṭhītriphalāviśālā- trāyantitiktādviniśāmṛtānām| pītaḥ kaṣāyo madhunā nihanti mukhe sthitaścāsyagadānaśeṣān||104||

div.ab: Sa. saptacchadādibhiḥ kvāthaṃ mukhapākaharaṃ pibet| paṭolādīnāṃ kaṣāyo madhumān pīto mukhe ca sthitogaṇḍūṣo dhārito, mukhagadānaśeṣānnihanti| upajātī

ab.seg: svarasaḥ kvathito dārvyā ghanībhūtaḥ sagairikaḥ| āsyasthaḥ samadhurvaktrapākanāḍīvraṇāpahaḥ||105||
paṭolanimbayaṣṭyāhvavāsājātyarimedasām| khadirasya varāyāśca pṛthagevaṃ prakalpanā||106||

div.ab: Sa. dārvyā rasaḥ kvathito ghanībhūtaḥ sagairikakṣaudro mukhastho vaktrapākādighnaḥ| paṭolādīnāṃ pṛthagevaṃ prakalpanā kāryā|

ab.seg: khadirāyovarāpārthamadayantyahimārakaiḥ| gāṇḍūṣo'mbuśṛtairdhāryo durbaladvijaśāntaye||107||
mukhadantamūlagalajāḥ prāyo rogāḥ kaphāsrabhūyiṣṭhāḥ| tasmātteṣāmasakṛd rudhiraṃ visrāvayedduṣṭam||108||

div.ab: Sa. khadirādibhirjalaśṛtairgaṇḍūśo dvijadārḍhyakṛddhāryaḥ| ahimārakaḥ-arimedaḥ| mukhādigadā bāhulyena kapharaktabhūyiṣṭhā yataḥ, tasmāddhetosteṣāṃ duṣṭaṃ rudhiraṃ punaḥ punarvisrāvayet|

ab.seg: kāyaśirasorvireko vamanaṃ kavalagrahāśca kaṭutiktāḥ| prāyaḥ śastaṃ teṣāṃ kapharaktaharaṃ tathā karma||109||
yavatṛṇadhānyaṃ bhaktaṃ vidalaiḥ kṣāroṣitairapasnehāḥ| yūṣā bhakṣyāśca hitā yaccānyacchleṣmanāśāya||110||

div.ab: Sa. kāyaśirovirekādikaṃ bāhulyena teṣāṃ śastam| kapharaktaharaṃ ca yatkarma tat śastam| yavādayo hitāḥ| yaccāparaṃ śleṣmanāśanaṃ tacca śastam|

prāṇānilapathasaṃsthāḥ śvasitamapi nirundhate pramādavataḥ| kaṇṭhāmayāścikitsita- mato drutaṃ teṣu kurvīta|111| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviraci- tāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttara- sthāne mukharogapratiṣedho nāma dvāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ|22|

Sa. prāṇapavanamārgasthitā kaṇṭharogāḥ pramādyataḥ śvāsamapi nirundhanti yataḥ, ataḥ-asmāddhetoḥ, teṣu rogeṣūpakramaṃ drāg vidadhīta| āryāścatasraḥ| iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇattaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdaya- ṭīkāyāṃ sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne mukharoga- pratiṣedho nāma dvāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 22||

div.head: śirorogavijñānīyādhyāyaḥ
div.ab: atha kramaprāptaṃ śirorogavijñānamāha ---- athātaḥ śirorogavijñānīyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre||2|| ) dhūmātapatuṣārāmbukrīḍātisvapnajāgaraiḥ| utsvedādhipurovātabāṣpanigraharodanaiḥ||1|| atyambumadyapānena kṛmibhirvegadhāraṇaiḥ| upadhānamṛjābhyaṅgadveṣādhaḥpratatekṣaṇaiḥ||2|| asātmyagandhaduṣṭāmabhāṣyādyaiśca śirogatāḥ| janayantyāmayān doṣāḥ--------------------------|3|
Sa. dhūmādibhiḥ śirogatā doṣā rogān janayanti|

-----------------------------------------------| --------------------------tatra mārutakopataḥ||3|| nistudyete bhṛśaṃ śaṅkhau ghāṭā sambhidyate tathā| bhruvormadhyaṃ lalāṭaṃ ca patatīvātivedanam||4|| bādhyete svanataḥ śrotre niṣkṛṣyeta ivākṣiṇī| ghūrṇatīva śiraḥ sarvaṃ sandhibhya iva mucyate||5|| sphuratyati sirājālaṃ kandharāhanusaṅgrahaḥ| prakāśāsahatā ghrāṇasrāvo'kasmādyathāśamau||6|| mārdavaṃ mardanasnehasvedabandhaiśca jāyate| śirastāpo'yam-----------------------------|7|
Sa. tatra-teṣu madhye, vātakopāt śaṅkhanistodādayaḥ syuḥ| tathā mardanādibhirmārdavaṃ jāyate| ghūrṇatīveti ghūrṇastudādiḥ| ayamīdṛśaḥ śirastāpa ucyate|

ab.seg: pakṣātkupyati māsādvā svayameva ca śāmyati| ativṛddhastu nayanaṃ śravaṇaṃ vā vināśayet||8||

div.ab: Sa. saṃ-ardhe tu śirasaḥ, ardhāvabhedaka ucyate| sa ca pakṣeṇa kupyati| māsena vā kupyati| svayameva-cikitsitaṃ vinaiva, upaśāmyati| ativṛddhastvayaṃ locanaṃ karṇaṃ vā hanyāt|

ab.seg: śorobhitāpe pittotthe śorodhūmāyanaṃ jvaraḥ| svedo'kṣidahanaṃ mūrcchā niśi śītaiśca mārdavam||9||
aruciḥ kaphaje mūrdhno gurustimitaśītatā| śirānispandatā''lasyaṃ rūṅmandā'hnyadhikāniśi||10||
tandrā śūnākṣikūṭatvaṃ karṇakaṇḍūyanaṃ vamiḥ| raktāt pittādhikarujaḥ sarvaiḥ syātsarvalakṣaṇaḥ||11||

div.ab: Sa. kaphaje śirobhitāpe'rucyādayaḥ syuḥ| divā pīḍā mandā bhavati, vibhāvaryāmadhikā| tathā tandrādayaḥ syuḥ| raktodbhavo mūrdhatāpaḥ pittādhikarujaḥ syāt| sannipātena sarvalakṣaṇaḥ syāt|

saṅkīrṇairbhojanairmūrdhni kleditte rudhirāmiṣe| kopite sannipāte ca jāyante mūrdhni jantavaḥ||12|| śirasaste pibanto'sraṃ ghorāḥ kurvanti vedanāḥ| cittavibhraṃśajananīrjvaraḥ kāso balakṣayaḥ||13|| raukṣyaśophavyadhancchedadāhasphuraṇapūtitāḥ| kapāle tāluśirasoḥ kaṇḍūḥ śoṣaḥ pramīlakaḥ||14|| tāmrācchasiṅghāṇakatā karṇanādaśca jantuje| -----------------------------------------------|15|

Sa. saṅkīrṇairāhāraiḥ śirasi kledite rudhire māṃse ca sannipāte ca kopite kṛmayo mūrdhni jāyante| te ca mūrdhnau raktaṃ pibanto dāruṇāḥ pīḍā manovibhraṃśakāriṇīrjanayanti| jvarādayaśca syuḥ| tathā kapāle tāluśirasoḥ kaṇḍvādyāḥ syuḥ| tathā tāmrācchasiṅghāṇakatvaṃ karṇanādaśca kṛmije syāt|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------| vātolbaṇāḥ śiraḥkampaṃ tatsaṃjñaṃ kurvate malāḥ||15||
pittapradhānairvātādyaiḥ śaṅkhe śophaḥ saśoṇitaiḥ| tīvradāharujārāgapralāpajvaratṛḍbhramāḥ||16||
tiktāsyaḥ pītavadanaḥ kṣiprakārī sa śaṅkhakaḥ| trirātrājjīvitaṃ hanti sidhyatyapyāśu sādhitaḥ||17||

div.ab: Sa. vātādhikā doṣāḥ śiraḥkampaṃ śiraḥ kampākhyaṃ kurvate| pittādhikairdoṣaiḥ saraktaiḥ śaṅkhe śopho'tidāhādayaśca syuḥ| sa ca śaṅkhakastiktāsyaḥ pītavarṇamukhaḥ kṣiprakārī ca syāt| tiktaṃ-tiktasvādamāsyaṃ, yasmin śaṅkhake saḥ| evamanyadapi yojyam| sa cānupakrāntastrirātreṇa jīvitaṃ harati| śīghraṃ ca cikitsitaḥ sidhyatyapi| apiśabdāt kadācinna sidhyati|

pittānubaddhaḥ śaṅkhākṣibhrūlalāṭeṣu mārutaḥ| rujaṃ saspandanāṃ kuryādanusūryodayodayām||18|| āmadhyāhnaṃ vivardhiṣṇuḥ kṣudvataḥ sā viśeṣataḥ| avyavasthitaśītoṣṇasukhā śāmyatyataḥ param||19|| sūryāvartaḥ sa ityuktā daśa rogāḥ śirogatāḥ| -----------------------------------------------|20|

Sa. pittānubaddho mārutaḥ śaṅkhādiṣu rujaṃ saspandanāṃ kuryāt| kimbhūtāṃ rujam ? anusūryodayaṃ udayo yasyāḥ sā tām| āmadhyāhnaṃ-madhyāhnaṃ maryādīkṛtya vardhanaśīlā, sā pīḍā bubhukṣitasya viśeṣeṇa| tathā'niyataśītoṣṇasukhā| ato-madhyāhnāt, paraṃ śamaṃ gacchati| saḥ-ityevaṃ, sūryāvarta uktaḥ| daśaite mūrdhagatā rogā uktāḥ|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| śirasyeva ca vakṣyante kapāle vyādhayo nava||20||
kapāle pavane duṣṭe garbhasthasyāpi jāyate| savarṇo nīrujaḥ śophastaṃ vidyādupaśīrṣakam||21||

div.ab: Sa. śirasyeva kapāle nava rogā bhaṇiṣyante| kapāle pavane duṣṭe garbhasthitasyāpi nīrujaḥ śophastatsavarṇaḥ-kāyasamānavarṇo, jāyate| tamupaśīrṣakākhyaṃ rogaṃ jānīyāt|
yathādoṣodayaṃ brūyāt piṭikārbudavidradhīn| kapāle kledabahulāḥ pittāsṛkśleṣmajantubhiḥ||22|| kaṅgusiddhārthakanibhāḥ piṭikāḥ syuraruṃṣikāḥ| ---------------------------------------------|23|
Sa. piṭikādīn trīn yathādoṣodayaṃ brūyāt| kapāle kledabahulāḥ pittāsṛkśleṣmajantubhiḥ kaṅgusiddhārthakaphalarūpāḥ piṭikā aruṃṣikāḥ syuḥ|

---------------------------------------------| kaṇḍūkeśacyutisvāparaukṣyakṛt sphuṭanaṃ tvacaḥ||23|| susūkṣmaṃ kaphavātābhyāṃ vidyāddāruṇakaṃ tu tat| romakūpānugaṃ pittaṃ vātena saha mūrcchitam||24|| pracyāvayati romāṇi tataḥ śleṣmā saśoṇitaḥ| romakūpān ruṇaddhyasya tenānyeṣāmasambhavaḥ||25|| tadindraluptaṃ rujyāṃ ca prāhuścāceti cāpare| ---------------------------------------------|26|

Sa. kaṇḍvādikṛt tvacaḥ sphuṭanaṃ susūkṣmaṃ yat taddāruṇakaṃ kaphavātābhyāṃ vidyāt| aṃ-pittaṃ vātena saha mūrcchitaṃ romakūpānugataṃ romāṇi pracyāvayati| tataḥ śleṣmā raktasahito romakūpān ruṇaddhi| tena kāraṇenāsya-indraluptavataḥ, anyeṣāṃ romṇāmanutpattiḥ| tat-etat, indraluptaṃ rujyāṃ cācetyanya āhuḥ|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| khalaterapi janmaivaṃ śātanaṃ tatra tu kramāt||26||
sā vātādagnidagdhābhā, pittātsvinnasirāvṛtā| kaphāddhanatvagvarṇāśca yathāsvaṃ nirdiśet tvaci||27||

div.ab: Sa. evaṃ-etattulyarūpā, khalaterutpattiḥ| kintu[tatra-] khalatau, krameṇa keśānāṃ śāto na tvindralupta iva sahasā| sā-khalatiḥ, vātādagnidagdhābhā syāt| pittāt svinnasirāvṛtā syāt| kaphena ghanatvak| tvaci varṇāśca yathādoṣaṃ nirdiśet|

ab.seg: doṣaiḥ sarvākṛtiḥ sarvairasādhyā sā nakhaprabhā| dagdhāgnineva nirlomā sadāhā yā ca jāyate||28||

div.ab: Sa. sarvairdoṣaiḥ sarvākṛtiḥ sarvalakṣaṇā khalatiḥ| nakhaprabhā sā cāsādhyā syāt| agnidagdhatulyā romarahitā sadāhā ca yā jāyate, sā'pyasādhyā syāt|

śokaśramakrodhakṛtaḥ śarīroṣmā śirogataḥ| keśān sadoṣaḥ pacati palitaṃ sambhavatyataḥ||29|| tadvātātsphuṭitaṃ śyāvaṃ kharaṃ rūkṣaṃ jalaprabham| pittātsadāhaṃ pītābhaṃ, kaphāt snigdhaṃ vivṛddhimat||30|| sthūlaṃ suśuklaṃ, sarvaistu vidyādvyāmiśralakṣaṇam| ---------------------------------------------|31|

Sa. śokādibhirudgataḥ śarīroṣmā mūrdhni doṣaiḥ sahitaḥ keśān pacati| ataḥ palitaṃ jāyate| tacca-palitaṃ, vātāt sphiṭitādiguṇaṃ syāt| pittena sadāhaṃ pītavarṇam| kaphāt snigdhaṃ vivṛddhimat sthūlaṃ suśuklaṃ ca| sarvaistu doṣaiḥ saṅkīrṇalakṣaṇaṃ vidyāt
---------------------------------------------| śirorujodbhavaṃ cānyadvivarṇaṃ sparśanāsaham||31|| asādhyā sannipātena khalatiḥ palitāni ca| ---------------------------------------------|32|

Sa. śirorujotthaṃ cāparaṃ palitaṃ vivarṇaṃ sparśanāsahaṃ syāt| khalatiḥ sannipātenāsādhyā| palitāni ca sannipātotthānyasādhyāni| doṣaiḥ sarvaiḥ khalatirasādhyeti prāguktameva| idaṃ tu vacanaṃ spaṣṭārthameveti manye, tathā sannipātodbhūtāni palitānyasādhyānīti|

---------------------------------------------| śarīrapariṇāmotthānyapekṣante rasāyanam|32| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭavira- citāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttara- sthāne śirorogavijñānīyo nāma trayoviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ|23|

Sa. śarīrapariṇāmodbhavāni tu palitāni rasāyanamapekṣanta iti| iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdaya- ṭīkāyāṃ sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne śirorogavijñānīyo nāma trayoviṃśo- 'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 23||

div.head: śirorogapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ
div.ab: athaitaccikitsitaṃ vyākhyātumāha ----- athātaḥ śirorogapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre|2| ) śirobhitāpe'nilaje vātavyādhividhiṃ caret| ---------------------------------------------|1|
Sa. pavanaje śirobhitāpe vātavyādhicikitsitaṃ kuryāt|

---------------------------------------------| ghṛtamaktaśirā rātrau pibeduṣṇapayonupaḥ||1|| māṣān kulatthān mudgān vā tadvatkhādeddhṛtānvitān| tailaṃ tilānāṃ kalkaṃ vā kṣīreṇa saha pāyayet||2|| piṇḍopanāhasvedāśca māṃsadhānyakṛtā hitāḥ| vātaghnadaśamūlādisiddhakṣīreṇa secanam||3|| snigdhaṃ nasyaṃ tathā dhūmaḥ śiraḥśravaṇatarpaṇam| ---------------------------------------------|4|

Sa. abhyaktaśirā rātrau ghṛtaṃ pibet| paścāduṣṇaṃ kṣīraṃ pibet| māṣādīn ghṛtānvitān khādet, tadvat-uṣṇapayonupaḥ san| tilānāṃ tailaṃ kalkaṃ vā kṣīreṇa saha pāyayet| piṇḍasvedā upanāhasvedāśca māṃsayuktairdhānyaiḥ kṛtā hitāḥ| vātaharadaśamūlādinā siddhena kṣīreṇa secanaṃ hitam| snigdhaṃ ca nasyādikaṃ hitam|

---------------------------------------------| varaṇādau gaṇe kṣuṇṇe kṣīramardhodakaṃ pacet||4|| kṣīrāvaśiṣṭaṃ tacchītaṃ mathitvā sāramāharet| tato madhurakaiḥ siddhaṃ nasyaṃ tat pūjitaṃ haviḥ||5|| varge'tra pakvaṃ kṣīre ca peyaṃ sarpiḥ saśarkaram| ---------------------------------------------|6|

Sa. varaṇasairyeketyādigaṇe(hṛ.sū.a. 15/21) jarjarite kṣīramardhodakaṃ pacet| tat kṣīrāvaśiṣṭaṃ śītībhūtaṃ mathitvā sāramāharet| anantaraṃ taddhataṃ madhuradravyaiḥ pakvaṃ nasyaṃ śreṣṭham| saṃ-asminneva varaṇādau varge kṣīre ca ghṛtaṃ pakvaṃ saśarkaraṃ peyam|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| kārpāsamajjā tvaṅmustā sumanaḥkorakāṇi ca||6||
nasyamuṣṇāmbupiṣṭāni sarvamūrdharujāpaham| śarkarākuṅkumaśṛtaṃ ghṛtaṃ pittāsṛganvaye||7||

div.ab: Sa. kārpāsamajjādīnyuṣṇajalena piṣṭāni sarvamūrdharujāghnaṃ nasyam| śarkarākuṅkumaśṛtaṃ sarpiḥ pittāsṛgutthe [nasyaṃ] hitam|

ab.seg: pralepaḥ saghṛtaiḥ kuṣṭhakuṭilotpalacandanaiḥ| vātodrekabhayādraktaṃ na cāsminnavasecayet||8||
ityaśāntau cale dāhaḥ kaphe ceṣṭo yathoditaḥ| ardhāvabhedake'pyeṣā tathā doṣānvayātkriyā||9||

div.ab: Sa. kuṣṭhādibhiḥ saghṛtaiḥ pralepaḥ| kuṭilaṃ-tagaram asmiṃśca vātodrekabhayāllohitaṃ nāvasecayet| evamapyanupaśame vāyau dāha iṣṭaḥ| kaphe ca yathoktamuṣṇamiṣṭam| ardhāvabhedake'pyeṣā eva kriyā doṣānvayāt-doṣānurodhāccā, yathāsvaṃ kāryā|
śirīṣabījāpāmārgamūlaṃ nasyaṃ biḍānvitam| sthirāraso vā, lepe tu prapunnāṭo'mlakalkitaḥ||10|| sūryovarte'pi tasmiṃstu sirayā'paharedasṛk| ---------------------------------------------|11|
Sa. śirīṣabījādibhirnasyaṃ syāt| śāliparṇīkvātho vā nasyam| prapunnāṭabījamamlena piṣṭaṃ lepaḥ| sūryāvarte'pyeṣa evopakramaḥ| tasmiṃśca sirayā raktaṃ srāvayet|

---------------------------------------------| śirobhitāpe pittotthe snigdhasya vyadhayetsirām||11|| śītāḥ śiromukhālepasekaśodhanabastayaḥ| jīvanīyaśṛte kṣīrasarpiṣī pānanasyayoḥ||12|| kartavyaṃ raktaje'pyetat pratyākhyāya ca śaṅkhake| ---------------------------------------------|13|

Sa. mūrdhābhitāpe pittasambhave snigdhasya sataḥ sirāṃ mokṣayet| tathā śiromukhālepādayaḥ śītā hitāḥ| jīvanīyaiḥ śṛte kṣīraghṛte pānanasyayorhite| rakteje'pyetaccikitsitaṃ kāryam| śaṅkhake ca pratyākhyāyaiṣa evopakramaḥ kāryaḥ|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| śleṣmābhitāpe jīrṇājyasnehitaḥ kaṭukairvamet||13||
svedapralepanasyādyā rūkṣatīkṣṇoṣṇabheṣajaiḥ| śasyante copavāso'tra nicaye miśramācaret||14||

div.ab: Sa. śleṣmaṇā śirobhitāpe purāṇaghṛtena snehitaḥ kaṭukairvamet| svedādayo rūkṣādidravyaiḥ śasyante| upavāsaścātra hitaḥ| sannipāte miśramācaret|

kṛmije śoṇitaṃ nasyaṃ tena mūrcchanti jantavaḥ| mattāḥ śoṇitagandhena niryānti ghrāṇavaktrayoḥ||15|| sutīkṣṇanasyadhūmābhyāṃ kuryānnirharaṇaṃ tataḥ| viḍaṅgasvarjikādantīhiṅgugomūtrasādhitam||16|| kaṭunimbeṅgudīpīlutailaṃ nasyaṃ pṛthak pṛthak| ---------------------------------------------|17|

Sa. kṛmije śoṇitaṃ nasyaṃ deyam| tena-śoṇitanasyena, jantavo mūrcchanti| raktagandhena ca mattā ghrāṇena vaktreṇa ca nirgacchanti| anantaraṃ tīkṣṇanasyadhūmābhyāṃ nirharaṇaṃ kuryāt| viḍaṅgādibhiḥ sādhitaṃ sarṣapatailaṃ nimbatailamiṅgudītailaṃ pīlutailaṃ vā pṛthak pṛthak nasyaṃ hitam|
---------------------------------------------| ajāmūtradrutaṃ nasyaṃ kṛmijit kṛmijitparam||17|| pūtimatsyayutaiḥ kuryād dhūmaṃ nāvanabheṣajaiḥ| ---------------------------------------------|18|
Sa. ajāmūtradrutaṃ hiṅgu nasyaṃ paraṃ kṛmighnam| pūtimatsyānvitairnasyadravyairdhūmaṃ kuryāt|
---------------------------------------------| kṛmibhiḥ pītaraktatvādraktamatra na nirharet||18|| vātābhitāpavihitaḥ kampe dāhādvinā kramaḥ| ---------------------------------------------|19|
Sa. atra ca raktaṃ na visrāvayet| kuto hetoḥ ? ityāhakṛmibhiḥ pītaraktatvāt| kampe vātābhitāpokto vidhirdāhādvinā|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| nave janmottaraṃ jāte yojayedupaśīrṣake||19||
vātavyādhikriyāṃ, pakve karma vidradhicoditam| āmapakve yathāyogyaṃ vidradhīpiṭikārbude||20||

div.ab: Sa. upaśīrṣake nave janmottaraṃ jāte vātavyādhicikitsitaṃ kuryāt| pakve ca vidradhivihitaṃ karma kuryāt| āme pakve ca vidradhau piṭikāyāmarbude ca yathāsvaṃ karma kuryāt|

ab.seg: aruṃṣikā jalaukobhirhṛtāsrā nimbavāriṇā| siktā prabhūtalavaṇairlimpedaśvaśakṛdrasaiḥ||21||
paṭolanimbapatrairvā saharidraiḥ sukalkitaiḥ| gomūtrajīrṇapiṇyākakṛkavākumalairapi||22||

div.ab: Sa. aruṃṣikā jalaukobhirniḥsrutaraktā nimbajalena siktā vājiśakṛdrasaiḥ prabhūtalavaṇairlimpet| paṭolanimbapatrairniśānvitaiḥ supiṣṭairvā gomūtrādibhirvā| kṛkavākuḥ-kukkuṭaḥ|

ab.seg: kapālabhṛṣṭaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ vā cūrṇitaṃ tailasaṃyutam| rūṃṣikālepanaṃ kaṇḍūkledadāhārtināśanam||23||
mālatīcitrakāśvaghnanaktamālaprasādhitam| cācārūṃṣikayostailamabhyaṅgaḥ kṣuraghṛṣṭayoḥ||24||

div.ab: Sa. kuṣṭhaṃ cūrṇitaṃ kapālabhṛṣṭaṃ tailasaṃyutaṃ rūṃṣikālepanaṃ kaṇḍvādihitam| mālatyādiprasādhitaṃ tailaṃ cācāruṃṣikayoḥ kṣuraghṛṣṭayorabhyaṅgaḥ|

ab.seg: aśāntau śirasaḥ śudhdyai yateta vamanādibhiḥ| vidhyecchirāṃ dāruṇake lālāṭyāṃ, śīlayenmṛjām||25||
nāvanaṃ mūrddhabastiṃ ca, lepayecca samākṣikaiḥ| priyālabhijamadhukakuṣṭhamāṣaiḥ sasarṣapaiḥ||26||
lākṣāśamyākapatraiḍagajadhātrīphalaistathā| koradūṣatṛṇakṣāravāriprakṣālanaṃ hitam||27||

div.ab: Sa. aśāntau satyāṃ mūrdhnaḥ śodhanāya vamanādibhiryateta| dāruṇake lālāṭyāṃ śirāṃ vidhyet| mṛjāṃ śuddhiṃ nasyaṃ mūrddhabastiṃ ca śīlayet| priyālādibhiḥ samākṣikairlepayecca| lākṣādibhiḥ kṣaudrayutairlepaḥ| kodravatṛṇakṣārajalena prakṣālanaṃ hitam|

ab.seg: indralupte yathāsannaṃ sirāṃ vidhvā pralepayet| pracchāya gāḍhaṃ kāsīsamanohvātutthakoṣaṇaiḥ||28||
vanyāmaratarubhyāṃ vā guñjāmūlaphalaistathā| tathā lāṅgalikāmūlaiḥ karavīrarasena vā||29||
sakṣaudrakṣudravārtākasvarasena rasena vā| dhattūrakasya patrāṇāṃ bhallātakarasena vā||30||
athavā mākṣikahavistilapuṣpatrikaṇṭakaiḥ| tailāktā hastidantasya maṣī cācauṣadhaṃ param||31||

div.ab: Sa. indralupte yathāsanne deśe sirāṃ vidhvā [gāḍhaṃ-] suṣṭu, pracchāya-prachānaṃ kṛtvā, kāsīsādibhirlepayet| vanyadevadārubhyāṃ vā lepayet| hastidantamaṣī tailāktā cācānāmauṣadhaṃ param|

ab.seg: śuklaromodgame tadvanmaṣī meṣaviṣāṇajā| varjayedvāriṇā sekaṃ yāvadromasamudbhavaḥ||32||

div.ab: Sa. sitaromodgame meṣaviṣāṇajā maṣī tailāktā śreṣṭhā| saṃ-jalasekaṃ ca varjayet yāvadromodbhūtiḥ|

ab.seg: khalatau palite valyāṃ harillomni ca śodhitam| nasyavaktraśirobhyaṅgapradehaiḥ samupācaret||33||
siddhaṃ tailaṃ bṛhatyādyairjīvanīyaiśca nāvanam| māsaṃ vā nimbajaṃ tailaṃ kṣīrabhuṅnāvayedyatiḥ||34||

div.ab: Sa. khalatyādiṣu śodhitamāturaṃ nasyādibhirupācaret| bṛhatyādibhirjīvanīyaiśca pakvaṃ tailaṃ nasyaṃ hitam| nimbodbhavaṃ vā tailaṃ māsaṃ kṣīrabhuṅnāvayet, yatiḥ-saṃyamī brahmacaryaparaḥ|

nīlīśirīṣakoraṇṭabhṛṅgasvarasabhāvitam| śelvakṣatilarāmāṇāṃ bījaṃ kākāṇḍakīsamam||35|| piṣṭvā''japayasā lohālliptādarkāśutāpitāt| tailaṃ srutaṃ kṣīrabhujo nāvanāt palitāntakṛt||36|| kṣīrātsāhacarād bhṛṅgarajasaḥ saurasādrasāt| prasthaistailasya kuḍavaḥ siddho yaṣṭipalānvitaḥ||37|| nasyaṃ śailāsane bhāṇḍe śṛṅge meṣasya vā sthitaḥ| ---------------------------------------------|38|

Sa. nīlyādisvarasena bhāvitaṃ śelvādīnāṃ bījaṃ kākāṇḍakītulyaṃ chāgadugdhena piṣṭvā lohāllipād raviraśmibhistāpittāttailaṃ srutaṃ kṣīrāśino nasyaṃ palitāntakaram| kṣīrāt prasthena, sahacararasāt prasthena, bhṛṅgarājarasāt prasthena, surasārasāt prasthena, tailasya kuḍavaḥ pakvo madhuyaṣṭīpalayutaḥ śaile bhāṇḍe bījasārasya vā bhāṇḍe meṣaśṛṅge vā sthito nasyam|

---------------------------------------------| kṣīreṇa ślakṣṇapiṣṭai vā dugdhikākaravīrakau||38|| utpāṭya palitaṃ deyāvāśaye palitāpahau| kṣīraṃ priyālaṃ yaṣṭyāhvaṃ jīvanīyo gaṇastilāḥ||39|| kṛṣṇāḥ pralepo vaktrasya harillomavalīhitaḥ| ---------------------------------------------|40|
Sa. dugdhikākaravīrakau kṣīreṇa sūkṣmapiṣṭau palitamutpāṭya tatsthāne deyau palitaghnau| kṣīrādayo vaktrasya lepa indraluptavalīṣu hitaḥ|

---------------------------------------------| tilāḥ sāmalakāḥ padmakiñjalko madhukaṃ madhu||40|| bṛṃhayedrañjayeccaitat keśān mūrddhapralepanāt| māṃsī kuṣṭhaṃ tilāḥ kṛṣṇāḥ sārivā nīlamutpalam||41|| kṣaudraṃ ca kṣīrapiṣṭāni keśasaṃvardhanaṃ param| ---------------------------------------------|42|
Sa. tilādikaṃ śiraḥpralepanāt keśān rañjayet puṣṇīyācca| māṃsyādīni kṣīrapiṣṭāni paraṃ keśasaṃvardhanāni|

---------------------------------------------| ayorajo bhṛṅgarajastriphalā kṛṣṇamṛttikā||42|| sthitamikṣurase māsaṃ samūlaṃ palitaṃ rajet| māṣakodravadhānyāmlairyavāgūstridinoṣitā||43|| lohaśuklotkaṭā piṣṭā balākāmapi rañjayet| ---------------------------------------------|44|
Sa. lohacūrṇādikamikṣurase māsaṃ sthitaṃ samūlaṃ palitaṃ rajet| māṣādibhiryavāgūstridavasoṣitā lohaśuklotkaṭā piṣṭā balākāmapi rañjayet| kiṃ punaḥ palitaṃ na nihanti?|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| prapauṇḍarīkamadhukapippalīcandanotpalaiḥ||44||
siddhaṃ dhātrīrase tailaṃ nasyenābhyañjanena ca| sarvān mūrdhagadān hanti palitāni ca śīlitam||45||

div.ab: Sa. prapauṇḍarīkādibhirdhātrīrase siddhaṃ tailaṃ nāvanenābhyañjanena ca sarvān śirorogān hanti| śīlitaṃ ca palitāni hanti|

ab.seg: varījīvantiniryāsapayobhiryamakaṃ pacet| jīvanīyaiśca tannasyaṃ sarvajatrūrdhvarogajit||46||

div.ab: Sa. śatāvarījīvantikvāthena kṣīreṇa jīvanīyaiśca yamakaṃ pacet| tat nasyena sarvajatrūrdhvarogajit|

mayūraṃ pakṣapittāntrapādaviṭtuṇḍavarjitam| daśamūlavalārāsnāmadhukaistripalairyutam||47|| jale paktvā ghṛtaprasthaṃ tasmin kṣīrasamaṃ pacet| kalkitairmadhuradravyaiḥ sarvajatrūrdhvarogajit||48|| tadabhyāsīkṛtaṃ pānabastyabhyañjananāvanaiḥ| ---------------------------------------------|49|

Sa. mayūraṃ pakṣādivarjitaṃ tripalapramāṇairdaśamūlādibhiryutaṃ jale paktvā tasmin jale kalkitairmadhuradravyaiḥ kṣīrasamaṃ ghṛtaprasthaṃ pacet| pānādibhirabhyastaṃ-śīlitaṃ, tat-ghṛtaṃ, sarvajatrūrdhvarogajit| etanmāyūrākhyaṃ ghṛtam|

---------------------------------------------| etenaiva kaṣāyeṇa ghṛtaprasthaṃ vipācayet||49|| caturguṇena payasā kalkairebhiśca kārṣikaiḥ| jīvantītriphalāmedāmṛdvīkarddhiparūṣakaiḥ||50|| samaṅgācavikābhārgīkāśmarīkarkaṭāhvayaiḥ| ātmaguptāmahāmedātālakharjūramastakaiḥ||51|| mṛṇālabisakharjūrayaṣṭīmadhukajīvakaiḥ| śatāvarīvidārīkṣubṛhatīsārivāyugaiḥ||52|| mūrvāśvadaṃṣṭrarṣabhakaśṛṅgāṭakakaserukaiḥ| rāsnāsthirātāmalakīsūkṣmailāśaṭhipauṣkaraiḥ||53|| punarnavātavakṣīrīkākolīdhanvayāsakaiḥ| madhūkākṣoṭavātāmamuñjātābhiṣukairapi||54|| mahāmāyuramityetanmāyūrādadhikaṃ guṇaiḥ| dhātvindriyasvarabhraṃśaśvāsakāsārditāpaham||55|| yenyasṛkśukradoṣeṣu śastaṃ vandhyāsutapradam| ---------------------------------------------|56|

Sa. etenaiva kvāthena ghṛtaprasthaṃ vipācayet| caturguṇena kṣīreṇaibhiḥ-jīvantyādibhiḥ, kalkaiḥ kārṣikairetanmahāmāyuraṃ māyūrādguṇairadhikaṃ dhātvādibhraṃśaghnaṃ ca| yonyādidoṣeṣu śastam| vandhyāsutapradam|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| ākhubhiḥ kukkuṭairhaṃsaiḥ śaśaiśceti prakalpayet||56||
jatrūrdhvajānāṃ vyādhīnāmekatriṃśacchatadvayam| parasparamasaṅkīrṇaṃ vistareṇa prakāśitam||57||

div.ab: Sa. mūṣikādibhireva kalpayet| jatrūrdhvajānāṃ rogāṇāṃ śatadvayamekatriṃśadadhikamanyonyamasaṅkīrṇaṃ vistareṇa prakāśitam|

ab.seg: ūrdhvamūlamadhaḥśākhamṛṣayaḥ puruṣaṃ viduḥ| mūlaprahāriṇastasmād rogān śīghrataraṃ jayet||58||

div.ab: Sa. ūrdhvamūlamadhaḥśākhaṃ munayaśca yasmāt puruṣaṃ jānanti, tasmānmūlāpahāriṇo rogān śīghrataraṃ jayet|

sarvendriyāṇi yenāsmin prāṇā yena ca saṃśritāḥ| tena tasyottamāṅgasya rakṣāyāmādṛto bhavet|59| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭa- viracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttara- sthāne śirorogapratiṣedho nāma- caturviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ|24|

Sa. saṃ-yasmādasmin-uttamāṅge, sarvendriyāṇi, yataścātra prāṇāḥ saṃśritāḥ, tasmāduttamāṅgasya rakṣāyāṃ yatnavatā bhāvyamiti| iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdaya- ṭīkāyāṃ sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne śiroroga- pratiṣedho nāma caturviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 24|| iti śālākyaṃ nāma caturthamūrdhvāṅgamaṅgaṃ sampūrṇam|

div.head: vranapratiśedhādhyāyaḥ
div.ab: Sa. atha kramaprāptaṃ vraṇapratiṣedhaṃ vyācikhyāsurāha-

athāto vraṇapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre|2| ) vraṇo dvidhā nijāgantuduṣṭaśuddhavibhedataḥ| nijo doṣaiḥ śarīrotthairāganturbāhyahetujaḥ||1|| doṣairadhiṣṭhito duṣṭaḥ śuddhastairanadhiṣṭhitaḥ| -------------------------------------------------|2|
Sa. vraṇo dviprakāro-nijāgantubhedād duṣṭaśuddhabhedācca| nijo vraṇaḥ śārīraidoṣairbhavati| āganturbāhyahetūdbhavaḥ| doṣairadhiṣṭhito duṣṭaḥ| śuddho yo doṣairanadhiṣṭhitaḥ|

-------------------------------------------------| saṃvṛtatvaṃ vivṛtatā kāṭhinyaṃ mṛdutā'ti vā||2|| atyutsannāvasannatvamatyauṣṇyamatiśītatā| raktatvaṃ pāṇḍutā kārṣṇyaṃ pūtipūyaparisrutiḥ||3|| pūtimāṃsasirāsnāyucchannatotsaṅgitā'tiruk| saṃrambhadāhaśvayathukaṇḍvādibhirupadrutaḥ||4|| dīrghakālānubandhaśca vidyādduṣṭavraṇākṛtim| -------------------------------------------------|5|
Sa. saṃvṛtatvādiryo vraṇastaṃ duṣṭavraṇākṛtiṃ vidyāt|

Sa. sa ca pañcadaśaprakāro raktasahitairdoṣaiḥ syāt| tatra pṛthag doṣaistrayaḥ, saṃsargajāstrayaḥ, sannipātenaika iti [sapta]| evaṃbhūtā raktasahitaiḥ sapta| evaṃ caturdaśa| raktena kevalenaika iti pañcadaśa| nanu, prāgabhyadhāyi (hṛ.sū.a.29/6)-"śūlaṃnarte'nilāddāhaḥ pittācchophaḥ kaphodayāt| rāgo raktācca pākaḥsyāt" ityādi| tadihaikadoṣajatvaṃ dvidoṣajatvaṃ raktarahitatvaṃ cocyamānaṃ pūrvāparavyāhataṃ syāt| atrocyate| kāsasamprāptivadatra nyāyo bodhyaḥ| tathā hyekadoṣaje'pi kāse doṣāntarasyānubandhatvamurarīkṛtya dvidoṣajānusāreṇa yathopakramastathehāpīti nātra purvāparavyāhatatvam|

-------------------------------------------------| ----------------------------------tatra mārutāt||5|| śyāvaḥ kṛṣṇo'ruṇo bhasmakapotāsthinibho'pi vā| mastumāṃsapulākāmbutulyatanvalpasaṃsrutiḥ||6|| nirmāṃsastodabhedāḍhyo rūkṣaścaṭacaṭāyate| -------------------------------------------------|7|
Sa. teṣu madhye mārutāt śyāvādiguṇo mastvāditulyatanvalpavisrāvastathā nirmāṃsādiguṇaḥ syāt|

ab.seg: -------------------------------------------------| pittena kṣiprajaḥ pīto nīlaḥ kapilapiṅgalaḥ||7||
mūtrakiṃśukabhasmāmbutailābhoṣṇabahusrutiḥ| kṣārokṣitakṣatasamavyatho rāgoṣmapākavān||8||

div.ab: Sa. pittena vraṇaḥ kṣiprodbhavaḥ pītāduguṇo mūtrādisadṛśabahusrāvaḥ kṣārokṣitatulyarujo rāgoṣmapākavān|

ab.seg: kaphena pāṇḍuḥ kaṇḍūmān bahuśvetaghanasrutiḥ| sthūloṣṭhaḥ kaṭhinaḥ snāyusirājālatato'lparuk||9||

div.ab: Sa. kaphena pāṇḍuḥ kaṇḍūyuto bahuśuklaghanasrāvaḥ sthūlauṣṭhaḥ kaṭhinastathā srāyusirājālatato'lparujaḥ|

ab.seg: pravālarakto raktena saraktaṃ pūyamudgiret| vājisthānasamo gandhe yukto liṅgaiśca paittikaiḥ||10||

div.ab: Sa. raktena vidgumalohitaḥ saraktaṃ pūyaṃ sravet| turagasthānatulyo gandhena| tathā paittikairliṅgairyutaḥ|
dbābhyāṃ tribhiśca sarvaiśca vidyāllakṣaṇasaṅkarāt| -------------------------------------------------|11|
Sa. dvābhyāṃ tribhiḥ sarvaiśca lakṣaṇānāṃ saṅkarāt saṃsargajādīn vidyāt|

-------------------------------------------------| jihvāprabho mṛduḥ ślakṣṇaḥ śyāvauṣṭhapiṭikaḥ samaḥ||11|| kiñcidunnatamadhyo vā vraṇaḥ śuddho'nupadravaḥ| -------------------------------------------------|12|
Sa. jihvāprabhādiguṇo vraṇo'nupadravaḥ śuddhaḥ syāt|

-------------------------------------------------| tvagāmiṣasirāsnāyusandhyasthīni vraṇāśayāḥ||12|| koṣṭho marma ca tānyaṣṭau duḥsādhyānyuttarottaram| -------------------------------------------------|13|
Sa. tvagādīni vraṇāśrayāstathā koṣṭho marma cetyaṣṭāvṛttarottaraṃ duḥsādhyāni|

ab.seg: -------------------------------------------------| susādhyaḥ sattvamāṃsāgnivayobalavati vraṇaḥ||13||
vṛtto dīrghastripuṭakaścaturasrākṛtiśca yaḥ| tathā sphikpāyumeḍhroṣṭhapṛṣṭhāntarvaktragaṇḍagaḥ||14||

div.ab: Sa. sattvādimati vraṇaḥ susādhyaḥ| vṛttādiguṇastathā sphigādiṣu ca susādhyaḥ|

ab.seg: kṛcchrasādhyo'kṣidaśananāsikāpāṅganābhiṣu| sevanījaṭharaśrotrapārśvakakṣāstaneṣu ca||15||

div.ab: Sa. akṣyādiṣu sthitaḥ kṛcchrasādhyaḥ|

phenapūyānilavahaḥ śalyavānūrdhvanirvamī| bhagandaro'ntarvadanastathā kaṭyasthisaṃśritaḥ||16|| kuṣṭhināṃ viṣajuṣṭānāṃ śoṣiṇāṃ madhumehinām| vraṇāḥ kṛcchreṇa sidhdyanti yeṣāṃ ca syurvraṇe vraṇāḥ||17|| naiva sidhdyanti vīsarpajvarātīsārakāsinām| pipāsūnāmanidrāṇāṃ śvāsināmavipākinām||18|| bhinne śiraḥkapāle vā mastuluṅgasya darśane| snāyukledātsirācchedādgāmbhīryātkṛmibhakṣaṇāt||19|| asthibhedātsaśalyatvātsaviṣatvādatarkitāt| mithyābandhādatisnehādraukṣyādromādighaṭṭanāt||20|| kṣobhādaśuddhakoṣṭhatvātsauhityādatikarśanāt| madyapānāddivāsvapnādvavāyādrātrijāgarāt||21|| vraṇo mithyopacārācca naiva sādhyo'pi sidhyati| -------------------------------------------------|22|

Sa. phenādivahaḥ śalyukta ūrdhvanirvamī tathā bhagandaro'ntarmukhastathā kaṭhyasthisaṃśritastathā kuṣṭhyādīnāṃ vraṇāḥ kṛcchreṇa sidhdyanti| tathā yeṣāṃ vraṇe vraṇāḥ syuste ca duḥsādhyāḥ| visarpajvarādimatāṃ vraṇā naiva siddhyanti| śiraḥkapāle ca bhinne mastuluṅgadarśane [vā] vraṇo na siddhyati| srāyukledādeḥ kāraṇāt sādhyo'pi vraṇo na siddhyati|
-------------------------------------------------| kapotavarṇapratimā yasyāntāḥ kledavarjitāḥ||22|| sthirāścipiṭikāvanto rohatīti tamādiśet| -------------------------------------------------|23|
Sa. yasya kapotavarṇābhāḥ prakledavarjitā antāḥ, tathā cipiṭikānvanto-mlānaprāyāḥ, taṃ-vraṇaṃ, rohatīti nirdiśet|

-------------------------------------------------| athātra śophāvasthāyāṃ yathāsannaṃ viśodhanam||23|| yojyaṃ śopho hi śuddhānāṃ vraṇaścāśu praśāmyati| -------------------------------------------------|24|
Sa. atra ca-vraṇe, śophāvasthāyāṃ satyāṃ yathāsannaṃ-ūrdhvamadho vā, śodhanaṃ-vamanaṃ virecanaṃ vā, yojyam| śuddhānāṃ hi śopho vraṇaśca śīghraṃ śāmyati|
-------------------------------------------------| kuryācchītopacāraṃ ca śophāvasthasya santatam||24|| doṣāgniragnivattena prayāti sahasā śamam| -------------------------------------------------|25|
Sa. śophāvasthasya satataṃ śītopacāraṃ kuryāt| tena-śītopacāreṇa kṛtena satā, doṣāgniragniriva sahasaiva śamaṃ yāti|

ab.seg: viṣayukte viśeṣeṇa jalajādyairharedasṛk| duṣṭāsre'pagate sadyaḥ śopharāgarujāṃ śamaḥ||26||

div.ab: Sa. śophe vraṇe ca kaṭhinādiguṇe viśeṣeṇa jalaukaḥprabhṛtibhirasraṃ haret| yato duṣṭarakte'panīte sadya eva śophādiśamaḥ syāt|

ab.seg: hṛte hṛte ca rudhire suśītaiḥ sparśavīryayoḥ| suślakṣṇaistadahaḥpiṣṭaiḥ kṣīrekṣusvarasadravaiḥ||27||
śatadhautaghṛtopetairmuhuranyairaśoṣibhiḥ| pratilomaṃ hito lepaḥ sekābhyaṅgāśca tatkṛtāḥ||28||

div.ab: Sa. punaḥ punaḥ srāvite ca rakte sati sparśavīryayoḥ suṣṭhu śītadravyaiḥ suślakṣṇaistasminnevāhani piṣṭaiḥ-na tu paryuṣitaiḥ, tathā kṣīrādidravaiḥ śatadhautaghṛtayuktairmuhuraparairaśoṣibhirlepo hitaḥ| pratilomaṃ-na tvanulomam| sekābhyaṅgāśca pūrvoktaiḥ kṛtā hitāḥ|

ab.seg: nyagrodhodumbarāśvatthaplakṣaveta savalkalaiḥ| pradeho bhūrisarpibhiḥ śophanirvāpaṇaḥ param||29||

div.ab: Sa. nyagrodhāditvagbhiḥ pradeho bhūrighṛtaḥ paraṃ śophanirvāpaṇaḥ|

ab.seg: vātolbaṇānāṃ stabdhānāṃ kaṭhinānāṃ mahārujām| srutāsrujāṃ ca śophānāṃ vraṇānāmapi ceddaśām||30||
ānūpavesavārādyaiḥ svedaḥ, somāstilāḥ punaḥ| bhṛṣṭā nirvāpitāḥ kṣīre tatpiṣṭā dāharuggharāḥ||31||

div.ab: Sa. vātolbaṇānāṃ tathā stabdhānāṃ kaṭhinānāṃ tīvrarujāṃ srutaraktānāṃ śophānāṃ vraṇānāmapi ceddaksvarūpāṇāṃ kuṭṭitaghṛtādi saṃskṛtānūpamāṃsādyaiḥ svedo hitaḥ| atasīyuktāstilā bhṛṣṭā dugdhe nirvāpitāstenaiva kṣīreṇa piṣṭā dāharujāghnāḥ|

ab.seg: sthirān mandarujaḥ śophān snehairvātakaphapahaiḥ| abhyajya svedayitvā ca veṇunāḍyā śanaiḥ śanaiḥ||32||
vimlāpanārthaṃ mṛdgīyāt talenāṅuṣṭhakena vā| yavagodhūmamudgaiśca siddha piṣṭaiḥ pralepayet||33||

div.ab: Sa. śophān sthirānalpapīḍān vātakaphaghnaiḥ snehairmrakṣāyitvā svedayitvā ca vaṃśanāḍyā vimlāpanārthaṃ śanaiḥ śanairmalayet| talenāṅguṣṭhakena vā malayet| yavādibhiḥ siddhapiṣṭaiḥ pradehayet|

ab.seg: vilīyate sa cennaivaṃ tatastamupanāhayet| avidagdhastathā śāntiṃ vidagdhaḥ pākamaśrute||34||

div.ab: Sa. evaṃ kṛte yadi śopho na vilīyate, tatastamupanāhayet| tathā kṛte satyavidagdhaḥ śophaṇ san śāntiṃ prāpnoti| vidagdhastu pacyate|

ab.seg: sakolatilavallomā dadhyamlā saktupiṇḍikā| sakiṇvakuṣṭhalavaṇā koṣṇā śastopanāhane||35||

div.ab: Sa. badarādiyutā saktupiṇḍikā'mladadhiyutā kiṇvādyanvitā koṣṇā upanāhe śreṣṭhā|

ab.seg: supakve piṇḍite śophe pīḍanairupapīḍite| dāraṇaṃ dāraṇārhasya sukumārasya ceṣyate||36||

div.ab: Sa. śophe supakve grathite pīḍanairdravyairupapīḍite sati dāraṇārhasya sukumārasya narasya dāraṇamiṣyate|

ab.seg: guggulvatasigodantasvarṇakṣīrīkapotaviṭ| kṣaurauṣadhāni kṣārāśca pakvaśophavidāraṇam||37||

div.ab: Sa. guglgulvādīni, tathā kṣārauṣadhāni-kṣāravidhyuktāni (hṛ.sū.a. 3018), kṣārāśca, pakvaśophavidāraṇaṃ syāt| godanto-haritālam|

ab.seg: pūyagarbhānaṇudvārān sotsaṅgānmarmagānapi| niḥsnehaiḥ pīḍanadravyaiḥ samantātpratipīḍayet||38||

div.ab: Sa. pūyagarbhān sūkṣmadvārān sotsaṅgān marmāśritān sneharahitaiḥ pīḍanadravyaiḥ paritaḥ pratipīḍayet|

ab.seg: śuṣyantaṃ samupekṣeta pralepaṃ pīḍanaṃ prati| na mukhe cainamālimpet tathā doṣaḥ prasicyate||39||

div.ab: Sa. pīḍanaṃ prati yo lepastaṃ śuṣyantaṃ samupekṣeta| mukhe cainaṃ vraṇaṃ nālimpet| tathā ca-evaṃ, doṣaḥ, prasicyate-niryāti|

ab.seg: kalāyayavagodhūmamāṣamudgahareṇavaḥ| dravyāṇāṃ picchilānāṃ ca tvaṅmūlāni prapīḍanam||40||

div.ab: Sa. kalāyādayaḥ picchilānāṃ dravyāṇāṃ tvaco mūlāni ca prapīḍanaṃ syāt|

ab.seg: saptasu kṣālanādyeṣu surasāragvadhādikau| bhṛśaṃ duṣṭe vraṇe yojyau mehakuṣṭhavraṇeṣu ca||41||

div.ab: Sa. saptasu kṣālanādiṣu-kṣālanamālepo ghṛtaṃ tailaṃ rasakriyā cūrṇo vartiśceti sapta teṣu, surasādirāragvadhādiśceti (hṛ.sū.a. 15) duṣṭe vraṇe bhṛśaṃ yojyau tathā mehādiṣu ca|

ab.seg: athavā kṣālanaṃ kvāthaḥ paṭolīnimbapatrajaḥ| aviśuddhe, viśuddhe tu vyagrodhāditvagudbhavaḥ||42||

div.ab: Sa. athavā'viśuddhe vraṇe paṭolīnimbapatrajaḥ kvāthaḥ kṣālanaṃ hitaḥ| viśuddhe tu vraṇe nyagrodhāditvagudbhavaḥ kvāthaḥ kṣālanādau hitaḥ|

ab.seg: paṭolītilayaṣṭyāhvatrivṛddantīniśādvayam| nimbapatrāṇi cālepaḥ sapaṭurvraṇaśodhanaḥ||43||

div.ab: Sa. paṭolādibhirlepaḥ saindhavayuto vraṇaśodhanaḥ|

ab.seg: vraṇān viśodhayedvartyā sūkṣmāsyān sandhimarmagān| kṛtayā trivṛtādantīlāṅgalīmadhusaindhavaiḥ||44||

div.ab: Sa. vraṇān sūkṣmamukhān sandhimarmāśritān vartyā trivṛtādibhiḥ kṛtayā viśodhayet|

ab.seg: vātābhibhūtān sāsrāvān dhūpayedugravedanān| yavajyabhūrjamadanaśrīveṣṭakasurāhvayaiḥ||45||

div.ab: Sa. vātābhibhūtān sāsrāvān dāruṇavedanān yavādibhirdhūpayet|
nirvāpayed bhṛśaṃ śītaiḥ pittaraktaviṣolbaṇān| -------------------------------------------------|46|
Sa. pittā[dya]dhikān śītairbhṛśaṃ nirvāpayet|

-------------------------------------------------| śuṣkālpamāṃse gambhīre vraṇa utsādanaṃ hitam||46|| nyagrodhapadmakādibhyāmaśvagandhābalātilaiḥ| adyānmāṃsādamāṃsāni vidhinopahitāni ca||47|| māṃsaṃ māṃsādamāṃsena vardhate śuddhacetasaḥ| -------------------------------------------------|48|
Sa. vraṇe śuṣkālpamāṃse gambhīra utsādanaṃ hitaṃ vyagrodhādibhiḥ| tathā māṃsādīnāṃ prāṇināṃ māṃsāni suṣṭhu saṃskṛtāni bhakṣayet| yataḥ śuddhamanaso māṃsādamāṃsena piśitaṃ vardhate|
Sa. vraṇānāmutsannamṛdumāṃsānāṃ jātīmukulādibhiravasādanaṃ hitam|

-------------------------------------------------| utsannamāṃsān kaṭhinān kaṇḍūyuktāṃścirotthitān||49|| vraṇān suduḥkhaśodhyāṃśca śodhayet kṣārakarmaṇā| -------------------------------------------------|50|
Sa. utsannamāṃsādikā vraṇāstathā ye tu suṣṭhu durviśodhyāstān kṣārakarmaṇā viśodhayet|

ab.seg: -------------------------------------------------| sravanto'śmarijā mūtraṃ ye cānye raktavāhinaḥ||50||
chinnāśca sandhayo yeṣāṃ yathoktairye ca śodhanaiḥ| śodhyamānā na śudhdyanti śodhyāḥ syuste'gnikarmaṇā||51||

div.ab: Sa. aśmarijā vraṇā mūtraṃ sravanto, ye cānye raktavāhino, yeṣāṃ ca sandhayaschināḥ, ye ca yathoktaiḥ śodhanaiḥ śodhyamānā na śuddhyanti, te'gnikarmaṇā śodhyāḥ syuḥ|
śuddhānāṃ ropaṇaṃ yojyamutsādāya yadīritam| -------------------------------------------------|52|
Sa. yadutsādārthaṃ dravyaṃ kathitaṃ tadeva śuddhānāṃ vraṇānāṃ ropaṇaṃ yojyam|

-------------------------------------------------| aśvagandhā ruhā rodhraṃ kaṭphalaṃ madhuyaṣṭikā||52|| samaṅgā dhātakīpuṣpaṃ paramaṃ vraṇaropaṇam| -------------------------------------------------|53|
Sa. aśvagandhādikaṃ vraṇaropaṇaṃ param|
-------------------------------------------------| apetapūtimāṃsānāṃ māṃsasthānāmarohatām||53|| kalkaṃ saṃrohaṇaṃ kuryāt tilānāṃ madhikānvitam| -------------------------------------------------|54|
Sa. apagatapūtimāṃsānāṃ māṃsasthānāṃ vraṇānāmarohatāṃ tilakalkaṃ samadhukaṃ saṃrohaṇaṃ kuryāt|

ab.seg: -------------------------------------------------| snigdhoṣṇatiktamadhurakaṣāyatvaiḥ sa sarvajit||54||
sa kṣaudranimbapatrābhyāṃ yuktaḥ saṃśodhanaṃ param| pūrvābhyāṃ sarpiṣā cāsau yuktaḥ syādāśu ropaṇaḥ||55||

div.ab: Sa. eṣa tilakalkaḥ snigdhādiguṇaiḥ sarvarogajit| sa mākṣikanimbapatrābhyāṃ yutastilakalkaḥ paraṃ saṃśodhanam| pūrvābhyāṃ-kṣaudranimbapatrābhyāṃ, sarpiṣā cāsau tilakalko yutaḥ śīghraṃ saṃrohaṇaḥ syāt|
tilavadyavakalkaṃ tu kecidicchanti tadvidaḥ| -------------------------------------------------|56|
Sa. kecid vraṇasvarūpābhijñā yavakalkaṃ tilakalkavadicchanti|

ab.seg: -------------------------------------------------| sāsrapittaviṣāgantugambhīrān soṣmaṇo vraṇān||56||
kṣīraropaṇabhaiṣajyaśṛtenājyena ropayet| ropaṇauṣadhasiddhena tailena kaphavātajān||57||

div.ab: Sa. sāsrapittādīn vraṇān kṣīrayuktaropaṇadravyapakvena ghṛtena ropayet| ropaṇadravyasiddhena tailena kaphavātotthān ropayet|

ab.seg: kācchīrodhrābhayāsarjasindūrāñjanatutthakam| cūrṇitaṃ tailamadanairyuktaṃ ropaṇamuttamam||58||

div.ab: Sa. kāchchyādikaṃ sūkṣmarajīkṛtaṃ tailamadanairyuktaṃ ropaṇam|
samānāṃ sthiramāṃsānāṃ tvaksthānāṃ cūrṇa iṣyate| -------------------------------------------------|59|
Sa. saṃ-samānāṃ vraṇānāṃ sthiramāṃsānāṃ tvaksthānāṃ cūrṇamiṣṭam|

-------------------------------------------------| kakubhodumbarāśvatthajambūkaṭphalarodhrajaiḥ||59|| tvacamāśu nigṛhṇanti tvakcūrṇaiścūrṇitā vraṇāḥ| -------------------------------------------------|60|
Sa. saṃ-kakubhādijaiścūrṇairvraṇāścūrṇitāḥ śīghrameva tvacaṃ nigṛhṇananti|

-------------------------------------------------| lākṣāmanohvāmañjiṣṭhāharitālaniśādvayaiḥ||60|| pralepaḥ saghṛtakṣaudrastvagviśuddhikaraḥ param| -------------------------------------------------|61|
Sa. saṃ-lākṣādibhirghṛtakṣaudrasahito lepaḥ paraṃ tvagviśuddhikaraḥ|
-------------------------------------------------| kālīyakalatāmrāsthihemakālārasottamaiḥ||61|| lepaḥ sagomayarasaḥ savarṇakaraṇaḥ param| -------------------------------------------------|62|
Sa. kālīyakādibhirlepaḥ sagośakṛdrasaḥ paraṃ savarṇakaraṇaḥ|

ab.seg: -------------------------------------------------| dagdho vāraṇadanto'ntardhūmaṃ tailaṃ rasāñjanam||62||
romasañjanano lepastadvattailapariplutā| catuṣpānnakharomāsthitvakśṛṅgakhurajā maṣī||63||

div.ab: Sa. vāraṇadanto'ntardhūmaṃ dagdhastailaṃ rasāñjanaṃ ca lepo romodbhavakaraḥ| tathaiva tailapariplutā catuṣpānnakhādijā maṣī pūrvaguṇā|
vraṇinaḥ śastrakarmoktaṃ pathyāpathyānnamādiśet| -------------------------------------------------|64|
Sa. vraṇinaḥ śastrakarmavidhikathitaṃ (hṛ.sū.a. 29/34) pathyāpathyānnamādiśet|

ab.seg: -------------------------------------------------| dve pañcamūle vargaśca vātaghno vātike hitaḥ||64||
nyagrodhapadmakādyau tu tadvatpittapradūṣite| āragvadhādiḥ śleṣmaghnaḥ kaphe, miśrāstu miśraje||65||

div.ab: Sa. dve pañcamūle tathā vargo vātaghno vātādhike hitaḥ| tathā paittike nyagrodhādipadmakādī(hṛ.sū.a. 15/49 a. 15/12) hitau| ślaiṣmika āragvadhādiḥ (hṛ.sū.a. 15/17) kaphaghno hitaḥ| miśre tu miśra upakramo hitaḥ|

ab.seg: ebhiḥ prakṣālanaṃ lepo ghṛtaṃ tailaṃ rasakriyā| cūrṇo vartiśca saṃyojyā vraṇe sapta yathāyatham||66||

div.ab: Sa. ebhiḥ-pūrvoktaiḥ, prakṣālanādayaḥ sapta vraṇe sati yathāsvaṃ yojyāḥ|

jātīnimbapaṭolapatrakaṭukādārvīniśāsārivā- mañjiṣṭhābhayasikthatutthamadhukairnaktāhvabījānvitaiḥ| sarpiḥ sādhyamanena sūkṣmavadanā marmāśritāḥ kledino gambhīrāḥ sarujo vraṇāḥ sagatayaḥ śudhdyanti rohanti ca|67| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭa- viracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne vraṇapratiṣedho nāma pañcaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ|25|

Sa. saṃ-jātyādibhiḥ sarpiḥ sādhyam| abhayaṃ-uśīramatra| anena sarpiṣā sūkṣmamukhā marmasthādayaśca vraṇāḥ śuddhyanti rohanti ceti| śārdūlavikrīḍitaṃ vṛttam| iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdaya- ṭīkāyāṃ sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne vraṇaprati- ṣedho nāma pañcaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 25||

div.head: sadyovranapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ
div.ab: Sa. vraṇaprakramāt sadyovraṇapratiṣedhaṃ vyācikhyāsurāha-

ab.seg: athātaḥ sadyovraṇapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre|2| ) sadyovraṇā ye sahasā sambhavantyabhighātataḥ| anantairapi tairaṅgamucyate juṣṭamaṣṭadhā||1||

div.ab: Sa. abhighātātsahasaiva ye sadyovraṇā jāyante, asaṅkhyairapi tairvraṇaiḥ śarīraṃ juṣṭamaṣṭadhā kathyate|
tānevāṣṭau prakārānāha ---- ghṛṣṭāvakṛttavicchinnapravilambitapātitam| viddhaṃ bhinnaṃ vidalitaṃ-------------------|2|
Sa. ghṛṣṭetyādi|

ab.seg: raktaleśena vā yuktaṃ saploṣaṃ chedanāt sravet| avagāḍhaṃ tataḥ kṛttaṃ, vicchinnaṃ syāttato'pi ca||3||
pravilambi saśeṣe'sthni, patitaṃ pātitaṃ tanoḥ| sūkṣmāsyaśalyaviddhaṃ tu viddhaṃ koṣṭhavivarjitam||4||
bhinnamanyadvidalitaṃ majjaraktapariplutam| prahārapīḍanotpeṣāt sahāsthnā pṛthutāṃ gatam||5||

div.ab: Sa. teṣu madhye ghṛṣṭaṃ lasīkayā raktaleśena vā yuktaṃ sravet, chedanāt saploṣam| tasmādavagāḍhamavakṛttaṃ syāt| tato'pyavagāḍhataraṃ vicchinnaṃ syāt| pravilambi saśeṣāsthi yat| patitaṃ yaccharīrāt tat pātitaṃ syāt| sūkṣmamukhaśalyaviddhaṃ yattat viddhaṃ kthyate koṣṭhavivarjitam| anyat koṣṭhe yadviddhaṃ tadbhinnamucyate| vidalitaṃ tad gadyate yanmajjaraktapariplutaṃ prahārādibhiḥ sahāsthnā pṛthutāṃ gatam|

ab.seg: sadyaḥ sadyovraṇaṃ siñcedatha yaṣṭyāhvasarpiṣā| tīvravyathaṃ kavoṣṇena balātailena vā punaḥ||6||

div.ab: Sa. atha evaṃ vraṇasvarūpatāṃ jñātvā, sadya eveti sadyovraṇaṃ tīvravyathaṃ madhuyaṣṭīghṛtena koṣṇena siñcet| balātailena (hṛ.śā.a. 2/47) vā koṣṇena punaḥ punaḥ siñcet|

ab.seg: kṣatoṣmaṇo nigrahārthaṃ tatkālaṃ visṛtasya ca| kaṣāyaśītamadhurasnigdhā lepādayo hetāḥ||7||

div.ab: Sa. kṣatoṣmaṇaśca śāntaye tatkālanirgatasya ca kaṣāyādayo lepādyāḥ śasyante|

ab.seg: sadyovraṇeṣvāyateṣu sandhānārthaṃ viśeṣataḥ| madhusarpiśca yuñjīta pittaghnīśca himāḥ kriyāḥ||8||

div.ab: Sa. sadyovraṇeṣvāyateṣu sandhānāRthaṃ viśeṣeṇa mākṣikaṃ saghṛtaṃ yuñjīta| tathā pittaghnīśca śītāḥ kriyā hitāḥ|

ab.seg: sasaṃrambheṣu kartavyamūrdhvaṃ cādhaśca śodhanam| upavāso hitaṃ bhuktaṃ pratataṃ raktamokṣaṇam||9||

div.ab: Sa. sasaṃrambheṣu vraṇeṣūrdhvamadhaśca śodhanaṃ kāryam| tathopavāso vidhātavyaḥ| avasthāvaśāt pūrvoktaṃ bhojanaṃ hitam| tathā pratataṃ raktasrāvaṇaṃ hitam|

ab.seg: ghṛṣṭe vidalite caiṣa sutarāmiṣyate vidhiḥ| tayorhyalpaṃ sravatyasraṃ pākastenāśu jāyate||10||

div.ab: Sa. ghṛṣṭe vidalite ca eṣā pūrvoktā cikitsā iṣyate| yasmāttayoḥ-ghṛṣṭavidalitayoḥ, asramalpaṃ sravati| tena ca kāreṇena tayorāśu śīghraṃ pāko jāyate|

ab.seg: atyarthamasraṃ sravati prāyaśo'nyatra vikṣate| tato raktakṣayādvāyau kupite'tirujākare||11||
snehapānaparīṣekasvedalepopanāhanam| snehabastiṃ ca kurvīta vātaghnauṣadhasādhitam||12||

div.ab: Sa. anyatra vikṣate bāhulyena bahu raktaṃ sravati| na ca pākaṃ yāti| anantaramatyantaraktasrāvāt pavane kupite'tirujākare sati snehapānādikaṃ snehabastiṃ ca vātaharauṣadhasādhitaṃ kurvīta|

ab.seg: iti sāptāhikaḥ proktaḥ sadyovraṇahito vidhiḥ| saptāhādgatavege tu pūrvoktaṃ vidhimācaret||13||

div.ab: Sa. iti-evaṃ, sāptāhikaḥ sadyovraṇahito vidhiruktaḥ| saptāhena nivṛtta iti "prāgvahateṣṭhak" iti ṭhak| saptāhādūrdhvaṃ gatakṣobhe sati pūrvoktaṃ vidhiṃ-vraṇapratiṣedhoktaṃ, kuryāt|
prāyaḥ sāmānyakarmedaṃ vakṣyate tu pṛthakpṛthak| ---------------------------------------------------|14|
Sa. prāyo bāhulyena sadyovraṇa etatsāmānyaṃ karma| pṛthakpṛthag viśeṣeṇa karma bhaṇiṣyate|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------------| ghṛṣṭe rujaṃ nigṛhyāśu vraṇe cūrṇāni yojayet||14||

div.ab: Sa. ghṛṣṭe vraṇe pīḍāṃ prāgupaśamayya cūrṇāni yojayet|
Sa. avakṛtte punarvraṇe kalkādīni yojayet|

ab.seg: -------------------------vicchinnapravilambinoḥ| sīvanaṃ vidhinoktena bandhanaṃ cānu pīḍanam||15||

div.ab: Sa. vicchinne pravilambani ca vraṇe sīvanaṃ pūrvoktena vidhānena, tathā bandhanaṃ pīḍanaṃ ca paścād yojayet|

ab.seg: asādhyaṃ sphuṭitaṃ netramadīrṇaṃ lambate tu yat| sanniveśya yathāsthānamavyāviddhasiraṃ bhiṣak||16||
pīḍayet pāṇinā padmapalāśāntaritena tat| tato'sya secane nasye tarpaṇe ca hitaṃ haviḥ||17||
vipakvamājaṃ yaṣṭyāhvajīvakarṣabhakotpalaiḥ| sapayaskaiḥ paraṃ tadvi sarvanetrābhighātajit||18||

div.ab: Sa. sphuṭitaṃ locanamasādhyam| asphuṭitaṃ tu yannetramavadīrṇaṃlambate, tat sve sthāne sanniveśyāvyāvidhasiraṃ padmapatrāntaritena hastena pīḍayet| anantaramasyāturasya ghṛtaṃ chāgaṃ sakṣīrairyaṣṭyādibhiḥ kalkaiḥ pakvaṃ secanādau hitam| yatastad ghṛtaṃ paraṃ sarvanetrābhighātajit|

ab.seg: galapīḍā'vasanne'kṣṇi vamanotkāsanakṣavāḥ| prāṇāyamo'thavā kāryaḥ kriyā ca kṣatanetravat||19||

div.ab: Sa. galapīḍanamavasanne netre vamanādayaḥ kāryāḥ, prāṇāyāmo vā| tathā kṣanetrakriyā cātra hitā|
karṇe sthānāccyute syūte śrotastailena pūrayet| ---------------------------------------------------|20|
Sa. karṇe sthānād bhraṣṭe syūte sati tailena śrotaḥ pūrayet|

---------------------------------------------------| kṛkāṭikāyāṃ chinnāyāṃ nirgacchatyapi mārute||20|| samaṃ niveśya badhnīyāt syūtvā śīghraṃ nirantaram| ājena sarpiṣā cātra pariṣekaḥ praśasyate||21|| uttāno'nnāni bhuñjīta, śayīta ca suyantritaḥ| ---------------------------------------------------|22|
Sa. kṛkāṭikāyāṃ chinnāyāṃ vāte'pi niryāte sati samaṃ sthāpayitvā syūtvā ca nirantaraṃ śīghraṃ badhnīyāt| atrājena ghṛtena ca pariṣekaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ| uttānāḥ san bhojanaṃ bhuñjīta| suyantritaśca svapyāt|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------------| ghātaṃ śākhāsu tiryaksthaṃ gātre samyaṅniveśite||22||
syūtvā vellitabandhena badhnīyāddhanavāsasā| carmaṇā goṣphaṇābandhaḥ kāryaścāsaṅgate vraṇe||23||

div.ab: Sa. śākhāsu hatamāturaṃ tiryaksthitaṃ śarīre samyaksthāpite syūtvā vellitabandhena ghanena vāsasā badhnīyāt| asaṅgate vraṇe carmaṇā goṣphaṇābandho vidheyaḥ|

ab.seg: pādau vilambimuṣkasya prokṣya netre ca vāriṇā| praveśya vṛṣaṇau sīvyet sevanyā tunnasaṃjñayā||24||
kāryaśca goṣphaṇābandhaḥ kaṭyāmāveśya paṭṭakam| snehasekaṃ na kurvīta tatra klidyati hi vraṇaḥ||25||

div.ab: Sa. vilambumuṣkasya pādau netre ca vāriṇā prekṣya vṛṣaṇau praveśya sīvyet| katham ? tunnasaṃjñayā sevanyā| tathā kaṭyāṃ paṭṭakamāsajya goṣphaṇābandhaṃ kuryāt| snehasekaṃ na kurvīta| yataḥ snehaseke satyasmin vraṇaḥ klidyati|

ab.seg: kālānusāryagurvelājātīcandanaparpaṭaiḥ| śilādārvyamṛtātutthaiḥ siddhaṃ tailaṃ ca ropaṇam||26||

div.ab: Sa. kālānusāryādibhiḥ kalkitaiḥ pakvaṃ tailaṃ vṛṣaṇayo ropaṇam|

ab.seg: chinnāṃ niḥśeṣataḥ śākhāṃ dagdhvā tailena yuktitaḥ| badhnīyāt kośabandhena tato vraṇavadācaret||27||

div.ab: Sa. niḥśeṣeṇa chinnāṃ śākhāṃ dagdhvā tailena yuktyā kośabandhena badhnīyāt| anantaraṃ vraṇamivācaret|
kāryā śalyāhṛte viddhe bhaṅgādvidalite kriyā| ---------------------------------------------------|28|
Sa. viddhe śalyāhṛte sati bhaṅgādvidalite kriyā kāryā|

ab.seg: mastuluṅgasruteḥ kruddho hanyādenaṃ calo'nyathā| vraṇe rohati caikaikaṃ śanairapanayetkacam||29||

div.ab: Sa. śirasaḥ śalye nipatite sati vālavartiṃ praveśayet| anyathā-vālavarterapraveśāt, mastuluṅgasrāvādvāyuḥ ṛddhaḥ enaṃ- vraṇinaṃ, hanyāt| vraṇe rohati satyekaikaṃ kacaṃ śanairnayet|
ācaramocchvāsādāturaṃ samupācarediti vacanānmastuluṅgasrutāvapyupakramamāha ---- mastuluṅgasrutau khādenmastiṣkānanyajīvajān| ---------------------------------------------------|30|
Sa. mastuluṅgasya-majjākhyasya, srutāvanyajīvajān mastiṣkān khādet|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------------| śalye hṛte'ṅgādanyasmātsnehavartiṃ nidhāpayet||30||

div.ab: Sa. aṅgādanyasmācchalye hṛte sati tatra vraṇe snehavartiṃ nidhāpayet|

ab.seg: dūrāvagāḍhāḥ sūkṣmāsyā ye vraṇāḥ srutaśoṇitāḥ| secayeccakratailena sūkṣmanetrārpitena tān||31||

div.ab: Sa. ye vraṇā dūrāvagāḍhādiguṇāstāṃścakratailena-kohlakādyudbhavena tailena, secayet| kimbhūtena ? sūkṣmanetreṇārpitena-kṣiptena|

ab.seg: bhinne koṣṭhe'sṛjā pūrṇe mūrcchāhṛtpārśvavedanāḥ| jvaro dāhastṛḍādhmānaṃ bhaktasyānabhinandanam||32||
saṅgo viṇmūtramarutāṃ śvāsaḥ svedo'kṣiraktatā| lohagandhitvamāsyasya syād gātre ca vigandhatā||33||

div.ab: Sa. bhinne koṣṭhe raktena pūrṇe sati mūrcchādyāḥ syuḥ|

ab.seg: āmāśayasthe rudhire rudhiraṃ chardayatyapi| ādhmānenātimātreṇa śūlena ca viśasyate||34||

div.ab: Sa. āmāśayasthe rudhire raktamudvamatyapyādhmānenātimātreṇa śūlena ca viśasyate-vyāpadyate|

ab.seg: pakvāśayasthe rudhire saśūlaṃ gauravaṃ bhavet| nābheradhastācchītatvaṃ khebhyo raktasya cāgamaḥ||35||

div.ab: Sa. pakvāśayasthe lohite śūlasahitaṃ gauravaṃ bhavet| nābheradhobhāge śaityam| chidrebhyo rudhirasyaivāgamanam|

ab.seg: abhinno'pyāśayaḥ sūkṣmaiḥ srotobhirabhipūryate| asṛjā syandamānena pārśve mūtreṇa bastivat||36||

div.ab: Sa. āśayo'bhinno'pi sūkṣmaiḥ srotobhirlohitena syandamānenābhipūryate| pārśve mūtreṇa bastiriva|

ab.seg: tatrāntarlohitaṃ śītapādocchvāsakarānanam| raktākṣaṃ pāṇḍuvadanamānaddhaṃ ca vivarjayet||37||

div.ab: Sa. teṣu madhye'ntarlohitaṃ vraṇinaṃ śītapādaṃ śītocchvāsaṃ śiśirakaraṃ śītavakraṃ lohitākṣaṃ pāṇḍuvadanamānaddhaṃ ca varjayet|
