ab.seg: amāśayasthe vamanaṃ hitaṃ, pakvāśayāśrite| virecanaṃ nirūhaṃ ca niḥsnehoṣṇairviśodhanaiḥ||38||

div.ab: Sa. āmāśayasthe rakte vamanaṃ hitam| pakvāśayagate virecanaṃ nirūhaṃ ca vigatasnehairuṣṇaiśca viśodhanairhitam|

ab.seg: yavakolakulatthānāṃ rasaiḥ snehavivarjitaiḥ| bhuñjītānnaṃ yavāgūṃ vā pibetsaindhavasaṃyutām||39||

div.ab: Sa. yavādīnāṃ rasaiḥ sneharahitairannaṃ bhakṣayet| peyāṃ saindhavānvitāṃ vā pibet|
atiniḥsrutaraktastu bhinnakoṣṭhaḥ pibedasṛk| ---------------------------------------------------|40|
Sa. atiniḥsrutalohito bhinnakoṣṭho rudhiraṃ pibet|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------------| kliṣṭacchinnāntrabhedena koṣṭhabhedo dvidhā smṛtaḥ||40||
mūrcchādayo'lpāḥ prathamedvitīye tvati bādhakāḥ| kliṣṭāntraḥ saṃśayī dehī chinnāntro naiva jīvati||41||

div.ab: Sa. klinnāntrabhedena bhinnāntrabhedena ca koṣṭhabhedo dviprakāra uktaḥ| prathame-klinnāntrākhye, mūrcchadayo'lpāḥ-kiñcideva, syuḥ| dvitīye-bhinnāntrākhye, atiśayena bādhakāḥ syuḥ| klinnāntro dehī saṃśayī syād jīvane| bhinnāntro na jātu jīvati|

ab.seg: yathāsvaṃ mārgamāpannā yasya viṇmūtramārutāḥ| vyupadravaḥ sa bhinne'pi koṣṭhe jīvatyasaṃśayam||42||

div.ab: Sa. yasya viṇmūtramārutā yathāyathaṃ mārgaṃ prāptāḥ vigatopadravaśca sa naro bhinnakoṣṭho'pi san jīvati|

ab.seg: abhinnamantraṃ niṣkrāntaṃ praveśyaṃ na tvato'nyathā| utpaṅgilaśirograstaṃ tadapyeke vadanti tu||43||
prakṣālya payasā digdhaṃ tṛṇaśoṇitapāṃsubhiḥ| praveśayetklṛptanakho ghṛtenāktaṃ śanaiḥ śanaiḥ||44||

div.ab: Sa. antramabhinnaṃ niṣkrāntaṃ praveśanīyamantare| na tvato'nyathā-bhinnamityarthaḥ| anye tvevamācakṣate,-utpaṅgilaśirasāmarkoṭaśīrṣeṇa, grastaṃ bhinnamapyantraṃ praveśyam| saṃ-antraṃ niṣkrāntaṃ tṛṇādibhirdigdhaṃ payasā prakṣālya sarpiṣā'bhyaktaṃ klṛptanakhaḥ śanaiḥ śanaiḥ praveśayet|
kṣīreṇārdrīkṛtaṃ śuṣkaṃ bhūrisarpiḥpariplutam| aṅgulyā pramṛśetkaṇṭhaṃ jalenodvejayedapi||45|| tathā'ntrāṇi viśantyantastatkālaṃ pīḍayanti ca| ---------------------------------------------------|46|
Sa. śuṣkamantraṃ kṣīreṇārdrīkṛtaṃ bahughṛtapariplutamaṅgulyā galaṃ pramṛśet jalenodvejayet| tathā-evaṃ, antrāṇyantaḥ praviśanti tatkālaṃ ca pīḍayanti|

---------------------------------------------------| vraṇasaukṣmyādbahutvādvā koṣṭhamantramanāviśat||46|| tatpramāṇena jaṭharaṃ pāṭayitvā praveśayet| yathāsthānaṃ sthite samyagantre sīvyedanu vraṇam||47|| sthānādapetamādatte jīvitaṃ kupitaṃ ca tat| veṣṭayitvā'nu paṭṭena ghṛtena pariṣecayet||48|| pāyayeta tataḥ koṣṇaṃ citrātailayutaṃ payaḥ| mṛdukriyārthaṃ śakṛto vāyoścādhaḥpravṛttaye||49|| anuvarteta varṣaṃ ca yathoktāṃ vraṇayantraṇām| ---------------------------------------------------|50|

Sa. vraṇasūkṣmātvādantrasya bahutvāt [vā] koṣṭhamanāviśadantraṃ jaṭharaṃ tatpramāṇena pāṭayitvā praveśayet| yathāsthānaṃ sthite samyagantre sati paścād vraṇaṃ sīvyet| sthānāccyutamantraṃ jīvitaṃ harati| kupitaṃ ca tat-antraṃ, paṭṭena veṣṭayitvā paścādghṛtena pariṣecayet| anantaraṃ citrātailānvitaṃ koṣṇaṃ kṣīraṃ pibet| śakṛto mRṛdūkaraṇāya pavamānasya ca pravartanāya| yathoktāṃ ca vraṇayantraṇāṃ saṃvatsaraṃ yāvadanuvarteta|

ab.seg: avakīrya kaṣāyairvā ślakṣṇairmūlaistataḥ samam| dṛḍhaṃ badhvā ca sūtreṇa varddhayetkuśalo bhiṣak||51||
tīkṣṇenāgniprataptena śastreṇa sakṛdeva tu| syāndanyathā rugāṭopo mṛtyurvā chidyamānayā||52||
sakṣaudre ca vraṇe baddhe sujīrṇe'nne ghṛtaṃ pibet| kṣīraṃ vā śarkarācitrālākṣāgokṣurakaiḥ śṛtam||53||
rugdāhajitsayaṣṭyāhvaiḥ paraṃ pūrvodito vidhiḥ| medogranthyuditaṃ tatra tailamabhyañjane hitam||54||

div.ab: Sa. jaṭharānmedaso vartiṃ nirgatāṃ bhasmanā vā mṛdā'vakīryāthavā ślakṣṇacūrṇaiḥ kaṣāyairmūlairavakīrya tato mūlena samaṃ dṛḍhaṃ ca kṛtvā sūtreṇa badhvā tīkṣṇena vahniprataptena śastreṇa kuśalo vaidyaḥ sakṛdeva varddhayet| anyathā chinnayā rujā''ṭopo mṛtyurvā syāt| tato vraṇe samākṣike baddhe'nne ca sujīrṇe sati ghṛtaṃ pibet| athavā śarkarādibhiḥ śṛtaṃ dugdhaṃ pibet| tacca ghṛtaṃ kṣīraṃ vā rujādāhahṛt| anantaraṃ pūrvokto vidhiḥ| tatra medogranthiṣu kathitaṃ tailamabhyañjane hitam|
tālīsaṃ padmakaṃ māṃsīhareṇvagurucandanam| haridre padmabījāni sośīraṃ madhukaṃ ca taiḥ||55|| pakvaṃ sadyovraṇeṣūktaṃ tailaṃ ropaṇamuttamam| ---------------------------------------------------|56|
Sa. tālīsādibhiḥ kalkitaiḥ pakvaṃ tailaṃ sadyovraṇeṣu ropaṇaṃ paramuktam|

---------------------------------------------------| gūḍhaprahārābhihate patite viṣamoccakaiḥ||56|| kāryaṃ vātāsrajit tṛptimardanābhyañjanādikam| ---------------------------------------------------|57|
Sa. gūḍhaprahāreṇābhihate, tathā viṣamaṃ patite, tathoccakaiḥ patite ca, vātaraktaharādikaṃ kāryam|

---------------------------------------------------| viśliṣṭadehaṃ mathitaṃ kṣīṇaṃ marmāhataṃ hatam|57| vāsayettailapūrṇāyāṃ droṇyāṃ māṃsarasāśinam| 57 1/2| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnūśrīmadvāgbhaṭavira- citāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttara- sthāne sadyovraṇapratiṣedho nāma ṣa- ḍviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ|26|

Sa. viśliṣṭadehādikaṃ naraṃ tailadroṇyāṃ māṃsarasāśinaṃ vāsayediti| iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyāmāṣṭāṅgahṛdayaṭī- kāyāṃ sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne sadyovraṇaprati- ṣedho nāma ṣaḍviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 26||

div.head: bhaṅgapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ
div.ab: Sa. asmādanantaraṃ kramaprāpto bhaṅgapratiṣedhaḥ śasyate _

athāto bhaṅgapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre||2|| ) pātaghātādibhirdvedhā bhaṅgo'sthnāṃ sandhyasandhitaḥ| prasāraṇākuñcanayoraśaktiḥ sandhimuktatā||1|| itarasmin bhṛśaṃ śophaḥ sarvavasthāsvativyathā| aśaktiśceṣṭite'lpe'pi pīḍyamāne saśabdatā||2|| samāsāditi bhaṅgasya lakṣaṇaṃ, bahudhā tu tat| bhidyate bhaṅgabhedena tasya sarvasya sādhanam||3|| yathā syādupayogāya tathā tadupadekṣyate| ----------------------------------------------------|4|

Sa. pātādibhirasthnāṃ bhaṅgaḥ| sa ca dvedhā-dviprakāraḥ, sandhīnāṃ bhaṅgo'sandhervā| sandhibhaṅge prasāraṇa ākuñcane cāśaktiḥ sandhimuktatā ca| itarasmin-asandhibhaṅge, atiśophaḥ, sarvāsvavasthāsvatiśayena rujā, alpe'pi ceṣṭite'śaktiḥ, pīḍyamāne ca saśabdatā, syāt| iti saṅkṣepeṇa bhaṅgasya lakṣaṇamuktam| taccabhaṅgabhedenānekadhā bhidyate| saṃ-tasya-bhaṅgasya, sarvasya sādhanaṃ-cikitsitaṃ, yathopayogāya syāt tathopadekṣyate|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------------| prajyāṇudāri yattvasthi sparśe śabdaṃ karoti yat||4||
yatrāsthileśaḥ praviśenmadhyamasthno vidāritaḥ| bhagnaṃ yaccābhighātena kiñcidevāvaśeṣitam||5||
unnamyamānaṃ kṣatavadyacca majjani majjati| tadduḥsādhyaṃ kṛśāśaktavātalālpāśināmapi||6||
bhinnaṃ kapālaṃ yat kaṭyāṃ sandhimuktaṃ cyutaṃ ca yat| jaghanaṃ prati piṣṭaṃ ca bhagnaṃ yattadvivarjayet||7||

div.ab: Sa. prājyāśca te'ṇavaśca prājyāṇavaḥ,-prabhūtasūkṣmāḥ| tairdrārāḥ-dāraṇāni, vidyante yatrāsthni tat| prabhūtāṇudāri yadasthi tadduḥsādhyam| yaccāsthi sparśe-sparśane sati, śabdaṃ karoti tacca duḥsādhyam| yatrāsthileśo dāritaḥ-pāṭitaḥ, asthnāṃ madhyaṃ praviśet tacca duḥsādhyam| yaccābhighātena bhagnam| kimbhūtam ? kiñcidevāvaśeṣitaṃ bhavet, tacca duḥsādhyam| yacconnamyamānaṃ kṣatasamaṃ syāt, tacca duḥsādhyam| tathā yanmajjani majjati, tathā kṛśādīnāmapi yat, tacca duḥsādhyam| saṃ-kaṭyāṃ-kaṭipradeśe, yatkapālaṃ bhinnaṃ vidāritaṃ yacca sandhivimuktaṃ yacca sandheścayutaṃ yacca jaghanaṃ prati piṣṭaṃ bhagnaṃ ca yat tadvivarjayet-pariharet|

asaṃśliṣṭakapālaṃ ca lalāṭaṃ cūrṇitam tathā| yacca bhagnaṃ bhavecchaṅkhaśiraḥpṛṣṭhastanāntare||8|| samyagyamitamapyasthi durnyāsāddurnibandhanāt| saṅkṣobhādapi yadgacchedvikriyāṃ tadvivarjayet||9|| ādito yacca durjātamasthisandhirathāpi vā| taruṇāsthīni bhujyante, bhajyante nalakāni tu||10|| kapālāni vibhidyante, sphuṭantyanyāni bhūyasā| ----------------------------------------------------|11|

Sa. lalāṭamasaṃśliṣṭakapālaṃ-bhinnaṃ, cūrṇitaṃ ca nopakramet| śaṅkhaśiraḥpṛṣṭhastanānāṃ madhye yacchinnaṃ bhavet, tacca varjayet| saṃ-tathā'sthi samyaguddhṛtamapi durnyāsādinā yad vikriyāṃ gacchet, tacca varjayet| āditaḥ-prathamameva, yaccāsthi durjātaṃ-asamyagutpannaṃ syāt, tacca duḥsādhyam| athavā'sthisandhiryo durjātaḥ syāt, sa ca duḥsādhyaḥ| durjātaṃ ca durjātaśca durjātam| "napuṃsakamanapuṃsakena" ityekaśeṣaḥ| saṃ-tathā taruṇāsthīni-nāsākarṇākṣikoṣāṇi, bhujyante-kuṭilīkriyante| tathā nalakāni bhaṅgaṃ yānti| kapālāni ca vidāryante| anyāni cāsthīni bāhulyena sphuṭanti| etatsarvaṃ duḥsādhyam|

----------------------------------------------------| athāvanatamunnamyamunnataṃ cāvapīḍayet||11|| ācchedatikṣiptamadhogataṃ copari vartayet| āñchanotpīḍanonnāmacarmasaṅkṣepabandhanaiḥ||12|| sandhīn śarīragān sarvān calānapyacalānapi| ityetaiḥ sthāpanopāyaiḥ samyak saṃsthāpya niścalam||13|| paṭṭaiḥ prabhūtasarpirbhirveṣṭayitvā sukhaistataḥ| kadambodumbarāśvatthasarjārjunapalāśajaiḥ||14|| vaṃśodbhavairvā pṛthubhistanubhiḥ suniveśitaiḥ| suślakṣṇaiḥ sapratistambhairvalkalaiḥ śakalairapi||15|| kuśāhvayaiḥ samaṃ bandhaṃ paṭṭasyopari yojayet| ----------------------------------------------------|16|

Sa. atha-eṣāṃ bhaṅgasthitiṃ jñātvā, avanatamasthyunnamanīyam| unnataṃ cāsthyavapīḍayet| atikṣiptamasthyāñchet| adhastādgataṃ copari vartayet| saṃ-iti-evaṃprakāraiḥ, etaiḥ-āñchanādibhiḥ sthāpanopāyaiḥ, sarvāñcharīragān sandhīṃścalānacalāṃśca niścalaṃ saṃsthāpya vastrakhaṇḍajaiḥ paṭṭairbahusarpiṣkaiḥ sukhāvahairveṣṭayitvā'nantaraṃ kadambādijairvalkalairvaṃśotthairvā śakalaiḥ-khaṇḍaiḥ, vistīrṇaistathā tanubhiḥ-na tu sthūlaiḥ, suniveśitaistathā komalaistathā pratistambhayuktaiḥ kuśāsaṃjñaiḥ samaṃ bandhaṃ paṭṭasyopari kuryāt|

----------------------------------------------------| śithilena hi bandhena sandhisthairyaṃ na jāyate||16|| gāḍhenāti rujādāhapākaśvayathusambhavaḥ| ----------------------------------------------------|17|
Sa. ślathena bandhena sandheḥ sthairyaṃ na sampadyate| atigāḍhena tu bandhena rujādyudbhavaḥ|

----------------------------------------------------| tryahāttryahādṛtau gharme saptāhānmokṣayeddhime||17|| sādhāraṇe tu pañcahād bhaṅgadoṣavaśena vā| ----------------------------------------------------|18|
Sa. uṣṇe ṛtau tryahāttryahānmokṣayet| śīte ca ṛtau saptāhānmokṣayet| sādhāraṇe-śaradvasantākhye, pañcahānmokṣayet| athavā bhāṅgavaśena doṣavaśena mokṣayet|

----------------------------------------------------| nyagrodhādikaṣāyeṇa tataḥ śītena secayet||18|| taṃ pañcamūlapakvena payasā tu savedanam| sukhoṣṇaṃ vā'vacāryaṃ syāccakratailaṃ vijānatā||19|| vibhajya deśaṃ kālaṃ ca vātaghnauṣadhasaṃyutam| ----------------------------------------------------|20|

Sa. tato nyagrodhādigaṇadravyakaṣāyeṇa śītena secayet bhaṅgasandhīn| taṃ-sarujaṃ, pañcamūlaśṛtena kṣīreṇa secayet| saṃ-avasthādiviśeṣaṃ vijñāya cakratailaṃ vātaghnauṣadhasaṃyutaṃ sukhoṣṇaṃ vijānatā vaidyena vā'vacāraṇīyam|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------------| pratataṃ sekalepāṃśca vidadhyāt bhṛśaśītalān||20||

div.ab: Sa. pratataṃ sekādīṃśca suśītalān kuryāt|

ab.seg: gṛṣṭikṣīraṃ sasarpiṣkaṃ madhurauṣadhasādhitam| prātaḥ prātaḥ pibedbhagnaḥ śītalaṃ lākṣayā yutam||21||

div.ab: Sa. bhagno naro gṛṣṭikṣīraṃ ghṛtasahitaṃ madhuradravyasādhitaṃ śītalaṃ lākṣayā yuktaṃ prātaḥ pibet|

ab.seg: savraṇasya tu bhagnasya vraṇo madhughṛtottaraiḥ| kaṣāyaiḥ pratisāryo'tha śeṣo bhaṅgoditaḥ kramaḥ||22||

div.ab: Sa. savraṇasya bhagnasya vraṇo madhughṛtottaraiḥ kaṣāyaiḥ pratisāraṇīyaḥ| atha śeṣaḥ kramo bhaṅgakathito vidheyaḥ|

ab.seg: lambāni vraṇamāṃsāni pralipya madhusarpiṣā| sandhadhīta vraṇān vaidyo bandhanaiścopa0pādayet||23||

div.ab: Sa. vraṇamāṃsāni lambāni madhughṛtenālipya vraṇān vaidyaḥ sandadhyāt| kṛtasandhānāṃśca tān yathāsvaṃ bandhairyojayet|
tān samān susthitāñjñātvā phalinīrodhrakaṭphalaiḥ| samaṅgādhātakīyuktaiścūrṇitairavacūrṇayet||24|| dhātakīrodhracūrṇairvā, rohantyāśu tathā vraṇāḥ| iti bhaṅga upakrāntaḥ-------------------------|25|
Sa. tān-vraṇān, susthitān samāṃśca viditvā phalinyādibhī rajīkṛtairācūrṇayet| dhātakīrodhrayoścūrṇena vā| tathā-evaṃ kṛte sati, vraṇā drāgeva rohanti| saṃ-iti-anena prakāreṇa, bhaṅgaścikitsitaḥ|
Sa. śītartau śtiradhātostathā māṃsalasya stokadoṣasya vraṇaḥ sukhasādhyaḥ| anyathā-ato viparyayeṇa, dāruṇaḥ-kṛcchrasādhyo'sādhyo vā|

----------------------------------------------------| pūrvamadhyāntavayasāmekadvitriguṇaiḥ kramāt||26|| māsaiḥ sthairyaṃ bhavetsandheryathoktaṃ bhajatāṃ vidhim| ----------------------------------------------------|27|
Sa. yathoktaṃ vidhiṃ kurvatāṃ pūrvamadhyāntavayasāmekadvitriguṇairmāsairyathākramaṃ sandheḥ sthairyaṃ jāyate|

----------------------------------------------------| kaṭījaṅghorubhagnānāṃ kapāṭaśayanaṃ hitam||27|| yantraṇārtha tathā kīlāḥ pañca kāryā nibandhanāḥ| jaṅghorvoḥ pāRśvayordvau dvau tala ekaśca kīlakaḥ||28|| śorṇyāṃ vā pṛṣṭhavaṃśe vā vakṣasyakṣakayostathā| ----------------------------------------------------|29|

Sa. kaṭyādibhagnānaṃ kapāṭesthirhitā| yantraṇārthaṃ ca kīlāḥ-kīlakāḥ, pañca sthirasthitihetavaḥ kāryāḥ| teṣāṃ ca sthānānyāha-jaṅghorvodvau dvau kīlakau, tala ekaḥ kīlakaḥ, śroṇyāṃ bhagnasya pṛṣṭavaṃśe tu bhagnasya pārśvayordvau dvāveka iti| ata evāha śroṇyāṃ vetyādi| vaktrasya(kṣasya)kṣakayośca bhagnasya pañcaiva kīlakā yojyāḥ| viśeṣastvato nopariṣṭāt kīlako yojyo yuktivaśāt|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------------| vimokṣe bhagnasandhīnāṃ vidhimevaṃ samācaret||29||

div.ab: Sa. bhagnasandhīnāṃ vimokṣa evaṃprakāraṃ vidhiṃ samācaret|

ab.seg: sandhīściravimuktāṃstu snigdhasvinnān mṛdūkṛtān| uktairvidhānairbuddhyā ca yathāsvaṃ sthānamānayet||30||

div.ab: Sa. ciravimuktāṃstu sandhīn pūrvaṃ snigdhān paścāt svinnān mṛdūkṛtān yathoktairvidhānairbuddhyā ca viśeṣeṇa yathātmīyaṃ sthānaṃ prāpayet|

ab.seg: asandhibhagne rūḍhe tu viṣamolbaṇasādhite| āpothya bhaṅgaṃ yamayettato bhagnavadācaret||31||

div.ab: Sa. asandhau bhagne rūḍhe ca viṣamolbaṇasādhite sati bhaṅgamāpothya-bhaṅktvā, paścādbhaṅgaṃ yamayet| anantaraṃ bhagnavadācaret|

ab.seg: bhagnaṃ naiti yathā pākaṃ prayateta tathā bhiṣak| pakvamāṃsasirāsnāyuḥ sandhiḥ śleṣaṃ na gacchati||32||

div.ab: Sa. bhagnaṃ yathā pākaṃ na prāpnoti tathā vaidyo yatnaṃ kuryāt| yataḥ sandhiḥ pakvamāṃsasirāsnāyuḥ san śleṣaṃ na yāti|

ab.seg: vātavyādhivinirdiṣṭān snehān bhagnasya yojayet| catuṣprayogān balyāṃśca bastikarma ca śīlayet||33||

div.ab: Sa. vātavyādhikathitān snehān (ci.a. 21/66) catuṣprayogān-pānanasyābhyaṅgānuvāsanaiḥ, balyān-balāya hitān, bhagnasya yojayet| tathā bastikarma-"prāk sneha ekaḥ pañcānte" (hṛ.sū.ā. 19/63) ityādinoktaṃ, abhyaset|

śālyājyarasadugdhādyaiḥ pauṣṭikairavidāhibhiḥ| mātrayopacaredbhagnaṃ sandhisaṃśleṣakāribhiḥ||34|| glānirna śasyate tasya, sandhiviśleṣakṛddhi sā| ----------------------------------------------------|35|
Sa. bhagnaṃ naraṃ mātrayā śālyādibhiḥ puṣṭikṛdbhiḥ sandhisaṃśleṣakāribhiravidāhibhirupakramet| tasya-bhagnasya, glānirna śasyate| yataḥ sā-glāniḥ, sandhiviśleṣaṃ kurute|

ab.seg: lavaṇaṃ kaṭukaṃ kṣāramamlaṃ maithunamātapam| vyāyāmaṃ ca na seveta bhagno rūkṣaṃ ca bhojanam||35||

div.ab: Sa. bhagno lavaṇādikaṃ rūkṣaṃ cāhāraṃ na seveta|

kṛṣṇāṃstilān virajaso dṛḍhavastrabaddhān sapta kṣapā vahati vāriṇi vāsayet| saṃśoṣayedanudinaṃ pravisārya caitān kṣīre tathaiva madhukakvathite ca toye|36| punarapi pītapayaskāṃ- sthān pūrvavadeva śoṣitān bāḍham| vigatatuṣānarajaskān sañcūrṇya sucūrṇitairyuñjyāt|37| naladavālakalohitayaṣṭikā- nakhamiśiplavakuṣṭhabalātrayaiḥ| agurukuṅkumacandanasārivā- saralasarjarasāmaradārubhiḥ|38| padmakādigaṇopetaistilapiṣṭaṃ tataśca tat| samastagandhabhaiṣajyasiddhadugdhena pīḍayet|39| śaileyarāsnāṃśumatīkaseru- kālānusārīnatapatrarodhraiḥ| sakṣīraśuklaiḥ sapayaḥ sadūrvai stailaṃ pacettannaladādibhiśca|40| gandhatailamidamuttamamasthi- sthairyakṛjjayati cāśu vikārān| vātāpittajanitānativīryān| vyāpino'pi vividhairupayogaiḥ|41| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭavira citāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttara- sthāne bhāṅgapratiṣedho nāma sapta- viṃśo'dhyāyaḥ|27|

Sa. kṛṣṇān tilān vahati-asthire jale, saptarātrīrvigatareṇūṃstathā dṛḍhavasanasaṃyatān vāsayet| etāṃśca praviralān vikīrya pratidinaṃ saṃśoṣayet| tathaiva-pūrvoktena prakāreṇa, kṣīre sthitānanudinaṃ pratisārya śoṣitān sapta rātrīrevaṃ madhuyaṣṭīkvathite ca jale vāsayedviśoṣayecca| vasantatilakāvṛttam| punarapi ca pītakṣīrāṃstāṃstilān pūrvavadevātiśayena śoṣitānapagatatuṣaṃstathā virajasaḥ sañcūrṇya naladādyaiḥ sucūrṇitairyojayet| āryā| tānevāha-naladetyādi| aupacchandasikam| padmakādītyādi| kimbhūtairnaladādibhiḥ ? padmakādigaṇasahitaiḥ sucūrṇitairyojayitvā caitat tilapiṣṭaṃ sakalacorakādigandhadravyasiddhena kṣīreṇa saha pīḍayet| tatastattailaṃ sairyakā(śaileyā)dibhirnaladādibhiśca kalkīkṛtairdugdhasahitaiḥ pacet| indravajrā| etat gandhatailamativīryamasthisthiratvakṛdāmayāśca pavanapittotthānativīryān vyāpino'pyāśu jayati vividhaiḥ-pānanasyādibhiḥ, upayogaiḥ| svāgatā| śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdaya- ṭīkāyāṃ sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne bhaṅgaprati- ṣedho nāma saptaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 27||

div.head: bhagandarapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ
div.ab: Sa. vraṇasāmānyād bhagandarapratiṣedamācaṣṭe-

athāto bhagandarapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyaśutre||2|| ) hastyaśvapṛṣṭhagamanakaṭhinotkaṭakāsanaiḥ| arśonidānābhihitairaparaiśca niṣevitaiḥ||1|| aniṣṭādṛṣṭapākena sadyo vā sādhugarhaṇaiḥ| prāyeṇa piṭikāpūrvo yo'ṅgule hyaṅgule'pi vā||2|| pāyorvraṇo'ntarbāhyo vā duṣṭāsṛṅmāṃsago bhavet| bastimūtrāśayābhyāsagatatvātsyandanātmakaḥ||3|| bhagandaraḥ sa sarvāśca dārayatyakriyāvataḥ| bhagabastigudāṃsteṣu dīryamāṇeṣu bhūribhiḥ||4|| vātamūtraśakṛcchukraṃ khaiḥ sūkṣmairvamati kramāt| ----------------------------------------------------|5|

Sa. hastyaśvādigamanādibhirarśonidānoktairaparairapi niṣevitairaśubhapurākṛtakarmavipākena sadyo vā sādhunindābhiḥ pāyoraṅgule dvyaṅgule vā yo vraṇo'ntarbāhyo vā bāhu lyena piṭikāpūrvā duṣṭaraktamāṃsago bastimūtrāśayasamīpagatatvāt syandanasvabhāvaḥ sa bhagandaraḥ syāt| saṃ-bhagādīn sarvān dārayati, kriyārahitasya puṃsaḥ| teṣu-bhagādiṣu, śīryamāṇeṣu khaiḥ-chidraiḥ, sūkṣmairbahubhiḥ krameṇa vātādīn vamati|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------------| doṣaiḥ pṛthagyutaiḥ sarvairāgantuḥ so'ṣṭamaḥ smṛtaḥ||5||

div.ab: Sa. bhagandarākhyo vraṇo doṣaiḥ pṛthak tridhā| yuktaiśca doṣaistridhā| sarvairekaḥ| āganturaṣṭamo gaditaḥ|
apakvaṃ piṭikāmāhuḥ pākaprāptaṃ bhagandaram| ----------------------------------------------------|6|
Sa. apakvaṃ śophaṃ piṭikāṃ kathayanti| pakvaṃ śophaṃ bhagandaramāhuḥ|

----------------------------------------------------| gūḍhamūlāṃ sasaṃrambhāṃ rugāḍhyāṃ rūḍhakopinīm||6|| bhagandarakarīṃ vidyāt piṭikāṃ na tvato'nyathā| ----------------------------------------------------|7|
Sa. piṭikāṃ gūḍhamūlādiguṇāṃ bhagandarakarīṃ vidyāt| ato'nyathā-viparyayeṇa, piṭikāmātrāṃ vijānīyāt|
Sa. teṣu madhyācchyāvādiguṇā piṭikā pavanāt syāt|

ab.seg: --------------pittāduṣṭragrīvāvaducchritā| rāgiṇi tanurūṣmāḍhyā jvaradhūmāyanānvitā||8||

div.ab: Sa. pittāt piṭikoṣṭragrīvevocchritā rāgādiguṇānvitā ca syāt|
sthirā snigdhā mahāmūlā pāṇḍuḥ kaṇḍumatī kaphāt| ----------------------------------------------------|9|
Sa. kaphāt piṭikā sthirādiguṇā syāt|
Sa. vātapittotthā piṭikā śyāvadiguṇā syāt|
pāṇḍurā kiñcidāśyāvā kṛcchrapākā kaphānilāt| ----------------------------------------------------|10|
Sa. śleṣmapavanāt piṭikā pāṇḍurādiguṇā syāt| kaphapittajastu bhagandaraḥ "arśaḥsa(durnā)māśritya" (ślo.15) ityārabhyāgre pratipādayiṣyati| teneha tatpiṭikā tantrakṛtā nābhihitā|

----------------------------------------------------| pādāṅguṣṭhasamā sarvairdoṣairnānāvidhavyathā||10|| śūlārocakatṛḍdāhajvaracchardirupadrutā| ----------------------------------------------------|11|
Sa. sarvairdoṣaiḥ pādāṅuṣṭhatulyā nānāvidhavyathā śūlādibhirupadrutā piṭikā syāt|
Sa. tāśca piṭikāḥ pramādāt-ayatnāt, pakvāḥ sadyo vraṇatāṃ yānti|
Sa. teṣu madhyādvātajā piṭikā śataponakavat-tita uvat, sūkṣmadvāraiśchidraiḥ krameṇa cīyate| kiṃ kurvāṇaiḥ ? acchaṃ-tanuṃ, āsrāvaṃ saha phenamanavarataṃ sravadbhiḥ| ayaṃ śataponakasaṃjño bhagandaraḥ|
Sa. pittajastu bhagandara uṣṭragrīvākhyaḥ|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------------| bahupicchāparisrāvī parisrāvī kaphodbhavaḥ||13||

div.ab: Sa. kaphottho bhagandaro bahupicchaparisrāvī syāt| sa ca parisrāvī kathyate|

ab.seg: vātapittātparikṣepī parikṣipya gudaṃ gatiḥ| jāyate paritastatra prākāraṃ parikheva ca||14||

div.ab: Sa. vātapittāt parikṣepītyucyate| tatra gudaṃ parikṣipya gatiḥ puraprākāraṃ paritaḥ parikheva ca jāyate|
Sa. vātakaphād ṛjusaṃjño bhagandaraḥ| tatra ṛjvyā gatyā gudo dīryate|

----------------------------------------------------| kaphapitte tu pūrvotthaṃ durnāmāśritya kupyataḥ||15|| arśomūle tataḥ śophaḥ kaṇḍūdāhādimān bhavet| sa śīghraṃ pakvabhinno'sya kledayanmūlamarśasaḥ||16|| sravatyajasraṃ gatibhirayamarśobhagandaraḥ| ----------------------------------------------------|17|

Sa. pūrvotthaṃ durnāma samāśritya kaphapitte yadā kupyataḥ, tataḥ-tatkopāt, arśomūle śophaḥ kaṇḍvādimān syāt| saḥ-śophaḥ, pakvabhinno'sya-arśaso, mūlamāśveva kledayan gatibhirajasraṃ sravati| sa śopho'rśobhagandara ucyate|

----------------------------------------------------| sarvajaḥ śambukāvartaḥ śambukāvartasannibhaḥ||17|| gatayo dārayantyasmin rugvegairdāruṇairgudam| ----------------------------------------------------|18|
Sa. sannipātotthaḥ śambukāvartasaṃjñaḥ śambukāvartasamaḥ syāt| asmin-sarvaje bhagandare, rugvegaistīvrairgatayo gudaṃ dārayanti|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------------| asthileśo'bhyavahṛto māṃsagṛddhyā yadā gudam||18||
kṣiṇoti tiryaṅnirgacchannunmārgaṃ kṣatato gatiḥ| syāttataḥ pūyadīrṇāyāṃ māṃsakothena tatra ca||19||
jāyante kṛmayastasya khādantaḥ parito gudam| vidārayanti nacirādunmārgī kṣatajaśca saḥ||20||

div.ab: Sa. asthilavo māṃsagārdhyena bhukto yadā tiryak-unmārgaṃ, nirgacchan gudaṃ kṣiṇoti, tadā kṣātādgatiḥ syāt| tataḥ pūyadīrṇāyāṃ gatau māṃsakothena ca tasmin kṛmayo bhavanti| te ca kṛmayaḥ tasya-bhagandariṇo, gudaṃ bhakṣayantaḥ parito vidārayanti śīghrameva| asāvunmārgī kṣatajaścocyate|
teṣu rugdāhakaṇḍvādīn vidyād vraṇaniṣedhataḥ| ----------------------------------------------------|21|
Sa. teṣu-bhagandareṣu, vraṇaniṣedhato-vraṇapratiṣedhāt, rugādīn vidyāt|

----------------------------------------------------| ṣaṭ kṛcchrasādhanāsteṣāṃ, nicayakṣatajau tyajet||21|| pravāhiṇīṃ valīṃ prāptaṃ sevanīṃ vā samāśritam| ----------------------------------------------------|22|
Sa. teṣāṃ madhyāt kṛcchrasādhanāḥ ṣaṭ-ekadoṣajā dvidoṣajāśca| sannipātajaṃ kṣatajaṃ ca tyajet| pravāhiṇīṃ valīṃ prāptaṃ yadbhagandaraṃ tattyajet| tathā sevanīmāśritya yajjātaṃ tacca varjayet|

----------------------------------------------------| athāsya piṭikāmeva tathā yatnādupācaret||22|| śudhdyasṛksrutisekādyairyathā pākaṃ na gacchati| ----------------------------------------------------|23|
Sa. athāsya-bhagandarasya, piṭikāmeva-piṭikāvasthāmeva, yatnaṃ kṛtvā śudhdyādibhistathopakramet yathā pākaṃ na prāpnoti|

ab.seg: yantrayitvā'rśasamiva paśyetsamyagbhagandaram| arvācīnaṃ parācīnamantarmukhabahirmukham||24||

div.ab: Sa. pāke tu satyupasnigdhamavagāhena ca sveditaṃ tato'rśasamiva yantrayitvā suṣṭhu bhagandaraṃ paśyet-avāṅmukhaṃ parāṅmukhaṃ vā, antarmukhaṃ bahirmukhaṃ vā, ityevaṃ suṣṭhu nirūpya| arvācīnamiti "vibhāṣāñceradik striyām" iti svārthe khaḥ|

athāntarmukhameṣitvā samyak śastreṇa pāṭayet| bahirmukhaṃ ca niḥśeṣaṃ tataḥ kṣāreṇa sādhayet||25|| agninā vā bhiṣak sādhu kṣāreṇaivoṣṭrakandharam| ----------------------------------------------------|26|

Sa. anantaramantarmukhameṣiṇyā eṣitvā samyak śastreṇa pāṭayet| bahirmukhaṃ ca bhagandaraṃ niḥśeṣaṃ pāṭayitvā tataḥ kṣāreṇa sādhayet jvalanena vā| uṣṭrakandharaṃ-uṣṭragrīvaṃ, kṣāreṇaiva sādhu kṛtvā vaidyaḥ sādhayet-na tvagninā|
Sa. śataponakākhyamekāntarā nāḍīḥ kṛtvā pāṭayet| tāsu rūḍhāsu śeṣā api nāḍīḥ pāṭayet| anyathā-ekahelayaiva, gude pāṭite sati mṛtyuḥ syāt|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------------| parikṣepiṇī cāpyevaṃ nāḍyuktaiḥ kṣārasūtrakaiḥ||27||

div.ab: Sa. parikṣepiṇi ca bhagandare nāḍīkathitaiḥ kṣārasūtrakairevaṃkramāt, sādhayet|
arśobhagandare pūrvamarśāṃsi pratisādhayet| ----------------------------------------------------|28|
Sa. arśobhagandare pūrvamarśāṃsi pratisādhayet-upacaret|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------------| tyaktvopacaryaḥ kṣatajaḥ śalyaṃ śalyavatastataḥ||28||
āhārecca tathā dadyāt kṛmighnaṃ lepabhojanam| piṇḍanāḍyādayaḥ svedāḥ susnigdhā ruji pūjitāḥ||29||

div.ab: Sa. kṣatajo bhagandarastyaktvā-pratyākhyāya, cikitsyaḥ| anantaraṃ śalyavataḥ-saśalyasya, śalyamāharet| tathā kṛmighnaṃ lepaṃ bhojanaṃ ca dadyāt| pīḍāyāṃ ca satyāṃ piṇḍasvedādayaḥ susnigdhā hitāḥ|

ab.seg: sarvatra ca bahucchidre chedānālocya yojayet| gītīrthasarvatobhadradalalāṅgallalāṅgalān||30||

div.ab: Sa. bahucchidre ca bhagandare sarvatraivālocya caturaśchedān gotīrthakādikān kuryāt| tāneva chedānāha-gotīrthetyādi|

pārśvaṃ gatena śastreṇa chedo gotīrthako mataḥ| sarvataḥ sarvatobhadraḥ, pārśvacchedo'rdhalāṅgalaḥ||31|| pārśvadvaye lāṅgalakaḥ---------------------------| ----------------------------------------------------|32|

Sa. śastreṇa pārśvaṃ gatena yaśchedaḥ sa gotīrthakākhyaḥ, sa ca kāvyagatagomūtrikākāraḥ| sarvato yaśchedaḥ sa sarvatobhadrākhyaḥ, sa ca sarvatobhadrakāvyākāraḥ| ya ekasmin pārśve cedaḥ, sa ca dalalāṅgalakākhyaḥ,-kuṭārahitahalākāraḥ| pārśvadvaye yaśchedaḥ sa lāṅgalakākhyaḥ,-sampūrṇahalākāraḥ|

ab.seg: -----------------------samastāṃścāgninā dahet| āsrāvamārgānniḥśeṣaṃ naivaṃ vikurute punaḥ||32||

div.ab: Sa. vraṇān sarvāṃścāsrāvamārgān niḥśeṣaṃ kṛtvā'gninā dahet| evaṃ kṛte sati punarvikāraṃ vraṇo na yāti|
yateta koṣṭhaśuddhau ca bhiṣak tasyāntarā'ntarā| ----------------------------------------------------|33|
Sa. tasya-bhagandariṇaḥ, koṣṭhaśuddhau cāntarā'ntarā vaidyo yateta|
Sa. mārjārāsthi triphalārasakalkitaṃ vraṇe lepo hitaḥ|

ab.seg: jyotiṣmatīmalayulāṅgaliśelupāṭhā- kumbhāgnisarja(rji)karavīravacāsudhārkaiḥ| abhyañjanāya vipaceta bhagandarāṇāṃ tailaṃ vadanti paramaṃ hitametadeṣām||34||

div.ab: Sa. jyotiṣmatyādibhirabhyaṅgārthaṃ tailaṃ pacet| bhagandarāṇāmeteṣāmetat paramaṃ-atiśayena, hitaṃ gadanti| vasantatilakāvṛttam| vakṣyamāṇaṃ ca madhukādi drutavilambitam|

ab.seg: madhukarodhrakaṇātrureṇukā- dvirajanīphalinīpaṭusārivāḥ| kamalakesarapadmakadhātakī- madanasarjarasāmayarodikāḥ||35||
sabījapūracchadanairebhistailaṃ vipācitam| bhagandarāpacīkuṣṭhamadhumehavraṇāpaham||36||

div.ab: Sa. madhukādibhiretaiḥ sabījapūrapatraistailaṃ vipācitaṃ bhagandarādighnam|

ab.seg: madhutailayutā viḍaṅgasāra- triphalāmāgadhikākaṇāśca līḍhāḥ| kṛmikuṣṭhabhagandaraprameha- kṣatanāḍīvraṇaropaṇā bhavanti||37||

div.ab: Sa. viḍaṅgasārādayo mākṣikatailayuktā līḍhāḥ kṛmyādivraṇaropaṇāḥ syuḥ| māgadhikākaṇāḥ-pippalītaṇḍulāḥ| aupacchandasikaṃ vṛttam|

ab.seg: amṛtātruṭivellavatsakaṃ kalipathyāmalakāni gugguluḥ| kramavṛddhamidaṃ madhudrutaṃ piṭikāsthaulyabhagandarān jayet||38||

div.ab: Sa. amṛtādikamidaṃ krameṇa bhāgavṛdhdyā vṛddhaṃ madhunā drutaṃ piṭikādīn jayet| vaitālīyam|

ab.seg: māgadhikāgnikaliṅgaviḍaṅgai- rbilvadhṛtaiḥ savarāpalaṣaṭkaiḥ| guggulunā sadṛśena sametaiḥ kṣaudrayutaiḥ sakalāmayanāśaḥ||39||

div.ab: Sa. māgadhikādikairbilvadhṛtaiḥ-pṛthak palamitaiḥ, triphalāpalaṣaṭkasahitaiḥ sarvaistulyena guggulunā yutairmadhusametairmiśritairmātrayā bhakṣitaiḥ(?) samastavyādhiharaṇaṃ syāt|

ab.seg: guggulupañcapalaṃ palikāṃśā māgadhikā triphalā ca pṛthaksyāt| tvaktruṭikarṣayutaṃ madhulīḍhaṃ kuṣṭhabhagandaragulmagatighnam||40||

div.ab: Sa. guggulupalāni pañca, pippalyādayaḥ palāṃśikāḥ, tvagelayoḥ pṛthak karṣam| tadetanmadhulīḍhaṃ kuṣṭhādighnam| svāyambhuvākhyo guggulureṣa prasiddhaḥ| dodhakaṃ(ke) vṛttam(tte)|

ab.seg: śṛṅgaberarajoyuktaṃ tadeva ca subhāvitam| kvāthena daśamūlasya viśeṣādvātarogajit||41||

div.ab: Sa. tadeva-guggulvādikaṃ dravyaṃ, śuṇṭhīcūrṇayutaṃ daśamūlakvāthena subhāvitaṃ viśeṣeṇa vātarogajit|

ab.seg: uttamākhadirasārajaṃ rajaḥ śīlayannasanavāribhāvitam| hanti tulyamahiṣākṣamākṣikaṃ kuṣṭhamehapiṭikābhagandarān||42||

div.ab: Sa. triphalādirajo'sanakvāthena bhāVvitaṃ tulyamahiṣākhya(kṣa)mākṣikaṃ śīlayan kuṣṭhādīn hanti| ro narau lagayutā rathoddhatā|

ab.seg: bhagandareṣveṣa viśeṣa uktaḥ śeṣāṇi tu vyañjanasādhanāni| vraṇādhikārāt pariśīlanācca samyagviditvaupayikaṃ vidadhyāt||43||

div.ab: Sa. bhagandareṣu sarveṣvayamupakramaviśeṣo'bhihitaḥ| śeṣāṇi tu vraṇāni prakaṭasādhanāni| teṣu vraṇādhikārāt pariśīlanācca samyagviditvopakramaṃ yathāyogyaṃ kuryāt| upajātiḥ|

aśvapṛṣṭhagamanaṃ calarodhaṃ madyamaithunamajīrṇamasātmyam| sāhasāni vividhāni ca rūḍhe vatsaraṃ pariharedadhikaṃ vā|44| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭavira- citāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttara- sthāne bhagandarapratiṣedho nāmā- ṣṭāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ|28|

Sa. bhagandare vraṇe rūḍhe'pi turagapṛṣṭhagamanādikaṃ varṣaṃ yāvadadhikaṃ vā pariharediti| svāgatāvṛttam| iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdaya- ṭīkāyāṃ sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne bhagandara pratiṣedho nāmāṣṭāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 28||

div.head: granthyarbudaślīpadāpacīnāḍīvijñānīyādhyāyaḥ
div.ab: Sa. granthyādivijñānamucyate-

ab.seg: athāto grathyarbudaślīpadāpacīnāḍīvijñānīyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre|2| ) kaphapradhānāḥ kurvanti medomāṃsāsragā malāḥ| vṛttonnataṃ yaṃ śvayathuṃ sa granthirgrathanātsmṛtaḥ||1||

div.ab: Sa. saṃ-medomāṃsaraktasthitāḥ kaphapradhānā doṣā vṛttonnataṃ yaṃ śvayathuṃ, kurvanti, sa grathanād granthiḥ smṛtaḥ|
doṣāsramāṃsamedosthisirāvraṇabhavā nava| te---------------------------------------|2|
Sa. saṃ-te ca-granthayo, doṣādyātmakatvāt navasaṅkhyāḥ syuḥ|

ab.seg: sthānātsthānāntaragatirakasmāddhānivṛddhimān| mṛdurbastirivānaddho vibhinno'cchaṃ sravatyasṛk||3||

div.ab: Sa. saṃ-teṣu madhye vātādāyāmādiguṇaḥ śvayathuḥ syāt| sa ca vibhinno lohitamacchaṃ sravati|
pittātsadāhaḥ pītābho rakto vā, pacyate drutam| bhinno'sramuṣṇaṃ sravati----------------------|4|
Sa. saṃ-pittena dāhayutaḥ pītacchavirathavā raktaḥ| śophaḥ śīghraṃ pacyate| bhinnaḥ sa uṣṇamasṛk sravati|
Sa. saṃ-kaphena nīrujo ghanaḥ śophaḥ śītasparśaḥ śarīrasamānavarṇaḥ kaṇḍūyutaśca syāt| sa pakvaḥ pūyaṃ ghanaṃ sravet|

----------------------------------------------------| doṣairduṣṭe'sṛji granthirbhavenmūrcchatsu jantuṣu||5|| sirāmāṃsaṃ ca saṃśritya sasvāpaḥ pittalakṣaṇaḥ| ----------------------------------------------------|6|
Sa. saṃ-doṣairduṣṭe lohite sati granthirbhavet| jantuṣu-kṛmiṣu, vṛddhiṃ gacchatsu sirāmāṃsaṃ ca saṃśritya svāpānvitaḥ śophaḥ pittasamānalakṣaṇaḥ syāt|

----------------------------------------------------| māṃsalairdūṣitaṃ māṃsamāhārairgranthimāvahet||6|| snigdhaṃ mahāntaṃ kaṭhinaṃ sirānaddhaṃ kaphākṛtim| ----------------------------------------------------|7|
Sa. saṃ-māṃsalairāhārairmāṃsaṃ dūṣitaṃ granthi snigdhādiguṇayuktaṃ kaphākāraṃ karoti|

----------------------------------------------------| pravṛddhaṃ medurairmedo nītaṃ māṃse'thavā tvaci||7|| vāyunā kurute granthi bhṛśaṃ snigdhaṃ mṛduṃ calam| śleṣamatulyākṛtiṃ dehakṣayavṛddhikṣayodayam||8|| sa vibhinno ghanaṃ medastāmrāsitasitaṃ sravet| ----------------------------------------------------|9|

Sa. saṃ-medurairbhojanairmedaḥ pravṛddhaṃ vāyunā māṃse nītamathavā tvaci nītaṃ medogranthiṃ bhṛśaṃ snigdhādiguṇaṃ śleṣmasamānākāraṃ tathā śarīrakṣayavṛddhibhyāṃ kṣayodayau yasya taṃ tādṛśaṃ karoti| sa ca granthibhinnaḥ san ghanaṃ tāmramasitaṃ sitaṃ ca medaḥ sravati|
Sa. saṃ-asthibhāṅgenābhighātena vā'sthnyunnatamavanataṃ vā yat syāt, so'sthigranthiḥ |

ab.seg: -------------------padātestu sahasā'mbhovagāhanāt| vyāyāmādvā pratāntasya sirājālaṃ saśoṇitam||10||
vāyuḥ sampīḍya saṅkocya vakrīkṛtya viśoṣya ca| niḥṣphuraṃ nīrujaṃ granthiṃ kurute sa sirāhvayaḥ||11||

div.ab: Sa. saṃ-padāteḥ sahasaiva jalāvagāhād vyāyāmādvā pratāntasyaglānasya, pavanaḥ kruddhaḥ saraktaṃ sirājālaṃ sampīḍya tathā saṅkocya vakrīkṛtya viśoṣya ca niḥṣphuraṃ nīrujaṃ granthiṃ kurute sa sirāsaṃjñaḥ| niḥṣphuramiti "sphuratisphulatyoḥ" ityādinā ṣatvam|

ab.seg: aruḍhe rūḍhamātre vā vraṇe sarvarasāśinaḥ| sārdre vā bandharahite gātre'śmābhihate'thavā||12||
vāto'sramasrutaṃ duṣṭaṃ saṃśoṣya grathitaṃ vraṇam| kuryātsadāhaḥ kaṇḍūmān vraṇagranthirayaṃ smṛtaḥ||13||

div.ab: Sa. saṃ-aruḍhe vraṇe tathā rūḍhamātre-sadyorūḍhe vraṇe, sarvarasāśino narasyāthavā sārdre vraṇe bandharahite śarīre'śmābhihate vā vāto raktamasrutaṃ duṣṭaṃ saṃśoṣya grathitaṃ vraṇaṃ kuryāt| dāhādiyuta eṣa vraṇagranthiḥ smṛto munibhiḥ|
sādhyā doṣāsramedojāḥ, na tu sthūlakharāścalāḥ| marmakaṇṭhodarasthāśca-------------------------|14|
Sa. saṃ-doṣāsramedojā granthayaḥ sādhyāḥ| na punaḥ sthūlāḥ kharāścalāstathā marmasthāḥ kaṇṭhasthā udarasthāśca granthayaḥ sādhyāḥ |

ab.seg: tallakṣaṇaṃ ca medontaiḥ ṣoḍhā doṣādibhistu tat| prāyo medaḥ kaphāḍhyatvāsthiratvācca na pacyate||15||

div.ab: Sa. saṃ-grantheryanmahat tadarbudam| tasya cārbudasya lakṣaṇaṃ ṣaṭ prakāram| katham ? doṣaistrīṇi, raktamāṃsamedobhistrīṇīti| tacca-arbudaṃ, medaḥkaphabāhulyāt sthiratvācca prāyaḥ pacanaṃ na yāti|

ab.seg: sirāsthaṃ śoṇitaṃ doṣaḥ saṅkocyāntaḥ prapīḍya ca| pācayeta tadānaddhaṃ sāsrāvaṃ māṃsapiṇḍitam||16||
māṃsāṅkuraiścitaṃ yāti vṛddhi cāśu sravettataḥ| ajasraṃ duṣṭarudhiraṃ bhūri tacchoṇitārbudam||17||

div.ab: Sa. saṃ-sirāsthitaṃ raktaṃ doṣo-vātādyanyatamaḥ, saṅkocyāntaḥ abhyantare, ca prapīḍya pācayet| tatpakvaṃ ca sadānaddhaṃ sāsrāvaṃ māṃsapiṇḍitaṃ māṃsāṅkuraiścitaṃ vṛddhiṃ gacchati| vṛddhaṃ ca sadāśu satataṃ duṣṭaṃ rudhiraṃ prabhūtaṃ sravati| tat-evaṃvidhaṃ, śoṇitārbudaṃ gadyate| māṃsārbudamedorbudayośca lakṣaṇaṃ tadgranthilakṣaṇenaivoktaprāyatvānnehoktam|
teṣvasṛṅmāṃsaje varjye, catvāryanyāni sādhayet| ----------------------------------------------------|18|
Sa. saṃ-teṣu-ṣaṭsvarbudeṣu madhye,śoṇitamāṃsaje dve arbude nopakramet| aparāṇi catvāri sādhayet|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------------| prasthitā vaṅkṣaṇoorvādimadhaḥkāyaṃ kapholbaṇāḥ||18||
doṣā māṃsāsragāḥ pādau kālenāśritya kurvate| śanaiḥśanairghanaṃ śophaṃ ślīpadaṃ tatpracakṣate||19||

div.ab: Sa. saṃ-adhaḥkāyaṃ vaṅkṣaṇoruprabhṛti doṣā gatāḥ kapholbaṇā māṃsalohitagāḥ kālena pādau samāśritya nibiḍaṃ śvayathuṃ śanaiḥśanairvidadhati| tadetadchlīpadaṃ pracakṣate |
paripoṭayutaṃ kṛṣṇamanimittarujaṃ kharam| rūkṣaṃ ca vātāt---------------------------|20|
Sa. saṃ-ślīpadaṃ vātāt paripoṭena yuktaṃ kṛṣṇavarṇamahetupīḍaṃ kharaṃ rūkṣaṃ ca syāt|
Sa. saṃ-pittāt pītaṃ dāhajvarayutaṃ ca syāt|
-----------------------------------------------------| kaphādguru snigdhamaruk citaṃ māṃsāṅkurairbṛhat|21|
Sa. saṃ-kaphena guru snigdhaṃ rujārahitaṃ māṃsāṅkuraiścitaṃ mahacca syāt|
Sa. saṃ-tat-ślīpadaṃ, varṣātikrāntaṃ sumahat suparisrāvaṃ ca tyajet|

ab.seg: pāṇināsauṣṭhakarṇeṣu vadantyeke tu pādavat| ślīpadaṃ jāyate tacca deśe'nūpe bhṛśaṃ bhṛśam||22||

div.ab: Sa. saṃ-pāṇyādiṣvapi pādavacchlīpadaṃ jāyata ityeke vadanti| taccānūpadeśe'tiśayena rogasvabhāvājjāyate|

medasthāḥ kaṇṭhamanyākṣakakṣāvaṅkṣaṇagā malāḥ| savarṇān kaṭhinān snigdhān vārtākāmalakākṛtīn||23|| avagāḍhān bahūn gaṇḍāṃścirapākāṃśca kurvate| pacyante'lparujaste'nye sravantyanye'tikaṇḍurāḥ||24|| naśyantyanye bhavantyanye dīrghakālānubandhinaḥ| gaṇḍamālā'pacī ceyaṃ dūrveva kṣayavṛddhibhāk|25|

Sa. saṃ-medasthāḥ kaṇṭhādigā doṣāḥ savarṇān kaṭhinān snigdhān vārtākāmalakākārānavagāḍhān bahūn gaṇḍāṃścirapākāṃśca kurvate| te ca-gaṇḍāḥ stokapīḍāḥ pacyante| anye ca sravanti| apare cātikaṇḍurāḥ, kaṇḍuṃ rānti dadata iti kaṇḍurāḥ| naśyantyanye| anye jāyante dīrghakālānubandhinaḥ| iyaṃ-īdṛśī, gaṇḍamālā apacī cocyate| dūrveva kṣayavṛddhibhāk|

ab.seg: tāṃ tyajetsajvaracchardipārśvarukkāsapīnasām| -----------------------------------------------------||25||

div.ab: Sa. saṃ-tāṃ-gaṇḍamālāṃ, jvarādiyutāṃ tyajet| atha nāḍīvijñānamāha--

----------------------------------------------------| abhedātpakvaśophasya vraṇe cāpathyasevinaḥ||26|| anupraviśya māṃsādīn dūraṃ pūyo'bhidhāvati| gatiḥ sā dūragamanānnāḍī nāḍīva saṃsruteḥ||27|| nāḍyekā'nṛjuranyeṣāṃ saivānekagatirgatiḥ| -----------------------------------------------------|28|

Sa. śām-pakvaśophasyābhedanādapathyasevinaśca puṃso vraṇe pūyo māṃsādīnanupraviśya dūraṃ vrajati| sā dūragamanāt gatirityucyate| nāḍīva saṃsruternāḍītyucyate| anyeṣāṃ tu tantrakṛtāṃ mata ekā nāḍyanṛjuḥ-vakrā, nāḍītyucyate| saiva nāḍyanekagatirgatirityucyata iti |

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------------| sā doṣaiḥ pṛthagekasthaiḥ śalyahetuśca pañcamī||28||

div.ab: Sa. saṃ-sā-nāḍī, pṛthagdoṣaistrisaṅkhyā, sannipātena caturthī, pañcamī śalyahetuḥ |
vātāt saruksūkṣmamūkhī vivarṇā phenilodvamā| sravatyabhyadhikaṃ rātrau--------------------|29|
Sa. saṃ-vātāt sarujādiguṇā|
Sa. saṃ-pittāttṛḍādikṛt| pītoṣṇapūtipūyasrāvī| divase cātiśayena sravati |
Sa. saṃ-kaphāt ghanapicchilasrāvā kaṇḍūmatī kaṭhinā niśicābhyadhikledā syāt|
Sa. saṃ-kaphāt ghanapicchilasrāvā kaṇḍūmatī kaṭhinā niśicābhyadhikledā syāt|

antaḥsthitaṃ śalyamanāhṛtaṃ tu karoti nāḍīṃ vahate ca sā'sya| phenānuviddhaṃ tanumalpamuṣṇaṃ sāsraṃ ca pūyaṃ sarujaṃ ca nityam|31| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviraci- tāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne granthyarbudaślīpadāpacīnāḍīvijñānīyaṃ nāmaikonatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ|29|

Sa. saṃ-antare sthitaṃ śalyamanākṛṣṭaṃ sannāḍīṃ karoti| asya ca-śalyavataḥ puṃsaḥ, sā-nāḍī, phenilaṃ tanvādiguṇaṃ ca pūyaṃ nityameva sarujaṃ vahata iti| upajātivṛttam| iti śrīmRṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdaya- ṭīkāyāṃ sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭha uttarasthāne granthya rbudaślīpadāpacīnāḍīvijñānīyaṃ nāma ekonatriṃ- śo'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 29||

div.head: granthyarbudaślīpadāpacīnāḍīpratiśedhādhyāyaḥ
div.ab: Sa. adhunā granthyādīnāṃ cikitsitaṃ bibhaṇiṣurāha-

athāto granthyarbudaślīpadāpacīnāḍīpratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre|2| ) granthiṣvāmeṣu kartavyā yathāsvaṃ śophavat kriyā| ----------------------------------------------------|1|
Sa. āmeṣu-apakveṣu, granthiṣu yathāsvaṃ śopheṣviva kriyācikitsitam|

----------------------------------------------------| bṛhatīcitrakavyāghrīkaṇāsiddhena sarpiṣā||1|| snehayecchuddhikāmaṃ ca, tīkṣṇaiḥ śuddhasya lepanam| -----------------------------------------------------|2|
Sa. bṛhatyādibhiḥ siddhena sarpiṣā śuddhikāmaṃ naraṃ snehayet| tataḥ śuddhasya-kṛtavamanavirekasya sataḥ, tīkṣṇairdravyairlepanaṃ kāryam |

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------------| saṃsvedya bahuśo granthiṃ vimṛdnīyāt punaḥ punaḥ||2||

div.ab: Sa. granthiṃ samyak svedayitvā'ṅguṣṭhādibhiḥ punaḥ punarvimṛdnīyāt|

ab.seg: eṣa vāte viśeṣeṇa kramaḥ, pittāsraje punaḥ| jalaukaso himaṃ sarvaṃ, kaphaje vātiko vidhiḥ||3||

div.ab: Sa. eṣa kramo viśeṣeṇa vāte kāryaḥ| pittāsraje granthau jalaukasaḥ| sarvadā śītaṃ pralepādikaṃ hitam| kaphaje granthau vātodbhavagranthivihitaḥ kramaḥ|

ab.seg: tathā'pyakvaṃ chittvainaṃ sthite rakte'gninā dahet| sādhvaśeṣaṃ, saśeṣo hi punarāpyāyate dhruvam||4||

div.ab: Sa. evamapyapakvamenaṃ granthiṃ sādhu yathā bhavatyaśeṣaṃ ca tathā chittvā sthite rakte satyagninā dahet| śeṣaḥ kasmānna kriyate ? ityāha-saśeṣa iti| yasmāt saśeṣo granthirniścayenaiva punarāpyāyate-vṛddhiṃ yāti|
māṃsavraṇodbhavau granthī yāpayedevameva ca| ----------------------------------------------------|5|
Sa. sa- māṃsavraṇodbhavau granthī evameva yāpayet|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------------| kāryaṃ medobhave'pyetattaptaiḥ phālādibhiśca tam||5||
pramṛdyāttiladigdhena channaṃ dviguṇavāsasā| śastreṇa pāṭayitvā vā dahenmedasi sūddhṛte||6||

div.ab: Sa. medoje'pyetat kāryam| taṃ ca-medodbhavaṃ granthiṃ, tilakalkadigdhena dviguṇavāsasā channaṃ santaṃ taptaiḥ phālādibhirupaspṛśet| athavā śastreṇa pāṭayitvā medasi niḥśeṣamuddhṛte satyagninā dahet|

ab.seg: sirāgranthau nave peyaṃ tailaṃ sāhacaraṃ, tathā| upanāho'nilaharairbastikarma sirāvyadhaḥ||7||

div.ab: Sa. sirāgranthau ca nave sāhacaraṃ tailaṃ peyam| tathā vātaghnairupanāho hito bastikarma sirāvyadhaśca|

ab.seg: arbude granthivat kuryāt yathāsvaṃ sutarāṃ hitam| -----------------------------------------------------|8| | ajāśakṛcchigrūmūlalākṣāsurasa(lavaṇakṣāra)-kāñjikaiḥ| vastrabaddhairupasvedya mardayitvā pralepayet||1||
upodakāpatrapiṇḍyā chadairācchāditaṃ ghanam| niveśya paṭṭaṃ badhnīyācchāmyatyevaṃ navārbudam||2||
jīrṇe cārkacchadasudhāsāmudraguḍakāñjikaiḥ| pracchāne piṇḍikā baddhā granthyarbudavilāyanī]||3||

div.ab: Sa. arbude granthāviva sarvaṃ yathāyogaṃ sutarāṃ hitaṃ kuryāt |

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------------| ślīpade'nilaje vidhyet snigdhasvinnopanāhite||8||
sirāmupari gulphasya dvyaṅgule, pāyayecca tam| māsameraṇḍajaṃ tailaṃ gomūtreṇa samanvitam||9||
jīrṇe jīrṇānnamaśnīyācchuṇṭhīśṛtapayonvitam| traivṛtaṃ vā pibedevamaśāntāvagninā dahet||10||

div.ab: Sa. ślīpade vātotthe snigdhe svinna upanāhite ca gulphasya dvayaṅgula upari sirāṃ vidhyet| taṃ ca-ślīpadinaṃ, māsameraṇḍodbhavaṃ tailaṃ gomūtrayutaṃ pāyayet| jīrṇe cairaṇḍataile purāṇamannaṃ śālyodanaṃ śuṇṭhīśṛtena kṣīreṇa sahāśnīyāt| traivṛtaṃ vā pibet| evamapyaśāntau vahninā dahet| tathā gulphasyādhastātsirāṃ mokṣayet|
gulphasyādhaḥ sirāmokṣaḥ paitte sarvaṃ ca pittajit| -----------------------------------------------------|11|
Sa. paitte tu ślīpade sarvaṃ pittajiccikitsitaṃ hitam|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------------| sirāmaṅguṣṭhake vidhvā kaphaje śīlayedyavān||11||
sakṣaudrāṇi kaṣāyāṇi varddhamānāstathā'bhayāḥ| limpetsarṣapavārtākimūlābhyāṃ dhanvayā'thavā||12||

div.ab: Sa. kaphaje tu sirāmaṅguṣṭhake vidhvā yavānnaṃ śīlayet| kaṣāyaguṇayuktāni dravyāṇi mākṣikānvitāni hitāni| tathā vardhamānā dvitryādikrameṇa harītakyo hitāḥ| sarṣapairvārtākīmūlena ca limpet| dhānya(dhanva)yā-yavāsakayā vā, niśuṇṭhyā limpet|

ab.seg: ūrdhvādhaḥśodhanaṃ peyamapacyāṃ sādhitaṃ ghṛtam| dantīdravantītrivṛtājālinīdevadālibhiḥ||13||
śīlayetkaphamedoghnaṃ dhūmagaṇḍūṣanāvanam| sirayā'paharedraktaṃ, pibenmūtreṇa tārkṣyajam||14||
| palamarddhapalaṃ vā'pi karṣaṃ vā'pyuṣṇavāriṇā| kāñcanāratvacaṃ pītvā gaṇḍamālāṃ vyapohati]||1||

div.ab: Sa. apacyāmūrdhvādhaḥ śodhanaṃ dantyādibhiḥ sādhitaṃ ghṛtaṃ pātavyam| tathā kaphamedoharaṃ dhūmādikamabhyaset| sirayā raktaṃ haret| rasāñjanaṃ gomūtreṇāloḍitaṃ pibet|

ab.seg: granthīnapakvānālimpennākulīpaṭunāgaraiḥ| svinnān lavaṇapoṭalyā kaṭhinānanu mardayet||15||

div.ab: Sa. āmān granthīnnākulyādibhirālimpet| kaṭhinān granthīllavaṇapoṭalyā svinnān paścādaṅguṣṭhādinā mardayet |

śamīmūlakaśigrūṇāṃ bījaiḥ sayavasarṣapaiḥ| lepaḥ piṣṭo'mlatakreṇa granthigaṇḍavilāyanaḥ||16|| | kṣuṇṇāni nimbapatrāṇi klRptairbhallātakaiḥ saha| śarāvasampuṭe dagdhvā sārdhaṃ siddhārthakaiḥ samaiḥ||1|| etacchāgāmbunā piṣṭaṃ gaṇḍamālāpralepanam]||1.5||
Sa. śamyādibhiramlatakrapiṣṭairlepo granthyādivimlāpa(lāya)naḥ|

ab.seg: pākonmukhān srutāsrasya pittaśleṣmaharairjayet| apakvāneva voddhṛtya kṣārāgnibhyāmupācaret||17||

div.ab: Sa. pākonmukhān granthīn srutaraktasya pittaśleṣmaghnairdravyairjayet| athavā'pakvāneva granthīnuddhṛtya kṣārāgnibhyāmupakramet |

ab.seg: kākādanīlāṅgalikānahitottuṇḍikīphalaiḥ| jīmūtabījakarkoṭīviśālākṛtavedhanaiḥ||18||
pāṭhānvitaiḥ palārdhaśairviṣakarṣayutaiḥ pacet| prasthaṃ karañjatailasya nirugṇḍīsvarasāḍhake||19||
anena mālā gaṇḍānāṃ cirajā pūyavāhinī| sidhyatyasādhyakalpā'pi pānābhyañjananāvanaiḥ||20||

div.ab: Sa. saṃ-kākādanyādibhiḥ kalkairdvikarṣonmitairviṣakarṣayutaiḥ karañjatailasya prasthaṃ nirguṇḍīsvarasasyāḍhake pacet| tena (anena) tailena gaṇḍamālā cirotthā pūyavāhinī cāsādhyaprāyā'pi pānādibhiḥ sidhyati|

ab.seg: tailaṃ lāṅgalikīkandakalkapādaṃ caturguṇe| nirguṇḍīsvarase pakvaṃ nasyādyairapacīpraṇut||21||

div.ab: Sa. lāṅgalikīkandakalkapādaṃ nirguṇḍīsvarase caturguṇe tailaṃ pakvaṃ nasyādyairapacījit| lāṅgalikīkandakalkaḥ pādo yasmistaile tadevam |

ab.seg: bhadraśrīdārumaricadviharidrātrivṛddhanaiḥ| manaḥ śilālanaladaviśālākaravīrakaiḥ||22||
gomūtrapiṣṭaiḥ palikairviṣasyārdhapalena ca| brāhmīrasārkajakṣīragośakṛdrasasaṃyutam||23||
prasthaṃ sarṣapatailasya siddhamāśu vyapohati| pānādyaiḥ śīlitaṃ kuṣṭhaduṣṭanāḍīvraṇāpacīḥ||24||

div.ab: Sa. bhadraśrīdārvādibhiḥ palikairgomūtrapiṣṭairviṣasya cārdhapalena yuktairbrāhmīrasādibhiḥ saṃyutaṃ sarṣapatailaprasthaṃ pakvaṃ pānādyairabhyastaṃ kuṣṭhādīn śīghrameva hanti |

ab.seg: vacāharītakīlākṣākaṭurohiṇicandanaiḥ| tailaṃ prasādhitaṃ pītaṃ samūlāmapacīṃ jayet||25||

div.ab: Sa. vacāharītakyādibhiḥ kalkitaistailaṃ pakvaṃ pītaṃ nirmūlāmapacīṃ kuryāt|

ab.seg: śarapuṅkhodbhavaṃ mūlaṃ piṣṭaṃ tandulavāriṇā| nasyāllepācca duṣṭārurapacīviṣajantujit||26||

div.ab: Sa. śarapuṅkhāmūlaṃ tandulajalena piṣṭaṃ nasyena lepanena ca duṣṭāruḥprabhṛtīn hanti|

mūlairuttamakāraṇyāḥ pīluparṇyāḥ sahācarāt| sarodhrābhayayaṣṭyāhvaśatāhvādvīpidārubhiḥ||27|| tailaṃ kṣīrasamaṃ siddhaṃ nasye'bhyaṅge ca pūjitam| ----------------------------------------------------|28|

Sa. saṃ-uttamakāraṇyādīnāṃ mūlaistailaṃ kṣīratulyaṃ siddhaṃ nasye'bhyaṅge ca hitam| uttamaivottamaketi "anyatarasyām" iti hrasvaḥ| uttamakā cāsāvaraṇiśca(ṇī ca) uttamakāraṇītyarthaḥ| uttamakāraṇī-karambhaḥ(mbhā)|

----------------------------------------------------| govyajāśvakhurā dagdhāḥ kaṭutailena lepanam||28|| aiṅgudena tu kṛṣṇāhirvāyaso vā svayaṃ mṛtaḥ| -----------------------------------------------------|29|
Sa. gavādīnāṃ khurā dagdhāḥ kaṭutailena vimiśritena lepo hitaḥ| kṛṣṇasarpo dagdha iṅgudītailena, kāko vā svayaṃ mṛta iṅgudītailena, lepanaṃ hitam |

----------------------------------------------------| ityaśāntau gadasyānyapārśvajaṅghāsamāśritam||29|| basterūrdhvamadhastādvā medo hṛtvā'gninā dahet| -----------------------------------------------------|30|
Sa. saṃ-evamapyaśāntau satyāṃ rogasyāparapārśvajaṅghāsamāśritaṃ basterūrdhvamadhastādvā medo hṛtvā jvalanena dahet |

----------------------------------------------------| sthitasyordhvaṃ padaṃ mitvā tanmānena ca pārṣṇitaḥ||30|| tata ūrdhvaṃ hared granthīnityāha bhagavānnimiḥ| ----------------------------------------------------|31|
Sa. sthitasya puṃsa ūrdhvaṃ padaṃ mitvā tanmānena pārṣṇipradeśāt tāvanmātraṃ mitvā tata ūrdhva granthīn haret, iti nimimuniḥ prājyāśayo vadatīti|

ab.seg: pārṣṇiṃ prati dvādaśa cāṅgulāni muktvendrabastiṃ ca gadānyapārśve| vidārya matsyāṇḍanibhāni madhyājjālāni karṣediti suśrutoktiḥ||31||

div.ab: Sa. pārṣṇiṃ lakṣīkṛtya dvādaśāṅgulāni mittvā indrabastiṃ muktvā gadasyāparapārśve vidārya madhyānmatsyāṇḍasadṛśāni jālāni karṣet, evaṃ suśrutasya vacanam| upajātivṛttam|

ab.seg: ā gulphakarṇātsumitasya jantostasyāṣṭabhāgaṃ khuḍakādvibhajya| ghrāṇārjave'dhaḥ surarājabasterbhittvā'kṣamātraṃ tvapare vadanti||32||

div.ab: Sa. gulphāntaṃ yāvat karṇādārabhya prāṇinaḥ suṣṭhu mitasya karṇānāṃ hrasvalambatvenāniyatasthānatvāt sthānaniyamaṃ karoti| ghrāṇārjava iti| etaduktaṃ bhavati| nāsāgrāt karṇaṃ prati sṛṣṭatve sati sumitasya karṇād gulphaṃ yāvanna tvevameva, tathā tasya narasya khuḍakād gulphādaṣṭabhāgaṃ bibhajya-tyaktvā, indrabasteradhastādbhīttvā'kṣamātraṃ karṣet, ityapare vadanti| indravajrāvṛttam|

ab.seg: upanāhyānilānnāḍīṃ pāṭitāṃ sādhu lepayet| pratyakpuṣpīphalayutaistilaiḥ piṣṭaiḥ sasaindhavaiḥ||33||

div.ab: Sa. vātānnāḍīmupanāhya pāṭayitvā sādhu kṛtvā'pāmārgādibhirlepayet|
paittīṃ tu tilamañjiṣṭhānāgadantīniśādvayaiḥ| ----------------------------------------------------|34|
Sa. paittiṃ tu pāṭitāṃ satīṃ tilādibhiḥ pradehayet|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------------| ślaiṣmikīṃ tilasaurāṣṭrīnikumbhāriṣṭasaindhavaiḥ||34||

div.ab: Sa. śalaiṣmikīṃ ca pāṭitāṃ tilasaurāṣṭryādibhiḥ pradehayet|
śalyajāṃ tilamadhvājyairlepayecchinnaśodhitām| ----------------------------------------------------|35|
Sa. śalyajāṃ gatiṃ chinnāṃ śodhitāṃ ca tilamadhvājyairlepayet|
Sa. saṃ-śastreṇa chedanānarhāṃ gatiṃ samyageṣitāmeṣiṇyā bhittvā'nte kṣārayuktena sūtreṇa punaḥpunardārayet|

----------------------------------------------------| vraṇeṣu duṣṭasūkṣmāsyagambhīrādiṣu sādhanam||36|| yā vartyo yāni tailāni tannāḍīṣvapi śasyate| -----------------------------------------------------|37|
Sa. duṣṭeṣu sūkṣmamukheṣu gambhīrādiṣu vraṇeṣu yatsādhanaṃ kathitaṃ, yā vartaya uktāḥ, yāni tailāni, tat-etaccikitsitaṃ, nāḍīṣvapi yujyate|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------------| piṣṭaṃ cañcuphalaṃ lepānnāḍīvraṇaharaṃ param||37||

div.ab: Sa. saṃ-cañcoḥ phalaṃ piṣṭaṃ lepena paraṃ nāḍīvraṇahṛt|

ab.seg: ghoṇṭāphalatvak lavaṇaṃ salākṣaṃ būkasya patraṃ vanitāpayaśca| srugarkadugdhānvita eṣa kalko vartīkṛto hantyacireṇa nāḍīm||38||

div.ab: Sa. ghoṇṭāphalādikaḥ strīkṣīrasrugarkadugdhayuta eṣa kalko vartīkṛto drāgeva nāḍīṃ hanti| indravajrāvṛttam|

sāmudrasauvarcalasindhujanma supakvaghoṇṭāphalaveśmadhūmāḥ| āmrātagāyatrijapallavāśca kaṭaṃkaṭeryāvatha cetakī ca|39| kalke'bhyaṅge cūrṇe vartyāṃ caiteṣu śīlyamāneṣu| agatiriva naśyati gatiścapalā capaleṣu bhūtiriva|40| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭha uttarasthāne granthyarbudaślīpadāpacīnāḍīpratiṣedho nāma triṃśo'dhyāyaḥ|30|

Sa. samudralavaṇādikaṃ kalke'bhyaṅge cūrṇe vartyāṃ cāmīṣvabhyasyamāneṣvavidyamānagatiriva gatiḥ śīghraṃ naśyati| capalā capaleṣu nareṣu bhūtiḥ-vittaṃ, yatheti| upajātirāryā ca| iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛda yaṭīkāyāṃ sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭha uttarasthāne granthyarbudaślīpadāpacīnāḍīpratiṣedho nāma triṃśo'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 30||

div.head: kṣudrarogavijñānīyādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: kṣudrarogavijñānaṃ kramaprāptamācikhyāsurāha ---- athātaḥ kṣudrarogavijñānīyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātrayādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre)|2| snigdhā savarṇā grathitā nīrujā mudgasannibhā| piṭikā kaphavātābhyāṃ bālānāmajagallikā||1||

div.ab: Sa. bālānāṃ kaphavātābhyāṃ snigdhādiguṇayuktā piṭikā'jagallikākhyā syāt|
yavaprakhyā yavaprakhyā tābhyāṃ māṃsāśritā ghanā| -----------------------------------------------|2|
Sa. tābhyāṃ-vātakaphābhyāṃ, yavaprakhyā-yavasaṃjñā| sā yavaprakhyā-yavākārā, maṃsāśritā ghanā kaṭhinā ca|
-----------------------------------------------| avaktrā cālajī vṛttā stokapūyā ghanonnatā||2|| granthayaḥ pañca vā ṣaḍvā kacchapī kacchaponnatāḥ| -----------------------------------------------|3|
Sa. granthayaḥ pañca vā ṣaḍvā, kimbhūtāḥ ? amukhāstathā'lajīva vṛttāḥ-vartulāḥ, stokapūyā ghanā unnatāśca kacchapītyucyate| sā ca kacchaponnatā syāt|
Sa. karṇasyopariṣṭāt parito vā piṭikā kaṭhinā tīvrarujā śālūkanibhā panasikāsaṃjñā|

ab.seg: ---------------------śophastvalparujaḥ sthiraḥ| hanusandhisamudbhūtastābhyāṃ pāṣāṇagardabhaḥ||4||

div.ab: Sa. śopho'lparujaḥ sthiro hanusandhisamāśrito vātakaphābhyāṃ pāṣāṇagardabhaḥ|

ab.seg: śālmalīkaṇṭakākārāḥ piṭikāḥ sarujo ghanāḥ| medogarbhā mukhe yūnāṃ tābhyāṃ ca mukhadūṣikāḥ||5||

div.ab: Sa. vātakaphābhyāṃ śālmalīkaṇṭakasadṛśāḥ piṭikā rujānvitā ghanā medogarbhāstaruṇānāṃ mukhe syuḥ| tāśca mukhadūṣikāḥ|

ab.seg: te padmakaṇṭakā jñeyā yaiḥ padmamiva kaṇṭakaiḥ| cīyate nīrujaiḥ śvetaiḥ śarīraṃ kaphavātajaiḥ||6||

div.ab: Sa. padmakaṇṭakasaṃjñāste vedyāḥ, yaiḥ kaṇṭakairnīrujaiḥ śvetavarṇairvātakaphajaiḥ padmamiva śarīraṃ cīyate|

ab.seg: pittena piṭikā vṛttā pakvodumbarasannibhā| mahādāhajvarakarī vivṛtā vivṛtānanā||7||

div.ab: Sa. pittena yā piṭikā vartulā pakvodumbaraphalanibhāmahādāhajvarakṛcca, sā vivṛtākhyā vivṛtamukhā syāt|

ab.seg: gātreṣvantaśca vaktrasya dāhajvararujānvitāḥ| masūramātrāstadvarṇāstatsaṃjñāḥ piṭikā ghanāḥ||8||

div.ab: Sa. gātreṣu-avayaveṣu, vaktrasya cāntare dāhādiyutā masūrapramāṇāstadvarṇāstatsaṃjñā masūrikā ghanāḥ piṭikāḥ|
tataḥ kaṣṭatarāḥ sphoṭā visphoṭākhyā mahārujāḥ| -----------------------------------------------|9|
Sa. tābhyo masūrikābhyo dāruṇatamāḥ sphoṭā mahārujā visphoṭāsaṃjñāḥ|
Sa. padmakarṇikānibhā yā piṭikā piṭakairācitā, sā vātapittābhyāṃ viddhākhyā syāt|

ab.seg: -------------------tābhyāmeva ca gardabhī| maṇḍalā vipulotsannā sarāgapiṭikācitā||10||

div.ab: Sa. tābhyāmeva-vātapittābhyāṃ, gardabhīsaṃjñā maṇḍalākārā vistīrṇā tathotsannā sarāgapiṭakairācitā|

ab.seg: kakṣeti kakṣāsanneṣu prāyo deśeṣu sā'nilāt| pittādbhavanti piṭikāḥ sūkṣmā lājopamā ghanāḥ||11||

div.ab: Sa. kakṣānikaṭeṣu pradeśeṣu sā gardabhī kakṣetyucyate| sā ca vātāt syāt| tasyāmeva pittena sūkṣmāḥ piṭikā lājākārā ghanāḥ kakṣāsaṃjñā eva syuḥ|
tādṛśī mahatī tvekā gandhanāmeti kīrtitā| -----------------------------------------------|12|
Sa. tādṛśī-lājasadṛśī, mahatī piṭikaikā gandhanāmeti smṛtā|
-----------------------------------------------| gharmasvedaparīte'ṅge piṭikāḥ sarujo ghanāḥ||12|| rājikāvarṇasaṃsthānapramāṇā rājikāhvayāḥ| -----------------------------------------------|13|
Sa. gharmasvedayukte śarīre piṭikā rujāyutā ghanā rājikāvarṇā rājikākārā rājikāpramāṇā rājikāsaṃjñāḥ|
-----------------------------------------------| doṣaiḥ pittolbaṇairmandairvisarpiti visarpavat||13|| śopho'pākastanustāmro jvarakṛjjālagardabhaḥ| -----------------------------------------------|14|
Sa. pittādhikairdoṣairmandairyaḥ śopho visarpa iva visarpati, tathā'pākastanustāmravarṇo jvarakārī ca, sa jālagardabhaḥ syāt|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------------| malaiḥ pittolbaṇaiḥ sphoṭā jvariṇo māṃsadāraṇāḥ||14||
kakṣābhāgeṣu jāyante ye'gnyābhāḥ sā'gnirohiṇī| pañcāhātsaptarātrādvā pakṣādvā hantijīvitam||15||

div.ab: Sa. pittolbaṇairmalairjvaravato māṃsadāraṇāḥ sphoṭāḥ kakṣāpradeśeṣu ye'gnisadṛśā jāyante, sā'gnirohiṇītyucyate| pañcāhena saptarātreṇa pakṣeṇa vā jīvitaṃ hanti|
triliṅgā piṭikā vṛttā jatrūrdhvamirivellikā| -----------------------------------------------|16|
Sa. tridoṣalakṣaṇā piṭikā vartulā jatruṇa ūrdhvamirivellikākhyā|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------| vidārīkandakaṭhinā vidārī kakṣavaṅkṣaṇe||16||

div.ab: Sa. vidārīkandavat kaṭhinā kakṣāyāṃ vaṅkṣaṇe ca vidārī syāt| kakṣā ca vaṅkṣaṇaṃ ca kakṣāvaṅkṣaṇaṃ tasmin| "pāṇyoḥ"(?) ityādinā hrasvaḥ|

medonilakaphairgranthiḥ snāyumāṃsasirāśrayaiḥ| bhinno vasājyamadhvābhaṃ sravettatrolbaṇo'nilaḥ||17|| māṃsaṃ viśoṣya grathitāṃ śarkarāmupapādayet| durgandhaṃ rudhiraṃ klinnaṃ nānāvarṇaṃ tato malāḥ||18|| tāṃ srāvayanti nicitāṃ vidyāttaccharkarārbudam| -----------------------------------------------|19|

Sa. medaḥpavanakaphaiḥ snāyumāṃsasirāśrayairgranthiḥ syāt| sa ca bhinno vasāghṛtamadhunibhaṃ sravet| tasmin pavano'dhiko māṃsaṃ viśoṣya grathitāṃ śarkarāṃ kuryāt| tato doṣāstāṃ-śarkarāṃ, nicitāṃ durgandhaṃ lohitaṃ klinnaṃ vividhavarṇaṃ srāvayanti| tat evaṃvidhaṃ, śarkarārbudaṃ vidyāt|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------| pāṇipādatale sandhau jatrūrdhvaṃ vopacīyate||19||
valmīkavacchanairgranthistadvadbahvaṇubhirmukhaiḥ| rugdāhakaṇḍūkledāḍhyairvalmīko'sau samastajaḥ||20||

div.ab: Sa. pāṇitale pādatale sandhau jatrūrdhvaṃ vā granthirvalmīka iva śanairupacīyate| tadvatvalmīkavat, bahūni ca tānyaṇūni ca, tairbhūrisūkṣmairvadanairupalakṣito rugdāhakaṇḍūkledabahulo valmīkākhyo'sau tridoṣajaḥ|

ab.seg: śarkaronmathite pāde kṣate vā kaṇṭakādibhiḥ| granthiḥ kīlavadutsanno jāyate kadaraṃ tu tat||21||

div.ab: Sa. śarkarādibhirunmathite pāde kaṇṭakādibhirvā kṣate kīlasadṛśo granthirutsanno jāyate, tatkadaraṃ nāma|
vegasandhāraṇādvāyurapāno'pānasaṃśrayam| aṇūkaroti bāhyāntarmārgasya tataḥ śakṛt||22|| kṛcchrānnirgacchati vyādhirayaṃ ruddhagudo mataḥ| -----------------------------------------------|23|
Sa. apānākhyo vāyurvegasandhāraṇādapānāśrayaṃ mārgaṃ bāhyāntaraṇūkaroti| tato'sya-āturasya, kṛcchreṇa śakṛnniryāti| ayaṃ rogo ruddhagudo mataḥ|
-----------------------------------------------| kuryātpittānilaṃ pākaṃ nakhamāṃse sarugjvaram||23|| cipyamakṣatarogaṃ ca vidyādupanakhaṃ ca tam| -----------------------------------------------|24|
Sa. pittānilaṃ kartṛ nakhamāṃse sarugjvaraṃ pākaṃ kuryāt| taṃ cipyaṃ tathā'kṣatarogamupanakhaṃ ca vidyāt|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------| kṛṣṇo'bhighātādrūkṣaśca kharaśca kunakho nakhaḥ||24||

div.ab: Sa. abhighātāt kṛṣṇavarṇo rūkṣaśca kharaśca nakhaḥ kunakhākhyaḥ|
duṣṭakardamasaṃsparśāt kaṇḍūkledānvitāntarāḥ| aṅgulyo'lasamityāhuḥ-------------------------|25|
Sa. duṣṭakardamasaṃsparśāt kaṇḍūkledayutāntarā aṅgulyo'lasamiti vadanti|
Sa. tilasadṛśān kṛṣṇavarṇānarujāṃstvaksthāṃstilakālakānāhuḥ|
Sa. tāneva tilakālakānunnatān maṣānāhuḥ|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------| maṣebhyastūnnatatarāṃścarmakīlān sitāsitān||26||

div.ab: Sa. maṣebhyaḥ sakāśādunnatatarān varṇataḥ sitāsitān carmakīlāṃstānāhuḥ|
tathāvidho jatumaṇiḥ sahajo lohitastu saḥ| -----------------------------------------------|27|
Sa. tatpramāṇo jatumaṇiḥ sahajo lohitavarṇaścāsau syāt|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------| kṛṣṇaṃ sitaṃ vā sahajaṃ maṇḍalaṃ lāñchanaṃ samam||27||

div.ab: Sa. śuklaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ vā sahajaṃ maṇḍalākāraṃ śarīrasamaṃ lāñchanamāhuḥ|

śokakrodhādikupitādvātapittānmukhe tanu| śyāmalaṃ maṇḍalaṃ vyaṅgaṃ, vaktrādanyatra nīlikā||28|| paruṣaṃ paruṣasparśaṃ vyaṅgaṃ śyāvaṃ ca mārutāt| pittāttāmrāntamānīlaṃ, śvetāntaṃ kaṇḍumatkaphāt||29|| raktādraktāntamātāmra sauṣaṃ cimicimāyate| -----------------------------------------------|30|

Sa. vātapittācchokādikruddhāt tanu śyāmavarṇaṃ maṇḍalākāraṃ mukhe vyaṅgaṃ vadanti| mukādanyatra nīlikā| paruṣacchavistathā paruṣasparśaṃ śyāmavarṇaṃ ca vyaṅgaṃ vātāt syāt| pittena tāmrāntaṃ kiñcinnīlam| kaphena śvetāntaṃ sakaṇḍu ca syāt| raktādraktāntaṃ kiñcittāmramoṣayutaṃ cimicimāyate ca|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------| vāyunodīritaḥ śleṣmā tvacaṃ prāpya viśuṣyati||30||
tatastvagjāyate pāṇḍuḥ krameṇa ca vicetanā| alpakaṇḍūravikledā sā prasuptiḥ prasuptitaḥ||31||

div.ab: Sa. pavanena kaphaḥ preritastvacaṃ prāpya viśuṣyati| anantaraṃ tvak pāṇḍuḥ krameṇa ca vicetanā alpakaṇḍūrvikledarahitā ca jāyate| sā prasuptitaḥ prasuptiḥ syāt|
asamyagvamanodīrṇapittaśleṣmānnanigrahaiḥ| maṇḍalānyatikaṇḍūni rāgavanti bahūni ca||32|| utkoṭhaḥ--------------------------------| -----------------------------------------------|33|
Sa. asamyagvamanena preritapittaśleṣmānnanigrahairmaṇḍalānyatiśayakaṇḍūni lohitāni bahūni ca utkoṭhaḥ syāt|
Sa. sa evānubaddhaḥ koṭha ityucyate|

-----------------------------------------------| proktāḥ ṣaṭtriṃśadityete kṣudrarogā vibhāgaśaḥ|33| |yānavijñāya muhyeta cikitsāyāṃ cikitsakaḥ| ] iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne kṣudrarogavijñānīyaṃ nāmaikatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ|31|

Sa. iti-anena prakāreṇa, ṣaṭtriṃśat kṣudrarogā vibhāgenoktā iti| iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdaya ṭīkāyāṃ sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne kṣudraroga vijñānīyaṃ nāmaikatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 31||

div.head: kṣudrarogapratiṣedhādhyayaḥ
div.ab: athaiṣāṃ cikitsitaṃ vivakṣurāha ---- athātaḥ kṣudrarogapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre)|2| visrāvayejjalaukābhirapakvāmajagallikām| -----------------------------------------|1|
Sa. ajagallikāmapakvāṃ jalajanmabhirvisrāvayet|
Sa. yavaprakhyāṃ svedayitvā vilāyanārthaṃ pralepayeddārvādibhiḥ|

ab.seg: -----------------------------ityāpāṣāṇagardabhāt| vidhistāṃścācaretpakvān vraṇavatsājagallikān||2||

div.ab: Sa. pāṣāṇagardabhaṃ yāvadeṣa vidhiḥ| tena granthi(alajī)kacchapaśālūka(panasikā)pāṣāṇagardabhānāṃ pūrvoktaṃ kāryamityavatiṣṭhate| tāṃśca pakvān ajagallikāṃ ca vraṇavadupakramet|
rodhrakustumbaruvacāḥ pralepo mukhadūṣike| vaṭapallavayuktā vā nārikelotthaśuktayaḥ||3|| aśāntau vamanaṃ nasyaṃ lalāṭe ca sirāvyadhaḥ| -----------------------------------------|4|
Sa. mukhadūṣike rodhrādayaḥ pralepaḥ, vaṭapallavayuktā nārikelaśuktayo vā| evamapyanupaśame vamanaṃ nasyaṃ ca hitam| lalāṭe ca sirāmokṣaḥ|
-----------------------------------------| nimbāmbuvānto nimbāmbusādhitaṃ padmakaṇṭake||4|| pibetkṣaudrānvitaṃ sarpirnimbāragvadhalepanam| -----------------------------------------|5|
Sa. padmakaṇṭake nimbāmbunā kṛtavamano nimbakvāthapakvaṃ ghṛtaṃ sakṣaudraṃ pibet| nimbakarṇikārābhyāṃ lepaḥ|

ab.seg: vivṛtādīṃstu jālāntāṃścikitsetserivellikān| pittavīsarpavattadvat pratyākhyāyāgnirohiṇīm||5||

div.ab: Sa. vivṛtādīn jālāntānnirivellikāṃ ca pittavisarpamiva cikitset| agnirohiṇīṃ ca pratyākhyāya cikitset|

ab.seg: vilaṅghanaṃ raktavimokṣaṇaṃ ca virūkṣaṇaṃ kāyaviśodhanaṃ ca| dhātrīprayogān śiśirapradehān kuryātsadā jālakagardabhasya||6||

div.ab: Sa. jālakagardabhasya laṅghanādi yathāvasthaṃ sadā kuryāt|
vidārikāṃ hṛte rakte śleṣmagranthivadācaret| -----------------------------------------|7|
Sa. vidārikāṃ rakte srute kaphagranthimiva cikitset|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| medorbudakriyāṃ kuryātsutarāṃ śarkarārbude||7||

div.ab: Sa. śarkarābude suṣṭhu medorbudakriyāṃ kuryāt|
pravṛddhaṃ subahucchidraṃ saśophaṃ marmaṇi sthitam| valmīkaṃ hastapāde ca varjayed-------------------|8|
Sa. valmīkaṃ pravṛddhādiguṇaṃ hastapāde jātaṃ ca varjayet|

ab.seg: śuddhasyāsre hṛte limpet sapaṭvārevatāmṛtaiḥ| śyāmākulatthikāmūladantīpalalasaktubhiḥ||9||

div.ab: Sa. itarat punarvalmīkaṃ śuddhasya rakte hṛte śyāmādibhiḥ salavaṇakarṇikāraguḍūcībhirlimpet|

ab.seg: pakve tu duṣṭamāṃsāni gatīḥ sarvāśca śodhayet| śastreṇa samyaganu ca kṣāreṇa jvalanena vā||10||

div.ab: Sa. pakve tu [valmīke] duṣṭamāṃsāni sarvāśca gatīḥ śodhayet| kena ? śastreṇa| katham ? samyak| paścāt kṣāreṇāgninā ca (vā)|
śastreṇotkṛtya niḥśeṣaṃ snehena kadaraṃ dahet| ---------------------------------------------|11|
Sa. kadaraṃ śastreṇa niḥśeṣamutkṛtya snehena dahet|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| niruddhamaṇivatkāryaṃ ruddhapāyościkitsitam||11||

div.ab: Sa. ruddhagude cikitsitaṃ niruddhamaṇisadṛśaṃ kāryam|
cipyaṃ śuddhyā jitoṣmāṇaṃ sādhayecchastrakarmaṇā| ---------------------------------------------|12|
Sa. cipyaṃ śuddhyā-virekādikayā, jitoṣmāṇaṃ santaṃ śastrakarmaṇā sādhayet|
Sa. kunakhaṃ duṣṭamapyevameva sādhayet|
---------------------------------------------| ---------------------------caraṇāvalase punaḥ||12|| dhānyāmlasiktau kāsīsapaṭolīrocanātilaiḥ| sanimbapatrairālimped-------------------------|13|
Sa. alase tu caraṇau kañjikasiktau kāsīsādibhiḥ sanimbapatrairālimpet|
Sa. tilakālakān maṣāṃśca sūryakāntadibhirdahet|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| tadvadutkṛtya śastreṇa carmakīlajatūmaṇī||14||

div.ab: Sa. carmakīlajatūmaṇī śastreṇoddhṛ(tkṛ)tya tathaiva sūryakāntādibhirdahet|

ab.seg: lāñchanāditraye kuryādyathāsannaṃ sirāvyadham| lepayetkṣīrapiṣṭaiśca kṣīrivṛkṣatvagaṅkuraiḥ||15||

div.ab: Sa. lāñchanādiṣu triṣu-lāñchanavyaṅganīlikāsu, yathāsannaṃ sirāṃ vidhyet| kṣīrivṛkṣāṇāṃ tvagbhiraṅkuraiśca kṣīrapiṣṭairlepayet|

ab.seg: vyaṅgeṣu cārjunatvagvā mañjiṣṭhā vā samākṣikā| lepaḥ sanavanītā vā śvetāśvakhurajā maṣī||16||

div.ab: Sa. vyaṅgādiṣu cāyaṃ lepo'rjunavalkaṃ kṣīrapiṣṭaṃ vā| mañjiṣṭhā mākṣikasahitā vā| śvetāśvakhurajā maṣī sanavanītā vā|

ab.seg: raktacandanamañjiṣṭhākuṣṭharodhrapriyaṅgavaḥ vaṭāṅkurā masūrāśca vyaṅgaghnā mukhakāntidāḥ||17||

div.ab: Sa. raktacandanādayo vyaṅgaharā mukhakāntikarāḥ 'lepāḥ' iti prakṛtatvād gamyate|

ab.seg: dve jīrake kṛṣṇatilāḥ sarṣapāḥ payasā saha| piṣṭāḥ kurvanti vaktrendumapāstavyaṅgalāñchanam||18||
kṣīrapiṣṭā ghṛtakṣaudrayuktā vā bhṛṣṭanistuṣāḥ| masūrāḥ kṣīrapiṣṭā vā tīkṣṇāḥ śālmalikaṇṭakāḥ||19||
saguḍaḥ kolamajjā vā śaśāsṛkṣaudrakalkitaḥ| saptāhaṃ mātuluṅgasthaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ vā madhunā'nvitam||20||
piṣṭā vā chāgapayasā sakṣaudrā mauśalī jaṭā| gorasthi muśalīmūlayuktaṃ vā sājyamākṣikam||21||

div.ab: Sa. jīrakadvayādayo lepe prayuktāḥ payasā piṣṭā vaktracandraṃ nirastavyaṅgalāñchanaṃ vidadhati| vaktramevenduḥ, vyaṅgameva lāñchanamiti rūpakālaṅkāraḥ| masūrā bhṛṣṭā nistuṣāśca kṣīrapiṣṭāḥ sarpirmākṣikānvitā lepaḥ| śālmalīkaṇṭakāstīkṣṇāḥ kṣīrapiṣṭā vā lepaḥ| kolasya-amlabadarasya, majjā śaśāsṛkkṣaudrapiṣṭo guḍānvito lepaḥ| saptāhaṃ bījapūrasyāntarasthitaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ mākṣikayutaṃ vā lepaḥ| mouśalī jaṭā-śālmalīmūlaṃ, chagalīkṣīrapiṣṭaṃ sakṣaudraṃ vā lepaḥ| gavyamasthi tālapatrīmūlānvitaṃ saghṛtamākṣikaṃ vā lepaḥ

ab.seg: jambvāmrapallavā mastu haridre dve navo guḍaḥ| lepaḥ savarṇakṛt piṣṭaṃ svarasena ca tindukam||22||

div.ab: Sa. jambvāmrapallavādiko lepaḥ savarṇakaraḥ| tindukaṃ ca svarasena piṣṭaṃ lepaḥ savarṇakaraḥ|

ab.seg: utpalamutpalakuṣṭhaṃ priyaṅgukālīyakaṃ badaramajjā| idamudvartanamāsyaṃ karoti śatapatrasaṃkāśam||23||

div.ab: Sa. utpalādikametadudvartanaṃ padmasadṛśaṃ mukhaṃ vidhatte| āryā|

ab.seg: ebhirevauṣadhaiḥ piṣṭairmukhābhyaṅgāya sādhayet| yathādoṣartukān snehān madhukakvāthasaṃyutaiḥ||24||

div.ab: Sa. ebhireva-pūrvoditaiḥ, piṣṭairmadhukakvāthānvitairmukhābhyaṅgārthaṃ yathādoṣaṃ yathartu snehān pācayet|

ab.seg: yavān sarjarasaṃ rodhramuśīraṃ madanaṃ madhu| ghṛtaṃ guḍaṃ ca gomūtre pacedādarvilepanāt||25||
tadabhyaṅgānnihantyāśu nīlikāvyaṅgadūṣikān| mukhaṃ karoti padmābhaṃ pādau padmadalopamau||26||

div.ab: Sa. yavādīn darvīlepaṃ yāvad gomūtre pācayet| etadabhyaṅgād drāgeva nīlikādīn hanti| vaktraṃ śatapatrasadṛśaṃ karoti| caraṇau paṅkajapatratulyau vidadhāti|

ab.seg: kuṅkumośīrakālīyalākṣāyaṣṭyāhvacandanam| nyagrodhapādāṃstaruṇān padmakaṃ padmakesaram||27||
sanīlotpalamañjiṣṭhaṃ pālikaṃ sasilāḍhake| paktvā pādāvaśeṣeṇa tena piṣṭaiśca kārṣikaiḥ||28||
lākṣāpattaṅgamañjiṣṭhāyaṣṭīmadhukakuṅkumaiḥ| ajākṣīraṃ dviguṇitaṃ tailasya kuḍavaṃ pacet||29||
nīlikāpalitavyaṅgavalītilakadūṣikān| hanti tannasyamabhyastaṃ mukhopacayavarṇakṛt||30||

div.ab: Sa. kuṅkumādikaṃ sanīlotpalamañjiṣṭhaṃ palapramāṇaṃ jalāḍhake paktvā tena pādāvaśeṣeṇa lākṣādibhiśca piṣṭaiḥ kārṣikaistailasya kuḍavaṃ chāgīkṣīraṃ dvikuḍavaṃ pacet| tat-tailaṃ, nasyaṃ śīlitaṃ nīlikādīn hanti| mukhopacayakaraṃ varṇakaraṃ ca|

ab.seg: mañjiṣṭhā śabarodbhavastuvarikā lākṣā haridrādvayaṃ nepālī haritālakuṅkumagadā gorocanā gairikam| patraṃ pāṇḍu vaṭasya candanayugaṃ kālīyakaṃ pāradaṃ pataṅgaṃ kanakatvacaṃ kamalajaṃ bījaṃ tathā kesaram||31||
sikthaṃ tutthaṃ padmakādyo vasā''jyaṃ majjā kṣīraṃ kṣīrivṛkṣāmbu cāgnau| siddhaṃ siddhaṃ vyaṅganīlyādināśe vaktre chāyāmaindavīṃ cāśu dhatte||32||

div.ab: Sa. kanakasya tvak-kanakatvak, tāṃ kanakatvacam| mañjiṣṭhādīni vasā ghṛtaṃ majjā gokṣīraṃ kṣīrivṛkṣakvātha etadagnau pakvaṃ vyaṅgādināśe siddhaṃ-avyāhataśakti| mukhasya kāntiṃ cāndramasīṃ śīghraṃ karoti| śārdūlavikrīḍitaśālinyau vṛtte|
mārkavasvarasakṣīratoyānīṣṭāni nāvane| ---------------------------------------------|33|
Sa. nāvane-nasye, mārkavasvarasādīni|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| prasuptau vātakuṣṭhoktaṃ kuryāddāhaṃ ca vahninā||33||

div.ab: Sa. prasuptau vātakuṣṭhavihitaṃ kuryāt| vahninā ca dahet|
Sa. utkoṭhe kaphapittavihitaṃ kāryam|

----------------------koṭhe sarvaṃ ca kauṣṭhikam| 33 1/2| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne kṣudrarogapratiṣedho nāma dvātriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ|32|

ab.seg: Sa. koṭhe ca sarvaṃ kuṣṭhoktamiti| iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayaṭīkāyāṃ sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne kṣudrarogapratiṣedho nāma dvātriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ||32||

div.head: guhyarogavijñānīyādhyāyaḥ
div.ab: athāto guhyarogavijñānīyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre)||2|| strīvyavāyanivṛttasya sahasā bhajato'thavā| doṣādhyuṣitasaṅkīrṇamalināṇurajaḥ pathām||1|| anyayonimanicchantīmagamyāṃ navasūtikām| dūṣitaṃ spṛśatastoyaṃ ratānteṣvapi naiva vā||2|| vivardhayiṣayā tīkṣṇān pralepādīn prayacchataḥ| muṣṭidantanakhotpīḍāviṣavacchūkapātanaiḥ||3|| veganigrahadīrghātikharasparśavighaṭṭanaiḥ| doṣā duṣṭā gatā guhyaṃ trayoviṃśatimāmayān||4|| janayantyupadaṃśādīn-------------------------| ---------------------------------------------|5|

Sa. vanitāsambhogānnivṛttasya sahasā-akasmādeva, strīvyavāyaṃ bhajataḥ| kecit karādinaiva vyavāyābhāsaṃ kurvanti tannivṛttyai strīgrahaṇam| athaveti vakṣyamāṇaguṇāṃ striyaṃ sevamānasya| kimbhūtām ? vātādyadhiṣṭhitastathā saṅkīrṇaḥ-saṅkaṭo, malino'ṇuḥ-sūkṣmo, rajomārgo yasyāstāṃ tathāvidhāṃ striyam| tathā'nyayoni-mahiṣyādim| tathā'nabhilaṣantīm| tathā'gamyāṃ-bhaginyādim| tathā navaprasūtām| tathā dūṣitaṃ saviṣajantvādibhirjalaṃ spṛśato, ratānteṣvapi naiva vā jalaṃ spṛśataḥ| vivardhayitumicchayā tīkṣṇān pralepasekādīn vā prakṛtatvāt guhye prayacchataḥ| tathā muṣṭyādipātanaistathā vegarodhanena tathā dīrghātikharasparśanena ca yāni vighaṭṭanāni, taireva doṣā duṣṭā guhyaṃ prāptāstrayoviṃśati vakṣyamāṇān upadaṃśādīn kurvanti|
--------------------------upadaṃśo'tra pañcadhā| pṛthagdoṣaiḥ sarudhiraiḥ samastaiśca--------------|5|
Sa. atra-eṣu madhye, upadaṃśaḥ pañcaprakāraḥ| katham? ityāha-doṣaiḥ pṛthak trayaḥ, raktena caturthaḥ, sannipātena pañcamaḥ|
Sa. eṣāṃ madhye vātenopadaṃśe meḍhre śopho bhavati| dāruṇāḥ pīḍāḥ stambhastathā tvacaḥ paripoṭanam|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| pakvodumbarasaṅkāśaḥ pittena śvayathurjvaraḥ||6||

div.ab: Sa. pittena śvayathuḥ pakvodumbaraphalanibho jvaraśca syāt|
śleṣmaṇā kaṭhinaḥ snigdhaḥ kaṇḍūmān śītalo guruḥ| ---------------------------------------------|7|
Sa. śleṣmaṇā śvayathuḥ kaṭhinādiguṇaḥ syāt|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| śoṇitenāsitasphoṭasambhavo'srasrutirjvaraḥ||7||

div.ab: Sa. lohitena kṛṣṇasphoṭasambhavādayaḥ syuḥ|

ab.seg: sarvaje sarvaliṅgatvaṃ śvayathurmuṣkayorapi| tīvrā rugāśupacanaṃ daraṇaṃ kṛmisambhavaḥ||8||

div.ab: Sa. sarvadoṣaje sarvaliṅgatvaṃ śvayathuśca muṣkayoḥ syāt| tīvrā ruk śīghrapākādiśca|
yāpyo raktodbhavasteṣāṃ mṛtyave sannipātajaḥ| ---------------------------------------------|9|
Sa. eteṣāṃ madhye raktajo yāpyaḥ| sannipātottho mṛtyuhetuḥ|

---------------------------------------------| jāyante kupitairdoṣairguhyāsṛkpiśitāśrayaiḥ||9|| antarbahirvā meḍhrasya kaṇḍūlā māṃsakīlakāḥ| picchilāsrasravā yonau tadvacca cchatrasannibhāḥ||10|| te'rśāṃsyupekṣayā ghnanti meḍhrapuṃstvaṃ bhagārtavam| ---------------------------------------------|11|

Sa. saṃ-doṣairguhyaraktamāṃsāśrayaiḥ kruddhairmeḍhrasyāntarbahirvā kaṇḍūlā māṃsakīlakāḥ-śaṅkavo, jāyante| tathā picchilaraktasrāviṇaḥ| tathaiva yonau chatrasadṛśāḥ syuḥ| te māṃsakīlā arśāṃsi gadyante| upekṣitāśca meḍhre jātāḥ puṃstvaṃ ghnanti| bhage jātā ārtavaṃ ghnanti|
---------------------------------------------| guhyasya bahirantarvā piṭikāḥ kapharaktajāḥ||11|| sarṣapāmānasaṃsthānā ghanāḥ sarṣapikāḥ smṛtāḥ| ---------------------------------------------|12|
Sa. guhyasya bāhyato'ntare vā kapharaktajāḥ piṭikāḥ sarṣapapramaṇāḥ sarṣapākārā ghanāḥ sarṣapikāḥ smṛtāḥ|
---------------------------------------------| piṭikā bahavo dīrghā dīryante madhyataśca yāḥ||12|| so'vamanthaḥ kaphāsṛgbhyāṃ vedanāromaharṣavān| ---------------------------------------------|13|
Sa. piṭikā bahavo dīrghā madhye ca yā dīryante, so'vamantho vedanāromāñcavān kapharaktābhyāṃ syāt|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| kumbhīkā raktapittotthā jāmbavāsthinibhā''śujā||13||

div.ab: Sa. jāmbavāsthirūpā kumbhīkā raktapittodbhavā śīghrotpattiśca|
Sa. alajīṃ pramehe yathā, tathā'sminnapi vidyāt|
---------------------uttamāṃ pittaraktajām| piṭikāṃ māṣamudgābhāṃ-------------------------|14|
Sa. uttamākhyāṃ pittaraktajāṃ meḍhrapiṭikāṃ māṣasamāṃ mudgābhāṃ vidyāt|
Sa. piṭikācitā yā piṭikā syāt, tathā padmakarṇikākārā puṣkarakarkaṭābhā, tāṃ puṣkariketi vidyāt|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| pāṇibhyāṃ bhṛśasaṃvyūḍhe saṃvyūḍhapiṭikā bhavet||15||

div.ab: Sa. hastābhyāmatiśayena saṃvyūḍhe-ghṛṣṭe sati, saṃvyūḍhapiṭikākhyā syāt|
mṛditaṃ mṛditaṃ vastrasaṃrabdhaṃ vātakopataḥ| ---------------------------------------------|16|
Sa. mṛditaṃ-malitaṃ, vastrasaṃrabdhaṃ-vāsasā kṣobhitaṃ, vātakopānmṛditaṃ syāt|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| viṣamā kaṭhinā bhugnā vāyunā'ṣṭhīlikā smṛtā||16||

div.ab: Sa. yā piṭikā viṣamā samunnatā tathā kaṭhinā kuṭilā ca pavanenāṣṭhīlikā gaditā|

ab.seg: vimardanādiduṣṭena vāyunā carma meḍhrajam| nivartate sarugdāhaṃ kvacitpākaṃ ca gacchati||17||
piṇḍitaṃ granthitaṃ carma tatpralambamadho maṇeḥ| nivṛttasaṃjñaṃ sakaphaṃ kaṇḍūkāṭhinyavattu tat||18||

div.ab: Sa. vāyunā vimardanādiduṣṭena meḍhrajaṃ carma sarugdāhaṃ nivartate| kvacit-kadācit, pākamapi yāti| tat-carma, maṇeradhaḥ piṇḍitaṃ granthitaṃ pralambaṃ ca syāt| tatsakaphaṃ-kaphena tu saha, kaṇḍūkāṭhinyayutaṃ nivṛttasaṃjñaṃ syāt|
duruḍhaṃ sphuṭitaṃ carma nirdiṣṭamavapāṭikā| ---------------------------------------------|19|
Sa. kṛcchreṇa rohati yacca duḥsphuṭitaṃ carma, tat kathitamavapāṭikā|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| vātena dūṣitaṃ carma maṇau saktaṃ ruṇaddhi cet||19||
sroto mūtraṃ tato'bhyeti mandadhāramavedanam| maṇervikāśarodhaśca sa niruddhamaṇirgadaḥ||20||

div.ab: Sa. vātena carma dūṣitaṃ maṇau saktaṃ cet sroto ruṇaddhi| tato mandadhāramarujaṃ mūtrameti| maṇeśca vikāśarodhaḥ| sa evaṃ vidho rogo niruddhamaṇisaṃjñaḥ|
liṅgaṃ śūkairivāpūrṇaṃ grathitākhyaṃ kaphodbhavam| ---------------------------------------------|21|
Sa. liṅgaṃ śūkairākīrṇamiva syāt, tad grathitasaṃjñaṃ kaphajam|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| śūkadūṣitaraktotthā sparśahānistadāhvayā||21||

div.ab: Sa. śūkadūṣitaraktodbhavā sparśahāniḥ, sā sparśahānisaṃjñā|

ab.seg: chidrairaṇumukhairyattu mehanaṃ sarvataścitam| vātaśoṇitakopena taṃ vidyācchataponakam||22||

div.ab: Sa. yatpunarmeḍhraṃ chidraiḥ sūkṣmamukhaiḥ sarvataḥ-paritaḥ, citaṃ vātaśoṇitakopāt, taṃ śataponakaṃ vidyāt|
pittāsṛgbhyāṃ tvacaḥ pākastvakpāko jvaradāhavān| ---------------------------------------------|23|
Sa. pittaraktābhyāṃ tvacaḥ pāko jvaradāhānvitastvakpākākhyaḥ|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| māṃspākaḥ sarvajaḥ sarvavedano māṃsaśātanaḥ||23||

div.ab: Sa. sarvadoṣottho māṃspākākhyaḥ sarvavedano māṃsaśātanaḥ|

ab.seg: sarāgairasitaiḥ sphoṭaiḥ piṭikābhiśca pīḍitam| mehanaṃ vedanā cogrā taṃ vidyādasṛgarbudam||24||

div.ab: Sa. īṣallohitaiḥ kṛṣṇaiḥ sphoṭaiḥ piṭikābhiśca pīḍitaṃ liṅgaṃ vedanāśca dāruṇāḥ, taṃ-evaṃvidhaṃ, raktārbudaṃ jānīyāt|
Sa. māṃsārbudaṃ pūrvamuktaṃ granthyādirogavijñānīye(u. a.29)| tacca tridoṣajam|
Sa. vidradhiśca tridoṣajaḥ| sa ukto vidradhyādinidāne (ni. a. 11/9)|
---------------------------------------------| kṛṣṇāni bhūtvā māṃsāni viśīryante samantataḥ||25|| pakvāni sannipātena tān vidyāttilakālakān| ---------------------------------------------|26|
Sa. liṅge kṛṣṇāni māṃsāni bhūtvā parito viśīryante pakvāni sannipātena| tān-evaṃprakārān, tilakālakān vidyāt|
---------------------------------------------| māṃsotthamarbudaṃ pākaṃ vidradhiṃ tilakālakān||26|| caturo varjayedeṣāṃ śeṣāṃśchīghramupācaret| ---------------------------------------------|27|
Sa. eṣāṃ madhye māṃsārbudādīṃścaturastyajet-nopakramet| śeṣān-ṣoḍaśa rogān, śīghramupakramet|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| viṃśatirvyāpado yonerjāyante duṣṭabhojanāt||27||

div.ab: Sa. yonervyāpado viṃśatirduṣṭāhārādbhavanti|

viṣamasthāṅgaśayanabhṛśamaithunasevanaiḥ| duṣṭārtavādapadravyairbījadoṣeṇa daivataḥ||28|| yonau kruddho'nilaḥ kuryād ruktodāyāmasuptatāḥ| pipīlikāsṛptimiva stambhaṃ karkaśatāṃ svanam||29|| phenilāruṇakṛṣṇālpatanurūkṣārtavastrutim| srasaṃ vaṅkṣaṇapārśvādau vyathāṃ gulmaṃ krameṇa ca||30|| tāṃstāṃśca svān gadān vyāpadvātikī nāma sā smṛtā| ---------------------------------------------|31|

Sa. viṣamasthāṅgaśayanādibhiryonau pavanaḥ kupito rujādīn kuryāt| tathā pipīlikopasarpaṇamiva stambhaṃ karkaśatāṃ svanaṃ, tathā phenilādiguṇārtavasrutiṃ, tathā vaṅkṣaṇādau bhraṃśaṃ rujāṃ, krameṇa ca gulmaṃ kuryāt| taṃstāṃśca-anekavidhān, rogan kuryāt| sā-evaṃvidhā, vyāpat vātikī smṛtā|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| saivāticaraṇā śophasaṃyuktā'tivyavāyataḥ||31||

div.ab: Sa. saivāticaraṇā śvayathuyutā'tivyavāyāt syāt|

ab.seg: maithunādatibālāyāḥ pṛṣṭhajaṅgoruvaṅkṣaṇam| rujan sandūṣayedyoniṃ vāyuḥ prākcaraṇeti sā||32||

div.ab: Sa. maithunādatibālāyāḥ pavanaḥ pṛṣṭhajaṅghoruvaṅkṣaṇaṃ pīḍayan yoniṃ sandūṣayet| prākcaraṇeti sā syāt|
vegodāvartanādyoniṃ prapīḍayati mārutaḥ| sā phenilaṃ rajaḥ kṛcchrādudāvṛttaṃ vimuñcati||33|| iyaṃ vyāpadudāvṛttā-------------------------| ---------------------------------------------|34|
Sa. vegodāvartanena māruto yoniṃ prakarṣeṇa pīḍayati| tataḥ sā-yoniḥ, phenilaṃ rajaḥ kṛcchrādudāvṛttaṃ visṛjati| eṣā vyāpadudāvṛttākhyā|

ab.seg: -------------------------------jātaghnī tu yadā'nilaḥ| jātaṃ jātaṃ sutaṃ hanti raukṣyādduṣṭārtavodbhavam||34||

div.ab: Sa. yadā tu vāyuḥ sutamutpannamutpannaṃ raukṣyādduṣṭārtavajaṃ hanti, tadā jātaghnī syāt|
atyāśitāyā viṣamaṃ sthitāyāḥ surate marut| annenotpīḍito yoneḥ sthitaḥ srotasi vakrayet||35|| sāsthimāṃsaṃ mukhaṃ tīvrarujamantarmukhīti sā| ---------------------------------------------|36|
Sa. atisuhitāyā viṣamaṃ sthitāyā nidhuvane pavano'nnenotpīḍito yoneḥ sambandhini srotasi sthito mukhaṃ yonereva vakrīkuryāt, asthimāṃsena saha dāruṇapīḍaṃ, sā'ntarmukhītyucyate|
---------------------------------------------| vātalāhārasevinyāṃ jananyāṃ kupito'nilaḥ||36|| striyo yonimaṇudvārāṃ kuryātsūcīmukhīti sā| ---------------------------------------------|37|
Sa. vātalāhārasevinyāṃ mātari vāyuḥ kupitaḥ striyo garbhasthāyāḥ sūkṣmadvārāṃ yoni kuryāt| sūcīmukhī sā syāt|
---------------------------------------------| vegarodhādṛtau vāyurduṣṭo viṇmūtrasaṅgraham||37|| karoti yoneḥ śoṣaṃ ca śuṣkākhyā sā'tivedanā| ---------------------------------------------|38|
Sa. ṛtau vegadhāraṇādvāyurduṣṭo viṇmūtrasaṅgrahaṃ karoti| yoneḥ śoṣaṃ ca karoti| sā śuṣkasaṃjñā'tirujā syāt|
---------------------------------------------| ṣaḍahāt saptarātrādvā śukraṃ garbhāśayānmarut||38|| vametsaruṅ nīrujo vā yasyāḥ sā vāminī matā| ---------------------------------------------|39|
Sa. ṣaḍahenāthavā saptāhena garbhāśayādvāyuḥ sarujo nīrujo vā yasyāḥ śukraṃ vamet, sā vāminī gaditā|
---------------------------------------------| yonau vātopataptāyāṃ strīgarbhe bījadoṣataḥ||39|| mṛdveṣiṇyastanī ca syāt ṣaṇḍhasaṃjñā'nupakramā| ---------------------------------------------|40|
Sa. vātopataptāyāṃ yonau strīgarbhe bījadoṣānnaradveṣiṇī stanarahitā ca strī syāt| sa ṣaṇḍhasaṃjñā'nupakramā|

ab.seg: ---------------------------------------------| duṣṭo viṣṭabhya yonyāsyaṃ garbhakoṣṭhaṃ ca mārutaḥ||40||
kurute vivṛtāṃ srastāṃ vātikīmiva duḥkhitām| utsannamāṃsāṃ tāmāhurmahāyoniṃ mahārujām||41||

div.ab: Sa. pavano duṣṭo yonyāsyaṃ viṣṭabhya garbhakoṣṭhaṃ ca vivṛtamukhīṃ bhraṣṭāṃ vātikīmiva suduḥkhāmutsṛṣṭapiśitāṃ prakṛtatvādyoniṃ kurute| tāṃ mahārujāṃ mahāyoniṃ vadanti|
yathāsvairdūṣaṇairduṣṭaṃ pittaṃ yonimupāśritam| karoti dāhapākoṣāpūtigandhijvarānvitām||42|| bhṛśoṣṇabhūrikuṇapanīlapītāsitārtavām| sā vyāpat paittikī---------------------|43|
Sa. yathāyogaṃ dūṣaṇaiḥ-sarvaroganidānādyuktaiḥ, duṣṭaṃ pittaṃ yonau sthitaṃ yoniṃ dāhādyanvitāṃ karoti, tathā bhṛśoṣṇādiguṇayutārtavām| sā paittikī vyāpat|
Sa. raktayonyākhyā raktasyātisruteḥ syāt|

kapho'bhiṣyandibhiḥ kruddhaḥ kuryādyonimavedanām| śītalāṃ kaṇḍulāṃ pāṇḍupicchilāṃ tadvidhasrutim||44|| sā vyāpacchlaiṣmikī---------------------------| ---------------------------------------------|45|
Sa. śleṣmā'bhiṣyandakaraṇahetubhiḥ kupito yoniṃ pīḍārahitāṃ śītalādiguṇāṃ tathā tadvidhā-pāṇḍupicchilā, srutiryasyāstāṃ tathāvidhāṃ kuryāt| sā-evaṃvidhā, vyāpat ślaiṣmikī syāt|

ab.seg: ---------------------vātapittābhyāṃ kṣīyate rajaḥ| sadāhakārśyavaivarṇyaṃ yasyāḥ sā lohitakṣayā||45||

div.ab: Sa. yasyāḥ vātapittābhyāṃ rajaḥ kṣīyate dāhakārśyavaivarṇyayutaṃ, sā lohitakṣayākhyā|

pittalāyā nṛsaṃvāse kṣavathūdgāradhāraṇāt| pittayuktena marutā yonirbhavati dūṣitā||46|| śūnā sparśāsahā sārtirnīlapītāsravāhinī| bastikukṣigurutvātisārārocakakāriṇī||47|| śroṇivaṅkṣaṇaruktodajvarakṛt sā pariplutā| ---------------------------------------------|48|
Sa. pittalāyāḥ striyā narasaṃyoge kṣavathūdgāradhāraṇāt pittānvitena vāyunā yonirdūṣitā śūnādiguṇā bastyādigurutvādividhāyinī tathā śroṇyāditodakarī syāt| sā pariplutākhyā|
Sa. vātaśleṣmarogeṇa vyāptā śuklapicchilasrāviṇī yonirupaplutā syāt|

ab.seg: -------------------------viplutākhyā tvadhāvanāt| sañjātajantuḥ kaṇḍūlā kaṇḍvā cātiratipriyā||49||

div.ab: Sa. akṣālanāttu yoniḥ sambhūtakṛmiḥ kaṇḍūyutā, kaṇḍvā ca hetunā sutarāṃ suratābhilāṣiṇī viplutākhyā|
akālavāhanādvāyuḥ śleṣmaraktavimūrcchitaḥ| karṇikāṃ janayedyonau rajomārganirodhinīm||50|| sā karṇinī-------------------------------| ---------------------------------------------|51|
Sa. marudakālavāhanāt kapharaktamiśrito yonau karṇikāṃ rajomārganirodhinīṃ kuryāt| sā karṇinī gadyate|

ab.seg: ---------------tribhirdoṣairyonigarbhāśayāśritaiḥ| yathāsvopadravakarairvyāpatsā sānnipātikī||51||

div.ab: Sa. tribhirdoṣairyonigarbhāśayāśritairyathāyogamupadravakāribhiryā vyāpat sā sānnipātikī syāt|

iti yonigadā nārī yaiḥ śukraṃ na pratīcchati| tato garbhaṃ na gṛhṇāti rogāṃścāpnoti dāruṇān|52| asṛgdarārśogulmādīnābādhāṃścānilādibhiḥ| 52 1/2| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne guhyarogavijñānīyo nāma trayastriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ|33|
