Sa. iti- samāptau| evaṃ yonirogāḥ 'kathitāḥ' iti śeṣaḥ| yairāmayairyoniḥ śukraṃ na pratīcchati| tato garbhaṃ nādatte| rogāṃśca dāruṇānasṛgdarādīnaśrute| vātapittakaphaiścābādhān-pīḍāviśeṣān, prāpnoti| iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdaya ṭīkāyāṃ sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭha uttarasthāne guhyarogavijñānīyo nāma trayāstriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 33||

div.head: guhyarogapratiṣedhādhyayaḥ
div.ab: athaitaccikitsāṃ brūte ---- athāto guhyarogapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre)|2| meḍhramadhye sirāṃ vidhyedupaṃdaśe navotthite| śītāṃ kuryāt kriyāṃ śuddhiṃ virekeṇa viśeṣataḥ||1|| tilakalkaghṛtakṣaudrairlepaḥ pakve tu pāṭite| ---------------------------------------------|2|
Sa. upadaṃśe'cirodbhūte liṅgasya madhye sirāṃ mokṣayet| śiśirāṃ ca cikitsāṃ lepasekādibhiḥ kuryāt| viśeṣeṇa virecanena śuddhiṃ vidadhīta| pakve pāṭite ca tilakalkājyamadhubhirlepaḥ|

-----------------------------------------------| jambvāmrasumanonīpaśvetakāmbojikāṅkurān||2|| śallakībadarībilvapalāśatiniśodbhavāḥ| tvacaḥ kṣīridrumāṇāṃ ca triphalāṃ ca pacejjale||3|| sa kvāthaḥ kṣālanaṃ, tena pakvaṃ tailaṃ ca ropaṇam| ----------------------------------------------|4|
Sa. jambvādyaṅkurān śallakyādīnāṃ tvacaḥ kṣīrivṛkṣāṇāṃ ca tvacastriphalāṃ ca jale pacet| sa kvāthaḥ kṣālanaṃ hitam| tena ca kvāthena tailaṃ pakvaṃ ropaṇaṃ syāt|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------| tutthagairikalodhrailāmanohvālarasāñjanaiḥ||4||
hareṇupuṣpakāsīsasaurāṣṭrīlavaṇottamaiḥ| lepaḥ kṣaudrayutaiḥ sakṣmairupadaṃśavraṇāpahaḥ||5||

div.ab: Sa. tutthādibhirmākṣikadrutaiḥ sūkṣmīkṛtairlepa upadaṃśavraṇaharaḥ|
kapāle triphalā dagdhā saghṛtā ropaṇaṃ param| ----------------------------------------------|6|
Sa. karpare triphalā dagdhā ghṛtānvitā paraṃ ropaṇam|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------| sāmānyaṃ sādhanamidaṃ pratidoṣaṃ tu śophavat||6||

div.ab: Sa. sāmānyametat sādhanam| pratidoṣaṃ tu śophatulyaṃ cikitsitaṃ jñeyam|

ab.seg: na ca yāti yathā pākaṃ prayateta tathā bhṛśam| pakvaiḥ snāyusirāmāṃsaiḥ prāyo naśyati hi dhvajaḥ||7||

div.ab: Sa. yathā ca pākaṃ na yāti tathā'tiyatnaḥ kāryaḥ| yataḥ pakvaiḥ snāyvādibhiḥ prāyeṇa meḍhro naśyati|
arśasāṃ chinnadagdhānāṃ kriyā kāryopadaṃśavat| ----------------------------------------------|8|
Sa. arśasāṃ chinnānāṃ dagdhānāṃ copadaṃśatulyā kriyā kāryā|
----------------------------------------------| sarṣapā likhitāḥ sūkṣmaiḥ kaṣāyairavacūrṇayet||8|| tairevābhyañjanaṃ tailaṃ sādhayet vraṇaropaṇam| ----------------------------------------------|9|
Sa. sarṣapikāḥ śastreṇa likhitāḥ kaṣāyadravyairjambvādibhiḥ pūrvoktaiḥ sūkṣmacūrṇairavacūrṇayet| taireva kaṣāyaistailaṃ pacet| tadabhyañjanaṃ vraṇaropaṇaṃ syāt|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------| kriyeyamavamanthe'pi raktaṃ srāvyaṃ tathobhayoḥ||9||

div.ab: Sa. etaccikitsitamavamanthe'pi kāryam| tathaita(thobha)-yoḥ-sarṣapāvamanthayoḥ, asraṃ srāvyam|

ab.seg: kumbhīkāyāṃ haredraktaṃ pakvāyāṃ śodhite vraṇe| tindukatriphalārodhrailepastailaṃ ca ropaṇam||10||

div.ab: Sa. kumbhīkāyāṃ lohitaṃ mokṣayet| pakvāyāṃ tu vraṇe śodhite sati tindukādibhirlepaḥ| tindukādibhireva siddhaṃ tailaṃ ropaṇaṃ syāt|
alajyāṃ srutaraktāyāmayameva kriyākramaḥ| ----------------------------------------------|11|
Sa. alajyāṃ srutaśoṇitāyāmeṣa evopakramaḥ|

----------------------------------------------------| uttamākhyāṃ tu piṭikāṃ sañcchidya baḍiśoddhṛtām||11|| kalkaiścūrṇaiḥ kaṣāyāṇāṃ kṣaudrayuktairupācaret| ---------------------------------------------------|12|
Sa. uttamākhyāṃ piṭikāṃ baḍiśoddhṛtāṃ samyak chedayitvā kaṣāyāṇāṃ kalkaiścūrṇaiḥ kṣaudrayuktairupakramet|
Sa. puṣkarikāyāṃ saṃvyūḍhe ca pittavisarpavihitaṃ cikitsitaṃ hitam| saṃ-tvakpākasparśahānyoḥ secanam|

ab.seg: ------------------------------mṛditaṃ punaḥ| balātailena koṣṇena madhuraścopanāhayet||13||

div.ab: Sa. mṛditaṃ nāma liṅgarogaṃ vakṣyamāṇena (ślo.42) balā tailena secayet| tathā madhurairdravyaiḥ kalkitaiḥ sukhoṣṇairghṛtasnigdhairupanāhaśca kāryaḥ|
aṣṭhīlikāṃ hṛte rakte śleṣmagranthivadācaret| ----------------------------------------------------|14|
Sa. aṣṭhīlikāṃ rakte hṛte kaphagranthimivopakramet|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------------| nivṛttaṃ sarpiṣā'bhyajya svedayitvopanāhayet||14||
trirātraṃ pañcarātraṃ vā susnigdhaiḥ śālvalādibhiḥ| svedayitvā tato bhūyaḥ snigdhaṃ carma samānayet||15||
maṇiṃ prapīḍya śanakaiḥ praviṣṭe copanāhanam| maṇau punaḥpunaḥ snigdhaṃ bhojanaṃ cātra śasyate||16||

div.ab: Sa. nivṛttasaṃjñaṃ liṅgarogaṃ ghṛtenābhyajya svedayitvā copanāhayet trirātraṃ pañcarātraṃ vā susnigdhaiḥ śālvalādibhiḥ| tato bhūyaḥ svedayitvā snigdhaṃ carma maṇiṃ samānayet| kiṃ kṛtvā ? maṇiṃ śanaiḥ prapīḍya| praviṣṭe maṇau copanāhaṃ punaḥpunaḥ kuryāt| bhojanaṃ cātra snigdhaṃ hitam|
ayameva prayojyaḥ syādavapāṭyāmapi kramaḥ| ----------------------------------------------------|17|
Sa. ayameva kramo'vapāṭikāyāṃ yojyaḥ syāt|

ab.seg: snehāktāṃ srotasi nyasya siñcetsnehaiścalāpahaiḥ| tryahāttryahātsthūlatarāṃ nyasya nāḍīṃ vivardhayet||18||
srotodvāramasiddhau tu vidvān śastreṇa pāṭayet| sevanīṃ varjayan yuñjyāt sadyaḥkṣatavidhiṃ tataḥ||19||

div.ab: Sa. niruddhe-niruddhākhye niruddhamaṇau, nāḍīṃ dvidvārāṃ jatunā sṛtāṃ liptāḥ snehāktāṃ liṅge nyasya liṅgaṃ balātailādibhiḥ snehaiḥ siñcet| tryahāttryahāt sthūlatarāṃ nāḍīṃ kṣiptvā srotodvāraṃ vṛddhiṃ nayet| evamapyasiddhau dhīmān vaidyaḥ sevanīṃ pariharan śastreṇa pāṭayet| tataḥ-pāṭanādanantaraṃ, sadyaḥkṣatavidhānaṃ yuñyāt|
granthitaṃ sveditaṃ nāḍyā snigdhoṣṇairupanāhayet| ----------------------------------------------------|20|
Sa. granthitasaṃjñaṃ nāḍyā sveditaṃ snigdhoṣṇairupanāhayet|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------------| limpetkaṣāyaiḥ sakṣaudrairlikhitvā śataponakam||20||

div.ab: Sa. śataponakaṃ liṅgarogaṃ likhitvā kaṣāyadravyacūrṇaiḥ samākṣikairlimpet|
raktavidradhivatkāryā cikitsā śoṇitārbude| ----------------------------------------------------|21|
Sa. śoṇitārbude raktavidradhivaccikitsā kartavyā|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------------| vraṇopacāraṃ sarveṣu yathāvasthaṃ prayojayet||21||

div.ab: Sa. sarveṣu liṅgarogeṣu yathāvasthaṃ-avasthāvaśāt, vraṇopacārān-antaḥśuddhikaṣāyalepaghṛtatailarasakriyācūrṇāṃśchodhanaropaṇān, prayojayet|

ab.seg: yonivyāpatsu bhūyiṣṭhaṃ śasyate karma vātajit| snehanasvedabastyādi vātajāsu viśeṣataḥ||22||
na hi vātādṛte yonirvanitānāṃ praduṣyati| ato jitvā tamanyasya kuryāddoṣasya bheṣajam||23||

div.ab: Sa. yonivyāpatsu viṣaye prāyeṇa pavanavijayi cikitsitaṃ yuktam| snehanādi vātotthāsu vyāpattiṣu viśeṣeṇa śasyate| saṃ-yato vātamantareṇa yoṣito yonirna duṣyati| tasmāttaṃ mārutaṃ, jitvā parasya doṣasyauṣadhaṃ kuryāt|

pāyayeta(ttāṃ) balātailaṃ miśrakaṃ sukumārakam| snigdhasvinnāṃ tathā yoniṃ duḥsthitāṃ sthāpayetsamām||24|| pāṇinā namayejjihyāṃ saṃvṛtāṃ vyadhayet punaḥ| praveśayenniḥsṛtāṃ ca vivṛtāṃ parivartayet||25|| sthānāpavṛttā yonirhi śalyabhūtā striyo matā| ----------------------------------------------------|26|

Sa. tāṃ-striyaṃ, balātailaṃ (ci. a.21/73), miśrakākhyaṃ(ci. a.14/89), vā, sukumārakāhvayaṃ (ci. a.13/41), pāyayet| tathā yoniṃ snigdhāṃ svinnāṃ ca duḥsthitāṃ samāṃ sthāpayet| jihyāṃ-kuṭilāṃ yoniṃ, hastena namayet| saṃvṛtāṃ tu vyadhayet-prasārayedityarthaḥ| niḥsṛtāṃ ca praveśayet| vivṛtāṃ tu satīṃ parivartayet| yataḥ sthānād bhraṣṭā yoniḥ striyaḥ śalyarūpā bhavet|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------------| karmabhirvamanādyaiśca mṛdubhiryojayetstriyam||26||
sarvataḥ suviśuddhāyāḥ śeṣaṃ karma vidhīyate| bastyabhyaṅgaparīṣekapralepapicudhāraṇam||27||

div.ab: Sa. vamanādīni ca karmāṇi mṛdūni-akharāṇi, strī(striyā) kārayitavyā(ni)| sarvataḥ-adha upariṣṭācca, viśuddhāyā nāryāḥ pariśiṣṭaṃ karma-bastyādikaṃ, kriyate|

ab.seg: kāśmaryatriphalādrākṣākāsamardaniśādvayaiḥ| guḍūcīsairyakābhīruśukanāsāpunarnavaiḥ||28||
parūṣakaiśca vipacetprasthamakṣasamairghṛtāt| yonivātavikāraghnaṃ tatpītaṃ garbhadaṃ param||29||

div.ab: Sa. kāśmaryādibhiḥ kalkitaiḥ kārṣikairghṛtātprasthaṃ pacet| tat-ghṛtaṃ, pītaṃ yonivātavikāraharaṃ suṣṭhu garbhadaṃ ca|

ab.seg: vacopakuñcikājājīkṛṣṇāvṛṣakasaindhavam| ajamodāyavakṣāraśarkarācitrakānvitam||30||
piṣṭvā prasannayā''loḍya khādettadghṛtabharjitam| yonipārśvārtihṛdrogagulmārśovinivṛttaye||31||

div.ab: Sa. vacādikaṃ piṣṭvā prasannayā''loḍya ghṛtabharjitaṃ khādet yonipārśvārtyādiśāntaye|

ab.seg: vṛṣakaṃ mātuluṅgasya mūlāni madayantikām| pibenmadyaiḥ salavaṇaistathā kṛṣṇopakuñcike||32||

div.ab: Sa. vṛṣakādīni madyaiḥ salavaṇaiḥ pibet| tathā pippalī sthūlajīrake vā madyaiḥ salavaṇaiḥ pibet|
rāsnāśvadaṃṣṭrāvṛṣakaiḥ śṛtaṃ śūlaharaṃ payaḥ| ----------------------------------------------------|33|
Sa. rāsnādibhiḥ śṛtaṃ payaḥ śūlaghnam|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------------| guḍūcītriphalādantīkvāthaiśca pariṣecanam||33||

div.ab: Sa. guḍūcyādibhiḥ kvāthaiḥ pariṣecanaṃ sukhoṣṇaṃ hitam, prakṛtatvādyoneḥ|

ab.seg: natavārtākinīkuṣṭhasaindhavāmaradārubhiḥ| tailātprasādhitāddhāryaḥ picuryonau rujāpahaḥ||34||

div.ab: Sa. natādibhistailāt pakvāt picuryonau dhṛto rujāghnaḥ|

ab.seg: pittalānāṃ tu yonīnāṃ sekābhyaṅgapicukriyāḥ| śītāḥ pittajitaḥ kāryāḥ snehanārthaṃ ghṛtāni ca||35||

div.ab: Sa. pittalānāṃ ca yonīnāṃ śītādikāḥ kriyāḥ sekādyāḥ kāryāḥ| snehanārthaṃ ghṛtāni ca deyāni|

ab.seg: śatāvarīmūlatulācatuṣkāt kṣuṇṇapīḍitāt| rasena kṣīratulyena pācayeta ghṛtāḍhakam||36||
jīvanīyaiḥ śatāvaryā mṛdvīkābhiḥ parūṣakaiḥ| piṣṭaiḥ priyālaiścākṣāṃśaurdvibalāmadhukānvitaiḥ||37||
siddhaśīte tu madhunaḥ pippalyāśca palāṣṭakam| śarkarāyā daśapalaṃ kṣipellihyātpicuṃ tataḥ||38||
yonyasṛkśukradoṣaghnaṃ vṛṣyaṃ puṃsavanaṃ param| kṣataṃ kṣayamasṛkpittaṃ kāsaṃ śvāsaṃ halīmakam||39||
kāmalāṃ vātarudhiraṃ visarpaṃ hṛcchirograham| apasmārārditāyāmamadonmādāṃśca nāśayet||40||

div.ab: Sa. śatāvarīmūlatulācatuṣṭayāt kṣuṇṇapīḍitād rasena dugdhasamena sarpiṣa āḍhakaṃ pacejjīvanīyādibhiḥ karṣāṃśaiḥ kalkīkṛtaiḥ| pakve śīte ca mākṣikapalāṣṭakaṃ, kaṇāṣṭapalaṃ, sitāpalāni ca daśa, kṣipet| tasmācca karṣamātraṃ lihyāt yonyādidoṣaghnaṃ vṛṣyādiguṇaṃ ca|

ab.seg: evameva payaḥ sarpirjīvanīyopasādhitam| garbhadaṃ pittajānāṃ ca rogāṇāṃ paramaṃ hitam||41||

div.ab: Sa. anenaiva krameṇa kṣīraṃ sarpirvā jīvanīyaiḥ pakvaṃ garbhapradaṃ pittajānāṃ ca rogāṇāṃ paraṃ hitam|

balādroṇadvayakvāthe ghṛtatailāḍhakaṃ pacet| kṣīre caturguṇe kṛṣṇākākanāsāsitānvitaiḥ||42|| jīvantīkṣīrakākolīsthirāvīrardhijīvakaiḥ| payasyāśrāvaṇīmudgapīlumāṣākhyaparṇibhiḥ||43|| vātapittāmayān hatvā pānād garbhaṃ dadhāti tat| ----------------------------------------------------|44|

Sa. balāyā droṇadvayasya kaṣāye ghṛtatailayorāḍhakaṃ pacet| kṣīre caturāḍhake kṛṣṇādibhiḥ kalkitaiḥ sāmānyaparibhāṣayoktapramāṇaiḥ| tat-ghṛtaṃ, pānena vātapittarogān hatvā garbhaṃ dhatte| mudgādīnāṃ parṇyā pratyekaṃ sambandhaḥ,- mudgaparṇī pīluparṇī māṣaparṇīti|

----------------------------------------------------| raktayonyāmasṛgvarṇairanubandhamavekṣya ca||44|| yathādoṣodayaṃ yuñjyād raktasthāpanamauṣadham| ----------------------------------------------------|45|
Sa. raktayonyāṃ lohitaṃ varṇairlakṣayitvā'nubandhaṃ ca yathādoṣodayaṃ, raktasthāpanaṃ bheṣajaṃ prayuñjīta|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------------------------| pāṭhāṃ jambvāmrayorasthi śilodbhedaṃ rasāñjanam||45||
ambaṣṭhāṃ śālmalīpicchāṃ samaṅgāṃ vatsakatvacam| bāhlīkabilvātiviṣārodhratoyadagairikam||46||
śuṇṭhīmadhūkamācīkaraktacandanakaṭūphalam| kaṭvaṅgavatsakānantādhātakīmadhukārjunam||47||
puṣye gṛhītvā sañcūrṇya sakṣaudraṃ tandulāmbhasā| pibedarśaḥsvatīsāre raktaṃ yaścopaveśyate||48||
doṣā jantukṛtā ye ca bālānāṃ tāṃśca nāśayet| yonidoṣaṃ rajodoṣaṃ śyāvaśvetāruṇāsitam||49||
cūrṇaṃ puṣyānugaṃ nāma hitamātreyapūjitam| yonyāṃ balāsaduṣṭāyāṃ sarvaṃ rūkṣoṣṇamauṣadham||50||

div.ab: Sa. pāṭhādikaṃ puṣye gṛhītvā sañcūrṇya kṣaudrānvitaṃ tandulāmbhasā pibet arśoviṣayādiṣu| ye ca doṣā jantukṛtā bālānāṃ, tāṃśca yonidoṣādīn hanti| puṣyānugasaṃjñametaccūrṇaṃ hitamātreyapūjitaṃ ca| yonyāṃ balāsenā duṣṭāyāṃ sarvameva rūkṣoṣṇaṃ hitam|

dhātakyāmalakīpatrasrotojamadhukotpalaiḥ| jambvāmrasārakāsīsarodhrakaṭphalatindukaiḥ||51|| saurāṣṭrikādāḍimatvagudumbaraśalāṭubhiḥ| akṣamātrairajāmūtre kṣīre ca dviguṇe pacet||52|| tailaprasthaṃ tadabhyaṅgapicubastiṣu yojayet| tena śūnonnatā stabdhā picchilā srāviṇī tathā||53|| viplutopaplutā yoniḥ siddhyetatsphoṭaśūlinī| ----------------------------------------------------|54|
Sa. dhātakyādibhiḥ kārṣikaiśchāgamūtre dviguṇe, kṣīre ca dviguṇe, tailaprasthaṃ pacet| tattailamabhyaṅgādiṣu yojyam| anena tailena śūnādiguṇā yoniḥ sidhyati|

--------------------------------------------------| yavānnamabhayāriṣṭaṃ sīdhu tailaṃ ca śīlayet||54|| pippalyayorajaḥ pathyāprayogāṃśca samākṣikān| --------------------------------------------------|55|
Sa. tathā yavānnādikaṃ śīlayet| pippalyādiprayogāṃśca kṣaudrānvitānabhyaset|

--------------------------------------------------| kāsīsaṃ triphalā kāṅkṣī sāmrajambvasthi dhātukī||55|| paicchilye kṣaudrasaṃyuktaścūrṇo vaiśadyakārakaḥ| --------------------------------------------------|56|
Sa. kāsīsādikaścūrṇo mākṣikānvitaḥ paicchilye viśadatvakṛt|

ab.seg: durgandhe picchile klede stambhanaścūrṇa iṣyate| āragvadhādivargasya kaṣāyaḥ pariṣecanam||57||

div.ab: Sa. palāśādijaścūrṇo durgandhādiṣu stambhanamiṣyate| āragvadhādivargakvātho (hṛ.sū. a. 15/17) durgandhādau pariṣekaḥ|

ab.seg: stambdhānāṃ karkaśānāṃ ca kāryaṃ mārdavakārakam| dhāraṇaṃ vesavārasya kṛsarāpāyasasya ca||58||

div.ab: Sa. saṃ-stambdhānāṃ kharasparśānāṃ ca yonīnāṃ mṛdutvakaraṃ vesavārādidhāraṇaṃ vidheyam| vesavāraḥ-kuṭṭitasvinnasaṃskṛtamāṃsaviśeṣaḥ| kṛsarā ca pāyasaṃ ca kṛsarāpāyasam|

ab.seg: durgandhānāṃ kaṣāyaḥ syāttailaṃ vā kalka eva vā| cūrṇe vā sarvagandhānāṃ pūtigandhā(ndhya)pakarṣaṇaḥ||59||

div.ab: Sa. saṃ-durgandhānāṃ yonīnāṃ sarvagandhadravyāṇāṃ kaṣāyaḥ-kvātho, hitaḥ| tatpakvaṃ tailaṃ tatkalka eva vā| athavā sarvagandhānāṃ cūrṇaḥ pūtigandhā(ndhya) pahaḥ|

ab.seg: śleṣmalānāṃ kaṭuprāyāḥ samūtrā bastayo hitāḥ| pitte samadhukakṣīrā vāte tailāmlasaṃyutāḥ||60||

div.ab: Sa. śleṣmalānāṃ yonīnāṃ kaṭuprāyā gomūtrayutāśca bastayo hitāḥ| pitte madhuyaṣṭīkṣīrayuktā bastayaḥ| vāte tailāmlayutā bastayo hitāḥ|
sannipātasamutthāyāḥ karma sādhāraṇaṃ hitam| ---------------------------------------------|61|
Sa. sannipātotthāyāḥ sādhāraṇaṃ karma hitam|
---------------------------------------------| evaṃ yoniṣu śuddhāsu garbhaṃ vindanti yoṣitaḥ||61|| aduṣṭe prākṛte bīje jīvopakramaṇe sati| ---------------------------------------------|62|
Sa. evaṃ-anena prakāreṇa, yoniṣu viśuddhāsu satīṣu striyo garbhaṃ labhante| prākṛte bīje'duṣṭe sati tathā jīvasyopakramaṇe kṣepe sati|
---------------------------------------------| pañcakarmaviśuddhasya puruṣasyāpi cendriyam||62|| parīkṣya varṇairdoṣāṇāṃ duṣṭaṃ tadghnairupācaret| ---------------------------------------------|63|
Sa. narasya pañcabhiḥ karmabhiḥ śuddhasya, indriyaṃ,śukraṃ, doṣāṇāṃ varṇairduṣṭaṃ parīkṣya tadghnaiḥ-doṣaghnaiḥ, upakramet|

---------------------------------------------| mañjiṣṭhākuṣṭhatagaratriphalāśarkarāvacāḥ|63| dve niśe madhukaṃ medāṃ dīpyakaṃ kaṭurohiṇīm| payasyāhiṅgukākolīvājigandhāśatāvarīḥ|64| piṣṭvā'kṣāṃśā ghṛtaprasthaṃ pacetkṣīracaturguṇam| yoniśukrapradoṣeṣu tatsarveṣu praśasyate|65| āyuṣyaṃ pauṣṭikaṃ medhyaṃ dhanyaṃ puṃsavanaṃ param| phalasarpiriti khyātaṃ puṣpe pītaṃ phalāya yat|66| mriyamāṇaprajānāṃ ca garbhiṇīnāṃ ca pūjitam| etatparaṃ ca bālānāṃ grahaghnaṃ dehavardhanam|67| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne guhyarogapratiṣedho nāma catustriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ|34|

Sa. saṃ-mañjiṣṭādibhiḥ kārṣikaiḥ piṣṭairghṛtaprasthaṃ kṣīracaturguṇaṃ pacet| taddhṛtaṃ sarveṣu yoniśukrapradoṣeṣu śasyate| āyuṣyādi guṇaṃ paraṃ puṃsavanaṃ mriyamāṇagarbhāṇāṃ garbhiṇīnāṃ ca hitam| phalasarpiriti nāmnā prasiddham| kutaḥ ? yasmāt puṣpe-ārtavasamaye, pītaṃ phalāya jāyate| tathā paraṃ bālānāṃ grahaghnaṃ śarīravṛddhikaraṃ ceti| iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdaya ṭīkāyāṃ sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭha uttarasthāne guhyaroga pratiṣedho nāma catustriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 34|| iti śalyatantraṃ nāma pañcamamaṅgaṃ samāptam|

div.head: viṣapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ
div.ab: Sa. adhunā viṣatantramucyate, sadyaḥprāṇahāritvena tulyasādharmyāt|
athāto viṣapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre)|2|
Sa. tatra viṣasya prāgutpattidarśanārthamāha-

ab.seg: mathyamāne jalanidhāvamṛtārthaṃ surāsuraiḥ| jātaḥ prāgamṛtotpatteḥ puruṣo ghoradarśanaḥ||1||
dīptatejāścaturdaṃṣṭro harikeśo'nalekṣaṇaḥ| jagadviṣaṇṇaṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvā tenāsau viṣasaṃjñitaḥ||2||
huṃkṛto brahmaṇā mūrtī tataḥ sthāvarajaṅgame| so'dhyatiṣṭhannijaṃ rūpamujjhitvā vañcanātmakam||3||

div.ab: Sa. samudre surāsurairamṛtārthaṃ viloḍyamāne'mṛtotpatteḥ pūrvaṃ puruṣo dāruṇadṛṣṭiḥ samiddhadhāmā caturdaṃṣṭro harivarṇakaco dahanatulyanetro jātaḥ| taṃ puruṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhuvanaṃ viṣādaṃ gatam| ata evāsau jagadviṣadanāt viṣasaṃjñaḥ| brahmaṇa huṃkṛtastu sannasau vañcanasvabhāvaṃ svaṃ rūpaṃ hitvā sthāvarajaṅgamākhye mūrtī adhitasthau| puruṣarupī tiṣṭhedasau tato brahmā śāpaṃ dadyāt|

ab.seg: sthiramatyulbaṇaṃ vīrye yatkandeṣu pratiṣṭhitam| kālakūṭendravatsākhyaśṛṅgīhālāhalādikam||4||

div.ab: Sa. yadviṣaṃ sthiraṃ-sthāvaraṃ, kandeṣu pratiṣṭhitaṃ vīrye atyulbaṇaṃ tat kālakūṭādibhedabhinnam| phalādiṣvapi tad bhavati, kintu kande vīryātikṛt| ādiśabdena saṅgrahoktā bhedā gṛhyante| yathā (saṃ.u. a. 40)-"kālakūṭaṃ vatsanābhaṃ sāktukaṃ vālakaṃ kardamakaṃ vairāṭaṃ mustakaṃ śṛṅgī puṇḍarīkaṃ mahāviṣaṃ hālāhalaṃ markaṭakaṃ karkaṭaṃ kāśapuṣpakamindrāyudhaṃ tathā tailam|" iti (tyādi) bhedāḥ prakīrtitāḥ| eṣāṃ tu lakṣaṇaṃ tatroktam| tadahi vistarataragranthaśaṅkayā noktam|
sarpalūtādidaṃṣṭrāsu dāruṇaṃ jaṅgamaṃ viṣam| -----------------------------------------------|5|
Sa. sarpādidaṃṣṭrāsu tu yadvyavasthitaṃ tajjaṅgamam| tacca dāruṇam| daṃṣṭretyupalakṣaṇārtham, nakhaviṣāṇamūtrādīnāmapi puro viṣatvena vakṣyamāṇatvāt|

ab.seg: --------------------------------------------------------| sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ ceti viṣaṃ proktamakṛtrimam||5||

div.ab: Sa. sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ ceti dviprakāraṃ viṣamakṛtrimam|
kṛtrimaṃ garasaṃjñaṃ tu kriyate vividhauṣadhaiḥ| hanti yogavaśenāśu cirācciratarācca tat||6|| śophapāṇḍūdaronmādadurnāmādīn karoti vā| --------------------------------------------------------|7|
Sa. garasaṃjñaṃ tu kṛtrimam| yasmāttat kriyate| ata eva vividhāni vakṣyamāṇānyauṣadhāni yasmiṃstadevam| tacca yogavaśācchīghraṃ hanti| tathā vividhayogavaśāccirācciraṃ hanti| śophādīṃśca vidhatte|

atha viṣaguṇānnirdiśati --------------- --------------------------------------------------------| tīkṣṇoṣṇarūkṣaviśadaṃ vyavāyyāśukaraṃ laghu||7|| vikāṣi sūkṣmamavyaktarasaṃ viṣamapāki ca| --------------------------------------------------------|8|

Sa. tatsarvaṃ viṣaṃ tīkṣṇādiguṇaṃ syāt| guṇanirdeśanādasya raukṣyādvātamuṣṇatvāt pittaṃ karotīti jñāpyate| nanu, raukṣyādibhirguṇairvāyoḥ kopo na yujyate, raukṣyādīnāṃ guṇatvādvāyośca dravyatvāt| brūmaḥ| vāyorye raukṣyādayo guṇāsteṣāmeva viṣasthai raukṣyādibhirguṇairvṛddhiḥ kriyate| te ca vāyorātmabhūtāḥ, tannāśe vāyornāśaḥ syāt, yathā tantunāśe paṭanāśaḥ| tasmādyuktaḥ pavanasya raukṣyādibhirguṇaiḥ prakopaḥ| evaṃ pitte'pi yojyam| kaṭvamlādikathane'pi viṣasyāvyaktarasatvam, anekarasasambhavādekasyāpi ca vyaktasyānupalabdheḥ| vyavāyitvaṃ cāsya drāgevākhilakāyasya vyāpteḥ| tathā apāki,-viṣasya hi mantratantrābhyāmantareṇa pākābhāvāt, pakve'pyanne viṣasyāpakvasyevopalabdheḥ| ata eva śamitamapi kiñcitkāraṇaṃ prāpya punaḥ kupyati|

Sa. saṃ-tathā viṣamojaso viparītaṃ tīkṣṇādibhirdaśabhirguṇairyuktam| tīkṣṇādyairanvitamiti hetau prathamā| tīkṣṇādiguṇayuktatvādojaso viparītamityarthaḥ| tathā vātapittotaraṃ narāṇāṃ drāgeva jīvitaṃ harati|

ab.seg: kutaḥ ? ityāha---- -----------------------------------------------------| viṣaṃ hi dehaṃ samprāpya prāg dūṣayati śoṇitam||9||
kaphapittānilāṃścānu samaṃ doṣān sahāśayān| tato hṛdayamāsthāya dehocchedāya kalpate||10||

div.ab: Sa. yasmādviṣaṃ śarīraṃ prāpya pūrvaṃ raktaṃ sarvaśarīragataṃ dūṣayati, paścāt kaphapittavātānāśayasahitān dūṣayati| anantaraṃ kaphādibhiḥ samameva hṛdayamāśritya śariranāśāya sampadyate| nanu, viṣasya tīkṣṇādibhirguṇairyugapat tridoṣakopitvādraktakopitvācca pūrvaṃ śoṇitaṃ dūṣayati paścātrīn doṣāniti yaduktaṃ tadayuktimadiva dṛśyate| atra bhaṇāmaḥ viṣaprabhāveṇa raktamākṛṣṭaṃ pūrvaṃ saha tena saṃyuktaṃ viṣeṇa dūṣyate, tato yugapadeva doṣatrayakopaḥ, tato doṣaiḥ śoṇitena saha hṛdayaṃ vyāpya sarvasrotāṃsi baddhvā dehocchedāya pravartata iti na kiñcidatrānupapannam|

ab.seg: sthāvarasyopayuktasya vege pūrve prajāyate| jihvāyāḥ śyāvatā stambho mūrcchā trāsaḥ klamo vamiḥ||11||

div.ab: Sa. sthāvarasya viṣasyopayuktasya prathame vege rasanāśyāvatādi jāyate|

ab.seg: dvitīye vepathuḥ svedo dāhaḥ kaṇṭhe ca vedanā| viṣaṃ cāmāśayaṃ prāptaṃ kurute hṛdi vedanām||12||

div.ab: Sa. dvitīye vege vepathvādayaḥ| viṣaṃ cāmāśayaṃ prāptaṃ hṛdaye vedanāṃ vidhatte|
tāluśoṣastṛtīye tu śūlaṃ cāmāśaye bhṛśam| durbale harite śūne jāyete cāsya locane||13|| pakvāśayagate todahidhmākāsāntrakūjanam| --------------------------------------------------------|14|
Sa. tṛtīye ca vege tāluśoṣaḥ āmāśaye'tirujā syāt| netre cāsya durbalādiguṇe bhavataḥ| pakvāśayagate todādayaḥ syuḥ|
Sa. caturthe vege mūrdhno'tigurutvaṃ jāyate| caśabdāt pūrvoktā rasanāśayāvatādayaḥ syuḥ| evamagre'pi caśabdārtho bodhyaḥ|

ab.seg: kaphapraseko vaivarṇyaṃ parvabhedaśca pañcame| sarvadoṣaprakopaśca pakvādhāne ca vedanā||15||

div.ab: Sa. pañcame vege kaphaprasekādiḥ| sarvadoṣāṇāṃ prakopaḥ| pūrvoktāśca| pakvāśaye vyathā ca|
ṣaṣṭhe saṃjñāpraṇāśaśca subhṛśaṃ cātisāryate| --------------------------------------------------------|16|
Sa. ṣaṣṭhe vege cetanāyāḥ praṇāśo'tiśayenātisāraśca|

ab.seg: --------------------------------------------------------| skandhapṛṣṭhakaṭībhaṅgo bhavenmṛtyuśca saptame||16||

div.ab: Sa. saptame skandhādibhaṅgaḥ, saptānāṃ dhātūnāṃ dūṣaṇānmṛtyuśca syāt|

ab.seg: prathame viṣavege tu vāntaṃ śītāmbusecitam| sarpirmadhubhyāṃ saṃyuktamagadaṃ pāyayed drutam||17||

div.ab: Sa. prathame viṣavege tu kṛtavamanaṃ śiśirajalasecitaṃ śīghramevāgadaṃ saghṛtamākṣikaṃ pāyayet|
Sa. dvitīye viṣavege pūrvavat-śītāmbusecitaṃ, vāntaṃ viriktaṃ cānu-paścāt, agadaṃ pāyayet|
Sa. tṛtīye vege'gadapānaṃ nasyamañjanaṃ ca hitam|
Sa. caturthe vege snehasaṃyutamagadaṃ pratiyojayet|

ab.seg: --------------------------------------------------------| pañcame madhukakvāthamākṣikābhyāṃ yutaṃ hitam||19||

div.ab: Sa. pañcame vege madhuyaṣṭikākvāthamākṣikābhyāṃ yuktamagadaṃ hitam|
Sa. ṣaṣṭhe vege'tisāratulyā cikitsā|

ab.seg: ----------------------------------avapīḍastu saptame| mūrdhni kākapadaṃ kṛtvā sāsṛgvā piśitaṃ kṣipet||20||

div.ab: Sa. saptame vege'vapīḍo-rogānutpādanīyokto (hṛ.sū. a. 4/6), deyaḥ| athavā mastake kākapadaṃ kṛtvā saraktaṃ piśitaṃ nyaset|

kośātakyagnikaḥ pāṭhā sūryavalyamṛtābhayāḥ| śeluḥ śirīṣaḥ kiṇīhī haridre kṣaudrasāhvayā||21|| punarnave trikaṭukaṃ bṛhatyau sārive balā| eṣāṃ yavāgūṃ niryuhe śītāṃ saghṛtamakṣikām||22|| yuñjyādvegāntare sarvaviṣaghnīṃ kṛtakarmaṇaḥ| --------------------------------------------------------|23|

Sa. kośātakyādīnāṃ kvāthe yavāgūṃ siddhāṃ śītāṃ sasarpiṣkamākṣikāṃ yuñjayāt| sūryavallī-karavīrakākārapuṣpī| kṣaudrasāhvayaṃ-vaṭamākṣikam| vegāntare-vegamadhye, sarvaviṣaghnīm| kṛtaṃ karma yasya tasyaivaṃ kāryam|
Sa. madhūkādikvāthe peyāṃ śītāṃ saghṛtamākṣikāṃ yuñjyāt|

ab.seg: añjanaṃ tagaraṃ kuṣṭhaṃ haritālaṃ manaḥśilā| phalānī trikaṭu spṛkkā nāgapuṣpaṃ sakesaram||24||
hareṇurmadhukaṃ māṃsī rocanā kākamālikā| śrīveṣṭakaṃ sarjarasaḥ śatāhvā kuṅkumaṃ balā||25||
tamālapatratālīsabhūrjośīraniśādvayam| kanyopavāsinī snātā śuklavāsā madhudrutaiḥ||26||
dvijānabhyarcya taiḥ puṣye kalpayedagadottamam| vaidyaścātra tadā mantraṃ prayatātmā paṭhedimam||27||
"namaḥ puruṣasiṃhāya namo nārāyaṇāya ca| yathā'sau nābhijānāti raṇe kṛṣṇaparājayam||28||
etena satyavākyena agado me prasidhyatu| namo vaidūryamāte huluhulu rakṣa māṃ sarvaviṣebhyaḥ||29||
gauri gāndhāri cāṇḍāli mātaṅgi svāhā| " piṣṭe ca dvitīyo mantraḥ "harimāyi svāhā||30||
" aśeṣaviṣavetālagrahakārmaṇapāpmasu| marakavyādhidurbhikṣayuddhāśanibhayeṣu ca||31||
pānanasyāñjanālepamaṇibandhādiyojitaḥ| eṣa candrodayo nāma śāntisvastyayanaṃ param||32||
|vāsavo vṛtramavadhītsamāliptaḥ kilāmunā| ]||32||

div.ab: Sa. añjanādīni dravyāṇi| kanyā kṛtopavāsā snātāśuklavastrā taiḥ-pūrvoktairdravyaiḥ, mākṣikasiktaiḥ puṣyanakṣatre viprān pūjayitvā'nantaramagadavaramimaṃ kalpayet| vaidyaśca samīpastho mantraṃ nama ityādikaṃ paṭhet| piṣṭe cāgade dvitīyo mantro harimāyyādiko'tra yojyaḥ| nikhileṣu viṣādiṣu pānādimaṇibandhādi yojito'yaṃ candrodayo nāmāgadaḥ paraṃ śāntaṃ(nti) svastyayanam|

ab.seg: jīrṇaṃ viṣaghnauṣadhibhirhataṃ vā dāvāgnivātātapaśoṣitaṃ vā| svabhāvato vā na guṇaiḥ suyuktaṃ dūṣiviṣākhyāṃ viṣamabhyupaiti||33||
vīryālpabhāvādavibhāvyametat kaphāvṛtaṃ varṣagaṇānubandhi| tenārdito bhinnapurīṣavarṇo duṣṭāsrarogī tṛḍarocakārtaḥ||34||
mūrcchan vaman gadgadavāk vimuhyan bhavecca dūṣyodaraliṅgajuṣṭaḥ| āmāśayasthe kaphavātarogī pakvāśayasthe'nilapittarogī||35||
bhavennaro dhvastaśiroruhāṅgo vilūnapakṣaḥ sa yathā vihaṅgaḥ| sthitaṃ rasādiṣvathavā vicitrān karoti dhātuprabhavān vikārān||36||

div.ab: Sa. yadviṣaṃ purāṇaṃ, viṣaghnauṣadhibhirvā hatavīryaṃ, yadvā dāvāgnītyādibhiḥ śoṣitaṃ, svabhavenaiva vā guṇairna suṣṭhu yuktaṃ, tad dūṣīviṣasaṃjñāmupaiti| tathā vīryasyālpatvādetadavibhāvyaṃ-alakṣyam| tathā kaphenāvṛtaṃ varṣavṛndaṃ ca tatsthāyi| tena-dūṣīviṣeṇa, pīḍito bhinnapurīṣavarṇādikaḥ syāt| tathā mūrcchāṃ gacchan vamannasphuṭavāk tathā vimuhyan tathā dūṣyenopalakṣita udare yāni liṅgāni (hṛ.ni. a. 12/20), taiḥ sevitaśca bhavet| āmāśayasthe dūṣīviṣe kaphavātarogī syāt pakvāśayasthe dūṣīviṣe'nilapittarogī syāt| upajātayaḥ| dhvastāḥ kacāḥ śarīraṃ ca yasya sa dhvastaśirotuhāṅgo vilūnapakṣaḥ pakṣīva bhavet| rasādiṣu ca sthitaṃ nānāvidhān dhātuprabhavān vikārān karoti| upendravajrāvṛttam|

ab.seg: prāgvātājīrṇaśītābhradivāsvapnāhitāśanaiḥ| duṣṭaṃ dūṣayate dhātūnato dūṣīviṣaṃ smṛtam||37||

div.ab: Sa. tacca purovātādibhirduṣṭaṃ saddhātūn dūṣayati yataḥ, tato'pi hetordūṣīviṣaṃ smṛtam|

ab.seg: dūṣīviṣārtaṃ susvinnamūrdhvaṃ cādhaśca śodhitam| dūṣīviṣārimagadhaṃ lehayenmadhunā''plutam||38||

div.ab: Sa. dūṣīviṣapīḍitaṃ naraṃ susvinnamūrdhvamadhastācca śodhitaṃ santaṃ dūṣīviṣāri-vakṣyamāṇaṃ, mākṣikeṇāplutamagadaṃ lehayet|

tamevāha ---- pippalyo dhyāmakaṃ māṃsī rodhramelā suvarcikā| kuṭannaṭaṃ nataṃ kuṣṭhaṃ yaṣṭī candanagairikam||39|| dūṣīviṣārirnāmnā'yaṃ na cānyatrāpi vāryate| --------------------------------------------------------|40|
Sa. pippalyādiko'yamagado nāmnā dūṣīviṣāriḥ| na cānyasminnapi vāryate| kintu viśeṣeṇa prayujyate|

ab.seg: vivarṇabhāvaṃ bhajate viṣādaṃ cāśu gacchati| kīṭairivāvṛtaṃ cāsya gātraṃ cimicimāyate||41||
śroṇipṛṣṭhaśiraḥskandhasandhayaḥ syuḥ savedanāḥ| kṛṣṇaduṣṭāsravisrāvī tṛṇmūrcchājvaradāhavān||42||
dṛṣṭikāluṣyavamathuśvāsakāsakaraḥ kṣaṇāt| āraktapītaparyantaḥ śyāvamadhyo'tirugvraṇaḥ||43||
śūyate pacyate sadyo gatvā māṃsaṃ ca kṛṣṇatām| praklinnaṃ śīryate'bhīkṣṇaṃ sapicchilaparisravam||44||

div.ab: Sa. viṣadigdhena-viṣaliptena śastreṇa, viddho naraḥ punaḥpunaḥ pratāmyati| tathā vaivarṇyaṃ prayāti| drāgeva viṣādameti| asya ca-viṣadigdhena viddhasya, śarīraṃ kīṭairiva vyāptaṃ cimicimāyate| śroṇyādayaścāsya sarujāḥ syuḥ kṛṣṇaṃ duṣṭaṃ ca raktaṃ kṣarati| tṛḍādiyutaḥ kṣaṇenaiva ca dṛṣṭikāluṣyādikaraḥ syāt| tathā vraṇa īṣadraktaprayantaḥ śyāvamadhyo mahārujaḥ syāt| tathā śūyate pākaṃ yāti| teṣāṃ sadya eva ca māṃsaṃ kṛṣṇatāṃ gatvā praklinnaṃ saddīryate nityameva picchilayutaṃ parisravaṃ kuryāt|

kuryādamarmaviddhasya hṛdayāvaraṇaṃ drutam| śalyamākṛṣya taptena lohenānu dahed vraṇam||45|| athavā muṣkakaśvetāsomatvaktāmravallitaḥ| śirīṣād gṛdhranakhyāśca kṣāreṇa pratisārayet||46|| śukanāsāprativiṣāvyāghrīmūlaiśca lepayet| --------------------------------------------------------|47|
Sa. amarmaviddhasya hṛdayāvaraṇaṃ drutaṃ vidadhīta| śalyamākṛṣya taptena lohena vraṇaṃ paścāddahet| athavā muṣkakādikṣāreṇa pratisārayet| śukanāsādibhiśca lepayet vraṇam|
Sa. tasya ca-digdhaphalaviddhasya, kīṭadaṣṭacikitsitaṃ yathāyogaṃ kuryāt|
Sa. vraṇe ca pūtimāṃse pittavisarpa iva cikitsā kāryā|

--------------------------------------------------------| saubhāgyārthaṃ striyo bhartre rājñe vā'rāticoditāḥ||48|| garamāhārasampṛktaṃ yacchantyāsannavartinaḥ| --------------------------------------------------------|49|
Sa. saṃ-nānākāntāḥ yoṣitaḥ patye saubhāgyārthaṃ rājñaśca(rājñe vā) nikaṭavartino narāścārātipreritā garayuktaṃ bhojanaṃ dadati|
Sa. nānāprakāraprāṇyaṅgaśakṛtāṃ tathā viruddhauṣadhibhasmanāṃ viṣāṇāṃ ca stokavīryāṇāṃ yo yogaḥ, sa gara iti smṛtaḥ|

--------------------------------------------------------| tena pāṇḍuḥ kṛśo'lpāgniḥ kāsaśvāsajvarārditaḥ||50|| vāyunā pratilomena svapnacintāparāyaṇaḥ| mahodarayakṛtplīhī dīnavāgdurbalo'lasaḥ||51|| śophavān satatādhmātaḥ śuṣkapādakaraḥ kṣayī| svapne gomāyumārjāranakulavyālavānarān||52|| prāyaḥ paśyati śuṣkāṃśca vanaspatijalāśayān| manyate kṛṣṇamātmānaṃ gauro, goraṃ ca kālakaḥ||53|| vikarṇanāsānayanaṃ paśyettadvihatendriyaḥ| --------------------------------------------------------|54|

Sa. tena gareṇa pāṇḍvādiguṇaḥ kāsādipīḍitaśca syāt| vātena pratilomena yuktastathā svapnacintāparaḥ syāt| tathā bṛhajjaṭharayakṛtplīhavān dīnavāgādiguṇaśca syāt| svapne śṛgālādīn paśyati| prāyeṇa śuṣkavṛkṣodapānāni lokate| ātmānaṃ ca gauraḥ san kṛṣṇaṃ manyate| kṛṣṇaśca gauraṃ manyate| tena-garaviṣeṇa, vihatendriyaḥ san vikarṇaghrāṇacakṣuṣaṃ paśyet|
Sa. etaiḥ-uktairupadravaiḥ, aparaiścānuktairdāruṇaiḥ kliṣṭaḥ san garapīḍitaḥ kaścidacikitsitaḥ sadya eva nāśamaśnute|

--------------------------------------------------------| garārto vāntavān bhuktvā tatpathyaṃ pānabhojanam||55|| śuddhahṛcchīlayeddhema sūtrasthānavidheḥ smaran| --------------------------------------------------------|56|

Sa. garāturaḥ kṛtavamanaḥ san tat-pūrvoktaṃ, pathyaṃ pānabhojanaṃ bhuktvā śuddhahṛdayaḥ suvarṇaṃ śīlayet| kiṃ kurvan ? sūtrasthānoktavidheḥ-"śuddhe hṛdi tataḥ śāṇaṃ hemacūrṇasya dāpayet|" (hṛ.sū. a. 7/28) iti smaran| vidheḥ smarannityatra "adhīgartha-" ityādinā vidhiśabdāt karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī|

--------------------------------------------------------| śarkarākṣaudrasaṃyuktaṃ cūrṇaṃ tāpyasuvarṇayoḥ||56|| lehaḥ praśamayatyugraṃ sarvayogakṛtaṃ viṣam| --------------------------------------------------------|57|
Sa. mākṣīkadhātukāñcanayoścūrṇaṃ śarkarāmākṣikānvitaṃ leho dāruṇaṃ garayogajaṃ viṣaṃ hanti|

ab.seg: vacāmustaviḍaṅgāni takrakoṣṇāmbumastubhiḥ| pibedrasena vā'mlena garopahatapāvakaḥ||58||

div.ab: Sa. mūrvādīni takrādibhiramlena vā-bījapūrarasādirasena, garopahatāgniḥ pumān pibet|

ab.seg: pārāvatāmiṣaśaṭhīpuṣkarāhvaśṛtaṃ himam| garatṛṣṇārujākāsaśvāsahidhmājvarāpaham||59||

div.ab: Sa. pārāvatāmiṣādibhiḥ śṛtaṃ śītaṃ jalaṃ garatṛṣṇādighnam|

ab.seg: viṣaprakṛtikālānnadoṣadūṣyādisaṅgame| viṣasaṅkaṭamuddiṣṭaṃ śatasyaiko'tra jīvati||60||

div.ab: Sa. viṣaprakṛtyādiyoge sati viṣasaṅkaṭaṃ kathitam| [atra-] asmiṃśca viṣasaṅkaṭe, viṣārtaḥ śatamadhya eko jīvet| tatra viṣaprakṛtiḥ-pittaprakṛtiḥ| kālo-varṣāḥ| viṣānnaṃ-sarṣapādi| viṣadoṣaḥ-pittam| dūṣyaṃ-raktam| ādiśabdena sātmyādīnāṃ grahaṇam|

kṣuttṛṣṇāgharmadaurbalyakrodhaśokabhayaśramaiḥ| ajīrṇavarcodravatāpittamārutavṛddhibhiḥ||61|| tilapuṣpaphalāghrāṇabhūbāṣpaghanagarjitaiḥ| hastimūṣikavāditraniḥsvanairviṣasaṅkaṭaiḥ||62|| purovātotpalāmodamadanairvardhate viṣam| --------------------------------------------------------|63|
Sa. kṣudhādibhirviṣaṃ vṛddhimeti|

ab.seg: visarpati ghanāpāye, tadagastyo hinasti ca| prayāti mandavīryatvaṃ viṣaṃ tasmāddhanātyaye||64||

div.ab: Sa. prāvṛṣi ca jalaprabhavatvādviṣaṃ saṃkledaṃ guḍavad yāti| visarpati-prasarati, ghanāpāye-vigatavarṣāsamaye| tat-viṣaṃ, agastyo hinasti-alpaśakti karoti| tasmādghanātyaye-śaratsamaye, mandavīryatvaṃ prayāti|

ab.seg: iti prakṛtisātmyartusthānavegabalābalam| alocya nipuṇaṃ buddhyā karmānantaramācaret||65||

div.ab: Sa. iti-evaṃ pūrvoktena prakāreṇa, prakṛtyādikaṃ buddhvā-yatnena nirūpya, tataḥ karma kuryāt|

ab.seg: ślaiṣmikaṃ vamanairuṣṇarūkṣatīkṣṇaiḥ pralepanaiḥ| kaṣāyakaṭutiktaiśca bhojanaiḥ śamayedviṣam||66||

div.ab: Sa. ślaiṣmikaṃ viṣaṃ vamanairuṣṇādiguṇaiḥ pralepaiśceddaśairbhojanaiśca kaṣāyādiguṇaiḥ śāntiṃ nayet|

ab.seg: paittikaṃ sraṃsanaiḥ sekapradehairbhṛśaśītalaiḥ| kaṣāyatiktamadhurairghṛtayuktaiśca bhojanaiḥ||67||

div.ab: Sa. paittikaṃ viṣaṃ virecanaistathā'tiśītalaiḥ sekaiḥ pralepaiśca tathā bhojanaiḥ kaṣāyatiktamadhurairājyayutaiśca śamayet|

ab.seg: vātātmakaṃ jayetsvādusnigdhāmlalavaṇānvitaiḥ| saghṛtairbhojanairlepaistathaiva piśitāśanaiḥ||68||

div.ab: Sa. vātikaṃ madhurādiyuktaiḥ sasarpiṣkairbhojanairlepairmāṃsabhojanaiśca jayet|

nāghṛtaṃ sraṃsanaṃ śastaṃ pralepo bhojyamauṣadham| sarveṣu sarvāvastheṣu viṣeṣu na ghṛtopamam||69|| vidyate bheṣajaṃ kiñcidviśeṣāt prabale'nile| --------------------------------------------------------|70|

Sa. viṣe sraṃsanaṃ-virecanaṃ, pralepo vā bhojyamauṣadhaṃ vā nāghṛtaṃ śastam| kiṃ tarhi ? sarvameva tat saghṛtaṃ śastam| sarveṣu viṣeṣu sarvāvastheṣu ca ghṛtatulyaṃ nānyadauṣadhaṃ kimapyasti| viśeṣeṇa ca vāte'tirikte|

--------------------------------------------------------| ayatnācchleṣmagaṃ sādhyaṃ, yatnāt pittāśayāśrayam|70| suduḥsādhyamasādhyaṃ vā vātāśayagataṃ viṣam| 70 1/2| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīvadvāgbhaṭaviraci- tāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne viṣapratiṣedho nāma pañcatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ|35|

Sa. kaphagataṃ viṣamalpayatnena sādhyam| pittāśayāśrayaṃ yatnena sādhyam| vātāśayāśritaṃ suṣṭhu duḥkhena sādhyate'sādhyaṃ vā syāditi| iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayaṭī- kāyāṃ sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne viṣapratiṣedho nāma pañcatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 35||

div.head: sarpaviṣapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ
div.ab: Sa. viṣaprakramāt sarpaviṣapratiṣedhaṃ vivakṣurāha-

athātaḥ sarpaviṣapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātrayādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre|2| ) darvīkarā maṇḍalino rājīmantaśca pannagāḥ| tridhā samāsato bhaumāḥ, bhidyante te tvanekadhā||1|| vyāsato yonibhedena nocyante'nupayoginaḥ| --------------------------------------------------------|2|
Sa. darvīkarādibhedena bujaṅgāḥ saṅkṣepeṇa triprakārā bhaumāḥ| te tu yonibhedena vistarato'nekadhā bhidyante| viśeṣāścehānupayogino yataḥ, tato na nigadyante|

Sa. darvīkaramaṇḍalirājīmantasteṣāṃ viṣaṃ rūkṣādiguṇaṃ krameṇa ca vātapittakaphānāṃ kopanaṃ syāt| yadyapi viṣaṃ rūkṣādiguṇaṃ, tathā'pyatiśayārthaṃ punariha guṇakathanam| viśeṣācca viṣaṃ hyuṣṇameva kathitaṃ na śītalam|

Sa. ete ca-darvīkarādyayaḥ, tāruṇyādiṣu yathākramaṃ vṛṣṭyādiṣu ca viṣolbaṇā bhavanti| vṛṣṭiśabdeneha śrāvaṇādayaścatvāro māsā gṛhītāḥ| evaṃ śītātapadyāścatvāro māsā gṛhītāḥ| vyantarāḥ-vijātayaḥ, ṛtusandhiṣu viṣādhikāḥ syuḥ| ṛtusandhiḥprāguktaḥ (hṛ. sū. a. 3/58)|

--------------------------------------------------------| rathāṅgalāṅgalacchatrasvastikāṅkuśadhāriṇaḥ||4|| phaṇinaḥ śīghragatayaḥ sarpā darvīkarāḥ smṛtāḥ| --------------------------------------------------------|5|
Sa. rathāṅgādidhāriṇaḥ phaṇāvanto drutagatayo bhujaṅgā darvīkarā iti munibhiḥ smṛtāḥ|
Sa. abhogāḥ-alpabhogāḥ tathā nānāprakārairmaṇḍalaiścitāḥ prāṃśavo'śīghragatayo maṇḍalino vedyāḥ|

ab.seg: ----------------------------rājīmantastu rājibhiḥ| snigdhā vicitravarṇābhistiryagūrdhvaṃ ca citritāḥ||6||

div.ab: Sa. snigdhābhā nānāprakārābhistiryagūrdhvagarājibhirvicitritā rājīmanto vedyāḥ|
vijātayo'dhunocyante - godhāsutastu gaudhero viṣe darvīkaraiḥ samaḥ| catuṣpād------------------------------------|7|

Sa. godhāputro gaudheraḥ| nanu, gaudhera iti nāmnaiva godhāsutaḥ pratyapādi| tathā ca "godhāyā ḍhrak" ityapatyārthavyutpādito'yam| satyamāha bhavān| yādṛcchikanāmaśaṅkānirāsāya tvetat| sa ca darvīkarairviṣeṇa tulyaḥ, taireva jātatvāt| catuṣpāt-catuṣpādo'sau|
Sa. vyantarāṃścaiteṣāmeva saṅkareṇa jānīyāt| yataśca te saṅkīrṇalakṣaṇāḥ| tasmāt sannipātaprakopānāḥ syuḥ|

ab.seg: --------------------------------------------------------| āhārārthaṃ bhayāt pādasparśādativiṣāt krudhaḥ||8||
pāpavṛttitayā vairāddevarṣiyamacodanāt| daśanti sarpāsteṣūktaṃ viṣādhikyaṃ yathottaram||9||

div.ab: Sa. āhārādibhiḥ kāraṇairbhujaṅgā daśanti| teṣu yathottaraṃ viṣasyādhikyaṃ kathitam|
ādiṣṭāt kāraṇaṃ jñātvā pratikuryādyathāyatham| --------------------------------------------------------|10|
Sa. ādiṣṭāt sarpāt hetuṃ viditvā viditvā yathāsvaṃ cikitset|

ab.seg: --------------------------------------------------------| vyantaraḥ pāpaśīlatvānmārgamāśritya tiṣṭhati||10||

div.ab: Sa. vyantaro bhujaṅgamaḥ pāpasvabhāvatvādvartma āśrityāste|

yatra lālāparikledamātraṃ gātre pradṛśyate| na tu daṃṣṭrākṛtaṃ daṃśaṃ tattuṇḍāhatamādiśet||11|| ekaṃ daṃṣṭrāpadaṃ dve vā vyālīḍhākhyamaśoṇitam| daṃṣṭrāpade sarakte dve vyāluptaṃ, trīṇi tāni tu||12|| māṃsacchedādavicchinnaraktavāhīni daṣṭakam| daṃṣṭrāpadāni catvāri tadvaddaṣṭanipīḍitam||13|| nirviṣaṃ dvayamatrādyamasādhyaṃ paścimaṃ vadet| --------------------------------------------------------|14|

Sa. yasmin kāye lālāparikledamātram upalabhyate, na punardaṃṣṭrākṛtaṃ daṃśam| tat-evaṃbhūtaṃ, tuṇḍāhataṃ kathayanti| ekaṃ daṃṣṭrāpadaṃ dve vā daṃṣṭrāpade raktavarjite tad vyālīḍhasaṃjñam| dve damṣṭrāpade saśoṇite vyāluptaṃ vidyāt| trīṇi tu daṃṣṭrāpadāni māṃsacchedāt santatāsravāhīni daṣṭakamādiśet| daṃṣṭrāpadāni catvāri tadvat-daṣṭakamiva, daṣṭanipīḍitaṃ syāt| eṣu madhye dvayamādikathitaṃ nirviṣaṃ vadet| paścimaṃ-daṣṭanipīḍitākhyaṃ, asādhyaṃ vadet| vyāluptadaṣṭakaṃ tu kṛcchrasādhyamityarthādgamyate|

Sa. sarpajaṃ viṣaṃ na śoṇitamaprāpya śarīraṃ dūṣayate, api tu prāpya| kintu raktaṃ stokamapi prāpya viṣaṃ vardhate| yathā tailaṃ jalaṃ prāpya prasarati tathaiva| āheyamiti "dṛtikukṣi" ityādinā bhavārthe ḍhañ|
Sa. bhīroḥ-sabhayasya puṃsaḥ, sarpasaṃsparśāddhetoryadbhayaṃ tena vāyuḥ kruddhaḥ kadācicchophaṃ vidhatte| tat sarpāṅgābhihataṃ syāt|

ab.seg: viṣodvego jvaraścardirmūrcchā dāho'pi vā bhavet| glānirmoho'tisāro vā tacchaṅkāviṣamucyate||17||

div.ab: Sa. durgāndhakāre kenacitprāṇinā viddhasya daṣṭaśaṅkayā viṣodvegādayaḥ syuḥ, tacchaṅkāviṣaṃ nigadyate|

ab.seg: tudyate saviṣo daṃśaḥ kaṇḍūśopharujanvitaḥ| dahyate grathitaḥ kiñcidviparītastu nirviṣaḥ||18||

div.ab: Sa. saviṣo daṃśo vyathyate, kaṇḍvādiyuto dahyate, jālakavat kiñcit grathitaḥ| asmādviparītaśca nirviṣaḥ syāt|

ab.seg: pūrve darvīkṛtāṃ vege duṣṭaṃ śyāvībhavatyasṛk| śyāvatā tena vaktrādau sarpantīva ca kīṭakāḥ||19||
dvitīye granthayo vege, tṛtīye mūrdhni gauravam| dṛgrodho daṃśavikledaścaturthe ṣṭhīvanaṃ vamiḥ||20||
sandhiviśleṣaṇaṃ tandrā pañcame parvabhedanam| dāho hidhmā ca, ṣaṣṭhe tu hṛtpīḍā gātragauravam||21||
mūrcchā vipāko'tīsāraḥ, prāpya śukraṃ tu saptame| skandhapṛṣṭhakaṭībhaṅgaḥ sarvaceṣṭānivartanam||22||

div.ab: Sa. darvīkarāṇāṃ prathame viṣavege śyāvavarṇaṃ duṣṭaṃ ca raktaṃ syāt| tena ca-tādṛśā raktena, mukhanayanādau śyāvatā syāt| kīṭakāśca gātre sarpantīva| dvitīye viṣavege granthayaḥ syuḥ| tṛtīye śirogurutvādayaḥ syuḥ| caturthe ṣṭhīvanādayaḥ| pañcame sandhiviśleṣaṇaṃ tandrā parvabhedanaṃ dāho hikkā ca| ṣaṣṭhe ca vege hṛdayapīḍādyāḥ| saptame śukraṃ prāpya skandhādibhaṅgaḥ sarvaceṣṭānivartanaṃ syāt|

ab.seg: atha maṇḍalidaṣṭasya duṣṭaṃ pītībhavatyasṛk| tena pītāṅgatā dāho, dvitīye śvayathūdbhavaḥ||23||
tṛtīye daṃśavikledaḥ svedastṛṣṇā ca jāyate| caturthe jvaryate, dāhaḥ pañcame sarvagātragaḥ||24||

div.ab: Sa. maṇḍalinā daṣṭasya prathame vege raktaṃ duṣṭaṃ pītībhavati| tena ca raktena pītāṅgatā dāhaśca| dvitīye śvayathūdbhūtiḥ| tṛtīye daṃśavikledādayaḥ| caturthe vege jvaro dāhaḥ| pañcame sarvaśarīragato dāhaḥ|

daṣṭasya rājilairduṣṭaṃ pāṇḍutāṃ yāti śoṇitam| pāṇḍutā tena gātrāṇāṃ, dvitīye gurutā'ti ca||25|| tṛtīye daṃśavikledo nāsikākṣimukhasravāḥ| caturthe garimā mūrdhno manyāstambhaśca, pañcame||26|| gātrabhaṅgo jvaraḥ śītaḥ śeṣayoḥ pūrvavadvadet| --------------------------------------------------------|27|

Sa. rājimatā duṣṭasya raktaṃ duṣṭaṃ pāṇḍutāṃ gaccati| tena hetunā gātrāṇāṃ pāṇḍutā| dvitīye vege'tigātragurutvam| tṛtīye daṃśavikledādayaḥ| caturthe mūrdhno garimādayaḥ| pañcame gātrabhaṅgādayaḥ| śeṣayoḥ-ṣaṣṭhasaptamayorlakṣaṇaṃ, pūrvavat-darvīkaravat, vadet|
Sa. pañcasu vegeṣu cikitsitaṃ kuryāt| na tu tasmātparam, asādhyatvāt|

jalāplutā ratikṣīṇā bhītā nakulanirjitāḥ| śītavātātapavyādhikṣuttṛṣṇāśramapīḍitāḥ||28|| tūrṇaṃ deśāntarāyātā vimuktaviṣakañcukāḥ| kuṣauṣadhīkaṇṭakavadye caranti ca kānanam||29|| deśaṃ ca divyādhyuṣitaṃ sarpāste'lpaviṣā matāḥ| --------------------------------------------------------|30|

Sa. jalāplutādayaḥ sarpā alpaviṣā jñeyāḥ| divyādhyuṣito deśo-yatra devatāḥ kṛtasannidhānāḥ, taṃ deśaṃ caranti| [ "śmaśānacaityavalmīkayajñāśrayasurālaye| catuṣpathe jalasthāne jīrṇodyāneṣu koṭhare|| kṣīradrume nimbatarau nirjhare girigahvare| cakravajragadākuntatriśūlāṅkajaṭādharāḥ|| raktāsyanayanā ye ca te syurāśīviṣopamāḥ| na teṣu kālaniyamo na ca vegeṣvanukramaḥ| mantratantrabalānnāpi prasahya vinivartanam|" vṛddhavāgbhaṭāt| ] (saṃ.u.a. 41)

--------------------------------------------------------| śmaśānaciticaityādau pañcamīpakṣasandhiṣu||30|| aṣṭamīnavamīsandhyāmadhyarātridineṣu ca| yāmyāgneyamaghāśleṣāviśākhāpūrvanaiḥṛte||31|| naiḥ-ṛtākhye muhūrte ca daṣṭaṃ marmasu ca tyajet| --------------------------------------------------------|32|
Sa. śmaśānādiṣu daṣṭaṃ marmasu ca daṣṭaṃ tyajet| yāmyaṃ-bharaṇī| āgneyaṃ-kṛttikā| naiḥ-ṛtaṃ-mūlam| naiḥ-ṛtākhyo muhūrto-sandhyodaya eva|

--------------------------------------------------------| daṣṭamātraḥ sitāsyākṣaḥ śīryamāṇaśiroruhaḥ||32|| stabdhajihvo muhurmūrcchan śītocchvāso na jīvati| --------------------------------------------------------|33|

Sa. yaḥ śuklamukhanayanaḥ patatkacaḥ stabdharasanaḥ punaḥpunarmūrcchan śītocchvāsaḥ, sa na jīvati| [ "vepathurvedanāstīvrā grīvābhaṅgo'kṣiraktatā| mūrcchā galagrahaśchardiḥ pretarājasya kiṅkarāḥ|| jāmbavapratimo daṃśaḥ kūrmapṛṣṭhavadunnataḥ| raktaṃ khebhyaḥ samastebhyo vartate na tu daṃśataḥ|| romaharṣo na śiśiraiḥ śvayathurlohito'sitaḥ| hṛṣṭamehanatā vakravaktratvaṃ yasya taṃ tyajet||" vṛddhavāgbhaṭāt| } (saṃ.u. a. 41)
Sa. yasya dehina ekakālameva hidhmādayo hṛcchūlaṃ ca syāt, sa na jīvati|

--------------------------------------------------------| phenaṃ vamati niḥsaṃjñaḥ śyāvapādakarānanaḥ||34|| nāsāvasādo bhaṅgo'ṅge viḍbhedaḥ ślathasandhitā| viṣapītasya daṣṭasya digdhenābhihatasya ca||35|| bhavantyetāni rūpāṇi samprāpte jīvitakṣaye| --------------------------------------------------------|36|

Sa. yaśca phenaṃ vamati niścetanaḥ śyāvapādādistathā nāsāvasādādayaśca, yasya puṃso viṣapītasya tathā daṣṭamātrasya viṣaliptakenābhihatasya ca sāmānyenaitāni rūpāṇi tasya jīvitakṣaye samprāpte syuḥ| viṣapītasyetyāhitāgniṣūktatvāt paranipātaḥ|

Sa. tīkṣṇairnasyairna cetanā-na caitanyam| tathā kṣatācchinnādraktāgamo na bhavati| tathā daṇḍena-laguḍena, āhatasya rājiḥ-lekhā, na bhavati| yamasamīpaṃ prayātasya-gamiṣyato narasya| prayāta syeti "vartamānasāmīpye vartamānavadvā" iti bhaviṣyati ktaḥ|
Sa. ato'nyathā-sādhyatve sati, tvarayā-sadyo drāgeva, kaṇṭhagatān prāṇān jvalitagṛhamiva rakṣan viṣaṃ śīghraṃ śāntiṃ nayet|

--------------------------------------------------------| mātrāśataṃ viṣaṃ sthitvā daṃśe daṣṭasya dehinaḥ||38|| dehaṃ prakramate dhātūn rudhirādīn pradūṣayat| --------------------------------------------------------|39|
Sa. śarīriṇo daṣṭasya daṃśe mātrāśaratulyakālaṃ viṣaṃ sthitvā dehaṃ prakramate rudhirādīn dhātūn dūṣayat| prakramata iti "propābhyām" iti taṅ|
Sa. asminnantare-avasare, daṃśasyotkartanādikaṃ karma capalaṃ vidadhīta, yathā viṣavallī kāye na rohati| viṣaṃ vallīveti "upamitaṃ vyāghrādibhiḥ" iti samāsaḥ|

ab.seg: loṣṭaṃ mahīṃ vā daśanaischittvā cānu sasambhramam| niṣṭhīvena samālimpeddaṃśaṃ karṇamalena vā||41||

div.ab: Sa. daṣṭamātraḥ puruṣastameva sarpaṃ-daṣṭāraṃ, śīghrameva khādet (daśet)| athavā loṣṭaṃ dharaṇīṃ daśanaiśchittvā paścācca jhaṭiti niṣṭhīvena daṃśamālimpet| karṇamalena vā''limpet|

ab.seg: daṃśasyopari badhnīyādariṣṭāṃ caturaṅgule| kṣaumādibhirveṇikayā siddhairmantraiśca mantravit||42||
ambuvat setubandhena bandhena stabhyate viṣam| na vahanti sirāścāsya viṣaṃ bandhābhipīḍitāḥ||43||

div.ab: Sa. daṃṣasyopariṣṭāccaturaṅgule'riṣṭāṃ kṣaumādibhirveṇikayā siddhaiśca mantrairupalakṣito mantrairupalakṣito mantrajño badhnīyāt| bandhena hi viṣaṃ stabhyate| jalaṃ yathā setubandhena| asya ca daṣṭasya, sirā viṣaṃ bandhanapīḍitā na vahanti|

ab.seg: niṣpīḍyānūddheraddaṃśaṃ marmasandhyagataṃ tathā| na jāyate viṣādvego bījanāśādivāṅkuraḥ||44||

div.ab: Sa. anu-paścāt, niṣpīḍya daṃśamuddharet marmasandhiṃ varjayitvā| tathā-evaṃ kṛte sati, viṣavego na jāyate| yathā-aṅkuro bījanāśāt|

daṃśaṃ maṇḍalināṃ muktvā pittalatvādathāparam| prataptairhemalohādyairdahedāśūlmukena vā||45|| karoti bhasmasātsadyo vahniḥ kiṃ nāma tu kṣatam| --------------------------------------------------------|46|
Sa. maṇḍalināṃ ca daṃśaṃ pittalatvāddhetormuktvā, athāparaṃ daṃśaṃ hemādibhiḥ prataptaiḥ śīghraṃ dahedulmukena vā| yato'gniḥ sadya eva bhasmatāṃ sarvameva vastu nayati| kṣataṃ tu kiyanmātram|

--------------------------------------------------------| ācūṣet pūrṇavaktro vā mṛdbhasmāgadagomayaiḥ||46|| pracchāyāntarariṣṭāyāṃ māṃsalaṃ tu viśeṣataḥ| aṅgaṃ sahaiva daṃśena lepayedagadairmuhuḥ||47|| candanośīrayuktena salilena ca secayet| --------------------------------------------------------|48|

Sa. athavā pittalaprāyaḥ syāt tadā mṛdādibhiḥ pūrṇavadano'riṣṭāmadhyaṃ pracchāya-pracchānaṃ kṛtvā, ācūṣet| māṃsalaṃ tu sthānaṃ viśeṣeṇa pracchāyācūṣet| tathā daṃśena sārdhamaṅgamagadena punaḥpunarlepayet| candanośīrānvitenodakena secayecca śarīram|
Sa. viṣe pravisṛte sati sirāṃ vidhyet| sā hi uttamā kriyā| yato'syāsṛji nirhriyamāṇe viṣaṃ sarvameva nirhriyate, tadāśritatvāt|
Sa. saviṣaṃ śoṇitaṃ durgandhaṃ syāt| vahnau ca kṣiptaṃ caṭacaṭāyate| viśuddhaṃ ca raktaṃ doṣānusāreṇa pūrvavat-sirāvyadhavidhyuktena (hṛ.sū. a. 27) lakṣaṇena, vidyāt|
Sa. sirāsu tu śophādinā'nupalabhyamānāsu śṛṅgaṃ jalaukaso vā yuñjyāt|

ab.seg: śoṇitaṃ srutaśeṣaṃ ca pravilīnaṃ viṣoṣmaṇā| lepasekaiḥ subahuśaḥ stambhayedbhṛśaśītalaiḥ||51||

div.ab: Sa. srutaśeṣaṃ ca lohitaṃ viṣoṣmaṇā pravilīnaṃ lepādibhiḥ punaḥpunarupayuktairatiśītalaiḥ stambhayet|

ab.seg: askanne viṣavegāddhi mūrcchāyamadahṛddravāḥ| bhavanti tān jayecchītairbījeccāromaharṣataḥ||52||

div.ab: Sa. askanne-asrute'styāne, hi rakte viṣavegena mūrcchādyā bhavanti| tāṃśca śītairlepādibhirjayet| tathā romāñco yāvacchīte na syāt tāvadbījecca|
Sa. asre tu skanne sati viṣavegaḥ śīghrameva praśāmyati|

ab.seg: pibeddhṛtaṃ ghṛtakṣaudramagadaṃ vā ghṛtāplutam| hṛdayāvaraṇe cāsya śleṣmā hṛdyupacīyate||54||

div.ab: Sa. viṣaṃ tīkṣṇādiyogād hṛdayaṃ karṣati| tasya-hṛdayasya, guptaye-rakṣaṇāya, ghṛtaṃ ghṛtakṣaudramagadaṃ vā pibet ghṛtāplutam| asya-puruṣasya, hṛdayāvaraṇe sati śleṣmā hṛdaye cayaṃ yāti|

pravṛttagauravotkleśahṛllāsaṃ vāmayettataḥ| dravaiḥ kāñjikakaulatthatailamadyādivarjitaiḥ||55|| vamanairviṣahṛdbhiśca naivaṃ vyāpnoti tadvapuḥ| --------------------------------------------------------|56|
Sa. pravṛttāḥ-sañjātāḥ, gauravotkleśahṛllāsā yasya sa evaṃ bhūtastaṃ dravaiḥ kāñjikādirahitairvamanairvāmayet viṣaharaiśca vāmayet| evaṃ kṛte sati tasya-viṣārtasya, śarīraṃ viṣaṃ na vyāpnoti|
Sa. bhujaṅgadoṣādikaṃ susūkṣmayā buddhyā samyagālocya viśiṣṭāṃ kriyāṃ samācaret|
Sa. sinduvāritamūlādikaṃ jalānvitaṃ darvīkarairdaṣṭe pānaṃ nasyaṃ mākṣikaṃ kuṣṭhasahitaṃ hitam|

ab.seg: cāraṭīnākulībhyāṃ vā tīkṣṇamūlaviṣeṇa vā| pānaṃ ca kṣaudramañjiṣṭhāgṛhadhūmayutaṃ ghṛtam||59||

div.ab: Sa. kṛṣṇabhujaṅgadaṣṭasya rakte hṛte sati daṃśaṃ guñjānākulībhyāṃ limpet| tīkṣṇena mūlaviṣena vā limpet| kṣaudrādiyutaṃ ca sarpiḥ pānam|
tandulīyakakāśmaryakiṇihīgirikarṇikāḥ| mātuluṅgī sitā śeluḥ pānanasyāñjanairhitaḥ||60|| agadaḥ phaṇināṃ ghore viṣe rājīmatāmapi| --------------------------------------------------------|61|
Sa. tandulīyakādikaḥ pānādibhiragadaḥ phaṇināṃ rājīmatāṃ ca dāruṇe viṣe hitaḥ|

ab.seg: ardhāṃśaṃ saurasaṃ patraṃ kapitthaṃ bilvadāḍimam| sakṣaudro maṇḍaliviṣe viśeṣādagado hitaḥ||62||

div.ab: Sa. sugandhādayaḥ samāḥ-samabhāgāḥ, ardhabhāgena surasapatrādikamiti samākṣiko maṇḍalino viṣe viśeṣeṇāgado hitaḥ|

ab.seg: pañcavalkavarāyaṣṭīnāgapuṣpailavālukam| jīvakarṣabhakau śītaṃ sitā padmakamutpalam||63||
sakṣaudro himavānnāma hanti maṇḍalināṃ viṣam| lepācchvayathuvīsarpavisphoṭajvaradāhahā||64||

div.ab: Sa. pañcavalkādiko mākṣikayuto himavānnāmāgado maṇḍaliviṣaṃ lepena hanti, śophādihā ca| śirīṣapippalavaṭaplakṣavetasānāṃ pañcānāṃ tvak-pañcavalkamucyate|

ab.seg: kāśmaryaṃ vaṭaśuṅgāni jīvakarṣabhakau sitā| mañjiṣṭhā madhukaṃ ceti daṣṭo maṇḍalinā pibet||65||

div.ab: Sa. kāśmaryādikaṃ maṇḍalidaṣṭo naraḥ pibet|
vaṃśatvagbījakaṭukāpāṭalībījanāgaram| śirīpabījātiviṣe mūlaṃ gāvedhukaṃ vacā||66|| piṣṭo govāriṇā'ṣṭāṅgo hanti gonasajaṃ viṣam| --------------------------------------------------------|67|
Sa. vaṃśatvagādiko'ṣṭāṅgo'gado gomūtrapiṣṭo gonasaviṣaṃ hanti| vaṃśasya tvagbīje|
Sa. kaṭukādayo rājīmatāṃ viṣaṃ ghnanti|

--------------------------------------------------------| nikhanetkāṇḍacitrāyā daṃśaṃ yāmadvayaṃ bhuvi||68|| uddhṛtya pracchitaṃ sarpirdhānyamṛdbhyāṃ pralepayet| pibetpurāṇaṃ ca ghṛtaṃ varācūrṇāvacūrṇitam||69|| jīrṇe virikto bhuñjīta yavānnaṃ sūpasaṃskṛtam| --------------------------------------------------------|70|

Sa. kāṇḍacitrāyāḥ-sarpaviśeṣasya, daṃśaṃ yāmadvayaṃ bhuvi nikhanet| tata uddhṛtya pracchitaṃ sarpairdhānyamṛdbhyāṃ pralepayet| dhānyasya mṛd dhānyamṛt| tathā purāṇaṃ ghṛtaṃ triphalācūrṇayutaṃ pibet| jīrṇe virikto yavānnaṃ śālyādikaṃ sūpena saṃskṛtamadyāt|

ab.seg: kalkayedāranālena pāṭhāmaricasaṃyutāḥ| eṣa vyantaradaṣṭānāmagadaḥ sārvakārmikaḥ||71||

div.ab: Sa. karavīrārkayoḥ kusumamūlaṃ lāṅgalikādīṃśca kāñjikena kalkayet| eṣo'gadaḥ sārvakārmiko vyantaradaṣṭānāṃ hitaḥ| sārvakārmika iti "anuśatikāditvāt(dīnāṃ ca)" [iti] ubhayapadavṛddhiḥ|

ab.seg: śirīṣapuṣpasvarase saptāhaṃ maricaṃ sitam| bhāvitaṃ sarpadaṣṭānāṃ pānanasyāñjane hitam||72||

div.ab: Sa. śirīṣakusumarase saptavāsarāṇi sitamaricaṃ bhāvitaṃ bhujaṅgadaṣṭānāṃ pānādau hitam|

ab.seg: dvipalaṃ natakuṣṭhābhyāṃ ghṛtakṣaudraṃ catuṣpalam| api takṣakadaṣṭānāṃ pānametatsukhapradam||73||

div.ab: Sa. tagarakuṣṭhayordve pale ghṛtamākṣikayoścatvāri palāni| takṣakeṇāpi daṣṭānāṃ tatpītaṃ śarmadam|

ab.seg: atha darvīkṛtāṃ vege pūrve vistrāvya śoṇitam| agadaṃ madhusarpirbhyāṃ saṃyuktaṃ tvaritaṃ pibet||74||

div.ab: Sa. darvīkṛtāṃ ca prathame vege pūrvaṃ raktaṃ visrāvyānantaraṃ madhughṛtayutamagadaṃ śīghrameva pibet|
Sa. dvitīye vege vamanaṃ vidhāya tathaivāgadaṃ pibet|
Sa. tṛtīye vege viṣaghnamañjanādi dadyāt|
Sa. caturthe vege kṛtavamanaḥ pūrvoktāṃ yavāgūṃ pibet|

--------------------------------------------------------| ṣaṣṭhapañcamayoḥ śītairdigdhaṃ siktamabhīkṣṇaśaḥ||76|| pāyayedvamanaṃ tīkṣṇaṃ yavāgūṃ ca viṣāpahaiḥ| --------------------------------------------------------|77|
Sa. ṣaṣṭhapañcamayorvegayoḥ puruṣaṃ śiśirairmuhurliptaṃ siktaṃ ca tīkṣṇaṃ vamanaṃ pāyayet| yavāgūṃ ca viṣaghnaiḥ kṛtāṃ pāyayet|

ab.seg: kṛtvā'vagāḍhaṃ śastreṇa mūrdhni kākapadaṃ tataḥ| māṃsaṃ sarudhiraṃ tasya carma vā tatra nikṣipet||78||

div.ab: Sa. saptame vege tīkṣṇamagadamañjane nasye ca yuñjyāt| tataḥ śastreṇa kākapadamavagāḍhaṃ mūrdhni vidhāya tatastasya-daṣṭasya, tasmin kākapade māṃsaṃ saśoṇitaṃ nyaset, athavā carma nikṣipet|
Sa. tṛtīye maṇḍalināṃ vege vamitaḥ peyāṃ pibet|
Sa. ṣaṣṭhe'tīkṣṇamagadaṃ padmakādiṃ vā gaṇaṃ (hṛ.sū. a. 15/12) yojayet|

ab.seg: adye'vagāḍhaṃ pracchāya vege daṣṭasya rājilaiḥ| alābunā haredraktaṃ pūrvavaccāgadaṃ pibet||80||

div.ab: Sa. rājīmatāṃ prathame vege'tiśayena pracchāyālābunā raktaṃ haret| pūrvavaccāgadaṃ pibet|
Sa. ṣaṣṭhe'ñjanamatitīkṣṇaṃ yojayedavapīḍaṃ ca| nanu, atra kecidvegā noditā eva| teṣu kiṃ vidheyam ? ityāha-
Sa. akathiteṣu darvīkaroktāṃ kriyāṃ yojayet|
Sa. garbhīṇyādiṣu mṛduṃ kriyāṃ yojayet| sirāṃ ca na vyadhayet|

ab.seg: tamālaḥ kesaraṃ śītaṃ pītaṃ tandulavāriṇā| hanti sarvaviṣāṇyetadvajraṃ vajramivāsurān||83||

div.ab: Sa. tvagādikamidaṃ jyeṣṭhāmbhasā pītaṃ sarvāṇi viṣāṇi hanti| vajrivajramivāsurānityupamālaṅkāraḥ|

ab.seg: bilvasya mūlaṃ surasasya puṣpaṃ phalaṃ karañjasya nataṃ surāhvam| phalatrikaṃ vyoṣaniśādvayaṃ ca vastasya mūtreṇa susūkṣmapiṣṭam||84||
bhujaṅgalūtonduravṛścikādyairvisūcikājīrṇagarajvaraiśca| ārtānnarān bhūtavidharṣitāṃśca svasthīkarotyañjanapānanasyaiḥ||85||

div.ab: Sa. bilvamūlādikaṃ chāgamūtreṇa suślakṣṇapiṣṭamañjanādibhirbhujaṅgādibhirārtān puruṣān bhūtopadrutāṃśca svasthayati| upajātivṛtte|

ab.seg: pralepādyaiśca niḥśeṣaṃ daṃśādapyuddharedviṣam| bhūyo vegāya jāyet śeṣaṃ dūṣīviṣāya vā||86||

div.ab: Sa. daṃśādapi-kiṃ punaḥ kāyāt, sarvaṃ viṣamuddharet| śeṣaṃ hi viṣaṃ punarvegāya sampadyate, dūṣīviṣāya vā|

ab.seg: viṣāpāye'nilaṃ kruddhaṃ snehādibhirupācaret| tailamadyakulatthāmlavarjyaiḥ pavananāśanaiḥ||87||
pittaṃ pittajvaraharaiḥ kaṣāyasnehabastibhiḥ| samākṣikeṇa vargeṇa kaphamāragvadhādinā||88||

div.ab: Sa. viṣāpagame sati vāyuṃ kupitaṃ snehādibhirupakramet, tailādivarjitairvātanāśanaiḥ| pittaṃ pittajvaraharaiḥ kvāthaiḥ snehabastibhiścopakramet| āragvadhādigaṇena (hṛ. sū. a. 15/17) samākṣikeṇa kaphamupācaret|

sitā vaigandhiko drākṣā payasyā madhukaṃ madhu| pānaṃ samantrapūtāmbu prekṣaṇaṃ sāntvaharṣaṇam||89|| sarpāṅgābhihate yuñjyāttathā śaṅkāviṣārdite| --------------------------------------------------------|90|
Sa. sitādikaṃ mantrapūtajalena sahitaṃ pānam| prokṣaṇaṃ prakṛtatvānmantrapūtajalena vegaśo'ṅgaśaśca| tathā sāntvanaharṣaṇaṃ sarpāṅgābhihate yuñjyāt, śaṅkāviṣapīḍite ca yuñjyāt|

ab.seg: vaiḍhūryaṃ gardabhamaṇiṃ picukaṃ viṣamūṣikām| himavadgirisambhūtāṃ somarājīṃ punarnavām||91||
tathā droṇāṃ mahādroṇāṃ mānasīṃ sarpajaṃ maṇim| viṣāṇi viṣaśāntyarthaṃ vīryavanti ca dhārayet||92||

div.ab: Sa. karketanādīni viṣāṇi ca vīryavanti viṣaśāntyarthaṃ dhārayet|

chatrī jharjharapāṇiśca caredrātrau viśeṣataḥ| tacchāyāśabdavitrastāḥ praṇaśyanti bhujaṅgamāḥ|93| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne sarpaviṣapratiṣedho nāma ṣaṭtriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ|36|

Sa. chatravān jharjharahastaśca caret, viśeṣeṇa rātrau| tayoḥ chatrajharjharayoḥ, yathāsaṅkhyaṃ chāyāśabdābhyāṃ vitrastāḥ sarpāḥ praṇaśyanti, tasmādevamācaraṇīyamiti| iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayaṭīkāyāṃ sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne sarpaviṣapratiṣedho nāma ṣaṭtriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 36||

div.head: kīṭālūtādiviṣapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ
div.ab: Sa. viṣaprakramāt kīṭalūtādicikitsitaṃ vakti-

ab.seg: athātaḥ kīṭalūtādiviṣapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre|2| ) sarpāṇāmeva viṇmūtraśukrāṇḍaśavakothajāḥ| doṣairvyastaiḥ samastaiśca yuktāḥ kīṭāścaturvidhāḥ||1||

div.ab: Sa. sarpāṇāṃ-pūrvoktānāṃ, viṇmūtrādijāḥ kīṭā doṣaiḥ pṛthagyuktāstriprakārāḥ samuditaiśca yuktā iti catuḥ prakārāḥ syuḥ|
daṣṭasya kīṭairvāyavyairdaṃśastodarujolbaṇaḥ| -----------------------------------------------|2|
Sa. teṣu madhye vāyavyaiḥ-vātalaiḥ kīṭaiḥ, daṣṭasya daṃśastodarujādhiko bhavet|
-----------------------------------------------| āgneyairalpasaṃsrāvo dāharāgavisarpavān||2|| pakvapīluphalaprakhyaḥ kharjūrasadṛśo'thavā| -----------------------------------------------|3|
Sa. āgneyaiḥ kīṭairdaṣṭasya daṃśo'lpasrāvādimān syāt| pakvapīluphalanibhaḥ kharjūrasadṛśo vā syāt|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------| kaphādhikarimandarujaḥ pakvodumbarasannibhaḥ||3||

div.ab: Sa. kaphādhikaiḥ kīṭairdaṣṭasya daṃśo mandarujaḥ pakvodumbarasadṛśaḥ|
srāvāḍhyaḥ sarvaliṅgastu vivarjyaḥ sānnipātikaiḥ| -----------------------------------------------|4|
Sa. sānnipātikaiḥ-tridoṣādhikaiḥ kīṭaiḥ, daṣṭasya daṃśaḥ srutyadhikaḥ sarvaliṅgaḥ| sa ca varjyo-nopakramaṇīyaḥ|
-----------------------------------------------| vegāśca sarpavacchopho vardhiṣṇurvisraraktatā||4|| śirokṣigauravaṃ mūrcchā bhramaḥ śvāso'tivedanā| -----------------------------------------------|5|
Sa. vegāśca sarpavatkīṭeṣu syuḥ| tathā śvayathurvardhanasvabhāvo visraśoṇitatvaṃ ca mūrdhanetragurutvaṃ mūrcchādyāśca syuḥ|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------| sarveṣāṃ karṇikā śopho jvaraḥ kaṇḍūrarocakaḥ||5||

div.ab: Sa. karṇikādyāśca sarveṣāṃ daṃśānāṃ syuḥ|
vṛścikasya viṣaṃ tīkṣṇamādau dahati vahnivat| ūrdhvamārohati kṣipraṃ daṃśe paścāttu tiṣṭhati||6|| daṃśaḥ sadyo'tiruk śyāvastudyate sphuṭatīva ca| -----------------------------------------------|7|

Sa. vṛścikasya tīkṣṇaṃ viṣaṃ bhavati| tacca prathamamagniriva dahati| upariṣṭādāśvevārohati| paścācca daṃśe tiṣṭhati| daṃśo vṛścikasambandhī sadyo'tirugādiḥ syāt| tudyate sphuṭatīva ca| tudyata iti karmakartari taṅ|
-----------------------------------------------| te gavādiśakṛtkothāddigdhadaṣṭādikothataḥ||7|| sarpakothācca sambhūtā mandamadhyamahāviṣāḥ| -----------------------------------------------|8|
Sa. te-vṛścikāḥ, gavādiśakṛtkothāt viṣadigdhadaṣṭādi kothāt sarpakothācca sambhūtā yathāsaṅkhyaṃ mandaviśā madhyaviṣā mahāviṣāśca syuḥ|
-----------------------------------------------| mandāḥ pītāḥ sitāḥ śyāvāḥ rūkṣāḥ karburamecakāḥ||8|| romaśā bahuparvāṇo lohitāḥ pāṇḍurodarāḥ| -----------------------------------------------|9|
Sa. mandaviṣāḥ kīṭāḥ pītādiguṇāḥ| romaśā iti "lomādi" ityādinā śaḥ|
Sa. madhyaviṣāstu kapilādiguṇāḥ|

ab.seg: -------------------------------mahāviṣāḥ| agnyābhā-dvyekaparvāṇo raktāsitasitodarāḥ||10||

div.ab: Sa. mahāviṣā darbhadūrvāsadṛśā dviparvāṇa ekaparvāṇo vā| raktodarāḥ kecitkṛṣṇodarāḥ kecitsitodarāśca|

ab.seg: tairdaṣṭaḥ śūnarasanaḥ stabdhagātro jvarārditaḥ| khairvaman śoṇitaṃ kṛṣṇamindriyārthānasaṃvidan||11||
svidyan mūrcchan viśuṣkāsyo vihvalo vedanāturaḥ| viśīryamāṇamāṃsaśca prāyaśo vijahātyasūn||12||

div.ab: Sa. taiḥ-mahāviṣaiḥ, daṣṭaḥ san śūnajihvādiḥ syāt| tathedamidaṃ kurvannīdṛśaḥ san prāyaśo jīvitaṃ tyajati|

ab.seg: ucciṭiṅgastu vaktreṇa daśatyabhyadhikavyathaḥ| sādhyato vṛścikāt stambhaṃ śephaso hṛṣṭaromatām||13||
karoti sekamaṅgānāṃ daṃśaḥ śītāmbuneva ca| uṣṭradhūmaḥ sa evokto rātricārācca rātrikaḥ||14||

div.ab: Sa. ucciṭiṅgākhyo vṛściko vaktreṇa daśati| sādhyāddṛścikādatiriktavyathaḥ| tathā stambhaṃ karoti meḍhrasya| tathā hṛṣṭaromatāṃ-romaharṣaṃ, karoti| tathā daṃśaśca śiśirajaleneva sekamaṅgānāṃ vidhatte| sa evoṣṭradhūmakaḥ kathitaḥ| rātricaraṇācca rātrikaḥ sa evoktaḥ|

ab.seg: vātapittottarāḥ kīṭāḥ, ślaiśmikāḥ kaṇabhondurāḥ| prāyo vātolbaṇaviṣā vṛścikāḥ soṣṭradhūmakāḥ||15||

div.ab: Sa. kīṭā vātapittādhikāḥ| kaṇabhondurāḥ śleṣmolbaṇāḥ| prāyeṇa vṛścikā vātolbaṇaviṣā uṣṭradhūmakāśca|

ab.seg: yasya yasyaiva doṣasya liṅgādhikyaṃ pratarkayet| tasya tasyauṣadhaiḥ kuryādviparītaguṇaiḥ kriyām||16||

div.ab: Sa. yasya yasyaiva doṣasya liṅgādhikyaṃ jñāyate, tasya tasya doṣasya bheṣajairviparītaguṇaiḥ kriyāṃ vidadhīta|

ab.seg: hṛtpīḍordhvānilastambhaḥ śirāyāmo'sthiparvaruk| ghūrṇanodveṣṭanaṃ gātraśyāvatā vātike viṣe||17||

div.ab: Sa. vātike viṣe hṛtpīḍādayaḥ syuḥ|

ab.seg: saṃjñānāśoṣṇaniśvāsau hṛddāhaḥ kaṭukāsyatā| māṃsāvadaraṇaṃ śopho raktapītaśca paittike||18||

div.ab: Sa. pittolbaṇe saṃjñānāśādayaḥ syuḥ|

ab.seg: chardyarocakahṛllāsaprasekotkleśapīnasaiḥ| saśaityamukhamādhuryairvidyācchleṣmādhikaṃ viṣam||19||

div.ab: Sa. kaphādhikaṃ viṣaṃ chardyādibhirjānīyāt|

ab.seg: piṇyākena vraṇālepastailābhyaṅgaśca vātike| svedo nāḍīpulākādyairbṛṃhaṇaśca vidhirhitaḥ||20||

div.ab: Sa. vātike viṣe piṇyākena vraṇalepo yojyaḥ, tailābhyaṅgaśca nāḍyādibhiśca svedo bṛṃhaṇaśca vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ|
paittikaṃ stambhayetsekaiḥ pradehaiścātiśītalaiḥ| -----------------------------------------------|21|
Sa. pittādhikaṃ viṣaṃ sekādibhiratiśiśiraiḥ stambhayet|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------| lekhanacchedanasvedavamanaiḥ ślaiṣmikaṃ jayet||21||

div.ab: Sa. ślaiṣmikaṃ lekhanādyairjayet|
kīṭānāṃ triprakārāṇāṃ traividhyena kriyā hitā| svedālepanasekāṃstu koṣṇān prāyo'vacārayet||22|| anyatra mūrcchitāddaṃśapākataḥ kothato'thavā| -----------------------------------------------|23|
Sa. kīṭānāṃ trividhānāṃ yathāsvaṃ trividhaiva cikitsā hitā| svedādīṃśca prāyeṇa koṣṇān kuryāt| mūrcchitaṃ naraṃ daṃśapākaṃ ca varjayitvā tathā daṃśakothaṃ ca hitvā|
-----------------------------------------------| nṛkeśāḥ sarṣapāḥ pītā guḍo jīrṇaśca dhūpanam||23|| viṣadaṃśasya sarvasya kāśyapaḥ paramabravīt| -----------------------------------------------|24|
Sa. narakacādayo dhūpanaṃ sarvasya viṣadaṃśasya paraṃ hitamiti bhagavān kāśyapo'vādīt|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------| viṣaghnaṃ ca vidhiṃ sarvaṃ kuryātsaṃśodhanāni ca||24||

div.ab: Sa. tathā viṣaghnaṃ vidhiṃ sakalaṃ vidadhyāt| saṃśodhanāni ca kuryāt|
sādhayetsarpavaddaṣṭān viṣograiḥ kīṭavṛścikaiḥ| -----------------------------------------------|25|
Sa. viṣograiḥ kīṭavṛścikairdaṣṭān sarpavatsādhayet|
-----------------------------------------------| tandulīyakatulyāṃśāṃ trivṛtāṃ sarpiṣā pibet||25|| yāti kīṭaviṣaiḥ kampaṃ na kailāsa ivānilaiḥ| -----------------------------------------------|26|
Sa. trivṛtāṃ tandulīyakasamāṃ ghṛtena naraḥ pibet| evaṃ kīṭaviṣaiśca kampaṃ-kṣobhaṃ, na yāti| kailāsa iva vāyubhiḥ|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------| kṣīrivṛkṣatvagālepaḥ śuddhe kīṭaviṣāpahaḥ||26||

div.ab: Sa. śuddhe sati kṣīrivṛkṣatvagālepaḥ kīṭaviṣaghnaḥ|
muktālepo varaḥ śophatodadāhajvarapraṇut| -----------------------------------------------|27|
Sa. mauktikalepaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ śophādighnaḥ|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------| vacā hiṅgu viḍaṅgāni saindhavaṃ gajapippalī||27||
pāṭhā prativiṣā vyoṣaṃ kāśyapena vinirmitam| daśāṅgamagadaṃ pītvā sarvakīṭaviṣaṃ jayet||28||

div.ab: Sa. vacādikadaśadravyanirmitatvāt daśāṅgamagadaṃ kāśyapena nirmitaṃ pītvā sarvaṃ kīṭaviṣaṃ hanti|

ab.seg: sadyo vṛścikajaṃ daṃśaṃ cakratailena secayet| vidārigandhāsiddhena kavoṣṇenetareṇa vā||29||
lavaṇottamayuktena sarpiṣā vā punaḥ punaḥ| siñcetkoṣṇāranālena sakṣīralavaṇena vā||30||

div.ab: Sa. vṛścikotthaṃ daṃśaṃ sadya eva cakratailena secayet| śāliparṇīsiddhena vā itareṇa-cakratailena, koṣṇena vā secayet| saindhavānvitena vā''jyena muhurmuhuḥ siñcet| kavoṣṇena kāñjikena dugdhasaindhavānvitena vā siñcet|
upanāho ghṛte bhṛṣṭaḥ kalko'jājyāḥ sasaindhavaḥ| -----------------------------------------------|31|
Sa. jīrakakalkaḥ saindhavayukto ghṛtena bhṛṣṭa upanāhaḥ syāt|
-----------------------------------------------| ādaṃśaṃ sveditaṃ cūrṇaiḥ pracchāya pratisārayet||31|| rajanīsaindhavavyoṣaśirīṣaphalapuṣpajaiḥ| -----------------------------------------------|32|
Sa. ā- samantato, daṃśaṃ sveditaṃ pracchāya cūrṇai rajanyādijairgharṣayet|
-----------------------------------------------| mātuluṅgāmlagomūtrapiṣṭaṃ ca surasāgrajam||32|| lepaḥ sukhoṣṇaśca hitaḥ piṇyāko gomayo'pi vā| -----------------------------------------------|33|
Sa. bījapūrāmlagomūtrapiṣṭaṃ surasāpuṣpaṃ lepaḥ syāt| tathā sukhoṣṇaḥ piṇyāko gomayo vā lepo hitaḥ|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------| pāne sarpirmadhuyutaṃ kṣīraṃ vā bhūriśarkaram||33||

div.ab: Sa. pāne haiyaṃgavīnaṃ kṣaudrayuktaṃ, dugdhaṃ vā prabhūtasitaṃ, hitam|

ab.seg: pārāpataśakṛt pathyā tagaraṃ viśvabheṣajam| bījapūrarasonmiśraḥ paramo vṛścikāgadaḥ||34||

div.ab: Sa. pārāpataśakṛtādibhiḥ phalapūrarasasaṃyuktaḥ śreṣṭho vṛścikāgadaḥ|
saśaivaloṣṭradaṃṣṭrā ca hanti vṛścikajaṃ viṣam| -----------------------------------------------|35|

Sa. karabhadaṃṣṭrā śaivālayutā vṛścikaviṣaghnī| ["sasaindhavoṣṭradaṃṣṭrā ca hanti vṛścikajaṃ viṣam| manohvā saindhavaṃ hiṅgu mālatī pallavāni ca|| gośakṛdrasapiṣṭeyaṃ gulikā vṛścikārdite| laśuno maricaṃ hiṅgu surasaṃ viśvabheṣajam|| arkakṣīreṇa guṭikā vṛścikārditaśaṅkarī|" vṛddhavāgbhaṭāt (saṃ. u. a. 43)| ]
-----------------------------------------------| hiṅgunā haritālena mātuluṅgarasena ca||35|| lepāñjanābhyāṃ guṭikā paramaṃ vṛścikāpahā| -----------------------------------------------|36|
Sa. hiṅguharitāle sabījapūrarase lepāñjanābhyāṃ gulikā paraṃ vṛścikaviṣahṛt|
-----------------------------------------------| karañjārjunaśelūnāṃ kaṭabhyāḥ kuṭajasya ca||36|| śirīṣasya ca puṣpāṇi mastunā daṃśalepanam| -----------------------------------------------|37|
Sa. karañjādīnāṃ puṣpāṇi mastunā daṃśalepaḥ|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------| yo muhyati praśvasiti pralapatyugravedanaḥ||37||
tasya pathyāniśākṛṣṇāmañjiṣṭhātiviṣoṣaṇam| sālābuvṛntaṃ vārtākarasapiṣṭaṃ pralepanam||38||

div.ab: Sa. yo naro muhyatyādīn vidhatte, tathā dāruṇapīḍaḥ, tasya pathyādikaṃ vārtākarasapiṣṭaṃ pralepanaṃ kāryam|

ab.seg: sarvatra cogrāliviṣe pāyayeddadhisarpiṣī| vidhyetsirāṃ vidadhyācca vamanāñjananāvanam| uṣṇasnigdhāmlamadhuraṃ bhojanaṃ cānilāpaham||39||

div.ab: Sa. sarvasmin sudāruṇe vṛścikaviṣe dadhisarpiṣī pāyayet| sirāṃ ca vidhyet| vamanādikaṃ ca kuryāt| uṣṇaguṇādikaṃ ca bhojanaṃ vātaghnaṃ hitam|

ab.seg: nāgaraṃ gṛhakapotapurīṣaṃ bījapūrakaraso haritālam| saindhavaṃ ca vinihantyagado'yaṃ lepato'likulajaṃ viṣamāśu||40||

div.ab: Sa. nāgarādikamayamagado lepena vṛścikaviṣaṃ śīghraṃ parākaroti| svāgatāvṛttam|

ab.seg: ante vṛścikadaṣṭānāṃ samudīrṇe bhṛṣaṃ viṣe| viṣeṇālepayeddaṃśamucciṭiṅge'pyayaṃ vidhiḥ||41||

div.ab: Sa. saṃ-vṛścikadaṣṭānāmante bhṛśaṃ samudīrṇe viṣe viṣeṇa daṃśamālepayet| ucciṭiṅgasaṃjñe'pyeṣaiva cikitsā|

ab.seg: nāgapurīṣacchatraṃ rohiṣamūlaṃ ca śelutoyena| kuryādguṭikāṃ lepādiyamaliviṣanāśanī śreṣṭhā||42||

div.ab: Sa. gajapurīṣacchatraṃ kattṛṇamūlaṃ ca śleṣmātakajalena guṭikāṃ vidadhīta| eṣā ca lepena paraṃ vṛścikaviṣaghnī| [āryā}

ab.seg: arkasya dugdhena śirīṣabījaṃ trirbhāvitaṃ pippalīcūrṇamiśram| eṣo'gado hanti viṣāṇi kīṭabhujaṅgalūtonduravṛścikānām||43||

div.ab: Sa. arkakṣīreṇa śirīṣabījaṃ trīn vārān bhāvitaṃ pippalīrajoyutamagadaḥ kīṭādīnāṃ viṣāṇi hanti|

ab.seg: śirīṣapuṣpaṃ sakarañjabījaṃ kāśmīrajaṃ kuṣṭhamanaḥśile ca| eṣo'gado rātrikavṛścikānāṃ saṃkrāntikārī kathito jinena||44||

div.ab: Sa. śirīṣakusumādikameṣo'gado rātrikavṛścikānāṃ viṣakrāntikṛd bhagavatā jinenoktaḥ| upajātivṛtte|

ab.seg: kīṭebhyo dāruṇtarā lūtāḥ ṣoḍaśa tā jaguḥ| aṣṭāviṃśatirityeke tato'pyanye tu bhūyasīḥ||45||
sahasraraśmyanucarā vadantyanye sahasraśaḥ| bahūpadravarupā tu lūtaikaiva viṣātmikā||46||

div.ab: Sa. kīṭebhyo'pi ghorā lūtāḥ| tāśca munayaḥ ṣoḍaśasaṃkhyā adhyagīṣan| anye aṣṭāviṃśatirulūtā ityavocan| tato'pyapare bahutarā ācakhyuḥ| anye tu raveranucarāḥ sahasraśo vadanti| iti nānāmatamuktvā svamataṃ yuktyā sarvamatānugrāhi vakti| anekopadravasvabhāvatvenaikaiva lūtā viṣātmikā|

ab.seg: rūpāṇi nāmatastasyā durjñeyānyatisaṅkarāt| nāsti sthānavyavasthā ca doṣato'taḥ pracakṣate||47||

div.ab: Sa. nāmnā yāni rūpāṇi, tāni tasyā atisaṅkarāddhetordurjñānāni| sthānavyavasthā'pi nāsti| tasmāddoṣavaśena bhaṇiṣyate|
kṛcchrasādhyā pṛthagdoṣairasādhyā nicayena sā| -----------------------------------------------|48|
Sa. pṛthagdoṣairlūtā kṛcchrasādhyā, sannipātena cāsādhyā|
-----------------------------------------------| taddaṃśaḥ paittiko dāhatṛṭsphoṭajvaramohavān||48|| bhṛśoṣmā raktapītābhaḥ kledī drākṣāphalopamaḥ| -----------------------------------------------|49|
Sa. tasyā daṃśaḥ paittiko dāhādimān bhṛśoṣmā pītaraktābhaḥ kledavān drākṣāphalākāraḥ syāt|

-----------------------------------------------| ślaiṣmikaḥ kaṭhinaḥ pāṇḍuḥ parūṣakaphalākṛtiḥ||49|| nidrāṃ śītajvaraṃ kāsaṃ kaṇḍūṃ ca kurute bhṛśam| -----------------------------------------------|50|
Sa. ślaiṣmiko lūtādaṃśaḥ kaṭhinaḥ pāṇḍuvarṇaḥ parūṣakaphalanibho nidrādīnatiśayena karoti|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------| vātikaḥ paruṣaḥ śyāvaḥ parvabhedajvarapradaḥ||50||

div.ab: Sa. vātiko daṃśaḥ paruṣasparśaḥ syāvastathā parvabhedajvarakṛt|
tadvibhāgaṃ yathāsvaṃ ca doṣaliṅgairvibhāvayet| -----------------------------------------------|51|
Sa. tāsāṃ vibhāgaṃ doṣāṇāṃ lakṣaṇairyathāyogaṃ lakṣayet|

-----------------------------------------------| asādhyāyāṃ tu hṛnmohaśvāsahidhmāśirograhāḥ||51|| śvetapītāsitāraktāḥ piṭikāḥ śvayathūdbhavaḥ| vepathurvamathurdāhastṛḍāndhyaṃ vakranāsatā||52|| śyāvauṣṭhavaktradantatvaṃ pṛṣṭhagrīvāvabhañjanam| pakvajambūsavarṇaṃ ca daṃśātsravati śoṇitam||53|| sarvā'pi sarvajā prāyo vyapadeśastu bhūyasā| -----------------------------------------------|54|
Sa. āsādhyāyāṃ lūtāyāṃ hṛnmohādyāḥ syuḥ| śvetādiguṇāḥ piṭikāstathā śvayathvādyāśca| daṃśād raktaṃ pakvajambūnibhaṃ sravati| saṃ-sarvā ca lūtā tridoṣajaiva| bāhulyena tu vyapadeśaḥ|
-----------------------------------------------| tīkṣṇamadhyāvaratvena sā tridhā hantyupekṣitā||54|| saptāhena daśāhena pakṣeṇa ca paraṃ kramāt| -----------------------------------------------|55|
Sa. sā ca lūtā tīkṣṇādibhedena triprakārā| upekṣitā ca satī yathāsaṅkhyaṃ daśāhena pakṣeṇa ca hanti|

-----------------------------------------------| lūtādaṃśaśca sarvo'pi dadrumaṇḍalasannibhaḥ||55|| sito'sito'ruṇaḥ pītaḥ śyāvo vā mṛdurunnataḥ| madhye kṛṣṇo'thavā śyāvaḥ paryante jālakāvṛtaḥ||56|| visarpavāṃschophayutastapyate bahuvedanaḥ| jvarāśupākavikledakothāvadaraṇānvitaḥ||57|| kledena yatspṛśatyaṅgaṃ tatrāpi kurute vraṇam| -----------------------------------------------|58|

Sa. sarvaśca lūtādaṃśo dadrumaṇḍalākāraḥ sitādivarṇo mṛdurunnato madhye kṛṣṇavarṇaḥ śyāvavarṇo vā parito jālakavṛto visarpādimān syāt| tathā tapyate'nekarujaḥ| tathā jvarādiyutaḥ| tathā ca daṃśaḥ kledena yadyadaṅgaṃ spṛśet tatra tatra ca vraṇaṃ vidadhāti|
-----------------------------------------------| śvāsadaṃṣṭrāśakṛnmūtraśukralālānakhārtavaiḥ||58|| aṣṭābhirudvamatyeṣā viṣaṃ vaktrādviśeṣataḥ| -----------------------------------------------|59|
Sa. śvāsādibhiraṣṭābhireṣā lūtā viṣamudvamati| vaktreṇa viśeṣeṇa|

-----------------------------------------------| lūtā nābherdaśatyūrdhvamūrdhvaṃ cādhaśca kīṭakāḥ||59|| taddūṣitaṃ ca vastrādi dehe pṛktaṃ vikārakṛt| -----------------------------------------------|60|
Sa. nābherūrdhvaṃ lūtā daśati| ūrdhvamadhastācca kīṭā daśanti| daśatīti "daṃśasañjasvañjāṃ śapi" iti nalopaḥ| tayā-lūtayā dūṣitaṃ, vastrāsanādi śarīre lagnaṃ vikārakṛt|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------| dinārdhaṃ lakṣyate naiva daṃśo lūtāviṣodbhavaḥ||60||
sūcīvyadhavadābhāti tato'sau prathame'hani| avyaktavarṇaḥ pracalaḥ kiñcitkaṇḍūrujānvitaḥ||61||

div.ab: Sa. lūtāviṣajo daṃśo dinārdhaṃ na lakṣyata eva| tataḥ-anantaraṃ, asau-daṃśaḥ, prathame dine sūcīvyadhatulya ābhāti| avyaktavarṇaḥ prakarṣeṇa calo manākkaṇḍūrugyutaśca|

ab.seg: dvitīye'bhyunnato'nteṣu piṭikairiva vā''citaḥ| vyaktavarṇo nato madhye kaṇḍūmān granthisannibhaḥ||62||

div.ab: Sa. dvītīye'hanyabhyunnato'nteṣu piṭikairiva vā''cito vyaktavarṇo madhye nataḥ sakaṇḍūrgranthinibhaḥ|

ab.seg: tṛtīye sajvaro romaharṣakṛdraktamaṇḍalaḥ| śarāvarūpastodāḍhyo romakūpeṣu sāsravaḥ||63||

div.ab: Sa. tṛtīye'hani jvarānvito romāñcakṛdraktamaṇḍalaḥ śarāvākāro'dhikavyatho romakūpeṣu srāvavān|
mahāṃścaturthe śvayathustāpaśvāsabhramapradaḥ| -----------------------------------------------|64|
Sa. caturthe vāsare mahāṃśchophastāpādikṛt|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------| vikārān kurute tāṃstān pañcame viṣakopajān||64||

div.ab: Sa. pañcame dine tāṃstān-pūrvoktān, viṣakopajān vikārān vidhatte|
Sa. ṣaṣṭhe dine marmāṇyaśnute|
Sa. saptame divase jīvitaṃ hanti|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------| iti tīkṣṇaṃ viṣaṃ, madhyaṃ hīnaṃ ca vibhajedataḥ||65||

div.ab: Sa. iti-evaṃrūpaṃ, tīkṣṇaṃ viṣam| madhyaṃ hīnaṃ vā'to nirūpya lakṣayet|
ekaviṃśatirātreṇa viṣaṃ śāmyati sarvathā| -----------------------------------------------|66|
Sa. saṃ-sarvathā ekaviṃśatirātreṇa viṣaṃ śamaṃ yāti|
-----------------------------------------------| athāśu lūtādaṣṭasya śastreṇādaṃśamuddharet||66|| dahecca jāmbavauṣṭhādyairna tu pittottaraṃ dahet| -----------------------------------------------|67|
Sa. saṃ-atheti maṅgale| kṛtamaṅgalasya lūtādaṣṭasya, ā-samantāt, daṃśaṃ kṣipraṃ śastreṇoddharet| jāmbvauṣṭhādibhiśca dahet, pittādhikaṃ varjayitvā|

-----------------------------------------------| karkaśaṃ bhinnaromāṇaṃ marmasandhyādisaṃśritam||67|| prasṛtaṃ sarvato daṃśaṃ na chindīta dahenna ca| -----------------------------------------------|68|
Sa. saṃ-karkaśādiguṇaṃ daṃśaṃ daṃśaṃ na chindyāt na ca dahet|
-----------------------------------------------| lepayeddagdhamagadairmadhusaindhavasaṃyutaiḥ||68|| suśītaiḥ secayeccānu kaṣāyaiḥ kṣīrivṛkṣajaiḥ| -----------------------------------------------|69|
Sa. dagdhaṃ daṃśamagadairmākṣikasaindhavānvitairlepayet| paścāt kṣīrivṛkṣajaiḥ kaṣāyairatiśiśiraiḥ secayecca|
-----------------------------------------------| sarvato'paharedraktaṃ śṛṅgādyaiḥ sirayā'pi vā||69|| sekalepāstataḥ śītā bodhiśleṣmātakākṣakaiḥ| -----------------------------------------------|70|
Sa. sarvato raktaṃ visrāvayecchṛṅgādibhiḥ| anantaraṃ sekālepāśca śiśirā hitāḥ pippalādibhiḥ|
-----------------------------------------------| phalinīdviniśākṣaudrasarpirbhiḥ padmakāhvayaḥ||70|| aśeṣalūtākīṭānāmagadaḥ sārvakārmikaḥ| -----------------------------------------------|71|
Sa. phalinyādiko'yaṃ padmakasaṃjño'gadaḥ sārvakārmikaḥ| aśeṣakriyāsu(?) lūtākīṭānāṃ hitaḥ|
-----------------------------------------------| haridrādvayapattaṅgamañjiṣṭhānatakesaraiḥ||71|| sakṣaudrasarpiḥ pūrvasmādadhikaścampakāhvayaḥ| -----------------------------------------------|72|
Sa. haridrādvayādibhiḥ kṣaudraghṛtānvitaścampakanāmā'gadaḥ pūrvasmādadhikaḥ|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------| tadvadgomayaniṣpīḍaśarkarāghṛtamākṣikaiḥ||72||

div.ab: Sa. gośakṛnnīṣpīḍādibhiragadastadvat-pūrvaguṇaḥ|

ab.seg: apāmārgamanohvāladārvīdhyāmakagairikaiḥ| natailākuṣṭhamaricayaṣṭyāhvaghṛtamākṣikaiḥ||73||
agado mandaro nāma tathā'nyo gandhamādanaḥ| natarodhravacākaṭvīpāṭhailāpatrakuṅkumaiḥ||74||

div.ab: Sa. apāmārgādibhiragado mandaro nāma| anyaśca-vakṣyamāṇo natādiḥ(dibhiḥ), gandhamādano nāma|
viṣaghnaṃ bahudoṣeṣu prayuñjīta viśodhanam| -----------------------------------------------|75|
Sa. bahudoṣeṣu nareṣu viṣaghnaṃ viśodhanaṃ prayuñjīta|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------| yaṣṭyāhvamadanāṅkollajālinīsinduvārikāḥ||75||
kaphe jyeṣṭhāmbunā pītvā viṣamāśu samudvamet| śirīṣapatratvaṅmūlaphalaṃ vā'ṅkollamūlavat||76||

div.ab: Sa. kaphe yaṣṭyāhvādīni tandulodakena pītvā viṣaṃ kṣipramudvamet| athavā śirīṣapatrādikamaṅkollamūlayutaṃ jyeṣṭhāmbhasā pītvodvamet|
virecayecca triphalānīlinītrivṛtādibhiḥ| -----------------------------------------------|77|
Sa. triphalādibhirvirecayecca|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------| nivṛtte dāhaśophādau karṇikāṃ pātayed vraṇāt||77||

div.ab: Sa. dāhādāvupaśānte sati vraṇāt karṇikāṃ pātayet|

kusumbhapuṣpaṃ godantaḥ svarṇakṣīrī kapotaviṭ| trivṛtā saindhavaṃ dantī karṇikāpātanaṃ, tathā||78|| mūlamuttaravāruṇyā vaṃśanirlekhasaṃyutam| tadvacca saindhavaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ dantīkaṭukadaugdhikam||79|| rājakośātakīmūlaṃ, kiṇvo vā mathitodbhavaḥ| -----------------------------------------------|80|
Sa. kusumbhakusumādikaṃ dantīparyantaṃ karṇikāyāḥ pātanaṃ varam| uttamāraṇīmūlaṃ vaṃśanirlekhanayuktaṃ vā| saindhavādikaṃ pūrvaguṇam| takrajo vā kiṇvaḥ-upariṣṭāt phenābhaḥ, pūrvaguṇaḥ|

ab.seg: -----------------------------------------------| karṇikāpātasamaye bṛṃhayecca viṣāpahaiḥ||80||

div.ab: Sa. karṇikāpātanakāle ca viṣaghnairbṛṃhayet|

ab.seg: snehakāryamaśeṣaṃ ca sarpiṣaiva samācaret| viṣasya vṛddhaye tailamagneriva tṛṇolupam||81||

div.ab: Sa. lūtāyāmaśeṣaṃ snehane yatkāryaṃ-kartuṃ yogyaṃ, tad ghṛtenaiva kuryāt| yatastailaṃ viṣasya vṛddhaye, tṛṇolupamiva vahneḥ|

ab.seg: hrīberavaikaṅkatagopakanyāmustāśamīcandanaṭiṇṭukāni| śaivālanīlotpalavakrayaṣṭītvaṅgākulīpadmakarāṭhamadhyam||82||
rajanīghanasarpalocanākaṇaśuṇṭhīkaṇamūlacitrakāḥ| varuṇāguruvilbapāṭalīpicumandāmayaśelukesaram||83||
bilvacandananatotpalaśuṇṭhīpippalīniculavetasakuṣṭham| śuktiśākavarapāṭalibhārgīsinduvārakaraghāṭavarāṅgam||84||
pittakaphānilalūtāḥ pānāñjananasyalepasekena| agadavarā vṛttasthāḥ kugatīriva vārayantyete||85||

div.ab: Sa. hrīberādikamindravajrāvṛttam| rajanyādikaṃ vailālīyaṃ vṛttam| bilvādikaṃ svāgatāvṛttam| ete trayogadavarā vṛttasthāḥ pittaśleṣmānilalūtāḥ kramāt pānādibhiḥ kugatīriva vārayanti| āryā|

rodhnaṃ sevyaṃ padmakaṃ padmareṇuḥ kālīyākhyaṃ candanaṃ yacca raktam| kāntāpuṣpaṃ dugdhinīkā mṛṇālaṃ lūtāḥ sarvā ghnanti sarvakriyābhiḥ|86| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne kīṭalūtādiviṣapratiṣedho nāma sapta triṃśo'dhyāyaḥ|37|

Sa. rodhrādīni sarvābhiḥ-pānādibhiḥ kriyābhiḥ, sarvā lūtā ghnanti| śālinī| iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayaṭīkāyāṃ sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭha uttarasthāne kīṭalūtādiviṣapratiṣedho nāma saptatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 37||

div.head: mūṣikālarkaviṣapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ
div.ab: Sa. viṣacikitsāprakramāt mūṣikālarkaviṣamupakramate-

ab.seg: athāto mūṣikālarkaviṣapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre||2||
) lālanaścapalaḥ putro hasiraścikkiro'jiraḥ| kaṣāyadantaḥ kulakaḥ kokilaḥ kapilo'sitaḥ||1||
aruṇaḥ śabalaḥ śvetaḥ kapotaḥ palitonduraḥ| chucchundaro rasālākhyo daśāṣṭau ceti mūṣikāḥ||2||

div.ab: Sa. lālanādibhedena daśāṣṭādhikā ityaṣṭādaśa mūṣikā bhavanti|

ab.seg: śukraṃ patati yatraiṣāṃ śukradigdhaiḥ spṛśanti vā| yadaṅgamaṅgaistatrāsre dūṣite pāṇḍutāṃ gate||3||
granthayaḥ śvayathuḥ koṭho maṇḍalāni bhramo'ruciḥ| śītajvaro'tiruksādo vepathuḥ parvabhedanam||4||
romaharṣaḥ srutirmūrcchā dīrghakālānubandhanam| śleṣmānubaddhabahvākhupotakacchardanaṃ satṛṭ||5||

div.ab: Sa. eṣāṃ mūṣikāṇāṃ yatra śukraṃ patati, śukradigdhairaṅgairvā yadaṅgaṃ spṛśanti, tasminnaṅge rakte dūṣite pāṇḍutvaṃ yāti sati granthyādayaḥ syuḥ| tathā tatprabhāvāt kaphānugatabahumūṣikapotakavamanaṃ satṛṭ syāt|
vyavāyyākhuviṣaṃ kṛcchraṃ bhūyo bhūyaśca kupyati| -----------------------------------------------|6|
Sa. ākhuviṣaṃ vyavāyi-sakalaśarīravyāpanaśīlaṃ, tathā kṛcchraṃ-kṛchrasādhyaṃ, punaḥ punaśca kupyati|
-----------------------------------------------| mūrcchāṅgaśophavaivarṇyakledaśabdāśrutijvarāḥ||6|| śirogurutvaṃ lālāsṛkchardiścāsādhyalakṣaṇam| -----------------------------------------------|7|
Sa. mūrcchādayo'sādhyalakṣaṇam|

-----------------------------------------------| śūnabastiṃ vivarṇauṣṭhamākhvābhairgranthibhiścitam||7|| chucchundarasagandhaṃ ca varjayedākhudūṣitam| -----------------------------------------------|8|
Sa. śūnabastiṃ vivarṇādharaṃ mūṣikanibhairgranthibhirvyāptaṃ chucchundaragandhatulyagandhaṃ ca mūṣikaviṣadūṣitaṃ nopakramet|

-----------------------------------------------| śunaḥ śleṣmolbaṇāṃ doṣāḥ saṃjñāṃ saṃjñāvahāśritāḥ||8|| muṣṇantaḥ kurvate kṣobhaṃ dhātūnāmatidāruṇam| lālāvānandhabadhiraḥ sarvataḥ so'bhidhāvati||9|| srustapucchahanuskandhaḥ śiroduḥkhī natānanaḥ| -----------------------------------------------|10|

Sa. śunaḥ-sārameyasya, śleṣmādhikā doṣāḥ saṃjñāvahāni srotāṃsyāśritāḥ saṃjñāmapaharanto dhātūnāmatighoraṃ kṣobhaṃ kurvanti| saḥ-śvā, lālāyuto'ndhabadhiro dhvastapucchahanuskandhaḥ śiro duḥkhī natamukhaḥ sarvato dhāvati|

-----------------------------------------------| daṃśastena vidaṣṭasya suptaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ kṣaratyasṛk||10|| hṛcchirorugjvarastambhatṛṣṇāmūrcchādbhavo'nu ca| -----------------------------------------------|11|
Sa. tena-śunā, vidaṣṭasya daṃśaḥ suptaḥ-acetanaḥ, kṛṣṇaṃ raktaṃ sravati| paścād hṛtpīḍādyudbhūtiḥ syāt|
-----------------------------------------------| anenānye'pi boddhavyā vyālā daṃṣṭrāprahāriṇaḥ||11|| śṛgālāśvatarāśvarkṣadvīpivyāghravṛkādayaḥ| -----------------------------------------------|12|
Sa. anena-daṃśādisvarūpeṇa, apare vyālāḥ-duṣṭāḥ, daṃṣṭrāprahāriṇaḥ śṛgālādaya evaṃ vedyāḥ|

-----------------------------------------------| kaṇḍūnistodavaivarṇyasuptikledajvarabhramāḥ||12|| viḍaharāgarukpākaśophagranthivikuñcanam| daṃśāvadaraṇaṃ sphoṭāḥ karṇikā maṇḍalāni ca||13|| sarvatra saviṣe liṅgaṃ, viparītaṃ tu nirviṣe| -----------------------------------------------|14|
Sa. sarvatraiva saviṣe daṃśe kaṇḍvādayo liṅgam| nirviṣe ca daṃśe'to viparītaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ vidyāt|
-----------------------------------------------| daṣṭo yena tu tacceṣṭārutaṃ kurvan vinaśyati||14|| paśyaṃstameva cākasmādādarśasalilādiṣu| -----------------------------------------------|15|
Sa. yena prāṇinā daṣṭastacceṣṭārutaṃ kurvan mriyate| tameva daṣṭāraṃ, ādarśakādiṣu sahasā paśyan vinaśyati|

-----------------------------------------------| yo'dbhyastrasyedadaṣṭo'pi śabdasaṃsparśadarśanaiḥ||15|| jalasantrāsanāmānaṃ daṣṭaṃ tamapi varjayet| -----------------------------------------------|16|
Sa. yo jalebhyo'daṣṭo'pi santrasyet śabdasaṃsparśadarśanairhetubhiḥ, taṃ jalasantrāsasaṃjñaṃ daṣṭaṃ varjayet|
-----------------------------------------------| ākhunā daṣṭamātrasya daṃśaṃ kāṇḍena dāhayet||16|| darpaṇonāthavā, tīvrarujā syātkarṇikā'nyathā| -----------------------------------------------|17|
Sa. ākhunā daṣṭamātrasya narasya sato daṃśaṃ kāṇḍena dāhayet| darpaṇena vā dāhayet| anyathā-evamadagdhe sati, karṇikā dāruṇapīḍā syāt|
