div.ab: Sa. tathā mārdvīkaṃ sajalajaṃ dayitāvadanamiva| parivādinī-vīṇā, madhurakvaṇanā vallabheva| puṣpanikararamaṇīyā śayyāpallavavatī kusumapradhānā lateva| puṣpitāgreti vṛttanāmaśleṣaḥ| deśa ityādi| ete padārthāḥ kāmasya kāmaṃ-icchāṃ pūrayanti, kāmamutpādayantītyarthaḥ| puṣpitāgrendravajre vṛtte|

ab.seg: adhunā'gryasaṅgrahamāha---- mustāparpaṭakaṃ jvare, tṛṣi jalaṃ mṛdbhṛṣṭaloṣṭodbhavaṃ, lājāśchardiṣu, bastijeṣu girijaṃ, meheṣu dhātrīniśe| pāṇḍau śreṣṭhamayo'bhayā'nilakaphe, plīhāmaye pippalī, sandhāne kṛmijā, viṣe śukatarurmedonile gugguluḥ||48||
vṛṣo'srapitte, kuṭajo'tisāre, bhallātako'rśaḥsu, gareṣu hema| sthūleṣu tārkṣyaṃ, krimiṣu kṛmighnaṃ, śoṣe surā cchāgapayo'tha māṃsam||49||
akṣyāmayeṣu triphalā, guḍūcī vātāsraroge, mathitaṃ grahaṇyām| kuṣṭheṣu sevyaḥ khadirasya sāraḥ, sarveṣu rogeṣu śilāhvayaṃ ca||50||
unmādaṃ ghṛtamanavaṃ śokaṃ madyaṃ, vyapasmṛtiṃ brahmī| nidrānāśaṃ kṣīraṃ jayati, rasālā pratiśyāyam||51||
māṃsaṃ kārśyaṃ, laśunaḥ prabhañjanaṃ, stabdhagātratāṃ svedaḥ| guḍamañjaryāḥ khapuro nasyāt skandhāṃsabāhurujam||52||
navanītakhaṇdamarditamauṣṭraṃ mūtraṃ payaśca hantyudaram| nasyaṃ mūrdhavikārān, vidradhimacirotthamasravisrāvaḥ||53||
nasyaṃ kavalo mukhajān, nasyāñjanatarpaṇāni netrarujaḥ| vṛddhatvaṃ kṣīraghṛte, mūrcchāṃ śītambumārutacchāyāḥ||54||
samaśuktārdrakamātrā mande vahnau, śrame surā snānam| duḥkhasahatve sthairye vyāyāmo, gokṣururhitaḥ kṛcchre||55||
kāse nidigdhikā, pārśvaśūle puṣkarajā jaṭā| vayasaḥ sthāpane dhātrī, triphalā guggulurvraṇe||56||
bastirvātavikārān, paittān rekaḥ, kaphodbhavān vamanam| kṣaudraṃ jayati balāsaṃ, sarpiḥ pittaṃ, samīraṇaṃ tailam||57||
ityagryaṃ yatproktaṃ rogāṇāmauṣadhaṃ śamāyālam| taddeśakālabalato vikalpanīyaṃ yathāyogam||58||

div.ab: Sa. mustāparpaṭakaṃ jvare śreṣṭhaṃ-rogopaśamanahetuḥ| evaṃ śeṣeṣvapi yojyam| sandhāne-uraḥsandhāne, kṛmijā-lākṣā, śreṣṭhā| śukataruḥ-śirīṣaḥ| śārdūlavikrīḍitaṃ vṛttam| vṛṣādayo raktapittādiṣu śreṣṭhāḥ| upajātiḥ| akṣyāmayādiṣu triphalādīni sevyāni| indravajrā| anavaṃ-purāṇaṃ, sarpiḥ kartṛbhūtamunmādaṃ jayati| vyapasmṛtiṃ-apasmāraṃ, brāhmī jayati| evaṃ kṣīrādayo nidrānāśādīn jayantītiyojyam| guḍamañjarī-kālā śālmalī, tasyāḥ khapuro-niryāso, nasyena skandhādijāṃ rujaṃ hanti| navanītayuktaṃ khaṇḍamarditam| auṣṭraṃ payo mūtraṃ ca jaṭharaṃ parākaroti| auṣṭramiti cintyam| uṣṭrādruñi prāpte kecittu tasyedamiti vivakṣayā aṇpratyayaḥ kārya ityāhuḥ| nasyādayo mūrdhavikārādīn jahatīti sambandhaḥ| nanu, vṛddhatvaṃ kṣīraghṛte hata ityanupapannam| tathāhi-"ekarasābhyāso daurbalyakarāṇām|" (ca. sū. a. 25) ityuktam| daurbalyakaraṇaṃ ca kathaṃ vṛddhatvahṛt syāt ? brūmaḥ| utsargatvāttasya vacasaḥ, apavādarūpaṃ tvidaṃ vacanam| tasmāt kṣīraghṛtādanyatraikarasābhyāsasya daurbalyakaraṇtvaṃ vedyam| gītayastisraḥ(pañca)| kāsetyādi| [ bastirityādi|] āryā| iti-uktena prakāreṇa, yacchreṣṭhamauṣadhamuktam, tad rogāṇāṃ śamāya-śāntyai, alaṃ-samartham| tacca-agnyaṃ, deśādīnāṃ balena yathāsvaṃ kalpanīyam| jaghanacapalā''ryā| etacca yathāsvaṃ cikitsiteṣu kathitaṃ saṅkṣepatayā punaḥ kathitam| śāstraṃ hi vyāsena samāsena ca vimatayo virundhate| tasmāt pūrvaṃ vyāsenopadeśaḥ, idaṃ(ayaṃ) tu samāsenetyavabudhyasva|

ab.seg: ityātreyādāgamayyārthasūtraṃ tatsūktānāṃ peśalānāmatṛptaḥ| bheḍādīnāṃ sammato bhaktinamraḥ papracchedaṃ saṃśayāno'gniveśaḥ||59||

div.ab: Sa. saṃ-ātreyāt-bhagavataḥ punarvasoḥ, iti-uktena prakāreṇa, arthasūtraṃ-abhidheyatattvaṃ ca, āgamayya-avabudhya, agniveśaḥ saṃśayāno-na tu śāstrāvabodhāhaṃkṛtaḥ, idaṃ-vakṣyamāṇaṃ, papraccha| kimbhūtaḥ ? tasya-ātreyasya muneḥ, sūktāni-subhāṣitāni, yuktiyuktārthapratipādanātteṣāṃ sūktānāṃ madhurāṇāmatṛptaḥsākāṅkṣaḥ| tathā ca kimbhūtaḥ ? bheḍajātūkarṇyādīnāṃ punarvasuśiṣyāṇāṃ sammataḥ| tathā bhaktinamro-na tu jñānoddhataḥ san, sa papraccha| śālinīvṛttam|

ab.seg: kiṃ pṛṣṭavān ? ityāha---- dṛśyante bhagavan kecidātmavanto'pi rogiṇaḥ| dravyopasthātṛsampannā vṛddhavaidyamatānugāḥ||60||
kṣīyamāṇāmayaprāṇā viparītāstathā'pare| hitāhitavibhāgasya phalaṃ tasmādaniścitam||61||
kiṃ śāsti śāstramasmin iti kalpayato'gniveśamukhyasya| śiṣyagaṇasya punarvasu- rācakhyau kārtsnyatastattvam||62||

div.ab: Sa. saṃ-bhagavan-punarvaso, kecinnarā ātmavanto hitāhāravihārā api rogiṇaḥ pratyakṣānumānādyairupalabhyante| ātmavanto'pītyapiśabdādanātmavanto'pi| kadācit śeṣapādatrayavikalatvena rogitvaṃ syāt, netyāha-dravyopasthātṛsampannā vṛddhavaidyamatānugā iti| tathā''mayāśca prāṇāścāmayaprāṇāḥ, kṣīyamāṇā āmayaprāṇā yeṣāṃ ta evam, kecidrogādvimucyamānāḥ kecicca mriyamāṇā ityarthaḥ| viparītāstathā'para iti anātmavanto dravyopasthātṛvikalā vṛddhavaidyamatānanusāriṇaścaivaṃbhāvā dṛśyante| tasmāt-anantaroktātkāraṇāt, hitāhitavibhāgasya tantroktaṃ phalamaniścitaṃ-anaikāntikam| aniścitaphalatvācca kāraṇāt śāstraṃ-āyurvedākhyaṃ, kiṃ śāsti ? na-kiñcicchikṣayatīti| ataścaitadārambho niṣphalaḥ kākadantaparīkṣāśāstravat| iti vikalpayataḥ śiṣyagaṇasya-jātūkarṇyabheḍādeḥ, bhagavān punarvasustattvaṃ-paramārthaṃ, kārtsnyena-sāmastyena, jagāda| kimbhūtasya śiṣyagaṇasya ? agniveśo mukhyaḥ-pradhāno, yasya tasyeti|

ab.seg: kiṃ taduktavān? ityāha---- na cikitsā'cikitsā ca tulyā bhavitumarhati| vinā'pi kriyayā svāsthyaṃ gacchatāṃ ṣoḍaśāṃśayā||63||

div.ab: Sa. cikitsā-catuṣpātṣoḍaśaguṇayuktā, acikitsā-hitāhitavibhāgāparāmarśe yatkiñcanakāritā, sā tulyā bhavituṃ nārhati| keṣām ? kriyāṃ vinā svāsthyamapi gacchatām| apiśabdo bhinnakramaḥ, svāsthyamapī'tyato'nantaraṃ draṣṭavyaḥ| kimbhūtayā kriyayā ? ṣoḍaśāṃśayā| tadayaṃ bhāvaḥ,-ṣoḍaśa bhāgayā cikitsayā vinā yatra rogopaśāntiḥ syāt, tatrāpi cikitsayā kṣiprataraṃ tatsādhanaṃ cikitsā viśiṣṭā| tathā cikitsāsādhyānāṃ rohiṇikādīnāṃ cikitsāmantareṇa śāntirnāsti| tadevamapi cikitsayā tulyā'cikitsā na bhavitumarhatīti|

ab.seg: ātaṅkapaṅkamagnānāṃ hastālambo bhiṣagjitam| jīvitaṃ mriyamāṇānāṃ sarveṣāmeva nauṣadhāt||64||

div.ab: Sa. tasmādātaṅka eva paṅko duruttaratvāttasmin magnānāṃ taptānāṃ, bhiṣagjitaṃ-tadupadeśakaśāstraṃ, upacārādevamuktam| tadbhiṣagjitaṃ hastālambo-hastālambatulyam| mriyamāṇānāṃ sarveṣāmevāsādhyānāmapi bheṣajājjīvitaṃ na ca bhavati|

ab.seg: na hyupāyamapekṣante sarve rogā, na cānyathā| upāyasādhyāḥ sidhyanti,nāheturhetumān yataḥ||65||

div.ab: Sa. yasmāt sarve rogāḥ-asādhyā api, upāyaṃ-catuṣpādalakṣaṇaṃ cikitsitaṃ, nāpekṣante, asādhyarogāṇāṃ cikitsānirapekṣatvāt| ye copāyasādhyā rogāḥ-rohiṇyādayaḥ, te'nyathā cikitsāmantareṇa, naiva sidhyanti| yato yo'hetuḥ sa hetumānna bhavati| api tu niryuktika evāyaṃ hetuvādaḥ, yaccikitsākhyena hetunā vinaiva rogopaśāntirddaśya iti|

ab.seg: yaduktaṃ sarvasampattiyuktayā'pi cikitsayā| mṛtyurbhavati, tannaivaṃ nopāye'styanupāyatā||66||

div.ab: Sa. yattūktaṃ sarvasampattiyuktayā'pi cikitsayā mṛtyurbhavati| dṛśyante bhagavan kecidātmavanto'pi rogiṇaḥ| yāvatkṣīyamāṇāmayaprāṇāḥ ityādi| tadevaṃ na bhavati, yathā tvaṃ vadasi| yasmānna upāye'nupāyatā'sti| yo hi yasya yayā yuktyopāyaḥ prathitaḥ, sa na kadācittasyānupāyaḥ| yathā,-ghaṭasya mṛddaṇḍacakrādisāmagrīviśeṣo na kadācidanupāyo bhaviturmahati| tasmāccatuṣpāccikitsāsādhyasya rogasyopāya eva cikitsā, na tvanupāyaḥ|

ab.seg: api copāyayuktasya dhīmato jātucit kriyā| na sidhyeddaivavaiguṇyānna tviyaṃ ṣoḍaśātmikā||67||

div.ab: Sa. dhīmataḥ-prājñasya narasya, upāyayuktasyāpi daivāparādhāt iyaṃ ṣoḍaśātmikā kriyā kadācinna sidhyati| ta(ya)smādāyuḥ parīkṣya sādhyāsādhyavibhāgjño jñānapūrvaṃ cikitsāyāṃ vaidyaḥ pravartate tasmāddaivavaiguṇyam| vimalavipulamatyā samyak paricchedāccikitsāyā rogaviṣaye pravṛttāyāḥ siddhireva syānnāsiddhiḥ| yasmādyo yatropāyaḥ, sa tatrānupāyo na bhavati| muninā'pyuktam (ca.sū. a. 10/7)-"sādhyāsādhyavībhāgajño jñānapūrvaṃ cikitsakaḥ| kāle cārabhate karma yattatsādhayati dhruvam||" iti|

ab.seg: etadeva pratipādayannāha---- kasyāsiddho'gnitoyādiḥ svedastambhādikarmaṇi| na prīṇanaṃ karṣaṇaṃ vā kasya kṣīraṃ gavedhukam||68||
kasya māṣātmaguptādau vṛṣyatve nāsti niścayaḥ| viṇmūtrakaraṇākṣepau kasya saṃśayitau yave||69||
viṣaṃ kasya jarāṃ yāti mantratantravivarjitam| kaḥ prāptaḥ kalyatāṃ pathyādṛte rohiṇikādiṣu||70||

div.ab: Sa. kasya puruṣasya vahniḥ svedakarmaṇi, stambhanakarmaṇi ca toyaṃ, na siddham| ādiśabdānmūrcchāpagamādau śītānilādiḥ| api tu sarvasyaiva siddho'nvayavyatirekāt| evaṃ yāvadrohiṇikādiṣviti vyākhyeyam| evaṃ niścitaphalā cikitseti sthitam|

ab.seg: api cākālamaraṇaṃ sarvasiddhāntaniścitam| mahatā'pi prayatnena vāryatāṃ kathamanyathā||71||

div.ab: Sa. na kevalaṃ pūrvoktāddhetościkitsātantraṃ saphalam| yataścākālamaraṇaṃ sarvasiddhāntaniścitam| tadanyathā-cikitsāśāstramantareṇa, parameṇāpi yatnena kathaṃ-kena prakāreṇa, nirvāyatām ? na kenacidityarthaḥ|

ab.seg: na cākālamṛtyurakṣaiva prayojanamasya tantrasyetyāha---- candanādyapi dāhādau rūḍhamāgamapūrvakam| śāstrādeva gataṃ siddhiṃ jvare laṅghanabṛṃhaṇam||72||

div.ab: Sa. dāhādau viṣaye candanādi cāgamapūrvakameva lokarūḍham, na tvevameva| tathā śāstrādeva-cikitsākhyāt, sakalalokaprasiddhaṃ jvare laṅghanabṛṃhaṇaṃ bhaktacchedakṣīrādi siddhimupagatam, nānyasmāt|

ab.seg: catuṣpādguṇasampanne samyagālocya yojite| mā kṛthā vyādhinirghātaṃ vicikitsāṃ cikitsite||73||

div.ab: Sa. tasmāccatuṣpādā[nāṃ] ye guṇāḥ-āyuṣkamīyoktāḥ (hṛ.sū.a. 1/27), taiḥ sampanne-yukte, tathā suṣṭhu nirūpya deśakālādīn yojite cikitsite, vyādhinirghātaṃ prati vicikitsāṃ-saṃśayaṃ, mā kṛthāḥ|

ab.seg: etaddhi mṛtyupāśānāmakāṇḍe chedanaṃ dṛḍham| rogontrāsitabhītānāṃ rakṣāsūtramasūtrakam||74||

div.ab: Sa. yataścākāṇḍe-akāle, mṛtyupāśāḥ-jvarādayasteṣāṃ etat-cikitsāśāstraṃ, dṛḍhaṃ-sāraṃ, chedanam| tathā samutpannebhyo jvarādibhyastrastānāṃ śaṅkayā bhītānāṃ sūtrarahitaṃ rakṣāsūtrakaṃ, tatkāryakaraṇādityarthaḥ| tasmādadhyetavyaṃ cikitsāśāstram|

ab.seg: etattadamṛtaṃ sākṣājjagadāyāsavarjitam| yāti hālāhalatvaṃ tu sadyo durbhājanasthitam||75||

div.ab: Sa. tathaitat-cikitsāśāstraṃ, tat-sakalalokaprasiddhaṃ, sākṣāt-svarūpeṇa, amṛtaṃ mṛtyujaye, ta(ya)t lokaprasiddhaṃ jagataḥ surāsurarūpasya, āyāsādutpannaṃ kṣīrodamathanakāle, tena varjitamidam| amṛtamapi durbhājanasthitaṃ sadyaḥ-śīghrameva, viṣatvaṃ yāti|

ab.seg: tadeva durbhājanaṃ darśayati---- ajñātaśāstrasadbhāvān śāstramātraparāyaṇān| tyajeddūrād bhiṣakpāśān pāśān vaivasvatāniva||76||

div.ab: Sa. ajñātaḥ śāstrasadbhāvaḥ-paramārtho, yaistāṃstathāvidhān bhiṣakpāśān dūratastyajet| tathā śāstramātraparāyaṇān-śāstrapāṭhamātraśaraṇān| ata eva viṣasāmānyataḥ śāstrapāṭhamātratvena niṣiddham| tathā śāstraparamārthānavabodhācca viṣatvam| kāniva ? vaivasvātān-yamasambandhinaḥ, pāśān yathā| iti tāvadasampūrṇān|

ab.seg: samyagbhiṣajaḥ ślāghamāno brūte ---- bhiṣajāṃ sādhuvṛttānāṃ bhadramāgamaśālinām| abhyastakarmaṇāṃ bhadraṃ bhadraṃ bhadrābhilāṣiṇām||77||

div.ab: Sa. suvaidyānāṃ saccaritānāmiha loke'nyatra ca sadaiva bhadram| kiṃvidhānām ? āgamena-granthato'rthataḥ, ślāghituṃ śīlaṃ yeṣāṃ teṣām| īdṛśā apyanabhyastakarmāṇo na ślāghārhāḥ syurityāha, abhyastaṃ-asakṛttailalehādipākādyanuvāsananirūhādiyojanaṃ ca, [karma] yaisteṣāṃ lokadvaye'pi bhadram| sarvasattvānāṃ putramitrādirūpeṇa bhadramiva hitaṃ sukhaṃ cābhilaṣanti-icchanti ye, teṣāmapi bhadraṃ-śastam|

ab.seg: iti tantraguṇairyuktaṃ tantradoṣairvivarjitam| cikitsāśāstramakhilaṃ vyāpya yat paritaḥ sthitam||78||
vipulāmalavijñānamahāmunimatānugam| mahāsāgaragambhīrasaṅgrahārthopalakṣaṇam||79||
aṣṭāṅgavaidyakamahodadhimanthanena yo'ṣṭāṅgasaṅgrahamahāmṛtarāśirāptaḥ| tasmādanalpaphalamalpasamudyamānāṃ prītyarthametaduditaṃ pṛthageva tantram||80||

div.ab: Sa. tantryate-dhāryate śarīramaneneti tantram, tasya guṇāstantraguṇāḥ,-yaistantramalaṅkriyate tantrayuktyādayaḥ, tairevazṃprakārairyuktam| tathā coktaṃ saṅgrahe (u. a.50)-"alaṅkṛtaṃ yuktipadaiḥ sadratnairiva kāñcanam| ṣaṭtriṃśatā'rthadurgeṣu bhiṣajāṃ saṅkramairiva|| tatrādhikaraṇaṃ yogo hetvartho'rthaḥ padasya ca| pradeśoddeśanirdeśavākyaśeṣāḥ prayojanam|| upadeśāpadeśātideśārthāpattinirṇayāḥ| prasaṅgaikāntanaikāntāḥ sāpavargo viparyayaḥ|| pūrvapakṣavidhānānumatavyākhyānasaṃśayāḥ| atītānāgatāpekṣāsvasaṃjñohyasamuccayāḥ|| nidarśanaṃ nirvacanaṃ niyogo'tha vikalpanam| pratyutsārastathoddhāraḥ sambhavastantrayuktayaḥ||" iti| tatra 1 adhikaraṇaṃ nāma,-yadadhikṛtya pravartate śāstraṃ sthānamadhyāyaḥ prakaraṇaṃ vākyaṃ vā| tatra śāstrādhikaraṇaṃ-yadadhikṛtya śāstraṃ pravartate| yathā-aṣṭāvaṅgānyadhikṛtya hṛdayākhyaṃ sarvaṃ śāstraṃ pravṛttam| yathoktam (hṛ.sū. a. 1/5)-"kāyabāla" ityādi| sthānādhikaraṇaṃ yathā (hṛ.sū.a. 30/53)-"atrārthāḥ sūtritāḥ sūkṣmāḥ pratanyante hi sarvataḥ|" iti| adhyāyo'pi yadadhikṛtya pravartate tadadhyāyādhikaraṇaṃ| yathā (hṛ. sū. a . 2)_"athāto dinacaryādhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ|" iti| prakaraṇaṃ yadadhikṛtya pravartate tat prakaraṇādhikaraṇam| yathā (hṛ.śā. a.3/18)-"daśa mūlasirā hṛtsthāstāḥ sarvaṃ sarvato vapuḥ|" ityādi yāvat "ityavedhyavibhāgārthaṃ pratyaṅgaṃ varṇitāḥ sirāḥ|" ityādi| evaṃ vākyamapi yadadhikṛtya pravartate tadvākyādhikaraṇaṃ vedyam| 2 yogo nāma,-yojanā, uddeśanirdeśayoḥ sūtrabhāṣyaryorvā| yathā (hṛ.śā. a.3)-"athāto'ṅgavibhāgaṃ śārīraṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ|" ityuddiśyāṅgāni vibhajate-"śiro'ntarādhirdvau bāhū sakthinī ca samāsataḥ| ṣaḍaṅgam" ityādi| yuktirvā yogaḥ, pratijñā heturdṛṣṭānta upanayo nigamanamiti pañcavidhaḥ| yathā-agniḥ śarīrasthitermūlamiti pratijñā| agnipakvāhāre sati tastthiteriti hetuḥ, "tatrāgnirheturāhārānna hyapakvādrasādayaḥ|" (hṛ.śā. a.3/54) iti vacanāt| yathā-śālyaṅkurasya bījamiti dṛṣṭāntaḥ| upanayo yathā-cikitsāśāstrasya prayojanatvasādhanāya bahudhā dṛṣṭāntopanayaṃ kṛtavāṃstantrakṛt, "kasyāsiddho'gnitoyādiḥ" (hṛ.u. a.40/68) ityādayaḥ| tasmāt saprayojanameva cikitsāśāstraṃ pratyakṣaphalatvādityupanayaḥ| tasmādārambhaṇīyamiti pramāṇapadopadarśanamukhena nigamanam| yathoktam(hṛ.u. a. 40/73)-catuṣpādguṇasampanne samyagālocya yojite| mā kṛthā vyādhinirghātaṃ vicikitsāṃ cikitsite||" sādhyavyādhicikitsāyāṃ saṃśayānupapattyā pratipāditayā pramāṇaphalopasaṃhārakaraṇam| 3 hetvartho nāma,-yadanyaprastāvoktamanyatrāpi tathaivopapadyate| yathā (hṛ. śā. a.3/20)-"tatraikaikaṃ ca śākhāyāṃ śataṃ tasminna vedhayet| sirāṃ jālandharāṃ nāma tisraścābhyantarāśritāḥ||" ityādi| tathā (hṛ.śā.a.3/34)-"avedhyāḥ saṅkīrṇā grathitāḥ kṣudrāḥ ityādi| tadetebhyo viśeṣavacanebhyo'numīyate śeṣā vedhyā iti| anyathaitāni vacāṃsi nirarthakāni syuriti|

Sa. 4 padārtho nāma,-padenārtho gamyate| yathā-dravyamiti padam, tasyārtho bhūjalādiḥ| guṇa iti padam, tasyārtho gurvādiḥ| 5 pradeśo nāma,-yeṣāmarthānāmatibahutvāt sākalyenābhidhānasyāśakyatvāt stokamucyate| yathoktam (hṛ.sū.a.5/84)-"iti dravaikadeśo'yaṃ yathāsthūlamudāhṛtaḥ|" iti|
Sa. 6 uddeśo nāma,-saṅkṣepābhidhānam| yathā (hṛ. sū. a. 1/6)-"vāyuḥ pittaṃ kaphaśceti trayo doṣāḥ samāsataḥ| ityādi|
Sa. 7 nirdeśo nāma,-tasyaiva vistāroktiḥ| yathoktam (hṛ.sū. a. 1/11)-"tatra rūkṣo laghuḥ śītaḥ kharaḥ sūkṣmaścalo'nilaḥ|" iti|

Sa. 8 vākyaśeṣo nāma,-yasmin sūtre lāghavikenārthādgamya mānamanuktapūraṇārthamadhyāhriyate| yathā (hṛ.śā. a.3/3)-"tatra khāt khāni dehe'smin" 'bhavanti' iti vākyaśeṣaḥ| "āpyā jihvārasakaledāḥ" (hṛ.śā. a.3/4) ityuttaratra bhavārthe taddhitaśravaṇāt|
Sa. 9 prayojanaṃ nāma,-yadarthaṃ śāstrādi pravartate| yathā (hṛ.u. a. 40/64)-"ātaṅkapaṅkamagnānāṃ hastālambo bhiṣagjitam|" iti| anena prayojanena cikitsāśāstramadhyeyamityādi|

Sa. 10 upadeśo nāma,-āptavacanam| yathā(hṛ.sū. a.17/29)-"snehaklinnāḥ koṣṭhagā dhātugā vā srotolīnā ye ca śākhāsthisaṃsthāḥ| doṣāḥ svedaiste dravīkṛtya koṣṭhaṃ nītāḥ samyakśuddhibhVirnirhriyante||" ityādi|

Sa. 11 apadeśo nāma,-yadācāryaḥ kiñcidarthaṃ pratijñāya hetumupadiśati| yathā (hṛ.u. a.40/64)-"jīvitaṃ mriyamāṇānāṃ sarveṣāmeva nauṣadhāt|" iti pratijñāya hetumāha(hṛ.u. a. 40/64)-"na hyapāyayapekṣante sarve rogāḥ" sarvarogāṇāmupāyāpekṣābhāvāt|

Sa. 12 atideśo nāma,-yat kiñcidevārthajātamuktvā'nuktārthasādhanāya evamanyadapi pratyetavyamiti paribhāṣāyāṃ sthāpayati| yathoktaṃ karṇarogapratiṣedhe (hṛ.u. a. 18/4)-"mahataḥ pañcamūlasya kāṣṭhāt kṣaumeṇa veṣṭitāt| tailasiktātpradīptāgrāt snehaḥ sadyo rujāpahaḥ|| yojyaścaivaṃ bhadrakāṣṭhāt kuṣṭhāt kāṣṭhācca sāralāt|" ityādi|

Sa. 13 arthāpattirnāma,-yo'nyenārthenoktena tato'paro'pyartho gadita iva jñāyate| yathā (hṛ.sū. a.5/31)-"naivādyānniśi naivoṣṇam" ityuktam, na tūktaṃ divā bhuñjīteti| etaccārthāpattyā gamyate| [nanu,] kaḥ punararthaḥ ? kā cāsyāpattiḥ ? brūmaḥ| dadhyabhyavahāro'rthastatra tantrakṛtā 'naivādyānniśi' iti kālo niṣiddho na tu dadhibhakṣaṇam| tato yo'yamapratiṣiddho'rthaḥ, saāpadyate divā dadhibhojanārthaḥ, rātripratiṣedhe dinavyatirekeṇa kālāntarābhāvāt| sarvathā anabhyavaharaṇīyasyāhāraprastāve pratiṣedhānupapatteḥ| evamanyatrāpi vyākhyeyam|

Sa. 14 nirṇayo nāma,-yannivāritasyārthasya pratiṣṭhāpanam| yathā(hṛ.u. a.40/60)-"dṛśyante bhagavan kecidātmavanto'pi rogiṇaḥ|" ityādinā cikitsāśāstraphalaṃ prati saṃśayakaraṇe paścānnirṇayārthamuktam| yathā (hṛ.u. a.40/63)-"na cikitsā'cikitsā ca tulyā bhavitumarhati|" ityādi|

Sa. 15 prasaṅgo nāma,-pūrvābhihitasyārthasya kenacit sambandhāntareṇa punarabhidhānam| yathoktaṃ sirāvyadhavidhau (hṛ.sū. a. 27/2)-"lohitaṃ pravadecchuddhaṃ tanostenaiva ca sthitiḥ|" ityuktvā punaḥ śārīre śuddhārtavaprasaṅgenoktam (hṛ. śā. a.1/1)-"śuddhe śukrārtave sattvaḥ svakarmakleśacoditaḥ| garbhaḥ sampadyate yuktivaśādagnirivāraṇau||" iti| na ca punaruktatā tasya| yasmāt sirāvyadhe śarīraprabhavatvameva raktasyoktam, na tu kramo varṇitaḥ| śārīre tu yayā''nupūrvyā śarīrahetuḥ syāt tadvistareṇoktam| yathā(hṛ.śā. a.1/2)-"bījātmakairmahābhūtaiḥ sūkṣmaiḥ sattvānugaiśca saḥ| mātuścāhārarasajaiḥ kramāt kukṣau vivardhate||" iti|
Sa. 16 ekānto nāma,-ya ekameva pakṣamavyabhicāreṇa śrayati nānyam| tadyathā (hṛ.sū. a. 4/31)-"ye bhūtaviṣavāyvagnikṣatabhaṅgādisambhavāḥ| rogadveṣabhayādyāśca te syurāgantavo gadāḥ||" iti|
Sa. 17 naikānto nāma,-anyatarapakṣānavadhāraṇāt| yathā (hṛ.su. a.40/64)-"jīvitaṃ mriyamāṇānāṃ sarveṣāmeva nauṣadhāt|" ekāntena (hṛ.u. a. 40/64)-"na hyupā yamapekṣante sarve rogāḥ" ityādi|

Sa. 18 apavargo nāma,-sākalyenotsṛṣṭasya yatpunastadekadeśāpakarṣaṇam| yathā (hṛ.sū. a.27/4)-"śītoṣṇasnigdharūkṣādyairupakrāntāśca ye gadāḥ| samyak sādhyā na sidhyanti te ca raktaprakopajāḥ|| teṣu srāvayituṃ raktamudriktaṃ vyadhayetsirām|" ityutsargamabhidhāya ekadeśe'pavādaṃ vakti (hṛ.sū. a. 27/6)-"na tūnaṣoḍaśātītasaptatyabdasrutāsṛjām|" ityādi|

Sa. 19 viparyayo nāma,-yathopadiṣṭaviparyayeṇa lakṣaṇādikaraṇam| yathoktam (hṛ.sū. a.16/30)-"vātānulomyaṃ dīpto'gnirvarcaḥ snigdhamasaṃhatam| snehodvegaḥ klamaḥ samyak snigdhe, rūkṣe viparyayaḥ||" iti|

Sa. 20 pūrvapakṣo nāma,-pratijñātārthasaṃdūṣaṇaṃ vākyam| yathā hitāhitavibhāgaṃ pratyācikhyāsannāha| yathā (hṛ.u. a.40/60)-"dṛśyante bhagavan kecit" ityārabhya yāvat "hitāhitavibhāgasya phalaṃ tasmādaniścitam|" ityādi|
Sa. 21 vidhānaṃ nāma,-yatprakaraṇānupūrvaṃ vidhānamāvekṣyate|
Sa. 22 anumataṃ nāma,(hṛ.sū. a.9-10)-"uṣṇaṃ śītaṃ dvidhaivānye vīryamācakṣate'pi ca| nānātmakamapi dravyamagnīṣomau mahābalau||" ityādinā hyanumatam, na vighātaḥ kṛtaḥ|

Sa. 23 vyākhyānaṃ nāma,-yanmādṛśebhyo viśiṣṭatarabuddhigamyam| yathā (hṛ.śā. a. 1/37)-"saptahāt kalalībhavet|" (hṛ.śā. a. 1/49)-"dvitīye māsi kalalāt ghanaḥ peśyathavārbudam| puṃstrīklībāḥ kramāt" iti| na hyatra garbhasyāvartamānā bhāvāḥ śakyā vijñātuṃ yogidṛṣṭiṃ muktvā|
Sa. 24 saṃśayo nāma,-sākāṅkṣatvamaniścitavastuvijñānam| yathā (hṛ. śā. a. 5/128)-"saṃśayaṃ prāptamātrayo jīvitaṃ tasya manyate|" ityādi|

Sa. 25 atītāpekṣaṇaṃ nāma,-yadatikrāntamapekṣya prastutasya sādhanamucyate| yathoktaṃ hṛdrogacikitsite (hṛ.ci. a.6/39)-"rāsnājīvaka" ityādi yāvat "mahāsnehaṃ vipācayet||" iti| atra ca na jñāyate katamo māhāsneha iti| tadetadatikrāntamapekṣya prasādhyate snehavidhyuktam| yathā (hṛ.sū. a. 16/4)-"dvābhyāṃ tribhiścaturbhistairyamakastrivṛto mahān|" ityapekṣya vyākhyāyate|

Sa. 26 [anāgatāpekṣā nāma,-] ............................ 27 svasaṃjñā nāma,-yā tantrakāraiḥ svatantrasaṃvyavahārārthaṃ praṇitā satī paratantreṣu na vyavaharati| yathā (hṛ.sū. a.12/44)-"śākhā raktādayastvak ca" iti|

Sa. 28 ūhyaṃ nāma,-yadapratibaddhaṃ granthe svayaṃ prajñayā tarkayitvā yojyam| yathoktam (hṛ.sū. a.15/46)-"trayastriṃśaditi proktā vargāsteṣu tvalābhataḥ| yuñjyāttadvidhamanyacca dravyaṃ jahyādayaugikam||' [iti|]

Sa. 29 samuccayo nāma,-yathā(hṛ.sū. a.18/29)-"peyāṃ vilepīmakṛtaṃ kṛtaṃ ca yūṣaṃ rasaṃ" ca samuccinoti, tathā-"trīnubhayaṃ tathaikam| krameṇa seveta naro'nnakālān pradhānamadhyāvaraśuddhiśuddhaḥ||" iti|

Sa. 30 nidarśanaṃ nāma,-yannidarśayitavyaṃ sūkṣmamapyarthaṃ svadharmasādṛśyāt spaṣṭīkarotyādarśa iva mukhavidhum| yathoktam (hṛ.sū. a.19/84)-"yathā kusumbhādiyutāttoyādrāgaṃ haretpaṭaḥ| tathā dravīkṛtāddehādbastirnirharate malān||" ityādi|

Sa. 31 nirvacanaṃ nāma,-nirṇayārthaṃ vacanaṃ niruktam| yathoktaṃ viṣavidhāne (hṛ.u. a.35/1)-"mathyamāne jalanidhāvamṛtārthaṃ surāsuraiḥ|" yāvat "jagadviṣaṇṇaṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvā tenāsau viṣasaṃjñitaḥ||" iti| viṣasya nirvacanaṃ jagadviṣadanādviṣamiti|
Sa. 32 niyogo nāma,-yo yasyānuṣṭheyaḥ| yathā (hṛ.sū. a. 16/26)-"uṣṇodakopacārī syāt" ityādi|
Sa. 33 vikalpo nāma,-vividhaṃ kalpanam, idaṃ kāryamidaṃ vā kāryam| yathoktaṃ pūrvarūpadarśane jvarādau [vā] hitaṃ laghvaśanamapatarpaṇaṃ vā|

Sa. 34 pratyutsāro nāma,-yatropapattiṃ darśayantaḥ parasparamatāni nivārayanti| tadyathā (hṛ.śā. a.3/16)-"asthnāṃ śatāni ṣaṣṭhiśca trīṇi dantanakhaiḥ saha| dhanvantaristu trīṇyāha, sandhīnāṃ ca śatadvayam|| daśottaraṃ, sahasre dve nijagādātrinandanaḥ|" iti pūrvamatāt ṣaṣṭiṃ prayutsārayati| dhanvantarerapi mataṃ daśottaraṃ sandhiśatadvayamiti punarvasuḥ pratyutsārayati sandhisahasradvayaṃ sādhayan|

Sa. 35 uddāro nāma,-śāstrārambhapratyākhyānādicodyasya samādhānam| tadyathā (hṛ.u. a.40/60)-"dṛśyante bhagavan kecidātmavanto'pi rogiṇaḥ|" yāvat "hitāhitavibhāgasya phalaṃ tasmādaniścitam|" iti kṛte codye (hṛ.u. a.40/63)-"na cikitsā'cikitsā ca tulyā bhavitumarhati|" iti parihāraḥ|

Sa. 36 sambhavo nāma,-upapattiryasminnupapadyate anupadiṣṭe| yathā (hṛ.sū. a.26/47)-"duṣṭaraktāpagamanāt sadyo rāgarujāṃ śamaḥ|" ityuktam| pracchānālābujalaukāśṛṅgasirāvyadhairyathāsambhavaṃ raktamapanīyate| yathoktam (hṛ.sū. a.26/53)-"pracchānenaikadeśasthaṃ grathitaṃ jalajanmabhiḥ| harecchṛṅgādibhiḥ suptamasṛgvyāpi sirāvyadhaiḥ||" iti| evamanyatrāpi sambhavārtho yojyaḥ|

Sa. vyākhyā api tantrasya guṇaḥ| tābhirapi tantramalaṅkriyate| tāśca pañcadaśaprakārāḥ| tadyathā,-piṇḍapadapadārthādhikaraṇaprakaraṇārthakṛcchraphaloccitakanyāsaprayojanānulomapratilomātisūtrasamastavyākhyāḥ|

Sa. tatra 1 piṇḍavyākhyā nāma,-saṅkṣepatayā sūtrarūpeṇādhyāyādināṃ vyākhyā| yathā (hṛ.śā. a. 5/4)-"rūpendriyasvaracchayāpraticchāyākriyādiṣu| anyeṣvapi ca bhāveṣu prākṛteṣvanimittataḥ|| vikṛtiryā samāsena riṣṭaṃ taditi lakṣayet|" ityanena sūtreṇa sakalariṣṭādhyāyasamāsa uktaḥ|
Sa. 2 padavyākhyā nāma,-yatpadānāṃ chedaṃ kṛtvoccāraṇam| yathā (hṛ.sū. a. 1)-"atha ataḥ āyuṣkāmīyaṃ adhyāyaṃ vi ā khyāsyāmaḥ|" iti saptapadaṃ sūtraṃ pūrvaṃ vyākhyātam|
Sa. 3 padāRthavyākhyā nāma,-teṣāmeva padānāṃ vivaraṇam| yathā-athaśabda ānantarye adhikāre vā, ataḥśabdo hetā vityādi|

Sa. 4 adhikaraṇavyākhyā nāma,-yadvastuprakṛtamārabhyatadanuṣaṅgeṇa vyākhyānamārabhyate| yathā (hṛ.sū. a.2)-"athāto dinacaryādhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ|" iti prastutya "brāhme muhūrta uttiṣṭhetsvastho rakṣārthamāyuṣaḥ|" ityādinā saiva dinacaryā vivṛtya vyākhyāyate savistarā|
Sa. 5 prakaraṇavyākhyā nāma,-yasminnarthe sūtre vā prakṛtenāprakṛtaṃ sādhyate, yathā-trilavaṇādye cūrṇe guṇānuktvā'bhayākhye evamāha 'samānaṃ pūrveṇa'iti| tatra samānaguṇatā vyākhyātā|

Sa. 6 arthavyākhyā nāma,-yatra prakaraṇe sūtre vā svabhāvasyopavarṇanaṃ kriyate| tadyathā,-prakṛtirucyate svabhāvaḥ| sa punarāhārauṣadhadravyāṇāṃ svābhāviko gurvādiguṇayogaḥ| tadyathā,-māṣamudgayoḥ sūkaraiṇayośca|

Sa. 7 kṛcchravyākhyā nāma,-yatra leśata uktānāmavispaṣṭanāṃ prakaraṇe sūtre vā arthānāṃ yatnata udbhāvanaṃ kriyate| tadyathā (hṛ.sū. a. 2/30)-"anuyāyātpratipadaṃ sarvadharmeṣu madhyamām|" iti leśato bruvāṇaḥ śāstrakāraḥ sarveṣu hetuliṅgauṣadhādiṣu madhyamā pratipadāśrayaṇīyeti sūcayati|

Sa. 8 phalavyākhyā nāma,-yatra vastuni bahuṣvaniścitārtheṣvekīyamateṣu prastuteṣu vastusārabhūtaṃ svamataṃ svamarthamupanikṣipyaikīyamatāni tasminneva svamate'ntarbhāvaṃ nayati| yathā-nirūhamātrāpuṭakādiṣviyattāyāṃ sādhyāyāṃ ca niścitāni maharṣirbhirbahūni matāni praśastāni| yathā-"dvādaśaprasṛto nirūhaḥ kāryaḥ" ityeke| "mātrāṃ tripalikāṃ kuryāt snehamākṣikayoḥ pṛthak|" (hṛ.sū. a.19/44) ityādyanye| tadetāni matāni doṣauṣadhabalāpekṣayā svamatāntarbhāvitāni pramāṇāni ca| yathoktam (hṛ.sū. a.19/62)-"doṣauṣadhādibalataḥ sarvametatpramāṇayet|" anyonyaviruddhamapi "samyaṅnirūḍhaliṅgaṃ tu nāsambhāvya nivartayet||" iti|

Sa. 9 uccitakavyākhyā nāma,-yasmin sūtre nidarśanabhūtānyudāharaṇāni tantrāntaḥ samakṛṣyārthaḥ śasyate| yathā-pṛthivyādiṣu ca mahābhūtasaṃjñā sthāpitā, rasādiṣu ca dhātusaṃjñā niveśitā| "rasāsṛṅmāṃsamedosthimajjaśukrāṇi dhātavaḥ|" (hṛ.sū. a. 1/13) iti| punarucyate (hṛ.śā. a.3/65)- "parasparopasaṃstambhāddhātusnehaparamparā|" iti| atra kiṃ dhātorgrahaṇena bhūtānyapi dhātuśabdavānyāni bhavanti ? iti|

Sa. 10 nyāsavyākhyā nāma,-yasminnadhikāre vartamāne tenādhikāraṇārthena sahitaṃ sambandhamabhivīkṣyānyasyārtho vinikṣipyate| yathā (hṛ.u. a.40/60)-"dṛśyante bhagavan kecidātmavanto'pi rogiṇaḥ|" iti hitāhitavibhāgasya phalaṃ prati saṃśayamabhivīkṣya "na cikitsā'cikitsā tulyā bhavitumarhati|" (hṛ.u. a.40/63) ityādinā uttaraṃ dattvā tenaiva prasaṅgenānyo'rtho nikṣipyate| yathā (hṛ.u. a. 40/75)-"etattadamṛtaṃ sākṣājjagadāyāsavarjitam| yāti hālāhalatvaṃ tu sadyo durbhājanasthitam||" iti| evamanyeṣāmapyarthānāṃ sambandhamavadhārya vyākhyārthārhā kalpanīyā|

Sa. 11 prayojanavyākhyā nāma,-yatsūtramabhidhīyamānaṃ svārthatya niṣpattau nimittabhāvamupaiti| yathā-ukto'ṅgavibhāge'nekadhāsirāvistaraḥ| na ca tena sirāvistareṇoktena kiñcidihopakāro dṛśyate| yadi prakaraṇāvasare prayojanamidaṃ brūyāt "ityavedhya vibhāgārthaṃ pratyaṅgaṃ varṇitāḥ sirāḥ|" (hṛ.śā. a. 3/33) etadarthaṃ sirāvivaraṇaṃ pravṛttam| kaścidayaṃ vaidyo vedhyāvedhyavibhāgaṃ sirāṇāṃ jānīyāditi|

Sa. 12 ānulomyaṃ nāma,-yena.....tatra 1-2 pradhānakalpanā dvidhā,-pradhānasya kalpanā pradhānena vā kalpanā pradhānakalpanā| pradhānasya kalpanā yathāsarpiḥ snehanam, kṣīraṃ jīvanam, madhu sandhānakṛt, ityatra madhye prakṛṣṭaguṇatvāt sarpiḥkṣīre snehanajīvane kalpyete, na tu tailatoyādiṣvapi snehanajīvanatvaṃ nāstīti| mākṣikaṃ ca sandhāne pradhānatvāt sandhānakṛdityuktam, na tu sikyakamadhuyaṣṭikādiṣvapi sandhānakṛttvaṃ nāstīti| pradhānena tu kalpanā yathā-kṣīradadhitakramastunavanītakṣīraghṛtapurāṇaghṛtakilāṭāpīyūṣakūcīkāmoraṇādivargaḥ sarvaḥ kṣīravarga ityuktaḥ, kṣīraprādhānyāt| pradhānena kalpanāvyapadeśa ityeko'rthaḥ|

Sa. 3 guṇakalpanā nāma,- yena dharmeṇopeto'rthaḥ prayujyamānaḥ samartho bhavati, tena dharmeṇa yuktasya tasyāsāvaguṇo'pi gurvādiṣvapāṭhādguṇa iti kalpyate| yathoktam (hṛ.sū. a.1/26)-"bhiṣak dravyāṇyupasthātā rogī pādacatuṣṭayam| cikitsitasya nirdiṣṭaṃ pratyekaṃ taccaturguṇam|| ityādi| dakṣatvādicaturguṇanirdeśaḥ sarvathā praśaṃsāguṇa iti gamyate|

Sa. 4 leśakalpanā nāma,-anupadiṣṭasya vidheḥ kaṇṭhapāṭhena yatkiñcisūtrāvayavāntaramāśrityārthaḥ kalpyate| yathā-nātra śāstre kālamṛtyorakālamṛtyorvā kiñcillakṣaṇaṃ praṇītam| tattu leśato'numīyate| kathamiti, yadā hi kālaniyatamāyuḥ kṣayaṃ prāptaṃ bhavati, tadā riṣṭamutpadyate, na viṣamāparihāreṇa mriyamāṇe nare| uktaṃ hi (hṛ.śā. a. 5/60)-"bhiṣagbheṣajapānānnagurumitradviṣaśca ye| vaśagāḥ sarva evaite vijñeyāḥ samavartinaḥ||" iti| atra vikṛtivijñānīye gurumitradviṣaśceti caśabdo'smācchlokāt pūrvakāṇi yāni cottarāṇi tāni sarvāṇyeva samuccinoti| samavartī hi kālo mṛtyuriṣṭaḥ, itarastvasamavartī| ata eva cācaṣṭe tantrāntare-"kālamṛtyoreva riṣṭāni nākālamṛtyoḥ|" iti svābhiprāyaprakāśanārthaṃ tantrakāraḥ śakaṭodāharaṇaṃ dattavān| yathā-sama eva vāhyamānaḥ svapramāṇakṣaye bhaṅgapūrvarūpāṇyāpnoti| tathā niyatāyuṣaḥ svapramāṇakṣaye riṣṭasambhavaḥ| yathā ca-sa evātibhārakrāntatvādviṣamapathāśritatvādakāle'pi kṣayamāpnoti| tathā aniyatāyuṣo riṣṭotpattimantareṇa mṛtyuḥ| yadi punaraniyatā yuṣṭo'pi riṣṭotpattipūrvaṃ maraṇaṃ kalpyeta, tadā vārṣike ṣāṇmāsike vā'riṣṭe samutpanne śubhahetuyogānna mṛtyuḥ syāt| aniyatāyuṣo hi samyagupacārājjīvitānuvṛttiḥ| viṣamahetvaparihārānmṛtyuḥ| ata evāniyatāyuṣamadhikṛtya rasāyanānyupadiṣṭani| tadyogādayaṃ bahūnyapi varṣāṇi jīvet| niyatāyuṣastu kālamṛtyuvarṣaśatāt pareṇa jīvitaṃ na nirdiṣṭam| yathoktaṃ śārīre (hṛ.śā.a. 5/132)_'maraṇaṃ prāṇināṃ dṛṣṭamāyuḥpuṇyobhayakṣayāt| tayorapyakṣayād dṛṣṭaṃ viṣamāparihāriṇām||" iti| tasmādaviśeṣoktāvapi niyatāyuṣa evāriṣṭotpattipūrvaṃ maraṇamiti niścitam| tathā ca "ṛtucaryādhyāyaṃ vyākhyākhyāsyāmaḥ|" (hṛ.sū. a.3) iti pratijñāyāṃ ṣaḍṛtuviśeṣe pratipattirbhavati| na tu "ṛtustu dvādaśa niśāḥ" (hṛ.śā. a.1/26) asya ṛtoriti|

Sa. 5 vidyākalpanā nāma,-yathā sarvavidyānugatārthanirdeśe śāstrakārasya sarvavidyāsthānānupraveśa iha śāstre hita iti vacanādvinā'pīṣyate| tatra "ārdrasantānatātyāgaḥ" (hṛ.sū. a. 2/45) ityādinā vākyena buddhivacanaviṣaya adhyātmavidyāsaṅgraha iṅgyate| "arcayeddevagovipra" (hṛ.sū. a. 2/23) ityādinā dharmaśāstropadeśasaṅgrahaḥ| tathā "jagadviṣaṇṇaṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvā tenāsau viṣasaṃjñitaḥ|" (hṛ.u. a. 35/2) ityādinā padavyutpādanānniruktakaraṇācca śabdavidyāyā nirakteścopasaṅgrahaḥ| "sādhake'hani" (hṛ.śā. a. 1/73) sūtikāṃ gṛhaṃ praveśayet| tathā-"bharaṇīkṛttikāśleṣāpūrvārdrāpitṛnairrūte|" iti jyotiḥśāstroparodhaḥ| vicitrabhūṣitaśāstrasyotprekṣaṇīyam|
Sa. 6 bhakṣyakalpanā nāma,-"etattadamṛtaṃ sākṣāt" (hṛ.u. a. 40/75) ityādi|

Sa. 7 ājñākalpanā nāma,-yasyānuṣṭhāne hetuḥ samyagavantuṃ na śakyaḥ, kevalamāptavacanaṃ pramāṇīkṛtyānuṣṭhīyate| yathā-"nachindyāttṛṇam, na bhuvaṃ likhet|" iti| na hyatra heturvaktuṃ śakyate, etadanuṣṭheyamiti|

Sa. iyaṃ saptavidhā kalpanā viṃśatyāśrayā bhavati| yathā-1 ādilopaḥ, 2 madhyalopaḥ, 3 antalopaḥ, 4 ubhayapadalopaḥ, 5 ādimadhyāntalopaḥ, 6 varṇopajananam, 7 ṛṣikliṣṭam, 8 tantraśīlam, 9 tantrasaṃjñā, 10 prākṛtam, 11 samānatantrapratyayaḥ, 12 paratantrapratyayaḥ, 13 hetuhetukadharmaḥ, 14 kāryakāraṇadharmaḥ, 15 ādyantaviparyayaḥ, 16 śabdāntaram, 17,pratyayaḥ 18 upanayaḥ 19 sambhavaḥ 20 vibhavaḥ, [iti|]

Sa. tatra 1 ādilopo [nāma],-yathā (hṛ.sū. 2|a.6/32)-"bṛṃhaṇaḥ prīṇano vṛṣyaścakṣuṣyo vraṇahā rasaḥ|" ityatramāṃsaśabdalopena| tathā ca (hṛ.ni. a. 1/14)-"dhāraṇodīraṇaniśā" ityādau dhāraṇaṃ-vegadhāraṇam, udīraṇaṃ-vegodīraṇamiti|

Sa. 2 madhlopo [nāma],- yathā(hṛ.sū. a. 5)-"dravadravyavijājānīyamadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ|" ityatra dravadravyasvarūpa vijñānīyo dravadravyavijñānīya ityuktaḥ, anantaraṃ "annasvarūpavijñānīyaḥ" (hṛ.sū. a.6) ityatra svarūpaśabdaśravaṇāt|

Sa. 3 antalopo nāma,-yathā (hṛ.śā. a. 3/37)-"kaphaṃ punaḥ| gauryaḥ snigdhāḥ śirāḥ śītā vahante" ityatrāsraśabdasya lopo draṣṭavyaḥ, pūrvatrāsraśabdasya prakṛtatvāt| yathoktam (hṛ.śā. a.3/36)-"tatra śyāvāruṇāḥ sūkṣmāḥ pūrṇariktāḥ kṣaṇāt sirāḥ| praspandinyaśca vātāsram" iti| evamihāpi kaphāsraṃ vahanta ityanumeyam, tulyajātīyatvāt|

Sa. 4 ubhayapadalopo [nāma],-yathā (hṛ.śā. a. 3/57)-"ādau ṣaḍrasamapyannaṃ madhurībhūtamīrayet|" iti vacane 'madhye' "vidhāhādamlatāṃ tataḥ|| pittamāmāśayātkuryāccyavamānaṃ cyutaṃ punaḥ|" 'ante' agninā śoṣitaṃ pakvaṃ piṇḍitaṃ kaṭu mārutam||" iti| ādiśabdaśravaṇāt madhyāntaśabdāvatra luptanirdiṣṭau draṣṭavyau|
Sa. 5 ādimadhyāntalopo [nāma], yathā(hṛ.śā. a.3/55)-"annaṃ kāle'bhyavahṛtaṃ" ādau "koṣṭhaṃ prāṇānilāhṛtam|" madhye, ante ca "dravaiḥ" ityādi|

Sa. 6 varṇopajananaṃ nāma,- yatrānukto granthe varṇa ācāryeṇa paścād vyākhyākāla upajanyārtho'bhidhīyate| [yathā] (hṛ.śā. a. 3/3)-"tatra khātkhāni dehe'smin śrotraṃ śabdo viviktatā|" tathā-"vātātsparśatvagucchvāsā vahnerdṛgrūpapaktayaḥ||" 'bhavanti' iti varṇatrayamupajanya vyākhyā karaṇīyā| "āpyā jihvārasakaledā ghrāṇagandhāsthi pārthivam|" iti dvayorbhūtayorbhavārthe taddhitapratyayaśravaṇāt| vākyaśeṣo'pyayamevaṃprāya eva|
Sa. 7 ṛṣikliṣṭaṃ nāma,-yadṛṣī ṛṣiputro vā'samāhitacittatayā'śaktyā vā kiñcitpadajātama(jātaṃ)bhraṣṭamuccāritavān tathaiva talloke prayuñyate| yathā-'roma loma' ityādi|

Sa. 8 tantraśīlaṃ nāma,-yā tantrakārāṇāṃ prakṛtiḥsvabhāva ityarthaḥ| yathā-kiñcicchaṣyānugrahārthaṃ vistīrṇaṃ saṅkṣipanti, yathā (hṛ.śā. a. 3/16)-"asthnāṃ śatāni ṣaṣṭiśca trīṇi dantanakhaiḥ saha|" iti na tānyaṅgulihastapādamaṇibandhādivibhāgena vistāritāni| kiñcidvistārayanti, yathā-tatraivāṅgavibhāge sirā vistāritāḥ (hṛ.śā. a. 3/33)-"ityavedhyavibhāgārthaṃ pratyaṅgaṃ varṇitāḥ sirāḥ|" iti vacanāditi|

Sa. 9 tantrasaṃjñā nāma,-yatkasmiṃścidarthe madhye vyākhyāyamāne svatantrasiddhodāharaṇaṃ tatpramāṇārthamucyate| yathā-navajvare kaṣāyā apakveṣu doṣeṣu varjanīyā uktāḥ, (hṛ.ci. a.1/39)- "tataḥ pakveṣu doṣeṣu laṅghanādyaiḥ praśasyate| kaṣāyo doṣaśeṣasya pācanaḥ śamano'thavā||" iti viśeṣavacanāttatra svarasādeḥ pañcavidhasya kaṣāyasya pratiṣedhaḥ prasaktaḥ| tataḥ svarantrasaṃjñayā viśeṣaḥ pratiṣidhyate (hṛ.ci. a. 1/40)-"tiktaḥ pitte viśeṣeṇa prayojyaḥ, kaṭukaḥ kaphe|" ityādi| tasmāt svatantrasaṃjñayā tiktakaṭukaṣayau niṣiddhau pañcavidhayā svarasādikalpanayā|
Sa. 10 prākṛtaṃ nāma,-"ūṣakastutthakaṃ hiṅgu kāsīsadvayasaindhavam|" (hṛ.sū. a. 15/23) ityauṣadhādhikārāt saindhavaṃlavaṇam, na tvaśvādikam||

Sa. 11 samānatantrapratyayo nāma,-yatsādhyasya kasyacidarthasya sādhanāyānupalabhyamāne svantrāt pratyaye samānebhyastantrebhyaḥ pratyaya iti| udāharaṇaṃ yathā (hṛ.sū. a. 2/31)- "nīcalomanakhaśmaśruḥ" ityācāreṣūktam| iyadbhiriyadbhirdinaiḥ keśanakhaśmaśruṇyavatārya nīcalomādinā bhavitavyamiti noktam| tato vyākhyākārāḥ kṣārapāṇiprabhṛtayaḥ prasiddhyā daśarātreṇa keśādiṇāṃ saṃharaṇamiti niścinvanti| munistvavādīt (ca.sū. a. 8/18)-"triḥ pakṣasya keśaśmaśrulomanakhān saṃhārayet|" iti|

Sa. 12 paratantrapratyayo nāma,-yasyārthasya prasiddhito na svakīyamudāharaṇaṃ śakyamabhidhātuṃ nāpyanyebhyo bhiṣaktantrebhyaḥ| tatastasmin dvaye paratantrādudāharaṇaṃ kalpyate| yathā (hṛ.sū. a. 1/19)-"kālārthakarmaṇāṃ yogo hīnamithyātimātrakaḥ| samyagyogaśca vijñeyo rogārogyaikakāraṇam||" ityuktam| yogasya ca lakṣaṇaṃ noktaṃ tantre anyatra vā bhiṣaktantre| tatra bauddhatantrapratyayena niścīyate-"svahetubhyaḥ śītoṣṇādilakṣaṇena kālasyotpattireva yogaḥ|" iti|

Sa. 13 hetuhetukadharmau nāma,-yo hetuhetukena dharmo jñāyate| yathā-pittātisāriṇaḥ pittalātisevanāt pittamudriktaṃ raktātisārāya na cirādasya bhaviṣyatītyanumīyate, samarthasya hetoḥ svakāryasyāvyabhicārāt|

Sa. 14 kāryakāraṇadharmo nāma,-yatra kāryasaṃjñayā kāraṇaṃ nirdiśyate kāraṇasaṃjñayā vā kāryam, tatra kāryasaṃjñayā tāvatkāraṇaṃ nirdiśyate| yathā-doṣā api rogaśabdaṃ labhante| tatra doṣāḥ kāraṇam, "sarveṣāmeva rogāṇāṃ nidānaṃ kupitā malāḥ|" (hṛ.ni. a.1/12) iti vacanāt| sa cedānīṃ doṣo roga iti vyapadiśyamānaḥ kāraṇe doṣe kāryaṃ roga upacarito bhavati| evaṃ kāryaṃ kāraṇasaṃjñayā nirdiśyate|

Sa. 15 ādyantaviparyayo nāma,-yathā-annasvarūpavijñānaṃ prāptumujjhitvā pānameva prathamamuktaṃ dravadravyavijñānaṃ kurvatā, toyādīnāṃ pañcānāṃ vargāṇāmalpavaktavyatvāt| samudropamatayā śāstrasyānupūrvasukhāvagāhanārtham, pūrvaṃ hyalpaṃ sukhenāvagāhyate paścātprabhūtamiti nyāyāt|
Sa. 16 śabdānyatvaṃ nāma, yadarthaṃ paryāyaśabdaṃ varṇayanti śāstrakṛtaḥ| yathā (hṛ.ni. a. 1/1)-"rogaḥ pāpmā jvarovyādhirvikāro duḥkhamāmayaḥ| yakṣmātaṅkagadābādhāḥ śabdāḥ paryāyavācinaḥ||' ityādi|

Sa. 17 pratyayadharmo nāma,-yo na ca heturhetudharmopapattimātreṇa ca kenaciddhetutvena vyapadiśyate| yathā-devadānavagandharvādyunmādāpasmārādivicitragrahavikārā uktāḥ| yathoktam (hṛ.u. a.4/13)-"phullapadmopamamukhaṃ sau-myadṛṣṭimakopanam|" yāvat "anidramapradhṛṣyaṃ ca vidyāddevavaśīkṛtam||" ityādi| nacaite paramārthato hetavaḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? prajñāparādhaḥ| tathā coktam (hṛ.u. a. 4/3)-"hetustadanuṣaktau tu sadyaḥ pūrvakṛto'thavā| prajñāparādhaḥ sutarām" iti|

Sa. 18 upanayo nāma,-sūtrahetuprastāvena yatrānyatprakaraṇamupanīyate| yathā-mātrāśitīye āhāramātrālakṣaṇaprastāve atimātrabhojananimittāyā visūcikāyāścikitsā upanītā| mātrāyāṃ hi vibhajyamānāyāmavaśyamūnātimātre'pi vibhajanīye tadapekṣayā mātrāyāḥ samyak pratipādanasaukaryāt tatprastāvena ca visūcikāyāścikitsā|

Sa. 19 sambhavo nāma,-yatsūtraṃ prakaraṇaṃ vā vidhīyamānamarthasya vyāpakatvāt sakalena śāstreṇa vyākhyāyate| yathā (hṛ.sū. a. 1/5)-"kāyabālagrahordhvāṅgaśalyadaṃṣṭrājarāvṛṣān| aṣṭāvaṅgāni tasyāhuścikitsā yeṣu saṃśritā||" iti| etānyaṣṭāvaṅgāni sakalena śāstreṇopadiśyanta ityācāryaḥ pratijānīte|
Sa. 20 bhaṅgyā....vibhavakalpanāyā ścāsyāyaṃ viśeṣaḥ| ayaṃ vyākhyāyā vibhavo bhavati| sa tu vinaiva vyākhyāyāḥ paṭhyamāna eveti|

Sa. saptadaśa tācchīlyādī[nī]tyuktam| tadyathā-1 tācchīlyam, 2 avayavaḥ, 3 vikāraḥ, 4 sāmīpyam, 5 bhūyastvam, 6 prakāraḥ, 7 guṇiguṇavibhavaḥ, 8 saṃsaktatā, 9 taddharmatā, 10 sthānam, 11 tādarthyam, 12 sāhacaryam, 13 karma, 14 guṇanimittatā, 15 ceṣṭānimittatā, 16 mūlasaṃjñā, 17 tātsthyam, iti|

Sa. tatra 1 tācchīlyaṃ nāma,-yatkenacideva dharmasādṛśyena yukto bhāvastācchīlyamucyate| yathā (hṛ.ni. a. 15/15)- "sarvāṅgasaṃśrayastodabhedasphuraṇabhañjanam| stambhanākṣepaṇasvāpasandhyākuñcanakampanam|| kupito'nilaḥ karoti|" ityante na cāṅani svapanti| kiṃ tarhi ? devadattaḥ svapiti| taddharmasādṛśyādaṅgāni svāpaśabdenocyante| tadyathā-"puruṣaḥ supto na kiñcidvedayate| na cetayate| tathā'ṅgamapi yatkiñcinna vedayate nakhatodādi| tatsuptamiva supatamityucyate|" [iti|]

Sa. 2 avayavo nāma,-yatraikadeśodāharaṇe kriyamāṇe'nukto'nyo'pi tajjātīyako'rtho labhyate| yathā (hṛ.ci. a.1/3)_"laṅghanaiḥ kṣapite doṣe dīpte'gnau lāghave sati| svāsthyaṃ kṣuttṛḍruciḥ paktirbalamojaśca jāyate||" ityanenaikadeśodāharaṇena laṅghanena doṣakṣapaṇena lāghave sati svāsthyādyutpattiḥ| tatpratipakṣeṇa tvalaṅghanena doṣakṣapaṇe na jāte satyasvāsthyādayo'nuktā api labhyante|

Sa. 3 vikāro nāma,-viparītakriyā| yathā-vikārasaṃjñayā prakṛtirapi labhyate| prakṛtisaṃjñayā ca vikāraḥ| tatra vikārasaṃjñayā ca prakṛtiryathā (hṛ.sū. a. 6/114)-"puṣpe patre phale nāle kande ca gurutā kramāt|" [iti] śākamadhikṛtyoktam| atra prakṛtiḥ pāṭhāśūkā(ṣā)dīnāṃ patrādīni| tāni hi pākena vikriyamāṇāni cāvasthāntaraṃ pratipadyamānāni śākasaṃjñāṃ labhante| tadayaṃ śāstrakārasteṣāṃ vikārasaṃjñāṃ, yavādimaṇḍadisaṃjñāyā yavādikaṃ coktavān|

Sa. 4 [samīpyaṃ nāma,-] ..................5 bhūyastvaṃ nāma,-yadekasmin vartamānamādhikyena kvacillabhyate| yathā tantre (ca.sū. a.26/42)-"amlo bhaktaṃ rocayati" ityuktam, na ca madhurādirapi na rocayatīti| kasyaciccāmlavidveṣiṇo'mlo raso bhaktavidveṣameva kuryāt| tatra bhūyastvamāśrityedamuktam-'amlo rocayati|' kadācit kasyacidvā nāsau rocayenna tāvatā tanna rocanam|
Sa. 6 prakāro nāma,-yo yasya samānadarmā sa tasya prakāraḥ| yathā-"kaṇṭhameraṇḍanālena spṛśan vamet|" ityuktam| na ca tatprakārāṇāṃ suvarcalāśatapuṣpādinālānāṃ na grahaṇam|

Sa. 7 guṇiguṇavibhavo nāma,-kvacit guṇīni guṇaśabdenoktāni| yasmādāha (hṛ.śā. a. 3/60)-"pārthivāḥ pārthivāneva" iti| na hi pārthivā guṇāḥ santi kecit, ye paṭhyeran| guṇaśca guṇivadyathā (hṛ.u. a. 39/23)-"medhāsmṛtibalopetā babhūvuramitāyuṣaḥ|" iti| atrāyurguṇopetamamitatvam| nāyuṣaḥ parimāṇaguṇa āyurguṇenaiva śakyaḥ|

Sa. 8 saṃsaktatā nāma,-yadekasya bahubhiḥ sambandhaḥ| yathāvidyamāneṣvapi tatrānyeṣu sambandheṣu tasyaiva vyapadeśaḥ kriyate| yathā-madhuraskandhanirdeśena mākṣikādayo guṇitāḥ kaṣāyādirasopeto api madhuraprāyatvānmadhurasaṃsaktatayā|

Sa. 9 taddharmatā nāma,-yena tathābhūtaṃ sattaddharmatāmāsādya darśanāttāmevākhyāṃ labhate| yathā (hṛ.u. a. 40/76)-"vivarjayedbhiṣakpāśān pāśān vaivasvatāniva|" iti| māraṇadharmo hi vaivasvatapāśena samāno dṛṣṭa ityataste'pi tathaivoktāḥ|

Sa. 10 sthānaṃ nāma,-yatra sthāninā sthānaṃ sthānena vā sthānī vyapadiśyate| tatra sthāninā sthānaṃ yathā-karṇanādaḥ śrotraroga ityuktaḥ| na ca śrotrendriyasyāstinādaḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? tadadhiṣṭhānasya karṇasya| tasmādayaṃ śrotreṇa sthāninā karṇamadhiṣṭhānamuktavān| sthānena sthānī yathā-jihvā rasaṃ gṛhṇāti| tatra na jihvā rasaṃ gṛhṇāti, kiṃ tarhi ? rasanā|
Sa. 11 tādarthyaṃ nāma,-yatprayojanārthaṃ pravartate yo bhāvastenaiva vyapadiśyate| yathā (hṛ.sū. a. 15/1)-"madanamadhukalambā" ityādīni chardanāni,-chardanaprayojanānītyarthaḥ|

Sa. 12 sāhacaryaṃ nāma,-yo yena nityaṃ sambandha upalabhyate, sa tasmāt sambandhāttameva sambandhiśabdaṃ labhate| tathā-'mathyamānād dhūmaṃ dṛṣṭvā jvaladbhāsuraṃ vahnidravyamavaśyamabhyutthito vahnirityeva|

Sa. 13 karma nāma,-yatra karmakarmeti copacaryate| yathocyate "munayaḥ praśamaṃ jagmuḥ|" na cāgrāmasthānīyaḥ kaścitpraśamo'sti| kiṃ tarhi ? indriyāṇāṃ viṣayebhyaḥ kevalaṃ śaktiniyamaḥ praśamaḥ| atha ca gatiḥ-karmaviṣayebhyastivandriyāṇāṃ kriyānivṛttiḥ| tadeva ca karmetyuktam|

Sa. 14 guṇanimittaṃ nāma,-yatkasya vibhūtiḥ praśaṃsādikā khyāpyate| "dharmyaṃ yaśasyamāyuṣyaṃ lokadvaparāyaṇam| anumodāmahe brahmacaryamekāntinirmalam||" (hṛ.u. a. 40/4) iti brahmacaryasya praśaṃsāvibhūtiḥ khyāpyate| vrahmacaryasya hīme guṇāḥ, nābrahmacaryasyeti|

Sa. 15 ceṣṭānimittaṃ nāma,-yasminnāmamātraṃ kasyacit kriyayā bhavati bhāvasya| nātra praspandakriyeṣṭā| yathā-"dīpavadasya jñānaṃ jvalati|" ityucyate| na ca jñānasya pradīpasyevārcīṃṣi santi ūrdhvagāmīni, dīpavadvā sannikṛṣṭāni dravyāntarāṇi dahanti| rūpaṃ vā sparśaṃ vā tailādikopādānam| kintu prakāśakriyāmātraṃ parigṛhya jvalatīti praśaṃsākarmaṇi krodhabhayaśokalobhaharṣerṣyāmohādibhirupahataṃ vijñānaṃ malopahatadarpaṇavadaprakāśavṛtti bhavet|

Sa. 16 mūlasaṃjñā nāma,-yā loke'nyasminnarthe prasiddhā tantre cānyasmin [arthe] niveśitā| yathā (hṛ.ni. a. 1/2)-"nidānaṃ pūrvarūpāṇi rūpāṇyupaśayastathā| samprāptiśca" iti| rūpaṃ ca loke nīlapītalohitādi prasiddham, svaśāstre saṃjñayā tu rūpaṃ-liṅgaṃ lakṣaṇamiti|

Sa. 17 tātsthyaṃ nāma,-yadanyasyaivārthasya tatsthatvādanyasyaiva kalpyate| tadyathā (hṛ. ni. a.10/23)-"bastimehanayoḥ śūlam" iti| tatra puṃsaṃsthena kāraṇena bastimehanayoriti kalpyate| caitanyābhāve bastimehanayoḥ satorapi śūlābhāvāt tatpradeśasthi tatvāttayorityucaryate|

Sa. tathā tantradoṣaiḥ pañcadaśabhiraprasiddhaśabdādibhirvarjitam| [ tadyathā-]1 aprasiddhaśabdam, 2 duḥpraṇītam, 3 asaṅgatārtham, 4 asukhārohi, 5 viruddham, 6 ativistṛtam, 7 atisaṃkṣiptam, 8 aprayojanam, 9 bhinnakramam, 10 saṃdigdham, 11 punaruktam, 12 niḥpramāṇakam, 13 asamāptārtham, 14 apā(na)rthakam, 15 vyāhatam, [iti]|

Sa. tatra 1 aprasiddhaśabdam nāma,-yalloke nātīva prasiddham| yathā-"udakyāgamanalakṣaṇamasukhānām|" iti| yathā vā "ādhārasyāsipāṇidhāreṣvakuśalayogatā|" iti| asyārthaḥ,-akunāma vṛkṣaḥ tasya śalamiti|
Sa. 2 duḥpraṇītaṃ nāma,- sūtrabhāṣyaprayojanarahitam|
Sa. 3 asaṅgatārthaṃ nāma,- yatsūtreṇāsambaddham|
Sa. 4 asukhārohi padaṃ nāma,-yatpadasanniveśasya viṣamatayā duḥkhenoccāryate, carkarītādiprāyam| yathā-"dhātaryaripradam|" iti|

Sa. 5 viruddhaṃ nāma,-yad dṛṣṭāntasiddhāntasamayairviruddham| yathā kaścidvadennityaḥ puruṣo'kṛtakatvāditi hetuḥ, ghaṭa iti dṛṣṭāntaviruddham| tathā-madhurāmlalavaṇāḥ kaphaṃ śamayanti, kaṭutiktakaṣāyā vātaṃ jayanti, iti vaidyakasiddhāntaviruddha metat| samayaviruddhaṃ nāma,-yathā-yaḥ samayaḥ pūrvācāryaistattvadarśibhiḥ kṛtastaṃ vyutkramyāgacchati| yathā-"na loṣṭaṃ vimṛdgīyāt, na tṛṇaṃ chindyāt," iti| etat tattvadarśibhiruktatvālloṣṭamardanādi na kriyate| na tu heturatrāsti| 6 ativistṛtaṃ nāma,-yathā-madhurādiskandhaṃ bruvan yāvanti madhurāṇi jagati santi madhuraprāyāṇi madhuraprabhavāṇi tānyaśeṣāṇi yadyabhidadhāti, tadā'tivistṛtatvaṃ syāt| 7 atisaṃkṣiptaṃ nāma,-yathā-yogaśatakaprāyam| yathā vā-hetuliṅgauṣadhoddeśa eva kriyate, na tu tadavabodhakavākyānāmiti śeṣaḥ| 8 aprayojanaṃ nāma,-yathā (hṛ.sū. a. 2/48)-"ityācāraḥ samāsena" ityetāvadyadi vadet, na tu brūyāt "yaṃ prāpnoti samācaran| āyurārogyamaiśvaryam" ityādi, tadā na kaścidanutiṣṭhediti|

Sa. 9 bhinnakramaṃ nāma,-pūrvaṃ yenānukrameṇoktaṃ na tenaiva nirdiśyate prayojanāntarāsambhave'pi| yathā-vātapittakaphānuddiśya "tatra rūkṣo laghuḥ (hṛ.sū. a.1/11) ityādau vātaguṇanirdeśamakṛtvaiva pittasya vidadhīta| evaṃ kramo bhinno bhavet
Sa. 10 saṃdigdhaṃ nāma,-yathā-'kimakālamṛtyurasti utanāsti ?" ityubhayatra hetvābhāsaparigrahāt saṃśayaḥ|
Sa. 11 punaruktaṃ nāma,-yo'rtha ukto'pi punarucyate|
Sa. 12 niḥpramāṇaṃ nāma,-yathā (hṛ.ci. a. 1/46)-"pākyaṃ śītakaṣāyaṃ vā mustāparpaṭakam" iti| .........
Sa. 13 [asamāptārthaṃ nāma,-]............atra tāvaducyate| parato'pi cedityetattataḥ samāptārthatvānna jñāyate kimanena kāryamiti|
Sa. 14 anarthakaṃ nāma,-yadanyārthenāpi padenāpagatābhidheyam||1|

Sa. 15 vyāhataṃ nāma,-yathā-pūrvayā vākyayuktyā'parā vyāhanyate, aparayā pūrvā vā| yathā-"anāsthāpyā mehinaḥ" (hṛ.sū. a. 19/4) ityuktvā punarāsthāpanamanujajñe| mustāderniryūhe papāṭha (hṛ.ka. a. 4/40)-"vātāsṛkśophamehārśogulmaviṇmūtrasaṅgraham|" ityādi| tadatra vidhipratiṣedhayoḥ parasparavirodhādvyāhatatvam| atra samādhānārthaṃ vipulamataya evamabhidadhuḥ,-pramehiṇamāsthāpyaniṣedhādbastikalpe punaranujñānāt tantrakṛto'bhiprāyaviśeṣa īdṛganumīyate,-mehino vātasya prabalatvena bastimantareṇa nānyastathāvidha upakramo'ti, tasmāttasyāvasthāturavaśādyojyo bastiḥ| yadā''rtamehino dṛśyate pavanasyālpatve(tvaṃ), tadopakramāntareṇaiva cikitsituṃ śakya iti, tadā bastirna yojya iti pratipādayitumevaṃvidho vinyāsaḥ kṛtaḥ| iti-pūrvoktaiḥ, tantraguṇaiḥ-tantrayuktyākhyairyuktam, tantradoṣaiḥ-aprasiddhaśabdādibhirvarjitam, alpasamudyamānāṃ-stokavyāyāmānāṃ, prītyarthaṃ pṛthagevedaṃ tantramuktam| kimbhūtam ? cikitsāśāstram,-śatasahasraṃ brahmaproktamagniveśādipraṇitaṃ vā, vyāpya paritaḥ-samantāt, sthitam| na caitat svamanīṣānirūpitamityāha-vipuletyādi| vipulaṃ-vistīrṇaṃ samastavastuviṣayaṃ, amalaṃ nirmalamaviparyastaṃ, vijānaṃ yeṣāṃ mahāmunīnāṃ-ātreyādīnāṃ, ta evam| te ca te vipulāmalavijñānamahāmunayaśca| teṣāṃ mataṃ abhiprāyaḥ, tadanu gacchati-anuvartate, yattat vipulāmalavijñānamahāmunimatānugam| nanu, saṅgraheṇaiva mahāmunitaṃ saṅgṛhītam| tatkimanena ? ityāha-mahāsāgara iva gambhīro yaḥ saṅgrahākhyastasyopalakṣaṇaṃ-upāya[na]bhūtametat| tasmāt pṛthagetat tantramuditam| aṣṭāvaṅgāni yasya tadevam, aṣṭāṅgaṃ ca tadvaidyakaṃ ca, tadeva mahodadhiraṣṭāṅgavaidyakamahodadhiḥ, tasya manthanamiva manthanaṃ-pāṭhaśravaṇacintanādibhirvikṣobhaṇāt, tena karaṇabhūtena| yo'ṣṭāṅgasaṅgraha eva mahānamṛtarāśirāptaḥ| tasmāt-aṣṭāṅgasaṅgrahamahāmṛtarāśeḥ sakāśāt, pṛthagetattantramuditam| kīdṛśam ? analpaṃ phalaṃ-āyurārogyaiśvaryasukhādikaṃ yasya tadevaṃ, mahāphalamityarthaḥ| tadayaṃ bhāvaḥ,-tantrasyāsyālpatvāt pāṭhādiṣu svalpa evāyāso bhavati mahacca phalaṃ yataḥ syāt, tato'yamādaraṇīya ityarthaḥ| vasantatilakaṃ vṛttam|

ab.seg: idamāgamasiddhatvātpratyakṣaphaladarśanāt| mantravatsaṃprayoktavyaṃ na mīmāṃsyaṃ kathañcana||81||

div.ab: Sa. saṃ-idaṃ-anantarābhihitaṃ tantraṃ, mantravadācaritaṃ saṃprayoktavyam| na kathañcidapi mīmāṃsyam,-kimidaṃ syādvā naveti saṃśayo na kārya ityarthaḥ| kasmāt ? suviśuddhajñānebhyo mahāmunibhya āgamena śuddhatvāt, tathā pratyakṣaphalasya-jvaracikitsādikasya, darśanāt|

ab.seg: dīrghajīvitamārogyaṃ dharmamarthaṃ sukhaṃ yaśaḥ| pāṭhāvabodhānuṣṭhānairadhigacchatyato dhruvam||82||

div.ab: Sa. saṃ-ataḥ-aṣṭāṅgahṛdayākhyāttantrāt, pāṭhāvabodhānuṣṭhānaiḥ-rogacikitsālakṣaṇena, dhruvaṃ-avaśyaṃ, dīrghajīvitādīn prāpnoti| na ca tāneva prāpnoti| kiṃ tarhi ? paramapītyāha-

ab.seg: etatpaṭhan saṅgrahabodhaśaktaḥ svabhyastakarmā bhiṣagaprakampyaḥ| ākampayatyanyaviśālatantra- kṛtābhiyogān yadi tanna citram||83||

div.ab: Sa. saṃ-etat-anantaroktamaṣṭāṅgahṛdayākhyaṃ tantraṃ, adhīyānaḥ(paṭhan)-kaṇṭhe dadhat, saṅgrahabodhaśaktaḥ-etadgranthārthaviśeṣa-śeṣavastvavabodhārtham| tasmāt svabhyastakarmā ata eva pāṭhāvabodhaḥ| svabhyastakarmā-tasya guṇaśatayogādaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasya vyākhyānāmanyeṣāṃ bheṣajakarmajena satsvabhyastakarmaṇā cikitsakaḥ, akṣobhyaḥ san, anyeṣu-carakādiṣu, viśālatantreṣu vihitābhiyogān vaidyān yadi kampayati-kṣobhayati, tannāścaryam| upajātirvṛtam| yathā cākampayante'pare bhiṣajastathā darśayannāha-

ab.seg: yadi carakamadhīte tad dhruvaṃ suśrutādi- praṇigaditagadānāṃ nāmamātre'pi bāhyaḥ| atha carakavihīnaḥ prakriyāyāmakhinnaḥ kimiva khalu karotu vyādhitānāṃ varākaḥ||84||

div.ab: Sa. saṃ-yadi kevalaṃ carakaṃ paṭhati tatastasmāt suśrutādipraṇigaditānāṃ-vartmasandhisitādijānāṃ rogāṇāṃ, dhruvaṃ saṃjñāmātrāvabodhe'pi bāhyaḥ| kintu hetulakṣaṇopakrameṇānabhijña ityapiśabdārthaḥ| atha carakavihīnaḥ kevalaṃ suśrutapāṭhasādhyaprakriyāyāṃ doṣadūṣyakālabalaśarīrasattvasātmyādilakṣaṇāyāṃ, akhinnaḥ san vyādhitānāṃ-kāsaśvāsādyabhibhūtānāṃ, kimiva varākaḥ-alpadhīḥ, vidadhātu ? na kiñcidvidadhātuṃ śakta ityarthaḥ| iha tu carakoktaprakriyāyāḥ pratipādanāt suśrutoktāmayābhidhānācca tadadhyetā rogacikitsāyāṃ pravartamāno rogaśānti dhruvaṃ vidadhātyeva| mālinīvṛttam|

ab.seg: athaiva manyase yadyapi tatra tantrametadguṇam, tathā'pyārṣatantrādhyayane samādhānātiśaya iti| tata idamāha---- abhiniveśavaśādabhiyujyate subhaṇite'pi na yo dṛḍhamūḍhakaḥ| paṭhatu yatnaparaḥ puruṣāyuṣaṃ sa khalu vaidyakamādyamanirvidaḥ||85||

div.ab: Sa. saṃ-abhiniveśo-vastupakṣapātaḥ, tasya vaśaḥ-sāmarthyaṃ, tasmāt| anyatra guṇadoṣāvabhiyoktā śobhanokte'pi tantre yonābhiyujyate-ṛṣipraṇīte prītiṃ karoti, sa nara ādau bhavamādyaṃ,-prathamapraṇītaṃ brahmoktaṃ śatasāhasraṃ, vaidyakaṃ yatnaparastathā anirvedaḥ san puruṣāyuṣaṃ-varṣaśataṃ, paṭhatu| kilāsmin kāle hīyamānabuddhimedhājīvitasya puruṣasya śravaṇacintanāvabodhānuṣṭhānāni sudūrotsāritānyevetyarthaḥ| puruṣāyuṣamityacaturādisūtre nipātitam| [ drutavilambitaṃ vṛttam| ]

ab.seg: athaivaṃ manyase vaktṛtvaviśeṣādavaśyamevārthātiśayo bhavati| tasmādādyeṣu sukṛteṣvevābhiyogo yukto, na tvidānīntanakavikṛteṣviti, tadetanna vācyam| kutaḥ ? ityāha---- vāte pitte śleṣmaśāntau ca pathyaṃ tailaṃ sarpirmākṣikaṃ ca krameṇa| etad brahmā bhāṣatāṃ brahajo vā kā nirmantre vaktṛbhedoktiśaktiḥ||86||

div.ab: Sa. saṃ-vāte tailaṃ pathyaṃ, pitte ghṛtaṃ pathyaṃ, śleṣmākṣikaṃ pathyaṃ, yathākramam| ityevaṃ bhagavān brahmā bhāṣatām, brahmajo vā-sanatkumārādiḥ, bhāṇatu| nirmantre-aśabdasvabhāve tailādike svākarata utpanne, vātādiśamanaśaktervaktṛviśeṣoktyā śaktirna kācidityarthaḥ| śālinīvṛttam|

ab.seg: tadevopasaṃharan spaṣṭayati ---- abhidhātṛvaśāt kiṃ vā dravyaśaktirviśiṣyate| ato matsaramutsṛjya mādhyasthyamavalambyatām||87||

div.ab: Sa. vaktṛvaśāt kiṃ tailāderdravyasya śaktirviśiṣyate ? api tu na kaścideva viśeṣa utpadyate| yataḥ svabhāvahetubhya eva etacchaktiyuktāścotpannāḥ| ato-vidhātṛśād dravyaśaktiviśeṣalakṣaṇāddhetoḥ, matsaramutsṛjya-vidveṣaṃ vihāya, mādhyasthyamāśrīyatām| madhyastho hi puruṣaḥ kālabudhdyādyanurūpamidameva śāstramupakārakaṃ mama, na tvato'paraṃ śāstramupakārakaṃ buddhyā parāmarśyādhyeṣyate, na tvajñānābhiniveśāgrahametītyarthaḥ|

ab.seg: nanu, kimasmākamupakārakatvādidvāreṇa ṛṣipraṇītameva tantramanurāgavaśādadhyeṣyam ? ityāśaṅkyāha ---- ṛṣipraṇīte prītiścenmuktvā carakasuśrutau| bheḍādyāḥ kiṃ na paṭhyante tasmādgrāhyaṃ subhāṣitam||88||

div.ab: Sa. yadi ṛṣipraṇīte prītistataścarakasuśrutākhyau hitvā bheḍajātūkarṇyādimunipraṇītāni śāstrāṇi kimiti na paṭhyante sarveṇaiva vaidyavṛndena| api tu subhāṣitapriyatayā carakasuśrutau bāhulyena yathā paṭhyete, na tathā bheḍādayaḥ| tasmātsthitametat subhāṣitaṃ grāhyam, na tu munipraṇītameva tantram| ataścarakasuśrutavadanārṣamapīdaṃ guṇavattvānmatimadbhirgrāhyameva|

hṛdaya hṛdayametatsarvāyurvedavāṅmayapayodheḥ| kṛtvā yacchubhamāptaṃ śubhamastu paraṃ tato jagataḥ|89| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭavira- citāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttara- sthāne vājīkaraṇavidhirnāma catvā- riṃśo'dhyāyaḥ|40|

Sa. saṃ-etat-hṛdayākhyaṃ tantraṃ, hṛdayamiva| kasya ? sarvāyurvedavāṅmayapayodheḥ| yathā hṛdayaṃ śarīrasyaikadeśamapi daśabhirmūlasirābhiḥ sakalaṃ kāyaṃ vyāpnoti, tathedamapi ṣaḍbhiḥ sthānaiḥ sakalamaṣṭāṅgāyurvedavāṅmayaṃ vyāpya sthitamiti sādharmyāt| tadevamīdṛśaṃ hṛdayaṃ kṛtvā-vidhāya, yatkalyāṇaṃ paraṃ-śreṣṭhaṃ, prāptaṃ [ tataḥ- ] tasmācchubhāt, jagataḥ-bhuvanasya, maṅgalaṃ bhavatviti| āryā| iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṛdaya- ṭīkāyāṃ sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne vājīkaraṇa- vidhirnāma catvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 40|| iti vājīkaraṇamaṣṭamamaṅgaṃ samāptaṃ|
